Even if it’s against Lee Jae-shin, Korea’s first S-class raider. He was a strong man who could not guarantee victory or defeat.
However, a moment ago, Min Seong-oh said it directly.
There is a being behind Min Jae-hyeon who is so strong that he cannot use his hands.
Yoo Seon-jae was curious.
What kind of person was he to let such words come out of Min Seong-oh’s mouth so strong?
And how does Jaehyun come into contact with such a big man?
* * *
After that, the theory class was held again for several days.
No wonder.
This is because the theory classes are always arranged like this a few days before the event.
Even on the Milles Academy side, large events require a lot of manpower, so it gets messy and hectic for a while.
Both teachers and students are burdened with each other. This means that there is no room for practical classes.
Thanks to this, Jaehyun was feeling bored with the repeated theory classes recently.
‘Since I’ve read all the sorcery books in this library…’
In fact, Jaehyun visited all the libraries in the grounds of Milles Academy and read all the sorcery books called sorcery books.
It was a rare item in the first place, so there weren’t many copies, and it was also thanks to the endurance stat that Jaehyun had recorded in advance, so he didn’t get tired.
Anyway, it wasn’t enough that he read all the books, so he memorized all the textbooks.
After that, it was annoying to study separately, and it was because I decided that it would be better to do it while sitting in a chair.
In addition to that, Jaehyun was making remarkable progress in his actual combat experience.
After upgrading 《Magic Arrow》 once, the next one was not difficult. He also succeeded in raising the level of a few other low-level skills little by little.
Perhaps an achievement like this will make him safer for the next event.
Use magic repeatedly.
It is realized by analyzing the expression and infusing magic power.
It may not seem like a big deal once you realize it, but Jaehyun has gone over the wall one step further.
‘good. It goes smoothly like this.’
Jaehyun was satisfied, but he couldn’t hide his regret.
‘The three concepts written in the 4-star magic book. During Creation Destruction Amplification, only Amplification Destruction. I only learned two.
Even that was destroyed because of «Absolute Calculation». I can’t say I understood it fundamentally.’
Despite trying so hard, I still haven’t been able to get rid of all the 4-star magic books.
It’s a growth rate that others would be shocked to see, but it was just a lack of time for Jaehyun.
As Hella said, he must become a new slayer and grow several times faster than he is now.
Four remaining trials.
No matter how you think about it, the future was not easy.
As Jaehyun calmed himself down again, he suddenly heard the instructor’s voice.
“So… that’s why Yggdrasil rose up in the middle of the Pacific Ocean…”
A dull voice.
In other places, you may wake up and hear that your voice is good, but in class like this, it is just a voice that makes you feel drowsy.
In fact, Jaehyun was barely holding back his sleepiness.
To make Raider’s natural body drowsy with just his voice.
‘Are you using ‘Slip’?’
Jaehyun is thinking foolish thoughts. Suddenly, the instructor asked.
“Cadet Min Jae-hyeon. Can you explain the history and appearances of magic?”
Is it because I sighed too loudly?
The instructor pinpointed Jaehyun and asked a question.
Jaehyun was stunned, but soon regained his composure and replied.
“It has been about 10 years since the Demonic Beasts spread. As the Awakeners who obtained the Aesir system appeared, a magical language called rune language appeared in the world.
This is a science that draws out a phenomenon by pouring magic power into an arithmetic formula…” “
Enough. That’s a great answer if you stop.”
It seemed that the instructor was just checking to see if Jaehyun was paying attention in class.
but. There’s no way a cadet who only sighs deeply is studying.
However, apart from that, Jaehyun’s grades were very good.
Always perfect scores in paper tests and practical skills.
I haven’t taken the regular exam yet, so I’m not sure, but it’s probably as if I’ve secured a top grade.
Miles’ policy here.
monopoly of the strong.
Jaehyun was clearly a strong player here.
And Miles overlooks most of the mistakes of these strong players.
‘There is no reason not to use it.’
Jaehyun laughed inwardly.
This time, I opened another book, pretending to be quietly attending class without revealing it outwardly.
After a while.
Not long after, the instructor got lucky by ending class early.
“Now, I have a message for you. All sleepy cadets, please open your eyes.”
There was a sense of tension in the classroom, which had been relaxed at those words.
Now they also knew.
In an event that is officially held like this, it is not strange that anything happens, and in the worst case, you may die.
Especially since the mock dungeon, this trend has become more severe.
Jaehyun, who had been absentmindedly turning his sharpie, also fixed his eyes forward.
‘Is it finally the beginning of the next event…….’
The instructor continued his explanation.
“3 days later. Friday is the guild experience day. Guild experience is how the raider guild you are actually active in moves and hunts monsters. It will be a good opportunity to experience the whole thing firsthand.
It was specially planned for you by Chairman Koo Jain.”
I didn’t even listen to the last line related to Gu Jain and just let it go.
I just weed out the cadets who thought this event was unnecessary anyway.
Because I have no other intentions.
But apart from that, Jaehyun had a very happy face.
Guild experience.
As the instructor explained earlier, this is how other guilds move and work. It was a good opportunity to get a glimpse of how it works.
‘Before the return, I went to an E-class new guild and sat on a moldy couch…’
Jaehyun tried to sigh as he recalled the past, but kept his mouth shut.
His situation now is clearly different from then.
Jaehyun is a monster rookie who is sweeping all the first places in the Milles Academy event and other tests.
Freshman Hunt, which was aired on TV not long ago, has more than 10 million views on YouTube.
In other words, it was like cutting off the free pass to go to any guild.
‘As expected, the < Sea God > guild would be good, right? It is a precious opportunity to see with my own eyes the guild that ranked first in Korea before returning. I can’t miss it.’
The Haesin Guild is the first guild to rise to the surface after Yeon-hwa, headed by Yoo Seon-jae, went down the path of defeat.
Ahn Ji-seok, who is famous for his excellent character, is the guild master. It’s literally the first guild regardless of martial arts or magic.
The guild that Jaehyun wanted to go to the most during his martial arts days was Haesin.
‘Of course, since it’s a guild established by rookies, it’s probably small. At the very least, you’ll be able to see how the built infrastructure and human resources are rolled.’
Of course, it is definitely not that I hate Yeonhwa.
Currently, Yeonhwa is the best guild in Korea, and Yoo Seongeun is also an excellent radar.
However, it is also true that I want to know how things are going in other guilds.
Jaehyun started thinking about which guild he should go to with a smile on his face.
But then.
“Oh, and there are a few cadets who have been nominated first for the guild.”
“……huh?”
As for Jaehyun, he had forgotten about it because it was an undeserved offer that he had never even received in the past.
Guild priority nomination.
It is called this when another guild takes notice of a particular cadet and makes an offer to come to your own guild for the experience.
If you agree to this, the guild will give the cadet special points.
Jaehyun felt a chill run down his spine at the instructor’s words.
‘Ah…… can’t it be?’
Jaehyun listened intently to the instructor’s words.
And he realized that things were going exactly as he expected.
“Cadet Min Jae-hyeon, Cadet Seo In-na, and Cadet Kim Yu-jeong and the following three were first nominated by the Yeonhwa Guild.
Please make your decision by midnight today, file the paperwork, and send me the file.”
Jaehyun sighed and remembered his teacher’s face.
‘Well…… There’s no way the teacher would send me to another guild for experience……’
Yoo Sung-eun was a greedy person when it came to talent.
And in her opinion, the most valuable person in the future was none other than Min Jae-hyun.

chapters.title: Chapter 89
chapters.content:
Episode 89 Guild Experience (1)
‘Somehow. He asked me who the cadet stood out that day was…’
Jaehyun let out a small sigh and recalled the past.
The other day, when they visited the Yeonhwa Guild to report the results of the freshman hunt, Yoo Sung-eun and Park Ha-na asked Jae-hyun.
Was there a cadet who stood out in this freshman hunt?
Also, are they worthy of being scouted by Yeonhwa herself?
At that time, Jaehyun delivered the names of the four people while renewing the contract.
Ahn Ho-yeon, Kim Yoo-jung, Seo In-na and Lee Jae-sang.
Except for Lee Jae-sang, a student, all of them were cadets of the same age as Jae-hyeon. The cadets who went through the freshman hunt together, and the geniuses who ranked 4th in the overall ranking.
The Yeonhwa Guild carefully observed the performance of these four cadets. Thanks to you, the situation like this happened now.
Jaehyun’s factions all received guild experience in Yeonhwa.
To be precise, I got that opportunity…but
there’s probably no one to refuse.
Korea’s strongest guild in name and reality.
Because Yeon-hwa’s reputation was truly enormous.
‘Perhaps Ahn Ho-yeon was also clearly pointed out. Aren’t you the type to miss even one person?’
Jaehyun tilted his chair back a little and sighed again.
The opportunity to see the structure and system of other guilds with their own eyes was blown away.
I couldn’t help but feel regret.
‘Well, if the teacher comes out like this, there’s no way for me.’
As a representation, it was inconceivable.
What a guild experience proposal of Yeonhwa Guild. It was clear that if he refused, it would be difficult to see Yoo Sung-eun’s face for a while.
Perhaps Yooseong knew this and secretly applied pressure.
“Your teacher is also a bit rude. How dare you use such a cowardly move.”
After all, it’s absurd that the magic teacher Yoo Sung-eun sends Jae-hyeon to another guild.
But I really didn’t know how to do this.
‘Anyway, please give me some words. I just recited the names of talented kids. I didn’t know you would use it like this.’
Jaehyun muttered, feeling a tingling sensation as if he had been hit in the back of the head.
“I can’t help it.”
It was a clear conclusion.
Of course, if they were forced to go to another guild, they could go.
However, with the recent opening of Studio Elixir, Yoo Sung-eun and Yeon-hwa received considerable help.
Not only that, but it hasn’t been long since the contract was renewed.
It was morally wrong to refuse the nomination in the first place.
“Ha…”
Jaehyun let out a sigh of relief.
In the meantime, the instructor continued to call his name.
“Then, cadet Lee Soo-hyuk. It is the first nomination in the 《Haishin》 guild.
Similarly, after filing the paperwork, please send the related materials by email by midnight.”
Lee Soo-hyeok went to the Haesin Guild he wanted to go to.
A cadet who had a conflict with Jaehyun in a physical fitness test the other day.
It must have been a bit of luck.
‘Chit.’
Jaehyun clicked his tongue briefly and then licked his chin.
“Next…”
The instructor continued to make nominations.
The names of all promising cadets are called out.
Jaehyun was now able to hear the instructor’s voice.
“Huh……”
After a short sigh, he regained his senses.
anyway that’s how it happened
Jaehyun decided to think as positively as possible.
‘okay. It goes without saying that Yeonhwa Guild’s facilities are good anyway… I wanted to go to Haesin Guild, but getting entangled with Lee Soo-hyeok is another no-no.’
Bona Mana, if I go with Lee Soo-hyuk, I’m sure there will be another fight.
Unlike before the return, it would not be a big problem because I had the power, but it was better to be comfortable than to be swept away by troublesome things.
After a while.
When the instructor’s names were all finished, the bell rang.
Jaehyun sat down for a while, then got up after the people left.
As I turned around, I heard a familiar voice.
“Ah~ Min Jaehyun! Go with me!”
When I moved my gaze to where the voice came from, Kim Yoo-jung and Seo In-na were approaching.
Jaehyun thought for a moment while waiting for the two of them.
‘If I go to Yeonhwa Guild, at least my colleagues won’t die in this event.’
But that’s what it means.
It also meant that there were innocent students who would surely die in the guild experience.
and that evening.
An urgent call came from Ahn Ho-yeon to gather at the hideout.
It was a call that came close to midnight.
* * *
A few hours ago.
around six o’clock in the afternoon. Miles Academy’s personal training ground.
Ahn Ho-yeon, who finished swordsmanship training, muttered as she stretched.
“Ugh……. Should I ask the chancellor a potion to recover from fatigue? It seems that the reason why I feel sore lately is that my body has accumulated fatigue.”
Ahn Ho-yeon has been doing special training in swordsmanship after theory classes have been over lately.
A murderous schedule where only about six hours of time spent on swords per day are reached.
Thanks to that, my whole body was screaming, and I was so tired that I couldn’t move, especially now that I had just finished training.
‘Of course, thanks to my efforts, I succeeded in obtaining a new skill, but…’
The problem is that the newly learned skill is a skill that inflicts considerable damage on the body.
What an S-class skill.
It was a skill that would take at least several more years for Ahn Ho-yeon, who was still a cadet, to master.
‘Now, even if I try to the limit, I’ll only be able to use it for about 6-7 minutes…’
But Ahn Ho-yeon didn’t care.
“Let’s not be in a hurry. It’s not a skill I can handle properly yet.”
Still, it wasn’t without success.
Now he is able to handle The Extreme of Nothing perfectly.
As a freshman, he was able to use A-level skills freely.
However, An Ho-yeon had no intention of being satisfied with this.
“Jaehyun is already at a much higher level. No matter how much time you have, it’s not enough to win the Milles Academy Festival.”
After thinking for a while, he shook his head and cleared his thoughts.
Of course, it’s not without urgency.
However, the body collapses if it is not accompanied by proper rest.
Now is the time to rest.
Ahn Ho-yeon is trying to pack his things to go back to the cadet dormitory. Suddenly, I was startled by the voice calling my name and raised my head.
The source was a speaker installed at the top of the training ground.
[Ah… Cadet Ahn Ho-yeon. This is a call from Chairman Gu Jain.]
[Please come to the chairman’s office on the roof as soon as you hear it.]
Ahn Ho-yeon tilted his head with a puzzled face.
“Why is the chairman looking for me?”
It was something I couldn’t understand at first.
Generally, the cadets of Miles Academy do not have many opportunities to talk with Gu Jain.
Gu Ja-in also tends to use handouts or messages rather than having a direct conversation.
There would be no reason to have a face-to-face conversation.
While thinking deeply.
Suddenly, a disturbing thought popped into my mind.
It was because he remembered what Jaehyun had said to him the other day.
It was during the freshman hunt.
[not a big deal. It happened because I was affected by mind manipulation magic.]
[…Are you saying I attacked you because I was manipulated by magic? But…]
[Someone else intervened in the freshman hunt. The game is rigged by a mogul that the cadets don’t even dare to mess with. Well, I don’t know exactly what the purpose is.]
[…What kind of existence he is. Why did you intervene in the freshman hunt? Do you know?]
[No.]
Ahn Ho-yeon thought about it several times, recalling the conversation he had with Jae-hyun.
Who the hell intervened in the freshman hunt and for what purpose?
Why did he use mental manipulation on himself to fight Jaehyun?
After thinking about it, Ahn Ho-yeon was certain of one thing.
‘The incident during the freshman hunt is directly related to Gu Ja-in.’
Otherwise, it made no sense to bury the case so easily.
immediately after the incident.
Not a single word of what happened in subspace was on the news.
The same goes for what happened in the mock dungeon.
Even though it was obviously a dangerous incident, there was just a small happening in the newspaper-.
It was just described and passed on.
Could this be a coincidence?
The fact that the subspace field was built in the first place.
It is also Gu Jain who organizes all events including mock dungeons.
No need to think further, the answer is here.
Guin.
He is causing events to put the cadets in extreme situations.
‘Of course, I don’t know why he did that, but…’
There was no way the two coincidences overlapped.
Jain Gu is moving with a certain ‘purpose’.
Events are a cornerstone for him.
That was Ahn Ho-yeon’s idea.
“There is nothing wrong with being careful.”
Ahn Ho-yeon packed his things and put them in his inventory, then stood up.
There was no other way now.
Once they bump into each other, find out the purpose of Gu Jain calling him.
Right now, that’s the best.
After a while.
Ahn Ho-yeon climbed into the elevator to head to the chairman’s office.
I took a deep breath and looked at the mirror in front of me.
‘Something doesn’t feel right.’
After swallowing a gulp, I gathered my heart.
The signs were not good.
* * *
Director Jain Gu’s office.
Gu Jain’s voice can be heard from inside the room.
“yes. I’m trying to weed out all the trash that I don’t need this opportunity. It’s stupid to pour subsidies every year to people who can’t even aim for reawakening in the first place.”
[What do you plan to do with the support of the top cadets?]
“Wouldn’t there be plenty of resources for the top 1 percent after crippling a lot of the bottom worms?
What kind of noise are you hearing? Congressman Park will do a good job blocking it.”
Goo Ja-in met the other person’s stomach through the smartphone with a fishy smile.
Of course, only the way he speaks is polite, but his attitude is arrogant.
[But what are you going to do? a month ago. I made too big a deal in the mock dungeon.]
Congressman Park continued with a worried tone.
[‘Radar Management Headquarters’. The guys will start moving slowly. It’s a situation where you don’t know if you’ve already planted a spy inside Miles.
They don’t know anything else, but they’re the ones who can smell one smell.]
Gu Ja-in sneered at Congressman Park’s words and replied lightly.
“Anyway, it is just a dog that eats the rust of the country. And… you don’t have to worry, since we’ve already finished all the preparations.”
[Preparation?]
“The ‘guild experience’ in a few days. I intend to take advantage of that event.”
Gu Jain said that with a confident smile.
In fact, he has run the academy and held several events to test the cadets.
Gu Ja-in has so far bribed high-ranking political and business figures to block reports of the incident, and when even that is not possible, he uses his skills to brainwash citizens.
In order to block the noise coming to him and further solidify his power.
Gu Jain gave strength to his voice.
“This guild experience. We will artificially blow the gate there.”
[……Crab Gate?! Is that possible?]
“Of course. How is it? If I do well, I can sweep away all the useless things without getting my hands dirty.”
[Um…… Certainly if it’s that way…]
After a while. Congressman Park over the phone added as if he had made up his mind.
[Okay. Then, as I said before, let’s deliver the national subsidy to Miles.
From now on, I’m going to talk about specific plans……]
“Of course. Anything.”
Guin Ja-in and Rep. Park discussed the guild experience and the disposition of the lower rank cadets to be abandoned for a long time.
Rep. Park over the phone couldn’t help but admire Gu Ja-in’s plan.
Gu Ja-in was thinking of carefully burying the lower rank cadets.
A floor where even reawakening cannot be expected.
To Rep. Park and Jain Gu, they are completely useless. It was just a mosquito sucking blood.
decided to dispose of it.
Killing them will enrich the resources that will go to the other high-ranking cadets.
Not only that, but in the middle stage, they could fill their stomachs in moderation.
There was absolutely no problem with Gu Jain’s plan.
……if it weren’t for the boy listening to the story outside right now.
A boy with gray hair.
Ahn Ho-yeon heard all this outside and was in great shock.
‘What the hell is this…!’
It was just a coincidence that the conversation was overheard.
Instructor Kim Seok-gi, who was waiting outside the door, was away and was called by Gu Ja-in.
The moment he was about to knock, Congressman Park and Jain Gu started talking.
And…
As a result of coincidence, Ahn Ho-yeon learned about Gu Ja-in’s shocking secret.
‘shit……! now i get it Who encroached on my sanity in the freshman hunt that day. Everyone who caused the simulated dungeon and waited on it!’
Guin.
Miles’ director was pushing the cadets to the brink of death.
To nurture better radars by urging cadets in the middle and lower ranks to reawaken.
The lowest ranking cadets, who can’t even expect that, to save money.
‘A disgusting human…!’
Ahn Ho-yeon gritted his teeth.
I wanted to open the door right away and go in and ask how that could be.
He wanted to expose Gu Ja-in’s evil deeds to the whole world.
However, by doing so Can you bring that human down?
‘no. It’s dangerous to jump out now.’
Ahn Ho-yeon is just a cadet, and this is Milles Academy.
Gu Jain is the most powerful person in the academy.
There is no chance of winning here.
‘I can’t rule out the possibility that there are other henchmen.’
In addition, Milles Academy is surrounded by powerful magic throughout the building, making it impossible to record.
As it is a military academy, the nominal reason was to exclude the risk of military-related secrets being exposed to the outside world.
Ahn Ho-yeon calmed down his rising anger and calmly faced the reality.
at the same time.
‘It should be stopped.’
Only one thought sticks in my mind.
My head was cold.
Ahn Ho-yeon had to make the best choice he could.
‘can do. I have to do it as calmly as possible to avoid suspicion.’
Ahn Ho-yeon made all his decisions.
After a while.
No more voices could be heard from inside, as if the phone call with Congressman Park had ended.
Ahn Ho-yeon exactly five minutes later.
He knocked on the door of the chairman’s office.
“……Chairman. This is Ahn Ho-yeon.”

chapters.title: Chapter 90
chapters.content:
Episode 90 Guild Experience (2)
The party is sitting in a row in the workshop elixir building.
All of them had tired faces from not sleeping properly, but they had no choice but to come to their senses immediately after hearing An Ho-yeon’s story.
His words were so shocking.
Ahn Ho-yeon is at midnight when Milles’s crime prevention system goes into a non-operational state. Called the party to the hideout and explained the outline of the incident.
After all the talk. A moment of silence passed.
It was Kim Yoo-jung who spoke first.
“So, to put it simply… You mean that Chairman Gu Ja-in is trying to kill the low-ranking cadets in the guild experience?”
“okay. that’s right. You must have overheard the conversation yourself.”
Ahn Ho-yeon nodded.
A deep silence fell over the hideout.
Of course, everyone here knew it. To the extent that Gu Ja-in is a villain and has a bad back.
But it really wasn’t.
What kind of school would try to kill students for poor grades?
“Gugu-gugu, the corruption issue of Chairman Gu Ja-in has been mentioned year after year, but…” “
This is too serious even if it is done. You’re playing with your life.”
Seo Ah-hyun, who was sitting upside down in the chair, interrupted while listening to Lee Jae-sang. As she said, Gu Jain’s plan was extremely dangerous.
Jaehyun bit his lip. It felt like my head was spinning.
‘Guild experience… It was a much more dangerous event than I thought.’
Of course, Jaehyun heard information about the next event through Instructor Jeong Yi-soo.
However, this was only fragmentary information.
Instructor Jeong Yi-soo is from Gu Ja-in’s faction, but as he is still a rookie, he doesn’t know all the information.
Furthermore, Jaehyun before returning also had little to no proper memories of the guild experience.
It was just an accident and several cadets tragically lost their lives.
That was everything Jaehyun knew about the guild experience.
‘Anyway, I’ll have to get more detailed information from Instructor Jeong Yi-soo.’
next event. Guild experience.
Ahn Ho-yeon said that the deaths of innocent cadets must be prevented.
That’s why he came to the party and asked them to help him.
However, Jaehyun was skeptical.
‘In any case, we may all die. Should I intervene in this case?’
before regression. Jaehyun has already experienced a short life at the age of 27.
And I realized
That nothing remains after a life sacrificed for others.
It may be selfish, but it’s better to live for yourself.
Justification.
okay. There is no justification.
Jaehyun had no justification to intervene in this incident, so there was no need to move.
however.
Jaehyun looked around at the group.
Those who keep their mouths shut and are angry at Gu Ja-in. At least the five gathered here are people with upright dispositions.
Seo or Ahn Ho-yeon……
Needless to say, Kim Yoo-jung, who sacrificed herself for herself in the past. The same goes for Jaesang Lee.
Jaehyun couldn’t help but agonize.
None of these will stand by as innocent cadets die.
But suddenly intervening in this case would be poison.
‘If you don’t, everyone can die.’
Jaehyun knew.
Meaningless guest comments have no value beyond the act of inciting death.
but.
“Please.”
Ahn Ho-yeon’s words. It soon became a sanctification and spread slowly.
“……I can’t leave the dying cadets like this.”
“Is it time to worry? Other children’s lives are at stake!”
“I’m so scared, but. If I can, I will help somehow…….”
“I wonder if my older sisters and older brothers should help me, but… I won’t stop them.”
Jaehyun knew it well. These are radars.
A raider is a job that seeks treasure, hunts monsters… and protects humans.
at that time. With a voice familiar to Jaehyun, who was worried.
There is a cause.
―The main quest [Second Junction] has been automatically accepted.
[Main Quest]
The second turning point
Stop Guzain’s plans with wrong desires and save the students.
Difficulty: A+
Reward: Blank Card × 1 / Sealed Sorceress
Failure Conditions: Failure to rescue all cadets
―The Van Æsir throne watches over your choices!
* * *
Curator Guild Master’s Office.
Kang Yeon-ju was in the middle of reporting what happened a few days ago to Baek Ji-yeon.
Baek Ji-yeon’s face hardened as she listened to the report.
It was because he realized the seriousness of the matter.
“……Anyway, Min Jae-hyun has contact with at least two S-class raiders. One is Yooseong, the guild master of the Yeonhwa Guild, and the other is a man whose identity is unknown.
But I didn’t seem to get along well with the male side. They seemed to be at odds with each other and exchanged attacks with each other.”
“This is getting complicated. Did you touch a hive that shouldn’t be touched?”
“Maybe.”
Baek Ji-yeon said with a faint smile on her lips.
“But you know what? Hard-earned fruits are always…”
“Sweeter.”
When Kang Yeon-joo accepted the words, Baek Ji-yeon shrugged.
“For now, I’d like to keep in touch. Even for the growth of curators.”
“I will do as you say. If you give me a bonus, I will work even harder.”
“don’t worry. You will be surprised when you see your bank account next month.”
“Please, I will pray to God that he will not do that.”
“Yes, yes. Don’t worry, just get out.”
At Baek Ji-yeon’s words, Kang Yeon-ju bowed her head and left the office.
After a while.
Baek Ji-yeon, left alone, continues to watch the freshman hunting screen featuring Min Jae-hyun.
Jaehyun in the liquid crystal was neutralizing Shin Jun-sang and Kwon So-yul, both fighter-based radars, at once.
He grabbed the sword flying towards him and broke it, then put it out.
Not only that, but even engaging in ingenious combat using paralysis mushroom spores.
“But most surprising of all…”
Baek Ji-yeon changed the TV channel to play another program.
It was worn-out news that I had seen several times already.
[It is said that it was surprisingly only two young teenagers aged 17 and 16 who attacked the theme dungeon of 《Neverland》. They came to an amusement park and suddenly got caught up in a dungeon…] [
The names of the two are Seo Ah-hyun and Min Jae-hyun.]
[The two did not respond to the interview and left immediately after the dungeon raid. ……]
“There is no way that a person with that level of skill is the same person. Jaehyun Min. The more you know, the funnier he is.”
Baek Ji-yeon stared at the TV screen for a long time, exhaling ferocious eyes.
“I’ll get my hands on it somehow.”
Baek Ji-yeon raised one corner of her mouth and smiled.
She had no doubt that Jaehyun was a talented person who would take the position of curator to the next level.
* * *
The contents of the call that Ahn Ho-yeon heard were summarized as follows.
There are eight planned victims, all cadets with the lowest grades.
Gu Jain planned to deal with them by bursting the gate in this guild experience.
But here, the group couldn’t help but have doubts.
Seo Ina asked.
“…By bursting the gates, does that mean you’re using your magic tricks like in the mock dungeon last time?”
“well. I still don’t know everything. Gu Ja-in’s abilities are more hidden.”
The two sighed almost simultaneously.
As Jaehyun predicted in the first place, the ominous feeling was not wrong.
No, it was much more serious than I thought.
Guild experience.
An event with a seemingly peaceful name results in as many as eight innocent casualties.
“Do you know the list of cadets?”
It was Kim Yoo-jung’s question.
Ahn Ho-yeon shook his head.
“no.”
“You’ll find out soon, though. As far as I know, it’s not common for eight people to be singled out for a guild experience, and you only have to search for places that are related to Chairman Gu Jain, right? It is not very difficult.”
“They say everything that is surprisingly helpful.”
Jaehyun praised Seo Ahhyun who intervened in the middle and spoke naturally.
“okay. Then Seo Ah-hyun is in charge of that. Research the data and send it directly by email.”
“Yeah……Eh?!”
‘It would be good to have Instructor Jeong Yi-soo attached so that he can move with him. Seo Ah-hyun is smart, so I’ll be able to secure the list soon.’
“What are you talking about all of a sudden!”
The conversation was so flowing that I almost fell for it.
Seo Ah-hyun looked up at Jae-hyun in a fit of fuss.
she pleaded with a troubled face.
“…… why do I do that…….”
‘subordinate’.
As soon as Jaehyun blew magic power on him, Seo Ahhyun’s answer came back.
“……I will do my best!”
“……Jaehyun is scared of you sometimes.”
Seo Ina said that, but Jaehyun didn’t care at all and looked the other way this time.
“Prime Minister hyung, please make some auxiliary potions as well as physical strength. as many as possible.”
“G-g-g-g-yes. Ah Okay!”
Lee Jae-sang opened his chest and said, as if to leave it to himself.
The fact that the potion he made could save other cadets made him feel proud.
‘As expected, he’s a naturally gifted alchemist.’
Jaehyun thought so, but suddenly Kim Yoojung asked.
“But can we stop ourselves? It’s better to ask others…”
“I told you before. Don’t trust anyone at Milles Academy.”
Jaehyun stopped talking in a serious tone and took a slow, deep breath.
Then, he looked around Ahn Ho-yeon and Lee Jae-sang and Seo Ah-hyun and said.
“Remember. Among the instructors, there are definitely some of Gu Jain’s minions hiding.
Representatively, Instructor Kim Seok-gi. That guy is definitely a seeker. You better be careful.”
“……surely. Instructor Kim Seok-ki is always next to Gu Ja-in. If it is him, he can be suspected of being Gu Jain’s henchman.”
Ahn Ho-yeon nodded.
Jaehyun continued with a more serious face.
“Moreover, Jain Koo is a celebrity that everyone in Korea doesn’t know about. Do you think that such a person would have risen to the position without collusion between politics and business?”
It was a story that everyone in the meeting had no choice but to nod their heads.
Looking at Gu Jain’s recent moves, it is certainly natural to assume that politicians are also on his side.
Otherwise, Gu Jain wouldn’t be able to play with the lives of the students like he is now.
Even if you report it elsewhere, it will be difficult to conduct a proper investigation as there is no physical evidence.
Jaehyun thought for a moment.
“But Kim Yoo-jung, what you say has some truth. The problem is too big for us to solve on our own.”
“Then, if we first find out and contact the cadets who were sacrificed in the guild experience…” “
Then they will be replaced by other cadets. The only thing that will change is the person who dies.”
Jaehyun shook his head at Ahn Hoyeon’s words.
Jaehyun added.
“What we need right now is a network that will support us even if we turn our backs on Gu Ja-in.”
After saying that, Jaehyun raised his face calmly.
at that time. Kim Yoo-jung, who was worried, asked.
“But the networking side is not something we can do. Not to mention a network of people who can keep the chairman in check……”
“Yeonhwa Guild.”
“what?”
Kim Yu-jung looked at Jae-hyun with her arms crossed.
she said with a sigh.
“what? Yeonhwa Guild? No matter how this time, even if we were nominated first for Yeonhwa in the guild experience and received help when we opened the workshop, how can we ask for help there? In the first place, that makes no sense…….”
“There are ways.”
“How are you?”
Kim Yoo-jung asked as if she was genuinely curious.
Jaehyun didn’t answer.
There was only a small smile on his lips.
“Everything has a way. Life is a real battle, and a real battle is all about networking.”

chapters.title: Chapter 91
chapters.content:
Episode 91 Guild Experience (3)
The next day.
Jaehyun roughly conveyed the story of Gu Jain’s plan to Yeonhwa Guild.
It is said that Chairman Gu Ja-in is driving innocent students of Miles to death, and that at least eight casualties occur in this guild experience.
Also, a politician called Rep. Park maintains a close relationship with Jain Koo.
The party who delivered all the incidents had no choice but to be very nervous.
It is true that Jaehyun opened Studio Elixir the other day and received help from Yoo Seongeun, but it was because he was not sure whether Yeonhwa Guild would really help them.
But Jaehyun wasn’t worried at all.
It wasn’t just because he had a close relationship with her.
As far as he knew, Yoo
Seong-eun, the CEO of Yeonhwa, and Koo Ja-in, the director, were not on good terms.
Even before the return, the two forces had been competing against each other by checking each other.
The conflict between them is already one of the nationally famous interests.
A relationship where you can’t get enough of each other.
Whenever the two forces clash at an official event, reporters from all over the country cling to each other and create all sorts of gossip.
Jaehyun was well aware of this fact.
And I thought to use it appropriately if necessary.
* * *
After a while.
The party received Yoo Seong-eun’s reply and headed to the guild building.
The meeting room on the 2nd floor of Yeonhwa Guild’s main building.
This is a strictly controlled area where security is tight and the general public is not allowed to enter.
Various refreshments and chocolates were prepared on the conference room table, but no one touched them.
This was proof of the seriousness of the case.
Park Seong-jae, Yoo Seong-eun, and Jae-hyun’s party briefly exchanged greetings and sat down.
Yuseong welcomed Jaehyun and tilted his head with a puzzled expression.
“…Why does it seem like there’s one more person than what you said before?”
Yoo Sung-eun’s gaze turned to Seo Ah-hyun.
Jaehyun replied indifferently, not caring at all.
“He is just like a folding screen. What do you mean by decorative potted plants? Why don’t you water it? Just annoying.”
“……brother. I think it’s a bit too harsh for my evaluation to be so harsh.”
“Don’t worry, I won’t be talking about anything confidential.”
When Jae-hyun lightly ignored Seo Ah-hyun’s words, Yoo Seong-eun burst into laughter.
“Jaehyun, you are also great. I already made a lot of friends like this.”
“you’re welcome.”
Jaehyun trembled in moderation.
The group sitting next to them opened their mouths slightly. It was because Jaehyun’s appearance was quite unfamiliar to them.
Meanwhile. Jaehyun tried to get to the main point immediately after the atmosphere was moderately relaxed.
However, Kim Yoo-jung’s unexpected words interrupted him.
“So, so, so, so, really, to see CEO Yoo Seong up close like this! Wow I’m a huge fan! Please give me an autograph! Paper Paper… Mistress! Where’s the pen?!”
Jaehyun sighed and stared blankly at the scene.
‘Why did he suddenly become the chancellor’s older brother? A normal kid.’
Jaehyun clicked his tongue and shook his head.
The other party members were also in a similar mood.
at that time. Jaehyun nodded as if he remembered something.
‘Oh right. He was a big fan of the teacher.’
I forgot because the incident was so serious, but Kim Yoo-jung is a big fan of Yoo Seong-eun.
After all, it was she who first made the point of contact between Yoo Sung-eun and Jae-hyun.
It was Kim Yoo-jung who asked me to go with Yoo Seong-eun’s lecture right after the return.
Normally, I would have told him to stay still, but I let him go for a while.
Kim Yoo-jung borrowed a piece of paper from Lee Jae-sang on her own, got her signature, and hugged her tightly.
Yooseong smiled and put his hand on Kim Yoojung’s shoulder.
“thank you. Thanks to fans like this, I always get strength.”
Seeing the teacher’s fake smile, Jaehyun thought that it was truly amazing.
Is it possible to become a healer only if you have the generosity to embrace such an extreme fan?
If so, Jaehyun had no intention of dying as a healer.
Meanwhile, Ahn Ho-yeon and Lee Jae-sang, who were sitting next to them, were surprisingly calm.
Lee Jae-sang had met Yoo Seong-eun for business talks before opening 《Gongbang Elixir》 for the first time, and Ahn Ho-yeon had the experience of meeting a lot of famous people, so he wasn’t too surprised.
Seo Ah-hyun is a crazy person who can’t figure it out, so there’s nothing to talk about.
The turmoil in the hall subsided a bit and Yoo Seong-eun glanced at Jae-hyun and his colleagues.
“I will tell you the conclusion.”
She took a deep breath and started talking in earnest.
“Actually, Yeonhwa and several other guilds also know about Goo Jain’s infidelity or corruption. It’s just that the power is so strong that everyone is just hushing it up.
If you want to promote in Korea, you can’t help but notice that poor guy.”
“I thought it would. Otherwise, there’s no way Gu Ja-in would be walking around like this openly.”
Jaehyun looked at Yoo Seongeun’s face and started talking in more detail.
“Anyway, Gujain seems to have the ability to create gates arbitrarily.”
“Um…….”
Yoo Sung-eun frowned and paused for a moment, then nodded.
“I’ve never heard of it, but it’s not without possibility. With such ridiculous abilities, it makes sense that Gu Jain built such a strong force despite being an A-class raider.
What do you think of Seongjae oppa?”
“I think so too. However, there are still many things hidden about Chairman Gu Ja-in’s ability, so I think it’s a bit difficult to make hasty decisions.”
Park Seong-jae, who was sitting next to Yoo Seong-eun, also spoke in a calm voice.
“Then let’s start taking serious measures.”
Seong-jae Park took out the analysis data and handed it to her at the calm Yoo Seong-eun’s words.
Right after Park Seong-jae received a call from Jae-hyun. I decided to collect data to analyze this situation, and I was about to bring a map showing the points where the dungeon could occur.
On the map of Seoul projected with magic, red dots began to form one by one.
“They all show magic fields near guilds where there are guild experiences. All of them are places where the magical power is much stronger and darker than the surrounding area. If dungeons are created, there is a high chance that something will happen in one of them.”
“great. For a while, our Yeonhwa side will look back on those points. If there is any sign of something happening, we immediately close the area and evacuate the residents.”
At Yoo Seong-eun’s words, Park Seong-jae immediately nodded.
Those who sat across from them were really admiring the speedy handling of the Yeonhwa Guild.
However, Jaehyun’s face was still full of anxiety.
“It’s a good method, but… I don’t think Jain Gu didn’t prepare for this event so poorly. I completely ruined the previous mock dungeon event. and.”
He pondered for a moment, then opened his mouth with difficulty.
“Once they know that the Yeonhwa Guild has started to intervene in this matter in earnest, Jain Gu will also be more active. We’ll have to bump into each other someday, but it’s dangerous now.”
Of course, the Yeonhwa Guild is building a strong force. However, the same is true for Gujain.
It is premature to collide here.
For now, it is the right choice to weaken Gu Ja-in’s power little by little. In an all-out war, there is still a lot to lose.
“Is there any other way you can think of?”
Jae-hyun pondered for a while at Yoo Seong-eun’s question, and then nodded.
“yes. those cadets. We have to save it ourselves.”
* * *
On the day of the guild experience.
The four people gathered in front of the Yeonhwa Guild are taking deep breaths and resolving their minds.
Lee Jae-sang and Seo Ah-hyun were missing.
This is because Seo Ah-hyun, who has not yet entered school, is sick to say the least, and Lee Jae-sang is one grade above, so he does not participate in this guild experience.
However, Lee Jae-sang made enough potions.
Before entering the simulated dungeon, he made a lot of potions overnight, but this time he also worked hard to reproduce.
However, despite thorough preparation, Jaehyun could not relax.
There was only one thought in his head.
‘This event… might be much more dangerous than I thought.’
Jaehyun recalled the conversation he had with Sungeun Yoo in the conference room.
[Those cadets. We have to save it ourselves.]
[Gujain is a difficult enemy for you, the cadets, to stop. You may not know Jaehyun, but the other kids are newbies who haven’t entered a dungeon yet. All of them if you don’t mind……]
[I won’t let a single person die.]
[……That’s your answer. so. What do you want from Yeonhwa?]
[I’m going to ask you a few favors.]
[Ask?]
The day I visited Yeonhwa Guild.
Jae-hyun gave several suggestions to Yoo Seong-eun and Yeon-hwa.
First of all.
Never disclose the connection between yourself and the Yeonhwa Guild to the outside world.
second.
Support the necessary equipment and tools when entering the dungeon.
third.
During the guild experience, give them a kiss as if they had been through the experience.
fourth.
Provide a minimum safety device so that the party is not in danger.
Yoo Sung-eun sighed and accepted Jae-hyun’s proposal.
Anyway, when Gu Ja-in’s misdeeds are revealed, Yeonhwa Guild’s power naturally grows. It was not a losing trade.
However, Yoo Seong-eun said with concern.
[Something dangerous might happen. You have to be careful. Because Gu Ja-in is a scary person.]
Jae-hyun is as much as Yoo Seong-eun.
No, maybe he knew more about Gu Jain than that.
However, the reason why Jae-hyun is trying to solve the case directly with the party rather than relying on Yeon-hwa’s guild is simple.
Yeonhwa Guild and Gu Jain.
It is true that the two forces are fighting each other, but I thought it was not good to collide at a sensitive time like now.
Especially reproduction and softening.
In other words, what if Gu Ja-in finds out that he has a connection with Yoo Seong-eun?
Although he is currently plotting his work passively, paying attention to the people and the media, once the fact is revealed, Gu Ja-in will also take the move to give flesh and take bones.
If that happens, Gu Jain’s movement to pressure himself will become stronger.
It is correct here to hide and hide one’s hand as much as possible.
“You can see the building of the Jijiji real Yeonhwa Guild!”
In front of the guild building.
Kim Yoo-jung was almost in awe and was crying.
As for Jae-hyun now, he was not very impressed because he came and went every day, but he was also quite shocked when he first visited this place.
Jaehyun glanced at Kim Yoojung and said.
“hey. Why are you suddenly like this after seeing it yesterday?”
“That and this are completely different?! First of all, it can’t feel the same as seeing it when it’s morning and it’s dark.”
Kim Yoo-jung took the lead and went inside as if she was excited.
Ahn Ho-yeon and Seo E-na also don’t show it, but they are surprised by the guild facilities.
Jaehyun also decided to fit in properly and pushed himself inside.
Geeing…….
The automatic door opened and a man with a familiar face approached.
Park Seong-jae, who had been waiting in the lobby beforehand, bowed his head respectfully as he greeted the four of them.
“I’ve met you before… Nice to meet you. everyone. I am Seongjae Park, the manager of the guild Yeonhwa.”

chapters.title: Chapter 92
chapters.content:
Episode 92 Guild Experience (4)
Following Park Seong-jae’s guidance, we continued our experience by looking around the guild buildings.
As for Jaehyun, it was a place I had been to several times before, so I wasn’t very impressed.
I decided to give it a little something.
It was because the three people next to him reacted so violently.
“Wow crazy!”
“……Is this really the size of a guild?”
“It’s really crazy.”
Kim Yoo-jung and Seo Ina-ya tend to get along so well, but this time, Ahn Ho-yeon, which is rare, did not hide his surprise.
‘I’m not surprised at all. It’s a chance to see the inside facilities of Korea’s No. 1 guild.’
This is the inside of Yeonhwa Guild, which is not open to the public.
Outsiders are prohibited from entering. A place where even a member of the National Assembly cannot step without permission.
The fact that he had come to such a place with his own skills was boosting the spirits of the three people to the fullest.
“This is the information desk. It’s a place where you can handle basic office work. Over there is a common facility where you can rent guild equipment. If you go straight this way, there is a training ground.”
The guild experience process is not that complicated.
From viewing and experiencing basic guild facilities to how guilds work. In addition, it tells how to deal with demons, earn profits, and settle settlements.
That was the superficial goal of this guild experience.
Of course, this event did not mean much to Jaehyun, who had already signed a contract first.
But for the other three it was completely different.
“wow! Look at that statue! Qual crazy!”
“There are also weapons and recovery items that are only given to guild members! All of this is free?!”
“……pretty.”
Jaehyun’s head hurt.
After a while, I have to take these three to raid the dungeon.
Once again, I thought that it was fortunate that Seo Ah-hyun was not here.
Even if it wasn’t so, I’m not in the mood, but if he was there too…
I didn’t want to even imagine it.
Jaehyun sighed and thought about what was going to happen tonight.
When Ahn Ho-yeon first brought the news that something was going to happen at the guild experience, he said that on the first evening of the guild experience, Gu Ja-in was going to break the gate.
Now, at least a few hours left.
Jaehyun was calmly preparing for the next time without slowing down.
* * *
The < Kain > guild where the incident takes place is located about 30 minutes on foot from Yeonhwa.
The current time is 6:30 PM.
It was about two hours ago that we got the location where it happened and the names of the cadets.
Thanks to Instructor Jeong Yi-soo attached to Seo Ah-hyun, they succeeded in stealing confidential information from the academy, but the situation was not very good.
It was because the information was acquired on the same day, and the risk level could not be easily assessed as the incident occurred on the first day.
I asked the Yeonhwa Guild to find out general information about the Kane Guild.
《Kane》.
A guild founded the year before last with the chairman of the board, Gu Jain, behind him.
It was built by Jang Seong-hyeop, one of Gu Ja-in’s henchmen, and has recently received full support from Milles.
Jaehyun looked back at the group and asked.
“It’s an obvious plate. It could be much more dangerous than you think. Are you still going?”
“of course. It’s kind of scary…but I can’t let other people die. If I did, I would probably suffer from trauma for the rest of my life.”
Kim Yoo-jung grumbled and answered.
Jaehyun looked at her for a while and this time asked the same question to the other two.
“What about you?”
“……huh. I know.”
“What am I? Because I was what Jaehyun asked you to do from the beginning.”
The two of them also said so with their determination.
After arranging his thoughts for a while, Jaehyun nodded and looked at the group.
They all had a calm expression on their faces.
Jaehyun was genuinely amazed.
You may have to fight an enemy much stronger than yourself.
Your friends will know it too.
That if you do something wrong, you may die.
A dungeon is always a place where you have to go with such a risk.
However.
Still, they firmly believed in themselves that they could do it.
It was an unbelievable mindset for a 17-year-old cadet.
……Of course, Jaehyun had a slightly different idea from them.
‘The sealed magic book that was said to be given as a reward for a quest… what kind of item is that? In the first place, I don’t know why the quest rank that was only about saving cadets was A.’
It was clearly suspicious.
No matter how high you look, C to B is the appropriate difficulty level for this quest.
Of course, Gu Jain must have prepared some variables, but it must be at the level of a cadet anyway.
But why does the system say this quest is an A rank?
“Everyone, focus. depart. Don’t miss a moment of tension. got it?”
The three nodded at the same time.
‘I have a hunch that this dungeon will probably be much more dangerous than I thought.’
A sudden chill.
However, Jaehyun had a faint smile on his face.
‘I can do it with the strength I have now.’
Jaehyun knew his strength best.
Also, this time, he will never lose to Gu Jain.
* * *
“Then follow me this way.”
Eight cadets followed behind him at the man’s dry tone.
This is the guild «Kane».
It is a newly created guild in which Ja-in Koo owns a stake, and according to Instructor Kim Seok-gi, it is quite promising.
The people walking behind are the bottom cadets who did poorly in the freshman hunting basic physical fitness test.
They didn’t openly talk about it, but they were easy talkers who were quietly ignored by the other cadets.
Nonetheless, they were able to come to < Kane > through the guild priority nomination.
It is a place where cadets are envious of, which was established through direct investment by Jain Gu.
Having received the first nomination for such a place, he came to the Kane Guild here.
One cadet, who had been chasing the man at the forefront, began drawing his own blueprint with a happy face throughout.
Become a high-ranking radar, help others, earn money for your family, find a good-hearted girlfriend, and get married.
Such an ordinary daily life with two children and a happy life.
‘Bastards… Everyone ignored me as having no talent, but Chairman Gu Ja-in knew! That I have the qualities to become a much greater raider with a little effort!’
The man’s name is Joo Seong-chan.
He was a martial arts cadet with an aptitude score of 31%.
Those who succeed are also cadets who lack talent and do not exceed 40 aptitude points.
But all of them were as happy as the others for now.
A chance to experience the guild that Chairman Gu Ja-in helped from the establishment stage.
If there is a chance to stand out in a guild like this, a stepping stone to go to a bigger guild may be prepared at any time after graduation.
If things go well, it wouldn’t be bad to work as a direct member of this guild.
It is Chairman Gu Ja-in who is currently holding and shaking the Republic of Korea.
If only I could get a little more attention there…
“Sacrament, wait a minute.”
Suddenly, Joo Seong-chan stopped walking.
He heard a voice calling him from behind, and when he turned around, Ha Yeon-ju was calling him.
It was one of the members who came to the guild experience this time, but judging from the fact that he lowered his voice, it seemed that he was trying to say something important.
“what’s the matter. What’s going on?”
Joo Seong-chan replied in a generous voice. Anyway, the situation right now is not bad and I feel good, so whatever happened was good.
However, Ha Yeon-joo’s reply was enough to pour cold water on his mood.
“……Is this a real guild?”
“What are you talking about? This is Chairman Koo Ja-in…….”
“If it’s not that, the Radar Guild should have a lot of facilities. But, rather than being inside the guild, something… a nuisance? It seems to be close to a haunted house.”
“……A haunted house?”
I had never thought of it like that, but it felt kind of creepy.
When I looked around myself, Ha Yeon-joo’s words were understandable.
It was strange.
If it was a facility inside a guild, there would be high-tech equipment equipped with a mana response system.
However, this place is just a floor lined with creaky wooden planks and walls lined with curtain stones designed to block the view from outside.
I can’t immediately see what is at the end of the hallway.
The lights flickered from time to time, giving off an eerie atmosphere, and a gloomy aura leaked from every corner of the light-blocked room.
Joo Seong-chan immediately realized.
This disturbing aura that I feel right now is mana sensed from somewhere.
in a very unstable state.
Ominous mana that can explode like a bomb at any time.
Suddenly, anxiety began to spread to the six people behind me in turn.
The anxiety that spread like a torch did not subside. My heart was pounding and beating.
It’s a guild here.
How on earth can you feel this dark energy within the guild?
Hasn’t the minimum security system been established even though it has been two years since its establishment?
Suddenly, however, he had to stop thinking.
“This is our destination.”
while having a conversation.
The man who was in charge of the guide stopped walking and said.
But once again, the group was in a panic.
It was because the place he stopped was none other than the middle of the hallway.
Guild experience here?
Talking and teaching things about facility structure and contracts?
weird.
And it’s dangerous.
For a moment, the accident seemed to harden, but then I suddenly came to my senses.
Joo Seong-chan, Ha Yeon-joo, and the six in the back thought of that at the same time.
You must run away immediately.
All kinds of emotions run through my head.
Joo Seong-chan instinctively raised his head and checked the man’s face.
His pupils constricted unbelievably.
So did the others.
“How can it be!”
“Instructor Kim Seok-gi!?”
It was unbelievable.
Wasn’t the man in front of you a face you’d never seen before?
Why did the face suddenly change?
Besides, that person must be Instructor Kim Seok-gi.
One of the instructors in charge of classes at Milles Academy.
It was embarrassing, but the most confusing thing was the words that came out of his mouth.
“……ah. I didn’t expect the skill effect to end so quickly… but it can’t be helped. Although it is a little early.”
“Instructor…?”
Ha Yeon-ju mustered up the courage to ask, but there was no answer.
I instinctively sensed it.
Instructor Kim Seok-ki in front of them put them into a trap.
By the time the cadets’ thoughts were organized, Kim Seok-gi clenched his fists with a fishy smile.
Vivid mana began to rise from his body like smoke and soon began to surround them.
“Goodbye here. Cadets.”
The moment he finishes talking, the fire starts to devour the cadets.
A white magic circle drawn on the floor instantly radiated light and devoured them.
I couldn’t even move my feet to escape.
It was because the magic circle swallowed them several times faster, and they couldn’t move their bodies due to the restraining magic tool used by Instructor Kim Seok-gi.
“Buy and save me!”
“Instructor Kim Seok-ki… why!”
The voices of several cadets vomited in resentment could be heard, but Kim Seok-gi ignored them.
They no longer have utility value.
As the policy of Milles Academy is, this is an inevitable choice.
Kim Seok-gi spoke calmly as he watched those who were swallowed up by the flames and sent to another place.
“everyone. This is my last class. Always be alert. I don’t know if I’ll survive that hell and come back.”
Kim Seok-gi said that while laughing.

chapters.title: Chapter 93
chapters.content:
Episode 93 Guild Experience (5)
After walking for about 30 minutes, we arrived in front of the Kane Guild building.
As long as it wasn’t far away, there was nothing that other people noticed while coming.
Especially today, he is wearing plain clothes, not the academy cadet uniform. It’s because it’s difficult if you catch the attention of others and get on the news.
Now they are the chairman of the board, Jain Gu.
And we have to deal with the evil forces that may exist.
They had to refrain from revealing their identities to Gu Ja-in.
Jaehyun looked at the people standing next to him for a moment.
They also do not express themselves, but they are nervous.
No wonder.
This is real life, not a joke. Jaehyun cannot be 100% sure that all of them will be able to return alive.
Originally, a dungeon is such a place.
So he set aside a device.
Something that would bring them even a little closer to 100% safety.
A very attractive hand.
for example.
[Are you following along well?]
[Of course. Don’t worry.]
Park Seong-jae, who is now following him while hiding himself with 《Stealth》, was an example of that.
Jaehyun smiled lightly while talking with Park Seongjae.

It was because Jaehyun asked not to inform him.

Radar must be able to protect itself at all times.
Park Seong-jae is an A-class radar.

Therefore, Jae-hyun asked Park Seong-jae to follow him while hiding.
[By the way, you are amazing. Jaehyun Min. How did you learn «Telepathy» already?]
[I read a few books of magic.]

《Telepathy》.

It’s handled like it’s not a big deal in a fantasy novel, so it looks easy, but the difficulty is a whopping 3 stars.
This is because the process is much more difficult than expected because it is fundamentally intervening in the minds of others and conveying my thoughts with magic.
For reference, Seongjae Park uses the artifact to use telepathy.
[Thank you for your patience.]
[Of course. That’s why I followed you.]
Park Seong-jae seemed excited about something.
It is a somewhat bright voice like an adult suitable for children’s pranks.
But inside, he is a veteran.
Perhaps, no matter what enemy is in front of him, he will cut down without hesitation.
Because that is the radar and Park Seong-jae is very familiar with such an environment.
“Looking at the map… is this place?”
Ahn Ho-yeon, who had been taking a step, stopped and took her eyes off her smartphone.
-We have completed the guidance to the destination.
The friendly voice coming from the smartphone is somehow giving a sense of difference.
I found the «Kane» guild using the pathfinding system, but something was strange.
“What is this? To call it a guild… it looks like a shabby abandoned building?”
Kim Yoo-jung looked at Ahn Ho-yeon with a slightly embarrassed face.
Ahn Ho-yeon scratched his head and turned on his smartphone again to check the information.
However, Jaehyun reached out his hand in the middle and stopped the action.
“no. This is right.”

Jaehyun broke into a cold sweat and did not take his eyes off the abandoned building.
“It’s flowing out of here. Fucking ugly rotten mana.”
* * *
“That’s why you borrowed my manager. Jaehyun is also a very shameless kid.”
Seongeun Yoo, who was sitting in the representative’s office and drinking tea, muttered as she recalled the situation a moment ago.
“I hope Manager Park Seong-jae can help. There is a bit of a corner.”
“Still, it’s my brother. Can’t you be a little gentler? Well, that’s your brother and sister’s charm.”
Yoo Sung-eun laughed a little as she saw Park Hana standing in front of her.
She is now guarding Yoo Seong-eun to fill the vacancy of Park Seong-jae, who left to solve the guild experience with Jae-hyun.
I strongly discouraged him, saying that he didn’t have to do that, but he never listened.
‘Anyway, that older brother is that younger brother.’
With that thought in mind, I lifted the teacup.
Suddenly, her hand stopped.
Coo-coo-coo…
Vibration that faintly resonated with the ground.
Yoo Seong-eun’s eyebrows narrowed.
‘……what? I feel an unsettling mana somewhere. The distance… is close.’
An ominous magic that can be felt from a very close distance.
What the hell is going on?
At the same time, what Jaehyun said a while ago came to mind clearly.
[The guild Gu Jain is trying to clear the dungeon is 《Kane》.]
[《Kane》?]
[Yes. I heard that it was a guild that Gu Ja-in himself took part in founding.]
[Yes. know. but it’s weird When it comes to Kane, it’s a guild in the middle of downtown Seoul. It’s even not far from the Yeonhwa Guild. Exploding a dungeon in a place like that… It’s not like Gu-Jin.]
[I’m sure it’s information obtained from inside. I guess it just doesn’t feel good. There must be an ulterior motive.]
Yoo Seong-eun woke up from her thoughts. She asked Park Hana.
“……One. By the way, what exactly is the guild that Gujain founded?”
“The < < Kane > > guild is a ghost guild with virtually no active radar.”
“A ghost guild?”
“yes. As you know, it seems that sometimes there are people who create raider guilds for tax evasion or corruption and leave no record of their activities.
This time, Chairman Gu Ja-in would have joined in as well.”
“I think Jaehyun is right. Goo Jain… what the hell are you up to?”
Yoo Seong-eun’s expression quickly darkened.
After thinking for a moment, she nodded her head as if making up her mind.
“In case you don’t know, prepare my equipment below.”
“……All right.”
After saying that, Hana Park left the room and went straight down to the basement.
she bit her lip
‘There comes a situation where you don’t know if the CEO will use the equipment… It’s not something that can be taken for granted. What the hell is going on?’
* * *
Meanwhile. After Hana Park went down to the basement.
Yoo Seong-eun was left alone and was thinking about this work.
‘That vibration from a while ago… it’s dangerous. There must be something wrong.’
The mana flowed out along with the vibration I felt earlier. This was completely different from the structure of normal magic power.
Rotten mana that can only be felt from a demon.
Yoo Eun-eun is a member of the Iga Kane Guild. And I was convinced that it had something to do with this guild experience.
Yoo Seong-eun was worried.
Is it really right to intervene in the case now?
If he makes a mistake, he may end up arguing with all of Gu Jain’s forces and political cadres.
If it was for the sake of Yeonhwa, he would never step out of this situation.
“But if Jaehyun is in danger… I can never leave him alone.”
The conclusion was drawn surprisingly simply.
Jaehyun was a life saver to him.
Turning your back here is clearly tantamount to betraying the child.
“First of all, as Jaehyun said, we have a safety device in place. If necessary, I can move myself.”
A little while ago, Yoo Seong-eun handed Jae-hyun a special earring.
《Ivaldi’s Earring》.
An artifact that allows you to know the location and biological reaction of an opponent in danger anytime, anywhere with items obtained while exploring dungeons in the past.
If he had this, he would be able to go to Jaehyun’s aid the moment he was in danger.
“For now, the minimum preparations are over. But don’t let your guard down. Because the opponent is Gu Jain.”
Yoo Sung-eun was ready to take any threat to protect Jae-hyun.
A close relationship with the government?
can be solved somehow
The Yeonhwa Guild, as the last bastion, has also finished reviewing the overseas expansion.
A series of sacrifices and speeches prepared the board.
The people trust themselves more than the state, worship them as saints, and burn internet bulletin boards every day.
What if the government and Yeonhwa Guild pretend at this point?
What if you turn your back on Gujain Milles Academy?
Of course, Yeon-hwa will suffer a lot of damage, but the same goes for her opponent.
A situation where one of you might have to start a power game where you might have to die.
But don’t worry.
Jaehyun Min.
Yeonhwa now holds the best master key in her hands.
Now, she only wanted Jaehyun to return safely.
* * *
Knocked out.
The door opened very easily. Like a trap designed from scratch.
Fortunately, no other signs of popularity were felt.
The group stepped inside the door and carefully looked around.
creak-.
The old plank makes an unpleasant noise and makes you stand on your nerves. The building itself seemed to be in poor condition, probably because of the considerable work done during the construction process.
Jaehyun took the lead and stepped inside, holding his breath.
‘If something happens, let the other kids go immediately and the manager and me. Only the two of them have to face each other. If we don’t, we could all be massacred here.’
Among the cadets of Milles Academy, they are definitely among the strongest.
However, it is by no means overwhelming compared to the current radar.
Jae-hyun could never lose the network he had built up and his friend Kim Yoo-jung.
‘If possible, I have to deal with it alone.’
Jaehyun had enough strength to do that.
“Jaehyun. By the way, there is no healer in this party, is it okay?”
Ahn Ho-yeon asked from behind.
Seo Ina tried to open her mouth but stopped.
Among them, Seo Eana is the only one who knows that Jaehyun has a heal skill.
Even that, Jaehyun had asked her to keep it a secret.
Fortunately, Seo Eana didn’t talk about Jaehyun’s heal skill.
If I was going to talk about it, I was going to use < Subordinate > to stop it, but…
‘I don’t think that’s going to happen.’
Jaehyun replied calmly.
“don’t worry. Because I have thoughts. There are a lot of potions that the chancellor received from you in the first place.”
“Ah… sure. Hyung’s potion is really ridiculously great.”
“There is also a taste! I liked the health recovery potion the most. It tastes like strawberries.”
‘Eating it for taste is more amazing.’
I could barely hold back the words that were about to come out of my throat.
at that time.
Suddenly, Seo Ina’s expression hardened.
Was it because he felt the strangeness of this space and the unsettling magic power?
It just didn’t seem like it.
Jaehyun, noticing this, asked.
“Inaya. are you okay?”
“…It seems that high-ranking magic has been activated in this area. I can feel the reverberation of magic.”
Jaehyun was also a part that I felt inwardly.
After thinking about it for a while, Seo Ina added.
“There are traces of the spell being activated somewhere…”
Kung!
As I was sweeping across the old wooden floor, I heard something breaking.
A sphere surrounding four people emitting light that forms on the floor at the same time.
Without even having time to recognize what it was, the party was engulfed in the light.
“Is this… a magic circle?”
A voice of bewilderment escaped Jaehyun’s mouth.
He quickly grasped the situation and quickly shouted at the party.
“Get out of this circle right now!”
But his call was not delivered. In the first place, the activation of the ceremony was too fast.
Jaehyun gritted it.
‘shit. This is transmission magic. If I use «Absolute Calculation» here, we might be swept away in a completely different place…!’
Jaehyun gritted his teeth and looked around.
Magic tools prepared in advance so that those caught in the trap cannot move.
It was difficult for those who were still cadets to escape from this.
“shit!”
Jaehyun let out a sigh of anger.
Soon after, letters that ordinary people could not read began to be written clearly.
Ahn Ho-yeon tilted his head, and Seo In-na and Kim Yoo-jung, who were magicians, were able to roughly guess what it was.
However, only Jaehyun was able to fully read the text.
[You fool. To Svartal Fame, the world of the Dark Elves. you. Transmit.]
The light is young.
However, you are sucked into a terrible abyss mixed with darkness that is different from what you have ever felt.
―Transfers the user to Svartalfame.
―The dungeon is dangerous compared to its level.
―Exit the dungeon immediately.
