chapters.content:
Episode 94 Svartal Fame (1)
Svartal Fame (world of the swart elves).
Also called Svartálfaheimr, the world inhabited by Dark Elves.
“shit.”
Jaehyun sighed and looked around.
“……What the hell is this place……”
Seo Ina trailed off and trembled.
Jaehyun answered without looking back.
“Svartalfame.”
not even a ray of light can reach. Darkness spread all around, welcoming the group.
A distant abyss that exudes shady and hopeless magic.
Jaehyun looked around and sighed slightly.
‘In Norse mythology, dark elves are described as possessing powers comparable to those of the gods. Of course, as it became a dungeon, its power would have weakened… but it’s too much to do.
Guin. Did you mean to send the cadets to a place like this to annihilate them?’
In the first place, I couldn’t understand that he was able to use such high-level transmission magic.
Gu Jain is human at best.
A mere human involved in the transmission ceremony of Svartal Fame, one of the nine worlds?
‘shit. Did you mean bursting the gate like this? After all, the more you peel it, the dirtier it comes out…’
Jaehyun pondered over Goo Jain’s actions in the past.
The first time I felt a sense of incongruity was during a mock dungeon.
At that time, Goo Jain sent a B-class monster to attack Jaehyun in order to tame him. He tried to subdue himself by using the magic beast strengthened by Odin’s raven.
But how could that be possible?
Humans cannot tame demons.
However, Gu Jain released a demonic beast in the dungeon and manipulated it to attack the cadets, which was clearly not a human domain.
Intervention of other transcendent beings.
Jaehyun couldn’t help but doubt this.
‘It’s certain that there is something in common between Gujain… and the Aesir gods.’
Guzain’s connection to Odin’s crows is enough to tell.
Odin’s raven.
In the decisive battle with Min Seong-oh, Jae-hyun realized what they were like.
One of the spiritual creatures of Norse mythology, beings who swear absolute loyalty to Odin.
Gu Jain manipulated the magical beasts enhanced with their powers.
What this fact tells us is clear.
Gujain is Odin. Or they are closely related to other Aesir gods.
‘I don’t know everything right now. Hella also told me that she couldn’t give me all the context. And… for now, I have to think of a way to get out of here first.’
Jaehyun took a deep breath and calmly organized his thoughts.
at that time. An uproarious voice erupted from the side.
“what?! Svartal Fame? That’s where even A-class raiders die!”
“…If Jaehyun’s words are true, the chances of surviving here are slim.”
Both Kim Yu-jung and Seo E-na were skeptical.
Well, if that was normal, it was a normal reaction.
Raiders that attacked Svartal Fame are rare enough to be counted on one hand.
Lee Jae-shin or Yoo Seong-eun, who are S-class raiders.
Even they couldn’t say for sure that they could survive here.
‘In the first place, there are almost no strategy for Svartal Fame at this time.’
Park Seong-jae, who followed along, would also not know the exact strategy of Svartal Fame.
Even the surroundings are so wide that it approaches the field. You’ll probably have to spend a lot of time just looking for the boss room.
Maybe we should spend a few days here.
Jaehyun let out a short sigh and looked up into the air.
“Doesn’t that sound like a good situation no matter how you look at it?”
“That’s right.”
At Jaehyun’s words, Seongjae Park released his hiding and revealed himself. The party was startled and shouted loudly, barely covering their mouths.
“Seo Seong-jae?”
“Manager?”
“……How are you here?”
In response to the three questions, Seongjae Park glanced at Jaehyun and said.
“Min Jae-hyun somehow foresaw that there would be such a variable. I’m here because you said you need an adult radar to help.
Yoosung has a lot of eyes for CEO to move directly.”
“It’s all good… I thought I was going to die like this…”
Kim Yoo-jung sighed and said.
However, Park Seong-jae’s expression was not good.
“no. My presence has not made things particularly better.”
“yes?”
This time, Ahn Ho-yeon asked a question.
Seongjae Park looked at the desolate and dark landscape.
“This is Svartal Fame, as Jaehyun said earlier. This is the world of the dark elves. If you’re a little careless here, you’re sure to get all killed. Danger remains the same.”
“…….”
Everyone had no choice but to be silent at Park Seong-jae’s cold words.
but. At most, Park Seong-jae is only an A-class radar.
This is a place where the possibility of clearing is remarkably low even if dozens of A-ranks enter the engineering college.
Of course, there is no change in the fact that it is of great help as the level is different, but it was obvious arrogance to think that it was possible to safely clear this place with that level of force.
This place is like the bottomless pit.
In a place with little light, they have to fight and finally defeat the boss. Everyone in the party knew what that meant.
Meanwhile, even at that moment, Jaehyun was trying to understand the rushing situation.
‘Svartal Fame’s attack strategy is still almost unknown. However, that’s just the story of ‘now’.’
Of course, there is no change to the fact that it is a difficult dungeon.
However, Jaehyun had already experienced Svartal Fame before returning.
Not only that, but high-ranking engineering colleges in the past left a lot of strategy for the Dark Elves.
If you can use the records well, surviving in this hellish place will not be so difficult.
Jaehyun spoke in a calm voice to the frightened party.
“don’t worry.”
Jaehyun smiled and looked around at the group.
“Somehow, everyone can come back alive. because i will make it Let’s start by finding survivors.”
* * *
“Oops. long time no see. Chairman. How have you been?”
“of course. Hoyeon-kun’s father has also become clearer.”
Two people sitting down almost at the same time having a meaningless conversation.
The two met in the lobby of a hotel in downtown Seoul and moved to talk. From now on, it will be difficult for the things the two are talking about to leak out.
Because it is very confidential.
Goo Ja-in and Ahn Seok-gu, who are seated, are examining each other’s behavior with subtle expressions on each other.
As soon as there is nothing to gain, the two are ready to abandon each other.
The distance between the two is as cold as if they were caught on thin ice. Even though they were close, the two were very far apart.
As evidence of that, the two of them didn’t even take a sip of coffee in front of them.
The first to speak was Ahn Seok-gu.
“It’s nothing else. The reason I asked to see the chairman like this is……”
He raised his eyes.
The bloody light of the eyes sweeps down Gu Jain’s eyes and face in turn.
“My son finished fourth in the freshman hunt.”
“yes. What a pity.”
Gu Jain replied with a calm face.
Ahn Seok-gu’s face contorted for a moment.
This is clearly a breach of promise.
lately. Even when talking about weeding out in the simulated dungeon, he hadn’t even dreamed that An Ho-yeon had ranked 4th in the freshman hunt.
I just vaguely thought that since my son had nothing to say, he would have ranked first.
However, the results were different.
Ahn Ho-yeon finished 4th, which made Ahn Seok-gu angry.
past. Gu Jain said it with his own mouth.
[We will definitely make your son the best radar in Korea.]
Believing in those words and providing full support, he raised his son to be strong.
But what?
4th place?
‘Even our Hoyeon lost to a magical raider… This must have been something the director, Gu Jain, did.’
That’s a simple conclusion.
You may have received back money, or you may have manipulated the event using your power.
Anyway, this makes no sense.
At most, three magic cadets beat their elite son and take all 1st to 3rd places?
Is that a reasonable thing to do?
Ahn Seok-gu tried to hide his displeasure, but he couldn’t erase everything that was revealed in his expression.
Displeasure that came with irritation twisted his brows.
‘That’s stupid.’
Seeing this, Gu Jain smiled.
He knew very well what Ahn Seok-gu wanted from him.
To raise my son, Ahn Ho-yeon, to the highest position and expose him to the media so that he can be admired as a hero.
That is Ahn Seok-gu’s ultimate goal.
‘But there is no need for me to intervene unreasonably. Losing games don’t work for me. Intervene only when it is judged that there is a clear advantage.
Yeah… It’s like a card game. A game that can never be lost where the opponent’s hand is clearly visible.’
Gu Jain had a fishy smile.
Originally, Ahn Seok-gu was a military officer and had a fairly deep connection to the central government.
His son, An Ho-yeon alone, is quite useful, but if he can extort these government contacts later on, it will help him to further solidify his position.
That’s why I’m still negotiating with him.
Fortunately, Ahn Seok-gu seemed to be well aware of his situation.
He said with a smile, trying not to raise his voice.
“I’m sure the Miles Academy sent Hoyeon because they thought they could raise her well… I’m worried when the situation develops like this.”
“haha. Father too. No need to worry at all. Ahn Ho-yeon already has natural talent. Maybe at the next event I will easily take first place.”
100% unreliable.
Ahn Seok-gu intuitively realized that Gu Ja-in was lying.
But should I show it here?
that’s sewage
It is right to wait and see more opportunities here.
Looking at it objectively, Miles is the one who can best raise his son.
If the relationship with Gu Ja-in goes wrong now, it will put a brake on his son’s growth.
Ahn Seok-gu decided to change the question slightly.
“You seem a little interested. Would it be all right if I ask you a question?”
“As much as you like.”
“The magic cadet who took first place in the freshman hunt this time… who the hell is he?”
A smile spread at the corners of Gu Jain’s lips.
Perhaps Ahn Seok-gu saw Min Jae-hyun’s personal profile on TV.
What he is now asking for is confidential information that has not been disclosed to the outside world a little deeper.
“Um… It’s a rule not to reveal personal information of a cadet to others. If Hoyeon is the father, I will specially inform you.
Aren’t we so bleak?”
Gu Jain said with a smile on his face, pretending to be patronizing.
Ahn Seok-gu silently crossed his arms and waited for his next words.
Soon, Gu Jain’s mouth opened.
“Min Jaehyun. He is a genius cadet who was born with 97% magical aptitude.”
“……97% magic aptitude?!”
Ahn Seok-gu asked Goo Ja-in with a genuinely surprised face.
Gu Jain silently nodded, confirming his words.
“Huh……”
Ahn Seok-gu could hardly get away from Gu Ja-in’s words.
‘The higher the aptitude of the radar, the more roughly the grade is determined. To mark some kind of growth threshold. That must be the aptitude of the radar… What? 97 percent?’
Is that the bottom line?
It’s hard not to believe it because it’s Gu Ja-in’s words, but it’s an overwhelming number that I can’t feel at all.
The son who was called a genius in the media and broke all records had an aptitude of 92.
But 97?
Is that also a magic cadet?
Looking at Ahn Seok-gu, whose face was distorted, Goo Ja-in had a calm and weak face.
He smiled lightly and pointed to the coffee cup in front of him.
“……this. It’s gone cold. Shall I ask you to come back?”
“……no. I’ll just go. Thank you for your time.”
“you’re welcome.”
Ahn Seok-gu got up, left the hotel, and got into the car.
He kept repeating one thing over and over, thinking and thinking.
“Min Jae-hyeon… How dare we lose to the magic world, Hoyeoni?”
His face contorted wildly.
It was a long time ago that his car on the road exceeded the speed limit.

Episode 95: Svartal Fame (2)
“…It seems too dark here… First of all, we need to use the Flash…” “
Ina, wait a minute. I will use the magic, so can you watch over me?”
After stopping Seo Ina from using Flash, Jaehyun stepped forward lightly.
Pats Tsutsut……!
The energy of life pulsating within the body collided with each other, creating a fierce noise.
After concentrating the mana in his fingertips, Jaehyun shot it towards the pitch-black darkness.
―Active skill 《Flash Lv 3》 is used.
―A stronger light dispels the darkness and brightens the surroundings.
Dozens of light-bearing spheres floated in the air and soon began to gather around Jaehyun.
Floating in the air, the white lights busily follow him.
Like moss, the sphere adhered to the stone walls inside the dungeon and emitted light.
“What?! This!”
Kim Yoo-jung, who was looking at the halo of light floating in the air, burst into embarrassment.
Jaehyun laughed involuntarily at the better response than he expected.
‘but. It’s strange that I’m not surprised when I see something like this.’
While Jaehyun thought so, he did not forget to scold Kim Yoojung.
“Kim Yoo-jung. It’s not here in the dungeon. Lower your voice.”
“Hup! I’m sorry…”
Kim Yoo-jung quickly covered her mouth.
She apologized, but still fixed her gaze as if possessed by the light.
“I mean, I’m just asking. Perhaps this light…”
“Right. You leveled up the D-class magic «Flash».”
“……what?!”
This time a more passive voice.
However, the confusion contained there was conveyed to Jaehyun.
A small burst of astonishment.
The eyes of the three people who were watching Jaehyun narrowed at once.
In particular, the faces of Kim Yoo-jung and Seo In-na, who are magicians, were the most worth seeing.
The two looked at Jaehyun’s back almost at the same time and thought.
‘Skill level up?! But that’s only possible with at least an A-class radar…!’
‘……Nonsense. Are you saying that Jaehyun has already raised his skills to that level?’
Of course, it wasn’t just the two of them who were shocked.
Ahn Ho-yeon and Park Seong-jae also seemed quite surprised, even without saying a word.
‘Is this a natural reaction?’
Jaehyun thought so with a calm face.
In the eyes of others, the achievements he has achieved will be simply unbelievable.
Over the past month, Jaehyun has worked hard to grow on his own.
While listening to the < Understanding Magical Operations > lecture, I realized the more fundamental truth of magic.
I realized how to configure the formula so that it is stable for the caster and how the formula can attack the enemy more effectively.
In addition, he succeeded in reading all the magic books in the central library of Miles Academy. After meeting Yoo Sung-eun, he did not neglect actual combat training either.
Thanks to this, Jaehyun was able to raise his abilities to a level where he could easily level up with D-rank or lower magic.
Jaehyun thought for a moment and looked at the light shining in front of him.
‘Especially, Flash is a magic that can be used at any time, so I used it day and night to level up.
I don’t eat much mana in the first place. Thanks to that, I’m already level 3. I’ve reached the point where people can follow me without having to carry spheres with their hands. Well, my arm doesn’t hurt, so it’s a win-win.’
Jaehyun nodded with a satisfied face, and chin chined forward.
“what are you doing? Aren’t you all going?”
“I see. let’s go everyone.”
“Ah yes……”
“……Yes.”
With fish-eyed faces, the party alternately looked at Jaehyun and the sphere that illuminated the front.
The viscous light on the wall was dispelling the cluttered darkness.
‘Is this really possible?’
Park Seong-jae stuck out his tongue as he watched Jae-hyun handle the sphere perfectly.
A drop of cold sweat ran down his back, and his body trembled.
Even though he was a martial artist, he was well aware of how outstanding the current achievement was.
As the manager of the Yeonhwa Guild, he had the opportunity to train many new raiders and experienced amazing talents every time.
Together. In Park Seong-jae’s eyes, Jae-hyun’s talent is out of the norm.
It was unbelievable.
He gulped down his saliva and looked at Jaehyun, who still had a calm face.
Park Seong-jae thought.
‘To reach the level of an A-class raider at the age of 17… It’s a terrifyingly overwhelming talent.’
In no country in the world, no one has reached Class A at the age of 17.
Seongjae Park took a deep breath and followed Jaehyun as he watched the light illuminating the cave and murmured.
“How far can Jaehyun grow?”
* * *
“Such a dog…… Instructor Seokgi Kim! How the hell are you going to handle it!”
“Sorry. Chairman… But I never thought that an outsider would dare to set foot inside the guild building…”
“Are you saying that now!”
Milles Academy’s Director’s Office.
Instructor Kim Seok-ki was bending over and bowing his head toward Gu Ja-in.
The reason why Kim Seok-ki was so confused was simple.
It was because the < Kane > Guild had just received a report from the < < Kane > > guild that other outcasts had been swept away along with the ceremony they had made to deal with the useless students.

intuition.

“Boss monster. We have to catch him and close the dungeon.”

chapters.title: Chapter 98
chapters.content:
Episode 98 King of the Dark Elves (1)
It was about two hours later that I encountered the two survivors.
As expected, the condition was serious because he fell into mana poisoning.
After feeding Lee Jae-sang’s potion, I waited for a while, and the medicinal effect began to work quickly. Before 30 minutes had passed, the color of her blood began to brighten.
The heavy breathing also gradually subsided.
The party couldn’t help but admire the potion’s performance.
“As expected, it is the chancellor’s potion. There is a reason why the workshop went well.”
“I know. I didn’t expect it to be this good either.”
Jaehyun scratched his head at Ahn Hoyeon’s words.
In fact, the potion’s performance was much better than Jaehyun expected.
It is very difficult to treat patients with mana poisoning.
Professional healing radars. It is impossible to alleviate symptoms so easily unless it is grade B or higher.
However, Lee Jae-sang’s potion made this possible.
It was a talent worthy of the word genius.
Meanwhile, Jaehyun and his party also drank potions in preparation for the upcoming battle.
From basic potions that restore physical strength and magic power. Even special potions that temporarily enhance key stats.
All of them were expensive items, but now was not the time to save them.
Dark Elf.
Even though they won the battle a while ago, they are Class A monsters.
Except for Jaehyun and Seongjae Park, no one in the party could deal with them one-on-one.
Without doping, the battle would be much more difficult.
‘It’s fortunate that there are plenty of potions.’
Jaehyun smiled bitterly at that thought.
After a while.
“Uh…”
The two unconscious cadets slowly woke up.
Each of those who fell was a man and a woman.
The first person to open his eyes was a man. It was Joo Seong-chan.
“……What the hell is this place…… You……”
“Min Jaehyun. And this is Svartal Fame. It is the land of the Dark Elves.”
Jaehyun quickly cut off his words.
“hey! Jaehyun Min! What are you going to do if you pass out after saying that?!”
Kim Yoo-jung immediately intervened with a rebellion.
Seongjae Park asked Seongchan Joo in a calm voice.
“I am Seongjae Park of the Yeonhwa Guild. I am here to save you.”
“……W Yeonhwa Guild?”
Joo Seong-chan muttered with a hand on his forehead as he suffered from a severe headache.
“It wasn’t a dream… it wasn’t…”
“What the hell happened?”
Jaehyun asked, but the answer didn’t come right away.
It seemed like it would take quite a while before we could have a normal conversation.
Jaehyun felt his head getting complicated.
As a result of reading the report, there are more cadets who are still alive.
But you can’t hit it blindly.
This is a dungeon that is at least equivalent to Class A.
If my memory is correct before returning, the boss is probably at the level of S rank.
No matter how recreated it is, it is difficult to break through without taking risks.
Therefore, Jaehyun was planning to break through the dungeon after digging up as much information as possible here.
However, if time is delayed like this, the story is different.
‘shit. Should I go and crash right away?’
when I was thinking
Fortunately, Ha Yeon-joo, who had fallen down with her, woke up.
Jaehyun jumped up quickly before she even asked.
“Don’t ask where. This is the dungeon of the Dark Elves in Svartal Fame.”
“……As expected.”
Ha Yeon-joo shuddered, but seemed to accept the situation aloofly.
but. The two must have already encountered the Dark Elves. After all, this was a more normal reaction than Joo Seong-chan, who kept his mouth shut.
Ha Yeon-joo said in a low voice as if her throat was locked.
“The other kids are being held.”
Only then did Joo Seong-chan come to his senses and added his words.
“That’s right! The kids who came to the Cain Guild with us…”
“First, tell me what happened. Because there is no time.”
“……okay.”
Ha Yeon-joo nodded at Jae-hyun’s words.
Joo Seong-chan and Ha Yeon-ju looked at each other for a while and then gradually moved on.
Ha Yeon-joo was the first to speak.
“Right after we landed in Svartalfame, we were immediately attacked by the Dark Elves. All the other kids were taken away, and Sung-chan and I barely escaped from them.
However, I couldn’t stand the mana poisoning, so in the end…”
Ha Yeon-joo couldn’t finish her words.
Maybe it’s because of guilt. As a raider cadet, he ran away in fear of the enemy despite borrowing that name.
Even Joo Seong-chan’s expression was shadowed.
they will think
They are cowards and should have died fighting alongside their comrades.
But this was plain arrogance.
Do you fight against an enemy you cannot handle?
This is only possible in cartoons.
A place where you can lose your life to an opponent lower than yourself. That is the dungeon and the field.
However, Jaehyun was also a person who understood their feelings better than anyone else.
In the past, he abandoned his colleagues in a mock dungeon and ran out.
Because I was afraid of death.
The thirst and instinct for life are something that everyone naturally experiences. It is more urgent to save the remaining people than to feel guilty here.
Jaehyun grabbed Joo Sungchan by the shoulder and shook him.
“Calm down and speak the truth. It’s not because of you that they were captured.”
“……but.”
“Are you going to kill all the other kids too?”
I can’t help it, even if it’s a little extreme.
The priority now is to save the cadets who are still alive. Things were too bad to care about their feelings.
“There is a king who moves the dark elves. I think he might be the boss.”
Ha Yeon-ju looked at Jae-hyun as if she had made up her mind.
Jaehyun bit his lip.
‘also. Is the king of the Dark Elves the boss of this dungeon?’
Jaehyun already knew which boss monster would appear in the dungeon.
‘Dark elves serve the king and absolutely obey his orders.’
Svartalfheim is vast and has countless factions and kings.
It was only natural that the boss monster here was the king of the Dark Elves.
“so. What was the king like? What about traits and skills?”
“I don’t know because I’ve never met them properly… I ran away right away at that time…”
“I’m sorry…”
Ha Yeon-joo and Joo Seong-chan both bowed their heads and said that.
“are you okay. One more thing than that.”
After reading the two together, Jaehyun asked a different question this time.
In fact, this was the most important question for Jaehyun.
“The man who brought you here. Who is that person?”
I wanted to ask this question the most from the beginning.
There is no way that Gu Jain was directly involved in this. If so, the most suspicious person at this point is…….
“…… Instructor Kim Seok-gi.”
Ha Yeon-ju struggled to open her mouth.
The two still seemed unable to get out of the shock.
“He brought us here.”
* * *
Yeonhwa Guild’s office.
Yoo Eun-eun and Park Ha-na. Two voices are heard.
“Are you really okay? Taking other guild members with you…”
“No. It’s an urgent situation. What’s more… If the other members of Yeonhwa accompany you now, the paparazzi will definitely follow you. Then things get bigger.”
Yoo Sung-eun replied calmly while wearing armor.
The equipment she is wearing right now is one of the best weapons in the Yeonhwa Guild.
《Advanced Valkyrie’s Guardian》.
It was an S-class item that corrected the defense and healing power to the limit.
‘To think he’d even wear a «Advanced Valkyrie’s Guardian»… that’s how dangerous it is.’
Hana Park helped Seongeun Yoo put on the armor with a stiff face.
Meanwhile, Yoo Seong-eun reflected on what happened a little while ago with a calm expression.
‘Ominous magic…… If it’s that long, it means that at least S-class magic has been activated.’
asked about this.
‘Jaehyun, the kids, and Sungjae oppa are in danger.’
Of course, in preparation for this situation, I handed over Ivaldi’s Earrings to Jaehyun.
Judging from the fact that the effect of the earring has not been activated yet, there should be no casualties.
But you can’t be at ease.
A healer is never a job that brings the dead back to life.
Any delay and everything will go awry.
After wearing all the equipment, Yoo Seong-eun stood up and said.
“Take a picture of the coordinates of the Kane Guild the kids said they went to and send it to me. one you wait here Secure all CCTVs around you.
If I don’t come back by tomorrow morning, I’ll immediately ask for help from the association and send reinforcements.”
“……All right.”
Park Ha-na wanted to stop Yoo Seong-eun right away, but she couldn’t.
Because when you look at her like that, no words can convince her.
Moreover, now the life of her brother, Park Seong-jae, is at stake.
I know it’s selfish, but if Yoo Sung-eun steps forward, there’s a good chance things will be resolved smoothly.
No matter how strong the enemy is.
There is no one who can stop Yoo Seong-eun unless it is the same S-class radar.
“CEO!”
Yoo Seong-eun was about to step outside.
Park Ha-na called Yoo Seong-eun and said.
“…You know, but you have to be careful.”
“don’t worry. You know how to do it well.”
After speaking in a subdued voice, Yoo Seong-eun left the guild building.
Her face was dark the whole time she climbed into the car and drove.
Running down the smooth road, Yoo Seong-eun made up her mind.
If, at all, Gu Jain had touched even one hair on her people…
she was ready to go to war.
* * *
“Let’s return to the crossroads for now.”
“That sounds like a good idea to me too. First of all, we plan and move from there.”
Jaehyun and Park Seongjae exchanged opinions and took their steps.
The party was preparing for the enemy’s attack while paying attention not to miss the words of the two people.
After passing through a long pitch-dark tunnel, I came out to a slightly brighter place.
Thanks to Jaehyun’s Flash, the party was able to return to where they came from without getting lost.
The three paths we met again.
Joo Seong-chan and Ha Yeon-ju had to move especially carefully because they were not in the body to fight.
Jaehyun looked over the road and thought for a while.
How can I defeat the boss the fastest?
How can I safely close the dungeon while protecting them?
After thinking for a while, the answer came straight away.
“You all wait here. I will scout the right road and come back.”
As a result of checking with the kigam, there was a colony of dark elves on the right. If you leave it alone, there is a high possibility that it will become cumbersome when you play the boss fight.
Jaehyun was thinking of clearing the post in advance to prevent this from happening.
“alone? What’s on the right side of the road?”
Kim Yoo-jung narrowed her eyes and asked anxiously.
“I can feel the turbid magic. There seems to be a colony of dark elves.”
Jaehyun said calmly.
At the same time, protests from others erupted everywhere.
“it’s crazy?! It’s too dangerous to go alone! You might die!”
“……Yoojeong is right. I know how you feel, but it’s better to move together.”
“I think so too. It’s true that Jaehyun has great skills, but…”
Jaehyun’s declaration of a bomb made everyone in the party panic.
The only one who did not oppose his opinion was Ahn Ho-yeon.
‘Jaehyun has never done anything without thinking.’
From the first encounter with the goblin, Jaehyun was a mysterious being to Ahn Hoyeon.
He always makes appropriate and correct judgments at every moment and knows how to lead his colleagues.
It is innate qualities as a leader.
And a true leader never abandons his comrades.
Always calmly find a way to overcome the situation, put it into practice, and eventually succeed.
After a while. Ahn Ho-yeon nodded and said.
“……okay. I agree.”
“hey! Ahn Ho-yeon!”
Kim Yoo-jung was hot, but Jae-hyun’s will was also stubborn.
“You still can’t win a one-on-one fight with the Dark Elves. Manager Park Seong-jae is also an assassin, so it’s true that it’s difficult to deal with more than two people. It’s the best I can do for now.”
“……but still……”
“Then is there another way?”
Jaehyun talked as much as he could and persuaded him.
However, I could never say that I would come back without dying. This is because a dungeon is a place where life cannot always be guaranteed.
“……All right. But if something dangerous happens, you must come back right away.”
In the end, Seongjae Park also gave up.
It was because Jaehyun’s words were right.
“Manager. I’ll be right back. I wish you well, my friends.”
“Okay, don’t worry.”
After that, Jaehyun disappeared towards the road to the right.
The group just kept their mouths shut and followed his back.

chapters.title: Chapter 99
chapters.content:
Episode 99 The King of the Dark Elves (2)
About an hour after that.
As they went deeper, the dark elves’ stronghold was revealed.
Jaehyun took a step inside, calmly erasing his presence.
A space full of darkness. The miasma tickling the tip of his nose twisted his forehead.
‘Corrupted Mana…… I did well not to bring the other kids.’
As expected of the enemy’s stronghold, the magic leaking out from inside was very sticky and ugly.
A mana with such a density that a mere cadet could never withstand it. If the party had come together, they might have been poisoned by mana and hindered.
Jaehyun sighed and moved further inside to avoid the enemy’s gaze.
After about 5 minutes like that.
In the pitch-black darkness, the voices of unknown people were heard.
Jaehyun quickly moved closer while activating the stealth skill of 《Shadow Armor》.
“Is the reconnaissance team returning yet? What the hell are those guys doing around?”
“So it is. It’s been a long time since my shift, but I’m really happy. I guess I’ll have to do a water change.”
‘……A sentry? Those scouts are probably the ones I killed earlier.’
Fortunately, the sentry didn’t notice at all that Jaehyun was hiding.
While looking for an opportunity to surprise, Jaehyun focused his attention not to miss their conversation. It was because there was a possibility of leaking useful information.
After a while.
When Jaehyun finally moved to about 5 meters away from the enemy. Their voices continued again.
“by the way. Those ‘outsiders’ who were summoned then.”
“Are you talking about the lower races of Midgard? ……Did you say human?”
“okay! that. Anyway, those guys were really good. Where else will you not fall?”
The sentry licked his lips and said.
Another sentry standing next to him crossed his arms and answered.
“Hey, it’s not always something you can see. I don’t know about you, but it’s hard to see such super products often. How lucky this time, guys with plenty of magic poured in, but…”
Jaehyun’s face hardened coldly as he listened to the eerie story of the two dark elves.
He immediately realized the reason for the discomfort he had felt earlier.
Right before the first encounter with the Dark Elves.
Jaehyun received the survivor’s feeling through 《Magic Detection》.
However, only six vital signs were detected at that time. Two people were not enough compared to the eight people who originally entered the dungeon.
Jaehyun finally realized why.
‘Two of them have already been eaten.’
Jaehyun chewed his lips and glared at the chattering Dark Elves.
‘The remaining people are gradually dying. There is no time to delay.’
Jaehyun immediately deployed his mana and shot it towards the guard post.
―Active skill «Flame Arrow Lv 3».
Quaang!
Eight arrows of intense fire ignited from the fingertips and began to smash the guard post.
The Dark Elves shouted as if they noticed something strange when they saw the arrows flying towards them.
“What is this!”
“Boo fire!!”
A panicked voice erupted from the witch’s mouth.
Jaehyun heard the sound from behind and stared blankly at the rest of the Dark Elves.
“An intruder has appeared! Everyone line up and annihilate the enemy!”
“I will say it again! An intruder appeared. Everyone line up and annihilate the enemy!”
The Dark Elves raised their mana and materialized the weapons they were good at using their mana.
The first in line was the two with spears followed by the four with staffs. In the back row, Dark Elves carrying crossbows and crossbows started running in formation.
The enemy raised their spirits and lined up on both sides of Jae-hyun, exuding intimidating mana.
A magical blue that has absolutely no effect poured out to blatantly scare the enemy.
However, Jaehyun just looked at them without being afraid at all.
The guy who was commanding the battle in the middle of the enemy camp took a step forward.
He was probably the leader of the guard post.
“To attack the Dark Elves in Svartal Fame. You’re a guy who has the guts to be human.”
“Why do you guys have more guts?”
“What do you mean?”
“Is it not guts to not run away even in front of me and take up a weapon?”
“……You are arrogant. human!”
The leader’s forehead narrowed as they exchanged words.
The leader laughed at Jaehyun’s words and said with a mischievous expression.
“Kill him.”
as soon as the words fall.
As if they had waited, the Dark Elves started attacking.
* * *
“……Is Jaehyun okay?”
Seo Ina looked at the party with a gloomy face and asked.
He was worried about Jaehyun, who went to the colony of Dark Elves alone a while ago.
The party, including Kim Yoo-jung, was also worried about Jae-hyun.
But there was no other way.
Realistically, except for Park Seong-jae, Jae-hyun is the only person who can become a force here.
If Jae-hyun fails in this task, there is little chance that the rest of the party will return alive.
“It will be fine. Because Jaehyun is strong.”
“okay. It’s not someone else, it’s Jaehyun. Nothing will happen.”
Park Seong-jae and Ahn Ho-yeon said, but Seo In-na still had a dark face.
Kim Yoo-jung also did not look good. She had already been greatly surprised to learn that Jaehyun had died in a mock dungeon.
A little while ago, Jaehyun stubbornly said he would go, and I couldn’t stop him…….
“It will be fine. maybe.”
Kim Yoo-jung smiled and said, trying to reassure Seo In-na.
Seo Eana, who is not good at interacting with others, would not be used to this kind of situation. However, Kim Yoo-jung also could not stand the trembling of her body.
“For now, let’s do what we can. We have to protect the sacrament and the performance.”
“……huh.”
On the other hand, Park Seong-jae’s expression hardened in an instant as he watched the scene.
It was because the thick magic power pouring out from inside the dungeon was rapidly approaching the party.
“Shh.”
Seongjae Park put his index finger to his mouth.
The voices of those who were talking stopped.
The sound of the wind soon began to be heard.
‘It’s an ominous magic. It’s very subtle… but it’s coming this way little by little.’
Park Seong-jae said in a calm voice.
“An enemy is coming! Everyone in their seats!”
Upon hearing the voice, everyone in the party lined up and observed the enemy’s movements.
But the situation wasn’t getting any better, it was only getting worse.
Dangerous.
Park Seong-jae gritted it.
The magical power that is felt is different.
‘shit! It’s a completely different opponent than the guys I dealt with earlier.’
At the same time, an urgent voice erupted from Park Seong-jae’s mouth.
“Everyone, hurry up and avoid it…!”
However. Park Seong-jae’s words were not yet finished.
Took-tuk.
Two terrifying sounds in succession.
The group’s mouths were tightly shut.
After a while.
Unbelievable things were happening in front of those who came to their senses.
“Manager!”
“Oh, how could this be…!”
Kim Yoo-jung and Ahn Ho-yeon muttered in dismay.
All eyes were focused on one spot.
At the end of the line of sight was the site of the real disaster.
Park Seong-jae fell forward while bleeding, and the red eyes felt behind him.
they saw
Six elite dark elf knights surround him. Park Seong-jae’s left arm was neatly cut.
* * *
Jaehyun caught his breath.
The first thing fired was the long-range magic of the guys with staffs.
Koo Goo Goo……!
Ice fragments of freezing properties and dizzying lightning strikes rushed sharply toward the reappearance.
Even if you can’t do all of them, it’s an intermediate level or higher level C-class magic.
but.
―Active skill 《Absolute Calculation》 nullifies the enemy’s magic.
―Active skill «Wind Boost».
It was a completely meaningless attack to Jaehyun.
After destroying all attacks, Jaehyun immediately kicked the ground and moved behind the wizards.
A mage’s most vulnerable moment is when she starts casting immediately after using magic.
Jaehyun was well aware of that weakness.
charrrrrrr!
Chains that became sharp like swords began to pierce the hearts of enemies.
All the Dark Elves holding the staff perished in the blink of an eye.
The leader saw it belatedly and realized that Jaehyun’s words were not lies.
Jaehyun was strong.
It was a fact that I realized without competing for a few sums.
However, even so, the leader had a fishy laugh.
No matter how strong the representation is, this is the Dark Elves’ outpost. The troops still have a long way to go.
Defeating them all would be impossible for a mere human.
“You will never return alive here.”
With the leader’s words, more reinforcements flocked from the rear.
As a kind of standing army, they were stationed in case there was a problem at the guard post.
The Dark Elves used magic while keeping their distance from Jaehyun as much as possible. The staff they are holding emits light and attaches itself to Jaehyun.
Geeeeee…….
Together with poisonous mana, an arithmetic formula was written in the air and emitted light.
―Dark Elves use the active skill 《Mana Chain》.
―Dark Elves use the active skill Paralysis Spell.
―Dark Elves use the active skill 《Poisoning Spell》.
Status abnormal magic that comes in succession.
However, Jaehyun already knew that they would come out like that.
‘The scariest thing about Dark Elves is CC.’
This is a pattern often seen in intelligent witches.
Use CC to neutralize the enemy and eat it slowly.
However, Jaehyun had no reason to panic at all.
―The passive skill 《Hell’s Protection》 protects the user from abnormal status.
《Blessing of Hell》.
The power gained from the first trial drove away the status ailments.
Jaehyun laughed.
As long as you have this skill, you will never get abnormal status.
However, the Dark Elves, who were unaware of this, had no choice but to panic.
“How did this happen! You resisted magic?!”
“I don’t know about that.”
Jaehyun sent magic power through his body and took a step forward.
A cool smile spread across his lips.
“Heuk!”
Suddenly, he jumped up and grabbed the leader’s neck.
The other Dark Elves were already terrified and unable to move.
Jaehyun asked in a low voice.
“Answer the question.”
“How dare you… a human subject! An order to the proud Dark Elves… Kap!”
Jaehyun tightened his grip and twisted his bones coldly.
“If you want to change your pride and your life, you can do whatever you want. Well, it doesn’t pay off, though.”
“Kuh…… I will tell you! So let go now!”
“good. Then I will ask again.”
As I let go of the strength in my hands, the leader fell to the ground and grabbed my head.
Jaehyun stepped on the leader’s head with his foot and asked.
“There must be humans who fell here a few hours ago. Did you eat them?”
“……Yes.”
The leader looked at Jaehyun’s face and added urgently.
“Ha, but I didn’t eat all of them! Some are still alive…”
“Where are they now?”
“Wow, to the king’s residence…”
‘As expected.’
Jaehyun was well aware of the habits of the dark elves.
Perhaps the surviving cadets are being treated like their toys.
Watching them struggle in pain by inflicting conditions such as poisoning or paralysis, or forcing them to eat poisonous meat.
The Dark Elves had been killing humans in a cruel and dirty way even before returning.
‘I can’t drag the time.’
Jaehyun raised his mana again and put it on his toes.
I got enough information.
Now this guy has no utility value.
Tsutsutsutsutsut…!
The ripple sound of clashing magical powers.
The leader trembled and shouted in shock.
“Wait a minute! I will definitely save you…”
“I don’t remember making a promise like that.”
“That kind of thing!”
Jaehyun raised an eyebrow and whispered in a low voice.
“You didn’t think it would save you, did you?”
Jaehyun blew magic into the leg that stepped on the leader and then exploded it.
Quaang!
Stunned by that sight, the rest of the Dark Elves secretly took a step back.
However, Jaehyun intended to slaughter them without leaving a single one.
Killing a creature with intelligence means always taking the risk of revenge.
But it didn’t matter.
Jaehyun was thinking of telling the dark elves what to fear.
―Active skill 《Chain of Lightning》.
Jaehyun looked around at the dark elves and said.
“Don’t think that you will die gracefully.

chapters.title: Chapter 100
chapters.content:
Episode 100 King of the Dark Elves (3)
“Is this here? The place where the kids and Seongjae oppa disappeared.”
Yoo Seong-eun had just arrived at the entrance of the «Kane» guild.
Shabby exterior and interior.
The gloomy mana that I can already feel is flowing down with high pressure, creating a blue wave.
Yoo Sung-eun, who looked around, frowned.
This is obviously a strange place.
Doors squeaking because they have not been oiled and windows that cannot be seen inside. Not only that, but even the thick scent of blood spreading from the inside.
“No matter how you think about it, it doesn’t seem like a normal guild building.”
Yoosung nodded and headed straight into the guild without hesitation.
Perhaps because Jaehyun and his party had already been there, the door was open.
Sigh…
The door moved and made an old metal sound.
As I entered, my anxiety grew more and more.
“Hmm…….”
No matter how you think about it, this is dangerous.
A building reminiscent of an abandoned building. An arithmetic formula written in white chalk abandoned in a long hallway.
Even the puddles of dark red blood that flowed around, perhaps as a result of being swept away by the ceremony.
Yoo Sung-eun already realized at once how the situation had turned just by looking at it.
“There are traces of the transmission magic being activated. It is also very powerful.”
Judging from the formula, this was a high-level ‘transmission ceremony to another world’.
Magic that transports users directly to the dungeons of the nine worlds excluding Midgard.
Although it has not yet been revealed to the public, this is a type of transmission magic currently under covert research.
‘Now I understand.’
A few solid facts popped into my mind.
one. A person presumed to be Gu Ja-in’s forces installed another world transmission magic here.
two. Jae-hyeon and his party, who came here to save the cadets, were forcibly transported somewhere.
three. It is a level of dungeon that cannot be easily cleared with Park Seong-jae and Jae-hyun’s skills alone.
Yoo Sung-eun realized that the situation was much more serious than he thought.
‘At least the fact that «Ivaldi’s Earring» didn’t work yet doesn’t mean it’s the worst situation.
But it’s true that the longer you drag it out, the more dangerous the kids are. I have to move as quickly as possible.’
Yoo Sung-eun immediately began to interpret the expression written in the center of the hallway.
“……A high-level formula. Goo Ja-in… You did a much bigger job than I thought.”
I unknowingly bit my lower lip.
Yoo Seong-eun started to speed up a little more.
“This is…!”
After a while.
The arithmetic expression emitted light and began to brighten up the dark interior of the building.
With trembling hands, Yoo Seong-eun lightly infused magic into the ceremony.
Uuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuh…
The transparent magic circle that surrounded the hallway began to emerge more clearly.
Eventually, the light took on the form of letters and quickly vomited its meaning.
Yoo Sung-eun began to read the magic language written there.
“You foolish one. The world of the Dark Elves… to Svartal Fame. you. send.”
As soon as the words were cut off, a heavy silence fell.
Yoo Seong-eun’s face turned blue.
If what you read is correct, this is a more serious matter than you can imagine.
Svartal Fame.
It is the world of the Dark Elves.
Raiders that survived Svartal Fame are rare enough to count on one hand.
A barren land in the radar world where the strategy has yet to be fully developed.
That place was Svartal Fame.
All sorts of emotions flooded her mind.
“The kids and Sungjae oppa are in danger.”
Park Seong-jae does not have good compatibility with the dark elves, and the others are only cadets.
The only reliable one is reproduction.
“I have to join Jaehyun as soon as possible.”

“Don’t be afraid! He must be strong, he is only human!”
Kais thought while following Jaehyun’s movements with his eyes.
‘He’s a much stronger guy than he looks. But no problem. Judging by his movements, he’s a martial artist. With the elite knights and my magic, it’s a fight that can never be lost.’
But the next moment his thoughts were completely denied.
―Active skill < Chain of Fire Demon > is activated.
* * *
Kell could only tremble as he bent his knees at the magical energy that oppressed the atmosphere.
It was incomprehensible to him.
what the heck is that man?
It was already the third encounter with the monster today alone.
Min Jae-hyeon, Ahn Ho-yeon, Yoo Seong-seong… All of them are mere humans.
They were only objects of slaughter that were nothing more than food to them.
But… why the hell did this happen?
“Keugh… what the hell are you! How could such a strong mana…!”
“I will ask again. Did you make them like that?”
Yoo Seong-eun said, pointing to Park Seong-jae, who lost consciousness after losing his arm, and Ahn Ho-yeon, whose blood was distorted.
Kell’s pupils shook violently.
‘You can never win. He’s an enemy on a whole different level from that guy earlier…!’
Kell quickly distanced himself from Yoo Seong-eun while holding a sword shaped like magic.
‘If I take those guys hostage, I’ll have a chance somehow!’
Kell thought while provoking with a fishy laugh.
“Yes. Those humans are my masterpiece.”
“You mean that too?”
Yoo Seong-eun started to approach Seong-jae Park and his party, who had fallen with cold eyes.
She first looked at Seongjae Park’s left arm. Naturally, the brow furrowed.
‘Wounds caused by surprise. It’s a cowardly move.’
Next was Ahn Ho-yeon.
‘I was forced to use power that I couldn’t handle. I must have overused the skill beyond the critical point. Was it that much of a crowd?’
Either way, the state was nonsense.
Yoo Seong-eun sighed lightly.
Soon after, the eyes shone from the two cold eyes. Yoo Seong-eun, who immediately drew out magic, began to heal the wounds of the party by using the nascent magic.
―Activate the active skill 《Sacrifice》.
―Recovers multiple targets at the same time.
―Depletes the user’s vitality.
The stamina of those who had lost their will to fight returned with the continuous sound of the system.
A very brief moment. But I definitely noticed them.
‘Sacrifice… He’s restoring everyone neatly in this short moment.’
‘I can’t believe… is this really possible?’
‘…Is this the S-class radar?’
Leaving the shocked people behind, I turned my steps in the direction of Kell this time.
Kell was horrified.
‘There was no time to take hostages. But you used recovery magic so quickly? What is this…!’
Yoosung started walking toward Kell with a kind smile.
“I had no intention of dealing with monsters anyway.”
“……!”
“A healer heals an injured person, even if it is an enemy. by the way.”
“Wait a minute!”
Kell, who felt the shocking magic power to blow his mind away, stepped back and shouted.
“Wait…”
“I don’t like touching my person.”
Quaang!
It was a very brief moment.
I just raised my hand up and then lowered it.
It was difficult to see that Yoo Sung-eun’s motion itself had a great meaning.
However, the results derived from it were truly staggering. Kell’s upper body, which was trying to stop the explosion, was blown away.
In an instant, Kell’s body was reduced to powder and he died.
‘…How can you do that…!’
Kim Yoo-jung was shocked and shivered.
Seo In-na gulped down her saliva and looked at Yoo Seong-eun, who was unable to capture the hideous mana.
‘…That’s not a skill. He just condensed his mana and shot it straight to explode the enemy. … But is that really possible?’
It was a shocking sight that I couldn’t believe even if I saw it with my own eyes.
Others had the same reaction as her.
Yoosung said calmly.
“Even if your arm is a sacrifice, it will take time to put it back on. The same goes for Hoyeon. It will take a few days to wake up.”
“Can I get better?”
“of course. Sacrifice is a unique skill. Rather… Where is Jaehyun?”
“…ah. That’s…”
There was silence. A breathless silence lingers between the party.
Anxiety is clearly engraved in Yoo Sung-eun’s head. The party was confused and couldn’t come up with an answer quickly.
The obvious expression of guilt on his face.
I hope so.
“Jaehyun is dead…!”
“no. That Ann… Jaehyun Min went to catch the boss monster alone!”
“…help. Yoosung really needs CEO’s strength.”
Joo Sung-chan and Ha Yeon-joo lowered their heads and said.
At those words, Yoo Seong-eun’s face softened a little.
Somehow, he’s not the kind of guy who would abandon his teammates. Something was strange.
Yoosung smiled and said.
“Don’t worry, Jaehyun will still be fine. Oh, you can rest assured that all the monsters in this area have been dealt with.”
At that, everyone was shocked.
Did you know how many demons there were and dealt with them all?
Kim Yoo-jung intervened among the distracted people and said.
“…Ha, but you went to catch the boss monster alone. I wonder if Min Jae-hyun will really be okay yet…….”
Yoo Seong-eun smiled and said.
“Jaehyun is stronger than you think. At least he won’t die in a place like this.”
No worries.
In the first place, Jaehyun has an extremely powerful skill that can destroy other people’s magic.
Yooseong crossed his arms and raised his lips.
Dark elves are magic beasts that deal with enemies based on magic.
At least as long as you don’t run out of mana.
Jaehyun never dies to anyone.

chapters.title: Chapter 103
chapters.content:
Episode 103 King of the Dark Elves (6)
―Active skill < Chain of Fire Demon >.
The mana fired from Jaehyun’s hand transformed into a chain containing flames.
It was a new magic, < Chain of Fire >, not the < Chain of Lightning > that was originally used.
Jaehyun smiled softly.
* * *
A few days ago from now.
Jae-hyun came to realize the last concept in the 4-star grimoire.
creation.
It wasn’t about making something out of nothing.
Combining existing magic appropriately and recreating it anew. That was the creation mentioned in the four-star grimoire.
Also, Jaehyun was already familiar with this precedent.
The 《Chain of Lightning》 that Jaehyun uses is originally a skill that was created by combining the «Mana Chain» and the magic of the electric attribute.
As such, the creation of magic is a series of processes in which new magic formulas are added to the base magic and unnecessary parts are corrected.
Jaehyun finally succeeded in mastering this after much effort.
Although the problem was that it was incomplete and the probability of success was low. Now that wasn’t a problem at all.
《Mana Chain》 is Jaehyun’s favorite skill.
The upper derived skill 《Chain Rain》 was also realized through this.
It went without saying that he was mastering the food perfectly.
The result was the < Chain of Fire >, which contained the flame right in front of my eyes.
Jaehyun fired his magic at the dark elves running towards him.
The sound of metal clashing surrounded Jaehyun and spread out in all directions. The chain rain that was shot down began to devastate the area.
charrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrr!
The chain imbued with magical power turns into a blade and sweeps away enemies within seconds.
Jaehyun’s current level is approaching 40. Dealing with dozens of chains is no longer a problem for him.
“Quaaaaaagh!”
“Buy and save…”
The screams and metal sounds of the Dark Elves were heard.
The time when Jaehyun used his chains to annihilate the enemies one by one.
Kainan, whose complexion became pale, stammered and shouted at Jaehyun.
“You guys! How dare you… do you dare to think that you can live with this!”
Jaehyun laughed. Kainan gritted his teeth and snared.
“You will definitely regret it! Even if you kill me here, the other seven kings will surely kill you…”
Quaang!
Jaehyun’s fist, which narrowed the distance before he knew it, hit Kainan’s face directly.
His brows were twisted as if he didn’t want to hear it anymore.
thud!
Kainan’s body flew away and hit the wall, and a handful of blood gushed out from his mouth.
Jaehyun took a step towards Kainan and spoke in a low voice.
“I don’t know about that. If you twist them, tell them to come find me.”
A small smile crept across Jaehyun’s lips.
“Of course, that’s only if you can get out of here.”
* * *
―Active skill 《Sacrifice》.
―The designated target is deeply wounded. Treatment takes a considerable amount of time.
A drop of cold sweat flowed down and Yu Seong-eun’s hand trembled while using the skill.
‘As expected, this skill puts a strain on the body. If it wasn’t for Jaehyun, I would have died a long time ago.’
Yoo Seong-eun was treating Seong-jae Park and Ho-yeon Ahn, who had fallen with deep wounds.
All the Dark Elves who were attacking the party a moment ago were defeated.
Although non-combat, the Dark Elf elite knight was not a very difficult opponent for Yoo Sung-eun, an S-class raider. Even if it was the SS, it was the same.
The only problem left now is to treat the injured party and return them to normal condition.
The problem of their life and death was solved, but Yoo Seong-eun’s expression was not very bright.
‘Hoyeon’s condition is more serious than I thought.’
Rather, in the case of Park Seong-jae, the treatment was not difficult. All I had to do was attach the severed arm and refill my physical strength through divine power. If you have a little bit of skill, it shouldn’t be a problem.
However, An Ho-yeon’s case was different.
All blood vessels in the body were twisted, screaming at every moment, and the nerve strands that used magical powers were semi-permanently damaged.
Even if he had been a little late, An Ho-yeon would have been crippled, unable to handle magical powers for the rest of his life.
―The treatment of the designated target has been completed.
―The user’s HP is permanently reduced by 2%.
“Huh…….”
The soft green light that enveloped Ahn Ho-yeon faded and his rough breathing stabilized.
The party, who had been watching An Ho-yeon with worried expressions, asked while sweeping their chests.
“Is Hoyeon okay now?”
“okay. don’t worry. Get some rest for a while and you’ll be fine.”
“It’s fortunate……”
A while ago, An Ho-yeon used his season to protect them.
《The New Swordsman’s Day》. A truly fraudulent skill that transcends the extremes of nothingness and unites oneself and the sword.
In general, A-class raiders use it with difficulty, and only when they become S-class raiders can they use it properly was «New Swordsman’s Day».
However, Ahn Ho-yeon opened the door by forcibly activating the skill on the C-class subject.
She tried to forcibly peek into the next stage by crossing the limit with her own life as security.
Thanks to that, I collapsed like this with my body turned into rags, but the effect was amazing.
It was a success in cornering an enemy that was never thought to be able to deal with.
Meanwhile, Joo Seong-chan chewed his lips and recalled the battle with Ahn Ho-yeon earlier.
‘…No matter how the situation was, it was too risky… Hoyeon really used the skill with the thought of dying.’
I never knew how he could have shown such will.
That he would risk his own life to protect those without a drop of blood?
Joo Seong-chan thought of Jae-hyun at the same time.
The appearance of Jae-hyun, who overwhelmed the enemy he had to deal with until Ahn Ho-yeon opened the ‘door’.
‘That was hardly at the level of a cadet.’
Everyone in the party here had the same thoughts as Joo Seong-chan.
An Ho-yeon, who risked his life against the enemy, was that much. But does it mean that reproduction is stronger than that?
More than Ahn Ho-yeon, who risked his life by opening the door?
After a moment of silence, Seo Ina raised her head and asked.
“…Anyway, Jaehyun is really good, right? In case you get seriously hurt…”
Kim Yoo-jung and Ha Yeon-joo and Joo Seong-chan, who were worried in their hearts, also raised their heads.
Yoo Sung-eun nodded lightly with a benevolent smile.
“don’t worry. As I said before, Jaehyun doesn’t die that easily. I guarantee you.”
Of course, I would be lying if I said I wasn’t worried at all.
But there was no need to worry more than necessary.
Jaehyun had a skill that could break all magic.
And the Dark Elves are a race that is very vulnerable to other fields besides magic, especially boxing techniques. On the other hand, Jaehyun has excellent talents in both martial arts and magic.
Because of this, Yoo Sung-eun never thought that his student would die in a place like this.
Of course, even so, in order to save the other cadets, he had to act quickly.
Because the most important thing in treatment is not to exceed the golden time, which is nothing else.
Yoo Seong-eun got up without even having time to rest.
“Then you guys are taking good care of the wounded here. I’m going to the boss room.”
“Ah yes! And… Min Jae-hyun, please take good care of me.”
“…me too.”
At the words of Kim Yoo-jung and Seo In-na, Yoo Seong-eun smiled and winked.
“Don’t worry, just relax.”
* * *
Kainan, the eighth-ranked king of the Dark Elves.
He has been a king since his birth.
Born as the son of the first king, he will later gain supremacy throughout Svartal Fame.
A born king and reigning one.
‘That’s me, Kainan. … I’m sure it must be!’
Right now, he is only hit by a human-like attack and is pinned to a wall.
Is this really possible?
‘shit……! If this is the case, there is nothing you can do! I have to let the other brothers know about this!’
Kainan made up his mind. That person can’t deal with himself.
An opponent you can’t beat. If that’s the case, I should at least let my brothers know who he is!
“Listen to all elite knights! Protect me now and retreat…!”
Charleureuk!
“Aaaaaagh!”
“Old lord! Help me…”
Kainan couldn’t finish his words at the screams that erupted from all over the place. Chains clad in flames pierced through all of his soldiers.
The elite knights were literally falling like dominoes and building a tower.
Contemplation stained Kainan’s face.
‘I can’t help it now. I have no choice but to run away alone!’
Kainan forced himself up and started running with all his might.
With the desire to get away from that monstrous human right away.
but.
It wasn’t Jaehyun to watch it blankly.
He was blocking Kainan’s way before he knew it, and had a characteristic cold expression.
“Where are you trying to escape?”
“Keugh!”
Jaehyun grabbed Kainan’s head with one hand and tightened his grip.
The skull tightened and a voice that seemed to break slowly leaked out.
“Damn… eat…!”
Jaehyun didn’t stop there and used chains to block all of Kainan’s limbs.
“I can’t run away anymore. Die gracefully.”
However, Kainan only smiled at Jaehyun’s words.
He glared at Jaehyun with a venomous expression on his face and pursed his lips.
“Are you afraid to die alone…! I’ll make you my companion on the way to Helheim!”
At that moment, powerful magic power began to flow from Kainan’s body and soon covered the entire boss room. A cold chill penetrated Jaehyun’s body.
Kainan’s secret number and secret skill that only the king of the Dark Elves can learn.
《Land of Ice》.
It was a magic that instantly freezes anything that exists on the field with an S-class skill.
Just now. The reason why Kainan didn’t use this magic was because he couldn’t properly handle 《Ice Ground》 and could cause great damage to his allies.
But now it’s meaningless.
At the point where everyone is about to die, such a thing is useless worry.
Kainan decided to use the skill with his own death as collateral.
To blow that damn human off.
but.
“Is this an unexpected harvest?”
Jaehyun laughed.
Kainan couldn’t help but shudder at the goose bumps running down his spine.
‘Ahead of the dark elves’ king’s secret… Are you laughing?’
Jaehyun opened his inventory and pulled out an item at the same time as releasing his magical power.
blank card.
It was something I had acquired a while ago and had been saving for a long time.
“I didn’t expect to use this in a place like this.”
―You can learn new skills.
―Do you want to register «Frozen Earth» on the blank card?
“Register.”
―I have registered «Frozen Earth» on the blank card!
Jaehyun waited for the blank card to completely copy the skill, and then did it right away.
―Active skill «Absolute Calculation».
―Destroy «The Frozen Land».
I broke the 《Frozen Earth》.
The ice barrier that covered the boss room faded, and Kainan’s face was stained with astonishment.
“You should have attacked while watching the opponent.”
Jaehyun didn’t hesitate and broke Kainan’s neck.
at the same time.
―You defeated Kainan, the king of the Dark Elves.
―Achieve indescribable achievements.
―You have acquired the title 《The One Who Killed the King of the Dark Elves》.
―You have acquired the material item 《Essence of the Dark Elf King》.
―You have acquired the equipment item 《Dark Elf King’s Pauldrons》.
“You and I are opposites.”

chapters.title: Chapter 104
chapters.content:
Episode 104 Reunion and Revenge (1)
―You defeated Kainan, the king of the Dark Elves.
―Achieve indescribable achievements.
―You have acquired the title 《The One Who Killed the King of the Dark Elves》.
―You have acquired the material item 《Essence of the Dark Elf King》.
―You have acquired the equipment item 《Dark Elf King’s Pauldrons》.
―You have cleared the second junction quest.
―You have acquired the sealed magic book.
―You have acquired the active skill 《Shape of Magic Tools》.
―You have acquired 1 blank card.
System sounds that resonate in succession with the final blow.
However, Jaehyun decided to check later and moved quickly.
After taking out the four cadets who were slowly dying while imprisoned behind bars, he felt the pulse.
Two died and two lived.
Jaehyun’s eyes fell cold.
―Activate the active skill 《Sacrifice》.
-Heals the target.
A blue light slowly spreads to the two cadets who survived the reenactment.
Jaehyun was silently sweating and thinking constantly even while continuing the treatment.
If they had come a little faster, could they have saved the other two?
“Healer is originally a cruel job.”
Jaehyun, who was lost in thought, looked back in surprise at the sudden voice. Healing light is overlaid on his light and spreads to the fallen cadets.
Jaehyun slowly parted his lips.
“…teacher.”
Yoo Seong-eun, who came by her side, was helping herself and healing those who survived.
Unlike usual playfulness, the two calmly cooled eyes were filled with sadness.
“When a healer is the happiest, it’s a situation where he doesn’t have to heal. The second time is to save people who are in danger of dying.”
Jaehyun nodded and added his magic power.
The green light was added and strong life energy permeated.
* * *
It was about two hours later that I encountered the party again.
Jae-hyun had two shins cut by Kim Yoo-jung and had to receive Seo In-na’s cold eyes. Ha Yeon-joo and Joo Seong-chan, who watched from the side, burst into laughter.
It wasn’t a genuine laugh. A happy heart that even a few people came back alive and a fake laugh to shake off the sorry for the four people who died.
But no one was able to pinpoint him.
Raiders must always risk their lives and must remain calm at all times.
The theory that had been taught countless times at Miles Academy became a reality and weighed down their shoulders.
“Anyway, I survived. I’m just glad I didn’t get wiped out in a dungeon of this level.”
Everyone nodded their heads in agreement at Yoo Sung-eun’s calm words.
This was at least an A-class dungeon. Perhaps, if he hadn’t entered the dungeon with Jae-hyun and if Yoo Seong-eun hadn’t appeared and saved him in time, the group would have been annihilated.
‘I was just lucky this time. More people may die next time.’
Jaehyun couldn’t get rid of the feeling that something was stuck in his chest.
Milles Academy and Guzain’s plan. It wasn’t long now to stop this.
‘I have to become stronger.’
Jaehyun kept repeating and praying small for the four dead cadets.
―The death of the boss monster 《Kainan, King of the Dark Elves》 has been confirmed.
– Return to Midgard.
* * *
At the end of a dark night.
Around 1 am, a man sitting in the driver’s seat of a Mercedes E-Class is shaking his legs.
Seokgi Kim.
He was the instructor of Milles Academy and the person who organized this event.
Kim Seok-gi nervously cursed while holding the steering wheel.
“What bastards dared to set foot in a guild dungeon? You won’t be able to come out of there alive anyway… but even if you do come out, you won’t die gracefully.”
At the very moment he mumbled in a voice mixed with irritation, the light in the Kane Guild’s main building was young, and a group of people jumped out.
* * *
“Thank you so much for today.”
“thank you so much.”
“thank you.”
Returning to reality, the party sincerely expressed their gratitude to Yoo Seong-eun.
If it wasn’t for her help, they would have been the food of the Dark Elves.
Yooseong crossed his arms and said.
“If you’re so grateful, you can come to our Yeonhwa later. right?”
“I want to go! You can go right now!”
Kim Yoo-jung made a fuss and stuck close to Yoo Seong-eun.
Yoo Sung-eun stroked Kim Yoo-jung’s hair quietly, as if she didn’t like her behavior.
“I have no face because I seem to have looked ugly. sorry. everyone.”
Seongjae Park, who came to his senses, scratched his head as if he was embarrassed.
The party waved their hands and made a fuss as if they were saying something.
“no. If it wasn’t for the manager, we would have died long ago.”
“that’s right!”
An Ho-yeon hadn’t woken up yet. It was a side effect of the aftermath of 《New Sword Union》.
According to Yoo Sung-eun, it will be better after a good night’s sleep.
‘As expected, Sacrifice is a fraud.’
Jaehyun thought it was fortunate that at least his teammates weren’t hurt.
I feel sorry for the four cadets who have already died, but it can’t be helped. Saving everyone is theoretically possible.
Radar was a job that constantly required each other’s lives to be weighed.
“ah! here it is here!”
Yuseong waved his hand and welcomed a car entering the alley.
It was a black van with Park Ha-na in it.
Park Ha-na, who got out of the car after a while, asked Yoo Seong-eun.
“What happened? I was worried because I couldn’t hear from you for several hours!”
“Sorry. I’ll explain what happened a little later, so bear with me for now. And can you take these kids to the guild? You will be very tired from fighting hard.”
“Are you the representative? Aren’t you going with me?”
“I have work left to do. The same goes for this disciple.”
Park Hana narrowed her eyes for a moment, then nodded.
“All right. Manager Seongjae Park, let’s go together.”
“I see!”
Park Seong-jae moved his body and climbed into the passenger seat at the firm call of his brother.
“That… manager Seongjae Park’s arm today……”
The moment Jaehyun tried to protest for Seongjae Park, Seongjae Park’s urgent expression caught his eye.
[Please don’t tell me. Please.]
[Is it okay to use telepathy already? You eat a lot of magic. That.]
[It’s not okay! Still, please don’t talk about my arm to my sister!]
Park Seong-jae urgently sent a message. Thanks to the use of the artifact, it didn’t consume as much magical power as the wizard, but it was never to the extent that he, a patient, could freely use it.
at that time. Hana Park shot at her with her eyes narrowed.
“What about the arm?”
“Ah ah, that’s because… your arm was bruised from a bump.”
“A wound like that is nothing to Raider. I don’t know if my arm was cut off.”
“Big.”
Park Seong-jae covered his mouth with a face that said he was stabbed, but luckily he was not caught.
The other party also nodded and smiled as if they had read the atmosphere.
“Then let’s go.”
Park Ha-na completely disappeared from the sight of the two after a while after burning all the party.
Jaehyun looked at those who disappeared far away for a while, then suddenly said in a cold tone.
“Did you feel it too?”
“okay.”
The eyes of the two were directed to the same place at the same time.
There, the Mercedes E-Class and a man in the driver’s seat were reflected intact.
* * *
“Damn it! How the hell did Yooseong smell this time?!”
Kim Seok-gi was in shock and couldn’t get out of it.
A little while ago, he saw a group of people who had escaped the dungeon with a halo of light.
There were familiar faces there.
Min Jae-hyeon, Kim Yoo-jung, Ahn Ho-yeon, and Seo E-na. And even the cadets he fell into a trap.
But more than anything, what surprised him was the existence of Yoo Sung-eun.
what? What happened?
Are you saying that among them, there was a cadet who had a connection with Yoo Sung-eun?
In the first place, he thought there would be no chance of clearing the dungeon.
This ridiculous situation was completely unexpected.
Kim Seok-gi hurriedly started the car and started to step on the accelerator.
Whatever it was, there was no chance of winning against the S-class Raider.
He must be at least A-class.
Class S and Class A are only one class difference, but there is a difference in class that fundamentally changes the track.
‘You can never win. I have to avoid it!’
The moment the engine starts and the car finally starts to slide on the road.
Quaang!
There was a roar that drowned out the exhaust sound of the Mercedes-Benz E-Class.
After moving less than a few meters, the car’s ignition went off and the windshield on the front was shattered. His brow furrowed wildly, and at the same time cold sweat ran down Kim Seok-gi’s back.
It can’t be like this.
Just a moment ago, Min Jae-hyun and Yoo Sung-eun were more than 300 meters apart from him.
But in that short moment, did you narrow the distance like this?
He even had an A-class magic tool that could erase his presence. They should never have been able to find themselves!
‘shit……!’
Yoo Sung-eun looked down at herself and asked if she knew Kim Seok-gi’s heart.
“Instructor Kim Seok-gi. I don’t know why you are here.”
“Yoo Yoo-sung is the representative…!”
Kim Seok-gi chewed his lips and saw her looking at him from outside the car.
Yoo Seong-eun.
She radiated enough magical power to make your hamstrings tingle just by looking at it.
The magic she used to stop the car a while ago was the C-class skill, Gravity.
It was a type of magic that used gravity to crush the opponent and block their movements.
For tracking, the < Magic Perception > of purely intuition and reproduction was effective. He was able to catch Kim Seok-ki, who was trying to escape, at once.
Seokgi Kim must have realized that he couldn’t hide it anymore, so he gnashed his teeth and shouted.
“Since when did you know? Min Jae-hyeon… what kind of relationship do you have with that guy!”
“You have a bad habit of talking to my pupil.”
“…what? Are you a disciple? Did you have anything like that?!”
“okay. What are you complaining about?”
Yoo Sung-eun no longer respected Kim Seok-ki.
He is a heinous figure who has led innocent cadets to death several times. There was no courtesy to offer.
On the other hand, Kim Seok-gi had an intuition the moment he met her cold eyes.
he will surely die
to that woman
“I should have lived a little better.”
Jaehyun sneered at me from the side.
If he had been alone, he would have been a difficult adversary to deal with.
But as long as Yoo Seong-eun is together. Even if Kim Seok-gi died and woke up, the war situation could not be overturned.
S-class raiders are both a blessing and a disaster at the same time.
“Damn it…! Do you think you will die like this!”
Kim Seok-gi raised his power to the maximum.
Artifacts containing countless magical powers spilled out of his arms.
All of them were magic tools received from Gu Jain.
‘It’s not something I got to use in a place like this, but… This is an emergency situation!’
Tsutsutsut!
Instructor Kim Seok-ki’s new model disappeared with the noise of magical energy colliding with each other.
However, the two looked back without panic at all.
And there was Kim Seok-gi, who was aiming behind the magic tools.
“die!!”
Kim Seok-gi was quickly pointing the dagger he had taken out of his weapon at Yoo Seong-eun.
Yooseong smiled and watched him blankly.
“Is it a magic tool that allows you to use teleport? But the performance is poor. It’s only a few tens of meters to move. It’s the worst for the purpose of running away.”
Yoo Sung-eun lightly dodged his sword and then slowly began to raise his magic again.
Park Ha-na was already doing a good job controlling the area. This is because he had whispered in advance that no civilians could come and that it should be thoroughly controlled.
There probably won’t be a big problem if you reveal your strength a little more here.
But at that moment, a faint smile spread across Kim Seok-gi’s face.
“I knew it would come out like that…! All magicians are like that!!”
He said that while injecting power into the new magic tool he took out of his possession.
It was a small round crystal.
Jaehyun’s brow narrowed. He already knew what it was.
magic suppression device.
It was the object that prevented Jaehyun from recalculating the formula when he was taken to Svartal Fame during the day.
Jaehyun moved his gaze to Yooseong with a slightly nervous face.
And all worries were relieved.
“How stupid.”
There was no need to worry from the beginning. It was because Yoo Seong-eun was clearly smiling.
On the contrary, she raised the corners of her mouth with a look of excitement.
“Did you think you could deal with me with something like that?”
Kim Seok-ki’s eyebrows were distorted.
The magic tool in his hand began to emit strong light, and soon it shattered.

chapters.title: Chapter 105
chapters.content:
Episode 105: Reunion and Revenge (2)
The magic tool cracked with a crackling sound, and soon it was destroyed.
Kim Seok-gi looked as if he couldn’t believe the situation unfolding before his eyes.
Hana Jae-hyun was well aware of why Kim Seok-ki’s magic tools were broken.
‘Sir, you let the concentrated mana flow at a level that the inhibitor couldn’t handle. That’s why the device couldn’t stand it and was smashed.
In any case, it is theoretically possible. But…’
Jaehyun knew how absurd that was.
The magic suppressor sends out more mana than it can handle, destroying the device?
In order to do so, at least among the S-class, the mana management value must be at the top.
Otherwise, all my magic power would be taken away.
However, Yoo Sung-eun was not just a wizard.
Water level radar in the world. No matter how complicated the formula and magic were, it wasn’t a big problem for her.
“Is that all you have?”
Kim Seok-gi sat down on the floor at Yoo Seong-eun’s low voice.
He thought this was the only option, and there was no other way.
“Why did you kill the other cadets? Who is behind it?”
“Are you afraid to tell me…!”
“It must be a rescuer. Oh, of course, I didn’t ask because I thought you would answer. It would be nice if there was a potion that made me tell the truth, but there is no such thing in the world.”
“What do you want to say!”
When Kim Seok-gi, who was sitting on the floor, growled, Yoo Sung-eun laughed and raised his magic power.
“It means you will die here.”
stop.
At the same time as Yoo Sung-eun said, Kim Seok-gi’s whole body stiffened as if paralyzed.
A wave of suffocating magical power rose and a small cloud floated over Kim Seok-gi’s head. The light like fireflies slowly gathering below it.
The light that flickered and poured like a street lamp was clearly embedded in Jaehyun’s mind.
‘That magic is…’
Active skill 《Call Lightning》.
It was a brain-attributed magic that could annihilate enemies at once with an A-class skill, depending on the user’s grade.
The chain of lightning that Jaehyun often uses also has the same brain property.
However, the difference in class was enormous.
The electric shocks gathered in an instant poured down and covered Kim Seok-ki’s entire body.
The body’s bloodstream twists and flows backwards. At the same time, the knees are bent.
Jaehyun couldn’t help but stare at Yoo Sungeun and Kim Seokki, stunned by the unfamiliar scene.
Yoo Seong-eun. A person revered as a saint in Korea and the only S-class healer.
But what she was showing now was that of a punisher.
There was no mercy in his hands, and he coldly tore his enemies apart again and again.
“Aaaaaaagh!”
Kim Seok-ki’s long screams were not leaked out by Silence.
meticulous
Yoo Seong-eun did not leave behind.
Kim Seok-gi’s body disappeared before he knew it, being eaten by the strong blue of magic.
All he left behind was a Mercedes E-Class car. It was broken a little while ago, and only fragments remained.
The corners of Jaehyun’s mouth rose slowly. He thought while looking at Yoo Seong-eun standing next to him.
‘okay. The person behind me was like this. The S-class radar, which is by far the best in the country. There is still a long way to go.’
Jae-hyun had to catch up with Yoo Sung-eun. The battle to be fought and the fate surrounding it have not yet been resolved.
It all started now.
Guin. This time, although Jae-hyeon transferred the disposition of Seok-ki Kim to Seong-eun Yoo, Jae-hyeon had no intention of taking Ja-in away.
The faces of the dead cadets passed Jaehyun for a moment. Jaehyun lightly clenched his fists and let his mana flow.
in the near future. I was thinking of cutting off all bad ties with Gu Ja-in.
* * *
A little while ago.
Returning home, Seo Ina recalled Jaehyun lightly destroying the spear flying towards her.
‘…You saved me. Jaehyun is. … me.’
She was greatly shocked by her sense and reaction speed as a magician of representation, and at the same time felt a strong sense of helplessness and a sense of admiration.
‘In that short moment, Jaehyun turned the formula upside down and reversed the magic.’
It’s unbelievable, but Seo Eana saw Jaehyun’s movements a moment ago.
He quickly reversed the shot spear and shattered it with mana so that the trajectory could not be known.
However, for the cadets, this was only possible in theory.
Magic is basically several times more difficult to reverse than to cast it.
It’s because you don’t know exactly what kind of magic the enemy used, and even if you do know, it’s definitely not that everyone uses the same formula to use magic.
for example.
Depending on the enemy, even the same «Fire Ball» can be combined with «Big» to increase its size, or combined with «Levitate» to launch a sphere into the air.
Like this, magic is scary because it is not a complete system.
Because you don’t know how the enemy will formulate an attack.
‘By the way… Jaehyun realized what kind of magic the enemy used and how he used it in a short period of time, less than one second, and reversed the magic.’
Of course, Seo Eana was only half right, but no one could correct it.
Because Jaehyun is the only one who knows that he got the skill called < Absolute Calculation > thanks to < Odin's Lost Eye >.
Thanks to this, Seo Eana’s misunderstandings continued to pile up. His self-blame was a bonus.
