‘…I’m still a long way off.’
But even thinking so, a smile spread across her lips.
I don’t know why, but I’m glad that Jaehyun saved him. After the mock dungeon incident, the two of them hadn’t had a proper conversation.
“…You should say thank you later.”
I tried to contact him on my smartphone, but I gave up.
Also, this kind of greeting should be met in person.
Seo Ina buried herself under the blanket while thinking about the boring things.
* * *
Two days after the case was closed.
Milles Academy was littered with reporters, and outsiders were strictly prohibited from entering for the time being.
It was natural.
Externally, an accident occurred within Milles Academy, and rumors began to spread that the Kane Guild, where they went to experience, was created with Gu Jain’s investment.
In the meantime, speculation has even started to circulate that Gu Jain created a ghost guild and abandoned the students.
Gu Ja-in, who was sitting in the chairperson’s office and was washing his hair, hit the desk nervously.
Instructor Kim Seok-gi, who was in charge of this task, could not be reached, and he was tired of the reprimanding phone calls from Congressman Park.
‘Why did this happen?’
There was nothing more to think about. Gu Jain knew why.
‘There is someone who knows my plans. There’s a traitor inside Miles. A guy who knows me very well.’
Gu Jain trembled and shook his clenched fist.
Didn’t he usually pay special attention to security? But information leaks in such a serious matter?
He cannot reach Kim Seok-ki, who may know the whole story of the case and the clues to it.
‘Probably Instructor Kim Seok-gi is dead. Otherwise, there’s no way such a materialistic guy wouldn’t contact me.’
concluded calmly.
Gu Ja-in was a person who came to the present position by trampling on countless people.
And that also meant knowing the best way to get out of this difficult situation.
Goo Ja-in picked up his smartphone, hung up the incoming call from Congressman Park, and called another place.
After a while, the voice of the other party was heard. He was a man with a low-pitched voice.
“That’s me. Guin.”
[I don’t think there’s any need to ask what’s going on… Because the country is in chaos.]
“I want to ask you to handle the case. We’ll match the money to whatever you want.”
At Gu Jain’s words, the other person on the other side of the phone laughed loudly.
[haha! As expected, Chairman Gu Ja-in has a big heart. Don’t worry. An incident like this will be covered in no time. The chairman just needs to wipe his feet and go to sleep.]
“That’s nice to hear.”
Gu Jain showed this and laughed before hanging up the phone.
From now on, he intended to start a war that he was best at.
press exhibition. If he dominated the reporters and the press, he would not be able to defeat Gu Jain, no matter how strong his opponent was.
“Well, that kind of thing is impossible unless you become a member of the Yeonhwa Guild.”
Gu Jain had no doubt that his plan would succeed.
He got up from his seat, went to the wine cellar, and took out a bottle of wine.
* * *
3 days after the incident. way to school.
The cadets started coming to the academy again, and Gu Ja-in’s press exhibition also began.
However, Jae-hyun and Yoo Seong-eun knew from the beginning that Gu Ja-in would come out like this.
Neither of them had the slightest thought that he would kill the cadets without this level of support.
Thanks to this, the Yeonhwa Guild side was also preparing a follow-up article, and they exploded almost simultaneously, launching a counter-fire operation.
As originally planned, it was difficult to hide the fact that Yeon-hwa was involved in the case. This is because the scale of the incident was so large that it was an event that resulted in as many as four deaths.
Goo Ja-eun gnashed his teeth and ran wild.
The Yeonhwa Guild has become a treatment that requires a little more prudence.
There are not many people in Korea who turned Koo Ja-in into an enemy. Even there, there is only one person who can open a media war like this. Only Yeonhwa Guild.
Gu Jain probably knew this, and he thought that Yeonhwa Guild had a deep connection with this guild experience incident.
From now on, you can’t actively check Gu Ja-in’s movements.
If the numbers are just a little bit wrong, Gu Jain will also try to keep the Yeonhwa Guild in check.
While thinking about that, Jaehyun pricked the side of a cadet who was walking about three steps ahead.
“Ugh!”
“Yeah. Do you look healthy now?”
“I am again. Was it Jaehyun?”
A handsome boy with gray hair. Ahn Ho-yeon said while sweeping his side with an unfair expression.
“It’s all thanks to you and the CEO. If it wasn’t for you two, I would have died long ago.”
“Why is that?”
Jaehyun walked side by side with Ahn Hoyeon and asked as if it was not a big deal.
Ahn Ho-yeon closed his lips for a moment. The intent of the question was clear.
Why did Ahn Ho-yeon want to give up his life for his comrades at that time?
Ahn Ho-yeon did not know what answer to give.
No, I knew it all too well.
He wanted to be like Jaehyun.
It was so cheesy that he couldn’t get it out of his mouth, but the representation he saw was the object of envy.
He looked like a real hero, not the people who were sweeping the lower dungeons only for the money on TV.
So I just followed.
Just like Jaehyun saved himself.
Just like when I headed to the boss room alone to save Ina Seo, her teammates, and this time the cadets in the mock dungeon.
But it was also a strange story.
words that are hard to express.
I couldn’t keep my mouth shut and I was confused, but Jaehyun spoke calmly.
“okay. You just have to keep doing it with that mindset.”
“…what?”
“You can put a reason behind it, so you can do whatever you want. Even if I don’t tell you, you’ll do it anyway.”
Jaehyun stood in front of the first classroom of Milles Academy with a calm face. This is where Ahn Ho-yeon and I part ways. Because he has to go to a martial arts class.
Jaehyun added one last word before parting with him.
“Well, take care of your body in moderation. I’m worried about the other kids.”
“…okay.”
The very moment when the two of them had a conversation and were about to part. Two people appeared from behind with a familiar voice.
It was Kim Yoo-jung and Seo E-na.
“Hey, what are you guys doing there? Don’t you know that morning classes were canceled because of work?”
“uh?”
“really?”
“…huh. There was a notice in the group chat room a while ago.”
Jaehyun and Ahn Hoyeon confirmed the notice belatedly. As the two said, the morning class was canceled.
“Ah bother. You came out for nothing, then.”
As Jaehyun scratched his head with an annoyed face, a fishy smile appeared on Kim Yoojung’s lips. It was that of a typical prankster.
Kim Yoo-jung took her luck with a serious face.
“Yeah, but. Aren’t you the one?”
“huh? what?”
“…What?”
Ahn Ho-yeon asked with an innocent face. It was the same with Seina.
Jaehyun seemed to know the reason, but for the sake of the group’s mentality, he didn’t say anything. Originally, this bad role was not her own.
Kim Yoo-jung put her arms around the party’s shoulders and said with a dark expression.
“It’s midterms from next week.”
At those words, the faces of everyone in the party, except for Jaehyun and Kim Yoojung, hardened.
It was worth it.
Ahn Ho-yeon and Seo E-na.
As Jaehyun remembers, the two of them had the best grades in practice, but their writing was a mess.
‘Maybe he got a failing grade in the first exam and took the retest three times…….’
Now the two clung to Jaehyun and Kim Yoojung with faces almost crying.
“Sir! Study… teach me!”
“…me too…yo.”
Kim Yoo-jung and Jae-hyun burst into laughter as they looked at the faces of the two desperately clinging to each other.

chapters.title: Chapter 106
chapters.content:
Episode 106 Midterm exam (1)
Milles Academy’s regular exam has been infamous since ancient times.
This is because it is called the tomb of many cadets due to the excessively difficult difficulty and excessive competition.
The test is mainly theory and practical. consists of two in total.
First of all, the theory takes a test of the subject you are taking, just like a general university.
For example, 《Magic Science》 or 《Basic Matou Science》 are basic.
In the case of the magic world, here is 《Understanding Magical Operations》. In the case of martial arts, a major subject such as 《Basics of herbivory》 is added.
Note that. Jaehyun has already mastered all subjects, regardless of magic or martial arts.
It was because he had to maintain the unprecedented position of 《Battle Mage》, so he couldn’t miss the lectures related to martial arts.
In the case of practicality, it is again divided into two parts.
The first is a potion preparation test based on alchemy.
The second is a strategy test to clear a dungeon prepared in subspace.
In the case of the latter, it can be considered similar to simulated dungeon practice, but
in reality it is completely different.
The simulated dungeon practice is an event where outsiders are strictly prohibited.
It was not disclosed to the outside, but only internally evaluated.
However, the practical test of the regular exam is broadcast live nationwide through broadcasting stations. Among them, especially the 1st grade exam tends to attract more people.
It is because it is a rare opportunity to see new faces who will shake Korea in the future.
‘If you do well, you will become a celebrity and stand out from other guilds, otherwise you will be disgraced nationwide. It’s a dirty way like Gu Jain.’
In this process, Milles Academy and Gu Jain will earn huge relay fees.
To put it simply, it’s an ulterior motive to use the cadets to do business.
Jaehyun couldn’t help but shake his head at the viciousness.
before regression.
Jaehyun also had memories of being terribly humiliated in the practical exam.
During the final strategy test, the leader of the team used him as a throwaway card and betrayed him.
Thanks to that, Jaehyun became the first member of the team to be eliminated, and viewers spat out harsh words against him.
It started with ‘lack of ability.’ and then ‘I don’t know how that came to Milles Academy.’ ‘Tax is too much, so expel him.’ Comments of malicious criticism, such as ‘Did you go to school with only your face painted?’.
This was still clearly embedded in Jaehyun’s brain.
‘Of course, it doesn’t matter now.’
Now, Jaehyun is no longer in a position to worry about the academy exam.
In the first place, the reason why Jaehyun suffered from the exam was only because of the practical skills, and now, thanks to the practical skills and the written notes, it was not a problem at all.
…Of course, there was no guarantee that the others would too.
“Why the hell is Drake’s weak spot on his heel?!”
“…do I have to memorize all of this? …is that a lie?”
Ahn Ho-yeon and Seo E-na’s voices sounded close to screaming.
The two lowered their heads almost simultaneously and buried their faces in the desk.
Currently, the party is at the study cafe on the premises of Miles Academy.
It was because not long ago, the two asked Jaehyun and Kim Yoojung to teach them their studies.
The problem was that both of them had gloomy grades in theory, and they had built up walls from their studies.
Jaehyun laughed.
They’ve been acting like adults lately, but they’re still 17-year-olds.
After all, it was more natural to worry about exams than to catch a witch.
‘Anyway… where should I start teaching? I can’t answer.’
Jaehyun looked at the two of them alternately, deeply troubled.
Of course, I had no intention of taking care of my studies from the beginning.
Even though they are his faction, there is no reason for Jaehyun to go through such trouble.
In the future that Jaehyun knows, the two somehow graduate from Milles.
There was no need for Jaehyun to step in and do something.
However, since the two earnestly asked for help, I accepted the offer, thinking that it would be useful anytime afterward if I put down the burden.
‘After all, my academy life will be easier if they grow well.’
Meanwhile. Kim Yoo-jung was contemplating how to tease the two with a mischievous expression on her face.
She didn’t seem to have much resistance to the theory test itself.
which is natural
Kim Yoo-jung was so good at theory that she competed for first and second place in the entire school when she was in middle school. It wouldn’t be easy for Jae-hyun now to beat Kim Yoo-jung with theory.
“You have to do it step by step. How far did you study in middle school?”
“…When I was in middle school, my grandmother said it was OK to play.”
“I also barely studied handwriting because I was preparing for my practical skills…….”
Seo Na-na and Ahn Ho-yeon’s voices gradually got smaller, and Jae-hyun’s face darkened.
However, Kim Yoo-jung had a pleasant expression without such a sign at all.
“Then let me explain from the beginning. Short-term accelerated tutoring. How about having a karaoke room and an after party after exams to pay for tutoring?”
“Ohhh…!”
“…So cool…”
The two of them nodded vigorously like fanatics fascinated by religion.
‘Well, Kim Yoo-jung teaches theory well. I was helped too.’
Jaehyun agreed and recalled the past for a while.
When I first started learning about magic. He had taken theory classes from Kim Yoo-jung.
I definitely have fond memories of that time… Damn it.
‘The respectful words are still as good as yesterday.’
Jae-hyun glared at Kim Yoo-jung for a while with eyes filled with a strange murderous look.
Kim Yoo-jung was already forcing the two of them to call themselves teachers with respectful words.
Well, it seems that the two of them, who have already become believers, happily accepted the offer.
* * *
For the first time, Yu-Jung Kim began teaching the two of them 《Masuology》.
It is commonly known as the most difficult subject, but with Kim Yoo-jung’s help, I was able to understand the characteristics of the demons and learn their weaknesses and habits more fun than I thought.
It was such a fruitful class that even Jaehyun, who already knew the contents, was impressed.
“…Mr. Seo is a genius.”
Seo Eana said while looking at Kim Yoo-jung with thick tears hanging on her face.
Jaehyun wasn’t just playing around either.
“Ho Yeonah. Hoyeonah. Ahn Ho-yeon! Wake up quickly. Otherwise, you lose.”
…It’s a bit drastic, but I couldn’t help it.
A genius who shines first in martial arts aptitude. Ahn Ho-yeon was vulnerable to sleep and books.
“Oh sorry. I get sleepy just by reading books…”
“After getting a failing grade, I’ll wake up in fear just by looking at the book.”
“…….”
Jae-hyeon persuaded (?) Ahn Ho-yeon and helped him focus on his studies.
Surprisingly, Seo In-na adapted quickly and completed all the basics of Mathematics, and Ahn Ho-yeon somehow succeeded in following along.
But that was just the beginning.
The following subjects related to magic power and the principle of gate generation, etc.
Consecutive subjects left both of them completely exhausted.
four hours after that.
Ahn Ho-yeon and Seo E-na muttered as they looked at the ceiling with stunned faces.
“I was wrong…….”
“…Meet me at the reexamination center.”
“Both of them. Stop talking nonsense and get up. The next subjects are 《Understanding Wavelength》 and 《Radar Mindset》…….”
Jaehyun shook his head.
Apparently, this test seemed burdensome to my colleagues in many ways.
* * *
After preparing for the theory test, Jaehyun returned to the hotel around 6:00 pm.
I thought about training a bit more, but maybe it’s because I’ve been working too hard lately.
Besides, I haven’t checked the items I got from defeating the boss of this dungeon yet.
How to check items obtained from boss raids on time. After entering the hotel room, Jaehyun unpacked his things and sat down on the bed.
“First of all, this.”
Jaehyun looked at the newly acquired title first.
[Title item]
Name: The one who killed the king of the dark elves
Rating: A
Description
An honorable title that can only be obtained by those who killed the king of the dark elves.
1. Magic + 30
2. +10% attack power against dark attribute monsters.
*When you wear the title, you will incur the wrath of all Dark Elves and become a target.
“…Are all the title items so fraudulent?”
It was such a good item that I thought so.
It’s not enough to support a whopping 30 mana, so it increases attack power by 10% when facing dark attribute monsters?
Items like this were rare and hard to find.
Even the grade was A.
If it was listed on the auction house, it was a fraudulent item that would start with at least 10 billion won.
‘what. To begin with, I’m the only one with a title item, so it makes no sense to compare them.’
Of course, there is a phrase that will incur the wrath of the Dark Elves, but… To Jaehyun, who has absolute arithmetic, the Dark Elves were just delicious food.
After trying to calm down the corner of his mouth that was about to rise, Jaehyun checked the next item.
[Material Item]
Name: Essence of the Dark Elf King
Rating: A+
Description
The magical essence of the eighth king of the Dark Elves, Kainan.
If prepared well, it can be a great medicine.
1. Permanently increases magic stat (10 ~ ??) according to the degree of preparation when consumed.
“This is good too. Because the magic stat is always lacking.”
This item was great too.
Ingredients for an excellent medicine that can aim for a permanent increase in magic stats.
“The chancellor will be happy if I bring it to my brother.”
As much as Jae-sang Lee likes to work with new medicinal materials, Jae-hyeon intended to bring the essence to him and ask him to prepare it.
Next was the equipment item.
[Equipment Item]
Name: Pauldrons of the Dark Elf King
Rank: A
Description
Pauldrons of the Dark Elf King Kainan. top quality.
1. Strength +25 / Magic +25
2. Stamina +1500
There were no special skills attached, but this was also more than Jaehyun expected.
Jaehyun immediately put on the pauldron and moved his body lightly.
It was the first item that greatly increased the strength stat after regression.
This would be a great experience when working as a battle mage in the future.
The last thing to check was skill.
Obtained from the sealed magic book after killing the king of the Dark Elves.
Jaehyun opened the window without hesitation.
[Active Skill]
Name: Formation of magic tools (LV. 1)
Rating: EX
A skill that uses magic to shape weapons necessary for battle.
The higher the grade, the higher grade the weapon can be produced.
Weapons will disappear if you don’t continuously inject magical energy into them.
1. Shape the magic tool.
2. Options and grades are given randomly according to level (current minimum grade – C).
3. If the grade of the weapon is too high, the grade drops according to the user’s level.
Jaehyun looked at the skill window again and again as if he couldn’t believe it.
It was such a good skill.
He felt the reward of holding the king of the Dark Elves with great difficulty.
A skill that can shape arms?
Until now, Jaehyun was unheard of.
Even a C-class weapon costs thousands of dollars to purchase at the auction house, and in the case of a B-class weapon, it easily exceeds hundreds of millions to billions.
Not much more to say than that.
However, this skill can create weapons beyond C-class in real time every battle, just by growing it.
Even the kind you want.
The fact that the options were random wasn’t a downside at all.
Jaehyun decided to try the skill right away.
He lightly injected mana into his palm.
Then, along with the sound of rotating magical energy, the light that emerged from the palm began to take the shape of a weapon.
The first thing he produced was a dagger with a short blade.
―You have succeeded in crafting an equipment item!
―Displays item information.
[Equipment Item]
Name: Mana Blade
Grade: C
Description
A basic mana blade with magical power.
Attack Power: + 30
Durability: 100/100
“…It’s a scam.”
Jaehyun left such an impressionistic comment.
Of course, the options in the C class are not that great. However, there was an enormous utility that could not be compared to that.
“huh?”
But this wasn’t the end.
After a while, the blue effect was overlaid on the weapon he made, and he was promoted to B-class.
“What?!”
Jaehyun was perplexed and examined the weapon here and there.
Then the sound of the system sounded.
―Equipment item < < Misteltain > > reacts.
―All the effects of «Mistiltein» will be unlocked when the conditions are met!
―You have acquired the passive skill 《Genius of Arms Manufacturing》.
―From now on, the grade of all equipment produced by the user will increase by 1.

chapters.title: Chapter 107
chapters.content:
Episode 107 Midterm (2)
―The equipment item 《Misteltain》 reacts.
―All effects of < < Mistiltain > > will be unlocked by fulfilling the conditions!
―You have acquired the passive skill 《Genius of Arms Manufacturing》.
―From now on, the grade of all equipment produced by the user will increase by 1.
Jaehyun had no choice but to open his mouth and stare at the crashing system window.
《Mystyltain》.
The item that had already given her an excellent skill called 《Magic Sensing》 shone again.
The corner of Jaehyun’s mouth soared and he didn’t know it would come down.
“I understand now. Why did the system say that at the time?”
The first time I equipped Mistiltane in a simulated dungeon.
Jaehyun received an unknown message from the system.
―Due to lack of conditions, only some effects of equipment are unlocked.
“I guess this is the real effect of Misteltein.”
I didn’t understand at first.
Why is the bracelet classified as a weapon and not an accessory?
But now I know for sure.
If it’s an item that allows you to make equipment on the fly and go into battle, it’s natural for it to be classified as a weapon.
As soon as Jaehyun confirmed the effect of the skill, he jumped up from his seat.
《Formation of Magic Tools》.
It was to immediately check the performance of the item made with the newly acquired skill.
Jaehyun immediately put on his coat and headed to the training ground.
A week passed quickly after that.
And now.
The first day of the exam was bright.
* * *
There were two test subjects on the first day.
The first things I studied were 《Mathematics》 and 《Understanding Magical Operations》.
Jaehyun couldn’t help but tilt his head the moment he received the first test paper.
‘…isn’t it easier than I thought?’
It was clearly an unexpected situation.
It is true that in the past, Jae-hyun did well in Milles’ theory test. However, it was the first time that the problem felt ‘easy’ to this extent.
Isn’t it the regular test of the Milles Academy that the daily says it is as demanding as a college assignment and as comprehensive as a thesis?
Jaehyun realized why the test felt so easy only after he solved all the questions.
‘Looking after the other kids, it seems that even I got better grades.’
It was a simple conclusion.
How to get better grades when teaching others than when studying alone.
After watching Ahn Ho-yeon and Seo E-na’s studies for a few days, I was able to understand the contents of the textbook more deeply without realizing it.
‘I definitely passed 95 points.’
Jaehyun kept his momentum and easily cleared the second < Understanding Magic Calculation >.
Because the difficulty of the test itself was quite high, I heard voices from other cadets, but that was not the case at all for Jaehyun, who had already completed all the preparations for the midterm exam by studying magic books.
Anyway, that’s how the first day’s exams were all over.
The theory test will be held until tomorrow and the day after tomorrow, and the practical test will be prepared after that.
The ratio of theory and practical grades at Miles Academy is 3 to 7. Of course, the actual skill is 7.
Both tests would not be a big threat to Jaehyun now, but he didn’t have the slightest desire to be complacent.
‘If you’re going to be complacent, there’s no reason to return to the past. You can’t relax.’
I suddenly made a promise, but Kim Yoo-jung came from behind waving to Jae-hyun.
A murmur was heard in the hallway.
“hey. Aren’t they them? The kids who got first place in the freshman hunt and got on the news. Min Jae-hyun and Kim Yoo-jung!”
“I guess that’s right. I don’t know anything else, but to be honest, how can you not recognize Min Jaehyun when he looks like that? is that a human face? Is this country?”
“Well, he’s handsome… and he’s really strong. I’m so jealous of Sibal.”
“By the way, where are Ahn Ho-yeon and Seo Ea-na?”
Jaehyun scratched his head as if embarrassed by the voice he heard.
Thanks to the amplification of the five senses after returning, I can hear the story about myself so clearly even if I don’t want to hear it.
Since I had never received any expectations in my previous life, this excessive interest was a bit burdensome.
‘Well, it’s better than being criticized.’
Jaehyun decided to think as positively as possible.
Kim Yoo-jung, who had come close to me before I knew it, asked, sticking next to me.
“hey! Min Jaehyun, did you do well on the test?”
“I think I saw something good.”
At Jaehyun’s words, Kim Yoojung nodded.
“me too. But all the other kids said it was difficult. I should also take a good look.”
“Did Hoyeon give up?”
“She’s wrong. It’s good if you get out of the failing grade. The way I see it, there is no answer for her studies.”
“It’s cool.”
Jaehyun said that with a small smile on his lips.
It was a peaceful day for the first time in a while.
‘what. For the time being, even Guzain won’t be able to walk around freely.’
Jain Koo recently lost his right-hand man, Seokgi Kim. In addition, the voice of the public about the irrationality of the Milles Academy’s operation is gradually growing.
As a Gu Ja-in, it is a situation where there is no choice but to suffer from a lot of headaches.
Of course, this whole situation was led by Jaehyun and Yeonhwa guild, but Gu Jain probably couldn’t figure out all the information yet.
At most, he would perceive Jaehyun as a cadet with excellent grades, and Jaehyun had yet to reveal all of his skills.
Anyway, the most important thing.
At least that Gu Jain can’t move easily right now.
As Jaehyun, it was necessary to grow firmly at this timing.
comrades belonging to their faction. The same goes for Kim Yu-jeong, Seo Ina, Ahn Ho-yeon, Lee Jae-sang, and Seo Ah-hyun.
They also need to grow steadily. Afterwards, no matter what enemies appear in front of you, they will have to become stronger in order to face them without fear.
And Jaehyun implicitly thought of helping the party become stronger.
‘Anyway, it’s something the kids have to work on… but no one gets complacent easily.’
Jaehyun nodded his head slightly and looked at Ahn Hoyeon and Seo Ina walking from the hallway across from him with gloomy faces.
The two must have taken different tests because they were magic and martial arts, but their faces seemed to be strangely sympathetic.
“I heard that even a tiger will come when I say it. And you can be a prophet.”
“ok? what?”
“Look at their faces. Is that an expression you can do without getting a failing grade?”
Only then did Kim Yoo-jung move her eyes to the children behind her and laughed out loud.
“hey. you saw it too I did my best. know?”
“okay. That’s not your problem with me. It’s because they stopped studying.”
“Hasn’t studying lost both of them?”
“That also makes sense…….”
“…Too much. We’ve all heard.”
Seo Ina said as she approached Jaehyun with her eyes narrowed. It was a bonus to poke Kim Yoo-jung’s side with an elbow.
Ahn Ho-yeon didn’t say anything with a stunned expression on his face, as if he didn’t leave the thought of the miserable test paper despite the two men’s beatings.
“Let’s start with scoring. Then I have to study the seven subjects tomorrow.”
At Jaehyun’s words, Seo Ina and Ahn Hoyeon’s expressions began to darken again.
It was the beginning of the second act of the midterm exam.
After thinking for a while, Kim Yoo-jung put her hand on the shoulders of the two and said.
“Um… what is that? I think that’s just it. When raiders catch a boss mob, don’t you know that it goes over to phase 2? Just changing the pattern. You can see it like that.”
“…is that a consolation?”
When Jaehyun was dumbfounded, Kim Yoojung coughed and leaned against the wall.
The two, who were almost certain to fail, still had gloomy faces.
* * *
“Did you do well on the test, Suhyuk?”
“of course.”
At the words of Kim Min-soo who asked from the side, Lee Soo-hyeok raised an eyebrow and said.
‘Well, I think three or four are wrong, but this is not bad. This time, I will overcome the baby Min Jae -hyun. ‘
Lee Soo-hyeok had trouble with Min Jae-hyeon in the AR room test the other day. Of course, he started the fight first, but he was quite annoyed by Min Jae-hyeon’s provocation.
While thinking with a fishy smile, Kim Min-soo suddenly shook his head.
‘Has that bastard lost his second bottle again? Has anything changed from when you were in middle school?’
However, it did not come out of my mouth. Talking about it will only get you beaten.
‘What’s obvious? He must be worrying about how to get into a fight with Min Jae-hyun again.’
After taking a small sigh, Kim Min-soo recalled the rumors about Min Jae-hyeon.
[In the simulated dungeon incident, they said that if it wasn’t for him, everyone inside would have died.]
[Huh? personality breakdown? Is he really nice? Cool.]
[It’s cheap, but it’s voluntary. look at the face Is that a pretty face?]
[This theory test was also completely wrong. It’s a big deal.]
[It’s so damn popular. I’m jealous of you even talking about it.]
Kim Min-soo could hardly figure out where such an irregularity came from.
Talent in all areas.
It was a position that could be said to be ambiguous in general, but Jaehyun was different.
He overwhelmed all fields and was showing results close to astonishment. It is natural that the attention of the instructors is also focused.
‘I hope he doesn’t needlessly fight.’
Although he is at least by his side due to the affection he has been with since middle school, there was a corner where it was difficult to say that Lee Soo-hyeok’s personality was good even with empty words.
It’s about dozens of times that I stopped trying to fight with others, so it’s enough to say everything.
‘If it’s fortunate, it’s that I was so strong that I didn’t get hit by other people, but…’
The problem is that the situation worsened as he even touched Min Jae-hyeon.
In Milles Academy, each faction exists. Unlike other general high schools, the unidirectionally determined career path determines their future and forms a group.
For this reason, those with high grades have their own groups in the middle ranks among themselves.
The problem is that Jae-hyun and Lee Soo-hyeok are both high-ranking cadets, so they will inevitably collide at some point.
But Lee Soo-hyeok didn’t seem to care about that.
It’s just not thinking.
‘That bastard without an answer…….’
Kim Min-soo sighed and left.
* * *
After all the two-day theory exams that followed.
The party gathered at the hideout.
I was waiting for two practical tests in a row over the next few days, so I wanted to finish a rough plan.
The exam, which will begin in three days, desperately needs Lee’s help.
What a manufacturing test.
By the way, none of the people gathered here were good at alchemy.
No, in the first place, Jaehyun and Kim Yu-jung were clumsy at the preparation itself.
Kim Yoo-jung, who made purple cookies during household chores, and Jae-hyun, who almost wasted all the ingredients for the elixir. It would have been difficult for both of them to pass this exam easily.
Because of this, they came to seek advice from Lee Jae-sang.
Lee Jae-sang readily agreed to teach the party at Jae-hyeon’s request.
“Well then, I will teach you about alchemy. Have you read all the school textbooks?”
“Sure.”
“Ho, can you show me yourself? I have to check my poetry skills in advance.”
At Lee Jae-sang’s words, the party headed to the magic engineering facility next to Milles’s main building.
It’s been a long time since the magic engineering facility was reproduced, so it was a new feeling.
Lee Jae-sang told them to prepare the potion they were going to make in the test.
Since it was not a difficult test, it took two hours to make all the potions.
two hours later.
Lee Jae-sang’s expression darkened noticeably.
Obviously, it wasn’t like this when Seo In-na and Ahn Ho-yeon made the potion for the first time, but at
some point, the pupil lost his way and started to wander.
Now, Lee Jae-sang was secretly watching Jae-hyun and Kim Yoo-jung.
Jaehyun asked, tilting his head.
“What’s wrong. brother?”
“That’s it…”
“It’s okay, so tell me.”
At Jaehyun’s words, Lee Jaesang raised his head and said as if he had made up his mind.
“If Yoo, Yoo-jung and you stay like this, I’ll get a failing grade.”
“…yes?”
The two looked at each other after questioning at the same time.
Lee Jae-sang closed his eyes as if he didn’t understand.
“You, you, you don’t have that…talent in alchemy at all!”
Jaehyun’s head throbbed.
…It didn’t look like things would go away easily.

chapters.title: Chapter 108
chapters.content:
Episode 108 Minus Hand (1)
“…I’m sorry. Speaking too harshly…”
Lee Jae-sang scratched his head and apologized.
However, Jae-Hyun and Kim Yu-Jung were already in a state of fascination. To be given a failing grade before even taking the test…
It wasn’t a pleasant feeling at all.
Meanwhile, unlike the two, Seo Eana received rave reviews. Ahn Ho-yeon was also praised for passing the test without difficulty.
Jaehyun thought for a moment and then asked.
“Hyung, is there any way to avoid failing grades? I did well in other grades, but there is no answer if I cut it here.”
“Me too! Oppa, if you mess up your grades here, I’ll be in big trouble!”
“Hahaha, but…”
Lee Jae-sang put on an expression that seemed troubled by the two people’s words.
After thinking for a moment without saying anything, he opened his mouth with difficulty.
“It is not that there is no method at all. That… if you use a special item…”
“Item?”
“Yes! It’s okay to use Priest items for Miles’ Alchemy Trial! Instead, there is a little problem, but…”
“Whew. Thank God… You really thought you were going to die. tell me right away Cost isn’t a problem, so I’ll do it right away…”
Lee Jae-sang interrupted with a pale complexion at Jae-hyeon’s words.
“It is not a problem that can be solved with money. The item you need to find is so rare even in the country that it is difficult to obtain it itself…….”
“What the hell is that item?”
When Kim Yoo-jung asked, Lee Jae-sang answered in a smaller voice.
“That’s it… It’s a monster called ‘Moonlight Firefly’… uh, they only come from very clean areas. Less than 100 of them come up in the B Black Market every year… Oh, it’s going to be hard to find.”
“Moonlight fireflies… But why are they fireflies?”
“If you grind the skin of the War Moonlight Firefly into powder and mix it with other ingredients, it becomes an item that can maximize the performance of the Four Potion.
If that’s the case, no matter how many of you guys use the proper potion… Huh! I’m sorry.”
“Ah… there was something like that.”
The afterword was intentionally left out.
Jaehyun nodded in admiration.
I didn’t know that he was taking up insects, but since he was a potion maker, he seemed to be interested in this and that.
Jaehyun thought about it for a moment, then crossed his arms and said.
“Aside from that, are there any other ingredients we need?”
“Everything else I can buy on the market.”
“Then, where can I get one?”
“Yeah… but they’re hard to find…”
“I’ll try something.”
Jaehyun abandoned the idea of passing the alchemy test with his own skills early on.
Kim Yoo-jung also seemed to be the same.
There was no other way for the two of them. Moonlight fireflies. I have to pass the test even if I have to exterminate those bugs immediately!
The eyes of Jaehyun and Yujeong Kim were filled with determination.
* * *
“But do you know where I am going and follow me?”
Jaehyun, who was walking down the hallway, fired at Kim Yoojung, who was standing next to him.
Kim Yoo-jung replied with a vicious smile.
“You are not the kind of person who will do things without thinking, are you? If I follow you around, something will work out.”
“…I don’t really want to take you with me because you said that.”
At Jaehyun’s words, Kim Yoojung screamed.
“hey! What is a good friend!”
“I know, so don’t scream. Pay the right price.”
“okay. I’ll do well as you tell me, so don’t just throw it away. You really have to pass the exam in one go. Are failing grades acceptable in my life?”
Jaehyun gave an appropriate answer to Kim Yoojung’s words and climbed into the elevator.
Kim Yoo-jung opened her eyes wide and asked.
“But why take the elevator upstairs? This is where the seniors are.”
“So get on. I’m going to seek some help from a senior I know.”
“…is there a senior you know?”
“okay. Someone you know too?”
At Jaehyun’s words, Kim Yoojung tilted her head.
Did you know any seniors at Milles Academy?
I don’t remember anyone like that at all.
After a while.
After Jaehyun arrives on the 2nd year floor. I searched the room and found one person.
Only then did Kim Yoo-jung realize. Why did Jaehyun say he was looking for someone he knew?
There was a very familiar face in front of Kim Yoo-jung with a puzzled expression.
Soyul Kwon.
One of the members of Sid, one of the most popular circles on campus, he was one of the seniors who were outed by two during the freshman hunt.
‘I’m glad. I thought what if I had already gone to the dormitory.’
Jaehyun laughed.
The reason he came to Kwon So-yul was clear.
‘Thanks to Kwon So-yul’s unique skill 《Search》, he can track a designated target up to hundreds of kilometers.
As long as you use this, it’s not unreasonable to find and catch traces of moonlight fireflies.’
Of course, if you want, you can use a blank card to copy Kwon So-yul’s skill.
It was because Jaehyun’s inventory still had the blank card he obtained from hunting the king of the Dark Elves the other day.
However, Jaehyun was well aware that such a choice was poison.
‘Even if it’s a unique skill, it’s stupid to use a card for a tracking skill.’
Furthermore.
Jaehyun has already roughly decided on the next skill to copy with a blank card.
‘Single extreme skill. I need that.’
It was fine now that the AoE skill was < Judgment of Light > and the newly obtained < Frozen Earth >.
However, in order to deal with the boss monster, extreme skill is inevitably required.
Of course, there is < Chain of Lightning >, but it is true that it is a bit ambiguous when considering only single firepower. It wasn’t that he wasn’t as strong as an A-rank, but there are many stronger skills in the world.
In the first place, the reason why Jaehyun uses chain-type magic is because of its utility.
There was no reason for Jaehyun to insist on one skill after defeating the king of the Dark Elves and acquiring all sorts of magical power-enhancing items.
In addition, Jaehyun is already scheduled to fight Hugin and other Aesir gods.
At such an important time, giving up a card just for 《Explore》?
‘It’s stupid. … In addition, it is necessary to be careful about copying the unique skills and active skills.’
It was natural.
S-class skills can be learned by anyone with talent.
However, their unique skills are different.
A unique skill is a skill that is monopolized by an individual or a specific family.
What if you see them randomly copying and using them?
At least, it will be difficult to look good to the top radars with vested interests.
‘Perhaps if my ability is revealed to others… I will definitely be killed by other S-class raiders.’
Jaehyun wasn’t strong enough to deal with S-class raiders yet.
They will have no reason to keep Jaehyun alive, who will gradually grow and threaten their place.
In this situation, recklessly copying a unique skill was a big risk.
‘Now, it’s better to copy skills that are maximally usable and can be used in front of others without any problems.’
Jaehyun nodded slightly and took a step into the room.
Fortunately, Kwon So-yul was reading a book alone in the circle room.
Jaehyun was relieved and let go of his luck.
“ah. I barely found it. hello. Senior Kwon So-yul.”
Kwon So-yul took her eyes off the book and said with a displeased expression.
“…what? Min Jae-hyun and Kim Yoo-jung…? Why are you here?”
“Nothing else. I have come to ask you something.”
Kwon So-yul frowned at Jae-hyun’s bold words.
“hey. You played with me like that during the freshman hunt, and now you’re here…”
“If you help me, I’ll give you a fair reward. We are also in a hurry.”
“I don’t know what it is, but I won’t listen, so go away.”
“Do you know what I’ll give you and refuse so easily?”
“what?”
Kwon So-yul’s expression changed at Jae-hyun’s words.
‘Well, at most, it looks like they’re going to share some points… Really. How do you view seniors?’
she asked, crossing her arms.
“okay. Say something. What are you going to give me?”
Jaehyun smiled.
If this is the case, it is as if everything has been passed.
Jaehyun was thinking of proposing the most common and snobbish thing among what people want from people.
Jaehyun said in a calm voice.
“I will give you money. in cash.”
“hey! No matter how much I am a senior, I think I will be swayed by money…….”
“30 million won. how is it? If the work goes well, I can take care of more.”
Kwon So-yul’s two eyes turned bright.
Without realizing it, my saliva went down.
“…I’ll listen and see.”
30 million won… It was too big an amount to refuse.
* * *
“…Well, that sounds like a possibility.”
“thank god.”
Kwon So-yul nodded his head, saying that it was possible enough after hearing Jae-hyun’s plan.
Jaehyun and Kim Yoojung took a deep breath and were relieved.
Well, it’s a unique skill, but it was strange that fireflies couldn’t find one.
Just before you do a favor. Kwon So-yul said he had two questions.
The first was simple.
No matter how skillful you are, you need traces to find fireflies. But can anyone find traces of moonlight fireflies here?
“Do not worry. I’m bringing an incredibly talented alchemist with me.”
“Um… well, if that’s the case.”
The second question was also insignificant.
How did you know you had the «Search» skill?
This is a story that has spread all over the school, so I just covered it up.
Kwon So-yul also quickly understood Jae-hyun’s answer because he didn’t ask in an interrogative manner.
Kim Yoo-jung was a bit shy, but quickly became close with Kwon So-yul.
The extreme sociability was demonstrated in the urgency created by the exam period.
“Then let’s leave today. Because the test is coming soon.”
“Well, that’s fine. Are you really giving me 30 million won?”
Even though he wrote the contract and showed it to him, Kwon So-yul did not seem to believe it easily.
Jaehyun nodded as if he didn’t care.
“Ah, because it is. That’s a lot of money.”
“…Yoo Jung-ah. What kind of gold spoon is he?”
At Kwon So-yul’s question, Kim Yoo-jung shook her head.
Jaehyun, who was next to him, answered instead.
“If I had to put it that way, I am a self-made man. ah! Chancellor hyung is leaving now.”
“Ah yes. Ah Okay.”
“…Isn’t that Lee Jae-sang? Is he going too?”
“Ah, is it old?”
When Jaehyun asked, Kwon Soyul meekly nodded.
“Then we were on the same team in the freshman hunt at first.”
I felt that I had found an unexpected friendship.
Lee Jae-sang said that he had a freshman hunt with the same team as Kwon So-yul last year.
Of course, my grades weren’t that good, and I didn’t play very well.
Jaehyun turned on his smartphone screen to check his watch and said calmly.
“Don’t worry, I prepared all the luggage and necessary expenses. Shall we go then?”
* * *
Muju-gun, Jeollabuk-do. Deogyusan area.
The reason Jaehyun and the party came to such a distant place was simple.
Although it is a monster, the moonlight firefly is not a monster that appears in dungeons.
These are monsters that can be found in normal nature and appear in places where real animals and plants are distributed.
In the society, these monsters are referred to as «Natural Witchbeasts».
There is a lot of talk about the creation principle and ecology of demon beasts, but most of them say that mana that stayed in the air and ground after the outbreak of monsters transformed actual animals and plants into demon beasts.
Because of this, Jaehyun chose this place as his destination.
Muju-gun, Jeollabuk-do is the place where you can find fireflies most easily in the country.
It fits their purpose exactly.
“by the way. It’s still spring, so the weather is pretty cold.”
“sleep. Here are yours, and the chancellor wears them too.”
Jaehyun took out short padding from his inventory and handed it to the party one by one.
I thought the mountain would be cold on the way back, so I bought padding in advance. Of course, since it was a raider with transcendental power, the cold wouldn’t make it dull…
Anyway, I couldn’t neglect my preparations when I had to fight monsters.
Kwon So-yul, who accepted the padding, asked with her eyes shining.
“Wait a minute. This padding… isn’t it super expensive? It was advertised on TV.”
“yes. You know.”
Jaehyun nodded his head appropriately.
Kwon So-yul quickly received and put on the padding and said with a satisfied face.
“hey. Are you giving me this? If you give it away, you’re a real bad guy. you.”
“I will give it to you. Don’t worry and use your skills. I have to work for 30 million won.”
“Mr. Ha… Okay, so look for traces.”
A white fog spread in front of the group entering the deep part of the mountain.
His vision was blurry, his vision was unclear, and his son-in-law was dark.
However, Lee Jae-sang was doing well on the mountain road covered with twilight. Even though it was a little past ten in the evening, he seemed very active.
Kim Yoo-jung whispered to Jae-hyun and asked.
“Prime Minister, brother, why are you like that? It’s a little bit… I think I’m excited.”
“I know. Well, he said it before getting on the portal. He likes bugs.”
“You say you like bugs…?”
Kim Yoo-jung trembled and refused with her whole body.
Either that or not, Lee Jae-sang was busy looking for traces of moonlight fireflies.
about an hour after that.
“ah! These are the traces of moonlight fireflies.”
Lee Jae-sang found the bodily fluid of the moonlight fireflies on the tree.
When Jaehyun looked at Kwon Soyul, she immediately nodded.
“Okay. Wait a minute.”
―Use the active skill 《Search》.
―I found the traces of the moonlight fireflies.
―Guide users to the target ‘Moonlight Firefly’.
