chapters.content:
Episode 109 Minus Hand (2)
―Use the active skill 《Explore》.
―I found the traces of the moonlight fireflies.
―Guide users to the target ‘Moonlight Firefly’.
“good. I think I found it.”
“oh! Are you already?”
At Kwon So-yul’s words, Kim Yoo-jung responded with a happy voice.
Lee Jae-sang was startled and put his index finger on his lips.
“Shh joh, if you don’t be quiet, the moonlight fireflies might run away…….”
“Ah yes. sorry.”
After Kim Yoo-jung apologized, she moved behind Kwon So-yul.
Jaehyun rolled his eyes here and there in search of moonlight fireflies.
After moving deeper for about 20 minutes, a place where the surroundings could not be distinguished came out.
Jaehyun asked, tilting his head.
“what? I don’t think this is the road we came from before.”
“I know. It’s strange, and it seems like something spooky.”
Kim Yoo-jung hit the ball.
Lee Jae-sang, who was ahead of him, also swallowed.
Even so, it seemed unexpected that the surrounding scenery would change all of a sudden.
Jaehyun calmly grasped the current situation.
“Somehow, something is wrong here……”
the moment I was about to say.
Jiing!
Along with the magical response, dozens of glowing fireflies popped out from the lake valley covered in water mist.
Lee Jae-sang opened his eyes wide and said.
“So-so-so-that’s a moonlight firefly!”
“Hmm… It’s bigger than a normal firefly. A bit harsh.”
Even at first glance, the size of the moonlight firefly was much larger than that of a normal non-masculinized individual. It seemed to be well twenty times.
Kim Yoo-jung’s face hardened coldly.
Apparently, he thought he was only coming to catch small fireflies.
‘Well, since I was little, I hated bugs to death.’
Kim Yoo-jung hated bugs from the past.
In particular, cicadas and mantises were the flagship type as soon as they saw them.
Jaehyun was also not very fond of bugs. Of course, we should respect the tastes of people like Jaesang Lee, but…
‘There are so many cute things in the world, but why bother with bugs?’
That was Jaehyun’s idea.
Lee Jae-sang, holding his breath as if excited, is delighted in a small voice.
Kwon So-yul had no reaction.
Jaehyun cautiously approached the firefly.
Geeing……!
The fireflies flap their wings vigorously.
Jaehyun swallowed his saliva.
‘As expected, they move faster than normal fireflies, probably because they’re magical beasts.’
Take out a bug collecting container from your inventory and pour your magic toward flying insects.
―Activate the active skill «Gravity».
«Gravity» is a skill that allows you to freely manipulate gravity.
It’s a C-class, so the rating isn’t high, but it’s enough to catch bugs.
Along with the swirling sound of magic power, the moonlight firefly’s wings began to gradually slow down.
Of course, mercy was placed in the hands.
If you put too much mana on it, all the bugs could burst out.
Lee Jae-sang said that no matter what happened, it was not enough.
But…
It seems that the moonlight fireflies have consumed a lot of mana.
“I don’t think I can do this with just one skill?”
At Kim Yoo-jung’s words, Kwon So-yul also nodded.
“You hold up to the insect theme better than I thought. Jaehyun-ah, can you control your magic more?”
“…no. no more here I don’t have enough skill to do it more delicately.”
Jaehyun thought for a moment.
If you leave it like this, you might miss all the moonlight fireflies.
For reference, the price of one moonlight firefly is close to 10 million won. At first glance, the number is almost thirty.
If he caught it, he would probably have a large amount left over even if he gave 30 million won to Kwon So-yul.
‘The chancellor should also give some to his brother. I should give Kim Yoo-jung just enough to use.’
After organizing my thoughts, I used my magic again. This time it was a more cautious move.
Jaehyun shoots magic in the form of a thread, and then connects the point where the thread touches in the form of a line and plane.
Soon, a small rectangular space was formed, and a magical room was created to confine the fireflies.
“What?! This?”
When Kwon So-yul sighed softly, Jae-hyun replied indifferently.
“I’ve been practicing in advance because I thought something like this might happen.”
“Mana room… Now, the mana room was randomly created. you?”
Jaehyun calmly nodded his head at Kwon Soyul’s surprised face.
Kim Yoo-jung and Lee Jae-sang were not too surprised because they had already appreciated the skill of reenactment before leaving.
However, Kwon So-yul was different.
‘Mana room… nonsense!’
What Jaehyun had just created was a mana room.
One of the actual facilities at Miles Academy, it was a kind of chemical and biochemical facility created to adapt to mana poisoning.
But you make it? Randomly?
“what are you doing? Catch them all.”
At Jaehyun’s words, Kim Yoo-jung slaughtered and Kwon So-yul only then moved.
Lee Jae-sang was already putting the moonlight fireflies blocked by the wall into the collecting bin.
Kwon So-yul shook his head.
‘I’m not sure what happened… Min Jae-hyun. Also great. that offer. Should I accept it?’
The moment you reach out for a firefly floating in the air with a dazed face.
Unexpectedly, Jaehyun’s voice was heard.
“Oh wait. If I held it with my bare hands, it would smell… awful. It’s already too late.”
“…under. You should have told me sooner.”
Kwon So-yul shook his head at the stench of the unknown slime on his hands.
After a while.
Jaehyun, who caught all the bugs, said with a satisfied face.
“Then shall we go back?”
* * *
It didn’t take long to make moonlight firefly powder.
As soon as Lee Jae-sang returned, he locked himself in the lab with a face like a mad scientist in the movie. Thanks to this, it took two days to complete.
It was really super fast.
The five people gathered at the magic engineering building again.
Jaehyun and Kim Yoojung were preparing potions while swallowing saliva.
However, two people came to observe. Ahn Ho-yeon and Seo E-na’s complexion was not very good.
This is because the substance that the two of them synthesized (?) had a purple color that people could not possibly swallow.
Of course, Jaehyun’s color was slightly brighter. However, it was only a difference in severity, and both of them had the worst cooking skills.
Ahn Ho-yeon, who was watching from the side, said with a serious expression.
“You guys should never date or get married. please.”
“What kind of bullshit is that all of a sudden?”
“…what.”
Jaehyun and Kim Yoojung raised their heads almost simultaneously and answered.
Ahn Ho-yeon shook his head and said.
“If you both get married, you won’t cook like that. What’s wrong with children?”
“…i think so too.”
Even Seo Ina nodded with a pale face.
The two of them looked slightly hurt, but soon focused on preparing the potion again.
“I think you should put it in now.”
As if waiting with the sound of words, he poured some of the powder handed over from Lee Jae-sang.
Only a very small amount of about a spoonful with a 2g spoon.
But the effect was incomprehensible.
The two solutions, which had been purple, suddenly became transparent the moment the powder entered them.
“What?!”
“…I know. What the hell is this…….”
Ahn Ho-yeon and Seo In-na looked at the solution and Lee Jae-sang alternately as if surprised.
Lee Jae-sang crossed his arms and nodded as if he was satisfied.
“Now, it is being refined well. Ah, maybe more than 70% purity is worth looking forward to.”
As soon as he finished speaking, the potion, which had been holding transparent light, regained its color.
What the two of them are making now is a strawberry scented HP recovery potion.
As the solution turned red, the faces of the two were delighted.
“Look at this! I did it too! I did!”
“and! Chancellor, I think this is really crazy. The performance…”
After a while. Lee Jae-sang was delighted at the words of the two, but he could only tremble as he clashed his teeth.
‘Jaejae Jaehyun’s refining rate is 51%… Yoojeong’s is 47%.’
It was a truly shocking feat for something created with the help of moonlight fireflies.
‘If at all possible, I’ll make sure that the two of us don’t make four potions…’
Lee Jae-sang clenched his fists and made a promise.
The two didn’t know that, and they were busy loving each other.
For Jaesang Lee, it was disturbing in many ways.
* * *
A few days later. The first day of the midterm exam.
Jae-Hyun and Kim Yoo-Jung took a potion manufacturing test in the same laboratory.
‘Because I’ve worked hard until now… I’m sure it’ll work out somehow.’
Both of them were quite confident.
It’s true that it’s quite difficult as you have to make an intermediate recovery potion.
However, don’t they have moonlight firefly powder that costs hundreds of thousands of won per spoon?
It was clear that he could easily pass this level of testing.
In fact, Lee Jae-sang also handed over the powder for the first time and said this.
[If this is an item, the refinement rate is at least 70% or higher… That’s why it should be enough to rank in the top 5 of the school!] I didn’t get a sense of how
excellent the refinement rate was over 70%, but if it was in the top 5 of the school, it was very positive. .
In the past, Jaehyun had scored four failing marks in this test.
Kim Yoo-jung recorded one more failure, five times.
Of course, even that, Kim Yu-jung passed because she had good grades in other tests, and Jae-hyun was lucky and somehow managed to do it.
It was only one hand that he had made a proper potion with his skills.
‘If I had to argue, I made potions even during the freshman hunt, but…’
The potions he made at the time were of the lowest quality and crude. There was a restriction that you couldn’t bring consumption items from outside, so I had no choice but to make it.
There was no reason to make a potion on his own when Lee Jae-sang was present.
“Then let’s start the exam.”
The instructor in charge of the exam announced the start.
Jaehyun and Kim Yoojung started preparing potions as they were familiar with them.
As taught by Jaesang Lee, mash the herbs and add water to the herbs in a 2:1 ratio.
Now, after putting the herbs and various ingredients together in the pot and boiling it for a while, the color should have become transparent…
As expected, the color of the liquid in the two people’s pot was clearly purple.
The two thought almost at the same time.
‘As expected… Something to believe!’
‘It’s tempting!’
Without hesitation, the two scooped a spoonful of the powder that had been placed on the table beforehand.
The liquid immediately turned transparent and soon regained its color.
Jaehyun and Kim Yoojung’s faces showed strange joy.
On the other hand, the instructor who was watching the scene was frightened and swallowed saliva.
‘Put that precious moonlight firefly into a mere intermediate recovery potion?’
No, I can understand that by conceding a hundred times.
The biggest problem is…
‘Two people… the skills are so bad!’
The test of accurate potion making test consists of checking the degree of refinement and drinking by the instructor.
The instructor swallowed his saliva.
No matter how much moonlight fireflies were put in… you want to eat that?
I rubbed my eyes, wondering if I had become an instructor for no reason, but all of a sudden.
Jaehyun and Kim Yoojung’s eyes met.
The two looked at each other and thought while wiping their noses.
‘Chit, I made some this time.’
‘That’s what I’m going to say.’
The instructor was flagship.
After a while.
After all the exams were over, Jaehyun and Kim Yoojung’s final grades were 31st and 42nd respectively.
Lee Jae-sang listened to the results of the two and lowered his head.
On the other hand, Seo In-na ranked first in all freshmen school alone without any items. Ahn Ho-yeon also achieved good results in 29th place. “Huh… I went through so much trouble to catch fireflies
, but I’m 31st and 42nd…”
“How did I catch the bug…….”
muttered.
Lee Jae-sang wiggled his hands as if he was sorry.
“I’m sorry… I thought that with this level of item, even your skills would be in the top 5 unconditionally… Next time, at least cut off the unicorn’s horn…” “
It’s done. brother. thank you.”
Jaehyun sighed and sat down on the sofa.
‘Well… Because cooking was the worst from the start.’
A test passed anyway.
Jaehyun quickly recovered his mentality.
Kim Yoo-jung also seemed to have come to her senses again.
The party gathered at the hideout.
It was because two days from now, there will finally be a practical test on dungeon strategy.
A chance to make a name for yourself across the country.
Jaehyun was thinking of solidifying his position here.
However, this was not the end of Jaehyun’s plan.
‘In this midterm exam, Gu Jain’s stock price will go down once again.’
Jaehyun looked forward to the expression Gu Jain would make, as he played with his plan with a happy face on his face.
I thought it would be very worth seeing.

chapters.title: Chapter 110
chapters.content:
Episode 110 Practical Test (1)
If you ask the cadets at Milles Academy about the second practical test.
Nine out of ten people will answer like this.
[Fuck.]
[Is that a test? Difficulty level is high]
[Wait a minute! PTSD…….]
The reasons are various. It was true that they agreed.
actually. The difficulty level of this second practical exam is very high.
It is because the conditions are difficult as it is a compilation of all the academy classes that have been taken so far.
Freshman Hunt Mock Dungeon AR Test.
The second practical test was designed after the three main classes of the first semester, which were the most important.
For example, being held in sub-space is like hunting freshmen.
The way to attack the dungeon is similar to the mock dungeon.
It is similar to the AR test that you are not facing real enemies.
but.
Just because you’ve experienced it once doesn’t mean it’s easy.
This is because even if the test is conducted in a subspace where there is no risk of injury, it is difficult enough to compare with the midterm exam of the Radar Academy, which has a different level of difficulty.
‘Rather, the level of difficulty goes up as there is no risk of getting hurt.’
In addition, in this test, as in the mock dungeon, you have to work as a team.
If you meet a team member you do not agree with, you may get a low grade and be expelled.
…however. Apart from this, there was a really big problem.
‘The way you organize your team. That’s the factor that exponentially increases the difficulty of this second practical skill.’
In the practical test at Milles Academy, the number of people is not randomly assigned like in the previous mock dungeon raid.
Each cadet is given a differentiated cost based on their performance so far, and three other team members must be voluntarily formed within the line where the total of these costs does not exceed 50.
For example, the cost of Jaehyun, who ranked first among all freshmen, was 20.
Inevitably, the remaining three seats had to be filled with 30.
Considering that the general average cost of middle-ranking cadets is 10, Jae-Hyun alone consumes the cost of two people.
It was inevitably difficult to determine the relative number of remaining people.
‘I can’t take my colleagues with me in this test.’
In a situation where you need to build a party of four, Jaehyun has already consumed 20 cost.
There are three seats left, and no matter how much cost is saved here, it is difficult to bring more than one colleague.
Other colleagues also hunt freshmen, simulated dungeons, etc. Thanks to being active in various events, the cost was very high.
In the case of Ahn Ho-yeon, 17. Seo In-na and Kim Yu-jeong were assigned costs of 15 and 14, respectively.
If Jaehyun recruits Ahn Hoyeon, the cost of 37 will be consumed with just the two of them.
Simply put, a situation arises in which only the lowest-ranking cadets should take the remaining positions.
When I was calmly organizing my thoughts. I started to hear a buzz around me.
It was the voice of the other cadets.
“Hey Min Jaehyun, does he have a team?”
“Of course~ How many kids must have asked to do it when it came in first place?”
“That’s true, but… I think we’ll get good grades if we do it together.”
“Well, it’s magic, but even martial arts have been chewed up. If we are in the same team, we can get on the bus right?”
“Should I just close my eyes and ask?”
“no way. Let’s not mess around and play with each other.”
With the confused sound of words, all eyes are focused on Jaehyun.
All the cadets seemed to want to be on the same team as Jaehyun.
Jaehyun kept his mouth shut and glanced at the cadets staring at him for a moment.
‘…what. No wonder.’
It is only natural for them to be interested in Jaehyun.
Jaehyun has already proven his ability several times.
In almost every class, including the freshman hunting mock dungeon AR test, Jaehyun showed phenomenal talent. It couldn’t be more attractive to others.
Of course, Jaehyun was completely unaware of the gazes around him.
‘by the way. I never thought I would become a coast-eating hippo. Was my cost 6 before?’
In the past, Jaehyun was assigned a low cost due to poor grades.
This is a double-edged sword. Although he couldn’t choose his teammates, it was easy to join a party with relatively high ranks.
This is because a party with high-ranking raiders must eventually save costs.
In fact, Jaehyun took advantage of this situation before returning to join a party that was good compared to his grades.
‘…The result was the worst.’
In general, when playing as a team at Milles, there are many cases in which the upper rank cadets designate the lower rank cadets to form a team.
If you look closely, Jaehyun now has his own options. Nothing bad.
1 in the mid-term rankings of Milles Academy.
No cadet would ever refuse his offer.
but.
Even though the situation was advantageous to him, Jaehyun had a displeased expression.
‘It’s a dog way. Does the upper rank point to the lower rank? By what right?’
It’s a big deal that depends on the grades of the midterm exam.
To make someone else’s life-and-death matter depend on someone else’s choice.
At least in Jaehyun’s opinion, this was obviously wrong.
‘In the past, I was also in a position to be chosen.’
As Jaehyun recalled the miserable past and held the accusation, a shadow suddenly fell over his head.
When I raised my head, one of the students with a sad face came up to me.
“hi?”
Seeing the cadet’s face, Jaehyun’s eyes narrowed. Jaehyun’s brow furrowed wildly.
‘That bastard is…’
A face so familiar that it makes my teeth tremble.
The person who tortured Jaehyun to death in the same test before returning was right in front of his eyes.
Jaehyun has never forgotten that cunning face over the past 10 years.
‘… Ugliness. As I remember, he’s disgusting looking.’
Ughanseong.
In the past, in the second practical test, he was the person who served as the leader of Jaehyun’s team.
To add, the culprit who ruined Jaehyun’s midterm exam grades.
‘At the time, that bastard rolled me like a servant and threw it away. Abusive language, violence… so terrible that I can’t count them all.’
The ugliness that Jaehyun remembers was clearly a villain.
A person who digs into the weaknesses of others, threatens them, and extorts only their own interests.
In the past, Jaehyun had memories of suffering terribly thanks to him.
A twisted smile crept across Jaehyun’s lips.
Uh Han-seong continued without noticing the change in Jae-hyun’s expression.
“Are you Min Jaehyun? A genius cadet who ranked first in the freshman hunt and played an active role in the mock dungeon.”
“so?”
There was a sharp edge in Jaehyun’s voice as he answered.
Thanks to that skinny face, Jaehyun had to suffer until the moment he graduated.
trauma.
The person who planted the trauma in her was right in front of her eyes. If the heat didn’t spread, that would be strange.
‘…what?’
Chu Han-seong only then became embarrassed by Jae-hyun’s cold response.
He cleared his throat to hide his embarrassment.
“…I’ll tell you something straight. Team up with me in this test.
I’m on the cheap side compared to my skills. Now that you’re 20, isn’t it difficult to pick a teammate? I will help you.”
“under.”
Jaehyun immediately understood how this disgusting situation was going.
Chu Han-seong, who had bullied him in the past, is thinking of using himself to ride the bus this time.
‘This guy is everywhere. baby bat. It’s strong and weak, irredeemable garbage.’
Jaehyun laughed as he got up from his seat at the same time as he thought.
“I’m sorry. I have no intention of doing it with you. Why don’t you recognize someone else?”
“…for a moment. Did you hear my story? My cost is cheap compared to my skills…….”
“I know. But that doesn’t really mean anything.”
“what?”
At Jaehyun’s words, Uh Hanseong questioned and frowned.
Jaehyun took a step closer and looked straight at Ughanseong.
“I can clear the exam by myself. And… you’re not really helpful to me. You are too weak.”
“What?!”
Ugly Hanseong’s face quickly turned red.
Jaehyun walked past him and headed for the stairs behind him.
In fact, Jaehyun had already decided a few days ago who he would be working with for the second practice session.
Tboob. Tboob.
Jaehyun approached the two people sitting at the back of the stairs and asked.
“Did you guys think about what I said?”
“of course! Both me and Jina decided to do it together.”
“I’m glad. I was worried about what would happen if we didn’t do it together.”
Jaehyun trembled with a smile.
However, the face of Ughanseong, who saw it, was distorted fiercely like never before.
‘What?! What the hell is going on!’
Chu Han-seong looked incredulously at the two people talking to Jae-hyun.
They were completely unexpected people.
Kim Jin-ah and Park Seong-woo.
It was something we couldn’t understand.
Aren’t those two the ones who abandoned Jaehyun and ran away from the last mock dungeon?
Even if they fell apart, why did they, who should have fallen apart long ago, become the same team?
* * *
After a while. A cafe on the premises of Milles Academy.
Jaehyun, Jina Kim, and Seongwoo Park were drinking coffee while waiting for the rest of the team.
In the middle of a moment of silence, Kim Jin-ah suddenly asked.
“I… Jaehyun. Are you really going to be okay with us? At that time, even in the mock dungeon, we weren’t very helpful. …I even abandoned you and ran away. We still don’t know why you chose us.”
trembling voice. Jaehyun looked up and looked at the two of them.
Both Kim Jin-ah and Park Seong-woo had pale faces, probably recalling the trauma of the time.
Jaehyun crossed his arms as if it was no big deal.
“don’t worry. I didn’t mean to be with you with the intention of losing money.”
In fact, Jaehyun did not choose these two with the intention of losing money.
Because there are many places to use it.
The reason I picked them was just that.
“Then it’s fortunate…”
Park Seong-wu blurted out, and Kim Jin-ah answered and asked.
“By the way, who will fill the remaining seat?”
“Oh, didn’t I tell you otherwise?”
The moment Jaehyun was about to answer the question.
Suddenly, a voice from behind interrupted me.
“hey. Are the two people you said you were going to be together with them?”
A familiar voice echoed.
Jaehyun smiled. He said without looking back.
“Come. the last one.”
The eyes of the two of them moved to the direction where the voice came from, and their eyes widened.
A familiar face could be seen from the edge of the gaze.
Youjeong Kim.
At the time of the mock dungeon incident. Kim Jin-ah and Park Seong-woo, who reprimanded Park Seong-woo for abandoning their teammates and leaving the dungeon, became the same team.
Jaehyun looked at the three of them alternately.
“Should I say hello first?”

chapters.title: Chapter 111
chapters.content:
Episode 111 Practical Test (2)
“Sit down for now.”
At Jaehyun’s recommendation, Kim Yoojung sat down next to her with her eyes narrowed.
A moment of suffocating silence flows. Kim Yoo-jung opened her mouth first.
“Ha… Min Jaehyun. Let me endure somehow. But did you really choose them because you’re okay?”
“What do you want to say?”
“You know. What am I talking about.”
The two people in front froze at Kim Yoo-jung’s stiff tone.
Jaehyun knew why she reacted so coldly.
‘Kim Jin-ah and Park Seong-woo. They were the ones who saved me before the return, but in the current timeline, they are perceived as irresponsible cadets who almost killed me.’
Mock dungeon incident.
In an event you could call a tragedy, Jae-Hyun actually almost died.
At that time, Kim Jin-ah and Park Seong-woo ran away leaving behind Jae-hyun and Seo In-na.
To follow the leader, Jae-Hyun’s instructions, and to call the instructors outside.
However, the problem was that the dungeon at the time was in the form of a closed dungeon and it was impossible to enter inside from the outside.
As a result, the two were criticized by others.
A cowardly raider who ran away without being able to protect his comrades.
He took on the stigma that Jaehyun used in the past.
Jaehyun looked at Kim Yoojung and said calmly.
“You said that too. Ina and I sent them outside. Isn’t it too harsh to blame the two of you?”
“Ha yes. It can be harsh. however. That doesn’t mean that these two people didn’t abandon you and run away. Honestly, I don’t understand why you made this choice.”
“are you okay. And realistically, catching these two was the best.”
Of course, this statement is somewhat ambiguous.
Jaehyun is currently ranked #1.
Able to work with any cadet. To put it simply, I had the free pass in my hand.
It is not difficult to form a team with other cadets if you put your mind to it.
But in the end, Jaehyun chose these two people.
The reason was simple.
‘Thanks to the two of them running away from the simulated dungeon, the cost is relatively undervalued compared to their skills. It’s not the Ughan Castle that’s really cheap, but this one.’
All of Miles’ class grades are actively used in this evaluation. In order to give an appropriate cost, the data at the time of the mock dungeon practice had to be used as well.
‘Park Seong-woo and Kim Jin-ah abandoned their colleagues in a mock dungeon and ran away. It’s impossible to get a good evaluation no matter what.’
After a while.
Kim Yoo-jung, who heard all the explanations, nodded with a shy face.
“…what’s the matter. But… it’s kind of weird though. You can get a perfect score on the practical test by yourself. Why are you taking the two of you?”
At Kim Yoo-jung’s words, Park Sung-woo and Kim Jin-ah also raised their heads.
It was a question that the two of them also wanted to ask.
‘It’s sharp.’
“It’s all because I have thoughts. Did you see me doing things for no reason?”
Jaehyun laughed.
In this exercise, there were several prerequisites for Jaehyun to form a team member.
one of them is right.
‘Enmity toward Gu Jain.’
Jaehyun made a plan for this second practice.
In order to realize this, the hostility towards Gu Jain. He also needed a heavy mouth to listen to himself.
‘I made an appointment in advance for a time like this. No problem.’
Jaehyun briefly recalled the phone call he had with Kim Jinah a few days ago.
[…You want to be on the same team as us? I’m fine, but…]
[I have to accept one condition instead.]
[Conditions?]
[Yes. Never disclose what happened in this second practical test to the outside world. That’s the condition.]
[It’s not difficult if it’s something like that.]
[Then, that’s it. Oh right. We need to write a simple contract for this condition. Are you okay?]
[Yes. are you okay. If it’s okay with us, we’ll help with anything.]
The real reason for choosing the two. that.
“Guardian. In this event, we will bring him down.”
“…what?”
Kim Yoo-jung was surprised by Jae-hyun’s words and asked back.
The other two also looked at Jaehyun and soon became stunned.
‘Is Jaehyun… serious?’
Kim Jin-ah trembled in disbelief.
Of course, he and Park Seong-woo also heard from Jae-hyun and knew about it. That Chairman Gu Ja-in deliberately set them into a trap.
That what happened in the mock dungeon that day was no coincidence.
But…
Guin.
How the hell did you bring him down, who had absolute power?
This was something that even the Radar Management Headquarters could not easily accomplish.
However.
While receiving the attention of the three, Jaehyun just smiled.
All plans were already in his head.
‘Guardian. If you can get out of the network again this time. Let’s see.’
* * *
“Hello. everyone. I am Instructor Park Ha-joon, who will supervise the second practical test for this midterm exam.”
on the day of the test.
Jaehyun gathered in the auditorium with his teammates to take the second practical exercise.
The instructor in charge of this exam is Park Ha-joon.
According to Instructor Jeong Yi-soo’s report, he is one of Gu Ja-in’s new henchmen.
Jaehyun sneered and looked at his behavior.
‘What’s obvious? A new right-hand man to fill the vacancy after losing Kim Seok-gi.’
However, there will be nothing to see.
Recruiting a talented person like Kim Seok-ki is difficult, no matter how old he is.
Kim Seok-gi was an elite raider who was at the top of the A-class. Now Park Ha-joon is also A-class, but there was a difference in rank from him.
As for Jaehyun, he’s an opponent who doesn’t need to be nervous at all.
‘by the way. I can’t believe Gu Ja-in still didn’t notice Instructor Jeong Yi-soo’s brainwashing.’
I thought it was unexpectedly insensitive.
The other day, Jae-hyeon cast a brainwashing spell on Instructor Jeong Yi-soo.
It was to use her, Gu Jain’s confidant, to steal important information about Miles.
But after the guild experience.
Quite a long time has passed, but there is no message from Gu Jain.
The brainwashing that Instructor Jeong Yi-soo is also still in effect.
Given the circumstances, it was correct to assume that Ja-in Gu did not notice Instructor Yi-soo Jeong’s brainwashing.
There was no reason not to use it as a representation.
“hey. But are you really okay?”
Unexpectedly, Kim Yoo-jung, standing next to her, tilted her head and asked.
When Jaehyun didn’t respond, Kim Yoojung seemed frustrated and added.
“That… your strategy. The one who said he was going to bring Gu Jain down.”
Kim Yoo-jung spoke in a noticeably smaller voice.
Jaehyun smiled and nodded.
“don’t worry. Whatever happens, I will take responsibility.”
“hey! Where is that word? It’s the same team. Ugh. done. I just asked.”
Kim Yoo-jung grumbled and put both hands in the pockets of her skirt.
Park Seong-woo and Kim Jin-ah, standing next to them, seemed nervous and were trembling.
After a while.
Instructor Park Ha-joon’s words about the exam came to an end.
“…So, from now on, all of the second practical tests will be accompanied by a helicam.
The video to be filmed will be broadcast live across the country without any delay, and large bonus points will be awarded to cadets who achieve good grades. Please do your best.”
All explanations were soon over.
Jaehyun took a deep breath, recalling what he had just heard.
The mana that slowly fills up in the lungs.
‘The ceremony in the auditorium is working.’
Geeing…….
A jet-black abyss with its mouth wide open appeared from the floor.
It was almost the same shape as the one I saw during the freshman hunt in the past.
If there’s something different about it.
‘The expression is divided. It seems like this formula was created to transmit one group at a time.’
“Okay then.”
A small smile spread across Jaehyun’s lips.
“This time, even you won’t be able to get out. Guin.”
* * *
Milles Academy Director’s Office.
Gu Ja-in, who is sitting on a chair, is skimming through the articles on the portal site with a stiff expression.
Every article that appeared in the headlines was just against the plant.
[Milles Academy in crisis… Do you want to return Korea’s most prestigious title?]
[Gu Ja-in drives innocent cadets to their deaths. The resignation protest continues.]
[Radar management headquarters. Milles Academy, which does not guarantee the safety of the cadets, is wrong.]
[The center of the accident. trouble maker. Who is Goo Ja-in, chairman of Miles?]
“Damn it…! Dog-like litters! How much money did I feed you to write an article like this?!”
bang!
Gu Jain slammed the desk and clenched his fists. It couldn’t have been more exasperating for him.
They shot billions of dollars into the accounts of reporters and asked them to block this guild experience article.
But hit the back like this?
Gu Jain gritted his teeth and slowly vomited it out.
“All the media is turning their back on me. dare me from Gu Jain.”
Gu Jain’s eyes cooled.
he already knew
Who intervened in this incident and roasted the reporters?
“Yeonhwa Guild… Yooseong, that damn bastard intervened in the incident.”
The cause is certain.
To keep Gu Ja-in’s forces in check and to grow Yeon-hwa’s pie.
But it’s also true that I don’t understand right away.
Wasn’t this guild experience prepared with great care?
In order to make up for the mistakes made in the mock dungeon, all preparations were strictly kept secret.
No matter how good your nose was, it would have been impossible to dig into this case.
“Huh……”
Gu Jain let out a rough breath and raised his head.
“Yooseong… what the hell is the reason? Why are you suddenly interfering with me?”
Of course, while pretending to be with the Yeonhwa Guild until now, he has earned the resentment of many people.
However, as much as he made many enemies, he also recruited many allies and prepared for this situation.
After thinking for a while, Gu Jain came to a conclusion.
“There is a traitor within. Some of the instructors are negotiating with the enemy.”
Otherwise, it would have made no sense that this incident had leaked out.
“I can’t help it. For the time being, I have no choice but to save myself. At least until this midterm… no, until the start of the second semester, you’d better be careful.”
Of course, he would have to take some damage, but it was better than having his position threatened.
After a while, the incident will subside.
After all, he is the founder of Milles Academy and is supported by the entire nation.
There is nothing to break down here.
‘Soon the midterm exam will begin. When the live broadcast starts, all the attention will be on it. I just need to hold out for a little bit.’
The timing wasn’t bad.
By the time the midterm exams were over, the guild experience would have faded.
No matter how much Yeonhwa guild was, it was not strong enough to bring him down right away.
“For a while, I act like I am dead. When the press calms down, we can go back to our original plan.”
Gu Jain forcibly regained his calm expression and muttered that.

Episode 112 Practical Test (3)
Pajijijik… Kung!
―You have been transferred to subspace.
―Team D: Min Jae-hyeon (leader) Kim Yoo-jung Kim Jin-ah Park Seong-woo ―This is a party of four people.
―After clearing all stages of the dungeon, return with the boss monster’s core.
―First floor quest: Defeat all the monsters on the first floor and find the stairs to the second floor.
The transmission ceremony vomited four people, including Jaehyun, into a space engulfed in flames.
There is a tingling sensation on the skin from the heat.
Jaehyun sighed and looked around.
The place the party arrived at was a large field dungeon.
The surroundings are all reddish, and magma flows meanderingly everywhere.
It was a place very familiar to Jaehyun.
‘Muspelheim. The world of fire giants.’
“This is…”
Kim Yoo-jung looked around and blurted out her words.
Jaehyun immediately replied.
“Muspelheim. I think this is a dungeon modeled after that place.”
“huh. I think so too. There would be no way there would be pillars of fire spread all over the place except in Muspelheim.”
Park Seong-wu agrees with Jae-hyun’s words and nods his head.
Jaehyun looked around at the group and spoke calmly.
“Let’s start with dungeon mapping.”
The first thing you need to do after entering the dungeon is this mapping.
What terrain and items are available for use inside.
Also, what monsters appear and how strong they are.
To deal with unexpected situations by grasping miscellaneous information like this in advance.
This is called mapping.
‘If you don’t go through this process, it’s difficult to quickly respond to unexpected situations. So even if you’re a skilled radar, you tend to skip mapping.’
After giving the order, Jaehyun began to investigate the area more closely.
“You have to be careful. This is different from a normal dungeon.”
When Jaehyun spoke calmly, the party also nodded and agreed.
The dungeon unfolding in this subspace is completely different from other general dungeons.
It’s because it’s a stage format.
This is a different category from the dungeons in the form of crypts that are generally thought of.
To clear a stage dungeon, you must clear the conditions required for each floor, reach the highest level of the dungeon, and defeat the boss.
In simple terms, it can be seen as similar to the format of the game.
Clear a stage, move on to the next stage, and head towards the end.
The structure of the dungeon itself is surprisingly simple.
―Use the active skill 《Magic Power Detection》.
It spreads its senses widely and begins to read the surrounding landmarks.
We need to gather as much information as possible now.
After a while, a monster appears. Before that, there were items to be secured.
“Let’s go get some seoricho first. Prolonged exposure to this heat is dangerous.”
“That’s right. When you’re in a burn state, you’re sluggish and your movements slow by 20 percent.”
Kim Yoo-jung agreed. The remaining two seemed to have no disagreements.
Jaehyun started to move based on the information he investigated using magic detection.
A barren barren land. I walked past flowing magma and streams of fire.
Let’s get a little deeper. Herbs blooming like snow on the hot ground caught my eye.
‘There it is. Seoricho.’
Jaehyun smiled.
Seoricho was one of the key items in the Muspelheim Dungeon.
An item that can be made into a potion to help resist burn conditions when taken.
Among the current team members, Park Seong-woo had the best grades in the last alchemy evaluation, so José thought of entrusting it to him.
“First, collect as many as possible and put them in your inventory. Find out where to prepare the potion.”
Outside objects are not allowed in this midterm exam. There are no restrictions on the use of priestly items in other closed trials, but this is different.
There are several reasons, but there is only one big reason.
that’s right.
-After a while. Viewers are about to enter the room.
―Please pay special attention to your words and actions.
This is because soon viewers will come in and the ‘channel’ will be activated.
After a while, Jaehyun and his party should become broadcasters who satisfy them.
They become BJs who have to show off their strategy to the viewers.
‘Now the real practical skills test begins. Of course it’s disgusting, but… it’s worth using.’
Needless to say, most aspiring raiders, including Jaehyun, hated these events.
To hold a modest event using raiders who risk their lives to hunt monsters.
It was a difficult thing to accept easily for the cadets, who were at an age when their heads would be hot.
The same goes for reproduction.
However.
‘I have to use it now.’
In order to set the stage for the downfall of Gujain, a scene like this is needed.
Jaehyun had already planned everything. The only thing left now is to move forward as fast as you want.
‘But before that.’
Jaehyun raised his head and said calmly.
“Four approaching. The monster rank is C. The formation goes to B.”
“huh!”
“okay.”
“okay.”
Received Jae-hyeon’s instructions, the three men took a combat stance.
A monster was approaching.
Jaehyun smiled.
“Then let’s start slowly.”
* * *
Intermediate Practical Exam Approximately 4 hours have elapsed.
Seo In-na and Ahn Ho-yeon ended up forming the same team.
This is because Seo Eana wanted to team up with someone she was familiar with thanks to her shy nature, and Ahn Ho-yeon also wanted a talented cadet to prepare for any variable.
Thanks to that, the two became a team.
Right now, he was raiding a dungeon with another cadet at the bottom.
“…Isn’t the dungeon too easy?”
Seo Ina, who was suddenly ahead, asked.
Ahn Ho-yeon scratched the bridge of his nose and answered.
“Yeah… what is it? The monsters are much weaker than I thought. I think this is much easier than the mock dungeon practice. Um, it’s just a freshman exam, so it’s a bit easy, right?”
“…huh. I think so.”
There are monsters covered with hot slime all around.
These were the flame attribute monsters they hunted a while ago.
Thanks to the performance of the two, the monster was not much of a threat.
In the first place, they went through a mock dungeon guild experience and became strong enough to be unmatched by other cadets.
The Witchbeast of Stage 1 was not a big threat to them yet.
Of course, it’s a completely different world for the other two people who follow.
‘What the hell are you talking about?’
It was an incomprehensible conversation.
Didn’t they almost get out of the attack of the monster that poured out a while ago?
Every moment of battle, he was keenly aware of why his seniors said that the academy’s theory classes were nothing.
But what?
You think it’s too easy?
It was a word that ignited a competitive spirit, but the difference in class was too great.
The two sighed and shook their heads.
Clearing the dungeon itself wouldn’t be difficult thanks to meeting good teammates, but getting entangled with such geniuses made me feel how insignificant my talents were.
While trudging along, the two of them suddenly thought about it almost simultaneously.
‘By the way… those two are like that too. What kind of a monster is Min Jae-hyun?’
* * *
The first monster he encountered was Lava Slime.
A C-class monster that attacks enemies with flames all over its body.
‘Even though it’s grade C, it’s a pretty tricky monster. You have to be careful.’
Jaehyun had already had experience dealing with them before returning, so he knew them well.
Lava slimes basically live in groups of four or five. Their attack power was minimally low, but they were never allowed to be vigilant.
“Don’t get as close as possible and use items to deal with them. It explodes on contact with dust.”
Lava Slime is a dangerous beast to deal with up close.
These are monsters that spread dust, bury it in the opponent’s body, and explode it using the surrounding terrain to attack the enemy.
Basically, it is safer to use the small explosives given in the subspace test.
“huh. okay.”
Kim Jin-ah swallowed and took the shield out of her arms and held it in her hand. It was a basic shield for cadets, not the one used in the mock dungeon the other day.
Park Seong-woo also quickly activated the skill and equipped a shield.
“The spirit of water…….”
Kim Yoo-jung started casting for the attack.
However, I was planning to use water attribute magic here.
Wind attribute magic, which she often uses, has the highest proficiency, but it was not a suitable skill to use here.
All around the party is filled with flames and magma. If wind attribute magic was used here, there was a possibility of flames moving here and there, as well as explosion damage due to dust.
For this reason, Kim Yoo-jung prepared 《Water Shoot》, a class C magic with water attribute.
A skill that allows you to quickly eliminate enemies by shooting a powerful stream of water.
After casting, Kim Yoo-jung tilted her head and shouted.
“Min Jaehyun!”
“yet!”
However, Jaehyun did not allow the attack right away and stood by.
he was waiting
―The channel is opened.
―Viewers entered.
May the voyeurs visit the room.
The corners of Jaehyun’s mouth rose slowly.
Now the curtain on the real test has risen. This is the real beginning.
[Anonymous 1: 11111]
[Anonymous 2: 222222222]
[ Anonymous 3: Don’t play with numbers
;
hit. I came to see Commun earlier.]
When the viewers came in, Jaehyun immediately shouted.
“now!”
with those words.
Quaang!
Kim Yoo-jung’s 《Water Shoot》 hit a single lava slime.
Jaehyun also raised his lips, raising his mana.
My heart was beating constantly.
It was natural.
Here in the field, the skill «Frozen Earth», which he had learned while hunting the king of the Dark Elves, would be most effective.
A thrilling sensation seemed to run through his body.
‘…of course, but I don’t intend to show S-class magic right away.’
From the beginning, Jaehyun had no intention of using «Frozen Earth».
The reason was simple.
‘It’s about raising the level of stimulation little by little. And when the critical point is reached… Bread and pop it.’
But that didn’t mean I wouldn’t draw attention in the first place.
There was no worry as there was a new skill prepared for the present.
‘The better you use the audience, the faster you can ruin the old person.’
Jaehyun clenched his fists.
I’ve already experienced viewers who were hit with this shit once.
Jaehyun knew their tendencies better than anyone else.
After pouring magic into his fingertips, Jaehyun lifted his head.
―Active skill 《Ice Rain》.
“Ice Rain”.
Wide-area magic that rains hailstones from the sky with an A-class skill.
Of course, among freshmen, who can use such high-level skills?
‘I am the only one.’
Jaehyun immediately exploded his condensed mana.
The sky turned black for a while.
Patter!
Soon, huge hailstones started pouring down on Lava Slime.
at the same time.

The chat window was set on fire due to Kim Yoo-jung and Jae-hyun’s successive magic.
Everything was as Jaehyun expected.
After a while. The corners of Jaehyun’s mouth draw a soft arc.
‘I don’t think everyone believes it yet…but it’s just a matter of time.’

chapters.content:

The 2nd Practical Test Begins. after about six hours.

Song Ji-seok.

He is smiling as if he is full of energy as he watches the video that is now playing.

But no matter how you look at it, there was a corner that I couldn’t get tired of.
Comments were the same.

Is that also freely?
This was a level that other pro raiders couldn’t easily enter.
A vibrant community.
Song Ji-seok murmured as he put his hand in the outer pocket of the coat he was wearing.
“Min Jae-hyeon… He doesn’t break a drop of sweat even after using A-class magic. According to agent Kim Ji-yeon a while ago, she doesn’t seem to have a good relationship with Gu Ja-in… I also have to bring her to this side somehow.”
Jae-hyun was a person who could be a major player in uncovering Gu Ja-in’s corruption.
Although he is still a cadet, he has skills that exceed that of a cadet.
I didn’t know if I could bring out the fall of Gu Jain faster if I just got my hands on these talents.
Moreover, the situation is very good right now.
It is not clear why, but the Yeonhwa Guild is also actively checking Gu Ja-in.
The guild experience was prepared quietly enough that even the radar management headquarters did not notice.
Smelling this incident meant that Yooseong was also preparing to destroy Gu Ja-in.
If you use this well, it would not be unreasonable to work with Yeon-hwa to uncover Goo Ja-in’s evil deeds.
“Now is the real start.”
Song Ji-seok smiled, showing his white teeth.
He took his smartphone out of his suit coat and put it to his ear.
After a while.
[Hello?]
Soon after, a familiar voice came from the smartphone.
Kyung Hoon Park.
As Song Ji-seok’s direct junior, he was the first to recognize Jae-hyun’s ability in the past and said that he might be able to clear the dungeon in Neverland.

[Senior finished the phone call. Is there anything?]
“I have a favor to ask of you.”

[yes? All of a sudden… besides, that’s a violation of human rights, isn’t it? A person who is the team leader of the radar management headquarters who cares for the people can do such a thing…….]
“It’s an opportunity to destroy Gu Ja-in.”
At Song Ji-seok’s words, Park Kyung-hun over the phone was silent for a moment.
Guin. To both of them he was an object of terrible hatred.
In the past, Song Ji-seok and Park Kyung-hun each had the experience of losing their own family members to Goo Ja-in.
Song Ji-seok is his only son.
Park Kyung-hoon has a younger sister who is four years younger than him.
The two of them had reasons to hate Gu Ja-in.
That’s why I react sensitively to that name.
After a while.
Park Kyung-hoon said in a slightly subdued voice.
[…I’ll try to do something. But what if there is no belly?]
“There is no way there is.”
Song Ji-seok crossed his arms and said with a confident expression.
The reason he was so sure was clear.
The previous Neverland incident.
In that case, Song Ji-seok thought that Min Jae-hyeon’s identity would be widely known nationwide.
Characteristic from place of origin. from likes to dislikes. When did you wake up and how do you train, etc.
Every little bit of information.
However, after the incident, Jaehyun’s name was only mentioned a few times on TV, and few articles were published compared to the weight of the work he had done.
And that is.
‘It means that the back boat that looked after Min Jae-hyun blocked all the articles. And that on purpose.’
But not all doubts were gone.
why?
Why did Jaehyun hide his identity by covering reporters’ mouths?
Who else will look after Jaehyun?
Song Ji-seok has been thinking about him for over a month.
And I was certain of one thing.
‘Min Jae-hyun is hiding his power.’
At the same time he thought
Along with the guild experience incident, the Yeonhwa Guild exploded an article as if it had been waiting for it. The meaning of this action is unclear.’

“Then let’s move in earnest.”
after the battle is over. Jaehyun looked around at the group and said.

It was because he had to pack all the necessary items before moving on to the second floor.
‘The dungeon’s difficulty increases as you go down. Farming time will run out.’
It is very difficult to catch high-ranking monsters in the depths of the dungeon and combine it with farming.
From the 2nd floor, a higher grade monster will appear. The people I’m dealing with now are only C-class monsters, but after that, I have to deal with up to B-class monsters.
Of course, since it’s a midterm exam, even if it’s the same level as the actual monster, it’s right to look down at least two or three ranks. Even this was bound to be a huge burden for freshmen.
It was good to pack all the necessary survival items on the 1st floor as much as possible.
After a while.
Jaehyun and the party succeeded in killing all the lava slimes.
In the first place, there was no great difficulty because it was a low-grade beast that only had to be careful of dust.
Kim Jin-ah and Park Sung-woo also got used to dealing with enemies using bombs.
Of course, this method had its limitations as the effectiveness of bombs in the depths decreased sharply, but it was certain that the dungeon raid would go smoothly.
“Huh… I think I’ve taken care of the items at this level. It would be better to start making potions soon.”
When Jaehyun said, Sungwoo Park pointed his finger across the street and said.
“I think the heat will be a little less over there. There is less energy coming up from the ground.”
“Um… I guess so.”
Jinah Kim agreed.
Jaehyun also decided that the location selection was not bad.
‘Because in order to make a burn resistance potion with frost weed, I have to get away from the heat to some extent.’
Jaehyun took out a basic set for tent installation from his inventory.
It was one of the items Park Ha-joon handed out before entering the dungeon for the first time.
Incidentally, a tent is a device that acts like a shelter, and if you enter it, the broadcast will be cut off for a while.
In the meantime, they regroup and go into battle again.
For reference, the period leading up to this second practical test is 3 days.
The earlier you clear the dungeon, the earlier the time will go, but in general, it’s usually completed in 3 days.
This is because there are items that can only be obtained here, and the more carefully you clear the dungeon, the more points you get.
“Then we’ll pitch a tent.”
Park Seong-woo and Kim Jin-ah set up a tent.
Jaehyun plays the role of guarding the surroundings. Kim Yoo-jung took on the role of cooling the surrounding temperature with water attribute magic until the potion was completed.
all important things. The distribution is done properly.
Thanks to that, the chat window was also filled with admiring comments.

[Anonymous 22: To be honest, when I went to Miles, I did that much, too?]

[Anonymous 6: ㄴㅇㅋ]
“Now, it’s done. Now let’s go inside.”
At Kim Jin-ah’s words, Jae-hyun and Kim Yoo-jung pushed their bodies inside the tent.
“It is quite cozy.”
After Kim Yoo-jung said that, she sat cross-legged in the middle.
Park Seong-woo took out alchemy tools such as pots and ladle burners and laid them on the floor.
“I think it will take about an hour to make the potion.”
“are you okay. That’s enough.”
Jaehyun nodded.
An hour is enough.
Anyway, there are things I need to do before entering the second floor.
Well, in the first place, Sungwoo Park’s preparation speed is not that slow.
“Ha… but it’s really hot here. I think I’m going crazy.”
Kim Yoo-jung sighed and said. Jaehyun also agreed.
“I know. After all, this is a dungeon modeled after Muspelheim.”
It’s not that it wasn’t, the inside of the dungeon was too hot.
It would be slightly better if I used the water attribute and ice attribute magic like before, but I couldn’t abuse even that.
In a situation where you don’t know when a monster will pop out, it’s poison to waste mana recklessly. Patience is also one of Radar’s main virtues.
“I will try to do it as soon as possible. Be patient.”
At Park Seong-woo’s words, Kim Yoo-jung scratched her head as if she was embarrassed.
“I wasn’t talking about making it fast…”
“Yeah. Kim Yoo-jung is also the best at noticing others.”
“hey! Because it’s not like that!”
Kim Jin-ah, who was next to Jae-hyun and Kim Yoo-jung, smiled lightly.
“You guys are really good.”
“It’s not particularly good.”
At Kim Yoo-jung’s words, Kim Jin-ah tilted her head.
“Are you looking like a best friend? Were you close since childhood?”
“Um… I’ve known you since then.”
Kim Yu-jung had a blunt tone, but she answered quickly.
Jaehyun laughed.
‘As expected, I can’t have a harsh personality.’
At first, she was angry when she heard that the two of them were forming a team, but Kim Yoo-jung knew it well.
There is nothing wrong with Kim Jin-ah and Park Sung-woo.
I just became more sensitive in a situation where I might lose my friend. She, too, fully understood their situation.
No matter how many people choose the job of a raider who kills monsters and closes dungeons, they are mere humans in the face of the fear of death.
Because fear eats away reason and eventually wears out reason.
After thinking for a while, Jaehyun looked back at the three of them and said.
“Guys. I have something to tell you about the operation, so would you like to come together?”
The party followed Jaehyun’s words and gathered in a circle.
Jae-hyun slowly explained his strategy to his colleagues. It was to convey the changes that he was not sure about until he entered sub-space.
After a while.
After hearing about the whole plan, the party looked at Jaehyun with dumbfounded faces.
“…is that really possible?”
Kim Yoo-jung’s bewildered voice echoed inside the tent for a while.
Jaehyun stood up from his seat and smiled.
“of course.”

The outskirts of Milles Academy.
Agent Kim Ji-yeon’s low voice is heard from a rare place.

“however. Is there any possibility that Cadet Min Jae-hyeon is in contact with another faction?”
[That’s the problem.]
Song Ji-seok over the walkie-talkie paused for a while.
[Probably Min Jae-hyun. There must be a connection with the Yeonhwa Guild.]
“A connection with the Yeonhwa Guild?”
Kim Ji-yeon asked with her eyes wide open. Song Ji-seok over the phone answered calmly.
[okay. Now that Kyung-hoon is investigating, something must come out. So, you contact Min Jae-hyeon as soon as possible so that he can bring you to this side. Let’s make the conditions match that side as much as possible.]

‘To meet the conditions as much as possible… The team leader also wants to catch cadet Min Jae-hyeon.’
Kim Ji-yeon lightly bit her lip and thought.
Of course, I always thought it would come like this. Min Jae-hyun is a talented person with outstanding talent, and he is one of the few students who is on the opposite side of Goo Ja-in.
If Radar HQ can catch him here, it will be a big win in the long run.
nevertheless.
It was none other than Gu Jain that made contact difficult until now.
‘Gu Ja-in was also targeting cadet Min Jae-hyeon.’
Looking at the trend of Gu Ja-in so far. It was right to see that he was also targeting Min Jae-hyun.
In the last few events, he showed great interest in Jaehyun and even manipulated the events.
Of course, there was no way to stop it because he found out too late, but Jaehyun overcame even this proudly. If that greedy human didn’t go after it, that would have been odd.
“Then we will contact you again.”
After a while. After Kim Ji-yeon finished the call, she headed to the academy’s control room.
It was to observe the reproduction in detail.
a few minutes later.
When I arrived at the control room, I saw a familiar face.
Instructor Park Ha-joon.
He wasn’t a particularly pleasant person.
‘Gujain seems to be away. … Well, there’s no way I’ll be fine after something like that happened.’
Kim Ji-yeon also heard everything Jaehyun said on the live broadcast a while ago. The way he talked about Gu Ja-in without hesitation made me awestruck.
Anyone who knew Koo Ja-in’s reputation in Korea could not have easily done so.
‘How on earth can a mere cadet speak mean things to Gu Jain?’
However, what was scarier than that was that Jae-hyeon knew about Gu Ja-in’s true identity to some extent.
‘Cadet Min Jae-hyeon is smart. He probably wouldn’t have done anything unmanageable.’
Kim Ji-yeon thought that Jae-hyun wasn’t just making a negative comment about Goo Ja-in.
Min Jae-hyeon knows about Goo Ja-in’s corruption.
In addition, he did this because he was sure that he would not be subjected to injustice such as expulsion.
that was her idea
“Ah, Instructor Kim Ji-yeon. What are you doing here?”
When Kim Ji-yeon came inside, Instructor Park Ha-joon raised her head and greeted her.
She let out a small sigh and replied appropriately.
“Oh what. I want to see the situation of the second performance.”
“Haha, I’m in charge of this side, but I don’t have to stop here. Do you think I was unreliable?”
When Park Ha-joon spoke sarcastically, Kim Ji-yeon looked at her face and smiled.
She answered calmly and with clear pronunciation.
“well. Maybe so.”
Park Ha-joon’s face wrinkled slightly at those words.
‘It’s pitiful.’
Kim Ji-yeon ignored him as if it was no big deal and moved her gaze to the screen.
She knew very well why Park Ha-joon behaved in such an ugly way.
‘Originally, now that Kim Seok-gi has disappeared, I have the authority to lead the second practice of the midterm exam. Park Ha-joon intervened and took the seat.’
Park Ha-joon used his connection with Goo Ja-in to push Kim Ji-yeon out and take his current position.
But this is an incomplete power.
Koo Ja-in has yet to fully acknowledge Park Ha-joon.
in this situation. Park Ha-joon is keeping Kim Ji-yeon, who has more skills than herself, in fear that she will be greedy for her position.
Park Ha-joon put his hands in his pockets and said sarcastically.
“I joined the company as a motivation at first. I’m a little sorry for leaving you like this.”
“I don’t know because I don’t really care.”
“haha. what kind of words Who wouldn’t be greedy for this position? Stop being honest.”
Park Ha-joon said that and glanced at Kim Ji-yeon.
Still, she was staring at the screen without changing her expression.
‘…Huh, no matter how hard you try, do you think you’ll never know that you’re envious of my position?’
Park Ha-joon grinded his teeth.
complex.
Park Ha-jun had a deep inferiority complex toward Kim Ji-yeon.
last two years ago. As her first motivation to join Milles Academy, she was always a few steps ahead of herself.
Park Ha-joon’s status as a radar is very unstable even within Milles.
Because of this, he decided to use his strengths to succeed.
Ability to ride the line.
He may not have enough skills, but he had the ability to line up well.
Thanks to this, Kim Ji-yeon took advantage of the gap outside of Goo Ja-in’s eyes and took the position herself.
‘Stupid bastard. Why do you stand up to the chairman of the board…’
Kim Ji-yeon has a precedent of challenging Koo Ja-in several times in the past.
In the process of planning major events for Miles, he climbed up to Jain Gu, the chairman of the board, saying that he had to ensure the safety of the cadets so that the image of Miles would not be damaged externally.
Park Ha-jun could not understand.
What the hell is he saying to the chairman of Miles, saying this and that?
People sometimes have to cover up even the truth.
It means that if you want to succeed for the sake of success, your mouth must be heavy.
‘Thanks to that, I’m now being favored by Chairman Gu Ja-in.’
Park Ha-jun had no doubt that he was ahead of Kim Ji-yeon.
That’s why I’m trying to overcome my sense of inferiority by grabbing the pod like this.
Of course, Kim Ji-yeon doesn’t see anything pathetic like this.
Kim Ji-yeon opened her mouth without taking her eyes off the screen.
“Instructor Park Ha-joon. I have only one piece of advice.”
“Ha, as much as you like.”
“You’d better check carefully to make sure that the rope you caught… isn’t a rotten rope.”
Jiyeon Kim turned and looked at him.
Soon after, she smiled once and left.
“Enough then.”
Park Ha-joon stood tall and could not say anything.
I felt my face turn bright red.
He clenched his fists nervously.
‘shit. still there! After… No. Chairman Koo Ja-in can’t reduce the rotten club. You will be back to your original place soon. That bastard is just something I envy.’
Park Ha-jun showed this and laughed.
* * *
The second hidden piece.
It is a very special item.
Items that cannot be used properly unless certain conditions are met.
But Jaehyun knew how to deal with it.
“This way.”
Now, Jaehyun’s words were about to go into the fire.
No matter what instructions he gave, he carried them out without question. It was more than I could have imagined.

Viewers’ opinions were very good.
The cool battle and development of Jaehyun. Also, the fact that it is the only channel through which communication is possible seemed to come fresh to them.
To the extent that the majority of reviews say that it is a broadcast that people believe in and watch.
The community was also full of stories about Jaehyun and his teammates every day.
“By the way, what’s the salamander’s weakness?”
“As expected, the badge.”

“Basically, the Salamander has a hard outer shell, so it is difficult to damage it easily.
It’s the only ship with weak hardness, so if you attack it, you can easily catch it. The standard way to catch them is to use ice-attribute magic. If you use something hard and sharp like a fragment of ice, you can quickly peel off the outer skin.”

Kim Yoo-jung cleared her throat as if she was embarrassed by Kim Jin-ah’s praise.
“No matter how big it is, the best thing is to aim for the moment of feeding. The moment when monsters become weakest is when they eat food and their movements become dull due to the feeling of fullness.”

When Jaehyun said it sarcasticly, Kim Yoojung became furious.
“hey! But I haven’t lost to you in theory until now?!”
“There is a difference between being good at studying and saying the right things.”
“Seed!”
“We’re okay with each other… I’m sure all the viewers are listening, right?”
When Jaehyun raised the corner of his mouth and said, Kim Yoojung’s face turned blue.
In fact, in the chat window, there was a line of chatting with ‘ㅋ’ and ‘Kim Yoo-jung, who is the strongest in the world!’
Kim Yoo-jung was silent for a while with her face flushed.
so in silence Jaehyun has arrived at his destination.
A place where huge rocks are stuck everywhere. It was a place where the heat coming up from the ground was several times hotter than in other places.
“for a moment. I can feel magic around here…”
Jaehyun murmured moderately and then headed towards the center where the rocks were lined up.
‘good. I have everything I wanted.’
I smiled and looked around, but suddenly the chat continued.
[Anonymous 22: Oh, do you know what item you will get this time?]
[Anonymous 32: Just by looking at it, “that” yes Yes]
[Anonymous 55: Oh, “that”?]
[Anonymous 11: “That”;; My heart is already becoming magnificent…]
[Anonymous 93: No, what the fuck is that, you fuckers.]
[Anonymous 64: Let’s refrain from hateful expressions;;]
Meaningless chatting continued for a long time. Finally, a viewer who knows what item Jaehyun will get has appeared.
[Anonymous 52: Ah! isn’t that sword? Old things stuck at the end of that rock.]
Jaehyun chuckled.
As the viewer testified, there are countless swords stuck in the nearby rocks.
All of them are old and should be thrown away at the junkyard right now.
But even in this gap there are treasures.
And Jaehyun planned to find the treasure.
“Then shall we find the hidden piece?”
Jaehyun approached the crack in the rock and began examining the sword.
Colleagues tilted their heads and asked.
“hey. But why is this sword suddenly falling behind? Aren’t these the real hidden pieces?”
“So… looking at it, everything here seems to be unconfirmed items. Is there anything I can do to help?”
“Hmm…”
Jaehyun didn’t answer them, just raised the corner of his mouth.
Kim Yoo-jung shook her head as if she was fed up with it.
“I don’t know what it is, but it looks like it has a very dark plan.”
Jaehyun neatly ignored her words and lightly blew magic into his eyes.
―Use the active skill 《Foresight》.
―Check unconfirmed items!

a few months ago. Jae-hyun acquired the sub-skill «Perception» of the passive skill «Eye of the Absolute God» at the Magical Engineering Shopping Mall.

yet.

actually. The item I had now was worth it.

Hearing Jaehyun’s words, Kim Yoojung crossed her arms and asked as if she was worried.
“But is it okay if I take my time? Originally, salamanders have a sensitive sense of smell. If you stay nearby, you may be attacked first.”

‘Kim Yoo-jung is right. Salamanders are basically beasts with a sensitive sense of smell. Even more so with the King Salamander, whose physical abilities have been upgraded further.
I need a countermeasure to deal with him.’
This is an attack broadcast.
Wiping out the enemy with overwhelming force is quite possible in the present reproduction, but it is impossible to move the hearts of viewers in that way.
For a perfect attack, you must analyze and prepare for the enemy’s habits, strengths and weaknesses, and then move thoroughly.

If it is difficult to get rid of body odor.

found an insect that gave off the most terrible level of stench.
bomb dust bug.

but.

After a while.

when it does Beast’s blood is of great help.

…before that, of course.

Whoa……!

In order to prevent the smell from leaking out, a wind barrier was erected to trap the odor inside and then move it slowly.
Meanwhile.

In the meantime.

but it seemed that a critical hit had occurred.

and. Finally, in one section, his eyes stopped once again.

Kim Yoo-jung was focused on her smartphone. Looking closely, I found an article that revealed the truth of Gu Ja-in in detail, and all of them were clicking likes.
Jaehyun couldn’t help but stick out his tongue.
“You are amazing too.”
Kim Yoo-jung didn’t even pretend to hear.
A moment of peace passes by. Soon the car’s speed slowed down.
Yuseong said as he loosened his legs.
“Then now we have to make sure we finish. Press conference three days later. Everything is finished there. In the meantime, practice without leaking even the pronunciation.”
At those words, a small smile spread across Jaehyun’s face.
Press conference.
At a press conference to be held three days later.
Gu Ja-in’s misdeeds and
reappearance will be officially revealed to the world as Yoo Seong-eun’s successor.

chapters.title: Chapter 126
chapters.content:
Episode 126 Spotlight (2)
3 days later. Yeonhwa Guild official press conference.
Even in a conference room with a large number of people, there is one person who definitely catches everyone’s attention.
Jaehyun Min.
He was a genius cadet who made a great contribution to uncovering the evil deeds of Gu Ja-in the past three days.
“I should have known from the first time I scored in the freshman hunt! Damn, I thought he was a friend who negotiated with the Yeonhwa Guild first!”
“That’s right. It was a great opportunity for VBS to get the scoop first.”
“After investigating, it turns out that it was also Min Jae-hyeon who solved the Neverland incident. I thought it would go quietly, but it seems Yeon-hwa covered it up.”
“Anyway, it was a waste. If I had been able to find out about Min Jae-hyun’s identity a little faster, I would have gotten a huge scoop.”
“Eh. That’s what I mean. Anyway, Yeonhwa takes good care of her family. How could it not be a single article?”
Each of the reporters was talking about Jaehyun.
There was also talk of Yoo Sung-eun and Yeon-hwa, but the main character of this press conference was Jae-hyun.
In a way, it was only natural that all the spotlight was focused on Jaehyun.
“why? Are you nervous now?”
The waiting room behind the press conference room.
Yoo Seong-eun, sitting across the table, asked Jae-hyun.
Jaehyun shrugged.
“are you okay. It’s just that I don’t like a lot of people that much.”
“For something like that, you did a splendid job. Now that this has happened, I need to fix it properly. is not it?”
“Do not worry. I will do my best without shaking.”
Jaehyun looked at his watch for a moment after replying appropriately.
There were less than five minutes left before the press conference began.
‘after. Let’s stay calm. It’s all over now. Jain Koo has stepped down as chairman, and Miles has been tentatively placed in my hands.’
Jaehyun calmly reflected on the events of the past three days.
On the first day of the break, Jae-hyun and Yoo Sung-eun visited the radar management headquarters.
There he met two familiar people.
Song Ji-seok and Park Kyung-hun.
They were people I had seen a couple of times before.
The two said they wanted to meet Jaehyun and would make a special offer.
[What was the reason you said you wanted to see Jae-hyun?]
At the time of our first meeting, Yoo Seong-eun asked with a disapproving face.
Naturally, she did not allow Jaehyun to have a one-on-one conversation with the head office.
It was because he was worried that they would suggest that Jaehyun join the headquarters.
The radar management headquarters is a low salary, but it is easy to enter the political world after that.
For Yooseong, it was bound to be an awkward encounter.
So when Song Ji-seok first suggested that he meet Jae-hyun. Yoo Sung-eun allowed this on the condition that he also sit together.
The Radar Management Headquarters also readily accepted this.
However, the radar management headquarters has made an unexpected proposal that is completely different from what they thought.
However, contrary to Yoo Sung-eun’s expectations, the head office has made an unexpected proposal.
[I would like to put Min Jae-hyeon in the position of honorary radar management headquarters.]
Song Ji-seok’s proposal was shocking.
Jaehyun and Yoo Seongeun faced each other and couldn’t help but blink.
What is the position of Honorary Radar Management Headquarters?
Although it is not directly affiliated with the country like members of other headquarters, it can receive all the benefits of the radar management headquarters. You can receive the same treatment as the headquarters staff just by working twice a year.
Simply put, it was a position close to the accumulated (?).
Also, this is of course another guild.
Or, it was irrelevant even if it was combined with another job.
From the subject of enjoying the benefits of civil servants to the point of being free to hold concurrent positions.
In many ways, it was a proposition with far more benefits than losses.
Song Ji-seok also added:
[The two-time limit on activities per year is only indicated in the document, and we have made it possible to replace it with simple volunteer activities, so please make a good decision.] Song Ji-seok earnestly asked, and Jae-hyun eventually accepted
.
[great. I will do that.]
Yoosung readily accepted the offer as it was a contract with nothing to lose.
Yeonhwa and Radar Management Headquarters. A contract in which both sides benefit.
However, it was reproduction that benefited the most.
‘Yeonhwa and Radar Management Headquarters. I was able to sleep on both sides at will. Both forces are in a situation where they can’t ignore me anymore.’
Both forces approached to take advantage of themselves.
If so, you will use them too.
That was the way of representation.
We had been talking for so long.
Finally, the real story came out.
Yoo Seong-eun asked first.
[Who are you planning to appoint as the new president of Milles Academy?]
Song Ji-seok said, raising his lips as if he had already predicted everything.
[Don’t worry. That part was also thought out in advance. Tell them to come in.]
With those words, the door of the office where we were talking opened.
Seeing the face of the person entering, Jaehyun was shocked.
‘I can’t believe that person will be the new chairman. It’s still temporary, but…’
“It’s about time. let’s go.”
While reminiscing, I suddenly heard Yoo Seong-eun’s voice.
Jaehyun shook off his short thoughts and faced reality again.
‘okay. You don’t have to think about the next problem now. Right now, it is more important than anything else to finish the press conference right in front of me.’
The first event to announce one’s appearance to the public.
As always, Jaehyun was going to get through this time as well.
* * *
chump chump chump!
As we entered the press conference, hundreds of cameras fired their flashes all at once.
All reporters who received permission from the Yeonhwa Guild and officially entered here.
They were the ones who made a significant contribution to bringing down Gu Ja-in this time.
There were four seats in all.
Yuseong, Song Ji-seok, Park Seong-jae, and the most senior seat were the seats of Jae-hyun.
Jaehyun sat down in the seat with his name written in the middle and looked ahead.
When many people paid attention to him, he was a bit upset, but it was okay.
‘It’s not like I committed a crime.’
After lightly brushing it off, he kept his expressionless while watching the reporters.
It seemed that a full-fledged press conference was about to begin. Yoo Seong-eun took the microphone first.
“hello. We sincerely welcome all of you who came to the official press conference of Yeonhwa Guild and Radar Management Headquarters. I am Yoo Seong-eun, the representative of Yeonhwa.”
Ceremonial applause was heard along with the voices.
Song Ji-seok and Park Seong-jae also greeted lightly.
“This is Song Ji-seok, who is in charge of Team 1 of the Radar Management Headquarters. Nice to meet you.”
“I’m Yeonhwa’s manager Park Seongjae.”
Everyone was not nervous at all, as if they were used to press conferences.
Jaehyun also bowed lightly.
“This is Min Jaehyun.”
The moment Jaehyun said hello, the flash came out again.
It was the moment when the purpose of the reporters gathered here was revealed.
‘It’s an opportunity to write an article about the Yeonhwa Guild’s preferred negotiator! I can’t miss it!’
‘A cadet with A-class and S-class skills… A sensational article in the world!’
‘There is also a story that CEO Yoo Seong-eun taught Min Jae-hyun himself. If only this could be confirmed…’
The reporters were aiming for a reenactment.
A crazy talent that has not yet been revealed to the world, and a sense of justice that throws oneself without hesitation to save a teammate at the time of practical training.
This will serve as an example for others.
Maybe if you write an article, the number of views won’t be a joke.
“Then I will take the question from now on. If you have any questions, please raise your hand and follow the instructions of Manager Park Seong-jae.”
Yoo Sung-eun calmly controlled the reporters.
‘As expected, the representative of Yeonhwa is not just anyone.’
Jaehyun smiled lightly at that.
She has been close with Yoo Seong-eun lately, but she is Yeon-hwa’s guild master.
She was the one who had done countless worse things.
It’s about a press conference like this.
Jaehyun thought about it, but suddenly a reporter in front of him got the right to speak and asked a question.
“Is it true that the former chairman, Gu Jain, intentionally killed the cadets and disguised it as an accident?”
“yes. you’re right.”
Yoo Seong-eun answered briefly and then calmly continued.
“Guardian. He is clearly evil, and I have all the evidence of his criminal activities.”
Hearing this, Jaehyun laughed.
‘Of course, I went through a bit of trouble stealing it.’
In fact, all of Yeon-hwa’s corruption data about Goo Ja-in was dug up by Jae-hyun.
From the time I took the understanding of magic arithmetic class to now. Jae-hyun used Instructor Jeong Yi-soo, who succeeded in brainwashing, to secure a lot of corruption data.
Although it was not possible to steal all the information due to the low access rights, it was the result of using Seo Ah-hyun’s brain.
Circumstances of Koo Ja-in’s corruption, bribery-related data, double ledgers, etc.
They succeeded in stealing all kinds of dangerous data.
‘As a Gu-Jin, he would not have thought that his data would be lost.’
No wonder. Gu Ja-in only gives work to the henchmen he trusts.
In addition, in order for them to read the secret data inside Miles, they need the magic recognition of those they have given permission along with the password.
If you do not go through this, you will never be able to read the corruption data of Gu Ja-in.
but. Jae-hyun used Seo Ah-hyun to find out the academy’s password and was able to enter the secret data reading room through Instructor Jeong Yi-soo’s magic recognition.
Once in the reading room, it was not difficult to take out the materials.
Afterwards, Jaehyun handed over all information related to Goo Jain to Yeonhwa Guild.
I thought they would take care of the rest.
The result was also a success.
Yoo Seong-eun continued.
“By the way, this is not the first time Gu Jain has committed an evil deed. He has killed dozens of cadets and faked accidents.
An astronomical amount of support is delivered to the Milles Academy every year. In addition to that, it is estimated that there must have been some other reasons. This is still under investigation.”
The reporters quickly took notes on the related content through tablet PCs and notebooks they brought.
Their faces were itching to write an article.
about an hour after that. The press conference continued.
As the questions and answers continued, the reality of Gu Ja-in began to be revealed in detail.
How he committed and covered up the accident and what kind of connections he had with high-ranking officials.
In addition, it is all about the 17 items that the Radar Management Headquarters applied while detaining Goo Ja-in.
Reporters were quick to play their hands whenever new facts came to light.
Perhaps by tomorrow, articles about Gu Jain and Miles will be pouring in non-stop.
Right then. A reporter asked a sharp question.
“Did the radar management headquarters not grasp this situation in advance?”
A painful reporter’s question. However, Song Ji-seok answered calmly.
“I have no face. It is our fault. Yeonhwa and Yooseong, as well as guild masters Min Jaehyun, who sat in the middle, had a great influence in uncovering the corruption of former chairman Koo Jain.”
Song Ji-seok was talking down to himself and the Radar Management Headquarters, giving Yeon-hwa and Jae-hyun a boost.
Jaehyun smiled.
‘okay. Is that how it came out?’
He understood Song Ji-seok’s intentions at once.
