‘Currently, the power of the Radar Management Headquarters has become very weak. Song Ji-seok and Park Kyung-hun will soon be promoted for their achievements, but they won’t be able to wield the same power as before.’
It was natural.
Most of the top officials in the headquarters who really had power were those who ate Gu Ja-in’s bribes. However, they were all arrested along with Gu Jain.
It is true that recognition has increased by catching Jain Koo, but it is also a self-evident fact that the base of support is shaking.
In this situation, in order for the radar management headquarters to regain its power.
It was best to bury it with a strong and clean person.
Song Ji-seok planned to take control of the radar management headquarters.
To this end, he has made Yeon-hwa and herself an offer they cannot refuse.
‘There is nothing wrong with us. I just use it if I can eat it.’
As Jaehyun, it wasn’t a bad thing.
After Song Ji-seok lowered his head once, he continued.
“Representatives of Yeonhwa Guild and Yoo Sung-eun, who helped us achieve this despite our shortcomings. Also, I would like to take this opportunity to express my sincere gratitude to Min Jae-hyun.”
In response to Song Ji-seok’s answer, the reporter sat down without asking further questions.
It meant that the answer was sufficient.
After a while. The reporter to ask the next question rose from his seat.
Having been pointed out by Park Seong-jae, he looked at Jae-hyun for a while and opened his mouth.
Jaehyun straightened up and sat down.
It was because he felt that his turn had finally come.
As expected, the reporter asked Jaehyun.
“Is it true that Jaehyun Min is the guild master of Yeonhwa Guild.
Something to come has come.
Jaehyun raised his eyebrows at that thought.
After he grabbed the mic, he took a deep breath.

chapters.title: Chapter 127
chapters.content:
Episode 127 Spotlight (3)
“Min Jae-hyeon is the guild master of Yeonhwa Guild. Is it true that Yooseong is the direct disciple of CEO?”
“All are true.”
At Jaehyun’s declaration, the buzz of reporters quickly filled the conference hall.
It was natural.
The apprentice of Yoo Sung-eun, who is an S-class radar, has been revealed.
This was a scoop as big as the corruption of former chairman Koo Ja-in.
Jaehyun has been consistently active not only in the second practical training, but also in hunting freshmen and theme dungeons.
For reporters who make a living off of views, the appearance of such a rookie was very welcome.
‘If I can write a single article about Min Jae-hyun, I will be promoted soon!’
Everyone was thinking the same thing.
Jaehyun was calm.
“Thanks to CEO Yuseong, I was able to improve my lack of skills and come to where I am now.”
Reporters also nodded as if moved by Jaehyun’s humble words.
The Jaehyun they saw was the current best rookie with both skills and humility.
Reporters seemed impatient to write an article about Jaehyun.
at that time. The reporter who asked the first question asked again.
“Min Jaehyun. So far, each newspaper has looked at numerous articles related to the awakened rookie, but no article about Min Jae-hyun could be found. Did you hide the skills you saw from the start?”
“I didn’t want to be noticed by a lot of people.”
Jaehyun gave a short answer.
After that, the questions continued to pour in.
Other reporters also joined in this time.
“When specifically did you sign a contract with Yeonhwa Guild?!”
“It’s only been a few months. I guess I was lucky.”
“Is it true that it was Jae-Hyun who attacked the dungeon at the time of the Neverland-themed dungeon incident?”
“you’re right. I happened to be nearby and got caught up in the incident.”
“When did you learn about Gu Ja-in’s evil deeds? Were all the things you said during the live broadcast during the second performance based on facts?”
“yes. I was aware of the evil deeds of the former chairman, Gu Ja-in, from the first time I entered school.
During the freshman hunt, I fell into Gu Jain’s trap and almost died once. But not a single line of news about an accident like this came out.”
Jaehyun calmly responded and looked ahead.
The reporters’ questions soon led to trivial matters.
Even family relationships and whether or not you have a girlfriend.
However, Jaehyun did not change the color of his face and maintained his calmness.
‘It would be difficult if I showed myself being swung around here.’
due to the nature of the job. From now on, Jaehyun has to meet reporters constantly. If you give the impression of being swung here once, you will have a lot of trouble afterwards.
Responding calmly is the most important thing now.
like that. After being asked for a while.
Yoo Seong stopped the reporters’ offensive.
“Please refrain from asking too many questions to Jaehyun, who is still in shock after going through a major event.”
With those words, the barrage of questions visibly subsided.
Except for Seongjae Park, the three accepted a few more questions.
about an hour later.
So the press conference ended.
* * *
“Damn it! Are those bastards feeding me like this?! I think I will end up here!”
Gu Jain, whose hands were bound, spoke in a voice mixed with annoyance.
he thought
How the hell did things get so twisted?
even just a few months ago.
I never expected that I would end up like this.
Guin.
The downfall of one of Korea’s greatest powers was something that even he himself could not accept.
from the highest to the lowest.
It was only a few months.
Jaehyun Min. This happened just a few months after he entered Miles.
something that is not easily accepted.
Park Ha-joon, who was by his side, also seemed to have almost lost trust in himself.
Even at first, I tried to convince myself that there was still hope… but
I almost gave up on the second day.
Gu Jain felt stomach acid bubbling inside.
On TV, he portrayed himself as a villain every day, and on the contrary, Sung-Eun Yoo and Jae-Hyun Min were admired as heroes.
It was completely incomprehensible to him.
“How much did I do for you…!”
Gu Ja-in was sincerely sorry.
He said he was innocent when he appeared in front of reporters.
It was sincere.
Jain Koo has been the chairman of the board of directors and has trained numerous AS-class radars.
How many lives were saved because of this?
Could someone else have done it if they had been in the same position as you?
no.
Never.
They are shaken by false hypocrisy.
More people would have died had he not sat on the board of directors at Miles.
Of course, there are people who sacrificed themselves, but they are a minority. It’s just a sacrifice for the sake of the great.
Not everyone can live.
Everyone knows it, even if you don’t show it.
That it was absurd that no victims came from the attack of the Witchbeast.
Gu Jain thought.
If not everyone can live anyway and someone has to die.
Shouldn’t we choose who to die for ourselves? Also
, isn’t it a hundred times better for the useless weak to die
for society ?
Gu Jain could not understand. They are just hypocrites.
‘Disgusting bastards.’
Gu Jain could never give up here.
But now I couldn’t do anything.
At least until I get in touch with ‘them’ for a few months.
He would have to stay locked up here.
* * *
Again a few days after that.
Central Auditorium of Milles Academy.
The entire party gathered to hear the speech of the newly inaugurated interim chairman.
The auditorium was generally quiet, but only one area was noisy.
It was also where Kim Yoo-jung was.
“hey! How could you hide such an important fact?! Yoosung is your sister’s disciple? you?”
Kim Yoo-jung raised her voice and grabbed Jae-hyun by the collar.
Jaehyun hurriedly grabbed her wrist.
“Yeah, because I know. Let’s talk about this! Inaya Hoyeona, try to stop him!”
“…This time, Jaehyun thinks you were bad.”
“I am neutral.”
Seo In-na and Ahn Ho-yeon also turned their backs.
Well, from their point of view, it would be disappointing that Jaehyun hid this incident.
Nothing else but direct follower of Yeonhwa’s representative, Yoo Sung-eun…….
Well, it’s Kim Yoo-jung.
After arguing with Kim Yoo-jung for a long time.
Jaehyun barely catches his breath.
“I’m just saying this just in case… it’s not over. know?”
“……huh. Gujain can’t collapse that easily.”
Seo Ina nodded. So did the others.
“In the meantime, you just need to get stronger as quickly as possible. The Yeonhwa Guild and the Radar Management Headquarters also agreed to help you.”
“It’s best if we don’t intervene directly…but that’s true.”
At Kim Yu-jung’s words, Jae-hyun nodded as if he couldn’t do anything about it.
Ahn Ho-yeon also burned with enthusiasm.
“I will become stronger too. I definitely knew it from my guild experience. That I am weak.”
“……So do i.”
Jaehyun nodded his head proudly at the conversation between the three.
spirit of improvement. This will lead colleagues to higher places in the future.
‘Of course, I have no intention of bringing children into the case in the future.’
Apart from that, Jaehyun definitely realized.
It doesn’t matter how strong they are.
You should not let your party get involved in your own business.
For a decisive battle with the Aesir god, stronger power is needed.
It had nothing to do with them, and it was too early to entrust their backs to them.
‘It’s not that I’m ignoring the kids, but it’s something I have to do against the Æsir god. I can never drag you in.’
Jaehyun thought about it, but suddenly the lights in the auditorium turned on and a person appeared.
It was a familiar face to Jaehyun, no, to all the magic students here.
“what? Why is the instructor over there?”
Jaehyun laughed lightly at Kim Yoojung’s bewildered voice.
“It’s that person.”
“……What are you talking about?”
Seo In-na also asked again, and Jae-hyun answered again.
“Instructor Kim Ji-yeon. That person is the new chairman.”
At those words, everyone in the party was stunned.
What do you mean by that?
A new instructor who is only in his late 20s is the new chairman?
In the midst of the confusion, only Ahn Ho-yeon tilted his head.
“so. Who is that instructor?”
* * *
Above the abandoned buildings in Daegu.
This is an unrepaired area that was abandoned after a demonic outbreak.
without a single person. This is where it would normally have been.
However, a being in the form of a human is standing here right now.
A being with a huge horn on its back that possesses transcendent magical power.
Heimdall.
A male god famous for being wise and beautiful, also called the white god.
“Don’t hide, make an appearance.”
Heimdall pulled out the sword from his waist and said to the empty lot.
“How dare you follow Heimdall?”
“It’s not a pity. What kind of rude words. I’m only here to say hello.”
at that time. A voice was heard and Hela, who had been hiding behind cover, appeared.
Heimdall snorted.
“You half-Aesir gods did something very interesting this time.”
“Only Odin and the Æsir will do it.”
“Hung, if you put it in the water, your mouth will just melt. Hell. Does she still have hope? The opponent of the prophecy will appear and liberate you like a hero?”
“That’s something you never know.”
At Hela’s words, Heimdall burst into laughter as if he was dumbfounded.
“haha! Hey do you really think that’s possible? You believe that mere humans can destroy all the Aesir thrones and open a new world? It’s so funny that it makes no sense.”
“Wouldn’t that be better than believing in nothing?”
Heimdall shook his head and tried to walk past Hella.
However, Hella passed him and blocked his way.
The hand holding Heimdall’s sword extended forward.
It soon took the form that the sword was aimed precisely at Hella’s neck.
Heimdall warned in a subdued voice.
“Get out of the way. I will go to meet the opponent of the prophecy.”
“I cannot send you.”
Hela shook her head resolutely. However, Heimdall did not back down.
“Do you want to die at my hands?”
“You won’t be able to use your power properly in Midgard anyway. I have a better advantage on this side. Do you want to waste your life on pointless bravado?”
“Heung, in order to kill me, you must be prepared for extinction too, right?”
“If I could kill you with that one life, wouldn’t it be an extra business?”
The corners of Heimdall’s mouth went up. Soon he burst out laughing and shouted.
“good night. If you have the confidence to handle me, where do you go?”
Tsutsutsutsutsut…!
Heimdall raised his magic power to the fullest and released his status.
A mana far greater than the one he used when fighting Hugin.
However, Hella was aiming for now.
‘Now.’
Right after Heimdall used magic. A rope that suddenly floated in the air began to bind Heimdall. It was according to Hella’s plan.
“It would be better not to move. It was a chain made of three non-existent materials used in Gleipnir. Even you won’t be able to cut it off easily.”
“…It’s a joke that’s not trivial. Hella.”
Heimdall said so without being shaken at all.
He was with a mischievous smile.
“You can’t hold me for long like this. You should already know, right?”
“I didn’t expect that from the beginning. but.”
Hella smiled.
“It should buy you enough time.”
Heimdall looked at the rope that tied him.
‘It’s not as strong as Gleipnir, but it’s an item with strong binding magic. Hella… it was like that too. He already knew I was coming to Midgard.’
Heimdall raised an eyebrow.
“Mimir’s power. Prophecy… Do you think it can change the fate that has been decided?”
“I would rather ask. Odin’s death is predestined. Asgard is destiny. Do you think you can get away with it?”
“……It’s interesting. yes it is good Do whatever you want. But once these chains are broken.”
Heimdall paused for a moment, then closed his lifeless eyes.
“I will kill you first.”
Heimdall’s terrifying words. It felt like I was suffocating.
No matter how much Hela is a being with a status, she is still an alter ego.
It is impossible to deal with Heimdall unless Hel directly manifests in Midgard.
“I look forward to it.”
After Hella finished speaking, she quickly left the place.
Hela flies through the air and heads somewhere quickly.
Her destination was the dormitory of Miles Academy where Jaehyun was located.
‘In this place, no matter how much a god is, he cannot fully use his power. However, the case of humans who have inherited that power is different.’
Originally, beings in each world are subject to power restrictions when moving through the world tree.
The power that can be produced here is about 30% of what it was in the original world.
However, the problem was that no one could block Heimdall’s 30% attack.
‘The only way to stop Heimdall now is to develop Min Jae-hyeon.’
Other anti-Aesir factions cannot even set foot here due to a treaty they made in the past.
The only thing that can stop Heimdall right now is Jaehyun.
Jaehyun is a resident of Midgard. He is a human.
Even if he received the power of a god, he could fully use that power.
‘I have to force myself to go through the second trial.’
There was only one hope.
antagonist of prophecy.
No one can stop Heimdall other than Jaehyun Min.

chapters.title: Chapter 128
chapters.content:
Episode 128 A Brief Break (1)
“So. Who is that instructor?”
Jaehyun crossed his arms and answered Ahn Hoyeon’s question.
“Instructor Kim Ji-yeon. I’m a rookie instructor in the magic world. By the way, the spy of the Radar Management Headquarters.”
“Spy?”
Kim Yoo-jung was surprised and asked. Jaehyun nodded calmly.
“okay. During the mock dungeon incident, I thought it was strange that he took care of the cadets unlike Gu Jain’s henchman… As expected, he had a contact with the radar management headquarters.”
Saying that, Jaehyun briefly recalled the past.
The incident happened a few days ago. Return to the first encounter with the Radar Management Headquarters.
[Who do you plan to appoint as the new chairman of Milles Academy?]
Yoo Sung-eun, who met Song Ji-seok at the time, asked.
Song Ji-seok answered her question with his white teeth exposed.
[Don’t worry. That part has already been thought of. Tell them to come in.]
The presence that came in with the voice.
Jaehyun was quite surprised when he saw her.
[……uh? Instructor Kim Ji-yeon?]
The person Song Ji-seok picked as the new chairman of Milles was none other than Kim Ji-yeon.
At the time of the mock dungeon incident the other day.
The person who led the new cadets and who tried to find out the truth of the day by summoning Jaehyun after the theme dungeon.
In fact, at first, Jaehyun thought she was Gu Jain’s henchman.
But in the end it wasn’t.
Rather than being Gu Ja-in’s confidant, Kim Ji-yeon was a spy dispatched by the Radar Management Headquarters to uncover Koo Ja-in’s corruption.
Jaehyun was satisfied with the choice of Radar Management Headquarters.
Yeonhwa’s dominance over Miles is a bad picture from the outside.
In order to satisfy her own self-interest, Yeon-hwa could be framed for expelling Gu Ja-in, so she needed to step back and take what she wanted.
‘Rather, it would be nice if the Radar Management Headquarters would step in and take care of the dirty work.’
Instructor Kim Ji-yeon’s age was not a big problem.
In the first place, it was because it had not been decades since the job of radar had emerged in the public eye, and most of the people who sat in key government positions were young.
‘Well anyway, Chairman Kim Ji-yeon is just a scarecrow temporarily dispatched by the Radar Management Headquarters.’
On the day of the story, he himself said the same.
[I’m only serving as the interim chairman, so I don’t really have much authority, but…
but please take good care of me.]
Jaehyun smiled.
In the future, Miles Academy was no different from being in his hands.
Jiyeon Kim. She belongs to the Radar Management Headquarters. Inevitably, it is a position that has no choice but to notice Jaehyun. There was no reason Jaehyun wouldn’t use this.
“No matter what, to be the chairman of Milles in his twenties. That’s great.”
Ahn Ho-yeon crossed his arms and nodded.
“Well, all the other instructors were subject to water changes. Instructor Kim Ji-yeon was the only one who didn’t come out after robbing. There are things I can trust because I belong to the headquarters.”
Others also agreed with Jaehyun’s words.
Kim Ji-yeon on the podium lightly greeted the cadets.
“hello. This is Instructor Kim Ji-yeon, who has newly assumed the position of temporary chairman. It’s not enough, but please take good care of me.”
Jaehyun and his colleagues went back to the dormitory after listening to her short speech.
It was to soothe the tired body and take a break.
‘Certainly, there is quite a bit of fatigue in the body. I need to rest now.’
Jaehyun had a very tight schedule for a while.
He prepared an outpost for Gu Ja-in’s downfall, made a plan, and executed it.
Not only that, but also personal growth and the supply and demand of necessary items.
Jaehyun has come this far by achieving all the goals he had set.
but.
He wasn’t satisfied yet.
‘The future is more important.’
After taking a deep breath, we headed to the hotel.
It was to plan for the next.
* * *
Two weeks from the next day was a rest period for Milles Academy.
After the change of the chairman.
It was because the academy also needed time to enter a stable period.
Thanks to this, Jaehyun and his party got a fairly long break after a while.
“It’s been a while since I rested……”
Jaehyun muttered with a blank expression.
It’s not that it’s not, but when I think about it, it’s been a long time since I’ve had a break.
The last time I took a break… maybe it was the day before school started?
“It’s such a sad life…….”
Jaehyun muttered while lying on the bed.
Suddenly there was a knock on the door.
bang! bang!
“what? from morning.”
I narrowed my eyes and looked at my watch. The current time is nine o’clock in the morning.
I’ve never had a delivery service, and I don’t remember room service.
There’s no one to come…
‘There’s no one.’
A sigh escaped Jaehyun’s mouth.
“He’s the only one who’ll suddenly attack at this hour.”
“hey! Can’t you open the door sooner?!”
A distinctive, clear voice coming from outside. It was Kim Yoo-jung.
Jaehyun sighed and said, “Let the ground go down again.”
“Wait a minute. I’ll put on some clothes and go out.”
After answering appropriately, he put on his coat and opened the door.
When we went outside, everyone in the party, except for Seo Ah-hyun, was huddled together.
Kim Yoo-jung looked up at Jae-hyun with her eyes wide open and said.
“Didn’t you forget your promise? After the midterm exam, we all decided to go to karaoke together.”
Jaehyun murmured that something like that had happened and then parted his lips.
“Well, now that I think about it, I think I remember…”
“You’re lying.”
Kim Yoo-jung laughed and said.
Like a childhood friend, he seemed to see through Jaehyun’s lies right away.
Amazing accuracy that makes you wonder if you’ve even used a skill.
Jaehyun looked back at the memories with admiration and finally recalled them.
‘……right. I promised you before the midterm exam.’
before taking the midterm exam. It was a story when I was taking care of Ahn Ho-yeon and Seo E-na’s theory class.
At that time, I remembered that Kim Yoo-jung had to ‘shoot karaoke’ as a condition for teaching me to study for the exam.
“don’t worry! I made a reservation for the best karaoke room on the premises.”
Ahn Ho-yeon raised his thumb and said. Jaesang Lee also nodded in tandem.
Jaehyun scratched his head and said in a slightly annoyed voice.
“okay. i will go Will you wait in the lobby below? If they come in droves… could you at least say something in advance?”
“I sent you a text, but you didn’t see it? And will it be expensive again? Since when did I contact you and come to you? Oh right. Is there anything to drink inside?”
When Kim Yoo-jung came inside, speaking confidently, Jae-hyun was dumbfounded for a moment and couldn’t answer.
After a while. Jaehyun, who suddenly came to his senses, shouted incredulously.
“Then check it out from now on! hey! wait for a sec! Where are you coming in! Aren’t you leaving right now!?”
When Kim Yoo-jung entered the house first, the rest of the group secretly watched Jae-hyun.
“sorry!”
“……Excuse me.”
“Mimi, I’m sorry!”
I took off my shoes and ran inside.
Jaehyun felt his head throb.
The party was already searching through Jaehyun’s refrigerator, bed room and wardrobe.
Eventually, he gave up taking a shower and quickly changed his clothes.
‘Those…… I will definitely take revenge.’
* * *
Jaehyun, who quickly changed his clothes, was led by them to the Milles premises. Arrived at the high-tech(?) karaoke room.
After a while.
“It’s late at night↗ if you’re okay↘”
“…….”
“…….”
“…….”
A deep silence fell inside the room where Jaehyun and his party entered.
An unknown sound, whether it was a song or a high-pitched voice, echoed from the speaker.
A muffled sound came from the hallway while no one was able to open their mouths easily.
“Hey fuck. I was startled What kind of songs are all these bastards singing like that?!”
“A guy like that should be banned from karaoke. Whoa…….”
“The pitch is… not a real person.”
“Tsk, seeing you sing like me, your face must be ugly at first glance.”
Kim Yoo-jung looked around and quickly drew the curtains so that she could not see inside.
It’s because it’s difficult to sell even one’s own face thanks to the song that was leaking from inside.
“…Jaehyun is a human too…”
Seo Ina muttered softly while listening to the song.
Ahn Ho-yeon also nodded in agreement.
“okay. Also, not everyone can be perfect. He took away his cooking skills and singing from Jaehyun. Cancer also says the world is still worth living in.”
Kim Yoo-jung laughed and intervened in the conversation between the two.
“Originally, his songs are messed up. When I was in middle school, I was scouted for joining a band club thanks to my face, but the manager threw me out first after hearing the song.”
“Why why why why… I think I’m fine…”
Lee Jae-sang said in a crawling voice, and Kim Yoo-jung became furious.
“My brother is too generous, so it’s Tal. How can he sing well?”
“No matter how hyung, this is a bit…….”
Lee Jae-sang quickly turned sullen when Ho-yeon Ahn said, disgustingly.
For reference, Kim Yoo-jung and Ahn Ho-yeon were pretty good at singing.
I’m at the level of a singer, I’m a non-celebrity, well, even if it’s not that much, at least it wasn’t to the point where I heard people say I couldn’t sing. Lee Jae-sang did not enjoy singing, so he passed.
after the song is over. Jaehyun wiped the sweat with a satisfied face.
Kim Yoo-jung and Ahn Ho-yeon were sweeping their hearts as if they were glad that the song was over.
‘I will never make Min Jae-hyun sing again.’
‘I shouldn’t make Jaehyun sing from now on.’
The two were thinking about the same thing.
“Who is next?”
When Jaehyun asked the group, Seo Ina raised her hand in a hesitant voice.
“……it’s me.”
“Come on Mike.”
Jaehyun held out the microphone to Seo Ina.
Seo Eana quickly reached out to grab the microphone Jaehyun handed her.
Then, for a moment, the two hands touched.
“……Oh!”
The moment the microphone was about to fall to the floor with Seo In-na’s startled voice, Jaehyun quickly grabbed her hand along with the microphone.
“I think you also resemble Kim Yoo-jung. Why are you clinging around?”
Jaehyun said that and put the microphone in Seo Ina’s hand.
At that moment, Seo Ina felt her heart beating fast and repeating itself.
Heat rose up in my face, and I involuntarily bent forward slightly.
“what’s the matter. Are you sick?”
When Jaehyun asked, Seo Ina shook her head and looked at his face for a moment.
“……are you okay. Thanks for catching me.”
Soon after, the Jeonju was heard, and Seo Ina looked around at the party and spoke softly.
“……I’m not that good at singing, so don’t expect it.”
“no way. I also heard Min Jaehyun’s song. Will the eardrums you’ve been listening to be washed away?”
When Kim Yoo-jung trembled, Jae-hyun narrowed his forehead.
“Are you talking too harshly? I see you don’t know, but it’s not that I can’t sing, it’s because you don’t have ears to hear. Is it enough for me to listen?
is not it. Hoyeonah?”
“uh? Uh uh…….” Ahn
Ho-yeon evaded at Jae-hyun’s words and turned his head away.
Jaehyun shook his head as if he couldn’t understand, and then moved his gaze to Seo Ina.
‘by the way. Before the return, there were only a handful of people who had heard Ina’s voice, but to hear all the songs…’
Jaehyun nodded his head, moved again.
‘Even if I can’t sing, I have to clap my hands.’
About 10 seconds after thinking so.
Jaehyun couldn’t help but open his mouth at a completely different idea.
“……What is it? Why is he so good at singing?”

chapters.title: Chapter 129
chapters.content:
Episode 129 Short Break (2)
“…What is it? Why is he so good at singing?”
A choked voice escaped Jaehyun’s mouth.
Seo Eana’s song was truly shocking.
The soft voice resonated and overpowered the atmosphere, and the treble rose smoothly without clogging.
Jaehyun was stunned and stared blankly at him.
Colleagues’ reactions were the same.
“What?! Why are you so good at singing?! Are you a singer?”
“I thought you had cherished that voice until now…”
Kim Yoo-jung was surprised, and Ahn Ho-yeon clenched her fists in exasperation.
Jaesang Lee was clapping his hands and nodding his head.
‘I’m usually introverted so I didn’t expect it at all, so why are you so good at singing?’
Jaehyun couldn’t help but tilt his head as he continued to listen to Seo Eana’s song, mesmerized. I couldn’t come up with such pitch and tempo control unless I learned it elsewhere.
After a while. After the song was over, Jaehyun approached Eana and asked.
“Where did you learn to sing?”
“……huh? no.”
“But he sings so well?! crazy. Is this a talent…….”
Kim Yoo-jung interrupted and shook her head as if she was shocked.
After thinking about it for a while, Seo Ina asked again.
“……Am I good at it?”
“of course!”
This time, everyone in the party except Lee Jae-sang answered at the same time.
Seo Eana returned to her seat with a slight blush on her face, and Kim Yoo-jung and Ahn Ho-yeon started making reservations asking her to sing their favorite song.
Seo Ina smiled lightly and wiggled her hand holding the microphone.
“……thank you. It’s the second time I’ve played my song for someone else.”
Jaehyun smiled for a moment as he saw Seo Ina saying that.
It was such a peaceful time.
* * *
Seoul in a few days. reenactment house.
“……therefore. You have to work as carefully as possible. got it?”
“all right. I think I’ve heard that sound 20 times now.”
Jaehyun was sitting on the sofa watching TV, complaining about Lee Seonhwa’s nagging.
Miles is out of operation for two weeks, so he is returning home and resting.
‘It’s not the right time to be like this.’
Jaehyun let out a small sigh, but did not take his eyes off the TV variety show.
Then, unexpectedly, he handed Lee Seon-hwa what he had brought. It was in a small pouch, but I couldn’t see what was inside, so I couldn’t immediately figure out what it was.
“This is a gift.”
Lee Seon-hwa tilted her head at her son’s calm words and accepted the pouch.
‘Why does Jaehyun give me all the presents?’
He was a son who was usually nice but rarely showed affection.
But why is he giving himself gifts like this?
I heard that the weight was light.
Lee Seon-hwa moved her hand and pulled the zipper on the pouch.
After a while. Seonhwa Lee’s pupils constricted and a small voice came out.
“This is… a bankbook?”
“yes. I am earning money now. What is your pocket money?”
At Jaehyun’s words, Seonhwa Lee looked at her son with widened eyes.
‘When did they grow up like this and already give me pocket money?’
I was happy, but my heart ached inside.
A normal person my age would still be enjoying their school days to the fullest.
Even if I had money, I would be busy hanging out with my friends.
‘……Jaehyun was always like this.’
My son has always been like this.
He cares for and cares for the people around him whom he believes in more than himself.
He may look cynical to those who don’t believe because he hits the iron wall, but he blindly sacrifices himself even if he loses to his own people.
Lee Seon-hwa looked at Jae-hyun with pity for a moment and then opened her bank account. The cover was carefully peeled off. As she checked the interior, her hands began to tremble.
“Jae Jae Jae! This… is that money you really earned on your own?!”
Seonhwa Lee shouted in astonishment.
The amount stamped on the bankbook that Jaehyun handed over was well over 1 billion, no matter how small it looked.
Jaehyun nodded slightly.
“Use all of them as you wish, Mom.”
A word spoken bluntly.
Why do you say that?
An unfamiliar feeling rushed through my heart.
It was something I wanted to say so long ago.
son succeeded. I wanted to give my mother a hug.
but he’s a bad boy Despite endlessly rolling over on the front line, he was unable to take care of his mother.
But not anymore.
Reproduction is after regression. Until now, we have constantly changed the present and have reached this point.
All that’s left now is to protect your family and friends. and.
‘The only thing I can do is kill Odin and put an end to all tragedies.’
Odin will invade Midgard at any time.
Also, Jaehyun had no intention of taking away the life he had regained.
“Now don’t worry about money and live comfortably.”
After saying that, Jaehyun stood up from his seat with an embarrassed face.
Seonhwa Lee hugged her son tightly.
said the mother
“It was very difficult.”
Jaehyun pondered for a long time on how to respond to his mother’s words.
before regression. He always told the same lie to this question.
no it’s not hard
In fact, mother, you would have known best.
Jaehyun’s words are lies.
But even so, he had no choice but to say it.
because. This time I decided to give a slightly different answer.
“It was hard.”
“……know. Mom is everything.”
Lee Seon-hwa patted his son on the back and said so.
Tears welled up for no reason, but I lifted my head up and closed my eyes, trying to swallow them.
like that.
The moment when the house almost turned into a sea of tears. A doorbell sounded.
Ding-dong-.
Jaehyun hurriedly got up from his seat after wiping the tears that could not flow with his sleeve.
Because he was wearing a gray hoodie, the ends of his sleeves were a bit dark.
“I’ll go out and see.”
Jaehyun quickly opened the door to the front door.
OK.
“uh?”
A familiar face caught my eye. While Jaehyun was parents, the woman in front of him greeted him.
“……hi.”
One fact was clearly engraved in Jaehyun’s mind.
How does he know our house?
The person standing in front of the door was none other than Seo Ina.
Jaehyun immediately realized who was doing this.
“Don’t hide behind, come out?”
“no way. What did you hear?”
With Jaehyun’s words, Kim Yoo-jung, who had been hiding behind Seo In-na, appeared.
Jaehyun let out a small sigh.
“so. What happened again this time?”
“Ah~ we’re having a meat party at my house today. I want you to come too.”
“right. Was your parents coming to Korea today?”
Jaehyun nodded as if he remembered. Kim Yoo-jung affirmed.
“ok. My mom always called me and asked me to come because she always took care of me.”
After thinking for a moment, Jaehyun nodded.
“Well, you usually take care of yourself a little bit. Do some reflection.”
“what. You owe it to your old lady. When did I owe you?”
‘It’s already that time.’
Jaehyun was quiet in his thoughts while arguing.
end of April already. It has been two months since I entered Milles Academy.
‘A lot of things have happened in the meantime.’
After Jaehyun pondered for a while, Kim Yoojung calmly said.
“hey. When will you come? My mom and dad also liked seeing you after a long time.”
‘Well… today is the day I decided to rest.’
“okay. I’ll go.”
“okay. Then wash up later and come to my house. at six in the evening.”
Jaehyun nodded. Six o’clock was still plenty of time.
You can rest a little more, take a nap in moderation, and wake up.
“okay. See you later.”
The moment Jaehyun was about to close the door after exchanging light greetings.
Seo Ina paused for a moment before asking.
“……Jaehyun. Have you ever… cried?”
Looking closely, Seo In-na’s eyes were on Jae-hyun’s wet sleeve.
“uh?”
Jaehyun quickly covered his sleeve as if embarrassed.
“no. I was just helping mom wash the dishes.”
“……I see.”
silence for a while. Jaehyun said as he put his hands in his pockets.
“Is it six o’clock in the evening? See you later.”
“……huh.”
Jaehyun saw the two of them away.
After a while. Looking at the two dots, Jaehyun murmured softly.
“Ina… you have surprisingly good observational skills.”
In the article I read before returning, Seo In-na was cold-hearted and indifferent to others, and cold towards her guild members. No matter how you look at it, it was a departure from her current appearance.
“After all, a knight is just a knight.”
Jaehyun smiled and closed the door.
* * *
After showering, Jaehyun stood in front of the closet to change clothes.
The current time is 5:40 PM.
I had to hurry because it would soon be the time I had promised with the two of them.
Jaehyun sighed as he opened the closet and looked inside.
“If I had known it would be like this, I would have bought some clothes when I came.”
There was hardly any plain clothes to wear inside.
Due to the rigorous classes at Milles Academy, the clothes she wore in middle school hardly fit. It was because the size of the clothes got bigger because of the muscles attached to the shoulders and thighs.
“After entering the academy, I only wore school uniforms. There was no need to buy private clothes.”
After thinking about it for a while, Jaehyun had no choice but to take out the widest clothes from the closet.
A plain white hoodie and black slacks. It was also a black and blue jacket to wear over it.
after changing clothes. Looking at the clock again, there were two minutes left until 6:00.
Jaehyun scratched his head and sighed.
“Ah, Kim Yu-jung will be nagging me for being late again.”
Jaehyun immediately left the house and walked a little faster to arrive in front of Kim Yoojung’s house.
The house is 10 minutes away. It wasn’t too far.
Get to the door and ring the doorbell. Sure enough, Kim Yoo-jung grumbled and opened the door.
“You are 7 minutes late. My late fee.”
“Stop talking bullshit and open the door.”
At Jaehyun’s words, Kim Yoojung chuckled and clicked her tongue briefly.
Of course, contrary to his actions, the door was opened obediently.
“Yeah. How come your house seems to get bigger every time I look at it?”
“What are you talking about? Why is the quiet house getting wider?”
At Jaehyun’s words, Kim Yoojung laughed and said,
Jaehyun lowered his clenched fist, barely restraining himself from wanting to punch him.
Upon entering, a luxurious sofa that can comfortably seat ten people caught my eye. All kinds of famous paintings hanging in the living room and famous brand rugs on the floor.
Jaehyun nodded again, thinking.
‘Kim Yoo-jung is the daughter of a rich family, right…….’
Kim Yoo-jung is a rich family’s material, even a silver spoon, if not a gold one.
My parents handled and traded the corpses of demons, but this job was risky but very profitable.
Needless to say, the revenue earned annually exceeds at least 2 billion won.
Jaehyun stuck out his tongue and looked around the inside of the house.
“…… Jaehyun, are you here?”
Seo Ina, who was sitting on the sofa, asked.
Jaehyun nodded.
“huh. Oh right. That I asked earlier. or why are you here?”
“……that is. I had nowhere else to go.”
“Oh sorry.”
Jaehyun quickly apologized for Seo Eana’s voice getting smaller.
I just remembered it now, but Seo Eana doesn’t have a family right now.
After the only grandmother died because of lack of money. She had no family left.
‘Just by looking at it, Kim Yu-jung knew in advance and invited her to her house. There is a surprisingly delicate corner. It doesn’t suit me.’
Perhaps Kim Yoo-jung brought Seo E-na back to her home to help her with nowhere else to go.
Jaehyun laughs and looks at the back of Kim Yoojung who is busy moving.
Suddenly, a familiar voice pierced his ears.
“oh! Jaehyun is here! Long time no see uncle?”
“hello.”
Jaehyun bowed his head in greeting.
The person who greeted him was none other than Kim Yoo-jung’s father.
“what? Jaehyun is here?”
The middle-aged woman who comes out into the living room is, of course, her mother.
Incidentally, both of them were people who took good care of Jaehyun.
They were kind and warm.
‘These were the people who took good care of me when I lost my mother before returning…’
Thinking about it again made my nose tingle for some reason. but then
“Ah!”
Soon, the uncle’s headlock hit Jaehyun directly.
It didn’t hurt, but thanks to that, the tears evaporated neatly.
Jaehyun thought with a smile.
‘It seems like it’s family inheritance to wear headlocks all the time.’
“Jaehyun~ It’s been a really long time. We ate a lot while we came and played well.”
“Ah yes.”
The aunt also welcomed Jaehyun. The old man poked Jaehyun’s side with his elbow and said.
“Isn’t Yoojung bothering you these days? Once upon a time, when I was in elementary school, you always hit me and came to tell me…”
“…You still remember that.”
It was a story that Jaehyun had already heard dozens of times.
Kim Yoo-jung stepped on her father’s foot while carrying the tableware.
“Daddy, if you have time to talk nonsense like that, don’t you quickly bring some food? It’s heavy!”
“Ah got it. Anyway, who resembles him and has such an eccentric personality… I don’t know if there’s a guy I’ll take with me later.”
Shaking his head while talking, he suddenly stabbed Jaehyun in the side.
“How about it. Even if it’s Jaehyun, do you think Yoojung will take you?”
Seo In-na, who was sitting on the sofa, and Kim Yoo-jung, who was carrying tableware, turned to Jae-hyun.

chapters.title: Chapter 130
chapters.content:
Episode 130 A Brief Break (3)
“… Huh?”
Jaehyun asked in a stern voice.
Seeing Jaehyun’s eyes, the uncle began to add with all his enthusiasm.
“Hmm. Even though Yoojung is a bit strong, she has a kind heart, a good brain, and… Ouch! Wrong. Anyway, temper hair.”
Kim Yoo-jung pinched his side so that his father couldn’t talk any more strangely, and the uncle laughed as if it was always the case.
Kim Yoo-jung looked at the two in turn with her eyes wide open.
“I want you to bring the meat quickly. Min Jaehyun, move too!”
“That’s right. What should I do first?”
The old man jumped up and started carrying things.
“okay. Can we move all of that?”
When Jaehyun sighed and got up, Seo Ina also got up and started moving things.
The aunt and the uncle said that it was okay to stay still, but the two moved busily, saying that they could not do that.
When the five people moved, all food materials and tools were quickly moved to the outdoors.
Currently, they are on a small terrace in the yard of Kim Yoo-jung’s house.
This was the place for today’s meat party.
after preparation.
Everyone was seated and the uncle decided to grill the meat.
With his brawny muscles, he brushed olive oil on the large steak meat, seasoned it, took out the spices, and marinated them for a while so that they could penetrate well into the meat.
After a while. The enduring time is all over. Finally, the meat started to go up on the fire.
Sizzle.
The three of them involuntarily swallowed their saliva.
The uncle must have known that kind of heart, and he quickly grilled the meat and served it in front of us. The meat, which was quickly cooked and cut to taste, was put on a plate and placed on the table. It was the start of a serious party.
“As expected, the man grills the meat very well.”
When Jaehyun said while wiping the saliva with his sleeve, the man replied with a big smile.
“what. Even if it looks like this, isn’t it a former chef? That’s about it! haha!”
The uncle seemed to be quite excited about the praise.
Seo Ina also tried the meat and opened her eyes wide as if in shock.
Kim Yoo-jung crossed her arms and said in a triumphant voice.
“My dad grills some meat. Of course, everything else is a mess, so I can’t live without my mother.”
At Kim Yoo-jung’s words, the lady who was pouring the drink next to her laughed for a moment.
“It would have been nice if Hoyeon and the chancellor brother came too.”
Suddenly, Kim Yu-jung put a piece of well-cooked meat into her mouth and said.
My father, who grills meat, wrapped a large wrap and put it in his mouth.
Jaehyun nodded and took a piece of meat himself and shoved it into his mouth.
“Because they say everyone is busy. I can’t help it. Let’s meet separately next time.”
“……huh. OK.”
Seo In-na also agreed by chewing on the meat.
After an hour of mindlessly eating meat like that. Finally, Kim Yoo-jung’s father joined the table and came to talk.
“Anyway, Jaehyun is you. I was really surprised.”
“yes?”
When Jaehyun raised his head to ask, the old man raised a corner of his mouth and said.
“It was during the second practice of the midterm exam. If it wasn’t for you, Yoojung would have been seriously hurt. Even if you look like this, you are a precious daughter.”
“……no. I haven’t done anything.”
Jaehyun turned his head and replied, probably because he felt remorse.
The uncle thought that Jae-hyun was shy and acted like that…
but everything was just a play by Jae-hyun.
Thoroughly planned work for Guzain’s downfall.
Knowing that, Kim Yoo-jung also smiles at Jae-hyun.
When her father tried to talk too long, Kim Yoo-jung cut it off moderately.
“dad. If you’re going to talk, shouldn’t you be nice to me? What does it look like?”
“Cheup! That’s what Ma said. haha. Guys, eat a lot of meat.”
The uncle gave his daughter a small wink while breaking out in a cold sweat.
Seo Ina smiled lightly, and Jaehyun also raised the corner of his mouth.
But this time, the lady patted Jaehyun on the shoulder and said.
“Ajumma is also happy to see that Jaehyun is doing well. He worked hard every day.
I’m saying this now, but she was very surprised when she first heard that you were going to the magic world. To put it bluntly, it was because I didn’t want to be separated from Yoo-jung, but I wanted to.”
“It’s not like that… but thank you anyway.”
Seeing Jaehyun answer, the woman nodded her head in satisfaction.
“The more I look at him, the better he looks. Our Yoojung should also bring a boyfriend like you. He has a bit of a personality…”
“Oh really! What’s wrong with mom? Eat some meat! If not, will I eat mom’s too?”
Kim Yoo-jung said in a fit of fuss.
Hearing the story of the two, Jaehyun smiles awkwardly, but from the side he knocks! A voice was heard. It was Seo Ina.
“what’s the matter? What’s going on?”
“……no.”
Ina immediately denied Jaehyun’s question.
It seemed that he had lost control of his strength when he put down his chopsticks.
Jaehyun tilted his head, but soon turned off his nerves and continued to enjoy the meat party.
* * *
“Do you even know what you did!”
Ahn Seok-gu’s voice, his face flushed red, reverberated through the house.
Ahn Ho-yeon, who stood in front of him, did not reply and looked at his father with a cold, hard face.
My father continued to raise his voice.
“Chairman Gu Ja-in… He had a bad back, but he was a guy who could definitely support you! But what? You said you saved the dying cadets because you felt sorry for them? Fool!”
Ahn Seok-gu was angry from the top of his head. He could hardly understand his son’s behavior.
recent. Chairman Gu Ja-in was arrested on charges of corruption and tax evasion.
The downfall of the one who believed that he would grow his son into the best radar in Korea.
Ahn Seok-gu could not help but be angry.
Together. Recently, I learned that my son and Min Jae-hyun were involved in his downfall.
It is said that Min Jae-hyun is Yeon-hwa and Yoo Seong-eun’s direct disciple, and Ahn Ho-yeon cooperated with him in preventing the guild experience incident.
From Ahn Seok-gu’s point of view, it was as if his son had pointed a gun at him. If he had stepped out a little too late, Ahn Seok-gu would have been arrested under the pretext of agreeing with Goo Ja-in.
Ahn Seok-gu’s eyes were bloodshot.
“Ugly bastard! How dare a son put his father in jail?! Are you still my son!”
“father.”
“Shut up and listen! Ahn Ho-yeon! You must be the best radar in Korea. You have to put everyone under your feet! That’s the privilege of those with power!
Bring down that bastard Min Jae-hyun right now. Do whatever it takes to become the best…!”
“Please stop it.”
Ahn Ho-yeon said with a face full of contempt, as if he would not hear it anymore.
I have tried to convince my father several times.
In the past, Jae-hyun was a benefactor who saved him several times, and the guild experience incident was also that he himself asked for help from Jae-hyun.
But my father didn’t even listen.
He taught every cadet to trample on his friends as rivals.
It was disgusting.
Ahn Ho-yeon knew.
Even if you go that far and reach the top, there is nothing left.
Even if I climb to the highest place alone.
Can you save a true comrade?
‘It can’t be.’
Ahn Ho-yeon has now come to a conclusion.
I will no longer live according to the Father’s will.
“father. Because this is my life.”
Ahn Ho-yeon put strength into every word. His eyes grew colder than before.
Ahn Ho-yeon said as he pushed his father who was holding me by the shoulder.
“My father lives his father’s life. honest.”
“Ah Hoyeon! Can’t come here right now! Ahn Ho-yeon!”
Ahn Ho-yeon went outside ignoring his father’s words.
One destination.
It was my mother’s hospital.
* * *
Seoul Central Hospital.
Ahn Ho-yeon greeted the nurse with a familiar face and entered the hospital room.
I see my mother, who has not yet woken up, lying in a hospital bed.
Lying in the hospital room, barely exhaling.
Ahn Ho-yeon pursed his lips and lowered his head.
‘Mom…….’
It was not uncommon for An Ho-yeon to visit her mother’s hospital room.
He was a filial son by nature, and his mother was a very precious family to him.
Previous. Until a few years ago, my father was also like him.
In the past, the father loved his wife very much, but now he has changed.
It was very difficult to cure the disease of his wife, who was deeply wounded by the demonic beast, and required an astronomical amount of money and the help of a professional healer.
However, his father did not have the strength to do so.
My military connections didn’t help.
I was tired because
He ran around in various ways to save his wife, but in the end he gave up.
In a newly changed world, those with power monopolize medicine.
If you don’t have anything, if you can’t dominate others, you’re thrown away.
My father gradually deteriorated.
after. He began to obsess over Ahn Ho-yeon’s talent.
Because it was the only way to save his wife. So, he overworked his son and constantly put him into more difficult situations.
But now, many years later. The father’s desire to cure his wife’s illness had all but disappeared.
There is just a twisted desire to raise his son as a special being and be recognized by others and an ineradicable sense of defeat.
Ahn Ho-yeon recalled the face of his father who was angry with him.
the father said
To beat Jaehyun somehow.
Engrave your name on the highest place.
Of course, Ahn Ho-yeon also intended to do everything in his power to defeat Jae-hyun.
But I won’t win in a cowardly way.
in a fair way.
Ahn Ho-yeon knew better than anyone what he had to do.
“I’ll be back.”
After chanting softly, she got up from her seat, leaving her ailing mother behind.
* * *
After all the meat parties.
The three of them were sitting on the sofa after roughly tidying up.
Kim Yoo-jung’s parents were not at home. It was because I had booked a late-night movie, so I hurriedly ran out while looking at the clock.
“I have to get up soon too.”
Jaehyun, who was watching TV, yawned and said.
Kim Yoo-jung lifted her head and looked up at Jae-hyun.
“Are you going already?”
“hey. what already It’s almost twelve o’clock now.”
“Since when did we ask for that? Just wait a little longer.”
“If I had more, your father wouldn’t leave me alone?”
“why?”
Kim Yoo-jung leaned over under the sofa and asked.
Jaehyun answered while pushing away Kim Yoojung’s face with an annoyed face.
“It’s kind of like when you’re away from your parents for a long time. Will you be scolded unconditionally?”
“You don’t have to be scolded. Isn’t that right?”
“……Ah yes.”
Seo Ina answered a little late.
Kim Yoo-jung tilted her head, but didn’t care deeply.
Jaehyun took out his smartphone from his pocket and checked his watch.
The current time is 11:53. It was soon midnight.
“I’m leaving in 7 minutes.”
“really? I also have one, but be ruthless.”
“shut up.”
The two squabble as usual.
Seo Ina, who had been watching the two of them suddenly, opened her mouth.
“…… I have a question for you guys… Can I ask you something?”
“ok? What? Ask me anything.”
Kim Yu-jung crossed her arms and said.
Seo Ina seemed to be thinking about it for a while, then she licked her lips and spat out the words with difficulty.
“Those… are you two… dating?”
There was silence for a moment.
Jaehyun’s small sigh flowed through the unknown silence.
“……what?”
Jaehyun thought.
What the hell is Ina talking about?

chapters.title: Chapter 131
chapters.content:
Episode 131 Item Enhancement
Jaehyun looked at Seo Ina with a bewildered face.
playful eyes. It seemed that he was sincere.
Jaehyun sighed as he put his hand on his face.
“Ha… I don’t know how he misunderstood that…”
The moment he sighed and was about to reply.
Kim Yu-jung interrupted like a thunderbolt.
“Where in the world did such a sweet scene come from just now…?”
This one, too, had an astonishing face.
Jaehyun nodded in agreement.
“Think about your usual relationship. And you know his personality. How many men can endure?”
“Do you cancel when you say that in a nice way?”
“Even your parents approved of it. Look at you once in a while.”
The two growled again soon.
Seo Ina hesitated for a moment and then added.
“……The parents seem to be close. I hope you guys look good too.”
“hmm. To be honest, it’s not that we’re on bad terms…but it’s not romantic feelings though.”
Kim Yu-jung crossed her arms and said.
For some reason, Seo Ina cleared her chest and nodded.
“……huh. I’m sorry for asking something.”
“Oh right. It’s late. I am going now.”
At Jaehyun’s words, Kim Yoojung shook her head as if she had given up.
“okay. Go go.”
“……bye.”
Seo In-na also nodded as if resigned.
Jaehyun smiled and got up from his seat.
“Then see you later. call.”
The two didn’t even see Jaehyun off, probably because of the sarcasm.
Jaehyun went outside and walked down the empty streets at dawn.
From tomorrow, I have to digest the tight schedule again.
Just thinking about it made my body ache for some reason.
* * *
The next day.
Jaehyun visited a department store specializing in radar near his house.
A place where I had been with Park Seong-jae in the past. It was to purchase the items needed for the dungeon attack in advance and to purchase clothes that fit his new size.
“This and this. And… give me that too.”
Jaehyun bought some clothes from his favorite brands.
From simple shirts and slacks to jeans and blazers that fit the body and ball cap shoes.
After buying all sorts of things, I had no choice but to spend quite a bit of money.
“Now that I have enough money. You shouldn’t regret it.”
After Jaehyun bought all the clothes, he headed to the second floor.
A floor with professional equipment that I visited alone, leaving Park Seong-jae, who had run away, behind. Jaehyun had several items to buy here.
As soon as I went upstairs, I noticed several items hanging inside the glass exhibition hall.
From C grade to A grade. Artifacts of each grade are arranged neatly in the showcase.
Jaehyun groaned and looked around.
“It’s been a while.”
It was a new feeling.
In the past, Jaehyun had never thought of buying equipment items with money.
However, now he has the means to purchase almost every item here.
Of course, thanks to the items handed over by the system, the ambiguous equipment wouldn’t be of much help, but it didn’t feel bad anyway.
Jaehyun looked around moderately and finally stood in front of the object he wanted.
He lightly opened the system window to check the item information.
[Enhancement Item]
Name: Shadow Ore
Grade: A
An ore that enhances shadow equipment. Rating increases by 1 when strengthening an item.
*Additional stats may be added with a low probability.
* The probability varies depending on the skill of the smelter.
Price: 495000000
‘An item that I wanted to use right away after getting the first Night Shade armor. I gave up because I didn’t have money at the time, but now I can live.’
Jaehyun raised an eyebrow.
The other day, Jaehyun made huge profits with the operating profit of Studio Elixir. In addition, the combined income from selling all the items he had obtained in the dungeon was over 3 billion won.
Of this, he intended to give about 1 billion to his mother and use the remaining money to strengthen his equipment.
It was because no matter how much the Aesir system distributed items, it was judged that it would be difficult to keep giving the necessary items in time.
Well, I would have made money anyway. If a better item comes along, you can change it.
“hey.”
Jaehyun called the clerk in front of him. The clerk approached with a smile and asked.
“Do you need anything?”
“yes. I want to buy shadow ore. Give me one.”
“All right. Is there anything else you need?”
“Are there any enhancement stones that can enhance the apprentice Valkyrie set?”
“We will process it after checking the inventory. please wait for a moment.”
Jaehyun also bought three enhancement stones to enhance the apprentice Valkyrie set. He smiled as he held a shopping bag full of enhancement stones in both hands.
‘good. This will be of great help in future battles.
……Of course, if the reinforcement is successful.’
That was the only problem.
However, Jaehyun was not deeply concerned.
“I have prepared all the measures for a time like this.”
A soft smile spread across Jaehyun’s lips.
* * *
Two hours later. Upon returning home, Jaehyun immediately locked himself in his room.
I had just finished shopping at the department store and had just visited Lee Jae-sang’s workshop.
By the way, the reason Jaehyun visited the workshop was simple.
[Consumption item]
Name: Elixir of Luck
Rating: A+
Increases the user’s luck exponentially for two hours when drunk.
“If you’re going to strengthen it anyway, it’s better to have a slightly higher probability.”
Jaehyun smiled.
“Anyway, the chancellor is really amazing. Already making an A+ class elixir.”
In the beginning, it was Lee Jae-sang who made the elixir of magical power enhancement and helped Jae-hyun a lot. Recently, the growth of Kobo Elixir has been smooth.
Lee Jae-sang’s growth had many corners that were helpful to Jae-hyeon.
“I’ll have to buy you a present later.”
Jaehyun took a deep breath and sat down.
After removing the shadow armor he was equipped with, he placed it on the floor alongside the shadow ore. After waiting for a while, the two items resonated and the system sound was heard.
―You can use 《Shadow Ore》 to enhance 《Shadow Armor》.
Jaehyun first checked the options of the shadow armor he was wearing.
[Equipment Item]
Name: Shadow Armor
Grade: B
The armor that protected the Night Shade. Upon equipping it, you gain the 《Stealth》 skill.
Effect
1. Physical / magic defense +100
2. Learn the active skill 《Stealth》.
[Active Skill]
Name: Stealth
Rating: B
Stats: –
Completely hides from the enemy’s sight range for 5 minutes.
Cooldown: 30 minutes
*However, if an enemy uses the 《Detection》 skill, the duration of the skill is reduced to 1 minute.
―Do you want to enhance the 《Shadow Armor》 using the Enhancement Stone?
“No wait.”
Jaehyun put his decision on hold for a while, then opened his inventory and took out the item.
Elixir of luck.
It was an elixir that could be expected to be effective in all situations where luck works.
Jaehyun immediately poured the elixir into his mouth and waited for a while.
―The user’s Luck temporarily increases significantly.
Jaehyun nodded and accepted the reinforcement proposal he had been putting on hold.
“I strengthen the shadow armor with shadow ore.”
with your voice. Dark shadows leaked from the shadow ore began to move to the armor.
Jaehyun held his breath and watched him silently.
After a while. It wasn’t long before I heard the voice I had been waiting for.
―The rank of «Shadow Armor» has risen by 1, making it A-class.
―As a result of your luck, the passive skill «Genius of Arms Crafting» is activated.
―< < Shadow Armor > will rise to S rank.
“uh?”
Two successive grade upgrades that I never thought of.
Even while Jaehyun was flustered, the sound of the system did not stop.
―< < Shadow Armor > has evolved into < Abyssal Armor >.
―Displays the information of 《Abyssal Armor》.
[Equipment Item]
Name: Abyssal Armor
Grade: S
Armor said to have been made from the abyss of Kinnungagap.
Effect
1. Physical / magic defense +350
2. Acquire the active skill 《Stealth Lv 3》.
3. Acquire the passive skill 《Shadow Fairy Tale》.
It was truly exponential growth.
Defense has also grown from 100 to 350, a value that can be expected in future battles.
Jaehyun also checked the strengthened «Stealth» and the newly acquired skill «Shadow Fairy Tale».
[Active Skill]
Name: Stealth (Lv 3)
Grade: B
Stats: –
Completely hides from the enemy’s field of view for 15 minutes.
Cooldown: 30 minutes
*However, if an enemy uses the 《Detection》 skill, the duration of the skill is reduced to 3 minutes.
[Passive skill]
Name: Shadow assimilation
Rating: A
Creates layered afterimages by assimilating the shadow and the user.
Drains the enemy’s attack with a certain probability.
1. Drains the enemy’s attack with a 2% chance.
2. Obtain an item, and only once, the attack has a 100% chance of spilling.
*However, the effect of the skill does not apply to light attribute attacks.
“I couldn’t believe it, but I didn’t expect the passive to explode… Plus skill enhancement and new skill acquisition.”
Jaehyun muttered with a pleasant smile.
It was a pleasant sound to hear.
Now with this, I have two S-class items. Not only that, but it was also encouraging that he had strengthened his “stealth” skill, which had high use value.
After that, small growth like this will make Jaehyun rank up faster.
‘Moreover, the newly acquired 《Shadow Fairy Tales》…… It’s a really useful skill. It’s a satisfactory achievement.’
The newly acquired skill 《Shadow Fairy Tale》 is a passive evasion skill.
There are limitations such as 2% chance and vulnerability to the light attribute, but this alone was good enough.
“good. Shall we strengthen the remaining equipment as well?”
Jaehyun grinned and this time he took out the apprentice Valkyrie set and lined it up.
The apprentice Valkyrie set is an item that Jaehyun was particularly reluctant to change.
“Other people might say that I only hang on to C-class equipment, but…”
The reason Jaehyun wanted to keep the Valkyrie set was clear.
Because of the set effect that is attached right away.
‘Anyway, it’s hard to find a skill that can replace 《Mana Steal》 in the Valkyrie set.’
《Mana Steal》 is a skill that recovers 1% of total mana whenever an enemy is defeated.
It was a skill that was difficult to throw away as Jaehyun, who consumed a lot of mana.
After a few days of trouble. Jaehyun decided to strengthen the item without giving up the skill.
“If you strengthen a set item, your rank will go up, but your skills will be maintained. It’s perfect for my current situation. Moreover, there are also passives such as 《Armor Manufacturing Genius》, so you might be aiming for a jackpot.”
As for reproduction, strengthening items directly was more efficient in many ways.
―Do you want to use 3 《Valkyrie’s Enhancement Stones》 to enhance the 《Apprentice Valkyrie Set》?
A system tone was heard. Jaehyun immediately accepted.
“okay.”
The light flashed once again, and soon it began to move to the apprentice Valkyrie set.
After a while.
―The rank of 《Apprentice Valkyrie Set (3 pieces of equipment below)》 has increased by 1 to B rank.
Jaehyun nodded as he listened to the sound of the system.
“Success.”
Unfortunately, the passive skill didn’t explode like a while ago.
―Displays enhanced item information.
[Equipment Item]
Name: Intermediate Valkyrie’s Ring
Grade: B A
ring for Intermediate Valkyries. A stylish silver decoration was added.
Magic Power: +25
Set Effect: 3/3
Passive Skill: Mana Steal (Lv 2)
* Intermediate Valkyrie’s Necklace When worn together with Intermediate Valkyrie’s Earrings, a set effect occurs.
The effect of the necklace and earrings that came to mind was also the same.
Enhancement of basic magical power. However, that wasn’t all.
Jaehyun brought up the skill window of 《Mana Steal》 that he had leveled up.
[Passive Skill]
Name: Steal Mana (Lv 2)
Rating: B
Whenever an enemy is defeated, 2% of one’s maximum magic power is immediately restored.
As he leveled up, the effect of «Mana Steal» doubled.
Jaehyun wanted to scream in joy.
As dramatic as the previous two skills. It was strange that he wasn’t happy.
“good. All equipment items have been strengthened. Then next.”
After completing the reinforcement, Jaehyun muttered as he got up from his seat.
A confident smile bloomed on his face.
Jaehyun turned his head and looked at the window.
“Let’s hear it from you, Hella.”

chapters.title: Chapter 132
chapters.content:
Episode 132 Great Ruins (1)
“Did you know I was coming?”
Hella, who was sitting by the window, opened her mouth.
Jaehyun nodded his head with a small smile.
“of course.”
In fact, Jaehyun already knew that Hela would come looking for him.
‘That enormous clash of magical powers I felt a while ago. A being with such power would at least not be a human.
Hella and Hugin. Or it would be more correct to see it as a confrontation between Hella and the other Aesir gods.’
a few days ago. Jaehyun felt a wave of powerful magic from the center of the closed city of Daegu.
It was almost the same level of disturbing magic that I felt during the battle between Hela and Hugin the other day.
It was hardly thought to be human.
Hella nodded as if she noticed.
“It looks like you felt a clash of magical powers.”
“Why did you come to see me?”
Jaehyun went straight to the main point.
According to Hella in the past, Jaehyun is still too weak to take the second trial. I thought it would be a while before I met her again.
Why did she suddenly appear?
Hela immediately came down from the window and polymorphed into human form. The steam imbued with magic dyes the surroundings black, and then forms a human form.
The girl’s face, which resembles the still young Hel, is revealed after taking off the veil.
“We must take the second trial as soon as possible.”
Jaehyun had no choice but to ponder for a moment at Hella’s incoherent declaration.
Until recently, she had told Jaehyun that she had no qualifications. Why did he suddenly change his words?
Jaehyun cautiously opened his lips.
“You said it before. The second trial is still too early for me.”
Raise your head and make eye contact. Jaehyun spoke in a clear tone.
“Is there a reason you changed your mind?”
At Jaehyun’s words, Hella nodded slightly and replied.
“That’s right. You must have felt it already. That an immortal with great magic has descended to this land.
The schedule has changed. I can’t delay any longer. Odin has begun to move.”
“Please explain in detail.”
“Everything around you will be destroyed.”
There was a faint light in Hella’s eyes as she spoke resolutely.
The subtle eyes of two colors spread a strange sense of intimidation.
Hella was biting her lip.
“Even the people by your side…everyone.”
My body trembles. Jaehyun’s eyebrows are twisted, and a clear anger rises.
‘Everything… will be destroyed?’
a day ago. It was only a day before that I saw my mother’s warm smile.
Few days had passed since I felt happiness with my friends by my side.
however.
Odin tries to take everything away from himself again.
As if he had already ruined his life once before returning.
Jaehyun looked at Hella with empty eyes and Hella was silent.
In the midst of the uncomfortable flow for a while, Hella opened her mouth again.
“Heimdall has manifested in Midgard. He’s after you.”
“If Heimdall… are you referring to the gatekeeper of Asgard? A god said to carry a huge horn and live in Bibrost, the rainbow bridge?”
“you’re right. Incidentally, he has a special power to foresee the near future. He is a dangerous enemy.”
Hella’s words landed heavily on Jaehyun’s chest.
Jaehyun thought as he licked his lips.
‘Know. That someday you will have to fight the Æsir. But… it’s too dangerous right now. I am still too weak.’
He knows better than anyone that he has grown rapidly recently.
but. It was absurd to deal with Asgard’s immortals with that much power.
‘Now I can’t even defeat Fugin by myself.’
Jaehyun couldn’t help but admit it.
The person he believed to be his father. Hugin.
Even Odin’s crow couldn’t face Jaehyun alone.
Even more so, the Aesir god would be several times stronger than that.
Equipped with a complete divinity, their power is truly unfathomable.
Jaehyun now could be crushed with just one gesture.
‘You need to increase your strength. To that end, Hella’s countermeasure was the second trial.’
Jaehyun, who was lost in thought for a moment, clasped his hands and let go.
“The second trial.”
He raised his head and met Hella’s eyes again. An immeasurably deep sadness has settled in the two eyes of different colors.
Jaehyun contemplated this and asked in the most calm voice.
“If you pass that, will you have the strength to face Heimdall?”
Hella shook her head with an exasperated expression.
“It is not. In order to destroy the throne of Aesir, you must clear at least three trials.
Because God’s status is more difficult to handle than imagined. but.”
Hella paused for a moment, then tightened her neck and stood up again.
“All gods can only use 30% of their power in the other 8 worlds other than their own. Same goes for Heimdall.”
30?
It was only then that Jaehyun nodded as if he understood.
“Now I get it. If you clear the second trial, you mean it won’t be impossible to deal with Heimdall, who has limited power, right?”
“you’re right. What’s more, in order for the gods to manifest on the ground, a huge amount of divine power is consumed. It won’t last long either.”
Jaehyun let out a sigh of relief.
‘It’s fortunate that the gods are limited by their power here.’
But not all questions were answered.
Heimdall. Why did he directly manifest in Midgard?
After all, they cannot kill themselves because of the power of prophecy.
It must be so.
Hella added, as if noticing.
“I said it before. The throne of Aesir intends to destroy everything around you.
Heimdall just wants to destroy you. They want to destroy the things they hold dear so that nothing remains. Because the human heart is much weaker than you think.”
“…So you’re saying you’re trying to kill the people around me?”
“The Æsir throne has done many things worse than that.”
There was no hesitation in Hella’s words.
Jaehyun had to clear his mind.
The current situation is difficult to accept hastily, but there is no other way. At this rate, his family and colleagues would be attacked by them.
‘We need to calmly grasp the situation.’
As Jaehyun thought about it, he couldn’t stand the disgust that welled up in his heart.
The Æsir gods were thinking of holding a third-rate movie hostage now.
Holding family and colleagues hostage and preventing him from gaining greater power.
It is the thought of killing him in the end.
‘There’s no way I can accept that.’
Jaehyun smiled and got up from his seat.
All decisions had already been made.
“What is the content of the second ordeal?”
Hearing Jaehyun’s words without hesitation raised Hella’s eyebrows subtly.
She lightly bit her lip.
‘This child… is also different from other humans.’
It was charming.
In Hella’s opinion, Jaehyun had a special quality different from other humans.
Unusual speed of judgment and decisiveness.
Every action was a mysterious boy.
Hella did not reveal her true intentions.
“To take the second trial, you must head to the ruins.”
“……ruins?”
Jaehyun tilted his head. Hella added quickly.
“You have to clear the ‘Trial of the Giant’ there.”
at the same time. A message floated in Jaehyun’s ear along with a refreshing voice.
[Main Quest]
Hrungnir’s Ordeal
Hrungnir, the leader of Jotunheim, is giving you an ordeal.
Pass the three Wisdom Trials and clear the trials.
Difficulty: S+
Reward: Hrungnir’s Gift
Remaining Time: –
Failure Penalty: –
* * *
Ruins.
Mysterious burial mounds have suddenly risen all over the world. Unidentified artifacts can be excavated, which encourages many raiders to challenge, but it is also a place that becomes the grave of many awakened people every year.
‘They said that all of the unidentified items and Mistiltein I got from the magic engineering shopping street were all excavated from the ruins.
Could the ruins have something to do with the circumstances of the gods?’
Hela said that in order to undergo the second ordeal, we must head to the ruins.
Given the circumstances, it would be correct to assume that there is a close relationship between the ruins and the two powers.
“The ruins and the giant… what kind of contact point is there between the two?”
Hearing Jaehyun’s words, Hella put her hands together and put them on her knees.
“Perhaps you have thought about it at least once. Who created the ruins that exist around the world and for what purpose? I do.”
“…the one who created the ruins?”
“That’s right.”
At Hella’s words, Jaehyun’s forehead wrinkled.
After a while. Jaehyun’s mouth opened, and a sigh of astonishment leaked out slowly.
“no way……!”
“you’re right. All the ruins that mankind has conquered so far have been left by giants.
It is a legacy left for mankind in preparation for the second Ragnarok.”
Hella added with a light smile.
“A feature that can only be found in ruins-type dungeons. Do you know?”
“……puzzle.”
After thinking for a moment, Jaehyun raised his head and answered.
I’m starting to understand little by little now.
A puzzle dungeon.
detective riddles, etc. It is a dungeon that prepares various puzzles and gives special artifacts to those who clear them.
As a type of special dungeon, it is similar to a themed dungeon, but it has a big difference in that you don’t play immersed in a character.
It is one of the dungeons with a low clear rate because the dungeon difficulty is quite high.
Together.
One of the biggest features of this dungeon was that it could only be found in the ruins.
This was a part that scholars who study the occurrence of dungeons could not easily come to a conclusion.
‘If, as Hella said, the giants made ruins-type dungeons… I can understand why there are so many puzzle-type dungeons only in ruins.’
Childhood. In the fairy tales my mother told me, the giant was always portrayed as a wise being.
The races that troubled Thor and troubled the Aesir gods.
“Certainly, it sounds credible that the giants described as wise in mythology created puzzle-type dungeons.”
As Jaehyun crossed his arms and said, Hella elaborated.
“The giants lost their home, Jotunheim, to Odin in the First War. In order to regain it, the anti-Aesir coalition forces must win in the second war.
Because of this, they created ruins. The idea was to equip the weakest of humans with their weapons so that they could put a blunt point on Odin.”
“I know. If Jotunheim had been destroyed, even as giants there would have been no other choice but to rely on humans.”
Jaehyun nodded. But there were still parts that I didn’t understand.
“But why did you use the cumbersome method of puzzles? If it’s simply to share power, it’s probably just a matter of sharing artifacts.”
“The giants did not want unwise humans to have their artifacts. Fools are bound to make mistakes and end up making bad decisions.”
“To put it simply, the reason the giants made the ruins and installed the puzzles is to select suitable humans… What are you talking about?”
Hella nodded.
“That’s right.”
Jaehyun thought he was acting like a wise giant.
After a while. Jaehyun, who was worried, opened his mouth again and asked.
“Where are the ruins where I have to undergo the ordeal?”
Hella smiled incomprehensibly at those words.
“It comes just in time.”
The place where her gaze stayed was where the TV was in Jaehyun’s room.
Jaehyun’s expression hardened as he moved his gaze to the TV screen.
A news was playing on the TV.
[……Breaking news. Unfortunately, the news is that the 11th attack on the great ruins has failed.]
[It was a highly anticipated attack with the European Union’s Ballack directly participating, but this time also failed without clearing the first gate called ‘credentials’. ……]
[The association’s position is that we cannot be confident of success in the next attack…]
Jaehyun, who heard the voice coming out of the screen, immediately nodded his head.
‘A great ruin. One of the largest ruins in the world. Certainly, it wouldn’t be strange if the second trial was ready.’
There is only one great ruin in the world and it is located in Iceland.
Iceland is one of the lands of Norse mythology.
The front and rear are definitely aligned.
Jaehyun thinks
Just in time, Hella confirmed the kill and smiled.
“To capture the great ruins of Iceland. That is the second ordeal.”

chapters.title: Chapter 133
chapters.content:
Episode 133 Great Ruins (2)
Great Ruins in Iceland.
It is the largest relic in the world that even reappearances are familiar with.
A forbidden place where not a single person has been allowed to enter for the past few decades.
Jaehyun frowned and asked.
“But I know that the Great Ruins is a place that no one has attacked yet. I was told that I didn’t even pass the first stage test called ‘credentials’.”
“I couldn’t prove it because I didn’t have the qualifications.”
Hella put her index finger on her lips and lightly raised the corner of her mouth.
“Because the purpose of the great ruins was you from the beginning.”
“You said it was me from the beginning?”
“That’s right. The designer of the Great Ruins, ‘Hrungnir’, left the ruins for you from the beginning.
I earnestly hope that you will inherit your power, kill Odin, and bring peace to the Nine Worlds.”
Hrungnir.
Hearing the name, Jaehyun paused for a moment and fell into thought.
‘Hrungnir was definitely a giant who was described as Thor’s nemesis.’
I don’t remember clearly, but in mythology, Hrungnir was a very rude giant.
Insulting Sif, Thor’s wife, taking Freya as his concubine, and so on. A giant who was eventually killed by Thor because of all sorts of depravity.
‘But it’s not a story to be believed right away.’
Hela said the other day.
The Æsir gods are distorting the myth and this is for brainwashing.
Perhaps this time, there was a similar daily probability.
“As you already know, Hrungnir is already dead. I fell for Thor’s wiles and lost my life.”
Hella said calmly and then leaned against the bed a bit.
Jaehyun asked.
“The designer, Hrungnir, is dead. Is there any problem with the second trial?”
“yes. You don’t have to worry about that part. There is just one minor problem.”
“What is it?”
Jaehyun immediately asked back, but somehow he couldn’t hide his uneasiness.
Hella scratched her cheek and said.
“That’s because there is actually not one credential. Everyone must meet both qualifications to step inside the Great Ruins.”
“……yes?”
When Jaehyun asked in a bewildered voice, Hella looked at him.
Jaehyun asked in an urgent voice.
“What is the other qualification?”
“Muscle strength of 150 or more, agility of 150 or more, the realm of an S-class raider…?”
Jaehyun’s face immediately hardened.
what?
The realm of an S-class radar?
* * *
Near the great ruins. The lobby of the Silcan Hotel where the European Union stays.
“shit! Do you know how many times this is!?”
A rough voice echoed through the lobby.
The owner was none other than Ballack, the representative of the European Union.
“What kind of credential are you still unable to set foot in the entrance?”
“calm down. Isn’t the permitted attack period over yet?”
Camilla, standing to the left of Balak, replied with an innocent expression.
She was an American S-class wizard and a talented genius raider who held the official record for the shortest time in the Mana Cube Test.
However, despite her words, Balak’s face was still cold.
“I don’t get it. So far we, the European Union, have attacked hundreds of sites around the world. Does it make sense that there are ruins that you can’t even set foot on?”
“It’s the only grand ruin in the world. You may be thinking too hastily.”
“but!”
“Balak, I know how you feel. But if you think about it, it’s not a big problem, right? It’s a big deal that the proud European Union can’t even step on. Could someone else dare to cross it?”
Despite Camilla’s persuasion, Ballack remained stubborn.
“That is not my business. Find a way to enter the ruins and attack them. That’s what our union is supposed to do. Don’t add excuses. Camilla.”
high-handed attitude. However, Camilla shook her head as if she was used to it.
“I will never lose a player.”
Balak gnashed his teeth and spat, then left.
‘I will somehow attack the great ruins.’
I will never give the right to attack to other guys.
That was the only thought in Balak’s head.
* * *
Hella’s shocking declaration. There was an uncomfortable silence for a moment in the room.
“no way. Are you kidding me?”
Jaehyun tried hard to deny the reality, but Hella shook her head seriously.
“The situation is the situation, do you think I would lie?”
“…….”
Jaehyun had no choice but to keep his mouth shut.
I think it’s grown quite steeply recently, but it’s still in A-class.
The state of the S-class radar is at a level that he cannot even look at.
‘In the first place, stats are also a problem. Agility is over 150 with TRP’s thunderous step effect…but my strength is less than 70.’
It was frustrating, but there were no other sharp tips.
Now, even if you go around the dungeon to level up, the limit is clear.
I’m drowning in trouble Suddenly, Hella clapped and said.
