Park Seong-jae was secretly walking around the cafe, looking at Jae-hyun and Baek Ji-yeon’s trends.
It was because Yoo Seong-eun ordered him to follow the two a while ago.
[But are you really okay? Of course, I don’t think that Jaehyun will go to Yeonhwa at all… but I’m worried that he won’t be shaken if he puts up an S-class artifact as a condition.] [
Jaehyun won’t go over that easily. My brother is so worried.]
[Why did that person send me to the role of tailing?]
[…….]
Yoo Seong-eun was currently suffering from bipolar disorder due to extreme stress.
[If Jaehyun was taken away, Yeonhwa Guild’s future plans would be all gone…]
It was something I couldn’t help but worry about.
Of course, Jaehyun maintains a close relationship with Yeonhwa. He is also his disciple and by using the power of Yeon-hwa, he has recently succeeded in removing the chairman of the board, Gu Ja-in, from his position.
However, apart from this, transfers between guilds of raiders are common.
Radars are basically wolves that follow their own interests.
Jaehyun, too, could transfer if other guilds offered conditions they liked.
Seongjae Park, who was on the phone, put his hand in his pocket.
The situation was so serious that it reminded me of the cigarette I quit smoking when I started working on the radar.
‘For now, there’s nothing I can do. I have no choice but to watch.’
Seongjae Park swallowed dry saliva and looked at Jaehyun reflected in the window.
* * *
“Three times the conditions set by Yeonhwa Guild. If you want, I will put more conditions than that.”
“It is definitely a great condition.”
Jaehyun nodded.
Even excluding the S-class artifact 《Nidhogg’s Fang》, it was a huge condition.
A whopping three times the contract Yeonhwa offered.
It was a proposal worth at least hundreds of billions of dollars when converted into value.
‘Conditions good enough to make anyone drool.’
If it hadn’t been for the Yeonhwa Guild, it would have been a contract that Jaehyun would have accepted.
Jaehyun touched the glass in front of him.
“First, I want to hear about Nidhogg’s Fang.”
Baek Ji-yeon nodded and looked at Kang Ju-yeon, who was sitting next to her.
“Mr. Joo Yeon?”
“All right.”
Kang Joo-yeon immediately opened the subspace and took out the small case she had put in her inventory. It was equipped with an advanced mana sensor, so it took a bit of work to open it.
Baek Ji-yeon put it lightly into the case and let’s wait for a while.
Clap!
The case was opened, finally revealing the full picture of the artifacts inside.
Jaehyun smiled lightly.
‘The Fangs of Nidhogg I know are right. That’s great.’
Jaehyun tried to hide his greedy expression and began examining the items.
‘It has the shape of a machete knife. I’m sure it’s practical.’
machete knife. It was a dagger with a similar appearance to a jungle sword.
An item that boasts a length of about 18 inches and a black blade that stretches straight out.
Jaehyun brought up the status window to check more detailed information.
[Equipment Item]
Name: Nidhogg’s Fang
Grade: S
A dagger made from the fangs of Nidhogg, a poisonous dragon living in Hvergelmir.
It can produce poison all the time without a venom gland and is very sharp.
*Applies a poison effect to enemies.
*When the number of wounds increases, stacking effects are activated up to 5 times.
[Active Skill]
Name: Deadly Poison (Lv 5)
Rating: S
Gives a poisoning effect that reduces the percentage of maximum HP.
Efficiency varies slightly depending on the enemy’s affinity.
A smile that couldn’t be hidden spread across Jaehyun’s mouth, who had always kept a cold expression.
Baek Ji-yeon, who caught the change, looked at Jae-hyun’s face and smiled.
‘As expected, he’s swayed by S-class items. Raiders are such a family.’
While she thought to herself, Jaehyun suddenly took his eyes off the item and asked.
“Well, like this, I want to hear the story in earnest soon.”
“This is all the story.”
At Baek Ji-yeon’s words, Jae-hyun laughed in response.
“I don’t think you would believe it.”
Jaehyun was fixing his clothes.
“so. What the hell is the reason for making such a proposal to me, who is only a cadet, with an S-class item?
If you don’t want to talk, I’ll get up first.”
It’s something I’ve always been curious about.
Of course, Jaehyun’s downfall, midterm exam, theme dungeon, freshman hunt, etc. It is true that the ransom price skyrocketed through repeated incidents.
However, it is by no means sufficient to make such a suggestion.
A contract with an S-class item.
This was a level that could only be done when the S-class radar was pulled out.
‘Obviously there is an ulterior motive.’
Jaehyun made a clear conclusion.
After waiting for a while, Baek Ji-yeon clapped her hands and smiled.
“Are you getting more and more greedy? i know? Min Jaehyun Raider is a really fun person.
how is it. Do you often hear this?”
“Sometimes.”
Baek Ji-yeon nodded.
“great. Let me tell you. Why am I approaching you.”
Jaehyun swallowed his saliva. What is the purpose of an alternative curator?
why did you approach me?
After a moment of silence, Baek Ji-yeon broke the rhyme with a light smile.
“Our curators would like to establish a relationship with the Radar Management Center.”
“Radar management headquarters.”
“That’s right. I feel like I want to open up with the head office. Even if you look at it like this, I’m in the position of running a merchant guild, so there are a lot of things I care about.”
Jaehyun let out a short laugh.
That was a good enough reason.
The curator is a merchant guild. Inevitably, there was no choice but to have a lot of trading volume. It goes without saying that huge taxes are incurred in this process.
In this case, reproduction can be of great help.
Administrative member of the Radar Management Headquarters. One of its biggest perks is tax cuts.
This was a law that also applied to the guild the member belonged to.
“I understand.”
“Our curator, Jaehyun Min, values Radar very highly. I promise you that you will not regret it if you come.”
As soon as Baek Ji-yeon finished speaking, Kang Ju-yeon handed over the briefcase to Jae-hyun. This file contains the details of the contract.
Jae-hyun kills time by looking at the file pretending to be lost in his thoughts.
[Jaehyun-kun, you can’t go over it! I don’t know much about it, but betraying my faith is something I’m not good at! Besides, spying… Hrungnir will be angry at the grave!]
A voice shouted from Hella.
Jaehyun replied without changing his expression.
[well. It’s because I don’t care about loyalty because it’s inefficient.]
[No way… isn’t it?]
Hella muttered in shock, and Jaehyun smiled.
He opened his heavy mouth and clasped his hands.
“Let’s think about it. Before that, if you let me touch Nidhogg’s fangs just once.”

chapters.title: Chapter 150
chapters.content:
Episode 150. Circle creation (1)
“Of course. Feel free to touch it anyway. He might become a member of our guild, so he can’t be stingy, can he?”
When Baek Ji-yeon readily agreed, Jae-hyun replied with a smile on his face.
“Thank you for your consideration.”
‘it’s okay.’
Jaehyun stretched out his hand and lightly squeezed the S-class item in front of his eyes.
The dagger that wrapped around the palm of the hand exuded energy that simply said it was excellent. It is large enough to replace the mana blade that Jaehyun usually makes.
The sharpness of the black blade boasted a phenomenal level even at first glance. Maybe a table in a cafe would be torn apart just by touching it.
“It’s a good dagger.”
“Then do you think of our proposal positively?”
As if waiting for Jaehyun’s words, Baek Jiyeon interrupted.
Jaehyun put down his sword with a soft smile and crossed his arms.
“well. I want to go home and think about it some more.”
“…Well, that’s good. It is a matter that does not require a decision to be made right away.”
“Thank you for your understanding. Then I’ll just get up.”
After finishing the conversation, Jaehyun got up and left the cafe first.
* * *
After a while.
Baek Ji-yeon, who was left at the cafe, was lost in thought with her lips bitten.
‘……Something is strange. What was that attitude from before?’
A strange feeling of uneasiness prevailed.
Jaehyun’s last move. It wasn’t too bad.
Kang Joo-yeon, who was sitting next to her, tilted her head and asked.
“Why are you like that, CEO? I think the conversation ended well.”
“It’s Min Jaehyun. Isn’t something strange?”
“yes? What?”
Kang Joo-yeon couldn’t help but be embarrassed. Why is Baek Ji-yeon suddenly saying something like that?
Didn’t the conversation a little while ago end well?
“No, no matter how you look at it, it’s strange. attitude at the end. It wasn’t anything out of the ordinary, and he showed me an S-class artifact, so why did he get up and go home without looking at it for a long time?”
“That’s… that’s definitely strange.”
Jooyeon Kang agrees and nods her head. Baek Ji-yeon quickly became a distraught face.
“Is there something up to you?”
“We don’t know yet, but even if there is a problem with the contract, there is nothing more we can do. Even the offer I made now has already far exceeded the limit.”
As Kang Joo-yeon said, I had no choice but to wait.
I hope I can get my hands on Jaehyun somehow.
I have no choice but to pray.
* * *
On the other hand, unlike Baek Ji-yeon, Jae-hyeon returned home with a very relaxed mind.
He entered the room, holding a dagger with a familiar look in his hand and smiling.
“I never thought I’d get this here.”
Jaehyun had an S-class dagger in his hand. He nodded his head while watching 《Nidhogg’s Fang》.
Baek Ji-yeon. A little while ago, she tried to coax herself as a curator through the medium of a dagger, but that was an obvious mistake.
Jaehyun’s skill. 《Formation of Magic Tools》.
This is a fraudulent skill that allows you to implement any item you have ever touched. There is a downside that the power is somewhat lowered, but this was not a big problem for Jaehyun.
“When I put up an S-class item as a condition for the first time, I couldn’t believe it, but… I thought I would be able to touch a real item.”
Thanks to this, Jaehyun fulfilled the conditions for making Nidhogg’s fangs.
In future battles, the poisoning effect and the collaboration of daggers will be of great help.
“Anyway, I’m sure you’ll be anxious about that side as well. I need to contact you.”
Jaehyun smiled and took out his smartphone and called Seongjae Park.
[hello. This is Park Seong-jae.]
Park Seong-jae’s voice on the phone was extremely tense. It seemed like he knew the reason, but Jaehyun continued talking without showing off.
“I have something to tell you.”
[…….]
The reply was late for some reason. The moment Jaehyun was about to open his mouth, Park Seongjae jumped in and quickly intervened.
[……Jaehyun-kun. please. Can’t you somehow remain in the Yeonhwa Guild?]
‘As expected. Judging from the fact that the words came out first, it seems that the curator went to Yeon-hwa first. My prediction was correct.’
Jaehyun smiled lightly.
“no way. What are you saying?”
[…… Yes?]
“I had no intention of going to Yeonhwa from the beginning.”
[Is that really? I saw you had a conversation with the Curators Guild… oh that’s it. I didn’t see it secretly, I was just passing by…….]
Seongjae Park stammered at Jaehyun’s words.
Jaehyun laughed.
“I know you’ve been shadowing me. Did you know that I didn’t know that?”
[…….]
It was after Jaehyun switched the phone with his other hand.
“The teacher is also listening to the phone call from behind, right? We all know each other, so let’s talk about it without hiding it.”
[……Like!]
I knew it would be like this. Jaehyun thought and sat on the bed.
“As I said just now, I have no thoughts of transferring. Yeonhwa has been so good to me, can I fall for one S-class artifact?”
[Can you tell me the main point instead of just talking around the corner?]
Yoo Sung-eun said that, probably because she had already noticed Jae-hyun’s dark intentions.
Jaehyun nodded.
“In exchange for me staying at Yeonhwa, there is one condition.”
[……okay. I’d rather feel comfortable that way.]
This time, Yoo Seong-eun’s voice came directly. It was after Jaehyun took a deep breath.
“The next event at Milles Academy. outdoor lodging. I would like to adjust the schedule a bit.”
[…Does that have anything to do with staying in the Yeonhwa Guild? It’s good for you.]
Yoo Sung-eun immediately asked as if he didn’t understand.
Jaehyun raised an eyebrow in response.
“yes. great.”
* * *
Time flies by quickly and it’s time to return to school.
After putting his private clothes and various items in a large trunk, Jaehyun put them back into his inventory. Not having to carry heavy objects was one of the Awoken’s advantages.
It was a short ride from Seoul to Daegu via the portal.
Jaehyun walked for a while and stood in front of the main gate of Milles Academy.
The inside was already noisy. Of course, Jaehyun knew why.
‘It’s finally the circle promotion period. I’m sure there will be troublesome things.’
Circle promotion period.
One month before joining the official circle. It refers to the period during which cadets can create circles or experience the facilities and systems of other circles in advance. It is convenient to think of it as a kind of experiential learning period.
“Come to our circle! Among the graduates, there are four B-class raiders!”
“Come to our Straits Circle! There are many benefits because it is a circle made by the master of the currently hot Haesin Guild!”
“In our circle…….”
A scene not very different from the solicitation of customers in the marketplace. Jaehyun looked around as if he was curious and started walking when he suddenly heard a man’s voice heading towards him.
“Min Jaehyun. I was waiting.”
“What are you doing?”
Jaehyun looked at the person who was talking to him and said.
A somewhat familiar face. But I couldn’t remember who it was.
The time when he was trying to recall his thoughts while searching his memory.
The man in front of me frowned.
“Don’t you know me?”
“Are you overly self-conscious? It doesn’t look particularly good.”
Jaehyun couldn’t help but say that without even knowing it.
It was Jaehyun who dealt with the S-class Raider Balak not too long ago. But what about a guy who is just an academy cadet? don’t you know who i am?
The moment Jaehyun was about to say another word.
“I am Jeonghyun. It’s the circle leader of the circle style. I want to recruit you.”
‘Ah, I just remembered.’
Jaehyun smiled faintly.
‘Junghyun. It is a special talent that will grow to S rank as the representative of Circle Yu.’
It was he who had excellent leadership as much as his skills. Later, he joined Haesin, the strongest guild in the martial arts world, and there was an article about him coming out of Haesin to establish his own guild.
‘Now that I’ve returned, I don’t know what the future will be like.’
In fact, knowing the future did not change Jaehyun’s answer.
“I’m sorry, but I’m not going to Yu. Would it be all right if I go then?”
At Jaehyun’s words, Junghyun didn’t waver at all and just raised the corner of his mouth.
He grabbed Jaehyun’s shoulder as he passed him and opened his magic a little.
“I want you to think about it again.”
“I think it’s a far cry from asking you to reconsider. no way.”
Seeing Jeong-hyeon gripping his shoulders, Jae-hyeon released his mana without losing.
“Would you like to be embarrassed here?”
Jaehyun laughed. Exhalation wells up in Jung-hyeon’s eyes as he calmly sits down. Magic power bursting out at the same time.
But that was then.
“hey! Jung Hyun! I said! You’re going to fail because your personality is a bitch. haha. yeah good idea Min Jaehyun, you should join our circle.”
Kang Joo-hyeop. The circle leader, who boasts of being second in martial arts, intervened.
Of course, it was the face in Jaehyun’s memory.
Jaehyun seems to be annoying and tries to ignore them both.
“no! Min Jae-Hyun will be recruited from our Seong-Eun!”
From behind, Han Jian, the head of the Sung Eun Circle, intervened.
It was a real bummer.
Jaehyun opened his mouth, barely holding back the pounding in his head.
“I’m sorry. I don’t get into any circles.”
Jaehyun’s words fell heavily.
The circle leaders who have gathered to recruit him are visibly agitated. What do you mean by that? You say you won’t join the circle?
Jeong-hyeon frowned and stepped forward.
“You’re not going to join the Circle. The kids’ circles here are all outstanding. Not necessarily where I am, but everything is great.”
“Are there any other circles you’ve already decided to join?”
Han Jian carefully asked. Jaehyun shook his head.
“no. I…”
Everyone’s eyes turned to Jaehyun. Jaehyun smiled and added.
“I’m thinking of making a circle myself.”
* * *
After a while.
After finishing all the morning lectures, the group gathered at the hideout.
They are about to be taken aback after hearing Jaehyun’s declaration.
“……so. Min Jaehyun, you will create a new circle. You mean this?”
Kim Yu-jung looked at Jae-hyun as if she was dumbfounded and asked.
Jaehyun nodded his head with a smile on his face.
“What is that? You all wanted to be in the same circle as me anyway.”
“hey. No matter how it is…….”
“I think you already know… but there are many cases where Milles’ circles are basically created by current students. Is it okay for freshmen to make it? Like a disadvantage.”
It was Ahn Ho-yeon’s question. Jaehyun nodded.
“of course. There’s no rule that says freshmen shouldn’t make circles. Thoroughly skilled. Besides, most students who are already enrolled won’t be able to deal with us, so what’s the problem?”
Jaehyun said in a high-pitched voice. However, the expression of others was not good.
“Ah, no matter how much … Would you like to be checked by other circles?”
It was Jaesang Lee’s question. Recently, he had not joined another circle after leaving the circle because of work overlaps due to the opening of a workshop.
“That doesn’t matter as long as your skills are different. My brother is worried too much.”
Jaehyun was still calm. The group could only nod their heads.
‘Because Jaehyun’s skills are already at the top level even compared to existing radars.’
At least grade A. That was the realm of reenactment. At least there was no room for doubt about his skills.
Silence flows for a while. This time Seo Ina asked.
“……Have you already thought of something? There are few instructors who know freshmen, so it is difficult to rent a circle room, and there will be many difficult things. It’s better to join another circle now…”
A practical matter. No matter how good a freshman is, a problem like this is difficult.
Networking. No matter how much Jaehyun is a first-class cadet, it’s hard to solve these networking problems…
“You guys know that, right? I have a deep connection with the chairman.”
The faces of the party, who had forgotten forgot, suddenly brightened at Jaehyun’s words that suddenly fell.
Jaehyun has a close relationship with Instructor Jiyeon Kim. In addition, he is the first negotiator of the Yeonhwa Guild and at the same time the direct follower of Yoo Seongeun.
‘Maybe…….’
‘If we do well…’
‘…It might be possible.’
‘Jae Jae-hyun is amazing!’
Everyone looked at Jaehyun with admiring eyes.
“I will make a formal offer.”
Jaehyun looked around at his colleagues with a light smile.
“how is it? Everyone. Do you want to join my circle?”
The group’s eyes shone transparently.
The answer was as if it had already been decided.

chapters.title: Chapter 151
chapters.content:
Episode 151 Circle Establishment (2)
“…I want to enter.”
Surprisingly, the answer came back from Seo Ina first. determined expression.
It seems that he wanted to enter the circle with Jaehyun from the beginning.
‘What am I? A great welcome.’
Even when he first went through the simulated dungeon incident with Seo In-na, Jae-hyeon thought that he shouldn’t be involved with her anymore. that he might block her path.
Maybe you’ll get involved in something dangerous and hurt yourself.
It was the same with other colleagues.
Lee Jae-sang, Ahn Ho-yeon, Kim Yoo-jung, a bit ambiguous, but even Seo Ah-hyun. Jaehyun was afraid of hurting them because of him.
Because of this, I have always tried not to have a deep relationship. Because when you have a deep relationship, you have to reveal your shame and secrets.
This was too difficult for Jaehyun, who had feelings of distrust towards others.
So I was about to give up. He did not build interpersonal relationships and ran self-righteously.
But now I seemed to know.
You cannot reach what you want in this way.
Jaehyun finally realized that simple truth.
‘Protect power somehow. I won’t let anyone die.’
Jaehyun made up his mind and nodded.
Soon after, the rest of the party replied as if there was nothing to worry about.
“I’ll go in too.”
“If it’s okay with me too…”
“I’ll go in too. But you said you were going to do this anyway, so when you called back then, did you bounce?
I knew you really had a bad personality, but…….”
Kim Yoo-jung’s last nagging was heard with one ear as always.
Jaehyun opened his mouth looking at his colleagues.
“Welcome everyone to the circle I created.”
“……But I have a question, what will you name your circle by any chance?”
It was Seo Ina’s question. Jaehyun smiled and added.
“I’ve already decided on a name for the circle.”
Jaehyun raised his head.
“The circle name is……”
* * *
“The document you mentioned here.”
Jaehyun handed the documents to Chairman Jiyeon Kim and said, Files for circle creation.
It was written by Jaehyun himself as soon as he heard about the intentions of his colleagues.
Kim Ji-yeon reached out and accepted the file and said.
“We will take care of it right away. It won’t take long. It will take two days.”
Jaehyun nodded.
‘As expected, I have connections and I need to see them. It’s going smoothly.’
Currently, the place where Jaehyun arrives and has a conversation is none other than the director’s office of Milles Academy.
A place that had been used by Jain Gu in the past and was filled with white-toned crazy furniture.
However, now it has become a place that is no different from a second hideout for reappearance.
‘Chairman Kim Ji-yeon is a member of the radar management headquarters, and I am also a radar belonging to the headquarters.’
It is a situation where Kim Ji-yeon, the chairman of the board, cannot help but pay attention to Jae-hyun.
Looking back, it was all thanks to Jaehyun and Yeonhwa Guild that he got to where he is now.
She would have no choice but to care a little.
‘I’ll do any request. I won’t be able to refuse even if it’s a bit unreasonable.’
Jaehyun laughed to himself and began to plan how to rip off the academy.
I decided to use everything that was available anyway.
I had no intention of wanting to be at the convenience of others here.
After thinking for a while, Kim Ji-yeon, who was suddenly looking through the documents, asked.
“……The circle name is Nine? Does it have any special meaning?”
“It doesn’t mean much. It’s just my favorite number.”
“okay.”
Kim Ji-yeon nodded without asking deeply.
She continued to read the paper, then suddenly stopped in one place and opened her eyes wide.
Kim Ji-yeon raised her head and asked.
“By the way, I expected the other cadets to be Jaehyun’s colleagues… did you really recruit this cadet into the circle?”
The place Kim Ji-yeon pointed at was the area where the founding member was written.
There was a familiar name written on it.
Soyul Kwon.
He was a second-year cadet with the unique skill 《Search》, and he had a good relationship with Jaehyun.
Why is she trying to move a circle when she is already in a circle with a name?
Didn’t he even fall out with Jaehyun because of the freshman hunt?
Kim Ji-yeon asks a curious question.
Jaehyun nodded his head as if it were natural.
“Sure.”
“But wasn’t cadet Kwon So-yul on good terms with Jae-hyun? It was the same during the freshman hunt…
I can still clearly see that when I entered the common martial arts class before, I was screaming that I would kill you right away.”
‘……You said something like that. this old man is real See you later.’
Unlike the inside, Jaehyun replied with a smile on the outside.
“no way. It’s all in the past. It’s been a long time since I forgot. and.”
Kim Ji-yeon tilted her head at Jae-hyun’s naturally virtuous tone.
Jaehyun was
“I’m pretty good at persuasion.”
* * *
Circle Seed’s Circle Room.
Shin Jun-sang frowned and shouted at Kwon So-yul, who was packing his personal belongings.
A harsh voice reverberated from inside the circle room to the outside.
“so. Are you really going to leave our circle? Even the guy who fucked us in freshman hunt. Min Jae-hyun is going to move to a new circle?!”
“okay. But what does that have to do with you?
“Does that make sense?! Suddenly, there was something in the middle, so it’s like this?”
“It’s on my mind, so shut up. before I kill you.”
Kwon So-yul responded coldly, packed his bags, and left the circle room.
‘It’s annoying.’
Kwon So-yul clicked his tongue and put his hand in his pocket.
After all, my heart was hardened. There was no reason to listen to such a worthless bastard anymore. I already knew there was no vision of this place. There was no reason to stay.
‘Anyway, Min Jae-hyun. He’s a great guy. You’re a freshman, you’re at the level of A, and you’ve already secured your academy connections…’
She smiled bitterly as she recalled her conversation with Jaehyun during the midterm exam.
It was when the moonlight fireflies went hunting.
[so. What do you propose to me?]
[Come into the circle I will create.]
[……Circle? Are you kidding? You’re going to make a circle on the freshman topic? No matter how good your skills are…]
[I’m saying this because I can. What kind of connections do you have? I’ve made all the plans, so don’t worry and just come. As long as you’re a senior, I’ll support you with anything I need.]
[Why do you do this to me?]
[It’s a unique skill.]
[……You’re really filthy honest?]
[That’s right. But you won’t regret it.]
How many people can’t trust Jaehyun’s words?
So far, he has risen to the present position by destroying the history of the academy. Mock Dungeon New Student Hunt. In all kinds of events, Jaehyun stood out.
However, even with these stories, Kwon So-yul could not easily make a decision about moving the circle.
‘Because Circle Seed was great too. I thought there was no reason to move. But… after hearing the story, I changed my mind.’
Kwon So-yul looked back at the circle room and bit his lip as if it was dirty.
It was because Jaehyun had recently heard all the conversations they had about him.
[Kwon So-yul? He’s honestly a search shuttle. I can’t even fight properly, so what kind of radar is that? It’s just like my halo. It’s like a device to stand out.]
[Your face looks smooth too. I’ll have to pry it up later Maybe not? How will it work?]
[Fuck. Don’t approach me because I’ve pointed it out. Before I kill the group.]
These were the details of the conversation between the circle leader, the members, and the trusted Shin Jun-sang.
Jaehyun passed on the conversation details and audio files to her to convince him.
Kwon So-yul couldn’t help but be embarrassed. No, it was unfair before that. He has been devoted to Sid so far. Even if it wasn’t a situation that was revealed on the outside, I tried to grow the circle.
But is their reaction now the result of their efforts?
The look of those who just see themselves as a tool. Kwon So-yul was disappointed with this.
“Dirty bastards.”
No more emotions left. the size of their circle. That was my only regret, but now I know that it’s nothing more than an illusion.
“Because he’ll break it soon.”
Kwon So-yul smiled and left. Shin Jun-sang, who had been following her with dazed eyes, frowned and called somewhere.
Undoubtedly, Jaehyun was up to something.
Such thoughts were simmering in his mind.
* * *
“Now everyone is here. All six members from the beginning.”
As Jaehyun crossed his arms and said, the five circle members sitting around nodded.
It was a place for light greetings, but I already know your face.
It became just a gathering for friendship under the guise of greetings.
“I knew that I had connections, but… I couldn’t believe you were one of the shareholders of Studio Elixir.”
Kwon So-yul looked around the meeting room on the second floor of the Studio Elixir building.
He was weak because he was intimidated by the murmur of his voice.

Episode 152 Hell Training (1)
“Hello. Dear viewers watching the World Radar Issues Channel. Today, we have two panels to discuss the mysterious grave robbery that took place in the great ruins of Iceland a few days ago.

“yes. Nice to meet you.”
“……Nice to meet you.”
The scene where the TV live broadcast is in full swing. The main point of discussion was the great ruins of Iceland, which were famously robbed not long ago.
Ballack and Camilla were invited to a panel on the program to hear about the incident because they were on the scene during the incident.
However, the reaction of the audience surrounding them was not good enough that the word invitation was colorless. The reason was simple.
‘Because they are suspicious of the European Union because of what happened at the time of the Great Ruins Robbery.’
Balak let out a sigh.
Since it was a broadcast with a free atmosphere, there were no special restrictions on behavior, but it was clear that it was a violation of etiquette.
Camilla noticed, but he didn’t even look at it.

The audience had their own reasons for showing the way they are now.
At the time of the massive tomb robbery. Why couldn’t the European Union stop the grave robbers even though there were as many as two S-class raiders on the scene?
Besides, ruins were robbed in the stronghold of the Alliance?
Truly absurd news.
It was not unreasonable that the citizens who heard this were puzzled.
furthermore.
Recently, reporters from various countries have been writing malicious articles about the European Union and accusing them of being criminals.
There was a conspiracy theory that the two S-class raiders and the European Union intentionally stole artifacts from the great ruins, and such rumors were spreading rapidly.
However.
‘It’s all bullshit.’
It was an absurd rumor that made Balak and Camilla burst into laughter.
A raider whose identity they dealt with is unknown. He was the owner of outstanding skills to the extent that the depth could not be known.
As S-class raiders, it was dangerous to fight such a monster while protecting their comrades.
Even Balak said. Even that, he said he survived because the mysterious man looked after him.
If that statement is really true, it was an issue that would bring great disturbance to the radar world.
No matter how you think about it, it’s hard to see the man who dug up the ruins as a good man, because each country had to negotiate and come up with an important plan to stop him and stop the mysterious man.
Measures must be taken as soon as possible.
That was Ballack and Camilla’s idea.
……but.
“This is a question that may be rude to the two of you, but there was a lot of controversy at the time of this robbery incident.”
The moderator sorted out the questions written on the card, let go of the rhyme, and then alternately looked at Balak and Camilla.
“Why couldn’t the great ruins be defended even though there were two S-class raiders?
These two issues are the main controversies mentioned among viewers recently. Would it be okay if I ask what you think about this?”
“I have nothing more to say. It is our tribe.”
Camilla responded calmly. Their purpose was obvious.
Writing provocative articles by inducing them to say unfavorable things to them.
Even if the raiders risk their lives to go to the frontlines, the next day’s headlines will include titles such as ‘Dozens die in dungeon break… Is the European Union’s incompetence okay?’
Camilla let out a small breath and looked at Balak.
In fact, it is not that there is no way to end the controversy produced by the moderators and viewers here.
Balak confessing everything that happened at the time.
However, this was difficult.
‘There’s no way Balak would admit his defeat. In a public setting, an S-class raider speaks of his lack of ability? He is even the representative of the European Union, which is said to be one of the strongest in the world?’
No matter how you think about it, it was impossible.
Camilla shook her head to get rid of her thoughts, but the host suddenly cleared her throat before opening her mouth again.
“Next question.”
He was holding on to a fishy sneer.
“The Japanese Self-Defense Forces and the US government are increasingly criticizing the failures of the European Union. You bought the right to capture the great ruins and boasted about the capture, but are you sorry that things turned out like this?”
“Are you sorry?”
Balak narrowed his eyes and looked at the host as if he were going to kill him.
Know. This is a low-key guiding newspaper.
U.S. government and Japanese vigilantes. These are people with forces almost equal to the European Union, and they would have been looking for an opportunity to bite the union’s failures like now.
‘A dirty joke to manipulate public opinion.’
Camilla, too, chewed her lips in indignation.
If they really cared about citizens, the world situation would not be as dizzy as it is now. Radar and the media, which are currently voicing their voices, have almost died, and this was all done by the media of each country.
Unbearable, Balak jumped up from his seat.
I couldn’t stand them spitting out trash anymore. He showed his teeth to the moderator and was clear.
“That’s right. I’m sorry. But one thing must be made clear.”
The audience’s eyes widen and their attention is focused on Balak.
He was nonstop.
“We, the European Union, have done our best. To protect the great ruins.”
“Then why was the great ruin robbed?”
The moderator seemed to have waited. Balak raised one corner of his mouth.
“I am that man. I was defeated by a mysterious man.”
“yes?”
“The battle was fought and swords crossed. However, I couldn’t beat him.”
“You, Balak, one of the strongest in the world, have been defeated?”
The host muttered in shock.
Camilla was also shocked.
‘It’s the first time I’ve seen Balak admit his defeat…’
Camilla had been with him even before he reached S rank. I also did a lot of sparring.
However, it was the first time I had ever seen Balak readily admit his defeat as he does now.
What was the change in his image, what did he go through in the fight with that man, and why did he change like that?
‘What the hell happened…’
“Camilla.”
Ballack’s voice interrupted suddenly.
Urgently coming to her senses, she quickly nodded in agreement.
“I will vouch for it. Balak was defeated by a mysterious man and I was unable to completely stop him either.”
“Camilla and the European Union have done their best. If you ask for responsibility, you will have to ask me, the representative.
Just make sure you know one thing.”
Balak took Camilla’s words. He raised his head with his fists clenched.
“The man in the black robe we dealt with. He seemed to have a purpose. You may be watching this show right now. And…
the next target might be the United States and Japan, not us.”
Balak sneered.
“I hope you take care of yourself.”
* * *
TV Program World Radar Issue Channel.

Even before the return, Jaehyun would often watch channels like this to study world radar trends.
Of course, I never thought that a story about myself would come out all of a sudden.
“by the way. For a proud Ballack, he readily admitted his defeat.
You seemed to be very unhappy that day.”
Jae-hyun recalled the fight with Balak at the great ruins in the past.
At that time, he succeeded in defeating Balak by using various tricks (?) including Balmung.
“Well, luck is skill.”
Few people can say that they are lucky even after winning the S-class raider, but Jaehyun knew very well that his victory was a fluke.
S-class level. This was a high mountain that Jaehyun had to climb now.
A wall that has not yet been crossed even after clearing the Great Ruins and securing all kinds of advantages.
To overcome this, Jaehyun was still working hard.
“You have to let your colleagues grow up enough.”
Recently he founded his own academy Circle Nine. It’s still only a temporary stage, but the next circle will be of great help to Jaehyun. The circle of Milles Academy that exerts great influence on various political situations and media.
Among them, the S-class circle was treated the same as the B-class raider guild. It was an unspoken proof that he was no longer at the level of a cadet.
“First, develop and establish the circle. And we have to make sure the kids can fend for themselves.”
Soon Heimdall will attack him. It was natural for him to take care of the safety of the people around him when he thought of his situation in which Jae-hyun could not be killed by the power of prophecy.
In the case of the mother, it is a situation where Hella’s black magic can somehow hide it, but the rest of the colleagues do not have the conditions.
It is difficult to fight while protecting everyone with Jaehyun’s current skills.
At present, the ideal method is to develop one’s allies sufficiently so that they can at least escape their own danger from the coming threat.
“My role is one. It is to open an avenue for our comrades to escape.”
For this, rapid growth was essential.
Jaehyun had already planned all the plans and now only had to put them into practice.
“Outdoor camping event. Most cadets are at one of two crossroads here.”
Either grow rapidly or realize your limitations and quit the academy.
However, Jaehyun wasn’t worried. Because none of his colleagues would announce that he would quit the academy and return home.
“Then let’s start slowly.”
Hell training in preparation for the camp. All preparations for reenactment have been completed.
* * *
The next day. after afternoon classes.
Jaehyun summoned all the freshmen.
“so. What is the reason you summoned us like this?”
It was Ahn Ho-yeon’s question. Jaehyun smiled and looked around.
This is Yeonhwa Guild’s secret training ground. This is the place where Jae-hyeon rented it for a while with the permission of Yoo Seong-eun.
For reference, at Jaehyun’s suggestion, Sungeun Yoo very readily accepted the rental of the training ground.
[what? If you need it, I’ll give you a secret gym or something.]
Thanks to Jaehyun, Ahn Ho-yeon, Kim Yoo-jung, and Seo In-na, all four of us gathered together.
It was for training to be active in the outdoor training camp to be held later.
Jaehyun cleared his throat and let go.
“There is only one reason why I called you to Yeonhwa Guild’s training ground. It’s to prepare for the outdoor training camp that will begin soon.”
“wow! Is this really made of arc metal?! They said it was very expensive!”
“……Kim Yoo-jung?”
“Oh sorry. I am so excited.”
Kim Yoo-jung scratched her head. Hagin Yeonhwa Guild’s training ground. Even so, the number of people who can set foot in the secret training ground can be counted on one hand.
If you’re not curious about being here, that’s even weirder.
‘I thought there were less than 10 people including the people involved in the construction, but maybe.’
Jaehyun laughed as he recalled the boasts that Yooseong secretly shared in the past.
Unbeknownst to her, she secretly enjoyed flaunting herself and the Yeonhwa Guild. Perhaps this was part of a strategy to keep Jaehyun from paying attention to other guilds.
“so.”
Jaehyun shook his head and lightly brushed away his thoughts.
“Our circle has just begun. I’ll get Yeonhwa’s support, and honestly, I’ll be able to borrow the power of Instructor Jiyeon Kim, the chairman of the board.
But I can’t go long that way.”
“…well, that’s for sure.”
Kim Yoo-jung agreed. Ahn Ho-yeon also nodded and crossed his arms.
“Anyway, Milles Academy is a strictly skill-oriented academy. It’s not that you don’t need connections, but if you lean too much on it, you’ll get into trouble later.”
“…In the first place, I hate being judged for things other than my skills.”
Seo In-na also wrapped her arms around her and gave a helping hand.
Jaehyun was Joo Eok.
“okay. But I’ll be honest. Your skills are not yet high enough to beat the top ranks of the senior year. Of course, he is gifted with natural talent, but he is still in the 1st to 5th place among freshmen. It is true that it is regrettable by the standards of current students.”
“That’s right.”
“From now on, all the circle members will train together. you said before How was I able to grow in such a short period of time? From now on, watch me and follow me. Then you will know what to do.”
“oh……!”
Ahn Ho-yeon admired. Kim Yoo-jung made a satisfied expression and burned her passion.
“Finally, Min Jae-hyun’s secret notebook is revealed…! To be honest, it was a bit embarrassing to be honest…!”
“……Should I tell you?”
“no.”
Kim Yoo-jung immediately denied it and laughed bashfully.
When I turned my head, Seo Eana’s expression also hardened. It seems that they have not been satisfied with the speed of their growth lately.
‘Well, since I’m next to you, it has to be.’
Of course, it is impossible for them to keep up with Jaehyun’s growth rate.
In the first place, the system they used was different, and in Jaehyun’s case, he was constantly overcoming his limitations by gaining opportunities.
It was embarrassing even compared to other cadets or raiders.
“Then Jaehyun, what are you planning to teach me? Is there anything you can teach me, a martial artist?”
Ahn Ho-yeon asked with anticipation.
Jaehyun tilted his head as if it was strange and replied.
“huh? What do you mean? When did I say I was teaching you unilaterally? I will learn a lot from you too.”

Kim Yoo-jung and Seo Eana’s reaction was worth watching. Ahn Ho-yeon also didn’t seem to understand right away.
Isn’t it a representation that is at least four or five times stronger than them?

However, whether he knew their feelings or not, Jaehyun was just smiling.
“Then, training for the outdoor camp begins. And there. Senior Kwon So-yul, please come in quickly. Don’t hide there secretly.”
“……Tch.”
As a result, all members of the circle except for Lee Jae-sang, a non-combatant, and Seo Ah-hyun, a middle school student, gathered.
It was the beginning of full circle training.

In this event, where a wide field must be searched, the pie for Kwon So-yul to play an active role is very large.

Director of the new academy.

Public opinion management.

Jaehyun thinks Suddenly, Kim Ji-yeon’s voice begins to follow.

Each of you must move with the members of your circle, and each circle is given nothing but survival kits.
In order to survive, you must actively use the information you have learned at the academy to hunt the monsters. However, to be safe, you must not stray within a radius of 20km from our headquarters here. Violation of this will result in immediate disqualification.”
An overview of basic safety and survival kits. What followed was the full-fledged rules of the outdoor training camp.
“There are a total of two things you need to do during the week.
first. Stay alive. Although this is a shallow area of the field, it is a dangerous place for you, the cadets. If you survive here, you have what it takes to be a good raider.
second. During the time limit, cooperate with each other to hunt as many monsters as possible and collect the tokens. Of course, the higher the grade of the beast, the greater the bonus, so be careful of injuries in the process.”
“What should I do if there is an emergency?”
A girl who had been listening to Kim Ji-yeon silently raised her hand and said.
The familiar face seemed to be that of a freshman in the first year.
Kim Ji-yeon replied with a benevolent smile.
“Do not worry. There will be instructors stationed nearby. If a dangerous situation arises, immediately report it to the instructors instead of hiding it. The most important thing is your safety.
Then, if there are no more questions, this is the end of the description of the outdoor training camp.
I wish you all the best of luck.”
After the last words, the gathered cadets spread out and gather in circles.
Since Jaehyun’s circle had been gathered from the beginning, there was no need to move separately.
“For now, let’s move as we planned the strategy.”
Kwon So-yul nodded at Jae-hyun’s words and asked again.
“Find a place to camp and clean up the surroundings. Then, the full-scale demon subjugation. Right?”
“You have a good memory.”
“Don’t make fun of seniors.”
Kwon So-yul said in a sharp tone.
Jaehyun waved his hands moderately and went forward to receive the survival kit.
The contents are about minimal survival items and light tools. There was also a walkie-talkie that could directly contact the instructor in case of a problem. According to the description, it has been processed with high-strength magical power, so it is said that it will not break even with an attack of 10 tons.
Unfortunately, there was no food included. Since the monsters in the shallow area can be eaten after cooking, they are not stored separately in the kit.
To think he had to cook and eat the monsters he hunted. It was dark in front of their eyes, but Seo Eana was there for Circle Nine.
It probably won’t be a big problem unless you tell them to chew the iron.
“Jaehyun, then where should we start?”
Ahn Ho-yeon asked, but Seo E-na cut off the conversation.
“……wait for a sec. Can’t you feel the gaze over there?”
Seo Ina was pointing her hand in one direction. In fact, Jaehyun had already felt the blatant magic for a long time.
At the end of her gaze were familiar faces. Jaehyun raised an eyebrow.
‘Circle Seed. It seems that the other side decided to check us? It must be because he took senior Kwon So-yul with him. It’s clumsy anyway.’
A few days ago, Jaehyun succeeded in stealing member Kwon Soyul from Sid. It was already expected that there would be friction with them in this process.
‘Well, at least it’s at the level of a cadet.’
Jaehyun laughed. It doesn’t matter how strong they are to him.
It was self-evident that even if Jeong-hyeon, who is now called the strongest of Miles, came, he would not be able to defeat him.
Even though Kwon So-yul knew that it happened because of him, he seemed not to care too much.
“You don’t have to worry anyway. Min Jaehyun, you are much stronger than them.”
“That’s right…”
Jaehyun smiled lightly at those words.
“of course.”

Episode 159 Outdoor Camp (2)
Some distance away from Circle Nine where Jae-hyun belongs.

To give him such a humiliation? Jaehyun’s existence was inevitably annoying to Lim Seongho, who was obsessed with the idea of the chosen people.
‘I need to dampen Min Jae-hyeon’s growth once.’
Just taking Kwon So-yul away doesn’t mean raising a dispute.
Seongho Lim had the ability to read the current edition.
Currently, Jaehyun is a super rookie who is constantly mentioned on TV and various media.
Already, some are claiming that he has far surpassed the level of a student and can do his part even if he is immediately put into the front line.
In fact, it is only a matter of time before Jaehyun reaches the level of S-class.
Lim Seong-ho was also aware of this, but it was also an opportunity for himself.
‘What if Circle Seed beat Min Jae-hyun even once? If that’s the case, it’s not enough to diminish the guy’s reputation, and he can persuade Kwon So-yul back to Sid.
Where is that? The media will also pay attention to our circle.’
If that is the case, there is a high probability that talented freshmen will also apply as seeds.
Jung Hyeon’s Yoo, Han Ji-an’s Seong-eun, Kang Joo-hyeop’s Aran, Chae Ji-yoon’s 3rd Eye, etc.

he nodded and said.

It is Jaehyun who possesses the S-class magic, Frozen Earth. What if you get attacked again due to a mistake in judgment and get a headwind?
At that time, he would not have been able to show his face to the academy because of his disgrace.
‘Well, no matter what, the rest of the circle members are freshmen. Kim Yoo-jung and Ahn Ho-yeon and Seo E-na. All of them are great talents, but they are still not enough to deal with current students. It’s a landslide victory for our seed.’
Lim Seong-ho thought so and nodded.
Suddenly, a cheeky voice interrupted from behind him.
“It’s funny, I can’t speak. Humans called seniors are plotting to trample on freshmen in such a dirty way.
Since when did Miles become so political?”
The eyes of the circle members, including Lim Seong-ho and Shin Jun-sang, are narrowed and their eyes are directed to one place.
There was a familiar face there. A recent up-and-coming freshman.
A genius who ranks 4th in the magic world rankings and is said to be the most outstanding outside of Jaehyun’s faction.
It was Lee Soo-hyuk.
He, who was humiliated by Jae-hyun during the AR test in the past, took Jae-hyun’s side for some reason.
* * *
Suhyuk Lee suddenly had that thought.
‘Why am I taking Min Jae-hyun’s side right now?’
He frowned and looked at the ugly seniors in thought for a moment. pathetic. No matter how talented he is, because he is envious of freshmen, planning something like that…
So, while listening to the conversation a while ago, I interrupted without realizing it.
It was never to take Jaehyun’s side.
yes no cancer don’t
‘But what?’
Jaehyun Min is better than that trash.
With that thought in mind, Lee Soo-hyeok did not back down at all and stood upright.
He let out a light breath and slowly recalled the events of the past month.
after the last midterm exam.
As a result, Lee Soo-hyeok completely removed his doubts about Jae-hyun.
A confrontational situation with Guin, who is at the top of the academy’s rank. It was because I was completely influenced by Jaehyun’s spirit.
Jaehyun risked his own destiny to accuse the chairman of the board at the time. Although he was a direct disciple of Yeonhwa, the power Gu Ja-in possessed was something that no one could easily see.
However, Jaehyun did not back down and contributed to uncovering the corruption.
Lee Soo-hyuk, who watched this in real time, couldn’t help but admit it.
‘Min Jaehyun is stronger than me.
……At least for now.’
At least, I was able to properly confirm in the last midterm exam that Jaehyun did not get to where he is now by using shortcuts.
In a situation where no manipulation was possible, Jaehyun freely used A-class and S-class skills. At best, he was learning even B-class skills the hard way.
‘I don’t want to admit it and it’s annoying, but it can’t be helped. You have to accept it.’
At the same time, Lee Soo-hyeok thought.
Seo or Min Jae-hyun. And even Kim Yoo-jung, who is growing rapidly.
He said he would somehow catch up with the magic cadets who performed better than him in midterm exams and make his name appear on TV day and night.
Also, he thought there was only one way to do that.
Being next to Jaehyun and following his training and methods. And then, one step at a time.
Lee Soo-hyeok was thinking of joining Jae-hyun’s circle in order to do so.
If it was according to the original plan.
‘But… he made a circle. Directly on the freshman topic. In addition, he succeeded in recruiting Kwon So-yul, a member of Sid, one of the largest circles on campus, into his own circle.’
It was even Jaehyun who was known to have a bad relationship with her.
But Jaehyun made that possible.
This was proof that he had overwhelming power to attract even those who hated him.
at last.
Lee Soo-hyeok, who couldn’t bear to join Jae-hyun’s circle, decided to join another circle.
As a result, he joined U, the number one club in the school, through an entrance test.
The circle where Jung-hyeon, who came to recruit Jae-hyun a while ago, is the club leader. It was a place that could have a positive impact on Lee Soo-hyuk’s growth.
Kim Min-soo, who had always been around, also managed to join U with a pull-up.
That’s how he joins the circle and prepares for the event.
Suddenly, Lee Soo-hyeok heard it.
The story that Circle Sid was intentionally trying to attack Jaehyun.
It was infuriating. Of course, he is hostile toward Min Jae-hyun. It was heroic to uncover the corruption of the chairman and save the students, but that and personal feelings are different matters.
but. No matter how much it is, the current student is trying to keep the freshman in check in that way. No, I couldn’t just watch the act of soaking.
So Lee Soo-hyeok had no choice but to speak.
“Aren’t you ashamed of the current student subject? If you want to eat radar like that, go out and search.”
After a moment of silence flowed throughout. Lim Seong-ho sighed and said.
“……What do you bastard believe in and act like that? Looks like you joined a good circle?”
To his words, Lee Soo-hyuk responded with a fishy smile.
“I have no intention of hiding behind the circle. But know one thing. You won’t be able to perform well at this event with that mindset.”
“Are you preaching?”
Shin Jun-sang intervened and gnashed his teeth.
That wild freshman didn’t know that he was afraid of his senior and jumped at him.
“Hey hey…… What are you fighting over all of a sudden?! those seniors? sorry. He’s a bit of a brawler, so he’s good at arguing…”
Kim Min-soo approached, sensing an uneasy atmosphere from a distance, and tried to defuse the situation by intervening, but Im Seong-ho ignored him and continued.
“The cover is missing. You are Lee Soo-hyuk, right? Why are you covering Min Jaehyun? why. Can he be your friend? Or should I ask you to put it in the Yeonhwa Guild?”
“Even if you do such a cowardly thing and enter the guild, what does it mean? Are you sick?”
Kim Min-soo’s expression hardened in an instant. I didn’t think I’d hit it this hard when I said I wouldn’t have an accident for a while.
The seed that Lee Soo-hyeok is now dealing with is a gathering of people who are rumored to be outstanding even within the Milles Academy.
It means that you don’t know what kind of risk you will be taking after you quarrel.
As for Kim Min-soo, he only wanted to quickly sort out the situation somehow.
However, Lee Soo-hyeok seemed to have no such intention.
“Since bastards like you are doing radar, it’s not that the people are swearing at you for being an asshole. You are not even seniors.”
“Ha… Really, if this wasn’t just an event.”
“For now, calm down. No matter how hard he tries
… Suddenly, a man appeared from behind with a raucous voice.
familiar face. Lim Seong-ho saw him and gnashed his teeth.
“Junghyun…… Was Lee Soo-hyuk a member of your U Circle?”
“okay. What’s going on? If our circle members do something wrong, we apologize instead. of course.
If Lee Soo-hyeok really did something wrong.”
“…How long would you not think that Yu could do anything like that? I heard that you also made a recruitment offer to Min Jae-hyun and got rejected.
Junghyun: Do you think it’s okay to leave him alone? that it might cause a stir. You must have known, too.”
However, Jeong-hyeon was stubborn.
“That is not my business. Anyway, we have to go out to society soon. Circles are pretty meaningful on their own, but in the end it’s skill that puts them up on the radar.
You’d better keep that in mind.”
His eyes narrow and a mischievous smile leaks out. From Jung-hyeon’s body, mana that a cadet could not handle was pouring out.
I don’t know if I’ll fall for that magical power.
Lim Seong-ho and Shin Jun-sang, feeling chills running down their spines, eventually turned their heads first.
“I’ll see if I can do that look next time.”
“as you please.”
Jung-hyeon left the passing party alone and looked at Lee Soo-hyeok.
Lee Soo-hyuk clicked his tongue briefly and bowed his head.
“Sorry for causing trouble.”
“never mind. ‘Cause I’ve heard it all before Originally, Sid is a guy who often commits despicable things. From what I can see, you seem to have a good relationship with Min Jae-hyun, but you don’t have to worry too much…” “
No. I’m not familiar with that bastard.”
When Lee Soo-hyeok said that in an unpleasant tone, Jeong-hyeon, embarrassed for nothing, scratched his head.
‘If I’m close, I’ll say it well later, and somehow I tried to flirt with my circle…’
It was the moment when the plan went awry.
Even in the midst of this, Lee Soo-hyeok gnashed his teeth, remembering Min Jae-hyun’s thin face.
‘I can’t help but admit that he’s the best among freshmen. But in the near future, I will pass over my guy.’
Ho Seung-shim stays in his eyes for a short time and then disappears. Kim Min-soo suddenly said, punching him in the head.
“If you act like a dog one more time, I will kill you.”
“……Are you ignoring me too?”
Lee Soo-hyeok gnashed his teeth, but did not add anything else.
He only wanted to repay the debt he owed to Jaehyun during the AR test as soon as possible.
Meanwhile, Jaehyun, who was watching them from behind, tilted his head.
‘Why is Lee Soo-hyuk suddenly taking my side? Am I crazy?’
Jaehyun tut and clicked his tongue at the sight of the garbage guy who was acting like a dog to him before returning to do the laundry.
What the hell did I do wrong, what the fuck?
Jaehyun sighed at the thought.

chapters.content:
Episode 160 Outdoor Camp (3)
There is a reason why Milles Academy is located in Daegu, which has already been in ruins.
Scholars and radar experts explain this and that for various reasons, but the biggest reason was for the restoration of the closed city of Daegu.
Daegu is the first city in the world where the ‘gate’ is opened and numerous demons are rampant.
An underdeveloped area that was taken away first after Yggdrasil appeared. A kind of preliminary preparation for rebuilding this place is the outdoor camp at Miles Academy.
Part of an operation to wipe out nearby demons and recover key bases.
Jaehyun tightened the armor he was wearing and thought for a moment.
‘I heard that Daegu’s gate disaster was really terrible.’
decades ago.
Jae-hyun knew the situation at the time of the tragedy in Daegu in detail.
It was a time when he couldn’t even walk properly, but because his mother, Seonhwa Lee, was from Daegu, he had the opportunity to hear about what happened at the time.
My mother was lucky like this, recalling the time when the incident had occurred.
[That was really a big deal.]
After my hair grew a bit. Jaehyun realized that what his mother said was not an exaggeration.
After entering Miles, I naturally came into contact with the past records of the Daegu incident, because the data I saw at that time were still vivid in my eyes.
Most of the records from the time of the incident have been lost and can no longer be found, but a few photos remain in the museum on the site.
The scenery in the photos Jaehyun saw in the past was truly shocking.
A city burning red.
People lying down on the road and crying, and the red eyes of the demon.
Even the empty pupils of the dying.
‘It was really terrible.’
Jaehyun shook his head.
He recalled a story he heard in class recently.
The textbook of Miles Academy also contains a story about the scene at the time of the incident.
The full text of that section was as follows.
[Decades in the past.]
[The forces of the witches based on the Jungang-ro quickly coalesced and engulfed the entire Daegu.] [
The witches mercilessly killed and killed humans in the endless flames, and humans were crushed like ants. Lost.]
[In the process, tens of thousands of Daegu residents died or were injured and evacuated.
At this time, a human with special power appeared at the end of despair.] [
It was Korea’s first awakened person, Joo-won.]
‘Joo-won… There is no one in the world who doesn’t know. The first Awakener.’
A legendary being known to have worked with Korea’s first S-class raider Lee Jae-shin.
Jaehyun had heard the name Joowon since he was a child and knew it well. There was a time when I admired it. That’s because he was a skilled raider.
However, Joo Won suddenly disappeared several years ago. No one knew what happened, but he probably died fighting the demon. The media made a lot of noise.
Jaehyun thought for a moment and then returned to the case.
Branches sprout from my head, and the content continues.
[Joo-Won obtained the Aesir System, became an Awakener, and confronted the Beast. He started to build a myth by defeating numerous monsters, and people who were influenced by his efforts began to rise.]
[Mysterious power. The Awakeners, including Joo-Won, who obtained the ‘Esir System’, succeeded in stopping the Demon Beast from expanding its power at one point.
The area that was protected at this time is where the current Milles Academy is located.]
[Simply put, Milles Academy is a huge tomb built up with the corpses of senior raiders.]
Well, a war broke out, but where is the land that is not a grave? rolled.
Jaehyun thought about the contents and swung the dagger that was a gimmick wrapped around his waist.
‘When Milles Academy first entered, Daegu was also the first city to deliver support funds. It’s only natural that Miles feels responsible for this.’
Of course, even so, it does not mean that the cadets directly bear the burden.
This is, after all, an adult matter. For academy cadets who are still students, the outdoor camp is just one of the events to be recognized for their abilities.
It is true that the risk is low.
However, carelessness is prohibited.
‘Because the really dangerous thing isn’t the outdoor camp event itself.’
Jaehyun’s lips twitch and ridicule leaks out.
Mighty mana that is barely perceptible. I could feel it from deep inside.
Heimdall. Asgard’s gatekeeper was waiting for him beyond.
‘I’ll break it somehow.’
A sneer lingers on Jaehyun’s lips and then disperses. Over the past week, he’s also gotten pretty strong.
All preparations are complete.
‘The ceiling of Asgard.’
Jaehyun looked down at the ruined city of Daegu with calmly lowered eyes.
The week from now will pass more slowly than ever.
Jaehyun knew this better than anyone else.
* * *
The depths of the closed city. The roof of a destroyed building.
Heimdall, the white god, and Hugin the crow are seen sitting on the watchtower.
The two gathered to discuss the disposition of the antagonist of the prophecy. However, the expression on one side was not very good.
“There must have been a more convenient way to deal with it. You bothered to bring work.”
Hugin was the first to speak.
Heimdall responded with a hearty laugh.
“This is just a brief entertainment. Yes… it’s like an aperitif.”
“Your opponent is the antagonist of the prophecy.”
“Haha Hugin.”
Heimdall, who had been laughing all of a sudden, stopped talking and looked at Hugin with lifeless eyes.
“Do you think a blue human kid can dare to deal with the gatekeeper of Asgard? Or is this Heimdall unreliable?”
“This is what Odin himself instructed.”
Hugin went on like that, not backing down at all. Silence flows for a while. After Heimdall relaxed his expression, he took out a bottle of alcohol from his waistband.
“Would you like a drink?”
“Be careful not to drink while working.”
“You’re not being funny.”
Heimdall gulped down the unstopped liquor in one gulp, then threw the bottle to the floor before he knew it.
It was so high that even the sound of falling was brutal.
Heimdall wiped his mouth with his sleeve and said.
“Don’t worry. We have prepared everything for the enemies of the prophecy.”
“What do you mean?”
Heimdall nodded.
“okay. I used Future Foresight.”
Hugin’s eyes narrowed involuntarily.
《Future Prediction》.
The authority that raised Heimdall to the top of Asgard. Since he did not enjoy using it normally, it was surprising enough for Hugin to show his power against mere humans.
“A week later. The academy’s outdoor camp has begun. Perhaps at that time, the enemy’s allies will flock to this place. Aren’t you looking forward to it? What stains and tramples on your transparent, shining smile?”
Heimdall had a cool expression.
“Don’t worry. Everything will go according to Heimdall’s plan.”
However, Hugin had no choice but to break Heimdall’s colic.
“It must be difficult.”
“……What?”
“The antagonist of the prophecy has begun to move.”
Heimdall immediately frowned at Hugin’s words. He quickly spread his magic and began to search the surroundings.
The radar of magical power that spread like a fan in the ruins of Daegu eventually found a very familiar being with magical power.
antagonist of prophecy.
“The antagonist of the prophecy… Yes. Did I change the future knowing I could see it? It’s fun. Fun!”
Heimdall exploded his madness. Every time he laughs, the ground shakes with magical power and even the upper floors of the buildings collapse.
He raised his head and looked at Hugin.
“My plan remains the same. His strength hasn’t fully recovered yet… but this is enough to give him despair.”
“I look forward to it.”
Hugin lowered his head.
“For the great Odin.”
With those words, Hugin disappeared into the shadows.
* * *
The view of the closed city was almost the same as the first day of the entrance ceremony.
It was a little dark and humid, and the view was obscured by a mist that looked like it was about to rain.
‘This isn’t good.’
Jaehyun’s eyebrows were distorted without even realizing it. In a situation where the field of view is limited like now, it is not possible to fight while using all the wide terrain as usual.
Even if it is not, the battle in the field covered with the ruins of the city is not easy. Before the return, Jae-hyun had survived several life-and-death crises here and barely came back alive.
As it is an outdoor training camp in the field, it is inevitable that there will be variables, but it was not very welcome.
‘Well, since I’ve finished all the training tailored to this situation, there won’t be any problems.’
Jaehyun took a closer look at his surroundings as he walked along the broken pavement. Here and there, collapsed apartments, shopping malls, and other aspects of Daegu, which used to be bustling, overlapped.
The word “sad scenery” comes out of nowhere. At the beginning of this closed city, the monsters have not yet appeared due to the hard work of the instructors, but from then on, various monsters will attack.
The attack of the monster with its teeth exposed against the group exhausted from repeated battles will be fierce, and Jae-hyun and his colleagues will have to overcome this and camp outdoors.
Even while thinking about Heimdall’s intervention and all kinds of variables.
Jaehyun sighed as he realized once again how difficult the problem he was facing was.
“Anyway, the atmosphere inside the Milles Academy is different. There aren’t any decent buildings around.”
Suddenly Kim Yoo-jung muttered as she walked through the ruined station.
Seo Ina, who was walking side by side, looked around and answered.
“……huh. It seems to be completely different from inside the academy.
Not to mention the concentration of mana in the air.”
“surely. The ‘fieldized’ area is completely different from the feeling of stepping on it.”
Ahn Ho-yeon also nodded in agreement.
fieldization.
This refers to the pouring of monsters due to the dungeon break and the area being occupied. To put it simply, it was an area where demons were rampant without being able to stop the dungeon.
Jae-hyun remembered several areas where fieldization had taken place.
First of all, from domestic regions such as Daegu, Gongju and Baengnyeong Island, to famous cities around the world such as Prague, Liverpool and London.
All of these places have become closed areas where people cannot live due to the appearance of early gates.
However, if the reason why the area where fieldization was progressing was dangerous was limited to the outbreak of demon beasts, that wasn’t the case either.
‘Field areas start to slowly fester from the ground and air. The land becomes uninhabitable due to the excessive amount of magic power.
Thanks to this, the government does not want to restore the area where fieldization has taken place.’
In areas where fieldization has progressed, ordinary people cannot even set foot. Most of them die from mana poisoning, so even if the city is regained, only the awakened ones can survive.
In short, it means that efficiency is bad.
The proportion of the awakened people in the population is very insignificant. Reclaim an entire huge city for them? From the government’s point of view, there was no such effort and waste.
In the case of Daegu, the first gate was opened, and the search is being conducted under the judgment that there must be many undisclosed secrets inside.
‘The fact that Milles Academy is attached there also plays a role.’
In fact, in the case of other areas where fieldization has progressed, restoration has not even begun.
Jaehyun looked at the group and said.
“okay. As you said, it’s several times more dangerous here than anywhere else. The level of monsters is higher than that of the dungeon, and it’s wide open, so you can’t escape out of the gate.”
It’s a dungeon, and unless it’s a closed dungeon, you can live if you get out. As long as the break doesn’t go off, dungeon revenge is still possible.
But the field is a land of death. The only places to run from here are broken buildings and empty fields.
It is said that Miles Academy prepared a safety device, but they pushed the cadets into such a place.
Again, Jaehyun reminded himself that the school he was attending was a military academy and a group that trained human weapons.
“I don’t think Gaga-Gaga will suddenly jump out of the Demon Witch…….”
said Lee Jae-sang, trembling. Looking around was like a meerkat standing tall just to sense danger.
The hand is inside the bag to take out the potion at any time in an emergency. Five times stiffer than usual.
“You never know when something will happen, so being careful is always safe. Of course, the area we search is shallower than the depths, so the level of monsters that come out will be low, but… We
must not be vigilant. Do you know?”
Jae-hyeon looked at the rubble around and warned the group.
‘You have to find the traces of monsters and get familiar with the ones that appear nearby. You will need information to prepare for later.
but.’
Before that, there was the most important order.
“First, let’s find a place to camp.”
At Jaehyun’s words, his colleagues search the area in perfect order. As we had agreed in advance, we started investigating the neighborhood without moving far away from Jaehyun.
In the case of Lee Jae-sang, he instructed not to take any individual action.
‘Because the chancellor’s fighting ability is close to zero.’
After a while.
Kim Yoo-jung gestured with a bright expression as if she had found a useful building.
“How are you over there? It looks good that the building is still intact, doesn’t it?”
After searching around for a while, I found a grayish-white building that could be used quickly. Originally a pharmaceutical company, all kinds of medicines are messed up on the floor.
“It sure looks good. Let’s go over there.”
At Jaehyun’s words, his colleagues nodded vigorously.
I probably won’t say it, but I’m pretty tired. The camp started around 2:00 PM. It’s 7 o’clock now, so it must be because of accumulated fatigue.
As Jaehyun, there was no need to worry for a long time at all. We have to start cleaning the surroundings from this evening, so we need to set up the tent quickly.
Now would be the best time to move.
Jaehyun thought about it, but Ahn Hoyeon took the lead and said.
“I will set up the tent. You guys, please search the surrounding area.”
“after. yes please.”
