Kang Yeon-joo shook her head and recalled her face as she walked through the empty hallway.
Jaehyun Min. was the culprit behind this incident.
‘Why did Jaehyun Min reject the curator’s proposal? Were you afraid of Yeonhwa’s retaliation?’
It was something I couldn’t easily understand. However, as Baek Ji-yeon said, it was self-evident that information that could not be grasped was intertwined.
There is no other way now. I have no choice but to keep watching him as the guild master tells me.
“It’s fucking right.”
Repeating it once again, the lecturer knocked on his stuffy chest.
It was a day when I particularly felt how hard the life of a salary earner was.
* * *
“The best way to hunt harpies is with glow traps. Coincidentally, Jaesang Lee is the best at making luminous traps. Harpies die here again.”
“Did you know that Chancellor hyung could make traps?”
This was a fact that Jaehyun did not know.
Originally, I knew that he was a genius in all fields of production, including potions, but it was a trap.
It was an unexpected harvest.
Kwon So-yul shook his head.
“okay. That’s great workmanship. I have had help before.”
Come to think of it, Lee Jae-sang and Kwon So-yul often participated in events together.
immediately after admission. I heard that they held an event as the same member during the freshman hunt, and recently formed the same team in some events for current students.
After joining Circle Nine, we almost always stick together.
‘Well, that’s almost unilaterally, Soyul sunbae is harassing Chancellor hyung.’
Jaehyun thought about it and nodded.
“Anyway, that’s a good story. Then the prime minister, please……”
“Hahaha, but I’m a bit reluctant to make more traps…”
said Lee hesitantly.
Rarely, he tried to refuse Jaehyun’s request. Lee Jae-sang was looking at Kwon So-yul with a pale, tired expression.
‘Why are you like that?’
Jaehyun thinks so.
Suddenly, Lee Jae-sang clenched his fists and added as if he had made up his mind.
“To make a night light trap, I have to use my cute insects as bait…….” “
…….”
“…….”
At Lee Jae-sang’s words, everyone in the party fell silent. did.
What the hell did you hear?
“Wow… that was the reason?”
Even Ahn Ho-yeon shook his head as if he was dumbfounded.
Jaehyun opened his mouth slightly and looked at Lee Jaesang. He had a genuinely sad expression on his face and was holding his worm container tightly.
From the first time I arrived at the field, I somehow wanted to carefully examine the floor, but before I knew it, dozens of bugs were filling the collection box.
When did they gather so many bugs when they couldn’t even move properly because they were afraid of the monsters in the field?
Anyway, it wasn’t anything to worry about.
Despite Lee Jae-sang’s pitiful appearance, Jae-hyun was not at all shaken.
No, there was no reason to be upset in the first place.
‘No matter how you think about it, there’s no problem at all, right?’
It may be a big problem for Lee Jae-sang, but at least it was nothing to Jae-hyeon.
As a leader, I have to do anything if the survival rate of my team members goes up even a little bit.
Jaehyun said without even thinking.
“Then let’s have the chancellor make a luminous trap. Then we will depart.”
Everyone nodded and agreed to Jaehyun’s proposal.
Only Lee Jae-sang was looking at the insect box in his arms with sad eyes.
“I’m sorry, brother, James Carbon……”
“……Did you give me a new name?”
Seo Ina asked.
Jae-hyun ignored Lee Jae-sang’s frustration and just reflected on the strategy.
* * *
Thanks to James and Carbon’s sacrifice(?), the production of the luminous trap was completed smoothly.
A simple process of crushing worms that secrete luminous substances into powder and then sprinkling them on tough, inedible worm meat.
Thanks to this, the production itself did not take a long time.
Of course, Lee Jae-sang’s expression was not good, but as a result, he couldn’t refuse Jae-hyun and Kwon So-yul’s request.
A sense of indebtedness to a weak temper and reappearance. And it is thanks to the appropriate harmony of the fear of Kwon So-yul.
“Is this enough preparation?”
It was Kim Yoo-jung’s question. Jaehyun nodded.
“Don’t worry, it’s enough.”
Turbuck. Turbuck.
The sound of their footsteps resounding empty.
Jaehyun and his colleagues were currently climbing the emergency stairs of the building.
The harpy’s nest is on the roof. In order to set a trap, you have to go upstairs, so Jae-Hyun and his colleagues headed upstairs after making all preparations.
After walking for a while, we quickly arrived at the rooftop door.
It was then.
“for a moment.”
Jaehyun, who was in the lead, raised his hand and stopped the group for a moment.
Chi profit.
He took a deodorant spray from his inventory and sprayed it on his comrade.
Of course, it’s best to spray it on the corpse of a demon after a battle, but it was because I knew that spraying it on the body like now would have a small effect.
Jaehyun did not forget to ask before opening the door.
“You have to be careful. Harpies are dangerous enemies. I have an extremely strong appetite. In particular, we have to be more safe.”
“……okay.”
“don’t worry.”
Seo In-na and Kim Yoo-jung answered. Ahn Ho-yeon and Lee Jae-sang also nodded.
Jaehyun’s eyebrows went up.
“then.”
Clap!
The door opened with a horse.
Harpies’ nests and the remains of destroyed buildings come into their eyes.
Jae-hyun held his breath and set the trap handed over to Lee Jae-sang. The colleagues decided to hide themselves near a nearby bench for now.
It will take at least 30 minutes for the effects of the trap to manifest.
Lee Jae-sang did not have much talent in combat, and Kwon So-yul had ability, but he was not outstanding compared to other colleagues.
Even during the freshman hunt, she was defeated by Jaehyun, who was still a freshman.
After about 20 minutes have passed.
“It’s faster than I thought.”
Along with Jaehyun’s words, something slowly sinking down flickers his gaze.
Kyaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!
Its wings, larger than its body, lightly land on the ground.
A black shadow soon appeared. The Harpy finally showed up.
The one who landed seemed embarrassed as he tilted his head at the food delivered to the nest (?), but soon he didn’t care and bit his mouth full of meat.
At that time, Jaehyun held his breath and threw his eyes at his colleagues.
“Now.”
“Now I’m going to relax a bit.”
Kim Yoo-jung turned her wrist and said. Ahn Ho-yeon and Seo E-na also answered with slightly excited expressions and walked past Jae-hyun.
“It’s an opportunity to see how much you’ve grown.”
“…But you have to be careful. There is nothing good about being vigilant.”
Three freshmen each adding a word.
For reference, Lee Jae-sang and Kwon So-yul. Jaehyun is waiting in the back.
The current battle is a board where three people can play an active role.
‘Let’s look forward to it.’
Jaehyun smiled and crossed his arms.
The reason was simple.
Because he didn’t intend to get involved in this battle.
Hunt down a B-class monster, Harpy, only with the power of your colleagues.
A while ago, Jaehyun suggested this to the party.
How much my colleagues have grown. After that, I wonder if they will not become a burden.
He wanted to see it with his own two eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 164
chapters.content:
Episode 164 Harpy Queen (1)
Kiek?
The harpy flaps its wings and screams at its comrades. A suffocating breath of life erupted from the demon’s pupils, and a drop of cold sweat ran down his back.
However, the party is closing the distance with the enemy without panicking at all.
It was a very instinctive and skillful move.
“…… Yoojung! support!”
“huh!”
“I will be in the vanguard. In the meantime, please cast both of them!”
The three of them fought skillfully like veterans who had worked together for a long time.
Ahn Ho-yeon stands at the forefront and Kim Yoo-jung supports. It seemed that Seo Ina decided to use her main dealing weapon to defeat the enemy.
Reasonable and accurate judgment.
Jaehyun nodded his head proudly.
‘good. It’s going well.’
If it was an ordinary new cadet, they would have shrunk and increased their movements a long time ago. He may have hesitated backwards, frightened by the beast’s size.
But my co-workers didn’t look like that at all.
―Active skill «Blue and White Sword».
―Active skill 《The Extreme of Nothing》 is activated.
An Ho-yeon activated two skills at the same time and blocked the harpy.
In the meantime, Kim Yoo-jung and Seo Ina, who fell into both sides, started casting.
It was Kim Yoo-jung who activated the magic first.
―Activate the active skill 《Overflow》.
The newly acquired skill 《Overflow》.
This was a magic that amplified the attack power of party members by 1.3 times.
An A-class support skill that is extremely rare.
Tsutsut……!
Kim Yoo-jung’s casting was surprisingly fast.
Should I say it’s because she has admired magicians for a long time?
Then, An Ho-yeon’s sword, which became even stronger with support, landed an accurate hit on Harpy’s shoulder.
The intensity of the overflowing blue flames seemed to deepen.
However, the enemy was like a B-class monster. Harpy twisted his body to let go of Ahn Ho-yeon’s continuous attacks.
Chut!
“Shallow!”
Ahn Ho-yeon shouted.
“……huh!”
As if she had waited for the right moment, Seo Ina, who finished casting, intervened.
―Active skill «Alfheim’s Sword».
The harpy, whose movements were delayed due to the paralyzing poison that Lee Jae-sang had applied to the trap and the sword marks applied by An Ho-yeon, was accurately hit by the sword with the holy light.
Chow!
With a bloody sound of skin cutting, a stream of blood burst out of the harpy’s mouth.
“……Yoo Jung-ah, please finish!”
With the voice of Seo Eana, Kim Yoo-jung, who was waiting behind, lowered her stance.
She raised her mana again and activated the magic she had cast in advance.
―Active skill 《Wind Edge》.
As soon as Kim Yoo-jung put her hand on the floor, greenish cone-shaped magic surged through the harpy’s heart.
soon
thud!
Harpy’s body fell to the floor. Jaehyun, who was watching this, gave a satisfied smile.
Kwon So-yul, who was watching from the side, only opened his eyes wide in fright.
* * *
‘What the hell are they? Are you really a freshman?!’
Kwon So-yul chewed his lips and recalled the battle he had just seen.
something I can’t understand at all. The moves my teammates showed earlier were too skillful to be dismissed as freshman level.
‘I knew they were strong. Uncharacteristically for a freshman, he is calm.
But this… no matter how you look at it, it’s just a monster.’
Kwon So-yul sincerely thought so and looked at Jae-hyun, who was smiling with satisfaction.
‘How was Min Jae-hyun able to make a circle with only those guys?’
Thinking about it, Kwon So-yul quickly shook his head.
‘No, that’s not it… It’s not just that the kids are talented, Min Jae-hyun’s guidance has helped them grow up to that point.’
The question of how was meaningless. Children’s ability to reproduce their talents.
It’s something the two could have done together. At least she judged it that way.
“how is it? There was no need to worry, right?”
Jaehyun, who had come close to me, said with his characteristic light smile.
Even Kwon So-yul had no choice but to nod his head this time.
“It’s amazing… it does.”
“I knew it.”
Jaehyun crossed his arms and nodded.
For reference, there was a reason why he said the same thing to Kwon So-yul.
Just now. It was because when Jaehyun expressed his opinion that it would be better for only the three freshmen to go hunting for harpies, she strongly discouraged them.
at that time. Kwon So-yul, who did not properly grasp the strength of his teammates, shouted:
[This is such an arrogant idea! The story will change if you step out, but harpies are B-class monsters!
If I don’t do it, the kids could get seriously hurt!]
Kwon So-yul had good reasons for saying that.
this is a field
No one knows what will happen here.
As a senior, it is natural to worry.
But Jaehyun knew.
That the current skills of the comrades are not lacking at all to deal with B-class monsters.
‘Ahn Ho-yeon has already won against an elite dark elf knight.’
Of course, this was the case when I risked my life and used < Union of Divine Swords >.
one. Even so, the fact that he defeated an elite knight never changes.
winners and losers.
Only the two remained were the raider’s hunt and the basic principle of combat.
“how is it? my skills! That was great!”
Kim Yoo-jung smirked and waved at Jae-hyun.
Jaehyun laughed.
“You’ve only got a hit. If you have a little conscience, give the kids some credit.”
“……no. This time, Yoojung really helped me a lot.”
“that’s right. I missed it a bit at the end, but after receiving the support magic and using the sword, the feeling was definitely different.”
The two of them chimed in. Jaehyun shrugged. Kim Yoo-jung was still intoxicated with her last attack with her chest wide open.
The three of them were happy for a moment.
At that time, Seo In-na, who was worried about seeing the dead body of the beast, parted her lips.
“……by the way. isn’t it strange Why is a harpy in a place like this?”
Her words had multiple meanings.
Why is Harpy here?
This was a problem that Jaehyun continued to worry about as well.
‘Originally, harpies are monsters that only appear in the middle of a city. But to show up in such a shallow area…’
thought Jaehyun nodded.
“There must be something going on deep in the city.”
* * *
That evening. Returning to their shelter in the closed city, the group made a campfire by sitting on the chairs in their survival kit. I was tired and didn’t want to move, but it was inevitable in order to survive.
‘Because no matter how much it is, you can’t avoid hypothermia. Well, I won’t die.’
Jaehyun threw the firewood into the fire thinking nonsensically.
It was decided that Seo Ina would be the stand-in for the night shift. Despite the fatigue of the first day, she was willing to sacrifice herself for her teammates.
“Sorry. You must be tired, so I asked for a night watch. If there is no work, I will stand.”
Jaehyun sincerely said that to her.
Seo Ina shook her head.
“……no. Anything you can do to help You have work to do on your own.”
Recently, she has been showing a lot of trust in Jaehyun. As they talked about the release of unique skills recently, it seemed that the distance had become much closer.
As a representation, it wasn’t bad.
That’s how I talk to the rest of the party and plan tomorrow’s schedule.
“Ah! It’s a big deal!”
Kim Yoo-jung shouted and jumped up from her seat.
Seo Ina tilted her head and asked.
“……Yoojung, what’s wrong?”
“I left the necklace enchanted with 《Clean》. It’s really a big deal…….”
“Come on.”
Jaehyun said as if he didn’t want to hear any more fuss, handing over a necklace he took out of his inventory.
“uh? this……!”
The item he handed over was a specially processed artifact enchanted with clean magic.
A non-combat type item that has the ability to purify the user’s body once a day, made for professional raiders.
It’s useful in dungeons, but it’s especially important in fields where it’s not easy to get in and out.
By the way, this item is not included in Milles’ survival kit. It is possible to bring it in, but it was not included in the academy’s support list.
“……wow. How did you know I left this behind? It’s creepy, really.”
Kim Yoo-jung wrapped her arms around her and pretended to tremble.
Jaehyun laughed.
“Have you been leaving things behind for a day or two? Your mother also emphasized several times to take good care of you.”
“……Sorry about that. Thank you anyway.
But my mom is too. Do you not trust your daughter that much?”
“Because I really can’t trust you.”
“hey!”
Jaehyun and his colleagues laughed out loud when Kim Yoojung got angry.
“……Smile?”
Kim Yoo-jung spoke bloodily, but the party did not pretend to hear.
It was because of being with her for a while and getting neurosis.
“Anyway.”
Jaehyun clicked his tongue and clenched his chin.
If you think about it, Kim Yoo-jung had a habit of forgetting things as often as she does now. Even in middle school, he probably suffered from similar things several times.
‘I leave things behind every day and forget to do my homework.’
Whenever that happened, it was Jaehyun who took care of her by her side.
Because you are used to this situation.
‘It’s because he wore more of my gym clothes.
Well, I was smaller back then.’
Even at the time of the 2nd of 15, Jaehyun was less than 170 cm tall.
During the winter vacation when he was in his third year of middle school, he continued to grow exponentially, and as a result, he has grown as he is now.
The last height he measured was 185. It was truly a human victory.
Recalling that time, Jaehyun had a smile on his lips.
“Kim Yoo-jung, you should also grow up. Stop forgetting things.”
“Nagging.”
Kim Yoo-jung grumbled and snatched the necklace from Jae-hyun’s hand. Even so, it seems that he is steadily saying thank you.
Ahn Ho-yeon stabbed Kim Yoo-jung in the side and said.
“Tell me honestly. Are you dating?”
“It’s not.”
“Do you want to go back?”
The two answered almost simultaneously. Seo Ina suddenly intervened and wrinkled her brow.
“……You said it wasn’t two people… Can I stop asking about that now?”
* * *
A few hours later.
Jaehyun couldn’t sleep and was on his way to somewhere.
A grumbling voice follows him.
“No matter how much you give me the elixir. Do you really have to bring me here?”
“For anything like that, I’ve been trembling and preparing everything before I go out.”
It was Kwon So-yul who stepped forward with Jae-hyun.
The two of them were moving to defeat the beast that had been collecting traces all day while activating their current unique skill «Search».
―You have completed collecting traces. Guides the user to the designated target.
Because I had investigated enough in the morning, I gathered enough traces to use the search.
However, she followed Jae-hyun alone because she couldn’t find the place where the boss monster was.
“If you really can’t catch it, you have to run away quickly, right? Am I still too young to die here?”
“I am a year younger. So use your skills correctly.”
“How come you have no respect for your seniors?”
“I call you senior every day.”
“shut up.”
After shutting Jaehyun’s mouth, Kwon Soyul took the lead in walking through the closed city. The morning air was cold and dreary, and nocturnal monsters crawled out nearby.
Fear ran through his body, but there was no other way.
In the first place, I’m not the kind of person who would give up my stubbornness because Jaehyun is dangerous.
‘I don’t know. it will work out somehow.’
It took about an hour to find the way while giving up halfway like that.
Finally, the two of them succeeded in finding the magic beast they had been looking for for a long time.
―Encounter the boss monster «Harpy Queen» in Field 1 of the closed city.
A giant monster appeared there.
It was a harpy more than three times as large as those of its comrades.
Jaehyun licked his lips while looking at him with a smile.
“You mean you can finally get your hands on that artifact if you catch it?”
A+ grade boss monster.
However, no matter how strong he was, to Jaehyun, he could only see it as a walking item bag.
He opened his magic and took a step forward.
“Do you eat this completely raw?”
On the other hand, Kwon So-yul, who was tired of the boss’s spirit, was horrified to see Jae-hyun step forward.
There was only one thought in her head.
‘Min Jae-hyun… is he crazy…?’

chapters.title: Chapter 165
chapters.content:
Episode 165 Harpy Queen (2)
Aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa…!!
The Harpy Queen rushes at Jae-Hyun, crying wildly.
Jaehyun raised an eyebrow.
“I didn’t expect to find it before the second day.”
Whoo!
The Harpy Queen flapped her wings.
thud! thud!
The beast’s feathers and nearby rocks fly together and stick nearby.
However, Jaehyun was not at all embarrassed and was looking at the enemy’s movements. The enemy is strong, but only by standard radar standards.
To Jaehyun now, the Harpy Queen was not a very threatening opponent.
Whoo!
successive attacks. After lightly dodging it, Jaehyun opened up his magic. Soon after, a high-pressure noise of clashing mana began pouring out of his body.
Magic of two different natures. It was multicasting.
―Active skill 《Mana Weapon》.
―Active skill 《Formation of magic tools》 is activated.
Tsutsutsut!
Along with the pouring mana, the hardness of the body was further strengthened.
A mana weapon that has been used as a main skill since the first regression. It had grown to a level where it could lightly let go of the Harpy Queen’s attacks.
“Fast!”
When Kwon So-yul burst into surprise, Jae-hyun shrugged as if it was not a big deal.
“Senior, unexpectedly, your reaction is reckless. There are still more surprises to come.”
Along with the words, a dagger begins to form from Jaehyun’s hand.
Even the jungle of sharp black blades. Watching this, Kwon So-yul’s expression hardened. Before long, a high-pitched scream for Jaehyun bursts out of her mouth.
“Could that be… Nidhogg’s fangs?! An S-class item?!”
“what. It’s similar.”
Jaehyun smiled and pointed it at the enemy while holding the dagger that fit perfectly in his hand.
“A… it’s a bit disappointing. Well, at this level, the Harpy Queen is ridiculous.”
* * *
A banquet of the lofty Aesir gods.
The place where the festival took place was in the middle of Asgard’s most beautiful palace.
Valhalla.
A huge palace owned by the Æsir, called ‘the great house of the dead’ or ‘the house of joy’, where all kinds of delicacies are prepared.
This place filled with all kinds of fine wine and gold was the ideal and dream place of Norse mythology.
“ha ha ha! I feel good! The war is being prepared well, and Heimdall has decided to deal with the opponent of the prophecy, so where are the worries in Asgard now!”
What I heard was the voice of Thor, the god of thunder. He greedily drank the honey wine that the dwarves had been brewing day and night for years and then set it down on the table with a thud.
As Thor said, preparations for the second Ragnarok in Asgard were going smoothly.
As for the handling of the opponent of the prophecy, which was the only concern, Heimdall took the initiative and the situation seemed to have been completely resolved.
‘Heimdall. Even if that friend is hot-tempered, it’s not even a matter of destroying a single human being.’
Although he likes fighting, Heimdall was fundamentally different from Thor.
A fighting style that seeks only victory regardless of means. His personality fits well with the warlike Thor, but while he blindly believed in force, Heimdall preferred a more brutal method.
‘That’s why it’s more reliable. He’ll make sure to deal with the adversary somehow.’
Thor raised the corners of his mouth and spoke in an excited voice.
“If we keep moving like this, this time, our Aesir will become the master of the nine worlds. Odin will be pleased.”
The present seat was vacant. Odin was on his way to Vanaheim for a while, saying he had something to do.
Thanks to this, they are now preparing for the second Ragnarok and holding a banquet that has not been held in a long time. Of course, this was Thor’s dogma.
In the middle of the chatter, Thor laughed heartily and said.
“Isn’t it okay if you don’t get caught?”
“…Anyways, an unfaithful bastard.”
The voice came from right next to me. There was a god with a dissatisfied expression who had lost an arm.
It was Tyr, the god of war.
“Thor. You’re a rough-and-tumble in everything. Was the weight of Ragnarok that light for you?”
“Haha, what are you saying? And you, Tir, wouldn’t be in a position to say such a thing?
I guess that’s what you say when you see your right arm eaten by Fenrir?”
“Funny. A piece of whetstone embedded in your forehead.
Doesn’t that belong to the filthy giant? To see such rudeness even with Mjolnir… Tsk, if it were me, I would have returned the weapon and died long ago.”
“Why don’t we try to figure out who’s stronger right now?”
Thor growls, taking Tyr’s words.
At that time, when a great cloud of war flowed between the two gods.
“stop.”
A cold female voice pierces their ears. The owner is Freya. He was the head of Valhalla and the Valkyries.
Recently, she was recognized by Odin for training the Valkyries and warriors, and was given control of Valhalla here.
Freyja said, furrowing her brow.
“If both of you continue to act indecently, I will punish you immediately. You won’t be able to avoid probation for at least a few months.”
“……joy. Got it. That guy is the first to start a fight.”
“I will.”
Thor and Tyr exchanged word for word, but fought no further. Now that Odin is away. The highest power in Valhalla was neither Thor nor Tyr, but she. There was no need to create a problem for nothing.
At that time, Frigg, who had been silently listening to the story, suddenly opened his mouth.
She was the wife of Odin and the god of the earth and the home.
“By the way, Valhalla’s troops have been greatly reduced. I don’t think collecting the souls of the dead is going well. What do you think? Freya?”
Words that were spat out as if thrown out. However, it was also a strangely bony horse. It’s true that Valhalla’s army has recently shrunk to the point of being shabby compared to its reputation in the past.
To Frigg’s words, Freyja responded with a calm tone.
“In the first Ragnarok, it was a problem that we used excessive force. That was clearly Odin’s mistake.”
“……You are the only one who can say such insulting words against the owner of Asgard.”
The eyebrows are raised and a tense fight between the two goddesses follows.
In fact, it would have been normal if this fight didn’t even come to fruition. Because Frigg was Odin’s wife and was like the godmother of Asgard, who held enormous power.
She even comes from pure blood in Asgard. It was different from Freya, who came here as a prisoner of Vanaheim, in terms of authenticity.
However, Freya did not back down at all and looked straight into Frigg’s eyes.
She is a god who has risen to her current position only with her own skills. It was because no matter how friggin it was, Freya couldn’t be careless.
Frigg bit his lip.
‘Even if it’s Odin, the unification of the nine worlds is impossible without the power of the Valkyrie army led by Freya.’
For now, Frigg had no choice but to bow to her.
Freyja laughed as if she knew this.
“I have no intention of matching Odin’s ambitions. He is a powerful man with power, but to me he is nothing more than trash.”
“Such rude…!”
Frigg raised his voice as if he couldn’t stand it any longer.
Thor and Tyr were not interested in drinking.
Freyja raised her eyes savagely. Then, a huge vibration began to rise in the Valhalla Palace itself.
“I have not forgotten what Odin did to me. Frigg.”
“that……!”
For some reason, Frigg was speechless.
Freya raised her magic power and continued.
“I won’t say more. If you don’t want to die, you’d better not make fun of me anymore.”
A deep silence flows along with the words. The festival stopped for a moment while no one could easily move their mouths.
Everyone here was just staring at each other, weighed down by Freya’s mighty magic.
After the warning, Freyja removed her closed lips as she lost her magic.
“Frig. And I would like to take this opportunity to declare it to everyone. All preparations for the ‘second apocalypse’ are complete.”
Freya’s eyes completely lose focus.
She had a face that showed no emotion whatsoever.
“Einherjar. The souls of the dead who will fight for Asgard are already prepared.”
* * *
―Active skill 《Shape of magic tool》.
―You have succeeded in crafting the equipment item 《Nidhogg’s Fang》.
―It is an excessively high-grade weapon. Your rank goes down by 1.
[Equipment Item]
Name: Crude Nidhogg’s Fang
Grade: A
A dagger made from the fang of Nidhogg, a poisonous dragon living in Hvergelmir.
It can produce poison all the time without a venom gland and is very sharp.
*Applies a poison effect (Lv 3) to enemies.
*When the number of wounds increases, stacking effects are activated up to 3 times.
Jaehyun raised the corner of his mouth and looked at the newly created fangs of Nidhogg.
Although the overall skills were lowered by 2 and the rank was lowered by 1, it was still excellent performance. A weapon worth billions of dollars by itself.
Jaehyun briefly recalled the past.
It was at the time when Baek Ji-yeon came to him and made a deal.
[Let’s continue what we said earlier. I would like to recruit Jaehyun Min Raider to our Curators Guild. To that end, I plan to meet the best conditions.]

Because of that, Jaehyun said.

wind cutter.

Meanwhile, Kwon So-yul looked at Jae-hyun in fright. Her mouth was barely shutting.
‘To use two different series skills fused together…?
What is it? How can he show that kind of side every time?’
In the first place, it was a reproduction that exceeded the standard of genius that is generally evaluated by the world.
Kwon So-yul is sincere, his current level is far above the current radar average, and he is probably at the top of A-class. Or even thought that I might have reached more than that.
“It’s hard to believe, but… If it’s that guy…”
It might be possible.

Chow!
What cut off my thoughts was the noise of Jaehyun’s dagger cutting off the enemy’s wings.
A deep smile appeared on Jaehyun’s lips as he swung his sword at the enemy.

Soon after, the scream of the Harpy Queen burst out.
Kyaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa…!

Voice messages heard at the same time.

“Did you finally get the ‘Wings of Storm’?”
Jaehyun muttered as he passed the harpy queen and started heading towards the nest.
The queen’s nest is several times larger than a normal harpy. I needed to move right away to see it all.
Jaehyun, who was busily walking forward, suddenly looked back and said.

“yes?”

“Are you crazy?”

“I finally found it.”

before regression. Jaehyun had a chance to hear about the wings of a storm and leaping in the air through Radar magazine.

On the other hand, no matter how low the skill level, the difference between presence and absence is very large.
‘Because skills can drastically change the way we fight.’
Jaehyun checked the information on the newly acquired skill with a satisfied expression on his face.
A skill window popped up with a refreshing message.
[Active skill]
Name: Jump in the air
Rating: A+
After floating in the air, set up a wind barrier and kick it to leap into the air.
Can be used up to 2 times in a row.
It was an explanation that could be seen that way if it was simple.
However, Jaehyun knew the true nature of the wings of the storm.
‘Before the return, the raider who obtained the wings of the storm was upgraded at once.
Of course, this time it will be difficult because of me.’
After Jaehyun smiled and closed the status window, he immediately equipped the item.
Kwon So-yul, who was watching him from the side, opened his mouth in admiration.
“wow. It’s the first time I’ve actually seen someone rooting for an S-class item. Do you feel something new?”
“Well, it’s not a scene that regular raiders can see often.”
Saying that, Jaehyun glanced at Kwon Soyul.
‘You are surprisingly quiet. Senior Soyul.’
I thought you’d give me some extra money now that I’ve got an S-class item. Surprisingly, she only gave me a strange look, but didn’t ask for anything.
“uh? But what is that?”
Suddenly Kwon So-yul pointed to one place and said. Jaehyun immediately rolled his pupils in the direction of her gaze.
Soon, a voice mixed with embarrassment escaped from his mouth.
“Are those… gloves?”
At the end of their gaze, a pure white glove was thrown away.
gulp.
It was then.
Mokuldae trembled at that moment, and goose bumps appeared all over Jaehyun’s body.
My hands tremble, and an unknown sense of incongruity spreads slowly.
Pure white gloves as if they were not dirty. The mighty magic power leaking out of him was crushing Jaehyun’s whole body.
message at the same time.
―You have obtained 《The Beginning Gloves》.
―Update information about the First Awakener in the Nornir system.
‘Information about the first Awakener…?’
* * *
“Then, is this place sorted out?”
Kim Yoo-jung said while wiping the sweat from her forehead.
The day after Jae-hyeon returns to his residence, a nearby field.
About two hours after the party went hunting, the monster’s seed has dried up.
Jaehyun looked around and nodded.
“okay. For now.”
Just now. Jaehyun had just returned to his residence and was hunting nearby monsters with Kim Yoojung. Lee Jae-sang and Kwon So-yul, who are on guard, are resting.
A barrier was placed near the residence. It was to prepare for any possible invasion.
There are four people in the battle, including Jaehyun, Kim Yoojung, Ahn Hoyeon, and Seo Inana.
They were hunting monsters competitively and collecting tokens for an outdoor camp.
“Isn’t this already close to the record high? Do you think we are strong?”
“of course. I followed along, isn’t it supposed to be this much?”
Ahn Ho-yeon and Kim Yoo-jung exchange a word with each other and talk excitedly. Seo Eana is silently watching her surroundings.
Jaehyun’s expression was not good.
He was thinking about the item he found in the harpy queen’s lair yesterday.
‘Gloves of the beginning…….’
Gloves of the beginning.
The item obtained from the nest gave off an unusual atmosphere from the name.
Jaehyun briefly recalled the message he had heard when he obtained the original glove.
―Update information about the First Awakener in the Nornir system.
‘There is only one Raider in the world with the title of the first Awakener.’
First Awakener.
Jaehyun clearly remembered the radar of this name.
‘Ju won. The world’s first Awakener and Korea’s hero.
But why did the Nornir system update information about him?’
A problem that is difficult to find a connection with. However, one thing was certain.
“There is a link between the First Awakener and the system.”
“huh? What did you say?”
Kim Yoo-jung reacted quickly to Jae-hyun’s muttering voice.
Jaehyun brushed her hair once, ignoring her.
“Ah! Don’t touch my hair!”
However, he didn’t even listen.
‘We need to find out why his gloves were dumped in a closed city.
The premonition… is not good.’
Jaehyun quickly came to a conclusion, but he knew there was nothing he could do about it.
For now, the first thing to do is to finish the camp safely and stop Heimdall’s ambitions. Priorities should not be forgotten.
That was when I was thinking.
“……Jaehyun.”
Seo Ina suddenly grabbed Jaehyun’s sleeve. When Jaehyun turned his head, she opened her mouth with a hard expression.
“……There is someone dying nearby.”
Jaehyun’s expression hardened at the words he had spit out.
Jaehyun immediately spread his magic power detection widely around him and read nearby information.
Then, as Seo In-na said, the reactions of those whose biological reactions were weak were received.
“We have to save it.”
Seo Ina said that, and Jaehyun nodded right away.
“okay.”
―Active skill 《Wind Boost Lv 5》 is activated.
As soon as the green effect stays on the legs, Jaehyun’s body shoots forward.
If the information that Jaehyun detected is accurate…
‘I can’t stand it for long. If I’m a little late, I’ll die.’
The other party immediately followed him.
After running for a long time, the four of them arrived at a point in the open field.
Soon after, Jaehyun, who discovered those in danger, tilted his head with a puzzled expression.
“……what. Why is he over there?”
* * *
The scene of the incident about 10 minutes before Jaehyun arrived.
Breathtaking tension runs throughout the field.
KIA AAG…..!!
Koo-goo-goo-goo!
With a cry, pieces of tile on the floor shattered and the ground began to shake.
A small pit is formed on the dirt road, and a giant snake-shaped monster that is 3m high rises from the ground.
Great Worm.
A guy several times bigger and stronger than a normal worm appeared. A B+ grade boss monster.
It is safe to say that the figure of the demonic beast, who vomits wild tears and straightens his huge body, is menacing.
Then, a cadet who was confronting the Great Worm can be seen nearby.

The situation he was in was dangerous even from a distance of 100 meters.

That’s a great worm.

Minsu Kim was looking up at him with empty pupils.
Lee Soo-hyeok thought as he raised his mana at once.
Why did things get so twisted?
Even just a moment ago, the two of them were still in the process of attacking the outdoor training camp.
The circle they are supposed to be in is the best circle you in the entire school.
I was fully prepared for the risk and received prior training in preparation for such a situation.
But…
‘an extraordinary thing happened.’
Just now. Lee Soo-hyeok experienced an incomprehensible phenomenon while moving with Yoo’s members, including Jung-hyeon, and became separated from the group.
The movement of the demons.
about an hour ago. From the depths of the closed city, high-ranking monsters suddenly came out in a heap.

However, what attacked them was a level that could not be repulsed unless it was the top-level raiders.
Even genius cadets can’t handle it.
Thanks to this, Lee Soo-hyeok and Kim Min-soo separated from the circle in a premarital situation.
In the process, Kim Min-soo even fell into an addiction state.
Kugoong!
“Big!”

They don’t have legs, but they can attack enemies by contracting and relaxing their bodies like springs. The hardness is not that great, but it is not even the level of a cadet that can be easily penetrated.
“Surt’s fierce flame…!”

Of course, Lee Soo-hyuk himself knows best how dangerous it is.

Your odds of winning are infinitely close to zero.
If I’d rather run away alone, the chances are much greater.
but.

Lee Soo-hyeok’s eyes flashed, and suppressed mana burst out from his danteon and fingertips.
Quaang-!
At the same time, “Fire Arrow” containing more than 70% of his strength.
however.
“……Isn’t that okay?”
Lee Soo-hyeok looked at the monster’s huge body, which was intact even after being hit by his own attack, with a face of resentment.
Dealing with a guy like that? I?
fear.
It was a rare feeling for Lee Soo-hyuk.
But now it occurred to me that no other words could describe how I felt.
A powerful demon in front of you and a fallen comrade.
To a desperate situation from which there is no escape.
“……Fuck.”
Lee Soo-hyeok spat out curse words and began to draw out the last mana that existed in his body.
I already know that I can’t win.
But I felt like it would be unfair if I didn’t do this.
Even if you die here.
I’ll die in a radar down way.
At least I won’t abandon my colleagues.
Along with Lee Soo-hyeok’s strong determination, mana once again dwelled in his body.
As if in response, the Great Worm also launches an attack with an unresponsive speed with its mouth wide open.
And at the last moment of desperation.
‘Would I have been able to deal with him if it was him?’
In Lee Soo-hyuk’s mind, a person’s face came to mind.
Quaang!
A familiar male voice was heard along with the sound of an explosion tearing through the space.
“Ah, I don’t want to save this bastard.”
Lee Soo-hyeok’s eyes widen and his gaze goes to one place.
There was a boy who blamed himself for not getting over it until the last moment.
“What are you looking for? Aren’t you taking care of your colleagues?”
Jaehyun clenches his fists while holding a sneer.
soon
Quaaaaang-!
The great worm’s body was pushed back and collided with the building behind it.

chapters.content:
Episode 167 Raid (2)
―Encounter the boss monster «Great Worm» in Area 2 of the closed city field.
Quaaaaang-!
‘I didn’t know that I would be able to save this bastard.’
Jaehyun sighed as he alternately looked at Great Worm and Lee Soo-hyuk being pushed back.
A little while ago, he had just arrived here after sensing the magical power of a dying cadet nearby.
But… I had to save Lee Soo-hyeok among many people.
Jaehyun couldn’t help but feel reluctant to do it.
However, that thought did not last long. Anyway, you can’t let people die.
Moreover, the priority was to finish the battle with the enemy now.
‘But I think this is a bit severe. A great worm in such a shallow area?’
The Great Worm was a monster that could only be seen in the deep areas of the closed city center.
Jaehyun had seen a live broadcast of the subjugation of the guy on the broadcast before returning.
‘At least downtown if it’s about the Great Worm. In other words, he is a guy who can only be seen when he gets closer to Banwoldang Station.
No matter how you think about it, it’s not a good situation.’
While muttering, I looked into the eyes of the massive beast in front of me.
I could feel the Great Worm’s mouth wide open and curl up behind me. This was the posture that the worm-type monsters usually showed right before the attack.
However, it is a movement that does not feel any inspiration to Jaehyun.
How many worms did you catch in the closed city for about two days?
It was a reproduction that was not difficult to evade or counterattack.
Kyaaah!
The enemy’s attack fired with a force that would tear Jaehyun’s torso apart.
However, Jaehyun did not avoid it. He clenched his fists and prepared to return his attack.
After filling the fist with mana, it is stabbed precisely into the beast’s face just before it overflows.
Wow!
Kiehek-!

‘I didn’t even need to take out another weapon.’

The appearance of a monster that was half destroyed and only the lower half of the body remained.
Watching this, Lee Soo-hyuk’s expression turned white with astonishment.
‘What the hell is that…!’
It was a sight that would never stop you from shutting your mouth.
Lee Soo-hyuk was unable to speak for a while due to the shock that seemed to stop him from breathing.
* * *
‘Min Jae-hyun. I knew he was strong. But what the hell is that…….’
It was impossible to explain in words.
The boss monster Jaehyun faced earlier was an A-rank.
This was a level that a party of six or more, mainly A-class raiders, could barely deal with.
‘But Min Jae-hyun hunted him casually.’
How was that possible?
It was something that Lee Soo-hyuk couldn’t understand.
As he was thinking, a cheeky voice suddenly interrupted his ears.
“Why are you standing there blankly? If we don’t treat him now, he will die.”
Lee Soo-hyeok, who was distracted by the battle, suddenly came to his senses and looked down.
Kim Min-soo with purple skin. In order not to pass the golden time, I had to treat it right away.
Lee Soo-hyeok immediately caught Min-soo Kim and kicked him.
At the same time, a cracked voice burst out of his mouth.

Maybe it’s because I was too nervous a while ago? My lips hardened and I couldn’t speak properly.
However. Jaehyun calmly nodded his head in response to the incoherent voice.
“Your colleague is hurt?”
Lee Soo-hyuk clenched his fists and struggled.
“……This guy is hurt. I need help.”
“Follow me. If it’s a detoxification potion, I’ve got it to rot.”
Jaehyun said that with the same blunt expression as the first time.
He was surprisingly the type with a fairly long back end.
* * *
Gulp. gulp.
The potion begins to pass down the esophagus of Kim Min-soo, who is addicted to it.
What I’m using right now is the status ailment recovery potion of Lee Sang-sang. It was an expensive item, well over 20 million won.
“Hey hey, it’ll be fine now!”
When Lee Jae-sang sighed in relief and spoke, Lee Soo-hyeok’s stiff shoulders relaxed.
He seems a bit nervous.
‘Well, if it’s a great worm’s poison, it’s a fatal wound to normal raiders.’
Jaehyun understood moderately and put his hands together neatly.
he asked.

Maybe it’s because he doesn’t speak well, but it was very boring to explain only the main points. Thanks to that, Jaehyun had to hold back the urge to yawn several times.
“so. To put it simply, you were participating in an outdoor training camp as members of the Circle type, but you were suddenly attacked by a monster from inside the city and beaten like an idiot…
And that guy got poisoned, so you couldn’t do anything like this? ”
“……I can reduce it to that extent.”
It seemed a little sarcastic, but basically it meant admiration. Lee Soo-hyuk looked at Jae-hyun and shrugged.
“Anyway, two things are certain. It is said that a demonic beast protruded from the inside beyond the expected level. And even senior Jung Hyun, the club leader, was swept away by the aftermath.”
‘To think that Jung Hyeon suffered… It’s definitely not a problem to be seen lightly.’
Jaehyun sighed and thought for a moment.
Just now. He also noticed the movement of the magic beast that Lee Soo-hyeok said.
A strange phenomenon in which beings with enormous magical power move from within the city as a group.
No matter how you look at it, it wasn’t easy to see.
‘Great movement of the demons.’
However, the problem was not only that.
“one thing. There are bigger problems than that.”
“……what is that?”
Seo Ina, unable to hold back her curiosity, asked.
Jaehyun bit his lip and replied.
“Isn’t it strange? Why didn’t anyone save Lee Soo-hyuk and Kim Min-soo when they were beaten?”
“ah! Come to think of it!”
Kim Yoo-jung’s voice interrupts. Ahn Ho-yeon had no choice but to nod.
“Certainly, Jaehyun is right. First, Chairman Kim Ji-yeon said. If there is a problem at this camp, tell the instructors immediately. But……”
“……The instructors all disappeared……?”
Seo Ina interrupted and said. Kwon So-yul also nodded.
“I think the same. It’s kind of strange. It is also true that a monster of this level has emerged from within the city. I can’t feel the instructors’ magical power nearby.
As if they were all gone.”
Her words created a deep silence among the group.
Jaehyun sighed and clenched his fists.
‘As expected, the culprit…’
He exhaled as he raised his head. A small amount of magical energy rises from the body, concentrating everyone in the field.
However, Jaehyun didn’t seem to care at all about the gazes that were gathering towards him.
He sneered and recalled a man’s name.
Heimdall.
‘It’s that guy.’
* * *
About two hours ago. Temporary outposts on the outskirts of closed cities.
“Anyway, do we have to suffer like this? You’ve already eliminated all the monsters in the shallow area where the outdoor camp is taking place.
Chairman Ha is also funny. Is it okay to place instructors in a place like this?”
The name of the man who sighed and opened his mouth was Lee Tae-hyun.
As one of Instructor Milles, this is typical of radar supremacy.
For reference, the grade was B.
It’s not that high, but to him who is never low. The current treatment was unreasonable.
‘To use people like me in a place like this!’
For this reason, Lee Tae-hyun was dissatisfied with Kim Ji-yeon, the chairman of the board, and Milles Academy.
To think that he, a B-class raider, had to take care of them by chasing after them.
“I am not a babysitter.”
he muttered nervously.
The junior instructor standing next to him spoke appropriately.
“no way. Still, isn’t it because we have to suffer so much to come out with usable kids?”
“It’s worth writing about. They don’t think about improving their skills and play the press or George.
Did you see that Min Jae-hyun or him before? Can you honestly say What kind of S-class skill is that at that age? What’s there? Have you already reached level A? Those who grumble like that should all return their licenses.”
“Still, no way Miles tried to manipulate the live broadcast. do you know That guy named Jaehyun Min might have a lot of talent.”
“Do you really believe me? Anyway. The problem is that you are so naive. It’s a problem.”
Lee Tae-hyun shook his head and said. He was dissatisfied with the new radars that had recently been uploaded.
What was it like when you decided to become a radar?
The first generation of raiders had a lofty goal of saving dying people.
There was such a thing as romance back then!
But these days, it’s full of guys with celebrity disease who just want to get on TV. It was something he couldn’t understand.
At that time, the junior spoke as if he had read his thoughts.
“If you keep doing that, you’ll hear the old jokes. Besides…… For us, it’s a honey if we don’t put in effort and come in well with a good salary. what.
To be honest, being an instructor at Milles Academy is much safer than my current radar job. Because I have a family.”
Lee Tae-hyun clicked his tongue, but couldn’t help but agree with his opinion.
He also has a sister-in-law. He is in his mid-thirties.
For the sake of his family, he had to refrain from raiding raiders who frequently entered dungeons.
You don’t know when you’ll die, and the experience of trembling with anxiety every day is something you do when you’re young.
Now that I have a family, it is many times better to belong to an academy and work safely.
“No matter what…”
Lee Tae-hyun was about to say something more with a dissatisfied expression.
coo coo coo…!
Suddenly, the clouds in the sky began to gather in one place and gathered over the heads of the two in a disturbing red color.
Woo woo woo!
at the same time. The sound of a trumpet coming from somewhere.
“Is this… a trumpet sound?”
Before Taehyung could finish his words, a shadow suddenly fell over his head.
“……uh?”
At the same time as he raised his head, a huge darkness opened its mouth wide and within a minute.
Kwajak!
He swallowed Lee Tae-hyun exactly.
The junior, who was watching the scene from the side, trembled and filled both pupils with astonishment.
“Battle battalion this is…”
He quickly tried to grab the radio, but failed.
Soon after, a flaccid tentacle pierced through the junior’s back.
“Heuk!”
An army of innumerable demons that could be glimpsed through the empty pupils of juniors.
The astonished whites of the eyes turn red and slowly start to cool.
“No… no…”
He used his last strength to grab the radio that had fallen to the floor.
Sentences close to astonishment that he never wanted to say slowly leaked out of his mouth.
“Danger code 11. ……Variables… has occurred… Everyone run away…….”

Tadat. Tadat.
Members of Circle You stormed into Nine’s residence.
Jaehyun threw firewood into the bonfire and opened his mouth with a nonchalant expression.
“You have come to the right place. Are you here to pick up these guys?”

“Even if you don’t, it’s a burden to us. I want you to take me quickly.”
“Why do you have two people with you?”

Why are Jaehyun and Lee Soohyuk and Kim Minsu together?
‘Did he have a close relationship with Min Jae-hyeon after all…!’
Jeonghyun thinks so.
Suddenly, Jaehyun stood up from his seat.
“Then take them with you. I have something to see.”
“……I don’t know what happened. I get it. We will take them.”
It was at that time when Junghyun answered.
“for a moment! I have something to say.”
Lee Soo-hyeok jumped up and glared at Jae-hyun.
‘what? What are you going to say while staring like you’re dying…’
“It’s an important thing.”
Lee Soo-hyeok’s notice was not serious, so Jae-hyun moved to avoid the party.
After a while. A corner of an abandoned city, a bit far from where you live.
Jaehyun’s completely unexpected words came out of Lee Soo-hyuk’s mouth with clenched fists.
“under.”
Jaehyun couldn’t help but sigh.
he said in an annoyed voice.
“They’re not like stars, really.”
* * *
Circle Seed’s abode.
Sid’s members sit around and plan to attack Jaehyun and Nine.
The key to this work is, above all, how to handle reproduction.
To do this, it was necessary to choose the most reliable and safe method.
During the conversation, one of the cadets suddenly opened his mouth.
“Anyway, do I need to do this? Min Jaehyun is still a freshman. Is he really that strong?”
“Not strong. I don’t know because you didn’t see the battle during the midterm exam, but…
At least there won’t be anyone in our circle who can beat him in a one-on-one fight.”
These were the words of Lim Seong-ho. The cadet who asked the question opened his mouth wide.
‘Im Seong-ho. If it’s what that guy said, that’s for sure. Min Jae-hyeon… He’s a real tycoon.’
Seongho Lim usually has excellent analytical skills.
But even he said that no one in Sid could deal with Jaehyun.
Perhaps this means that Jaehyun has superior skills beyond what he thinks.
However, if it ended here, it would not have been Lim Seong-ho.
“but. It’s not that there isn’t a way to deal with him.”
‘also.’
Sid’s circle members raised their mouths at the same time. Among them was Shin Jun-sang.
“It must be a plan to properly blow up that naughty bastard, right?”
Shin Joon-sang.
He also had a deep bad relationship with Jaehyun.
If I don’t break it down now so I can’t climb, I won’t be able to stretch my legs and sleep.
He wanted to take this opportunity to somehow prove Min Jae-hyeon’s incompetence and convince Kwon So-yul to become a seed again.
Seongho Lim nodded as if he knew everything.
“Of course. The artifact was also prepared. There are restrictions on use, but it’s not a big deal.”
“That’s good.”
“then.”
Lim Seong-ho got up from his seat with such luck.
“Let’s go catch it soon. The best rookie in the academy.”
* * *
“Thank you for protecting Lee Soo-hyuk and Kim Min-soo. As the representative of Circle You, I will never forget Grace.”
“Call me anytime you need help. Even if you are not a member of our group, I will help you immediately if necessary.”
Jeonghyeon did not stay long at the residence. He quickly disappeared with Lee Soo-hyuk and Kim Min-soo.
The reason was that time could not be delayed to reorganize and move the circle.
As a representation, it wasn’t bad.
‘It’s not a good thing for other people to stay in our circle for a long time.’
Jaehyun rested his chin and thought for a moment.
‘I can help at any time…’
Jeong-hyeon was about to erase his own debt to him. Since he’s a sincere person, he’ll be an appropriate hand at the academy.
‘More than that, Lee Soo-hyuk. I never thought he would say such a thing.’
Jaehyun remembered what Lee Soohyuk had said to him a moment ago.
[Circle Seed is targeting you. It sounds like it has dangerous artifacts. You’d better be careful.]
‘I’m so dumbfounded.’
It wasn’t a big threat, but it was annoying to Jaehyun.
Even if it’s not, Heimdall’s nerves are sensitive.
what? Cadets attack?
It was so outrageous that it made no sense.
‘I don’t know how great the artifacts were prepared.’
If you think it will just pass, you are mistaken.
Jaehyun got up from his seat with a sadistic smile on his face.
Kim Yoo-jung tilted her chair and tilted her head back as if in doubt.
“Where are you going?”
“I have something to do nearby.”
“……Does it take a long time?”
Seo Ina also tilted her head and asked.
Jaehyun replied with a small smile.
“Well, it might take a while.”
It will take quite a while to turn all the seed members into half assholes.
Jaehyun swallowed the last words and left the residence.
“by the way. Why is Lee Soo-hyeok suddenly helping me? Did you really get shot in the head?”
It was embarrassing in many ways.
If you think about it, it was a little strange since the moment when you didn’t abandon Kim Min-soo and kept him…
‘Well, it’s none of my business. now.’
The first thing to do was to kill the Circle Seed and let them know the horrors of the world.
* * *
“What do you mean by that? The monsters that have already been subdued are starting to boil again!
In addition, the average grade of monsters appearing in shallow areas has increased!?”
Central headquarters in the closed city of Daegu.
Chairman Kim Ji-yeon answered the phone and gave a puzzled voice. It was because the contents of the incoming phone call were definitely strange.
She clutched her forehead and thought.
‘Why? Clearly, before the event, I cleared all the monsters near the closed city with the instructors. A barrier was also put up to prevent the cadets from being swept to the center.
By the way… Why did the movement of a high-ranking monster be captured in a shallow area?’
The contents of a radio message that was transmitted to Instructor Kim Ji-yeon a while ago were truly shocking.
[This is a big deal! All of a sudden, higher rank monsters in the center are moving to the outskirts!]
[Something is strange. As if it was just in time for the outdoor training camp, monsters are pouring in with the start of the training camp!]
This was obviously strange.
Didn’t all the monsters in the shallow area be subdued in advance to eliminate the risk of injury to the cadets?
In addition, sufficient internal exploration has been completed, and instructors have been placed in various places in case of an emergency.
Being prepared for safety means that all preparations have been made.
However, this was completely unexpected even for the cautious Kim Ji-yeon.
‘Great movement of the demons.’
It was also a large-scale movement in which hundreds and thousands of Demonic Beasts moved at the same time.
A case never seen before in the city.
I mean, something like that.
As if it was put together, it exploded with the outdoor training camp.
“Did you find anything else unusual during your investigation?”
Kim Ji-yeon tried hard to ask in a calm voice, but the answer that came back was futile and meaningless.
[I’m sorry, but we haven’t revealed anything properly.]
“Huh… there’s nothing we can do about it. Contact the instructors immediately and completely stop the event…….”
Jiyeon Kim is talking. A chill ran down her spine with an inexplicable feeling of discomfort.
A disturbing and strange sensation felt through the walkie-talkie.
‘what?’
Koo Goo Goo!
At the same time, the sound of the ground breaking was heard from him.
Jiyeon Kim quickly fixed the radio and shouted.
“Instructor? Instructor! What happen! answer!”
Quaang!
Instead of answering, another fierce explosion is heard from the radio.
A much louder noise than before.
A drop of cold sweat runs down my forehead from the tension.
This is not good.
The screams heard over the radio right now are proof of that.
[All of a sudden, what the hell is that?!]
[A monster… is it a beast?]
[Everyone run away!]
[Save me! Who the hell are you!?]
My whole body stiffens and I get goosebumps.
pop.
The instructors’ voices were completely cut off there.
Kim Ji-yeon immediately stood up and looked at the other instructors around her. she said in a determined tone.
“It seems that something happened on the spot. Everyone has to move.”
The meaning of what she said was clear.
It means to use emergency troops.
They are the ones who will never move unless there is something extremely dangerous, but now she is talking about their necessity.
“How about contact with the dispatched instructors?”
Kim Ji-yeon immediately tried to contact other instructors, but there was no reply.
she replied biting her lip.
“It doesn’t work. It seems that everyone has already suffered.”
Kim Ji-yeon was trying to contact the cadets at the same time she was talking.
If you are as talented as Jae-Hyun or Jung-Hyeon, you might know something about the strange phenomena that are happening in the city.
However. It’s been
a long time since
I couldn’t contact you.
It seemed that a mysterious magical field floating like radio waves in the surrounding air was blocking transmission and reception.
‘……What is this mana? Even a walkie-talkie made of diffusion stone cannot be reached.’
Kim Ji-yeon quickly came to a conclusion.
“I will move now before it is too late. All teams are divided and the rescue operation begins.”
“All right. Let’s leave right away.”
The instructor at the front answered first.
The other instructors in the back also quickly nodded after reading the situation.
“It would be better to leave the support team and the minimum number of troops behind. Even healers should have at least two A-ranks.”
Jiyeon Kim nodded. Instructors spurring their seats with him in perfect order.
Kim Ji-yeon tried to calm her beating heart and made a phone call somewhere.
[This is Song Ji-seok.]
“That’s me. Jiyeon Kim.”
[Hey~ What is the president of Milles Academy calling for?]
“Something happened.”
With those words, Song Ji-seok’s voice over the receiver subsided.
[……What’s going on?]
“I need support. All the cadets and instructors who participated in the camp may die.”
[Damn it, I’m going right now, so hold on somehow!]
After the call, Kim Ji-yeon’s eyes settled down calmly.
‘I have to save it somehow.’
Children… are dangerous.

chapters.content:
Episode 169 Variable (2)
Bang!
“What?!”
After a while. Circle Seed’s abode.
Immediately after Lim Seong-ho gave the order to the members of Circle Seed to sortie. Along with a roar that came from somewhere, one side of the door of the dwelling was blown away.
All the seed members looked at each other with embarrassed faces.
It was strange.
The door that the wizards protected with defensive magic and barriers was destroyed at once?
“What is this……”
“They were gathered here.”
The members look around in bewilderment.
Suddenly, a man’s voice came from the broken entrance along with an explosion.
“Are we having a one-sided relationship?”
The existence that appeared by smashing the door. It was the owner of a very familiar face.
Jaehyun Min.
For some reason, he came to visit them first and was messing with them.
Shin Jun-sang tilted his head as if he was dumbfounded.
In the midst of his distraction, only one thought ran through his mind.
‘That role belongs to us…?’
* * *
“So. Did you guys try to attack me?”
Jaehyun laughed and said to the members of Sid who surrounded him.
He was just about to find this place by receiving all nearby biosignals with magic detection.
It was to process the power of the Circle Seed.
‘Originally, I didn’t intend to go this far…’
A while ago. Jaehyun was convinced by Lee Soohyuk’s words that he had to deal with them.
Sid was thoroughly and deliberately trying to attack himself.
If you show that you are being pushed back even once here, troublesome things may happen in the future.
‘I just hate troublesome things. Besides, these bastards could attack my colleagues instead of me.’
Jaehyun was thinking of reducing the things he had to worry about as much as possible.
Also, to do that, we need to process the seed here.
It won’t take long anyway, so no big deal.
“okay. then? I don’t know how you knew, but you can’t deal with all of us alone…”
Seongho Lim interrupted and said, and Jaehyun raised an eyebrow.
“You talk nonsense.”
“……That kind of confidence won’t last long. If you know what we have in store.”
Seongho Lim took a sphere artifact from his inventory and held it in his hand. Jaehyun’s eyes narrowed.
It wasn’t just because the artifact was precious.
‘It’s a familiar thing. Okay, that sounds like fun, right?’
“I just wanted to know how far I’ve grown. You guys are helping me like this.”
When Jaehyun spoke with a cheery smile, Sid’s members tilted their heads.
Are you not afraid to look at this artifact now?
“Everyone, don’t be scared! It’s just bluff. With this ‘Magic Suppressor’, even that guy won’t be able to withstand it!”
A smile escaped Jaehyun’s lips.
It’s a magic suppression device.
‘It’s an artifact that suppresses magical powers to stop wizards from casting and lowers the destructive power of fundamental magic.’
This was the item he used to kill Kim Seok-gi, Gu Ja-in’s henchman in the past.
at that time. Yoo Seong-eun, the teacher, poured unmanageable magic power into the magic suppression device and broke it.
‘If I were really close to the level of S-class.’
You will be able to do as the teacher did.
Jaehyun thought so while looking at Seongho Lim and the members of Circle Seed.
“Okay. Start that great artifact soon. Don’t keep me waiting.”
“That bastard…!”
This time, a harsh voice erupted from Shin Jun-sang’s mouth.
Lim Seong-ho also said with a furrowed brow.
“I can’t help it if I want to die like that.”
Geeeeing……!
The magic suppression device in Im Seong-ho’s hand was activated, and the remaining magic power in his body began to dissipate little by little.
As an expensive artifact, the effect was clear.
However, it was not enough to affect Jaehyun. he laughed.
“Are you going to believe this?”
At that moment, magic power burst out of Jaehyun’s body at once, and the magic suppression device in Seongho Lim’s hand was shattered.
Lim Seong-ho’s eyes narrowed.
‘What… the magic suppressor is broken?!’
“Let me give you one piece of advice.”
After destroying the artifact completely, Jaehyun took a step forward.
“If you’re going to believe in me and make a fuss, you have to be at least me. Got it?”
bang!
Jaehyun’s clenched fist extended forward. Lim Seong-ho’s body, which was holding the crystal, flew off and was pinned to the back.
“You are next.”
A voice falling with a fishy smile.
All the members of Circle Seed looked at Jaehyun in awe.
* * *
After a while. The sound of music echoed through Circle Seed’s residence.
“Ahhh… I’m sorry… I won’t do that again. Please release this.”
“Uh huh. If you move, your bones will hit. Stay still.”
“Please stop here…….”
Even Shin Jun-sang was hit a few times and completely gave in to Jae-hyun.
By the way, Jaehyun was now resting his feet on Shin Junsang’s back. He had bound them so that they could not move with mana chains.
He sighed as he chewed on the dried worm meat he had brought.
“Haha, I don’t understand what the hell you believed in and laughed at so much. It’s because I’m generous that you look at me like this.
If this happens one more time, I will really kill you.”
“……yes. sorry.”
Shin Jun-sang hit his head on the ground. Looks pretty distressed.
However, Jaehyun did not feel pity at all.
Even though he was a cadet, wasn’t he the one who tried to attack him?
If this had happened in a dungeon, I would have killed him.
Jaehyun sighed and released the chains that bound them.
“Then we can go now…….”
“Wait before that.”
Jaehyun stopped the members of Shin Junsang and Sid, who were slowly rising.
He said.
“You have to keep your mouth shut. Please stand in a line for now.”
“……?”
It was an order I couldn’t understand, but now I had no choice but to follow it.
Soon after, Jaehyun got up and came towards them. The Sid members closed their eyes involuntarily.
It was because the defense mechanism was working thanks to the dusty hit a while ago.
“Stay still.”
After saying that, Jaehyun opened up his mana slightly and activated the magic.
―Activate the active skill 《Brainwashing》.
―The shape of the skill is changed according to the user’s judgment.
―Active skill 《Subordinate》.
‘This is what the heck…….’
Pain spreads through their bodies as if they were suffocating their souls.
Jaehyun raised his eyebrows and said.
“Even the strength and ability I have. Prohibited from speaking out about anything. In addition, it is absolutely forbidden to touch me and my colleagues.
If you don’t, I’ll kill you all. know that.”
Along with Jaehyun’s words, a transparent blue chain climbed up their bodies.
Subordination obtained from Gu Jain in the past.
If you use this, it’s not difficult to keep your mouth shut.
―The subordination of the designated power supply has been completed.
“Okay then. How are you going to train your mind this time…”
Gu-gu-gu-gu-gu!
At that moment, an overbearing mana poured from the depths of the city.
‘……what?’
Jaehyun immediately stood up and untied his arms.
The feeling I felt a while ago. What is that?
‘Dangerous.’
Jaehyun realized that a completely different, very huge magic power was slowly moving to the outskirts.
he bit his lip.
“If you want to survive, go to the entrance somehow. Ask the instructors for protection.”
“yes?”
Shin Jun-sang tilted his head.
What did he eat wrong?
Why are you suddenly telling yourself this?
“Goes.”
As soon as Jaehyun said that, he left his seat and headed outside.
Unlocks magic power and activates wind boost for fast movement.
On the other hand, Lim Seong-ho, who was suppressed by his spirit, was finally able to breathe properly.
There was blood in both of his eyes.
“Ha …… Min Jae -hyun that baby ……!”
However, no one paid attention to Lim Seong-ho’s words. Because of this incident, the members’ trust in themselves has hit rock bottom.
Now, Lim Seong-ho’s position as a leader was virtually non-existent.
“shit!”
I will kill you someday
Seongho Lim repeated that and looked at the entrance Jaehyun had left for a long time.
On the other hand, Jaehyun’s expression after leaving Sid’s residence was cold.
‘If it’s this huge amount of magic…… At least it’s more than hugin. Heimdall is starting to move.’
Jaehyun was sure.
Enormous magic that suddenly began to spread from the center of the city.
This was an indicator that made it possible to confirm that he had moved.
“You have to make sure other people don’t get swept away.”
At the same time as murmur.
―The emergency quest 《Closed City Defense Battle》 begins.
―From now on, all living creatures here cannot leave the city, and if the boss monster in the field is not defeated, the city will be completely destroyed after three days.
―Displays quest information.
[Urgent Quest]
Defense of the closed city
The closed city of Daegu has been occupied by the evil Heimdall.
Defend your stronghold and stop the boss monsters, the Bone Dragon and Heimdall.
However, while the quest is in progress, adult raiders cannot use the power of the system and cannot return alive unless they defeat the Bone Dragon and Heimdall.
Condition
1. Stop the Bone Dragon.
2. Heimdall’s Deterrence.
difficulty: ???
compensation: ???
*Intervention into the city from outside is prohibited during the quest period.
“Has it already begun…?”
After catching his breath, Jaehyun put strength on his legs.
A small amount of mana leaked out from the gap between her tightly closed lips.
A huge defense game had just begun.
* * *
The abode of the Circle Nine.
A man arrived here.
“Is this where the adversary’s allies are?”
Heimdall.
The watchman of Asgard laughs and releases his magic.
Due to the sudden adjustment of the schedule by the adversary, it was not possible to recover the strength to the desired level, but it is not difficult to deal with the weak cadets at this level.
In the first place, Heimdall’s power, which had a divine power, was at a level comparable to that of an S-class raider, even if it was 30%.
It was his realm that even now Jae-hyun could not easily deal with.
Kugoong!
Heimdall passed the grey-white building and headed inside the Nine’s residence.
Kwajik!
With one gesture of his hand, the barrier guarding the dwelling is lightly crumbled.
“Why is Min Jae-hyun so late…….”
Kim Yoo-jung, who was resting in the tent, came out and tried to speak, but soon froze.
‘weird. That person is not Min Jae-hyun.’
I thought it might be the members of Junghyun and Yoo, but it wasn’t either.
The existence in front of me was the possessor of turbulent power with irresistible magical power.
‘It’s like… a witch beast.’
Kim Yoo-jung thought so and swallowed her saliva.
Anxiety sprouts in her heart, and her heart beats repeatedly.
Ahn Ho-yeon and Seo E-na and Kwon So-yul stood side by side. Lee Jae-sang is also out of the tent and examining the atmosphere.
“Are you allies of the adversary?”
“What do you mean by that……”
The moment Kim Yoo-jung was about to say something.
Kugoong!
The mana concentration in the atmosphere suddenly changed. All of my comrades staggered and bent at the knees at the magic power that had thickened more than three times.
Heimdall added with a faint smile.
“Only answer questions.”
Kwon So-yul instinctively opened up his magic and started the artifact.
The item I received from Jaehyun the other day.
It was to get in touch with him through the sentence of solidarity.
[Kwon So-yul: Min Jae-hyun, come back now! the enemy has appeared It looks like a human, but the magic I feel is like a demonic beast…]
The text didn’t continue.
It was because Heimdall, who approached Kwon So-yul before he knew it, smiled and grabbed her neck.
“Heuk!”
“You’re using obvious numbers.”
Heimdall condensed mana with his other hand and finished preparations to shoot at his colleagues.
he was mocking
“You all have to die here. adversary. Resent him.”
“It can’t be like that.”
―Active skill «Absolute Calculation».
Kwachang!
With a noise like glass breaking, the mana cannon fired by Heimdall was shattered and scattered fragments around.
Then there is the sound of chains clashing. Heimdall’s hand, which was gripping Kwon So-yul’s neck, falls off.
The mana that existed in the air also returned to its original state, and a black-haired boy appeared.
“Do you think I will just watch?”
Saying that, Jaehyun hit the chain with high-pressure electricity.
That moment.
Heimdall’s expression hardened and his two cold eyes turned to Jaehyun.
“You guys.”
Kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa!
Heimdall’s magical power exploded in an instant.
His lips opened slowly, and an overwhelming divine power poured out.
“Why do you have ‘His’ eyes?”

Episode 170 Asgard’s Sentinel (1)
“Please gather all your strength to save everyone! You shouldn’t be late in the slightest. There are already many injured instructors and cadets!”
At the entrance to the closed city, Kim Ji-yeon is seen shouting.
Currently, she was busy rescuing the injured instructors and cadets.
half a day already.
We are taking care of them with support from headquarters, but the situation is not very good.
‘There are many more people who haven’t been saved yet. Some instructors have already died. In addition…
strong monsters continue to appear from within. It’s dangerous at this rate.’
Demon beasts were constantly pouring into the shallow area.
We are doing our best, but at this rate, the situation may get worse due to a lack of manpower.
“If I don’t think of a way…”
“Chairman! We will help too.”
At that moment, the voice of a cadet came from behind.
Standing there was Jung-hyeon, the head of Circle Yu.
Jiyeon Kim pondered for a moment.
He came to the field with the instructors to save the cadets.
But is it okay to put the cadets in danger without protecting the safety of the cadets?
But there was no right way.
Circle You are students who already have skills comparable to pro raiders.
It was not embarrassing to enlist their help in case of emergency.
“please. But please refrain from fighting as much as possible. After all, you are still cadets.”
“All right. We will search the area and focus on rescuing people.”
“We will help Aran too.”
“Please let Sung-eun help treat the wounded.”
Aran’s representative Kang Joo-hyeop and Seong-eun’s circle leader Han Ji-an, who were waiting in the back, also offered to help.
All of the four major circles, except for Third Eye, had gathered here.
“Thank you all. Please lend me your strength so that I can somehow save it.”
Kim Ji-yeon said that while lightly ignoring the cadets.
Still, if they help, the number of workers will increase even a little.
If only the monsters can be stopped somehow, there is a chance of winning.
‘At this rate, there’s no possibility.’
Thinking so, it was time for Kim Ji-yeon to raise her magic power.
Chi-Chi…….
Kim Ji-Yeon stared blankly at her hand at something she couldn’t understand.
The reason was the use of magical power.
‘……what? Magical power… won’t it unite?’
Kim Ji-yeon’s eyes narrow. Voice message heard at the same time.
―……The Aesir system is down.
―The relationship with the user is temporarily disconnected.
The system… is down?
When she didn’t understand right away, an urgent cry came from behind.
“Chairman Lee…! Magical power… can’t be used!”
“me too!”
“I’m not good at skills either!”
Each of the instructors made their own music and shouted as if they were perplexed.
Kim Ji-yeon’s face turned blue.
what?
I’ve never had this happen while using the system.
Why the hell… Why did this happen in such an emergency situation?
Jiyeon Kim did not give up and shouted with her lips bitten.
“Is there no one who can use the skill?”
“I think I can.”
It was Jeong-hyeon who intervened then. Not only that, other circle leaders also agreed.
“I think my skills are working properly.”
“what? I thought it was just me Anyway, I can.”
Even Han Jian and Kang Joo-hyeop. Everyone can use the skill.
At that moment, a hypothesis formed in Kim Ji-yeon’s head.
‘Could it be… that only the cadets can use magic…?’
Looking around, the other cadets except for the three were also able to use magic.
The only thing blocked was the adult raiders, including himself.
“It’s difficult to understand in a hurry, but…”
She said, looking at the circle leaders as if she had made up her mind.
“We have to change our strategy. this battle. We will support you as much as possible.
You have to step in.”
“All right.”
After Jeonghyeon replied coolly, he started running toward the battlefield.
That moment.
―Encounter the Bone Dragon, the boss monster in Field 3 of the closed city.
The field boss of Area 3. The Bone Dragon appeared.
Originally, it wasn’t an opponent to be so frightened of.
The grade of this dragon is A+. The ability of the instructors was sufficient for hunting.
But not now.
From now on, those who had to deal with that guy were cadets.
Jeong-hyeon clenched his fists as he saw the 20-meter-high demon beast approaching him.
“This… it won’t be easy.”
* * *
Watchmen of Asgard. Heimdall.
When he first descends into Midgard. One temporary power was transferred to Odin.
The power to intervene to some extent in the Aesir system.
This was the rain of drought for him, who could only use 30% of his strength.
Heimdall put restrictions on the system and sealed the power of a certain age group.
It is to forcibly seal the power of instructors over 20 years old who exist in the closed city and forbid them from using the power of the system.
The reason for this decision was simple.
To watch the struggles of the young and weak.
Also, there is a limit to limiting the system, so it was judged that it would be better to forbid the power of stronger adult radars in order to pursue efficiency.
‘I thought that if I just used the power of the system, I could comfortably drive the opponents of the prophecy into a corner.
But… this is unexpected.’
Heimdall looked displeased.
“Why do you have ‘His’ eyes?”
Heimdall’s voice was full of anger.
Jaehyun quickly guessed the reason.
‘His eyes. That’s probably referring to the 《Lost Eye of Odin》 that I have.’
Jaehyun briefly wiped his left eye, which was stained with blazing gold.
If you think about it, it all started here.
The only mythical item in the world.
Having obtained this, I returned and succeeded in reaching this point.
Heimdall pulled out a sword from his waist and said.
“Now I get it. How was it that you were able to grow up so fast?
That’s not something that some insignificant human being can have.”
“If you twist it, take it away.”
After provoking and releasing his magic, Jaehyun stood in a position to protect his colleagues.
Seo Ina took a deep breath and said.
“……No matter how much Jaehyun is you, that person can’t be alone.”
“No, I have to do this. It’s something you shouldn’t get involved in.”
