The moment he heard those words, Jaehyun’s expression hardened.
okay. That’s how it happened.
Jaehyun was finally able to guess Chae Jiyoon’s true identity.
‘I heard from the headquarters’ radar that was investigating the incident at the time of the outdoor camp incident. The dead instructors were said to have been attacked by ‘purple tentacles.’
tentacle.
There is a high probability that the being with it played a leading role in the outdoor training camp.
Jaehyun made that conclusion at the time.
And now.
I definitely found out about this.
‘Chae Ji-yoon. She helped Heimdall to set up an outdoor camp. That’s why the Third Eye didn’t stand out when the other circles were active.’
“Sorry for not being of much help.”
Lee Mun-hwan said that while wiping his sweat. Jaehyun shook his head.
“no. That’s enough. thank you.”
Jaehyun got up from his seat after giving an appropriate greeting.
at that time. Moonhwan Lee called him over and said in an urgent tone.
“Uh… did you save me?”
Jaehyun tried to deny it moderately, but Balak, who was standing next to him, spoke first.
“okay. That guy saved everyone here.”
“Are you… the ballack of the European Union?”
Moonhwan Lee muttered in shock.
He asked Jaehyun if he had saved him, but it was because he judged that the odds were slim.
There were quite a few level radars here.
The same goes for Balak and Camilla in front.
If so, there was a high probability that it was the Raider who naturally saved him.
But…
‘No matter how you look at it, that child is still young.’
At that moment, the faces of the boy from the article and Jae-hyun overlapped in Lee Mun-hwan’s mind.
“Are you… a student of Jaehyun Min? That’s why it’s on the news these days…”
“That’s right.”
Jaehyun glared at Balak for a moment, realizing that something bothering him had happened.
However, Balak only shrugged his shoulders as if he had done the obvious thing.
Jaehyun lets out a sigh.
Suddenly, Moonhwan Lee lowered his head to Jaehyun and said.
“Thank you for saving me and my clients. I want to make an example.”
“example?”
Jaehyun’s ears perked up.
* * *
The next day. Germany with the buildings of the European Union.
Balak, who was sitting in the meeting room there, opened his mouth, which had been hardened, and let go.
“From now on, we will completely ban the pursuit of the ‘Man of the Robe’.”
Balak’s declaration was truly shocking.
It has been only a few months since the ruins were robbed.
However, the head of the coalition should completely ban the search for thieves?
It was a decision that could not be easily understood no matter how you think about it.
“that! What are you talking about all of a sudden?! So you’re saying let’s just pass on the excavation of the ruins? The world will look down on us!”
An older man slammed the table and shouted. He was a staff member of the European Union.
However, it didn’t mean much.
He was not an Awoken and had no great powers aside from his contribution to founding the Confederacy.
This meant that he had no say over Ballack or Camilla.
“I, the representative, made the decision. Need another reason?”
“Of course! Give me a good reason!”
“you’re right. Why did you suddenly make that decision?”
The heads of other coalitions also said the same in a fit of fuss.
After thinking for a moment, Ballack was about to open his mouth, but Camilla struck first.
“Even if we both attack, we can’t stop it.”
“……what?”
“I’m not sure if the Coalition could win if all of them attacked. To put it simply…
if you don’t want to be annihilated, you’d better give up pursuing him.”
* * *
The next day. The hotel room where Jaehyun is staying.
Ding-dong.
“come.”
With the sound of the doorbell, Jaehyun stepped outside with a smile on his lips.
It was none other than the courier that I had been waiting for.
‘Still, there’s something worthwhile about beating the dragon.’
Jaehyun smiled and took the package he received and went inside.
He briefly recalled the story of Lee Moon-hwan’s case yesterday.
[It’s too cheap to call it the price of life, but… the item you won at the auction. We will pay the winning bid for the 《Stone of Transcendence》 on our behalf.
Other than that, if you need anything else, please let me know anytime. I will help with both my mind and heart.]
Thanks to this, Jaehyun saved more than 10 billion won in the bidding for the stone of transcendence.
Do you think it’s cheap for saving lives, or did you think it’s worth the investment?
Whatever it was, it would have been a difficult choice.
‘It’s not a decision that someone who ran a hole-in-the-wall store would make.’
Jaehyun thought so and quickly opened the package.
Inside was a red stone that emitted a brilliant light.
[Special Item]
Name: Stone of Transcendence
Grade: S
A gem that removes the penalty of the Ring of Transcendence.
Jaehyun immediately put the stone on the ring of transcendence. Along with the status message, the information of the upgraded transcendence ring came to mind.
[Equipment Item]
Name: Ring of Transcendence
Grade: S
A ring that increases magical power by amplifying mana instantly.
1. Acquire the active skill 《Overdrive》.
[Active Skill]
Name: Overdrive
Rating: A
Increases the power of skills by 1.5 times for 5 minutes by amplifying mana.
* With the installation of the 《Transcendence Stone》, the magic ban disappeared.
The overdrive penalty was removed by equipping the transcendence stone.
A penalty that puts you in a forbidden state where you cannot use magic for 5 minutes when used.
This became a factor that prevented overdrive from being used at the critical moment of reproduction.
“But not now. Now the width of the battle will be wider.”
Jaehyun nodded his head in satisfaction.
However, his expression became subtle again.
It was because I had other concerns.
“Now, this guy is next…”
Jaehyun scratched his head as he looked at the egg he took out of his inventory.
A hatching dragon egg.
This was one of Jaehyun’s biggest worries recently.
“You can’t hold it like Edison… How the hell do you hatch this…”
Tirling.
The system I heard then.
―The conditions for hatching of < < Embryonic Dragon Egg > > will be updated.
Jaehyun tilted his head and looked at Al.
An updated status window pops up shortly thereafter.
―The egg hatching condition is to absorb magic stones.
“A magic stone?”
Jaehyun thought for a moment.
magic stone.
This was the core embedded in the beast’s body.
It is currently used for various purposes all over the world because it contains the magical power of a demon.
Right now, magic stones play the same role as electricity in the world.
Jaehyun thought about it for a moment, then nodded.
“okay. After all, it would be better to spend money now. It’s not like I don’t have enough money to save.”
Jaehyun grinned and turned on the hotel computer. The page he accessed is a site that sells magic stones.
It was a company specializing in corpses that had partnerships with various small and medium-sized guilds.
For reference, the people who run this company are Kim Yoo-jung’s parents.
Jaehyun immediately looked at the site and turned on his smartphone.
And immediately called somewhere.
[Hello.]
“This is me, Mister. Jaehyun Min.”
[Oh oh! Jaehyun, what are you doing? Well, even if Yoo-jung harasses again…]
“No, I have something to ask of you.”
It was Kim Yoo-jung’s father who answered the phone.
It was after Jaehyun cut off his lengthy story appropriately.
“I want to buy some magic stones. Can you get all of them above grade A? As soon as possible.”
[……All of them? But then it would be at least billions?]
“It’s okay. Because I have a lot of money.”
Jaehyun raised his eyebrows as he said that.
* * *
That evening.
Jaehyun smiled as he looked at the box of magic stones delivered with bullets through the portal.
I asked for it to be attached quickly, but as expected, he had excellent business skills. The courier had just arrived.
When Jaehyun tried to open it. Suddenly there was a knock on the hotel door.
Bang bang!
“hey! Jaehyun Min! Is it true that I suddenly collected all the magic stones from my parents?!”
“also. I knew you would come.”
I sighed and looked through the door for a moment.
Kim Yoo-jung’s voice. Apparently, he had heard from his father that he had purchased magic stones.
‘It seems that the other kids are also together.’
Jaehyun scratched his head and stepped out the door.
He obediently opened the door and let the party inside.
It was because if I didn’t open it anyway, it was obvious that he would continue to bother me.
Jaehyun said without even looking at the party who confidently entered the room.
“Well, it’s true that I bought it… but isn’t it coming too suddenly?”
“I came right after hearing what Dad said, right? You don’t have to listen to what it is.”
“okay. Jaehyun, we are also curious. Aren’t magic stones usually bought by people who make magic tools? Why are you…”
Ahn Ho-yeon was also so detailed.
Seo Eana in the back is also tilting her head.
Apparently, the other members didn’t come because they didn’t have time.
In particular, the two current students are taking other special classes, so they are busy for a while.
After thinking about it for a while, Jaehyun took out an egg from his inventory and put it down.
The eyes of the two widened at the dragon egg on the table.
“I picked this up.”
Jaehyun pours all the magic stones from the box that he got through luck like that into the eggs.
OK.
Jiying…!
The egg emitted light and began to swallow nearby magic stones in an instant.
“……What the hell is this? You can get a magic stone like this all at once…”
Seo Eana said.
“I don’t know either. So I’m going to try it.”
After saying that, Jaehyun raised an eyebrow.
It’s a dragon’s egg.
‘If someone worth using here comes out, it will be of great help.’
Thinking so, Jaehyun overturned the rest of the boxes one after another.
He continued to absorb the magic crystal into the egg.
Gying! Geeing……!
Al continued to devour the magical power of the magic stone.
System messages also continue uninterrupted.
―The egg absorbs A-class magic stones.
―The hatching rate increases.
―Egg absorbs S-class magic stones.
―The hatching rate increases.
Jaehyun nodded his head in satisfaction.
And finally. When I poured all the way to the last box.
The egg started shaking.
Great!
Looking at the dragon egg that started cracking, Jaehyun gulped down his saliva.
‘I’m looking forward to seeing what comes out.’
Jaehyun smiled as he watched the dragon egg slowly begin to crack.

chapters.content:
Episode 186:
How to Train Your Dragon (2)!
The egg cracked, and a brilliant light leaked from the inside.
Jaehyun swallowed his saliva involuntarily.
jump!
After a moment of waiting, the egg was completely broken.
almost simultaneously. Jaehyun was in great shock.
What?
An unknown creature tilting its head.
“What the hell is this…!”
What was born inside the egg was a small dragon that looked like a puppy.
A red dragon with dainty wings and round eyes.
On the soles of her feet, there was even a piece of pink jelly.
Jaehyun grabbed his heart without realizing it.
‘……It’s so cute.’
He doesn’t talk, but his hobby is to find and watch videos of cute animals.
“Crazy…….”
Kim Yoo-jung’s shocking voice leaked from the side.
I thought that a very ferocious and unattractive guy would come out to eat magic stones. It seemed that he was shocked by the cute dragon, which was the opposite of what he expected.
At that moment, a clear voice message popped up in Jaehyun’s ear.
―A dragon that inherited the power of Fafnir. 《Fafnir II》 becomes your pet.
―Current grade is D. When grown to the end, you can grow up to S+ grade.
Jaehyun’s eyes narrowed.
‘what? The pet is… S+ grade?!’
* * *
Surprisingly, there are quite a few people who carry pets among the radars.
Tamer-type Awakener.
Because they carry cute pets, they have become sensational among citizens.
Jaehyun also thought that he wanted to raise at least one pet.
‘But it’s hard to get a pet and you can’t handle it properly without a special skill. That’s why I wasn’t even dreaming.’
It felt like a sudden windfall.
Jaehyun’s mouth caught on his ears.
‘S+ class pet. As far as I know, the highest grade of summons or pets is at least B grade. A-class and higher radars are only that much.
But Fafnir II can become as strong as I am now.’
If you grow it well, it’s like almost doubling your power.
There is not even a phrase that says that the user’s magic power is consumed separately during summoning.
Jaehyun rubbed his chin and murmured with a happy expression.
“Still, it’s good that a good guy came out…”
It was then.
“Quaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa! what’s this?! Where the hell did something so cute come from!?”
Kim Yoo-jung, who suddenly intervened, shouted and held the born dragon tightly in the product.
The sight of King Fafnir II tilting his head in his arms after waking up from sleep completely captivated her.
“……Jaehyun, when did you learn taming?”
Seo Eana also showed interest in Fafnir II and asked.
Jaehyun again reached out to snatch Fafnir from Kim Yoojung, but was quickly stopped.
he said with a sigh.
“Rather than learning timing separately, like I said before, I really picked it up. in the dungeon.
But An Ho-yeon, why are you backing away like that?”
“Ah, that’s because I don’t like reptiles that much… should I say it’s a bit scary…?”
Ahn Ho-yeon retreated behind the sofa and hid herself.
Looking closely, he seemed to be shaking a bit.
“Oh right. You were too scared.”
Jaehyun remembered and nodded.
Suddenly, Kim Yoo-jung clenched her fists and said.
“It’s decided!”
“What else?”
Jaehyun seemed to be bothered by it, but Kim Yoojung ignored him.
“From now on, his name will be Yongyong. Do you like it too, Yongyong?”
“……what?”
Jaehyun looked at Kim Yoojung with an expression of absurdity.
……Is Fafnir II shaking his head for a moment just because of his mood?
* * *
Jaehyun introduced Fafnir II to other colleagues that evening and into the next day.
The name was too long, so I decided to shorten it to ‘Papi’ from now on. It resembled a puppy, and the two letters were just right for the name.
‘Well, Kim Yu-jung insists on calling her Yong-yong, but…’ It’s
just one person calling her that way anyway. It’s kind of like a nickname.
Since the dragon’s basic intelligence is smart, I thought it wouldn’t be a big problem, so I left it alone.
‘By the way, raising a dragon is also quite difficult…….’
For some time, Jaehyun read the instructions on how to raise a dragon displayed in the system, and repeated his thoughts over and over again.
It was the same now.
“Fafnir basically likes gold. He has a temperamental temper and mental age of about 5, so it’s difficult if he doesn’t treat you well…”
Jaehyun pointed at his throbbing forehead.
“Fafnir II grows with its users. As you hunt monsters and gain experience, your dragon will also rise in rank and learn new skills.
Also, if you don’t play with the dragon when it’s infancy, it’ll get worse, so you have to take good care of it…”
Apparently, raising a pet wasn’t that easy.
fortunately that.
“Oops. Do you like our Yongyong that much? After all, they follow me best.”
It was that Kim Yoo-jung and Papi matched surprisingly well.
Poppy often whined when she wasn’t there, probably liking Kim Yoo-jung, who hugged her for the first time.
Thanks to that, Kim Yoo-jung was going to and from Jae-hyeon’s hotel room almost as if she were at her own house.
“hey. Can’t I just take him?”
“no.”
Jaehyun stubbornly shook his head at Kim Yoojung’s words.
In the first place, a pet is tied to the system and cannot be given to others, nor is it a thing.
Furthermore, the body that will be one of the main powers of reappearance.
‘I will never hand it over.’
Jaehyun thought so and continued to read the parenting diary on the system window.
Lee Jae-sang puts a stethoscope on Papi’s heart to check his health.
Kwon So-yul also just arrived and was showing great interest in Papi.
I want to touch it because it’s cute, but I feel like I’m reluctant because of the image.
A blush was all over his face.
Kim Yoo-jung, who was worse off, said while holding out her papi to Kwon So-yul.
“Try to pet your sister too! It’s so cute!”
“Uh… uh. Is that so…?”
Kwon So-yul cautiously reached out his hand as if he couldn’t win.
It was then.
Kurr……!
For some reason, Poppy avoided Kwon So-yul’s hand and turned her head away.
Kwon So-yul squatted down on the sofa in the corner with an expression as if he had lost the world.
She gathered her knees together and buried her face.
Kwon So-yul muttered with a stunned expression on his face, with only his eyes open.
“Why do you hate me…”
Jaehyun nodded, placing a hand on her shoulder.
“Even animals recognize human personality. Well, if you think about it that way, it’s surprising that you follow Kim Yoo-jung…” This
is an issue that Jae-hyun couldn’t clarify.
Birds believe that the person they see right after hatching is their mother.
Maybe Fafnir II is similar?
It was the moment when one more question about reappearance was added.
* * *
It was the next day after another day that the system at Milles Academy was restarted.
Before going to school, Jaehyun went to Kim Jiyeon, the chairman of the board, and was allowed to take Fafnir II with him.
According to the regulations, it is considered a companion animal (?), so some procedures were required to go together.
Of course, as Jaehyun, there was no problem with permission because he had personal connections. Going around without permission was a hassle.
‘I have to pay attention to the instructor.’
Thinking that, Jaehyun sighed as he looked at the instructor in front of him.
Right now, he was taking a magic theory class in the third classroom of the academy.
The instructor conducting the class was a middle-aged man.
“…That’s why you should always look around carefully before using magic. The Witchbeast does not wait for your casting.
Please keep in mind that you are the one who always protects yourself…”
The contents were full of boring things.
Jaehyun’s magical achievement has now reached the point of being comparable to Camilla’s.
The instructors were also at the level of A, so it was correct to assume that there were practically no people in the academy who could teach reenactment.
Kreung…….
Even Poppy started begging me to play with him.
Jaehyun sighed and gently stroked him.
As the system said, it’s difficult if your personality gets worse.
but then
When the end of class is imminent. Suddenly, the instructor stopped writing and opened his mouth.
“Okay, that’s all for today’s class… I have something to tell you, so pay attention.”
Jaehyun’s eyes turned to him. The instructor had a slightly firm expression.
“Recently, there has been a series of incidents in which cadets have gone missing.”
“what?”
Jaehyun’s ears flashed as he played with Poppy while turning the pen.
Apparently, something happened while Jaehyun wasn’t there.
The instructor went on to explain the incident.
“Several cadets are already missing and the instructors are looking for them. The Academy is currently investigating this and will update you once details of the incident are revealed.
So, for a while, please leave school together as a group and pay special attention to each other’s safety.”
A disappearance that occurred almost at the same time as the normalization of the academy.
The cadets nearby were also chattering about it.
“Sudden disappearance, what the hell is that?”
“I see… Do I have to go to school worrying so much? How the hell is Miles going to deal with?”
“I heard that it was the members of ‘Third Eye’ and Chae Ji-yoon who went missing at first…” “
Ah. Don’t even talk about Chae Ji-yoon. Those are the things that ran away to live in the outdoor training camp. What a pain.”
“Well, that’s it too.”
Jaehyun’s expression darkened in an instant.
A sudden disappearance in school. In addition, the first missing person was Chae Ji-yoon…
Jae-hyeon’s pupils narrowed.
“It’s too exquisite to be a coincidence.”
* * *
“Yes. okay. The first disappearances started a week ago?”
[you’re right. We are also working hard to find the culprit within Miles, but… the culprit is so new that we haven’t been able to figure out all the information yet.
It will take some more time.]
After taking a shower, Jaehyun is talking on the phone with a white towel on his head.
The opponent is Kim Ji-yeon. Jaehyun contacted her to ask about the disappearance.
‘Because there had never been a mass disappearance case like this before the return.’
This is also a variable.
It is very likely that it is also related to the Aesir.
Jaehyun decided that and started investigating this matter.
“Were there any unusual findings at the crime scene?”
[Even if not, there were two common characteristics. The first is that an injection needle with a red liquid was abandoned near the incident.
The second is that nearby buildings have collapsed and the ground has been dug up. It was a trace of a drunken person doing something bad.]
“Did you find out what liquid was in the injection needle?”
[They requested the association, but they say they haven’t revealed their identity yet. However, it seems certain that it has something to do with this disappearance. There……]
“Is there something else?”
[It just happens to be on the news. Hang up and watch TV. Cadet Min Jae-hyun must also feel something strange.]
Jae-hyun tilted his head, but hung up the phone as she told him to.
The voice you hear as soon as you turn on the TV and tune in to the news channel.
[Breaking news…….]
Jaehyun couldn’t help but listen to the voice coming from the TV that was on.
[Recent news is that a polar religious group that worships Odin, who is described as the main god of Norse mythology, is rampant.] [
This religion, which calls itself ‘Asatru’, is committing crimes against the Awakened, and there are incidents It is said that an injection needle with unknown contents and necrotic skin tissue were found at the site.] [There are
already dozens of victims, but the government has yet to come up with a specific plan…]
“Asatru ?”
Jaehyun frowned.
He had heard this word before.

Crossroads within the Milles Academy grounds.

Seongho Lim.

‘shit……!’

At the time of the recent outdoor camp.

like that. Seongho Lim was on his way to the dormitory, passing the crowds with a hurried pace.
Turbuck.

Chae Ji-yoon smiled and said.
She took a step closer.
“Let me ask you one thing. Jaehyun Min Do you hate him?”
“……what? What is that all of a sudden…”
“I’m asking if you hate me enough to want to kill me. Him.”
Seongho Lim, who was embarrassed for a moment, crumpled his forehead fiercely.
Why did Chae Ji-yoon suddenly appear and ask such a thing?
Why was she missing in the first place?
However, the words that came out of Lim Seong-ho’s mouth were not questions about Chae Ji-yoon.
“of course! Jaehyun Min I’m completely ruined because of that bastard! My circle and my personal reputation have hit rock bottom!”
“Is it good? If you hate that much.”
“Are you kidding me right now!”
At Chae Ji-yoon’s self-talk, Lim Seong-ho shouted in a fit of anger.
However, she only looked at herself with a satisfied expression on her face.
That was the moment.
The unknown feeling of incongruity slowly began to spread from Chae Ji-yoon.
“You… what are you doing…!”
“I will give you a chance to avenge yourself. instead.”
at that time. I felt a chill run down Lim Seong-ho’s spine. Sensation as if something sharp was passing through the back and lower back.
Along with him, Chae Ji-yoon, who had approached him before he knew it, took something out of his arms and held it.
syringe.
Lim Seong-ho’s eyes narrowed when he saw this.
‘That’s definitely…… It’s been talked about on TV for a while…’
Phew!
At the same time, Chae Ji-yoon accurately inserted the syringe in her hand into Seong-ho Lim’s nape.
As the contents begin to decrease, the corners of Chae Ji-yoon’s mouth go up.
“Please make sure to kill me.”
Her short laugh echoed through the empty alley.
Lim Seong-ho, who had been injected with something unknown, turned his eyes.
“Chehehe…!”
With a gurgling sound, the pupils disappear and the whites of the eyes are clearly revealed.
His whole body turned pale, and blue veins sprouted all over his body.
Chae Ji-yoon, who was watching this, nodded with a satisfied expression.
“This experiment was a success. what to expect What kind of reaction will the adversary show?”
After a while. Lim Seong-ho came to his senses and regained his sanity. Chae Ji-yoon had disappeared before she knew it.
Im Seong-ho, who was abandoned in an alley, raised his lips as he clenched and opened his fists.
The list of information that came into his head a while ago and his trust in ‘him’.
And to the newly acquired power.
All of that was raising Lim Seong-ho’s self-esteem, which had fallen to the bottom.
“With this power, I can really kill Min Jae-hyun.”
However, Lim Seong-ho did not realize it.
That something is slowly breaking from within you.
* * *
Asatru.
It was a term referring to the religion where Odin’s fierce followers gathered.
‘I’ve heard that there are small groups all over the world, but…’
The sound of the TV continued while Jaehyun was thinking.
[After a fierce struggle, the Radar Management Headquarters succeeded in capturing several Asatru members, but they were already unconscious and only repeated the same words.] [“
Loyalty to Odin and Aesir…… ”]
[The shocking part doesn’t end here.]
[A member of Asatru captured. It is said that their identity was originally an Awakener and a raider belonging to the Association.
Why did Radar, who is supposed to fight for humanity, turn into such a villain?
What the hell took away their selves?]
A shocking story from the announcer.
I don’t know for sure, but I was sure of one thing.
“The Æsir and Odin are moving.”
What purpose it had and what it was aiming for requires further investigation.
However, it was already confirmed that Asatru was moving at the right time.
Jaehyun, who had been holding his hands together for a moment, nodded.
‘I have to investigate the case. The signs aren’t looking good.’
Just when Jaehyun reached out to turn off the TV. The last announcer’s words continued.
[The biggest problem pointed out by experts is the power of the awakened people belonging to Asatru.
It is said that after losing Izzy, they can handle at least three to five times more magic than the grade they were judged in the past.] * * *
News
and mysterious disappearances.
In a situation where the entire academy could be turned upside down, the cadets had no choice but to tremble in fear again.
It wasn’t long after the outdoor camp incident was sorted out.
Another big divergence was sending chills down their spines.
“About a week has passed since the first incident happened. A total of 18 cadets have gone missing and six have been confirmed dead.”
The instructor said so in a somber voice.
Classroom where lectures are held. However, it was not an atmosphere conducive to concentration.
First group of missing persons.
A serial disappearance case that occurred after Chae Ji-yoon and Third Eye disappeared. This was instilling trauma in the cadets.
‘It’s a matter of course. The number of missing people is already crossing double digits. And even the deaths…….’
In fact, the chances of the missing cadets being alive were slim.
The disgruntled voices of the cadets burst out from all over the place.
The instructor lowered his head and said.
“sorry. Although the instructors have not been able to reveal the truth of the case yet due to their immature response, we will try to solve the case as quickly as possible and normalize the academy.”
As an instructor, there was no other way than to say so.
Jaehyun crossed his arms and pushed the chair back.
‘Still, you can enter the scene of the incident from tomorrow evening. There will be an opportunity to investigate the disappearance in more detail.’
I haven’t been to the site for the past few days because I’ve been through all sorts of procedures. He had secretly looked around the scene of the incident, but hadn’t had a chance to see it properly.
In the meantime, Jaehyun went to the academy at dawn and tried to avoid becoming a victim.
There was no great income.
The incident always happened where Jaehyun couldn’t see it.
However, it was impossible for Jaehyun to keep scouting all over the academy without a sigh of sleep.
“First of all, we have to think about what to do with the academy event tomorrow.”
Starting tomorrow, there will be a ‘ranking match’, one of the events of Milles Academy.
The ranking match is a pre-event for the upcoming ‘Milles School Festival’.
I didn’t know that if I didn’t get good grades here, the position of the circle that I had raised to the best would fall.
‘Let’s stay calm. The opportunity will definitely come.’
In fact, in the current situation, it would have been much better for the academy to close the school.
However, this was also difficult in practice.
No matter how dangerous things like disappearances happen, this is basically a military academy that trains weapons to fight demons.
It is a situation where Miles can not show a shaken figure now.
‘It’s already the point of closing school several times. It’s hard to expect any more.’
Jaehyun patted Poppy’s head and murmured.
“For now, let’s focus on the work in front of us. Do you think so too?”
Greung!
Poppy nodded and rubbed his face in Jaehyun’s hand.
* * *
Kwaaaang!
―You have killed the orc!
―You have killed the orc!
―You killed the orc…….
“You’re crazy……”
Jaehyun’s voice echoed in the midst of the roaring explosion.
next day.
A simulated dungeon where ranking matches are held.
In the middle of a shady cave, Jaehyun and Papi are hunting a monster.
To be precise, it looked like Jaehyun was sitting on a rock and Papy was hunting.
Jaehyun shook his head and said.
“No matter how much it is a dragon… I never thought it would be this strong from the beginning…”
A dejected voice mixed with admiration.
In the meantime, Poppy continued to breathe fire at the enemy without stopping.
A somewhat creepy landscape. He seemed to be enjoying himself now.
‘I’ll have to raise him well so that his personality doesn’t get worse.’
Jaehyun thought of such silly thoughts for a moment and thought about the handout and rules of the ranking match he received yesterday.
[Notice regarding the ranking match]
In preparation for the academy festival, we inform you about the academy ranking match.
In the ranking match, the test is to clear a simulated dungeon made with augmented reality alone.
The rankings are randomly divided in the order in which the dungeons were cleared quickly, and the top seed is assigned to the cadets with the highest grades.
*Circle ranking is determined by the sum of the cadets’ personal points.
[Rules]
1. The use of external equipment is permitted.
2. You must clear the dungeon only with the cadet’s personal ability.
3. Special classes such as Healer also apply the same evaluation criteria, but after that, they take additional tests on related items to determine the final ranking.
“I was afraid that clearing it too early would draw attention, so I thought I’d check out Poppy’s skills… I never thought
it would be this bloody.”
Jaehyun seriously crossed his arms and looked at the excited Papi.
“I think you’re stronger than me before the regression… Maybe it’s because of your mood?”
Are dragons still dragons?
Jaehyun muttered that, popping up Poppy’s status window.
I haven’t had time to properly check this yet, but now that I have some time left, there’s no reason not to use it.
‘Then let’s check.’
Fafnir II’s status window popped up at the same time Jaehyun smiled.
Seeing this, his expression was once again stained with bewilderment.
“……What’s so deceitful?”

chapters.title: Chapter 188
chapters.content:
Episode 188 Limit Breaker (1)
[Pet Information]
Name: Fafnir II
Age: 0
Grade: D
[Skill]
Passive: Fafnir’s Blessing (S+)
Active: Dragon Breath (D)
Current growth rate – 31%
*100 If the percentage is exceeded, the rating increases by one level.
After confirming the simple information, Jaehyun opened the detailed skill window.
[Passive Skill]
Name: Fafnir’s Blessing
Rating: S+
Fafnir’s Blessing.
When a summoner and a dragon are on the same field, increases summoner’s ATK and MAG by 50%.
Jaehyun’s eyes widened as he read the explanation.
Somehow, when he summoned Poppy, his body seemed lighter, so it seemed that his physical abilities had improved thanks to Poppy’s passive skill.
“What kind of nonsense… well, thank you for me.”
Jaehyun raised the corners of his mouth and put on a satisfied expression.
A whopping 50% of attack power and magic power. Even though it was a dragon pet, I hadn’t expected this level of effect.
Jaehyun opened the window to check the remaining attack skills.
[Active Skill]
Name: Dragon Breath
Rating: D
A skill that attacks the enemy by exhaling the breath of the dragon.
This skill is upgraded whenever the dragon’s rank rises.
This, too, was a satisfactory skill.
The grade is still only D, but it’s a growth skill.
Even Jaehyun has hardly found anything like this.
Except for Seo Eana’s Alfheim’s sword, there were few people around who had growth skills.
“good. If it grows well like this, it will be quite helpful.”
Gyareung.
After killing all the enemies, Poppy approached and rubbed his face against Jaehyun’s knee.
Perhaps thanks to the calibration of the system, the guy followed Jaehyun very well.
‘Of course, I feel like I follow Kim Yoo-jung more, but…’
Jae-hyun immediately shook his head and brushed off his thoughts.
No matter what, Poppy’s owner is herself.
There is no chance that Poppy will like Kim Yoo-jung more… shit.
while thinking silly thoughts. I could feel the ground shaking lightly.
It seemed that this simulated dungeon raid would end soon.
―The dungeon boss monster 《Orc King》 appears.
The end of the dungeon raid.
Jaehyun put Poppy down on the stone he was sitting on and stood up.
No matter how dragon it is, it is difficult for Papi, who is still in its infancy, to even hunt the boss.
My body was a bit stiff anyway, and now was the time to step forward.
“Because I need a record.”
Jaehyun muttered that and then activated the shape of the magic tool to create an intermediate dagger.
This is a mock dungeon.
Because there was no need to show too much power.
Jaehyun swung the dagger with the blue effect once and threw it at the guy’s forehead.
ping!
A dagger stuck in the center of the orc’s forehead with a noise like arrows flying.
Kuruk!
With the scream of the guy, the 3-meter-tall body begins to crumble.
Following.
thud!
A system message audible as the huge body lay on the floor.
―You have successfully defeated the boss monster.
―Transfers the user to the waiting room.
* * *
―The record is 22 minutes and 21 seconds.
―Milles Academy broke the record for the shortest time ever.
―Additional points are settled.
Returning to the waiting room and checking the rankings, Jaehyun’s eyes narrowed.
The ranking displayed after clearing the dungeon a while ago.
Because there was a strange corner here.
[Mock Dungeon Attack: Individual Ranking]
1st place – Min Jae-hyeon 22 minutes 21 seconds
2nd place – Lim Seong-ho 30 minutes 50 seconds
3rd place – Jeong Hyeon 50 minutes 13 seconds
..9th place – Ahn Ho-yeon 1 hour 11 minutes 42 seconds
14th place – Seo Eana 1 Time 23 minutes 7 seconds
16th place – Kim Yoo-jeong 1 hour 30 minutes 14 seconds
59th place – Kwon So-yul 1 hour 53 minutes 4 seconds
Circle colleagues also recorded excellent grades on average.
Seo Na-na and Kim Yu-jung were ranked 14th and 16th, respectively, and Ahn Ho-yeon was 9th.
Kwon So-yul recorded an upper-middle ranking, and Lee Jae-sang was unfortunately out of the rankings.
However, it wasn’t the ranking of his colleagues that caught Jaehyun’s eyes.
‘Lim Seong-ho…… He’s second after me? Isn’t it Jeonghyun?’
Jaehyun was convinced that the only cadet who would objectively achieve grades next to him was Jeonghyeon.
The strongest among the spear-wielding cadets.
Afterwards, even after the rise of the magic world, he reached the top only with his own skills.
That was Junghyun.
But Seong-ho Lim, who pushed such a talented person, recorded the second place?
‘Something strange……’
It was that moment.
“Are you surprised?”
A man’s voice interrupted from behind.
Jaehyun immediately turned his head to check the face of the man standing in front of him.
He was an expected person.
“Lim Seong-ho.”
“Fortunately you remember.”
“How did you get that rank?”
Jaehyun asked with lively eyes.
Seongho Lim replied putting his hands in his pockets.
“Is there any reason why I should explain it to you?”
It was an expression of stubborn refusal.
Im Seong-ho’s sarcastic expressions and gestures contained a strange confidence that had never been seen before.
Jaehyun smiled.
“Drink or not.”
“You will feel like everything in the world is yours right now. The media, Yeonhwa, and the academy are all on your side. Isn’t the world a comfortable place to live in?”
“however?”
“I will bring you down somehow.”
Seongho Lim’s declaration. Jaehyun raised an eyebrow and laughed.
“Are you in second grade? Are you a little late?”
At those words, Lim Seong-ho’s expression crumpled.
He frowned and tried to say something more, but soon closed his mouth and left.
Turning around, he added a word.
“You’d better keep in mind what I said today.”
Meanwhile. As Lim Seong-ho left his seat, he began to hear the murmurs of nearby cadets.
“what? How the hell did Lim Seong-ho get such a result…?”
“Anyway, Min Jae-hyeon is stronger than Jung-hyeon? Does that make sense?”
“Ah… he must have written something. Is that a good grade? It’s because it was overshadowed by Min Jae-hyun, but that’s also the second-highest record ever.”
“Well…….”
Lim Seong-ho’s second-place record elicited controversy even among the cadets.
He wasn’t a cadet with such skills in the first place.
According to the information he picked up, his grades last year were in the top 30 overall. Even compared to Jaehyun’s colleagues, it wasn’t that great.
Also, that means that there is only one corner to look at.
‘He suddenly became stronger overnight.’
Jaehyun stood there for a while, immersed in his thoughts.
“There must be something.”
he felt it
Seongho Lim. That he is hiding something, and that this will have a close connection with Jaehyun himself.
* * *
Evening after the standings match.
After receiving a call from Kim Ji-yeon, Jae-hyun headed to the scene where the disappearance occurred.
Kim Ji-yeon, who had arrived first, took her luck wearing white gloves.
“You are here.”
“yes. Thank you for listening to my unreasonable request.”
“no. It was the same during the outdoor training camp and during the Gujain incident. Cadet Min Jae-hyeon has always contributed to the academy.”
Jiyeon Kim said with a faint smile.
Jaehyun scratched his head with an embarrassed expression.
I felt that my position had improved a lot in the past few months. In the past, it would have been unimaginable to hear such words from the chairman of Miles.
“First of all, let’s go back to the place where the first incident happened.”
“please.”
With Kim Ji-yeon’s guidance, Jae-hyun was able to take a closer look at the scene of the disappearance.
As she said at the beginning, there were signs of violent movement, the remains of collapsed buildings, and bloodstains near the site.
at that time. I got lucky as if I had suddenly remembered Kim Ji-yeon.
“The results of the request to the institute came out. The red liquid in the syringe. It was a new substance mixed with blood and other impurities.”
“……A new substance?”
“That’s right. It was a liquid that had never been studied before. Even……”
Kim Ji-yeon paused for a moment.
“The new substance contained strong magical powers.”
“……Is that true?”
Jaehyun looked shocked and tried to interpret her words.
How should I accept this?
Jaehyun put his hand on his forehead and thought.
‘Of course, blood plays a role in transporting the Awakener’s magic to all parts of the body. However, it cannot possess magic power by itself.
How the hell did this happen?’
The main organs of the body that produce and spread mana are the heart, brain, and dantian.
This means that blood can never become a container for mana.
Jaehyun couldn’t help but be embarrassed.
“We also didn’t know everything about this liquid. However, cadet Min Jae-hyun would know.
A polar religious group happening in this liquid and recent news. That Asatru might have something to do with it.”
“yes. I was guessing.”
Jaehyun nodded.
Asatru.
It was a group of Odin’s followers who had recently been infesting the whole country.
Jaehyun was convinced that this was related to the school disappearance case.
‘The thing that bothers me the most is the similarity of the incident scene.’
Jaehyun recalled the news he had seen recently.
What he paid attention to was:
[An injection needle containing a red liquid reminiscent of blood was abandoned at the scene of the incident.] [
They are said to be able to handle at least three to five times more magic than the grade they were judged in the past after losing their intelligence.]
From the outside The extreme religious incident that occurred and the current disappearance from the academy.
There were obvious similarities between the two.
Kim Ji-yeon was looking at Jae-hyun’s eyes.
“I don’t know exactly. Our academy and association are guessing that
this new substance is a kind of ‘Limit Breaker’ drug that dramatically increases the user’s magical power .”
‘It’s a limit breaker… I guessed it, but I never thought it would be mentioned directly from Chairman Kim Ji-yeon’s mouth.’
An ugly light stayed in Jaehyun’s eyes.
limit breaker.
This is an Awokener enhancement substance that has been studied several times in the past. A drug that forcibly enhances the user’s level when administered to make them stronger.
However, it was pointed out by many people as an unethical experiment method and was eventually discarded.
“sorry. Because our information is still lacking…….”
“No. it’s okay. Because it seems to have come out to some extent.”
At Jiyeon Kim’s words, Jaehyun raised an eyebrow as he said that.
She tilted her head, but Jaehyun didn’t say anything else.
‘I don’t know the details. But I know a bit about Limit Breakers.’
Reproduction is before regression. I had seen an article about those who secretly made this drug called Limit Breaker.
Maybe it was published in a big way on the social side.
‘It’s just the right time. If the drug called Limit Breaker is really related to this case, there is a high possibility that they did this.
It’s worth investigating.’
Jaehyun immediately came to a conclusion.
After looking around the few remaining incident scenes, he asked Jiyeon Kim for her understanding.
“I might have to take a break from the academy for a while. Would it be okay?”
“Is it for solving this case?”
“you’re right.”
“of course. Please contact us if you need any help.”
Jiyeon Kim had no choice but to say that.
After the outdoor camp, she had a hunch.
Reproduction is different from other radars. Stronger radars will certainly exist, but there is no radar that grows faster than that.
Not only that, he is moving with a clear goal.
Although I don’t know what that goal is…
‘If that’s the case, I might be able to solve this case.’
Jiyeon Kim sincerely thought so.
Now, no one in the country underestimates Jaehyun’s skills.
On the other hand, Jaehyun went to visit a person after breaking up with Kim Jiyeon.
“See you again?”
“Min Jae-hyun… I knew you would come.”
In front of him was Lim Seong-ho.
However, something was strange.
His purple-tinted body was so bizarre that it could not be called human.
Jaehyun was sure.
Im Seong-ho. That he became stronger by using ‘Limit Breaker’.

chapters.title: Chapter 189
chapters.content:
Episode 189 Limit Breaker (2)
That evening. Outskirts of Milles Academy.
Two cadets are standing in the middle of a lonely forest where Jaehyun and Hugin fought in the past.
Jaehyun and Lim Seongho.
However, it is difficult to say that one is human. It looked like a witch’s beast.
The skin tissue dyed purple was already on the verge of necrosis.
“Im Seong-ho. Did you use the limit breaker?”
Jaehyun asked Lim Seongho, who had a pale face.
Seongho Lim responded with a smile.
“okay. That’s what the public calls it.”
“Who gave you the drug?”
Lim Seong-ho frowned at Jae-hyun’s question as he raised his head.
“Ha, I think I’ll say that…….”
“Is it Chae Ji-yoon?”
At Jaehyun’s words, Lim Seongho’s expression hardened for a moment.
“Is that what he did?”
After Jaehyun muttered that, he looked at Seongho Lim with a puzzled face.
Without realizing it, a sigh leaked out.
‘It’s already too late to save.’
Im Seong-ho’s body he saw was rapidly disintegrating.
Right now, I’ve been forcibly suppressing the condition with drugs, but it must be difficult to hold on for long.
‘The mutation has already progressed to the extent of being serious. I thought it was strange from the time I took class during the day… but I never thought it would be this much.’
The reason why Jaehyun came to Seongho Lim and asked him about drugs was simple.
Limit Breaker is a drug that raises the level of an Awakener.
What if this has something to do with religious incidents outside and school disappearances?
‘If that’s the case, I thought that someone who suddenly became stronger would appear nearby.’
His choice was correct.
Jaehyun raised his head and asked.
“Why did you make this choice? You should know about the side effects of ‘Limit Breaker’.”
limit breaker.
These related topics are also covered in depth in Miles’ regular classes.
Im Seong-ho must have known that injecting it would damage his body.
Why is he ruining himself so much?
“To get revenge on you.”
Actually, it wasn’t his choice.
Im Seong-ho was only forced to inject drugs by Chae Ji-yoon.
If you look closely, you might say that someone hurt you.
But he didn’t.
A small amount of pride and stubbornness left behind in oneself. It was making him mad.
“plural.”
Jaehyun repeated a word that stung him like a stone.
plural.
He himself was moving forward with the same purpose.
However, Lim Seong-ho’s case was completely different from his own.
Anyway, he attacked himself to raise his profile.
Jaehyun had no reason to put up with it.
“Are you saying it’s my responsibility?”
“If it wasn’t for you, I wouldn’t have fallen. Because of you……! This happened because of you!”
“It’s not my fault, and it doesn’t matter what you think.”
It was a sophistry not worth listening to.
Jaehyun made a decision. He can’t come back the way he was.
Although he could heal his completely disintegrated body with his own Sacrifice, he could not restore his disintegrating mind.
There is only one way left now.
“Im Seong-ho. I will kill you.”
Tsutsutsutsu!
Jaehyun said so and opened his magic.
* * *
[Become an Asatru and be loyal to Odin… If you worship him, you will gain stronger power…!]
[Min Jae-hyun. Kill the enemy…….]
These were the two sentences that kept ringing in Seongho Lim’s head after he was injected with the drug.
He himself didn’t notice it, but Lim Seong-ho was slowly breaking down.
His head was filled with only malice towards Jae-hyun, making it impossible to think rationally, and his body was also forcibly replaced with magic by drawing life force.
‘Like that guy said, I might die here.’
Im Seong-ho thought so, but it was already too late.
There was nothing he could do at this point.
Seongho Lim shouted at Jaehyun with his fists clenched.
“Me too. I will kill you somehow, Min Jaehyun! Even if I die!”
‘You’re completely crazy.’
At the same time as he thought, Jaehyun raised his hand and deployed his mana.
―Active skill 《Flash Bomb Lv 5》 is activated.
bang!
With an explosion of pure white light, Jaehyun narrows the distance to the enemy’s blind spot.
Jaehyun then added speed to his running legs.
―Active skill 《Wind Boost Lv 5》 is activated.
‘Even now, he continues to grow stronger. It burns life force and replaces it with magical power. It needs to be dealt with as soon as possible.’
The decision was not difficult for Jaehyun, who had a lot of experience.
What is in front of you right now is a demon. never been a person
bout!
With a spirit, Jaehyun reached out his hand. A wave of condensed magical power bursts out.
―Active skill «Ice Spear Lv 5».
The spear of ice rising from Jaehyun’s palm shoots accurately at the enemy.
hooked!
The spear of ice pierced Lim Seong-ho’s shoulder.
In order to continue the momentum, Jaehyun once again deployed his magic and touched the ground.
―Active skill «Wind Edge Lv2».
This time, it is a skill that attacks the enemy by forming a pillar of wind attribute.
Jaehyun then activated a fire strike.
I could feel Seongho Lim’s stance collapsing at the unstoppable attack.
‘Min Jae-hyun… I knew he was strong, but was this enough…!’
Seongho Lim gritted his teeth and raised his magic to block Jaehyun’s attack.
bang! bang! bang!
The sound of several clashes of magical powers was heard, and dust rose.
After a while. All the dust that obscured the view was cleared with a huge explosion.
Jaehyun raised an eyebrow.
“You are weak against fire.”
“This bastard…!”
Im Seong-ho grinded his teeth.
Just now.
Why did Jaehyun attack the enemy using all kinds of attribute magic?
The reason was simple.
‘Because I’ve never faced guys who used limit breakers before. It’s easier to fight when you know what your weaknesses are.’
Jaehyun smiled with a smile on his face.
“Then let’s finish it soon.”
Ugh!
Magical power gathers at Jaehyun’s fingertips.
Lim Seong-ho screamed in a fit of fuss.
“I know how to do that!”
He drew out the mana he had exchanged for his life force and began to emit it toward Jaehyun.
Goo goo goo!
The tangible black magic hit Jaehyun like a tidal wave.
However, it didn’t mean much.
bang!
Jaehyun parried the enemy’s attack very lightly.
“How the hell…! ‘He’ said he could kill you with this much strength, but why!”
surely.
Lim Seong-ho, who attacked himself while burning his life, was strong.
If not up to Fafnir, he has a level of skill that is below it.
Balak and Camilla, who fought together the other day. It had almost the same level of magic as them.
But it doesn’t make any sense.
“It’s him… I know roughly who you’re talking about, but well, I’ve grown up in my own way.
No matter how strong your mana is, if you thought you could kill me with just that much control, you’d be mistaken.”
If it was the original representation, it would not have been possible to organize him so quickly.
But Fafnir II’s passive skill. The skill that reinforces reappearance just by existing in the field was a big help.
Jaehyun nodded and clenched his fists.
Eventually, along with the explosion of the god, his flame magic continued.
―Active skill 《Fire Strike Lv 5》.
―Active skill «Chain of Fire Lv 5» is activated.
―Active skill 《Overdrive》.
The blazing flames in his fists and the floating chains around him all flew precisely towards one point.
A skill that has become even stronger with Overdrive.
Only then did Lim Seong-ho realize.
Can’t win.
Min Jae-hyeon knew that he was an unbeatable enemy.
‘lost.’
At the last moment, Lim Seong-ho put his hand down.
It was because I definitely realized that it was an unwinnable fight.
anyway he dies
There was no need to be remorseful anywhere.
Wow!
Soon after, Jaehyun’s fist hit Seongho Lim in the face.
A fist that was imbued with flame hit him. Then Seongho Lim’s knee collapsed.
fluff.
“Damn it……”
Jaehyun said in a somewhat sharp-edged tone.
“You…why didn’t you think of countering my attack at the end?”
“That’s cool! what are you talking about……!”
“……done. die.”
Jaehyun used a chain that floated next to him and pierced his heart.
Soon after, Lim Seong-ho fell forward with a groan.
Jaehyun frowned and thought for a moment.
‘If you’re going to give up like that at the end, you shouldn’t have started in the first place. If he really wanted to get revenge on me.’
Jaehyun was seized by a feeling of tightness somewhere in his chest.
revenge of oneself.
To do this, you must not do it like Im Seong-ho did a moment ago.
You must be able to move forward without falling apart.
Jaehyun remembered that fact deep in his heart.
Parss.
Soon, Lim Seong-ho’s body was scattered into powder.
Nearby are bursting flesh and familiar injection needles.
It was the same scene as in the afternoon when Jaehyun first investigated the scene of the incident.
* * *
The top of the nearby mountain cliff where the battle took place.
Joo-Won and Chae Ji-Yoon are having a conversation while watching Jae-Hyun and Lim Seong-Ho fight.
“This test subject was also quickly destroyed.”
“Why don’t we just find a new human again?”
Joo Won smiled and said as if it was not a big deal.
Chae Ji-yoon put her index finger to her lips and crossed her arms with the opposite arm.
“It’s a pity, though. It’s hard to find a test subject like that again.”
“but. Because it’s difficult to find someone who has that much ‘hate’ towards an individual.
It is especially hard to find people who hate the enemy.”
For the two beings, Lim Seong-ho was an appropriate hand to attack Jae-hyun.
The most important thing in the experiment for the limit breaker is none other than emotions that have been raised to the limit.
‘Without strong emotions, weak humans will not be able to withstand the medicine and will die.’
The higher the grade, the worse the emotions it has, the more likely it is to withstand the Limit Breaker.
In addition, the power becomes stronger for those who hate it, so Chae Ji-yoon and Joo-won searched for a test subject with deep feelings that hated Jae-hyun.
The result is Lim Seong-ho.
……Well, unfortunately, it failed.
Recently, Joo-won and Chae Ji-yoon were scouring the neighborhood to find a suitable subject for the experiment.
Traveling around the country, Joo Won works outside of Milles Academy. Chae Ji-yoon found a scapegoat near the academy and the enemy.
They intended to raid suitable humans and use them as test subjects for the Limit Breakers, turning them into ‘followers’ of the great Aesir.
Those who are loyal only to Odin and sacrifice for him.
Joo-won and Chae Ji-yoon came down to Midgard for the purpose of training them.
“Anyway, I didn’t expect the adversary to win again. Is it too great?”
“Me too. I felt it during Fafnir, but it has too much power in the human subject.
As Hugin said, there is a possibility of becoming a stumbling block.”
“I wanted this test subject to kill him.”
“Isn’t that a big deal? He’ll have no choice but to come find us anyway.”
After all, the goal of the adversary is to end Ragnarok.
Even for this, Jaehyun has no choice but to come to them.
Joo Won touched the sword at his waist and smiled lightly.
“I hope the adversary will please me.”

chapters.title: Chapter 190
chapters.content:
Episode 190 Pursuit (1)
Deep in Helheim.
The temple of Hel, which was rarely popular, became noisy after a long time.
You can see the gods and giants sitting around a long table.
The green light pouring into the dark temple illuminated the long square table.
“Is this the first time that so many people have gathered since the anti-Aesir forces were purged?”
said the giant with a familiar face.
Smir. He was the son of Hrungnir and the one who presided over the second trial.
“I see. Contrary to initial expectations, it is fortunate that the enemies of prophecy are growing rapidly.
Well… the problem is that Aesir is also moving fast.”
Hearing Hella’s words, the others crossed their arms with complicated expressions.
“No matter how much, I would never have thought that such a secret would be hidden in the ‘Esir System’. I didn’t even think about it, but it’s a big deal.”
Hel touched his forehead with a shocked expression.
army of the dead.
Odin was trying to reconscript them and take Midgard into his hands.

quick.

Jormungand.

however.

First Awakener. Has Hella figured out his identity?

Odin’s Raven?
Odin’s Raven was the first Awakener to fight for humanity?

But no matter how you look at it, it wasn’t a playful expression.
Jaehyun looked at Hella with a hard expression.

An island where the location of South Korea is unknown.

Ju won. was the first Awakener.

cried the cadet.
However, Joo Won did not stop and put strength into the hand holding the sword.
hooked!

“Heuk!”
fluff.

match!

Joo Won replied.

Ha~ These are the Awoken people who follow me. After all, there is no progress?”

Why did you allow us to be tracked? If I wanted to, I could have removed the syringe and all traces of it.”

He said as he wiped his bloody sword.

Joo Won said and shrugged his shoulders.

Joo Won didn’t really feel emotions.
I don’t know the details, but it is said that it has been since the first time I was chosen as Odin’s raven.
“I want him to come all the way here soon. I want to fight soon.”

The glass tubes lined up in a long rectangular space and the Awakened who are trapped inside and barely breathing.

he was sure

That you would be a key cog in his plan.

Odin’s raven.
They became the limbs of Aesir and were the beings in charge of scouting the nine worlds.
As Jae-hyun, those who have no choice but to have bad feelings.

That Asatru is active and using the Limit Breaker to turn Awoken people into their dogs.
This was never something to be taken lightly.
“It must be dealt with now. Otherwise they will grow in power. After that, it cannot be stopped.”

Although Asatru had made an appearance in the world, the location of their home base had not yet been identified.
Even if you move right away, you can’t stop them unless you know their location.
“If we don’t find out the location somehow…”
said Hella, biting her lips lightly.
Jaehyun smiled and nodded.
“All right. I think I’ve found a way. I’ll have to try it to see if it’ll work out.”
Jaehyun said. Hella tilted her head and looked at him.

Hearing Hella’s words, Jaehyun got up and sat down in front of the computer in the living room.

Enter keywords and organize information in order of date and relevance. A few minutes to repeat to choose a useful one among them.

After a while.
After he finished searching for the article, he entered some addresses on his smartphone and saved them.
Jaehyun jumped up from his seat and said.

Reawakening.

about the increase in the number of re-awakeners… ….]
increase in reawakeners.

On top of that, the surge in re-awakening mentioned in the news yesterday. The timing is too close to be a coincidence.’
Jaehyun was almost certain.
Most of the re-awakeners mentioned in the news right now are those who have forcibly awakened their powers using Limit Breakers.
Also that is.

For this reason, Jaehyun looked up an article about reawakened people a while ago.
As a result, he was able to find the suspicious ones among the upgraded radars.

‘There are three candidates who are presumed to have used the limit breaker.’
That was enough to investigate the case and get information.
Jaehyun went outside without hesitation.
* * *

Being too obsessed with strength was a bonus.

Although it was an illegal (?) act, there was no time to worry about it. Really, if he had used the limit breaker, he would have been dying at this very moment.
If you don’t move now, you will lose even your life that could have been saved.
Having made up his mind, Jae-hyeon found Lee Seong-ryeol calling somewhere.
He was also in almost the same condition as Lim Seong-ho. Skin and veins already dyed purple. It was also impossible to return Lee Seong-ryeol to his original body.
sorry thing. However, Jaehyun did not have time to hesitate.
“Ouch!”
He approached and quickly overpowered Lee Seong-ryeol.
“Big! What is it! who is this!”
Beep…… Beep……

Jaehyun asked.
“Are you Lee Seong-ryeol? He said he recently reawakened.”
“You you…! Black robe…!?”
Jaehyun paused for a moment.
After all, rumors of the great ruins spread all over the world.
It was not unreasonable to recognize Rob.
Jaehyun decided to take advantage of this situation.
“okay. I came because I wanted to ask you something.”
“I don’t know what it is… I don’t know anything!”
“Limit Breaker. Where are the guys who gave it to you?”
“…….”
Yi Seong-ryeol, taken aback by Jae-hyun’s question, did not answer for a while.
He was glancing at Jaehyun with a puzzled expression.
“I will ask again. The guys who handed you the Limit Breaker. Where is their home base?”
Jaehyun’s voice was heavy.
He also had enough strength to subdue himself at any time.
Lee Seong-ryeol instinctively realized that the assailant in front of him was much stronger than himself.
“W Research center… I heard that there is a research center somewhere in Korea! I don’t even know the exact location!”
“laboratory?”
Immediately after Jaehyun asked, the man’s body began to turn blue.
Then, with a popping sound, the boy’s body exploded.
As before, there were few traces left.
Apparently, the drug was on the verge of disintegration.
Maybe Chae Ji-yoon and the crow in the actor put a ban on him.
Jaehyun clicked his tongue.
‘I knew it couldn’t be saved. It’s not a very nice sight.’
He shook his head for a second, consolidating his thoughts.
‘There are only two left. We need to find their hideout as soon as possible.’
Jaehyun opened up his smartphone and moved to the address entered next.
There was no time to delay.
* * *
A few hours back from that.
The Awakeners who visited the second and third times were also those who became stronger by using Limit Breakers.
Jaehyun’s prediction was correct.
Frightened, each gave the following information.
“I heard that there is a laboratory on an island in the West Sea!”
“I heard that the place where the research center is located is closed by a demonic beast that no one can live in.”
By synthesizing this information, Jaehyun found out the location of Limit Breaker’s laboratory.
“Baekryeong Island. That is the stronghold of Asatru.”

She was not very bright about the situation in Korea.
Jaehyun explained with a dark expression.

An area where S-class monsters have been rampant due to the dungeon break and the entire island has been fielded.

Hana Jae-hyun said without wavering.

Jaehyun took out his phone and called Yooseong.

[……When I open the beginning like that, there is always a story asking me to do something
. I’d like to get you an item. as soon as possible.”
[……under. I’ll listen to it first.]
From there, it was a breeze.
The artifact that Jaehyun requested from Yooseong was the Warp Marker.
A magic tool that allows you to move to that location only once if you specify an exact location.

The power of Hana Yeon-hwa was also amazing.
that afternoon. Jaehyun was able to get his hands on the warp marker right away.

If this is the case, it will not be too much of a hassle to get the job done.

After giving a proper thanks, Jaehyun returned to his room, installed a warp marker, and stood on top of it.
[Where do you want to go?]

A message that comes along with him.

All of a sudden, his son-in-law brightened and the surrounding scenery turned white.

A place that suffered almost the same damage as Daegu, where the Demon Beast appeared for the first time.

In the past, there were quite a few tourists.
But that is also a thing of the past.
‘After the dungeon break, this is a place where all living things have disappeared. The only thing that exists on Baengnyeong Island is the Witchbeast.’
Jaehyun took a step, recalling the information he learned at the academy in the past.
Magical power felt nearby. This was at least the level that the A-class raider guild’s engineering team had to attack.
‘It’s almost as strong as Daegu’s magic beasts. It’s dangerous.’
“Hella. Stay close to me. It’s hard to get hit and stretch like last time.”
“……Isn’t that a bit harsh? Then, to save Jaehyun…”
Jaehyun moderately ignored her barrage and took a step forward.
That moment.
Ohhh…!
A group of monsters surround Jaehyun.
Most of them were fishmen with fins.
‘It must be difficult to just pass.’
―Active skill 《Formation of magic tools》 is activated.
―You have succeeded in making Nidhogg’s Fangs (A+).
Jaehyun fixed his sword and looked at the enemy.
Kyareung!
Suddenly Poppy burst out of her arms and burst into tears.
I can’t do anything alone because I’m still young, but just having him is a big help.
Jaehyun takes a light breath.
fault!
kicked the ground
―Active skill 《Dagger Dance》 is activated.
―With the effect of the unique skill 《Garden of Swords》, mastery of swordsmanship skills doubles.
Jaehyun’s eyebrows went up.
A bloody bloody sound heard almost at the same time.
Awesome! Awesome! Awesome!
There was no hesitation in Jaehyun’s movements.
The total number of fishmen in the area is over twenty.
However, Jaehyun sorted it all out in just two minutes.
“……I’ve improved my skills even more since I didn’t see it. by the way.”
Hella looked somewhere with a puzzled expression.
His gaze was directed at Papi, not Jaehyun.
“Where did you get this dragon?”
* * *
Jaehyun’s colleagues gather around the hideout after all classes at Milles Academy are over.
Again, they expressed their sadness at Jaehyun, who disappeared without a word.
“What the hell! Min Jaehyun Why does he always disappear without saying a word? You didn’t even come to class!”

Ahn Ho-yeon agreed with Kim Yoo-jung’s words.
In fact, in Kim Yoo-jung’s case, she only wanted to see Papi (Yong-yong), whom Jae-hyun took with her.
There was a little bit of concern mixed in, but it wasn’t a big deal.
“…Aren’t you doing something dangerous again?”

I don’t know by now, but there was a good chance that he was doing something else. You might be fighting the same enemy as the giants you faced before.
“under. It’s frustrating. I want to see Poppy.”

Kwon So-yul said so.
Lee Jae-sang stammered as much as he could with a worried expression. “If I knew you would be away like this
, I would have prepared more potions for you…”
You’re rich there. him.”
Kim Yoo-jung waved her hand.
A moment of silence passed. Suddenly, Ahn Ho-yeon got lucky.
“Anyway, that’s what Jaehyun said before. Are you serious?”
“What do you mean?”
“……The words that said that if you can’t climb to the position of the S-class radar, you can’t fight together?”
Seo Ina asked. Ahn Ho-yeon nodded.
“Jaehyun’s personality doesn’t seem like a joke. But being an S-class isn’t… it’s not an easy position to reach.”
“In the first place, it was thought that one person would come out a year. Is that even possible?”
Kim Yoo-jung said while resting her chin.
Kwon So-yul also showed a skeptical reaction.
“Oh no way. I guess that’s just what I’m saying I said that because I don’t want us to get involved in dangerous things…”
“…I think I can do it.”
Seo Ina interrupted and said. Ahn Ho-yeon’s eyes turned to her.
“Actually, it’s embarrassing to say it… but I also think I want to somehow reach the level that Jaehyun has reached now.”

Kim Yoo-jeong scratched her head and said that.
reappearance.

he was sure

soon

profit!

ding.
