Episode 204 Yamatano Orochi (2)
“Is that… really human…?”
Moriya Lenki. The head of the Japanese coalition thought.
‘The black robe… It’s a monster. It’s overwhelmingly strong compared to all the radars I’ve seen so far. That is a level beyond the human realm.’
It was a matter that could be known even at a glance.
Moriya Renki recalled the story of the black robes he had heard about in past news articles and conversations with Balak.
[He uses a sword, but his magical power is on par with Camilla’s.]
[It wasn’t that he was careless. Of course, I wasn’t in the best condition for the battle, but even if I fought again, the result would have been the same.]
I can’t believe these words came from the mouth of Balak, who has a strong sense of pride.
Moriya Renki thought it was just that there was something between them and the resulting lip service.
But that wasn’t it.
‘The black robe is actually strong.’
Moriya Renki looked at the huge enemy and the black robe standing in front of him as if possessed.
The situation of confronting an S-class monster. However, he doesn’t seem to back down or get nervous.
He was completely crushed by the intimidation of the black robe.
“Uh, how… is that person fighting alone? That Yamatano Orochiwa!?”
Suddenly, the secretary next to me started talking to me.
Moriya Renki frowned.
“I told you not to follow me. Damn, do you want to die?”
“yes? What is that……”
“That person who is dealing with Yamata no Orochi… is a black robe.”
“……I beg your pardon?!”
“Black Robe. A monster that invaded the great ruins of Iceland.”
That was the moment.
Tsutsutsutsutsutsutsu!
An electric current containing enormous magical energy exploded nearby.
Eventually, a stream of water sprang up in the middle of the lake and formed a pillar.
with a splash!
Something landed and the floor opened.
Moriya Renki already knew the identity of what had just fallen.
“Hey Yamatano Orochi…”
he muttered with a stunned expression.
The black robe won an easy victory against the S-class boss monster.
Even in front of your own eyes.
* * *
Tsutsutsutsut!
The rough current and the lightning strikes that cut through the cracks.
The synergy of the two conflicting powers harmonizing was beyond imagination.
Kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa!
The constant surge of electric shocks became even stronger in conjunction with water property magic.
The mana leaked through the cracks of the whirlwind piled up several times, hacking off both the head and tail of the enemy.
A level of magic that others would mistake for a dungeon break if they saw it.
However, the man watching this was not at all embarrassed.
“Looks like you’re stronger than I thought… Is your strength out of control?”
Jaehyun calmly crossed his arms and murmured.
It’s been a long time since I reverse summoned Tyrbing, which I used a while ago.
‘It’s something that devours the user’s ego in the first place. I took it out just to see the power.’
The current Jaehyun has already achieved the second stage of the Divine Liberation.
It means that even an S-class boss is not a threat to him.
‘Well, there’s also Poppy’s passive. It’s to the point where I feel that the battle has definitely become easier.’
Suaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa…!!
Visit!
Yamatano Orochi slammed his face on the floor without hesitation.
The eight tails were also unable to use their strength properly, and they drooped and made waves.
Jaehyun took a deep breath as he listened to the sound of the system.
―You have succeeded in hunting down the boss monster 《Yamatano Orochi》 of Lake Chuzenji.
―You have cleared the first condition of the quest 《Dragon’s First Growth》.
It was a clear message that I never get tired of listening to.
Jaehyun stretched out and waited for the next message.
No matter how newly appeared, Orochi is a boss monster.
Item drops are natural, but Jaehyun had one more thing to gain from this.
The purpose of taking a long step to Japan.
‘That’s the evolution of cute Papi.’
At the same time as I was thinking, another message continued.
―You have acquired 《Yamatano Orochi’s Tail》.
―Displays acquired item information.
[Special Item]
Name: Yamata no Orochi’s Tail
Grade: S
A tail condensed with Yamatano Orochi’s power and magic.
When consumed after cooking, pet growth is promoted.
*caution! Humans cannot consume it.
“This is not bad. It’s a pity I can’t eat.”
Jaehyun licks his lips and thinks, but he hears the sound of the system again.
―Should the user be sent to 《Dragon Valley》 for the evolution of Fafnir II in order to fulfill the second condition of the quest?
‘Dragon Valley?’
Jaehyun, who put the bag on the floor again, tilted his head with a puzzled expression.
It seems that there is a place that needs to be heard more in order to clear the quest.
“Well… it wouldn’t hurt to go right now. There are things that need to be dealt with first.”
Snap… Snap…
When I got back and checked, Poppy was already asleep.
“To be able to sleep peacefully while the owner is fighting……”
The neighborhood was so noisy, but if this was a talent, it was a talent.
Jaehyun, who finished his thoughtless thoughts, turned his head away.
A high-pressure voice slowly escaped from his mouth.
“You there. come out right now Didn’t you think I wouldn’t know if you erased the presence?”
“……Black robe.”
Moriya Lenki, who had been hiding nearby, revealed himself.
Jaehyun raised an eyebrow.
‘This is an unexpected encounter with a giant. Moriya Lenki. He is the head of the Japanese Union, and his characteristic is that he looks like a bully.
It’s not bad though.’
―Active skill 《Insight Eye》.
―Based on the opponent’s ability, we classify the degree of danger.
―The risk level of the designated target is 《Low》.
“Weak.”
He nodded and raised his mana towards Renki Moriya.
Moriya Lenki spoke first.
“What purpose did you come here for? Wasn’t it enough just to capture the great ruins?”
Moriya Renki asked in a relatively calm voice.
Jaehyun shrugged.
“What do you mean?”
“You are a robber. He’s the one who stole the Nordic heritage. I don’t think this time will be any different.”
At that, Jaehyun smiled and put his hands in his pockets.
“I took care of Yamatano Orochi, who you guys were bothering. Rather, it deserves an award.”
Renki Moriya could not immediately respond to Jaehyun’s fierce talk.
Because there was one part I didn’t understand.
According to the rumors I heard during the raid in the past, the black robe was a grave robber. That is, he was a criminal.
It was unknown what was hidden in the ruins, but it was certain that he had stolen something from there and fled.
‘But this case is different. It’s like he’s… trying to help us.’
Moriya Renki thought.
Yamatano Orochi. This has been one of Japan’s major headaches. The information on the items to be obtained after defeating them has not been disclosed at all.
A fight with nothing to gain.
Nevertheless, the black robe came here.
For what?
“Tell me your purpose.”
“I have no particular purpose.”
“Are you thinking of killing us?”
The secretary who was standing next to Moriya Renki looked shocked.
‘Do you intend to kill me…? Moriya Renki, an S-class raider?’
Moriya Lenki, one of the best S-class raiders in the world.
But did he even intuit his defeat before starting the fight?
‘I’ve heard that the black robe is strong, but at what point did Moriya-san show that kind of reaction?
If I don’t do it, will everyone really die here?’
His thoughts did not last long.
It was because Jaehyun said something unexpected to the two people who were worried.
“I have no intention of killing. I didn’t even like it in the first place.”
“Then you must have come because you are interested in Yamata no Orochi.”
In response to Moriya Renki’s words, Jaehyun gave an appropriate response.
“Whatever, let it be.”
“Is there room for a conversation?”
“All I ask is one thing.”
At Jaehyun’s words, Moriya Lenki swallowed his saliva.
‘okay. You can’t ask for anything Because he seemed to be waiting for me from the beginning.’
The thing has finally come.
Renki Moriya thought that while looking at Jaehyun.
A man capable of doing this much would not ask for money.
identity washing? exile? If you’re a criminal, either way is possible.
‘No matter what, you must not go against his planting. That guy is a monster that can’t even be compared to the likes of me.’
Moriya Renki’s neck was shaking involuntarily.
black robe.
What the hell is he going to ask of himself?
“Write me some articles. If possible, pack it up to look nice.”
Jaehyun laughed at that.
Moriya Renki tilted his head as if he didn’t know why.
what article?
He tried to answer him, but he kept his mouth shut.
It was because he knew that one word of his own could kill the secretary next to him.
* * *
It was around two o’clock in the morning when Jaehyun returned to his dorm.

What was left of what was initially aimed at was the evolution of only one Papi.

“Huh… yes.”
Jaehyun took a deep breath and nodded.
Then, suddenly, his body became translucent and began to be transmitted somewhere.
I wasn’t too surprised because I had experienced it several times before.
However, the feeling of being transmitted was always accompanied by motion sickness, so it was a bit disgusting.
After a while. It was truly spectacular that the halo of light came into Jaehyun’s field of vision.
Literally a valley.
The sheer cliffs and colorful dragons flying in the air caught my eye first.
A nest that looks like a couple of mountains below it.
It was a place that looked like a dragon rare.
However, the size was different from the cave that Fafnir had dealt with in the past.
“Is this… the valley of the dragon?”
It was then.
“It’s been a while since a stranger came to visit.”
Jaehyun turned his head in the direction the voice came from.
There was an old dragon that looked to be several tens of meters tall.
A dragon with red skin and two horns on its head.
Jaehyun asked.
“What are you?”
“I am ‘The Watcher’. He is the owner of the Valley of Dragons.
I was waiting for you. The antagonist of the prophecy.”
The dragon’s voice was profound and seemed to be sucked in somewhere deep.
Jaehyun looked into his eyes and said.
“How do you know that I am the opponent of the prophecy?”
“Because I heard about them.”
“They? …You mean the three Norn sisters.”
Jaehyun quickly understood.
The three Norn sisters. He saw a future with Mimir and regressed himself to avoid repeating Ragnarok.
By using the Nornir system.
‘Anyway, the three Norn sisters seem to have seen quite a bit of my future.’
‘Those who watch’ looked at Jaehyun for a while, then nodded and took the lead.
“I will raise your child. Follow me.”
Jaehyun started following his words.
Not once has the system made unreasonable demands of itself.
Even now, they must be frantic for their own growth.
‘And that means I have no reason not to use them.’
“let’s go. Poppy.”
Greung!
Poppy clung to Jaehyun’s shoulder.
After a while. The place we arrived at was an altar with a mysterious atmosphere with a dragon engraved on the door.
Jaehyun looked around and asked.
“This is… where is it?”
“The Altar of Evolution. From now on, Fafnir… No, I should say I’m 2 years old now. I will draw on his strength. Step back.”
With that voice, the altar lights were turned on.
―The evolution of Fafnir II begins.

Episode 205 Altar of Evolution

Hwareuk!

‘Those who watch’ said that and handed an item to Jaehyun.
“Hold this.”
It was a parchment scroll with runes written on it.
“……What is this?”
“It is a scroll that allows you to connect the dragon and your soul.”
Jaehyun tilted his head as if he didn’t understand.
“But Poppy is already registered as my pet by the system. Why go through such a cumbersome process?”
“This is because the firepower that a pet can produce is completely different. If you and Fafnir II can completely share magical powers, he will become many times stronger.”
Jaehyun nodded.
There was such a story even among summoning-type raiders. The deeper the connection with the summoned monster, the stronger the power.
Among them, I had heard that sometimes the level of summons would go up.
“understood. Then what am I supposed to do?”
“Pour your magic into it. If you do that, the scroll will recognize you and connect your will with the dragon.”
Saying so, ‘The Watcher’ handed Papi a necklace with runes engraved on it.
Apparently, that rune word was a token to connect the bond.
Jaehyun quietly injected magic into the scroll and waited for a while.
“Then let’s start slowly.”
With the words of ‘the watcher’.
Strong magic power began to erupt from all over the Altar of Evolution.
Geeing…!!
It was a similar feeling to when he obtained Odin’s lost eye in the past.
Jaehyun let out a deep breath as he looked at Papi’s naturally virtuous face.
At that moment, light began to emanate from the scroll in his hand.
―The scroll 《The Pattern of Judaism》 recognizes the user.
―Magic structure update 17%… 33%… 67%… 100%.
―Connection with the summoned beast has been completed.
Along with the voice, Jaehyun could feel a strange magic power running up the back of his hand.
When he rolled up his sleeves and looked at his forearm where he felt a slight pain, there was a new change that was different from before.
‘Is this… a pattern?’
To be precise, it was a pattern written in runes.
It’s the same look I saw on Scroll and Poppy’s necklace a while ago.
‘The Watcher’ nodded with a satisfied expression.
“Now you and Fafnir II are connected by a bond. It gave me more power.”
Jaehyun immediately looked at Papi after the pattern was engraved.
He was scratching the necklace around his neck with his claws to see if it was uncomfortable.
“no. Papi. It’s a token of our bond, so you’re going to sever it?”
Jaehyun said that with a mischievous expression and stroked Poppy’s head.
Then, the ‘watcher’ opened his mouth.
“Now that the engraving is all over, let’s start evolving in earnest.”
with his words.
The white flame from the altar began to attach to Poppy’s body.
Jaehyun screamed in surprise.
“What is this…!”
“Okay. It is not the flame that burns life. Quite the contrary.”
“Against…?”
“Look at him.”
Jaehyun was dubious, but moved his gaze to Papi.
Then amazing things started to happen.
The fire with condensed mana……
“Are you eating?”
Poppy was swallowing white flames. As if it were a special meal (?).
Jaehyun looked at the ‘watcher’ with an incomprehensible expression.
he said with a chuckle.
“White flame increases the dragon’s vitality and amplifies its magical power. It’s a precious thing, so it’s not given to other races… but
it’s not a waste if you’re the opponent of the prophecy.”
―Fafnir II’s rank increases by 1.
―Current grade is C.
―Fafnir II learns new skills.
―You have acquired the active skills 《Gigantification》 and 《Dragon Fear》.
―The rating of 《Dragon Breath》 has risen by one level.
―Dragon has entered the growth phase from infancy.
Jaehyun felt proud of the message that came to mind one after another.
It was a rewarding moment to dare to change the destination of the school trip to Japan.
“Well, for now, let’s check the skills later. first.”
Jaehyun asked, raising the corner of his mouth.
“Did I say ‘the watcher’? There is something I want to ask you.”
Jaehyun’s ferocious eyes looked up at the dragon’s huge body.
Soon after, a smile spreads across the lips of the ‘those who watch’.
Jaehyun said in a calm voice.
“Dragon Valley. What is this place?”
It was a question Jaehyun had from the first time he came here.
When I first got Fafnir. The system informed Jaehyun.
[When the dragon dies, it is transferred to the ‘Valley of the Dragon’.
The pet can be resurrected after the waiting time has elapsed.]
Because of this phrase, Jaehyun had no choice but to question this place itself.
Valley of Dragons.
The real meaning of the place where even dead dragons are resurrected.
Jaehyun was asking about this.
After a long silence passed.
‘The Watcher’ opened his tightly closed mouth.
“The Valley of the Dragon is…”
* * *
The morning of the third day.
The autonomous schedule of the school trip went smoothly.
The members of Circle Nine, including Seo Eana and Kim Yoo-jung, decided to move together.
Jaehyun decided not to come together the day before, so we didn’t get together.
Even at this moment, he was struggling for Poppy’s growth.
……Of course, no one knew about this.
like that. In the middle of a circle tour in a peaceful atmosphere.
Suddenly, Lee Jae-sang raised a sensitive topic.
“Uh uh uh, did you two have fun yesterday?”
A question for Seo Ina.
Lee Jae-sang was asking about her trip to the aquarium with Jae-hyeon yesterday.
However, this was a catastrophic situation for others astute.
‘That crazy…!’
Kwon So-yul was the first to pray with both hands together.
No matter how ignorant it is.
Can’t you see the tear marks and swollen face left on Seo Eana’s face?
Ahn Ho-yeon and Kim Yoo-jung also did not look good.
‘Please… let me go over somehow…!’
Ahn Ho-yeon also joined hands with Kwon So-yul.
However, rather than the cold reply that was expected from Seo Eana, a bright voice returned.
“……yes. It was fun.”
When she said that, she even gave a small smile.
Ahn Ho-yeon and Kwon So-yul looked at each other for a while and then swallowed.
“Ah… what is it? We’re not asking, we’re just asking if you enjoyed the aquarium. I don’t think this means anything else…….”
Kwon So-yul tried to rectify the situation somehow.
Kim Yoo-jung smiled unconsciously at her appearance.
But that was then.
“…Actually, you knew everything. I like Jaehyun.”
“Quup! Wow! what what?”
Ahn Ho-yeon coughed as if he had heard a cough and looked at Seo In-na.
Kwon So-yul had the same reaction. Lee Jae-sang just looked around at his colleagues with his eyes wide open.
“I didn’t know anything at all…”
“From my point of view, you are impossible to date for the rest of your life.”
When Kwon So-yul fired at him, Lee Jae-sang quickly became gloomy.
But what surprised me the most was Kim Yoo-jung.
‘I knew, but… I didn’t expect to say it this far…’
Seo Eana was usually shy and didn’t talk much.
But I didn’t expect her to confess that she likes Jaehyun so confidently.
I vaguely guessed it, but hearing it in person was a different feeling.
While the three of them were flustered, Lee Jae-sang opened his mouth.
“Did you confess?”
“……It’s similar.”
Seo Eana replied with a relieved expression.
Lee Jae-sang let out a clumsy moan as Kwon So-yul’s elbow bent his back.
At that time, Kim Yoo-jung playfully grabbed Seo In-na’s arm and asked.
“Don’t be too heartbroken. There are better men out there…….”
“……I will hear from you soon.”
At that moment, the eyes of the two met.
Kim Yoo-jung’s eyes, which had always been bright, trembled for the first time, and a smile erased from her lips.
Seo Ina was given some strength.
“…answer. It’s just that I haven’t heard it yet.”
Seo In-na’s expression stood out for determination.
Meanwhile, at her bold declaration, Kwon So-yul unknowingly touched his forehead.
‘Hey guys, what else do you have left?’
* * *
“Valley of Dragons. To put it simply, this is the dragon’s grave.”

Around the time Jaehyun’s thoughts reached that point, ‘The Watcher’ opened his mouth again.
“Among the races of the nine worlds, there is magic that only dragons can use. “Rebirth”. This refers to the magic of passing on those memories and being reborn as an egg when you die.”
“Reborn…?”
“okay. The same goes for Fafnir II you have.”
Jaehyun couldn’t understand right away.
“But then, why does this guy have no memories of the past?”
“That’s because I was penalized by Odin’s curse. In order to be reborn, Fafnir sacrificed his memory.”
Sacrifice your memory
Jaehyun thought over the phrase for a while.
‘Why does he want to help me, even at the cost of his memory? Is it also revenge?’
It was not a question with a clear answer.
I was thinking about it, but suddenly he opened his mouth again.
“This is a great tomb and cradle. Valley of Dragons. The system calls it that.
We work here to restore and return the reverse summoned dragons. Of course, even if that’s the case, I hope you don’t recklessly drive our people to the battlefield.”
Jaehyun nodded.
I felt like I finally knew something.
After thinking about it for a while, he decided to ask one more question.
“I just got this. Do you know how to cook it?”
What Jaehyun gave was none other than Yamata no Orochi’s tail.
It was an item that corrected the growth rate when fed to a pet, but Jaehyun had no idea how to cook it.
“Haha, of course. I am the guardian of the valley of the dragon. Cooking like that is ridiculous. If you tell me, I’ll treat you to dragon’s cooking. All dragons are gourmets.”
Then watch and learn.
Having said that, the “watcher” pointed somewhere with his huge claws.
The place he pointed to was a restaurant.
There was a table with a surprisingly large plate and gold cutlery.
Jaehyun looked at the ‘watcher’ entering the kitchen as if he was absurd.
‘Cooking with that size doesn’t suit you? Something’s breaking… Is that a dragon?’
He thought so, but he didn’t express it outwardly.
I was just about to get tired from the battle. There was no reason to refuse to serve me a dish.
Jaehyun sat down and waited for a while with an expectant look on his face.
about 30 minutes later.

At that moment, a person clearly appeared in Jaehyun’s mind.

Looking at the scenery, he recalled the events of yesterday for a moment.
[If you tell me, I will treat you to dragon cuisine. All dragons are gourmets.]

As for reproduction, the tournament is conducted with a light heart.

* * *
Dragon Valley after Jaehyun leaves.
Near the giant nest.

The owner of a familiar voice. It was Mimir, the giant of wisdom.

“You have to live to see the sunrise tomorrow. I would have said it before. It’s too early for me to die.”
“…….”
Jaehyun was at a loss for words.
It seemed that her anxiety had been amplified by the fact that she had said that they would share the food they made together after the cooking contest was over.
She was seriously contemplating whether she should go back and do gastric lavage.
“Eat first.”
However, there was no such thing as Jaehyun overturning his choice.
After all, he had devised a way to resist the terrible cuisine.
Tasting Kim Yoo-jung and her own cooking can be a bit(?) harsh for others, but for now, she puts her life first.
There were times when Jaehyun became selfish, and one of them was now.
“I’ll have to try the Ina dish first.”
Ahn Ho-yeon, Kwon So-yul, and Jae-hyun ate a spoonful of Seo E-na’s dish first.
The dish she made was budaejjigae.
For Koreans who had almost lost their spiciness for 4 nights and 5 days, the effect of budaejjigae was amazing.
“…This is it. Taste of Korea…!”
Ahn Ho-yeon admired.
Kwon So-yul and Lee Jae-sang continued to stuff something into their stomachs, making a fuss that this might be their last supper.
Jaehyun was also enjoying Seo Eana’s food.
‘As expected, Ina’s cuisine is amazing.’
Thinking so, I ate budaejjigae.
Seo Ina suddenly smiled at Jaehyun.
‘…You look great.’
Thinking so, Seo Ina sat down at the table and stared blankly at Jaehyun with her chin resting on her chin.
After eating all the first dishes like that.
Next were Ahn Ho-yeon and Kwon So-yul’s dishes. The two of them were actually quite good, so there was no big problem eating them.
Lee Jae-sang’s tteokgalbi was unexpectedly delicious, and favorable comments continued.
The problem was next.
“eat.”
Click.
Jaehyun said as he set his dish down in front of his colleagues.
It was clean except for the two mouthfuls Poppy had just eaten.
“Wait a minute, Jaehyun. I need to prepare my mind a bit from here…”
Ahn Ho-yeon was frightened, and Kwon So-yul and Lee Jae-sang also nodded from behind.
However, Jaehyun never changed his words.
“eat.”
“Are the kids freaking out if you can’t cook?”
At that time, a triumphant voice came from Kim Yoo-jung.
Jaehyun was dumbfounded and lightly pushed her forehead.
“This is real. Poppy’s taste is a bit unique(?), so I like it. Isn’t it because you’re good at it?”
For some reason, Kim Yu-jung felt her face heat up at Jae-hyun’s sudden action.
She fanned her hands and turned around.
“Then why don’t you try your food first? So that the children can be at ease.”
The story of Kim Yoo-jung, who stammered strangely, made Jae-hyun worry.
It was because he knew that unlike Kim Yoo-jung, his cooking was tasteless.
But soon, the worry disappeared like snow.
‘With this, at least I won’t have to suffer from food.’
Jaehyun laughed and secretly activated a skill.
―Active skill 《Cold-blooded》 is activated.
―The user temporarily does not feel emotions.
―The user’s senses are temporarily dulled.
cold blooded.
In addition to getting rid of emotions, the skill obtained after the battle with Juwon in the past had the effect of blurring the senses.
The fact that it also has the effect of paralyzing the sense of taste was tested in advance. Also, this is the definite hand that Jaehyun believes in.
Jaehyun showed off his skill and put his food in his mouth in front of his colleagues.
As expected, there was no taste at the tip of his tongue.
He clenched his fists tightly, leaving his hands behind his back so Jaehyun couldn’t see them.
‘good. It’s a success.’
After clearing his throat, Jaehyun looked at his colleagues and said.
“Because I proved that there is nothing wrong. You eat too.”
At Jaehyun’s words, others ate his food with their eyes closed.
“Ugh…”
A rather violent reaction ensued, but fortunately there were no casualties.
And… Finally, the final turn came.
“Wouldn’t it be okay if we didn’t eat Yu-jeong’s cooking? Poppy likes it, so I think it would be okay to eat alone…”
Kwon So-yul looked at her notice while talking, but Kim Yoo-jung smiled and waved her hand.
“I’ll make as many more as you like, so all you have to do is enjoy it. Yongyong also ate it deliciously, so it will definitely be worth eating this time too!”
Kwon So-yul’s face turned white at the words he said while raising his thumb.
Kim Yoo-jung was convinced that her food was delicious even during the past outdoor training camp.
The colleagues looked at Jaehyun with resentful eyes with their eyes tightly closed.
Then the moment they taste a bite of food.
An electric current rushed through my tongue and brain.
“Kuhup…!”
“…Ha ha ha….”
“Nanana, save me… Soyul, I don’t know what it is, but please take one pill…”
Jaehyun was relaxed while watching their reactions.
He firmly believed in the power of skill. Wasn’t he actually able to eat his own food calmly?
Jaehyun didn’t worry at all and put Kim Yoojung’s stew in his mouth.
‘I don’t feel any taste… hmm?’
It was then that I felt that Jaehyun was strange.
‘Something’s wrong.’
Jaehyun was sure.
I shouldn’t be able to feel the taste because of the effect of the skill… What on earth is this sensation digging into the tip of my nose?
“Ugh…”
Jaehyun felt dizzy for a moment.
– You ingested poison.
―< < Blessing of Hell > > resists status ailments.
―< < Blessing of Hell > > resists status ailments.
―< < Blessing of Hell > > resists status ailments.
…message after message.
He watched the dish in front of him, trying to control his spinning mind.
It was strange.
Now that you’ve gained godhood, you’re going to collapse like this with just one dish?
“The kids… have already been hurt…”
I looked around and saw that the others were already down.
Only Kim Yoo-jung and Papi were looking at the fallen people with their heads tilted.
Jaehyun finally came to his senses and asked one last question before passing out.
“Kim Yoo-jung… this bird… don’t you taste the food when you cook? How the hell is this…”
Kim Yoo-jung responded with a natural smile.
“ok? If you pick it up in the middle of cooking, you’ll gain weight.”
“Who… said that…!”
“Did your mother do that?”
“Cowardly…”
With Kim Yoo-jung’s words of course, even Jae-hyun collapsed on the spot.
They woke up a few hours later.
It was the last day to return from a school trip.
* * *
The day we come back after all the school trips are over.
On the way back to Daegu after passing through the portal center, Jaehyun accessed the portal site and skimmed through the new articles.
In the main portal, as I talked about with Renki Moriya at the beginning. There were articles about black robes all over the place.
Its headline read:
[Black robe… shocked to see it appear in Japan this time]
[Black robe. After defeating Yamatano Orochi, he suddenly disappears?]
[A mysterious man appeared on Lake Chuzenji. What is the purpose of the black robe?
Why did he help the Japanese coalition?]
The article was stimulating, but it was mostly written in favor of the black robe.
‘It must mean that Moriya Renki is keeping his promise to me.’
Jaehyun thought so and put on a satisfied expression.
Now the name of the black robe will become more famous all over the world.
This will be of great help in your future activities.
Jaehyun thought so and turned off his smartphone when suddenly Hoyeon Ahn, who was sitting next to him, stabbed him in the side.
“I… That Jaehyun. I’m saying this because I don’t have kids.”
he was so lucky
When Jaehyun turned his head, he said in the lowest possible voice.
“Is there something going on with Ina?”
“what? What are you talking about?”
“No… Ina did that before when you weren’t there. He said something like that… confession to you. They said they haven’t heard back yet and are waiting. I want to know what the story is about.”
“Ah…”
Jaehyun couldn’t help but be a little taken aback by those words.
It was a story between two people, but I didn’t know that it would spread to circle members so quickly.
To think that Seo Eana was even talking about him.
It was something that I couldn’t help but be surprised by Jaehyun.
After thinking for a while, Jaehyun asked in a quiet voice.
“Is Ina okay?”
“Hmm… the expression seemed okay. I’m not going to say anything about other people’s love stories… but it’s kind of like when kids fall apart. I was just asking because I was worried.”
“don’t worry. There is no such thing.”
After saying that, Jaehyun put on his earphones and closed his eyes.
It meant that I would not talk about this matter any more. Ahn Ho-yeon was also considerate of him and did not ask more.
like that. The stopped bus started moving again, and the school bus came to a halt not long after at the academy site.
It was the moment when the long 5 days and 4 nights school trip schedule was finally over.
* * *
A few minutes later when Jaehyun and his colleagues were going back to the dorm.
Nyan-.
Hella, who suddenly turned into a cat, came to visit him.
Circle members of Nine tilted their heads as if they were puzzled by the appearance of the black cat.
“what? Why are there all the cats in the academy grounds?”
“…I know. Even the red and purple odd eye… I’ve never heard of a cat like this roaming the academy.”
“Anyway, it looks really strange. Even the hair is shiny.”
words of friends. They had reasons for their doubts.
This is because there are no animals except summoned beasts in the academy grounds of Milles Academy. The reason was that there was a possibility of becoming a demon beast due to the influence of magical power.
Nyaang.
As if she were a real cat, Hella came up to her and poked her leg.
Jaehyun looked at her with his eyes narrowed.
‘It’s strange. Hella never showed up first when she was with her friends.’
Hella looked as if she had something to tell her.
It’s not serious.
Thinking so, Jaehyun turned his back to his colleagues and said.
“I’ll go first.”
“Do you know that black cat? Are you Yongyong’s friend?”
Kim Yoo-jung asked. Jaehyun shrugged his shoulders appropriately.
“Something similar.”
“If it is urgent, go quickly. Let’s go and get some rest.”
Kwon So-yul nodded while saying that, and Lee Jae-sang agreed.
“G-g-g-g-g-yeah! Come on, everyone should get some rest!”
“…See you tomorrow.”
After exchanging greetings with his colleagues, Jaehyun quickly walked back to his hotel room.
As soon as I opened the door and entered, I heard the voice of Hela, who had polymorphed into a human.
She had an urgent expression.
“We need to move quickly.”
“…yes?”
When Jaehyun tilted his head, she sat down on the bed as if she was used to it now.
“The third trial is ready.”
“Are you finally starting over?”
Jaehyun smiled as if he had waited for Hella’s words.
Now is the time to go to the next step.
Hella kept her hands together.
“One thing in particular this time. I will warn you in advance.”
She was as heavy as possible.
“This trial will be completely different from the two past ones.”
“Why?”
When Jaehyun asked with a serious expression, Hella sighed.
“Because the god in charge of trials… is insane.”
* * *
A place full of fresh apple trees. The figure of a goddess is seen.
She clapped her hands excitedly and murmured.
“It’s finally my turn…! Adversary…! You pay for the precious gift! It’s wonderful!
Of course, it will take a while to come, but…….”
She spun around in place as if she was excited.
“Anyway, where are you coming from! It looks like Hella has already started guiding… I’m going to do some people-watching in a while!”
As she murmured, she held a wooden basket in her hand. There are a lot of ripe golden apples inside.
The goddess smiled as fresh as spring.
“Then… Shall we prepare for the third trial soon?”

chapters.title: Chapter 208
chapters.content:
Episode 208, the third ordeal
“The god in charge of the ordeal is out of his mind… what the heck does that mean?”
When Jaehyun asked with a puzzled expression, Hella let out a small sigh.
Jaehyun’s brow furrowed involuntarily.
I don’t know who is in charge of the next ordeal, but it seemed like a rather tricky god.
Hella shook her head and said.
“Should I say that in many ways, when we are together, we lose strength all the time. I’m annoyed when I’m dealing with… No, it’s not like that. big.
You will know when you experience it yourself.”
I mean you know when you experience it.
This was Jaehyun’s greatest fear before returning.
‘The god who presides over the third trial… What on earth is he doing that makes Hella talk like that?’
Hella usually exaggerates quite a bit, but she has never warned her so strongly.
Jaehyun immediately fell into thought with a disturbed expression on his face.
What the hell happened to the theme and content of this ordeal?
Is it okay to push on like this?
However, there was no other way.
Right now, I had no choice but to crash.
Although he succeeded in weakening their power in the battle with the Heimdall Lords. This is only two victories.
Ragnarok is scheduled.
Also, more victories were needed to prevent this.
Jaehyun had no intention of procrastinating.
‘The more you want it to be early, the more you have to prepare properly and move on. I can’t stop Aesir and Odin if I don’t take even one step ahead.’
Jaehyun, who came to a quick conclusion, nodded and opened his mouth.
“I will prepare right away. Where is this destination?”
“It is a fog garden.”
“Mist Garden?”
Jaehyun tilted his head as if he couldn’t understand. Poppy, who was sleeping next to her, also sat up and looked at Hella.
She opened her mouth again.
“That’s right. It’s a place you don’t know. There is a girl who has run away from the Æsir.
We call her ‘Fugitive of the Æsir’.”
“The Aesir’s fugitive?”
“I cannot give more details. Trial anyway. You, the antagonist, must experience it yourself. I am only a guide.”
Jaehyun understood right away and made up his mind.
“We will start tomorrow. It’s also an academy holiday. How long will it take to get there?”
“Even if it’s not the case, I have something to tell you about that part…” ”
… Judging from the reaction, it doesn’t sound like a good story.”
Hella trembled for a moment as if stabbed by Jaehyun’s words.
She looked at Jaehyun’s notice and hesitated, then closed her eyes tightly.
“It… it takes a while to go to the garden. About a year?”
“……yes?”
Jaehyun grabbed Hella’s shoulder with a puzzled expression.
what? 1 year?
As Hella averted her eyes, Jaehyun shouted in an urgent voice.
“…1 year?! Where is the alternate location that is taking so long?”
“I cannot say the exact location. But… I can tell you that it exists somewhere in Niflheim.
Once we get to Niflheim, it won’t be long.”
It’s Niflheim.
Jaehyun lost his mind in an instant.
Niflheim, the world of fog.
Heading to one of the nine mythical worlds?
However, there was something that complicated Jaehyun’s head more than that.
time of one year.
What family and colleagues will be left behind while you go through your ordeal?
Can you survive safely in the meantime?
My head was pounding. It was a great stress for him to have this happen in the rush of a day.
‘…As Jaehyun, I can’t help but worry. Even though he’s cold on the outside, he’s a warm person to his colleagues.’
Hella also fully understood his confusion.
Jaehyun was more concerned about his family and colleagues than his safety ahead of the ordeal.
He was the usual altruistic temperament.
When Hella thought so.
Jaehyun was racking his brains to find a way to minimize the time it would take to get to Niflheim.
gap of one year. This was something that could not be easily overcome.
‘It probably won’t be easy. It’s bad judgment to move around people without a plan.’
During the second trial, Jaehyun realized.
While you are going through trials, you can’t know anything that happens outside, and it’s impossible to respond to it.
If Odin and Aesir’s movement to attack their comrades started in time, Jaehyun could lose his people.
‘But in order to kill Odin, you can’t help but go through trials.
In addition, it will be difficult to reach the Mist Garden while avoiding the eyes of the Aesir gods. Because Hella said so.’
The Mist Garden is a special place created to hide the fugitives of the Aesir.
The basic purpose is to avoid the eyes of the Aesir, and it means that security is thorough.
No matter how much Hella was the guide of the ordeal, it was impossible to shorten the process of getting there.
when i thought so A thought flashed through Jaehyun’s head.
“Hella, as you said. Does that mean that as long as we somehow get to Niflheim, it won’t take long from then on?”
“yes? Yes… that’s true…”
At that moment, the corner of Jaehyun’s mouth went up.
He looked at Hella with a fishy expression and opened his mouth.
“I came up with a way. An interesting way to get to Niflheim in the shortest possible time.”
After a while. Hela, who heard the method of reproduction, screamed in fright.
“You really don’t think that way is possible!?”
* * *
Tiri-ri-ring! Tiri-ri-ring!
Central headquarters of the European Union.
Balak, who went to work after a while, was sitting in his seat when a phone call came from somewhere.
Judging from the fact that the call was connected by the secretary, it seemed to be an important call.
Ballack was annoyed, but as if he couldn’t help it, he grabbed the receiver.
The voice that came from the other side was that of someone very familiar.
[I have something to say.]
“Moriya Lenki. I want to ask what’s going on so suddenly… but I guess I know. Why did you call me?”
[Black Robe. What the hell is he?]
The representative of the Japanese Union.
Moriya Renki asked, getting straight to the point.
The questions were mixed with complex questions.
black robe. Where the hell is he from?
For what purpose is he moving?
“If you have personally encountered the black robe, you would know. That he… is a monster we can’t do anything about.”
[Are you saying you don’t know why he commits such eccentric things?]
At that, Balak hesitated for a moment, then smiled and nodded.
“okay. What do I know?”
He briefly recalled the meeting with Jaehyun in the past.
When people were put into a coma by a mysterious woman at an auction house.
black robe. In other words, Jaehyun tried to save them.
He even returned the sword he had aimed at in the past without killing himself and Camilla.
Of course, he put restrictions on himself so that he couldn’t tell anyone about himself, but it was easier to kill the witnesses than that.
But he didn’t.
Because of this, Balak and Camilla thought.
‘I don’t know what the black robe’s purpose is… but at least it’s not our enemy. It won’t be moving to harm humanity.’
Neither itself nor the European Union alone can stand against the black robes.
Unfortunately, they did not have the strength to deal with the black robes.
Unless all the elite raiders from the US, Japan, and EU get together. Blocking the black robes was nothing more than hitting a rock with an egg.
“Don’t strain yourself too much. There is nothing we can do anyway.”
[…You talk like you know me very well. Well… he was awesome. I didn’t expect Yamata no Orochi to be dealt with so quickly.]
Renki Moriya also didn’t have that bad feelings for Jaehyun.
A man who was in control of his life and death. However, despite the hostile attitude of himself and the Japanese coalition, he showed mercy to them.
Now, the reason why he called Balak and inquired about his identity was just to figure out the clear purpose of his movement.
Along with that, it was to respond to a dangerous situation.
also.
[Personally, I want to meet and talk with the black robe again. I think you can help.]
“Why do you think so? Did he decide that I and he had a point of contact?”
[Yes.]
“The basis?”
[European Union’s move.]
Ballack’s lips went up. Moriya Renki was continued.
[The European Union initially had strong hostility toward the black robes. It’s only natural that the world’s only
great ruins were robbed.]
[But after some time, after the auction house incident. You suddenly stopped searching for the black robes. We even sent official letters to other alliances requesting the same.
As if I had been instructed by him.]
“That’s an interesting reasoning. But what about this I can’t let go of the bridge.”
[Why?]
Moriya Lenki asked in a sharp tone.
“The reason is simple.”
Balak shrugged.
“I can’t say anything about him anyway.”
[What?]
Moriya Lenki was taken aback, but what he said was true.
Subordination to Balak and Camilla.
Because this was a restraining tool that kept the identity of the black robes secret.
Of course, no one in the world would think that an S-class raider could use such obedience magic.
[i get it. If you’re willing to hide your identity like that until the end… we’ll find out somehow. Expect it.]
“Try well. Of course, the results are obvious.”
At Moriya Lenki’s words, Balak couldn’t help but snort.
Wasn’t he the one who went through the black robe twice right in front of him?
Balak knew better than anyone else that Moriya’s skills would never be able to capture him.
* * *
The next day. Jaehyun left the hotel early in the morning. The thought of going through the third ordeal made my body ache already.
The current Jaehyun was anxious to prove his skills.
Until now, Jaehyun has grown sufficiently. It was quite different from the second ordeal a few months ago when attacking the great ruins.
At that time, if Smir hadn’t allowed him to go through the ordeal, he couldn’t even step inside.
But now, before I knew it, I was able to face the third trial with confidence.
As for Jaehyun, the feeling was inevitably new.
“It’s good. If it’s here, I won’t worry too much if anything happens.”
Now, the two beings and Papi were in the middle of a closed city with few people.
From now on, what they had to do could cause great damage to the surroundings, so it was necessary to choose the place well.
After looking around, Jaehyun took out an item from his inventory and held it in his hand.
“Then let’s start soon.”
The artifact in his hand is none other than a Shinhwa-class bracelet that Chae Ji-yoon had in the past.
It was Draupnir.
An item that opened the gate by eating people’s feelings of greed and gaining magic power.
This was a special item that summoned demons from the nine worlds and turned them into soldiers, allowing them to fight according to the will of the wearer.
Why did Jaehyun take out this item and hold it in his hand?
Helena knew this. She looked at Jaehyun with an incomprehensible expression.
The way he remembered yesterday. Because the risk was too much.
Hela narrowed her eyes as she saw the Draupnir in Jaehyun’s hand.
“Do you really want to try that crazy trick? You… you could die if you do something wrong…!”
However, despite her words, Jaehyun only smiled with a calm expression.
“of course.”

chapters.title: Chapter 209
chapters.content:
Episode 209 Niflheim (1)
“Of course.”
Jaehyun said that in an exhilarating voice and looked at Hella in front.
Niflheim. His way to the world of fog was simple but dangerous.
‘To use Draupnir.’
Hearing Hella’s words for the first time, Jaehyun thought.
What is the fastest way to Niflheim?
The answer did not come immediately.
Except for the time he visited Svartal Fame, Jaehyun had never visited another world in mythology.
The first and second trials were also conducted in dungeons or ruins. Jaehyun thought it would be the same this time too.
‘I’ve visited Hel’s temple during the first trial… but that was only to get a reward.’
For reference, the god in charge of this ordeal was a person with the alias of Aesir’s fugitive, and was in a situation where he could not reveal his identity to the outside world.
You can’t open dungeons or ruins to summon opponents.
In the end, in order to go through the ordeal, he had no choice but to move himself as an adversary.
For this reason, Jaehyun thought that a change of thinking was necessary.
It takes about a year to reach Niflheim. Because I had to find a way to shorten it somehow.
I was thinking about how to get to Niflheim so quickly.
It was a very ingenious and outrageous idea that passed through Jaehyun’s mind.
‘It’s using Draupnir’s effect. Because this artifact opens a portal connecting the other world and Midgard.’
What if you could use it to open a portal to Niflheim in Midgard?
It is possible to shorten the time by one year.
However, this method had considerable risks.
“Basically, Draupnir is a mythological artifact. It requires a lot of horsepower to drive it.
You will need to inject about twice as much magic as the total amount you can generate now.”
Hella said that with a worried expression.
Still, she couldn’t understand Jaehyun’s choice.
It is natural to be concerned that your family and colleagues are in danger.
But it was too reckless to adopt this method.
Isn’t it normal for other people to think about how to earn a year’s worth of time?
However, Jaehyun chose a new way to shorten the time.
Even if it means risking your own life.
“……under. anyway that’s how it happened I will also help as much as possible. It’s not good for me to see you die.”
“What is it? Are you taking care of me?”
Jaehyun smirked moderately and took a deep breath.
‘Know. How risky it is to force-drive a mythical artifact.
But I have no choice but to do it.’
Certainly among Draupnir’s effects is the linking of Midgard with the other world.
But that’s what drives it. Getting full control was another matter.
Artifacts are basically tools that store repetitive tasks, like skill slots, and inject magical energy into them to perform them.
To put it simply, the magic tool that allows you to use fireball simplifies the calculation formula by using the user’s magical power as a medium. It means a tool that shortens the process of activating magic.
Hana magic tools are composed of complex calculation formulas.
Because of this, the user of the artifact is not free to transform the expression unlike the wizard who learns and uses magic directly.
It’s because injecting magic power to perform a stored repetitive task is one thing, and transforming it after you have a fundamental understanding of it are two different things.
What Jaehyun wants to do now. Transforming Draupnir’s formula to open a portal to Niflheim without summoning a demon.
‘Fortunately, I heard the location and approximate coordinates of Niflheim from Hela. Now, all that remains is my individual ability.’
Gying!
At the same time as he was thinking, Jaehyun concentrated the magic that remained in his body into one point.
Magical energy slowly began to move from the dantian and head to a single point, and it flowed from the wrist to the bracelet that was attached.
Jaehyun’s brow furrowed for a moment, and a system message was heard.
―Activate the artifact «Draupnir (Myth)».
―Sufficient magic power has not been charged. Draupnir is powered by the user’s magic power.
-caution! The user does not have enough horsepower.
Stumble.
In an instant, a huge feeling of exhaustion breaks Jaehyun’s body.
His body slowly began to lean to one side.
Lose your balance.
Despite the sharp sensation he felt, he tried to hold on somehow, keeping his legs as strong as possible.
However, the operation of a mythical artifact. This was not an easy task for Jaehyun now, who had released the second stage of Godhead.
The reason Chae Ji-yoon was able to drive Draupnir in the past was because she took away people’s greed and replaced it with magic.
Hella’s expression hardened as she watched Jaehyun.
Greung…
Papy looked at Jaehyun with a worried expression.
Jaehyun’s expression is almost erased before he knows it. Soon after, the worst situation that the three beings did not expect at all began to happen.
-caution! The user’s mana flows back!
Due to the lack of magical energy injected into Draupnir, the power began to flow backwards.
It was the first mana rebound experienced by Jaehyun.
* * *
Freya.
The lord of Valhalla and the goddess who stands at the pinnacle of the Valkyries.
She was in a state of annoyance, unlike usual, who had always been calm.
The fine glass in front of her was about a third full of wine, but she hadn’t taken a sip.
A recent instruction given to him by Odin.
Because it upsets her.
“Odin… that scumbag made me do this… filthy bastard.”
Recently, Odin was preparing for the second Ragnarok.
In the process, of course, I heard that the opponent of the prophecy was interfering with him.
But I never thought that I would give myself such an order.
“Using Valkyries to attack humans?”
Not too long ago, Odin suddenly came to him and said.
[I need to deal with the adversary. Prepare the Valkyries.]
It was absurd.
Even if it’s not, they lost a lot of Einherjar and Valkyries in the first war in the past.
How long she groaned at the loss of an army that believed in her.
Still, Odin is pushing his next victim to limb.

adversary. That he became stronger was something I had heard and knew.

sensibility? If not, will it be your own will?

that it is already inherent in itself.
…!!

voice that follows.

―You have successfully operated the artifact.

* * *

“ha.”
Jaehyun sighed and looked around. Every time you breathe, the white breath breaks and scatters as smoke.
We have already arrived here and have been walking for about 30 minutes.
For Jaehyun, who has a transcendent body, this kind of cold was not a problem, but it was different for young Poppy.
The boy was trembling as if he was weak against the cold.
No matter how wonderfully potential a dragon was, Poppy was just entering its growth phase.
Enduring the cold of Niflheim is premature.
Well…

―Active skill «Ignition».
―The target’s body temperature rises.
Jaehyun warmed up Poppy by using his fire skill that raises his body temperature.
Even if he doesn’t die, Poppy is the only pet. I had no intention of hurting her here.
After a while.

A place full of ice and fog, devoid of any warmth.
Jaehyun walked around the streets and captured the scenery around him.

‘The level of the monsters that appear is not that high. Most of them are below grade B. There must be a stronger monster in the center, but there is no one who can feel threatened yet.’
Jaehyun looked around closely and calmly organized his thoughts.

while thinking Suddenly, Jaehyun’s feet stopped.
he muttered as he warmed up.

Grrr!
Jaehyun encountered several demon beasts nearby. He quickly figured out their identities.
troll.

However, the Demonic Beasts encountered by Jae-Hyun’s party were not ordinary trolls. The guys whose shoulders and faces were covered with white ice, as if they were frosted.

-Meet the Frost Trolls.

―Active skill 《Insight Eye》.

“Well, even if they’re a bit tough, it’s okay.”

Sniff?

……For reference, blueberries were not included.
‘Instead, Yamata no Orochi’s tail is included, so it’s a food that will be of great help to Poppy’s growth. I also really like Poppy.’
Fortunately, Poppy really liked this sandwich.
I don’t understand Kim Yoo-jung’s bizarre eating habits, but I decided to think of it as her own personality.
Jaehyun briefly recalled yesterday.

In addition, I didn’t forget to ask to be Poppy’s head chef.
[Of course I should! It’s food for my Yongyong!]
There were some offensive words mixed in, but Kim Yoojung readily agreed.
She’s very close with Poppy, and she’s not the one who eats her food… but her existence seemed to give her a lot of uplift.
Of course, it was a part that Jaehyun couldn’t understand, but I decided not to pay much attention.
Kwao…!
Poppy let out an unusual cry and stood in front of the enemy.
Apparently, the special sandwich stimulated his switch. After wiping the drool with his paw, he saw three trolls surrounding him.
“Take care of Poppy.”
Jaehyun cheered. Since Hella didn’t accompany her on the school trip this time, she didn’t know how much stronger Poppy had become, so she had an interesting expression.
“Then let’s look forward to it……”
Kreung!
―Fafnir II activates the active skill 《Giant》.
―Fafnir II activates the active skill 《Dragon Fear》.
At that moment, Poppy suddenly began to grow in size, and then a huge roar erupted.
The body of the guy who grew up without knowing it was over 2 meters.
Unlike his significantly different size, his cute face remains the same. Looking at the huge pink soles, Jaehyun smiled involuntarily.
―Fafnir II activates the active skill 《Dragon Breath》.
bang!
The breath that came out of Poppy’s mouth accurately hit the enemy.
Jaehyun looked at the place where the white flames shimmered.

Jaehyun couldn’t help but be genuinely surprised.
“… Originally, I thought it was extremely strong compared to its rank, but…”
I never thought the power of a C-rank Dragon Breath would be elevated to this level.
Jaehyun shook his head and looked at Poppy with an innocent expression.
‘It’s a story I heard in the Valley of the Dragon… but Poppy’s potential is amazing.’
In the past, Jaehyun had heard about Papi from ‘the one watching’.

Jaehyun briefly opened the stats window with a satisfied expression.
[Active Skill]

As the size increases, the power of stats and skills increases.
* It can be returned to its original state. Hugeness is maintained only when the skill is used.
[Active Skill]
Name: Dragon Fear
Rating: B
With a wild roar, greatly reduces the physical abilities of enemies weaker than yourself.

[Active Skill]

Jaehyun felt satisfied that Poppy’s newly acquired skill relieved the inconvenience he had experienced so far.

‘Once Papi gets too big… it’s not just one or two uncomfortable things.’
There is nothing dumber than attracting unnecessary attention from others.
In that sense, the giantization skill was a pass.
The next skill I checked was Dragon Fear.
A skill that reduces the stats of opponents weaker than you through a roar.
It was almost similar to how Heimdall forcibly sealed the power of reappearance with Gjallarhorn in the past. There is a difference in power, but it is a skill that can be usefully used.
The last one was the Dragon Breath, which could be called Papy’s exclusive weapon.
This rank has risen by 1, and has now reached C.
There was a clear difference in the breath that was changed, not just a simple increase in power.
‘The flames he exhaled turned white. It’s probably because he ate white salt at the altar.’
At that time, ‘Those Who Watch’ said to Jaehyun.
The white flame is a very precious flame and is not easily seen.
Also, it is said to be very useful because it absorbs the tough life force of the opponent.
Jaehyun realized that he was right when he saw the fallen troll in front of him.
Gua…
the troll was completely crushed and breathless.
‘It’s absurd that one C-class pet can make a troll like that.’
Basically, trolls are class A monsters with very good regenerative power. Even if you think you killed it, it was also an intelligent being that would rise up and attack the raiders.
However, Baek Yeom was completely taking away even his tenacious vitality.
The two remaining trolls standing in front of Poppy looked at him and screamed.
Aaah…!!
Kreung!
But Poppy didn’t seem to care much.
The guy’s attention was on the sandwich he could only get after winning.
It was also made by Kim Yoo-jung. His greatest concern was the poor cooking, which is embarrassing to even call it terrible.
“Isn’t it exploitation of labor anyway? Poppy is still growing up.”
Hella jokingly shot at him from the side, but Jaehyun neatly ignored it.
Jaehyun cleaned up the remaining two frost trolls before he knew it and welcomed Poppy back with a triumphant expression.
“good job.”
Greung.
After a short cry, it shrank again and returned to its original size.
The guy, who had returned to his original form, put out his front paw and confidently asked for a sandwich from Jaehyun.
As if Jaehyun couldn’t help it, he put on the white gloves he had taken out of his inventory and held up the basket containing the sandwiches for a moment.
Taat!
He pulled out a sandwich faster than light and handed it to Poppy. The boy was delighted and pushed the purple-stained bread into his mouth.
―The pet’s growth rate is increased!
System messages were also heard steadily.
A sandwich made from the tail of Yamata no Orochi. It was a shame if it didn’t work.
“No matter how I look at the dragon’s taste, I can’t get used to it.”
Even Hella raised both her hands and feet when she saw Poppy eating her sandwich.

Jaehyun started walking again after stroking Papi moderately.
frost world. Niflheim never knows what will happen. If you’re not as careful as possible, you’ll end up dying.
Recalling this fact deeply, Jaehyun stepped towards the center of the world filled with ice walls.
* * *

Hella spread her magic for a moment, felt the energy around her, then nodded.
“It’s not long now. A little further and we will arrive.”
Surprisingly, Niflheim itself was not that wide.
However, there were many magical places, so Hella had to keep disabling the barriers along the way.

The center of Niflheim.

yet.

Suddenly, a woman’s voice was heard in their ears.
A high-pitched voice, as if exasperated.
“what! Where is this! Who has been so early for so long?!”
A woman’s screaming voice came from inside.

All kinds of plants are growing in an orderly manner around it.
However, despite such a cozy scenery, Jaehyun couldn’t help but let out an embarrassed voice.
The cause was the words I heard from a woman I had just encountered.
[what! Where is this! Who has been so early for so long?!]

owner of the voice. According to the circumstances, this would be the person in charge of the third trial.

Idun. It was a familiar name to him.

Idun.
In Norse mythology, the god of youth and the grower of golden apples.

I was disappointed because the taste was not as good as I expected.
he reminisces about the past

Jaehyun realized that.
At first, why did Hela find it annoying dealing with the person in charge of the third trial?

3 days.

Jaehyun thought.

Annoyed voice. The reaction was instantaneous.

After all, things were messed up because he arrived in Niflheim too quickly.
“If you’re sorry, you have to pay for it. Don’t you know that an apology that is only verbal is not sincere?”
Idoon’s hesitant voice followed Jaehyun’s snarky words.
“Now, wait a minute…”
Idun didn’t say anything as if he was thinking for a moment, then clapped his hands as if he remembered.

“That guy…?”
After thinking for a while, an existence passed by Jaehyun’s head.
he said, blinking his eyes.

Anyway, I can’t go through the ordeal right away. For now, it’s best to do what she says.

Jaehyun nodded, trying to hide his satisfied expression.

Hella sighed.
Poppy just tilted his head, as if he didn’t understand.
* * *
After a while. Mist Garden after Jaehyun leaves.

However, she was simple.

he asked, looking around.

“prison?”

“Are you Nidhogg?”

“I received a quest to strengthen my weapon from Idun. They told me to get recognition from you… what exactly do I have to do?”
[First of all, reach where I am. The deepest part of Nastrond. Right to Hvergelmir.]
Hvergelmir.
