‘It means a bubbling spring, and it is the source of all the water in the world and the spring where Nidhogg lives.’
Even in mythology, the location of Hvergelmir is described as Niflheim.
By the way, the dragon said to live there is also Nidhog.
In other words, the historical evidence of the myth was well maintained.
Jaehyun nodded and nodded.
“Is that all?”
[Of course not. But getting there won’t be that easy.
You won’t even be able to reach this place without going through three doors.]
Nidhogg continued with a smile.
[Then I wish you luck.]
Before Jaehyun could answer, the voice became an echo and disappeared.
Hvergelmir. Leaving only the words to go to the deepest place.
Jaehyun frowned.
It’s because Nidhogg left meaningful words at the last moment.
“The road to get here won’t be easy… What the hell are you talking about?”
“Once inside, I will explain.”
Hearing Hella’s words, Jaehyun took a step inside.
With a squeaking sound, the white door made of bones opened, revealing its interior.
Seeing the scenery there, Jaehyun went cold without realizing it.
[Ah… stop… Stop it….]
There, I saw countless dead people tied to chains and unable to move.
Violet liquid dripped constantly over their heads.
Chii profit!
With a burning sound, the voices of the dead grew stronger.
Jaehyun was able to realize at once that it was poison.
“What the hell is this… what is it?”
To those words, Hella replied with a hard expression.
“The first gateway to Nastrond. This is where sinners who commit adultery are tortured. They have to endure the agony of the venom dripping over their heads every day.”
[Stop… release us… I… I…!!]
[Kwaaaaagh…!!]
[Please… please stop…]
“Close your eyes. don’t run into Because the eyes of sinners make people agitate.”
Hella led the way with her horse.
She seemed familiar here.
However, despite her words, sinners stood in the way of Jaehyun and Papi.
The moment Jaehyun tried to raise his mana as if he couldn’t do it.
Suddenly, Hella raised her hand and looked at Jaehyun.
Right then. Hella, who had restrained Jaehyun, calmly took a step and raised her magic power.
That was the moment.
chuck! chuck!
A strange thing happened.
The sinners who were surrounded by them bowed their heads toward Hella and began to pave the way.
“Hella? What is this…”
Jaehyun looked at the sinners who bowed down flat and bowed to Hella, with a look of incomprehension.
Hella smiled and said.
“It seems you forgot that I am the alter ego of Hel, the ruler of the dead.”
After she said that, she pointed forward and hurried her steps.
“Let’s go. You’ll have to move quickly to meet Nidhogg.”

chapters.title: Chapter 212
chapters.content:
Episode 212 Nastrond (2)
“Nastrond is the largest prison in Niflheim, where those who have committed the three ugly sins are imprisoned.
The first is a hell where reserved venom drips down to those who commit adultery. This is Gate 1 right here.”
Hella’s explanation was clear at a glance.
Jaehyun took a closer look at his surroundings as he walked through the first gate.
As she said, the theme of hell here was poison.
Countless figures of sinners came into his eyes, except for those bound in chains.
As Jaehyun walked past the criminal, he heard the scream of the dead man.
[AaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaG ………
I’ve done nothing wrong…]
Jaehyun looked at the horrendous screaming sinners in chains.
The hideous appearance with rotting parts of the body was hard to see even if the stomach was strong, and the stench piercing the tip of the nose was also terrible.
The hell common people think of.
And should I say the miserable words of a sinner who committed a serious crime?
Jaehyun frowned as if he was displeased.
“Hella, did Nidhogg say that you can reach this end by going through three gates?”
“That’s right. In order to go to Hvergelmir, you have to pass through all three gates he said.”
“What are the conditions for passing each gate?”
At Jaehyun’s question, Hella thought for a moment and then opened her mouth.
“Every time you pass through that gate, you are confessing your sins. Unless, of course, you have committed a sin.”
confession of sin
Hellas told me that the purpose of each gate was to confess the sins of those who committed them.
In that sense, Jaehyun had nothing to worry about at this gateway.
A felony dealt with in the first pass. This was adultery.
However, Jaehyun is not even married yet to commit adultery. Even before returning, he had never been in a proper relationship, let alone married, so there was no place for him to be guilty.
‘I don’t know why, but it makes me sad…’
Feeling somehow bitter, Jaehyun approached the person guarding the first gate.
A man of great height and excessively purple skin.
Hel explained that he was the ‘Covetous One’, one of the triplets of Nastrond who serve as the gatekeepers of each gateway.
A person who can be feared more than anyone else by those who commit sins.
However, Jaehyun had nothing to shy away from. He walked proudly and stood before the gatekeeper.
‘The person who coveted others’ glanced at Jaehyun, then nodded and opened his mouth.
[You are innocent. Go to the next gateway.]
Greung!
Jaehyun took a step towards the door to the next step with Papi following him toddling.
There was a quite long passage inside the door, but I thought it was a bad taste to have the faces of criminals stuffed on the wall.
I was walking through such a long, empty rectangular space.
Suddenly, Hella smiled and spoke up.
“I’m glad though. not having a spouse
I don’t even have a girlfriend in the first place.”
“…You seem excited about something?”
Jaehyun got angry at the strange teasing voice, but Hella didn’t stop.
Jaehyun let out a deep sigh and walked back to the depths of hell.
Two gates appeared before long. Jaehyun had no choice but to pause for a moment.
“…what? these are?”
* * *
As soon as I arrived at the second gate of Nastrond, the first thing I noticed was a snake.
Innumerable snakes bit the sinner, and a fountain of blood gushed out from among them.
[Please… take these off! Boo please!]
[Stop… Go away! Go away!]
I hear the frightening screams of the dead.
As Jaehyun looked at this with a depressed expression, Hella opened her mouth.
“The second gateway here is a hell where sinners who break their oaths are bitten by snakes and suffer blood pouring out.”
“The one who broke the oath…”
Jaehyun pondered over whether he had such a sin.
From before the return until now, of course, I have not lived perfectly. In the meantime, I made mistakes and reflected on myself and came this far.
In the process, it may have been a breach of oath and trust.
Jaehyun gulped and asked Hella.
“If the gatekeeper of this gate finds me guilty, what will happen to me?”
Looking back, I don’t remember committing such a major sin.
However, in the worst case, there was a possibility that there would be a catch or death here.
“You have to face your sins.”
“Facing sin?”
“That’s right. You must see the sin that is inherent in you from the depths of you. And then you really have to realize it.
If you do, the gatekeeper will let you go forward.”
Hela said that all who fail to pass the gates of Nastrond have failed to face their sins.
Because he didn’t admit his mistakes, and because he couldn’t wash away the great crime, he was imprisoned here and suffered every day.
She explained it that way.
“All right. I can’t help it. I have no choice but to hope that I will be the one who doesn’t come out with anything.”
Jaehyun said so, and this time as well, he passed the dead who paid respect to Hella and headed towards the end of the gateway.
There, as before, a man who appeared to be a gatekeeper was standing tall.
It was almost the same as the one I saw at Gate 1, but the skin was a normal color.
However, he had a strange appearance with snakes tied around his waist and legs.
[I am the ‘one who broke the oath’, the gatekeeper of the second gateway. Will you pass?]
“Yes.”
[I will look at your sins.]
He said in an overbearing tone and began to scan Jaehyun’s body.
It is the job of the gatekeeper to identify the guilty and ask the appropriate crime.
A little time passed like that.
The gatekeeper opened his mouth while looking at Jaehyun.
[I can’t say I’m not guilty. Since you have already broken your oath with others several times.]
“Really? That made me sad.”
Jaehyun said that with a sly smile on his lips.
In the worst-case scenario, he intended to meet Nidhogg by fighting the ‘Breacher of the Oath’ here.
reinforcement of equipment. This will be a great power to fight Aesir.
There was no thought of going back from here.
[But.]
It was the time when Jaehyun was preparing for battle.
It was the gatekeeper who suddenly got lucky.
[You also have the right to pass.]
“… Huh?”
what do you mean all of a sudden?
Why is the guy who just said he was guilty suddenly saying that he deserves to pass?
Jaehyun blinked at the quick change of attitude and looked at the ‘those who broke the oath’ in front of him.
It was then.
[However, it is impossible not to ask for guilt just because you are qualified. I will sentence you.]
“What is that…”
Jaehyun tried to say something, but the ‘one who broke the oath’ continued.
[From now on, I will show you a fragment of the past.
Come back after seeing that memory and confess what kind of oath you broke.]
At that moment, a bunch of snakes came out from under his feet and started biting Jaehyun’s limbs.
“Big…! What is this!”
With the fountain of blood gushing from his body, Jaehyun felt as if his mind went black for a moment.
Voices and scenes immediately came to mind.
Jaehyun’s eyes narrowed and his body began to tremble.
Memories that are slowly being drawn in front of your eyes.
This was very familiar to him.
* * *
“Run away!”
The owner of the voice that came at the same time as consciousness was blurred was a familiar person.
Jaehyun looked at the young faces of the two in front of him.
And I looked back at my memories.
This is a dungeon. And those in front now are Kim Jin-ah and Park Seong-woo.
They are now… sacrificing for me.
Goosebumps all over my body and I felt my mind go blank.
Jaehyun intuitively knew.
This is the illusion shown by ‘the one who broke the oath’. It was a memory of the past and it was his own sin.
‘At the time of the simulated dungeon… This is the past when two people were sacrificed.’
The day there was a mock dungeon before the return. Kim Jin-ah and Park Seong-woo sacrificed themselves for Jae-hyun.
Those who were kind like idiots were in danger due to Gu Ja-in’s evil hand in the mock dungeon, and they decided that they were already late, so they pushed their backs, saying that they would survive at least for Jae-hyun.
Hearing those words, Jaehyun ran away without hesitation. There was no time to feel grateful to them.
have to live
You have to survive.
That was the only driving force that kept Jaehyun’s legs from stopping at the time.
It wasn’t until a few days after the accident that Jae-hyeon recalled that day and realized that his choice was foolish.
I couldn’t save him and he ran away.
It wasn’t just that he was weak.
Still, he ran away alone.
Jaehyun thought.
How big of a sin is this?
* * *
The background suddenly changed and the fragments of memories continued.
Likewise, the place where Jaehyun was located was a dungeon, but the atmosphere was completely different.
Also, this was the place where the last memory of reproduction before returning was located.
‘At the time of the dungeon attack with the meteor guild… On this day, I got Odin’s lost eye and returned.’
Jaehyun looked around.
Countless meteor guilds and hired freelance raiders.
Purple smoke penetrates between them.
Poison Mist.
It was only then that Jaehyun realized what the oath the ‘those who broke the oath’ had just talked about.
The bond you shared with that person.
This was a kind of history accumulated with others.
But, unable to trust others, he gave up on it.
Even in the worst way.
Jaehyun continued to contemplate his memories without averting his eyes.
A thick purple fog spreads, and soon people start to scream and fall one by one.
Wild screams and moans from the mouths of those paralyzed in action. The raging fountain of blood further subsided the heavy fog.
Among them, Jaehyun could see one person.
The face of a very dear person.
‘…Myeong-ho hyung.’
Myeongho Lee.
He was a grateful person who took good care of him when he was struggling to find a job as a non-fighting radar.
Jaehyun betrayed that person at the last moment.
he said.
[Jung Woo-min. I’ll do something that didn’t happen today. So…]
Those words were an obvious betrayal and an act of betraying trust.
Jung Woo-min was the one who killed Lee Myung-ho.
But Jaehyun begged him for his life. for your own life.
my sins.
Jaehyun felt the bitter taste of blood on the tip of his tongue and kept an eye on the continuing memories.
People’s voices were heard and the fog continued to deepen.
An explosion was heard and the place was noisy.
Jaehyun aloofly watched as the white blade pierced Lee Myeongho’s chest.
Think again.
crime. what is my sin
A desperate longing for life? Can you say it’s my fault?
‘no.’
It was only then that Jaehyun realized clearly as he watched Lee Myungho collapse.
My sins that ‘the one who broke the oath’ said.
It ended up….
Chaeng-Geurang.
At that moment, the illusion that covered the whole field of view was shattered.
Along with that, a voice pierces Jaehyun’s ears.
[Now, what is your sin?]
Soon, a calm voice came from Jaehyun’s mouth after seeing his memories.
“My sins. It is ‘running away in front of a colleague’.”
It was also a sense of guilt deep in Jaehyun’s heart.
At Jaehyun’s words, the corner of the mouth of the ‘one who broke the oath’ went up.
As soon as he opened his arms, the door to the second gateway opened wide.
[Pass by. Adversary of the prophecy.]

chapters.title: Chapter 213
chapters.content:
Episode 213 Nastrond (3)
[Pass by. Adversary of the prophecy.]
‘The one who broke the oath’ said so and sent Jaehyun through the next gateway.
Jaehyun took a light step towards the inside.
‘Have I passed the two gates now?’
only one thing left.
Two days had already passed.
Jaehyun intended to quickly break through and go back in time for the ordeal.
Anyway, what I’m going through right now is nothing more than a weapon enhancement quest.
In the end, the reason he arrived in Niflheim was to undergo the third ordeal.
There was no time to delay for this.
“The third gateway may be against you.”
“A polarity?”
Jaehyun looked at Hella who explained that and asked again.
However, she didn’t say more, just shrugged her shoulders.
Jaehyun felt it.
‘It must mean that the final gateway is not easy.’
Greung!
Poppy poked at Jaehyun’s trouser hem and comforted him as if to cheer him up.
I remember seeing it a little while ago. This was making Jaehyun’s expression darker than ever.
Jaehyun let go of his hardened expression and walked forward again.
In any case, we must move forward.
It was a fact that, if not deeply recalled, would soon be forgotten.
* * *
[Ahhhhh…!]
[Ahhhh…! Ahhhhh … !!]
The last gateway to Nastrond, waiting for reproduction, was the hell of wolves tearing humans.
Blood-stained leather clothes and raging wolf teeth were strewn about.
Most of them are bladed, such as swords or spears.
“They are sinners who have committed murder. They are the ones who kill the innocent.
They will be constantly torn by wolves here at the third gateway.”
It is a place where murder is punished.
After all, killing a person in any place seemed to be the greatest sin.
Jaehyun looked around for a moment and then moved forward, ignoring the rows of dying dead.
Greung…!
Because of Hella, there were no sinners running into her, but it wasn’t a nice view anyway.
The dead tried to block their path from time to time, and Jaehyun had no choice but to frown.
Poppy was also crying low, wary of them.
Jaehyun stroked Poppy’s head for a while as if he was okay, then arrived at the last gatekeeper.
As expected of the theme, a man wearing a wolf’s mask was standing in the seat.
“He was the ‘taker of life’. He is the eldest of the triplets and the gatekeeper of the final gateway.”
Hella gave a brief explanation this time as well. Jaehyun nodded and walked towards him.
‘The one who took life’ opened his mouth.
[It’s been a long time since a human has come to the final gateway. No… I’m not a human anymore.]
‘The one who took life’ glanced at the reenactment as if it were interesting.
He seemed to know well about himself, the antagonist of the prophecy.
As a representation, that wasn’t too bad. There will be less to explain.
“I want to go through the last door. What should I do?”
At Jaehyun’s question, ‘the one who took away life’ looked at him for a moment, then shook his head.
[Hmm… You must have killed quite a few people.] For
some reason, the unshakable face of the ‘those who took lives’ looked stiff.
Jaehyun’s eyebrows narrowed, and an annoyed voice came out from him.
“so. Are you saying you can’t let me in?”
[No, that’s not it. The motives behind your murder are clearly different from those of the other evildoers. All those killed were either evil or irreparably damaged.
But that doesn’t make your sins go away. It’s definitely my fault for not even worrying about whether there was a way to save them.]
“I was more urgent to protect the things around me than to care about those guys.”
[I understand.]
‘The one who took life’ said that as if he really thought so.
He stared straight into Jaehyun’s eyes.
[I also lost a lot. Ragnarok… Because that long war was hell itself more terrible than Nastrond’s prison.
It would be natural to protect colleagues rather than strangers.]
“Can you tell me what I must do to get past the last gate?”
[One thing.]
The head of the ‘those who took life’ suddenly turned and the voice continued.
[Unconditionally affirm what I say. If so, let me pass you by.
Instead, if you give a negative answer or fail to answer my question, I will kill you here.]
“Listen and decide.”
At Jaehyun’s words, ‘the person who took away life’ immediately asked.
[Can you swear never to kill anyone again?
If you go back to before you committed the first murder, can you correct your decision at that time?]
At that, Jaehyun’s expression hardened for a moment.
However, he soon smiled and raised his speculation.
Can you not kill others?
“No, you can’t do that?”
Jaehyun remembered the first person he killed, Jung Woomin.
He was a trash that couldn’t even be treated as a human who tried to kill himself after his mother.
Jaehyun asked himself.
Can I really not kill him if I go back to the past?
Could I have made a different choice?
no no
“Even if I go back then, I will make the same choice. I have no regrets.”
[Kill.]
With Jaehyun’s voice, the order of ‘the one who took life’ came down.
Kreurreung!
The wolves surrounding them all rushed towards Jaehyun.
Poppy quickly stood in front of Jaehyun.
It was an instinctive posture to protect the owner.
Hella smiled and looked at Jaehyun.
“As expected, it’s your ending. It would be a road that could pass if you lied once. Are you going to turn everyone in Nastrond into enemies?”
“If you have to.”
Hela couldn’t help but admire Jaehyun’s actions from the bottom of his heart.
‘As expected, I’m a big enemy. Jaehyun always moves in the direction he thinks is right. Don’t get discouraged, just stay calm. That’s great power.’
From the beginning, Hella knew what the gatekeeper of the last gate, the ‘those who took life’, would ask Jae-hyeon.
Can you never kill people again?
It was a kind of test.
There are countless sinners who pretend to be remorseful just to escape this situation.
However, they are eaten by Nidhogg as soon as they pass the last gate.
It was because the person he hated the most was a person who falsely pretended to reflect and deceived himself.
Nidhogg waits beyond the last gate and preys on those hypocrites who come to Hvergelmir.
Those who deceive people and only take advantage of their own interests always bring disaster.
Nidhogg is working to tear those souls to pieces so they can never be reincarnated again.
However, Hella never explained this to Jaehyun.
Then, why did Jae-hyun decide to fight against the ‘those who took their lives’ instead of deceiving them?
In her opinion, Jaehyun just didn’t want to lie.
He just didn’t try to deceive himself and avoid his sins.
Jaehyun was aware.
What he had to do from now on could never be done without blood on his hands.
You cannot kill Odin by starting to run away to escape the situation.
You cannot destroy Asgard and stop the second Ragnarok.
Hella looked at Jaehyun with a satisfied expression.
The previous ‘those who took life’ didn’t have a bad expression either. He seemed to be enjoying himself again.
Do not deceive yourself and fight with force.
How many people are you talking about?
Even Jaehyun was strong.
He neither overconfided nor overconfided himself.
He was just certain.
that you will win
“I will help too. This is not an ordeal.”
Hella raised her magic power. Poppy also grew in size with a short grunt.
The battle between the three beings against the wolves at the last gateway to Nastrond has begun.
Jaehyun grabbed the sword he had made without hesitation.
Awesome!
Then, the cool sensation of slashing the wolf spread through his hands and through his whole body.
I wouldn’t kill someone needlessly.
but.
‘If anyone gets in my way, I’ll get rid of it.’
That was Jaehyun’s course of action.
* * *
Deep in Hvergelmir. There is one existence watching the battle of Jaehyun.
Nidhogg, a venomous dragon with a huge body.
He was the guardian of this spring and the dragon that gnawed at the roots of Yggdrasil.
[An interesting guy came to see me after a long time.]
Behind Nidhogg, countless corpses were piled up like a mountain.
Murderers who passed the last gate with hypocrisy. They have been degraded to Nidhogg’s dining street.
[Did you say it was Min Jae-hyeon…
He will definitely reach this place.] Nidhogg knew well that Jae-hyeon was strong.
No matter how strong ‘the one who took life’ is, it is difficult to defeat an existence that has completed the 2nd stage of godhood release.
Already, Jaehyun proved himself every moment and overcame his limitations to gain the strength he has now.
At the very least, it had been a long time since the gatekeeper was able to deal with it.
Nidhogg nodded and stretched his long body.
“Then, he will come to see me in the evening at the earliest, so get ready soon…”
The very moment he turned off the magic of the crystal ball he was using to observe the reappearance.
Quaang!
With a roar that erupted from the front, the door to the last gateway opened wide.
The corners of Nidhogg’s mouth rose mercilessly.
His party, including Jaehyun, was standing there.
They arrived at Hvergelmir many times faster than they expected. This was unexpected.
[That’s interesting…! The adversary… It’s beyond imagination!]
“Thank you for the compliment, but… why don’t you strengthen your weapon first? You know, I’ve come a long way.”
Jaehyun’s clever words.
Contrary to what I said, Jae-hyun got rid of the wolves in an instant and arrived here.
At a speed that even Nidhogg would be amazed at.
[Sorry, but that won’t work.]
Nidhogg continued as he raised his mana.
[I was looking forward to it quite a bit. Fighting against you, the antagonist of the prophecy.]
At that moment, Jaehyun’s ears suddenly started ringing loudly.
-caution! For the first time, I encountered a mythical being with full character.
―The difference in class is extreme!
―Stop fighting immediately.
―Stop fighting immediately.
However, Jaehyun did not back down.
He laughed and raised his mana to the fullest.
“I think I met someone worth fighting for after a while. Do you think so too? Hella.”
“You know what? Jaehyun is just as insane as Idoon.”
Of course, she was smiling as well.
Jaehyun caught his breath and looked ahead.
Needhog.
The owner of Hvergelmir in mythology and one who is described as the strongest among those with poison.
Right now, Jaehyun was about to battle against such an existence.
Nidhogg moved his huge body and took a combat stance.
[Don’t worry. I won’t do my best.]
“Of course I should. If you kill me here, you will lose too, right?”
Nidhogg smiled at Jaehyun’s bold words.
He looked at Jaehyun, exposing sharp white fangs.
[O antagonist of the prophecy. From now on, I will test you.]
Jaehyun couldn’t help but laugh at those words. He shrugged his shoulders and accepted the words.
“However much.”

chapters.title: Chapter 214
chapters.content:
Episode 214 Nidhog (1)
[There is only one condition.]
“Condition?”
Nidhogg had presented one condition to Jaehyun right before the battle.
He was baring his fangs.
[I visited this place to strengthen the weapon containing my power, so fight me using only that. Other than that, I won’t limit the use of magic and skills.
Of course, you shouldn’t get help from Hella and Fafnir either. How is it?]
Nidhogg’s conditions. This was an obvious penalty for Jaehyun.
Being unable to use the dragon slayer, Balmung, would inevitably be a huge limitation for him.
but.
“I will.”
Jaehyun readily agreed and raised his magic power.
No matter how much Nidhogg is a mythical being and has a penalty to himself. There was no reason to be afraid now.
From the beginning, he had no intention of killing himself.
‘I wonder if it’s the third trial. Forcibly testing my limits right now is risky for Nidhogg and Van Aesir.
Nidhogg wants only one thing from me in this quest. It’s just to confirm whether the name of the opponent of the prophecy is false or not.’
Nidhogg told Jaehyun a while ago.
He said he was looking forward to fighting himself.
What this meant was clear.
Nidhogg and this quest. It is trying to test reproduction.
‘It’s as if the third trial has already begun at the point of coming to Nastrond.
I’dun probably designed it from the beginning.’
Jaehyun nodded his head confidently.
Idun, who was in charge of the third trial, had a bit of a blind spot, but he was also a god.
She had prepared another preceding ordeal to test herself from the start.
Fight with Nidhogg and Hell in Nastrond. This will help Jaehyun grow in a better direction.
“Jaehyun. Stay focused.”
After thinking for a while, I heard Hella’s voice in my ears.
Jaehyun suddenly came to his senses and looked at Nidhogg’s huge body.
[then. start in earnest Lightly for now…… from step 2.]
At the same time as Nidhogg exploded his light beam, the ground nearby dug in and a huge divinity was released from his body.
That’s exactly level 2.
It was about the same as Jaehyun’s current level.
Tsutsutsutsu!
For the first time since the battle with Heimdall, Jaehyun experienced a sense of dizziness.
After all, is it the status of a mythical existence?
Even though he hadn’t revealed his full power yet, Nidhogg’s personality was on a par with his own.
‘If it was a normal raider, he would have collapsed or lost his life here.’
The battle with the opponent with the divine power had been fought many times.
However, this was a battle on a different level from them.
Jaehyun’s body was shaking at the sensation of a chill on the nape of his neck, but he calmed himself down.
―Release the Godhead.
As if fighting back, Jaehyun didn’t lose and opened his godhead.
Unlike other battles, the reason for opening the fight from the beginning was simple.
This is because in the current battle, you have to show off everything you have.
Because Nidhogg is not an opponent that can be dealt with with a reasonable mind and skill.
Tsutsutsut…!!
Jaehyun’s body began to be filled with an enormous divinity equal to Nidhogg’s.
Nidhogg raised an eyebrow.
[Anyway, this battle seems to be going to be quite long.]
Along with that voice, the venom breath spewing from Nidhogg’s mouth passed Jaehyun’s shoulder.
Quaang!
The breath flew behind Jaehyun and a huge explosion sounded. Then, powerful magic power began to swirl inside Hvergelmir.
Hela watched their battle and put on a worried expression.
“Please, Nidhogg shouldn’t be overly excited…”
Jaehyun was strong, but he wasn’t on a level comparable to Nidhogg, who could use a full blow.
The power of a mythical being is at a level that is not at all inferior to that of a god. Perhaps it would be impossible to deal with Jaehyun unless he grows at least one more step from the current liberation stage.
“I don’t think it will take too long to get there.”
Hella said that and crossed her arms. Unbeknownst to me, my hands were sweating.

Flames soared from the dragon’s open mouth and slowly flew towards itself, burning away all the mana around it.
slow and sharp.
Even so, Jaehyun did not stop and continued his thoughts.
Just like that, a very fleeting time passed like an arrow.
The breath was now only about 2m away from reaching Jaehyun’s torso.
Nidhogg, who was watching this, clicked his tongue.
‘The adversary… has he lost his mind? No matter how much I adjusted my power, it was the third level of Divinity Liberation.
If I get hit by that, I won’t be able to wake up for at least three days…’
Isn’t it the breath that I decided to avoid from the beginning.
Jaehyun’s reaction he expected was to realize his powerlessness and run away. Nidhogg firmly believed that it would grow the opponent.
However, Jaehyun never moved the way he thought.
I just quietly contemplate the burning flame as if it were beautiful.
In the midst of blinding the son-in-law with a bright flame.
Jaehyun, who had been silent, finally smiled.
‘Now I get it. Magic is a continuous language system. It exerts its power in the flow.
And that also means that if you break the chain of language itself, magic will be neutralized.’
Thinking about it, Jaehyun raised his head and put strength into the fangs of Nidhogg in his hand.
‘then.’
Time accelerated again.
My ears that had been blocked were opened, and the noise around me lingered in my ears.
Then, in an instant, the breath that flew to Jaehyun’s distance scatters angry magic and tries to devour him.
Hella’s eyes were filled with concern.
“Jaehyun-kun! Move now! If we avoid it now, we can somehow…”
Hella was speechless. It was because a shocking sight was unfolding before my eyes.
“You said you closed your eyes…?”
Instead of avoiding the attack, Jaehyun closed his eyes. He focused on the senses of the whole body.
‘I can clearly feel the movement of magic power. A huge movement that seems to swallow me up at any moment.’
Magical power that attacks oneself like a tidal wave.
When Jaehyun feels this and opens his eyes again. His eyes were colored with brilliant gold.
Beyond the eyes that emit a much stronger light than before.
It was visible to Jaehyun.
Nidhogg’s breath is like a tangled skein, connected by countless lines of magical power.
Also he saw
The minute gaps vaguely revealed between countless lines.
Jaehyun muttered as if he had realized.
‘……Each of the runes that make up the magic was a thread, and the magic that was activated by it was a thread.
Letters are intertwined to form a typed form. That’s magic.’
At the same time as the accident occurred, Jaehyun recalled a memory from the past.
It was at the time of the mock dungeon.
He first encountered Odin’s crow and saw the ‘thread of magic’ while dealing with it.
The thread that continued to inject mana into the guy who was connected to the Kobold Lord.
Jaehyun had a memory of stopping the regeneration of the kobold rod by cutting it off.
So he took up his sword.
‘I was mistaken. Magic can’t cut it. I thought so.
But it wasn’t. Magic is a continuous flow. That is, it is a thread. If you cut the knot, the magic will go back to nothing.’
I held the machete knife in my hand while making a light.
‘Then a sword is enough.’
Chwaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!
“I can bell.”
Nidhogg’s fangs cut from the lower left to the upper right, leaving a path so huge that it could not be thought of as a dagger.
While everyone held their breath.
The first thing that burst out was Hella’s astonishment.
“what!”
With the dagger in his hand, Jaehyun accurately cut Nidhogg’s breath in both directions.
She muttered as if she couldn’t believe what had just happened.
“This is nonsense. Nidhogg’s breath… you cut it…?”
The breath that was shot to devour Jae-hyun splits into two stems and flies behind him and gets stuck in the wall.
Kwaaang!
A roar erupted and Jaehyun smiled as he looked at the dagger he was holding in his slightly trembling hand.
Before I knew it, Nidhogg was looking down at me with a shocked expression.
[……You can’t believe it… can you see the ‘magical grain’?]
Jaehyun tilted his head at his words.
“……what? Magical texture? What is it?”
[Have you seen such a crazy bastard……]
The dragon’s curse echoed through Hvergelmir’s empty cavity.
At that moment, Jaehyun’s eyes narrowed at the voice message he heard.
―A new effect of the active skill 《Absolute Calculation》 is derived!

chapters.title: Chapter 217
chapters.content:
Episode 217 Magical Texture
―A new effect for the active skill 《Absolute Calculation》 is derived!
Jaehyun’s eyes widened at the system sound he heard.
New effects derived from absolute arithmetic?
‘Absolute arithmetic was already a sufficiently fraudulent skill…?’
Jaehyun scratched his head and turned his eyes to the message window that popped up.
In his opinion, the effect of absolute arithmetic was already ridiculous.
A skill that can break all magic with magical power?
It was something I couldn’t even put a price on. Where the hell is there a corner to strengthen a skill that already has such an effect?
However, the question of reproduction was immediately resolved.
―Displays updated skill information.
[Active Skill]
Name: Absolute Operation
Rating: EX
Stats: –
Understand and destroy the structure of magic operation.
*Only with magic whose structure is known, the ceremony can be dispelled without consuming mana.
1. Reverse the magic, transform it into a formula, and destroy it.
2. Magic that is destroyed by 《Absolute Calculation》 consumes different horsepower depending on the rank.
A line was added to the original skill description.
Jaehyun’s eyes widened when he saw this, and astonishment slowly poured out of his mouth.
‘It doesn’t consume magic…?’
I really couldn’t help but open my mouth. No matter how much the effect was applied only to skills that he knew the structure of, this was a great innovation.
You can nullify magic without spending magic.
Simply put, this meant that Jaehyun would not be harmed by any magic if he learned the formulas for all the magic that existed.
Even without consuming mana at all.
‘Of course, it’s impossible to learn all the arithmetic expressions… But anyway, it’s undeniable that it’s useful. It’s a huge effect.’
As Jaehyun nodded in satisfaction, he heard Nidhogg’s trembling voice.
[Really… did you cut my attack without knowing that it was magical?]
To that, Jaehyun had no choice but to give the same answer as before.
“……therefore. Do you want me to explain what it is?”
[Crazy guy.]
“No matter how much I hear the same thing twice, it hurts a bit.”
Hearing Nidhogg’s words, Jaehyun frowned.
However, Nidhogg seemed to have no intention of picking up words. It was because he didn’t quite understand what he had just seen.
What Jaehyun has done is beyond the category of genius. Perhaps it was only natural that Nidhogg reacted violently.
[Loki… How on earth did you choose such a guy as your adversary…]
Meanwhile.
At that time, Jaehyun’s ears heard a refreshing system sound.
―I succeeded in gaining recognition from Nidhogg.
―You have cleared the subquest 《Nidhogg’s Fang (Enhancement)》.
* * *
Nidhogg.
A legendary dragon that is said to have phenomenal power even among members of the Van Aesir Alliance.
He had lived a long time and had little experience meeting his match.
Unlike Fafnir, he was a dragon from birth. Inevitably, it was overwhelmingly stronger than the others.
Except for Loki, no one could guarantee victory in a one-on-one battle with him.
Thanks to that, he felt bored.
No matter who I fought, my heart never pounded, so it was understandable.
Loki, who was at least a match for himself, was also in a situation where he could not move due to the first Ragnarok.
It was frustrating for him.
10,000 years passed like that.
End of Hell in Nastrond. While protecting Hvergelmir, he saw countless rotten humans and fought them.
But it wasn’t pleasant at all.
To him, who was already on the 5th stage of divine liberation, human beings were more than just pyramids.
That’s how he lived his life with his sense of self-righteousness covered.
But just a moment ago, Nidhogg’s eyes flashed.
It is because the ability of the opponent was more than he thought.
‘The guy saw the ‘grain of magic’. This is only possible for those with divine powers, and those who are at level 3 or higher of liberation.
The adversary did just that.’
magic power.
To put it simply, it was the flow of magical power itself.
After he finished thinking, he slowly opened his mouth while looking at Jaehyun.
[I will explain the texture of magic. Of course you know about rune words and magic, right?]
“Rune words are letters and magic is a phenomenon that is manifested as a continuous combination of runes. is not it?”
Jaehyun’s Nidhogg nodded.
[right. Magic is like a story. To put it simply, runes are letters. Magic can be seen as a completed book.]
Book. It was an apt analogy.
If there is only one letter, it cannot be a story. However, if there is a continuous flow of this, it will exist as a full-fledged story.
Jaehyun sincerely admired Nidhogg’s analogy.
But the doubts didn’t go away.
“But why are you giving me a fundamental explanation of magic now?”
[If a scene from a book is ripped out, can the book retain its value as a story?]
“……I understand what you mean.”
Jaehyun was shocked as if he had been hit in the head with a hammer.
Nidhogg was on.
[The same goes for magic. adversary.
Let me ask you one thing. What did you see there when you cut my breath a moment ago?]
Jaehyun slowly followed the situation from before.
“…I saw the tangled threads of magical power.”
[And you cut the knot?]
“Right.”
Jaehyun was able to quickly grasp the meaning of his words.
[That is the grain of magic. The act of cutting the tangled knot you saw in the flow of magical power. This was an act of tearing up the book and making it lose its value as a story.]
“That’s why the magic was dispelled.”
As I nodded in agreement, Nidhogg frowned.
[……Is that all? Any other reactions?]
Jaehyun shrugged in embarrassment at his words.
Why are you reacting like that?
Did your pride get hurt in the battle a moment ago?
[Fuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu-k] Since you don’t seem to understand, I’ll explain. What you did just a moment ago, even if it was a god, couldn’t be done easily.
Most of them do not even see the grain of magic.]
Jaehyun didn’t understand right away.
It is true that he has attained a good rank, but he has not yet reached the point where he can stand against God.
Judging from its simple destructive power, reproduction is still in its infancy.
However, Nidhogg seemed to have a different idea.
[Of course, God is strong. I have a deeper level than you. However, this is an innate realm. It is innate from the beginning.
But you are different. Recognizing the grain of magic in a subject that has built up a human body… Because this is something no one can easily see.]
“Is this enough?”
[As far as I know, there are only two beings who have been able to see the grain of magic so quickly.]
Jaehyun raised his head involuntarily at his story.
A shocking name sprang from Nidhogg’s open mouth.
[Odin and Loki. You are reproducing their past achievements here and now.]
* * *
Odin and Loki.
Jaehyun kept coming in until now right after returning the two names.
Odin as something to be killed.
Loki as the leader of the Van Aesir.
‘Because the names of the two gods cannot be omitted from Ragnarok.’
The cause of Ragnarok in the myth that people are well aware of was Loki.
As a result, a war began and many gods met their end.
Of course, there will be distortions in this too.
However, one thing was certain: these two gods played a pivotal role in Norse mythology.
‘Hella said it too. I have a talent comparable to that of God. It was a story that I had heard and spilled with one ear back then…’
Now I couldn’t help but believe it.
After a while.
As the dust cleared, I heard the sounds of Hella and Papi rushing towards Jaehyun.
Gyareung!
Poppy flapped her wings and flew into his arms, while Hella crossed her arms and looked Jaehyun up and down.
“Haha, I can’t believe what he did, but… Nidhogg is right.
As I said before, Jaehyun’s talent is at a level that is not inferior to God’s at all.”
“If you give it too much space, it will become a habit.”
Even Hella said so, but Jaehyun was not shaken.
Talent. Jaehyun was well aware of the false part of this sweet word.
‘Talent misleads many people. No matter how splendid you have, you have to polish it. Then it’s just a raw stone.’
It takes effort to bloom.
Jaehyun wasn’t the type to be swayed by the stories around him, and he had a personality that couldn’t be lazy on his own.
[Surprised… to react that way to my praise.]
Nidhogg said while looking at Jaehyun with interest.
Jaehyun turned his shoulder and looked up at him, probably feeling stiff from the battle earlier.
He had something to ask for.
“……It’s hard to wait.”
He smiled and put his hands in his pockets.
“Weapon strengthening. Won’t you?”
[……I forgot. ha ha ha! good. I’ll do it right away, so put the weapon on the floor for a while.]
At Nidhogg’s words, Jaehyun obediently put down Nidhogg’s fangs.
Nidhogg motioned for a moment, asking Jaehyun to step back.
When Jaehyun silently stepped back, he lightly raised his mana.
Tsutsutsutsutsu!
Along with the sound, the magic power that existed in the surrounding air rushed into the dagger.
Nidhogg’s fangs stay with enormous divinity, and the sword’s appearance slowly begins to change.
Jaehyun gulped and glared at him.
yet.
―Enhancement of the artifact «Nidhogg’s Fang» has been successful!
―The rank of 《Nidhogg’s Fang》 will be upgraded to 《Myth》!
The magical power surrounding the artifact on the floor dissipated, slowly revealing its interior.
The cloth was firmly attached to the hilt, and the black blade, which was originally black, had a mysterious blue light.
At its center, a purple crack radiated light like the eyes of a demon.
‘Just looking at it, it seems like it’s a high-grade item.’
Jaehyun thought so and saw the dagger rising from the floor.
Nidhogg’s fangs rose in the air and flew in front of Jaehyun before he knew it. Jaehyun stretched out his hand and lightly gripped the sword.
‘The length of the blade or the overall grip did not change significantly. Rather, it’s a good thing.’
If the form changes a lot, it will take time to adapt in many ways.
Jaehyun decided that the current structure was just right.
Its basic attack power increased by more than 1.5 times, and it was good in many ways because it could continue to be used where it had been used so far.
[Haha do you like it? I tried to strengthen the weapon one more level with my strength!]
Nidhogg said excitedly, arrogantly.
But then.
Jaehyun took a step forward, ignoring Nidhogg’s excited voice.
“But I mean.”
[hmm? What is it?]
“Don’t you think the reward is too small compared to the difficulty of the ordeal I took?”
[…What?]
It was the moment when Nidhogg was perplexed.
Jaehyun raised his mana and looked at Nidhogg with an expression that he didn’t understand.
The message that popped up then.
―You can learn new skills.
―Use one blank card.
―Passive skill 《Poison Dragon’s Sadism (Myth)》 has been registered in the second socket!
In an instant, Nidhogg, who had his skill stolen, burst out of his nose.
It was something he would only do when he was really upset.
“Because I am the one who takes care of my share.”
Jaehyun laughed.
“Then I’ll take it well.”

chapters.title: Chapter 218
chapters.content:
Episode 218 Idun’s Golden Apple (1)
[Passive Skill]
Name: Venomous Dragon’s Sadism
Rating:
Acquire the power of the Mythical Venomous Dragon Nidhogg.
Maximizes the power of addiction-type skills.
*Overlapping effects of poison status or higher are always applied at maximum.
* When attacking an enemy who is in the poisoned state, 50% of the damage is added.
‘As expected, it’s a mythical level skill.’
Jaehyun smiled with satisfaction as he looked at the newly copied skill.
Poison Dragon’s Sadism.
This was Nidhogg’s core skill, which could serve as Jaehyun’s new hand.
Jaehyun nodded as he read the skill window. He briefly recalled the situation from before.
The first time I decided to copy this skill was when I destroyed my first breath.
‘Anyway, opportunities to copy mythical skills aren’t common. If there’s anything you can get here, you have to get everything.’
Jaehyun was careful not to do any harm.
Also, the bet Nidhogg had placed on him a moment ago did not match the difficulty of the quest at all.
This is most likely Nidhogg’s dogma.
‘I’ll have to take care of what I did.’
There was also one blank card left, so there was no problem copying the skill.
[……No matter how much it is. I didn’t expect to even brush off my skills.]
Nidhogg said, smacking his lips bitterly. He had a worm-eaten look on his face.
Apparently, the skill was stolen (?). It couldn’t have been fun.
However, Jaehyun didn’t care at all.
Rather, he looked at Nidhogg and said as if teasing.
“I haven’t even taken the third trial yet… are you already getting things out?”
Nidhogg frowned at Jaehyun’s words.
[…I didn’t know the adversary could be such a nasty guy. Is Hella always like this?]
“Yes. Unfortunately.”
Hella said so without hesitation.
Apparently, there seemed to be quite a lot of complaints piled up against Jaehyun.
This time, Jaehyun didn’t even pay attention and ignored it.
[Well… Anyway, congratulations. Adversary, you successfully blocked my attack.
Now that you’ve strengthened your weapons, I don’t think there’s anything more I can do for you.]
“Sure.”
Jaehyun turned around to get out of the seat after being properly spoken.
I got everything I deserved according to his word. Now I really have to go through the third trial.
It was not good to procrastinate for a long time.
It was when Jaehyun thought so and stood in front of the door he had first entered.
[Wait a minute. There’s something I haven’t said yet.]
“What is it?”
Jaehyun turned to Nidhogg again and asked.
said Nidhogg, leaning his enormous body.
[You must be heading to Yggdrasil soon, right? You should have received the quest from Mimir by now.]
“……Yes.”
Jae-hyun was surprised for a moment that Nidhogg knew about it, but soon understood.
He is also a member of the anti-Aesir faction.
It was no surprise that Jaehyun knew about the quest he had been given.
Jaehyun crossed his arms for a while and recalled the past.
At the time when the Nornir system was updated.
It was the moment when I realized the truth about the army of the dead in Einherjar.
The quest I received at that time, the main quest 《System Breaker》.
Jaehyun looked up again to remind him of this.
[Main Quest]
System Breaker
You noticed the plan of Odin and the Aesir gods.
Head to Yggdrasil’s control tower and destroy the system to prevent the Awoken from becoming Einherjar.
difficulty: ???
compensation: ???
*Restriction Conditions – Recreation of Divinity Liberation Level 3 or higher
could not complete this quest because it was not yet a level at the time of receiving this quest.
The 3rd stage of divine power liberation? This is because the conditions themselves were too harsh.
‘It’s better now though. It’s just one more step forward.’
Of course, it’s the same as not being able to proceed with the quest because the class isn’t enough yet.
Jaehyun shook his head.
“It is still far. Because there is only one step left.”
[No, it won’t take long. If it’s your talent, you’ll reach level 3 in no time. I guaranteed it myself, so I’m sure of the credit.]
Jae-hyeon’s eyes widened slightly at Nidhogg’s assertion.
Well, Nidhogg told me that he was the greatest talent after Odin and Loki.
It was not unreasonable for him to be so sure.
“so. What do you really want to say? I don’t think it’s just encouragement.”
[I wanted you to kill one guy while I was gone.]
“You want me to kill you?”
[A bird head that lives on the top floor of Yggdrasil. I want you to kill him.]
Nidhogg frowned as if he was annoyed at even mentioning it.
At his words, Jaehyun looked back at Shinhwa for a while. There was one corner to catch.
‘If it’s the bird’s head that lives at the top of Yggdrasil… you’re probably referring to the ‘nameless giant eagle’.’
Incidentally, he is known to be on very bad terms with Nidhogg.
Jaehyun nodded moderately, recalling the information he had read in the library in the past.
“Remember.”
[good. Then, since I took all of my money, go through the third ordeal right away!]
Nidhogg cheerfully saw off Jaehyun until the end.
Jaehyun walked towards the road he had come from.
Go through the gate and see Nastrond’s Hell once more.
Hell formed through three gateways. The road passed was still a gloomy landscape.
The only thing that changed in that gap was Jaehyun.
Meanwhile, Nidhogg, who was watching Jaehyun’s departure, muttered as he looked around the smashed field.
[Odin, the antagonist of the prophecy, and the being that will destroy Asgard… I’ve proven that his name isn’t a lie.]
As Nidhogg said earlier, he had high regard for Jaehyun.
A natural talent and an endless desire to improve. It is growing its opponents to higher ground.
However, the second Ragnarok. This will come sooner than you think.
[I hope the adversary will jump over me by then.]
If the other gods heard this, they would all be horrified.
Nidhogg is one of the strongest in the anti-Esir alliance, or even in the entire Nine Worlds.
Can you surpass that person? It would be easier to secretly pluck Odin’s beard.
Of course… if I really did that, I would have to rot in Asgard’s prison for the rest of my life.
* * *
In front of the classroom at Miles Academy after the Mathematics lecture.
In the hallway, three people are trudging back to the dormitory.
These were faces tired from continuous lectures.
Kim Yoo-jung grumbled and said.
“Min Jae-Hyun, the kid who says attendance is tight, misses the academy again. Where the hell are you and what are you doing?”
“I know. Didn’t even get a text message. Is something going on?”
When Ahn Ho-yeon agreed and accepted the words, Seo In-na’s expression quickly darkened. It was because he was worried about Jaehyun.
“……Isn’t it a big deal?”
“no way. Then you would have told us first.”
“……Jaehyun doesn’t usually talk about himself. I’m worried…”
Kim Yoo-jung was eloquent, but even she couldn’t object to Seo E-na’s words.
In reality, Jaehyun was the type who doesn’t usually talk about himself well. He tends to listen to what others have to say, but for some reason, he rarely reveals his true feelings.
“Um…….”
Even Kim Yoo-jung fell silent.
What the hell is Min Jae-hyun doing that keeps him busy every day?
“Whoever sees it will know that Ji is saving the world.”
Kim Yoo-jung sighed and said.
At her words, the three of them nodded their heads almost simultaneously.
* * *
It didn’t take long for Jaehyun to return to Idun’s garden.
The way I came once in the first place. Even if it wasn’t so, the way back was not difficult because he was Jaehyun with a bright eye for the road, taking care of Kim Yoo-jung, who was his usual guide.
“Finally, this is the third trial. I feel like I should go back after finishing everything already.”
“The third trial will not be easy, even for you.”
Hella, who was walking side by side, said that and warned Jaehyun.
Like a guide, Hella knew the contents of the ordeal line by line.
I couldn’t tell Jaehyun everything according to the regulations, but it was true that it would be the most difficult ordeal of all he had ever gone through.
“You have to hit it first.”
Kreung!
Poppy walked behind and wept softly as if agreeing.
yet. Those who returned on the road arrived at the center of Niflheim. Still, it was a good feeling because it was a place I had been to once.
mist garden.
This was the beginning of the third ordeal.
Jaehyun released the outer barrier again and went inside.
‘I have to do well this time somehow. As always.’
When Jaehyun took a deep breath before the ordeal.
A woman appeared from the entrance of the Mist Garden with a bright voice.
“oh! You’re here! Come on!”
The owner with a cheerful voice approached and stood in front of Jaehyun.
Jaehyun was able to guess who it was with his intuition. he raised an eyebrow.
“Finally, you show your face. Idun.”
Saying that, Jaehyun looked up.
In the place where his gaze reached, there was Idun, the god of youth.
Brilliant green hair and deep eyes with a mysterious atmosphere. It was a woman wearing a white blouse and carrying a small basket.
‘……It’s pretty.’
Jaehyun couldn’t help but be genuinely surprised.
That’s how Idun’s beauty was outstanding. It was a different beauty from Seo In-na.
A goddess with a lovely feeling who gives people strange happiness. This was very similar to what was described in Norse mythology.
“Was it hard to go? Would you like some tea first?”
Idun greeted Jaehyun and the others and said. She was looking around as if Jaehyun’s existence was strange.
Jaehyun asked in a calm voice.
“Rather than that, are you ready for the ordeal?”
Idun replied in an arrogant tone.
“of course! I prepared it so that you can play it right away if you want to!
How are you going to take the test now?”
“yes. please.”
There was no time for Jaehyun to delay.
Even at this moment, the Æsir will be in motion.
There is no time to rest…
“Here, take this! It is a must-have item for this ordeal.”
Jaehyun tilted his head as he suddenly accepted the item Idun gave him.
It was a very unique object to be tested.
“Is this… a seed?”
When Jaehyun asked, Idun stretched out his chest and answered confidently.
“okay! This test is to grow a tree!”
“……What are you growing?”
Jaehyun asked, dumbfounded.
As if Idun was strange, I tilted my head and said.
“It’s to… grow a tree…?”
“That… no ha. Why are you doing that in the ordeal?”
Jaehyun asked that without even realizing it.
It was something we couldn’t understand.
In the face of having to beat the Aesir gods as soon as possible……
What? Grow a tree slowly?

chapters.title: Chapter 219
chapters.content:
Episode 219 Idun’s Golden Apple (2)
‘I didn’t expect this kind of reaction…?’
Idun hesitated while looking at Jaehyun’s crumpled face.
she couldn’t understand
Why is it that the sublime test of growing plants is met with a trivial response?
‘How wonderful it is to grow a tree…!’
However, she never said the words out of her mouth.
It was because Jaehyun’s expression was too good to spit out words.
In fact, Jaehyun had not yet grasped the meaning of this ordeal.
‘Until now, I’ve been fighting hard and using my brain, but why is this ordeal like this?’
Two tests I’ve taken so far. They all had their own themes.
Jaehyun quickly figured out this and went through the ordeal more smoothly.
But no matter how hard it was, I never thought that the ordeal of growing a tree would come out.
“…I understand for now. Can you elaborate?”
I was embarrassed, but I couldn’t help but take the test.
form of the first test. At that moment, Hella’s words that this test might be the most difficult caught my heart.
Meanwhile, when Jaehyun asked, Idun relaxed his expression and resumed his explanation.
“Kuh hmm! Then I will explain, so listen carefully.”
She put her hand on her waist and cleared her throat.
“The content of the ordeal is simple. Growing an apple tree and then harvesting its fruit.
Plant the seeds I gave you earlier, diligently water them, and let them bask in the sun. If you do that… oh, would it be faster to just read it?”
[Main Quest]
Idun’s Ordeal (1)
Idun, the owner of the Mist Garden, is giving you an ordeal.
Grow the seeds you receive from her to harvest golden apples.
Difficulty: –
Rewards: –
*This quest is a chain quest. When cleared, it leads to Trial of Idun (2).
Remaining Time: 30 Days
Failure Penalty: Restarting the Ordeal
After reading the contents of the quest, Jaehyun was still unsure.
He came to the conclusion that he had no choice but to bump into it and ask.
“But I don’t have much time. You don’t know when Odin and the Aesir gods will move, but to grow a tree…” “
If that’s the case, don’t worry. Here in the Garden of Mists, time passes 30 times slower than in Midgard!
Well, the golden apple tree seeds I gave you can grow in a month.”
“ah.”
Among the dungeons, in many dungeons, time passed differently inside and outside.
Jaehyun quickly understood and looked at the seed in his hand.
“I’ll guide you to the field first! follow me.”
Idun took the lead and said so. Jaehyun, dubious about it, followed her.
There was nothing in his mind except to go through the ordeal somehow quickly and return.
* * *
Jaehyun, who followed Idun to the field, was once again taken aback.
“……This is a field?”
There was nothing but cracked earth and wasteland all around.
A dry place with almost no moisture.
plant a tree here
“Did I give you the wrong location?”
“no! This is right.”
Idun said that and playfully put his hands behind his back.
“What you are going through is the third ordeal. It can’t be that easy, can it?”
Jaehyun couldn’t help but agree.
At first, I thought it wouldn’t be difficult to plant a tree, grow it, and harvest the fruit.
Because the two ordeals I’ve been through so far had to risk my life.
Because of this, he unconsciously thought that this test was relatively trivial.
‘But it wasn’t like that.’
In order to grow a tree, a good field is essential.
If not, even something like fertilizer.
But there is nothing around.
Jaehyun said with a puzzled face.
“Why the hell is the ground so split apart? There are no weeds, let alone trees, right?”
“Ah~ I had a brief fight with Nidhogg before, but he seemed to be angry and let out his breath. You know because I met you too, right? Because his personality is so eccentric, he’s going through a lot of hardships!”
“…….”
Jaehyun was speechless.
So, is this a story about fixing this place that is now messed with poison and even growing trees?
“As I said before, it takes 30 days to grow a golden apple tree. Then good luck!”
“Wait! Should I tell them it’s like how to raise them?!”
“There is no such thing as a separate way to grow a golden apple tree. Just plant it in the ground and water it! By the way, there is a well in front of you, so you can get water from there.
Then I’m short of naps so I’m done. Hela and the cute dragon. Let’s go with you too!”
Idun said so without hesitation and then disappeared.
Hella and Papi also noticed that they were tired and quietly avoided their seats.
Suddenly left alone, Jaehyun murmured, pessimistic about the situation.
“What the hell is this? Ha…”
But there was no other way.
Anyway, isn’t Idun also the god who presides over the third trial?
He wouldn’t have given him an ordeal he couldn’t bear, and there would be a breakthrough somewhere to overcome.
Jaehyun, who was worried, muttered as he stepped toward the field.
“Let’s plant it first.”
Jaehyun planted the seeds of an apple tree in the barren land.
To put it in conclusion, Jaehyun’s farming was ruined.
Even after about a week has passed since then, the seeds have not even germinated yet.
* * *
When Jaehyun was working hard to sprout.
On the terrace of the mist garden, three beings sat watching him. They were drinking tea grown in Idun’s garden.
“Why is that?”
Hella suddenly raised her head and asked Idun.
“What are you asking?”
Idun said, taking off his pretense. Hella let out a sigh.
“I am asking why you gave me such a difficult ordeal. The seed given to Jaehyun. That’s actually sick.”
“……omg! When did you notice?”
Idun tilted his head back as if shocked, showing an exaggerated reaction.
However, when Hella looked at her with cold eyes, her expression calmed down.
“Um…well. I am the same as Nidhogg. You want to see if the adversary can move forward.”
“It’s bad taste. because it was born innocent. That’s why I hate you.”
“Isn’t it because I’m too pretty?”
Idun playfully accepted the remark and looked at the sweaty opponent.
As Hella said, Jaehyun will struggle in this test.
Jaehyun’s actions in the ordeal so far. This will again bind him in the third ordeal.
“But… it wouldn’t hurt to help out a little.”
Idun put down the teacup he was drinking while muttering.
* * *
“Oh! Are you crazy? How can it not even sprout for a week?!”
Jaehyun, who was tending an apple tree in the field, threw down a watering can with Idun’s face on it and said,
The seeds were planted and watered, but the sprouts did not germinate.
Jaehyun glared at the spot where the seeds were planted with an annoyed expression.
“Isn’t there something wrong with the seeds?”
As a representation, it was a natural thought.
According to Idun, an apple tree from this seed will grow quickly enough to harvest fruit in a month.
But at this speed, isn’t that impossible?
Jaehyun felt nervous in a situation he could not understand at the moment.
‘I can see why Hella said the third ordeal could be the most difficult. Somehow, the back of my head hurt.’
The thought of being betrayed by Idun ran through my head and anger welled up.
But there was no other way.
Even if you go and argue with her, nothing will change
…
Didn’t the tiger also say that it would come when I said it?
Jaehyun let out a sigh when Lee Doon, who had come to the field before he knew it, looked at him and asked.
“As you can see. I wish I could give you a tip.”
“A heart that loves plants…….”
“I won’t stand it if it’s a joke.”
Idun gasped at the resolute tone that drew the line between Jaehyun.
She broke into a cold sweat and laughed innocently.
“Sorry about that?”
“Ha… I knew that. What do you mean, can I ask you one thing?”
“If you can answer me.”
“This seed… is it alive?”
At Jaehyun’s question, Idun opened his eyes wide as if he was slightly surprised.
She said as she quickly returned to her natural, virtuous face.
“of course. The seeds of golden apples do not die. And then wait for the time when you will bloom someday.”
“okay.”
Idoon’s expression became interested in Jaehyun’s calm reply.
She stepped behind Jaehyun.
The seeds still showed no sign of germination.
“You seem to be having a hard time. Would you like to change it to another seed?”
Idun’s question. This was to motivate reenactment.
If you switch to a different seed, the tree may sprout a little faster.
In fact, Jaehyun also pondered for a while.
But soon he shook his head.
“it’s okay.”
“But you’re shooting at me with the intent to kill me right now? Changing the seed won’t affect the difficulty of the test.
Are you still not going to change?”
“yes.”
“The reason is?”
“I heard you haven’t died yet. It’s too early to give up.”
After Jaehyun said, he waved his hand.
It meant that if you weren’t going to give us useful information, don’t take offense.
Idun silently stepped back and returned to the terrace.
As she tried to calm down the corners of her mouth that rose involuntarily, Hella’s voice came from behind.
“Are you sure you like it?”
“huh!”
* * *
Two days later, Jaehyun borrowed a notebook from Idun and started writing in his journal.
It reminded me of the biology observation journal I used to write in middle school, and the trauma seemed to rise.
At that time, they said they dried all the kidney beans and killed them.
But now I couldn’t help it.
‘Because if you don’t observe properly, you might not notice the change.’
It was precisely the 10th day after the ordeal began that he recorded his journal.
[Day 10]
It hasn’t sprouted yet.
Water is given every day and sunlight is supplied from the artificial sun floating in the sky, but the seeds are still silent.
20 days left now.
Should I have changed the seed as Idun said?
no. There is still a lot of time left to think that way and give up.
Let’s start again step by step. one step at a time.
[Day 12]
The buds haven’t sprouted yet.
There are also no notable changes. Idun doesn’t come to see me anymore.
I feel my patience wear away little by little.
But I can’t help it.
I decided to eat as positively as possible.
[Day 15]
Now we have passed the turning point.
There are only two weeks left. I am worried about whether I will be able to do well.
However, even if you worry, the buds that did not sprout will not suddenly sprout.
As always, you need to calm your mind.
[Day 20]
There is still no change in the seeds.
[Day 21]
No change today. Now, the remaining days are down to single digits.
[Day 24]
Inject magic to see if the seed is alive.
As Idun said, the seed is definitely alive. It seems that the reason why it doesn’t sprout is because of my lack.
[Day 27]
I am still working hard.
I will work hard until the last day and somehow clear this ordeal.
Just like the previous two trials, you must overcome them.
* * *
[Day 30]
It is now the last day of the third ordeal that I promised with Idun.
Finally… the seeds sprouted.

chapters.title: Chapter 220
chapters.content:
Episode 220 Idun’s Golden Apple (3)
“Finally… It has sprouted…!!”
The last day of the ordeal.
Jaehyun cheered as he finally saw the sprouted seeds.
A dainty-sized bud sticking out its head greeted Jaehyun.
“It took a very long time. Really…….”
No matter how different the time goes outside and here in the mist garden, it was a long journey of 30 days.
Jaehyun finally succeeded in sprouting after all his hard work. It’s a situation he can’t help but feel overwhelmed by.
However, Jaehyun quickly came to his senses.
You have just taken the first step. The ordeal was not over.
‘At most, I only had 30 days to sprout.’
It would take much longer to properly grow an apple tree. He still has a long way to go.
“But it is true that there is hope. Ordeal penalty restart. If we start over, we’ll be able to get here a little faster.”
Jaehyun sighed and clenched his fists.
“Looks like there’s some progress? congratulations!”
When Jaehyun was distracted, he suddenly heard Idun’s voice from behind.
Suddenly, with her hands behind her back, she saw the seed that Jaehyun had grown. Idun smiled and smiled.
She squatted down on the floor and rested her chin lightly.
Jaehyun responded with a calm expression.
“It is true that progress has been made… but it is only starch that has sprouted a new sprout. It is rather a problem that I have only been able to do this for 30 days.”
“No, you did well enough.”
“……yes?”
Jaehyun tilted his head at Idun’s resolute words.
I don’t think he was originally such a warm character, but what is it all of a sudden?
It was at that time when Jaehyun looked at her and questioned her.
Idun straightened his knees again and stood up from his seat.
“Do you think you have failed the ordeal now?”
“So what…”
Jaehyun scratched his head and confessed honestly.
“It is a test that requires growing trees for 30 days, but I only sprouted on the last day. The odds of success are zero.”
“If this were a normal tree, it would be.”
“……What is that……”
Jaehyun tried to ask back with a slightly puzzled expression.
Deed Deed Deed!
Suddenly there was a vibration from the bottom of the field, and the seeds began to change.
The sprouts sprouted from the seeds Jaehyun planted grew rapidly and began to grow in size.
* * *
Deed deed!
The tree was growing at a speed far beyond common sense that Jaehyun knew.
Even bamboo, which is known to grow several tens of centimeters a day, was not at this level.
‘What is this!’
Jaehyun blankly watched the growing tree with a shocked face.
Suddenly, the sprout became a small seedling, and it didn’t take long to grow to Jae-hyeon’s waist. However, it did not stop there and the tree continued to grow.
As Jaehyun looked around with a puzzled face, he suddenly heard Idun talking.
“The first seed I gave you. It was the seed of a diseased golden apple tree. I’m sorry, but I also wanted to test you.”
“…seeds of diseased trees?”
“The seeds of a diseased golden apple tree do not germinate easily and do not consume a lot of water.
Its biggest characteristic is that it does not grow without the will and conviction of the person who planted it.”
“It’s a will…”
“Yes, a will. A tree will not grow unless it has the will to sprout and the will not to give up.
It was an ordeal that was designed that way from the beginning.”
Idun turned and approached the growing golden apple tree.
Then he reached out and touched the branch.
Still a tender branch.
But she knew.
This means that he will soon grow up to become a lofty giant tree.
“The golden apple tree is a mysterious plant. It grows and bears fruit in 30 days, but it does not sprout during the 29 days it is planted in the ground.”
“Doesn’t it sprout?”
When Jaehyun asked as if he was dumbfounded, Idun chuckled.
“okay! All it takes to grow this tree is patience and faith. Because that is all.”
‘It’s a futile ending for something of an ordeal.’
Jaehyun thought that Idun had managed to prepare for this ordeal.
she said at first. It doesn’t take much skill to grow a tree.
It does not require knowledge of miscellaneous plants or special fertilizers.
just waiting to believe
The tree just grew.
The Trial of Idun.
It was Jaehyun who safely put the first button on, but there were still things I was curious about.
“You suggested it a week after planting the tree. How about changing the seed?”
“It did.”
“What was the reason?”
“Um…….”
Idun pondered for a moment, then looked back at Jaehyun again.
“Because I wanted to know if you gave up. If you threw away the living seed because it didn’t grow well for a few days and chose something else…
you would have failed the test. That, in the end, is also denying yourself.”
‘Do you… deny me?’
Jaehyun nodded his head as if he had just realized that.
The third ordeal of Idun.
And the sick seed was passing one thing on to him.
This seed was projecting reappearance.
Seeds that did not even sprout until the 30th. But it grows and bears fruit in one day.
It was the same with the reproduction before the return.
He was weak and tried but couldn’t climb.
However, after returning, he blossomed his talent and reached the present state before he knew it.
Like a golden apple tree that continues to grow even at this moment.
‘Golden apple trees sprout on the 30th day after planting and grow in one day.
That said, if I had changed the seeds halfway through, I wouldn’t have been able to pass the ordeal.’
From the beginning, Lee Doon assumed all of this and asked Jaehyun this question.
“But your answer was different. I didn’t give up the seeds. Instead you asked
Are these seeds alive?”
Hearing those words, Jaehyun raised his head involuntarily and looked at her.
Idun smiled.
“That obsession-like will that never gives up on anything makes you go forward. I know.”
“Then is this the end of the third ordeal?”
“What are you talking about! There is one more linked quest left. The third trial is not over yet!”
“As expected……”
Jaehyun sighed as he was about to slip away.
From the first time I received it, it was written as a linked quest, probably.
Even as Jaehyun, I didn’t think that the ordeal would end just by growing a tree.
“But don’t be too heartbroken. There is only one quest left now!”
“That sounds good. so. What is the content of the quest…….”
At that moment, a voice message was heard along with Idun’s hand gesture.
―You have cleared the main quest The Trial of Idun (1).
―It is linked to the second quest.
―You have accepted the main quest 《The Trial of Idun (2)》.
―Displays quest information.
[Main Quest]
The Trial of Idun (2)
Defend the tree from the demons that seek golden apples and harvest the fruit.
Difficulty: –
Reward: Idun’s Gift
Remaining Time: 12 Hours
Failure Penalty: Trial Restart
“What is this… protecting the apple tree?”
Idoon answered Jaehyun’s question with an innocent smile.
“that’s right! When the golden apple tree bears fruit, it scatters the incense of great magical power!”
Jaehyun nodded in agreement.
Certainly, the golden apple he ate before possessed tremendous magic power.
Didn’t Jaehyun also have the experience of eating it in the past and increasing his total magic power at once?
“Probably by now, all of Niflheim’s monsters would have gathered! I don’t know, but there must be hundreds of them.”
“……what?”
In an instant, Jae-hyeon forgot even about his father-in-law and asked back.
Idun crossed his arms and nodded.
“As expected, the end of the ordeal is the battle! Among them, watching the Great War is the best!
Oh well, I’ll get out of the way soon. It will get in the way of the battle!”
“Wait a minute…!”
Jaehyun stretched out his arms to grab Idun, but he couldn’t reach them. He gritted his teeth as he saw the vacancy of Idun, who had disappeared before he knew it.
“Idun…… I won’t leave you alone once the ordeal is over.”
Jaehyun took a deep breath.
Before he knew it, Poppy approached him and prepared for battle with him.
At first glance, the enemies surrounding the tree in all directions were about hundreds.
Krrrrrr!
All sorts of monsters, such as the demonic beast in the form of a plant that was heard and the troll he dealt with previously.
Jaehyun opened his magic and shouted.
“let’s go! Poppy, you protect the tree!”
Kreung!
Poppy responded to Jaehyun’s words and used the giantization skill.
Poppy, who had grown in size before he knew it, was excited and waggled his tail.
Meanwhile, the apple trees were growing at a rapid pace.
―There are still 12 hours left before the golden apple tree bears fruit.
“This battle won’t be easy.”
Having said that, Jaehyun’s expression wasn’t too bad.
He poured out his mana at once towards the flocking demon beasts.
To Jaehyun, who also fought Nidhogg, they are not just pyramids.
……Of course, there were too many of them.
―Active skill 《Poison Rain》.
The magic power that spreads out from Jaehyun was scattered in the sky and soon created a huge purple cloud.
Poison Lane.
It was literally a skill that poured out poison.
‘Of course, I’ll have to be careful not to touch the golden apple.’
Shaaaaaa!
The magic formed from Jaehyun’s body begins to spread, and soon it rushes into the air and casts a shadow over the monster.
A dark cloud that extends its momentum by obscuring the artificial sun.
Seeing this, Jaehyun smiled.
Now he is trying to use magic of attributes that he has never used in actual combat.
‘I didn’t know I would be able to use poison property magic.’
Jaehyun thought so with a faint smile on his face.
Up until now, I had been fighting a battle of overlapping deadly poison using Nidhogg’s fangs, so I didn’t have to use poison property magic directly.
It is common to use poison magic to grant an abnormal state of poisoning, and the power of the skill itself is not that great.
However, Jaehyun decided to use Poison Rain now.
The reason was simple.
A message coming soon.
―Due to the effect of the passive skill 《Venomous Dragon’s Sadism》, the poisoning status ailment is strengthened to the «Deadly Poison» status ailment.
―Applies the «Deadly Poison» status ailment to designated targets (multiple)!
―Enemies become poisoned (maximum stacking).
Jaehyun raised his eyebrows as he looked at hundreds of demonic beasts that had become deadly poison before he knew it.
Poppy also burned his fighting spirit, holding a white breath at the corner of his mouth.
Jaehyun took a step forward and activated the skill again.
―Active skill 《Formation of magic tools》 is activated.
―Artifact 《Nidhogg’s Fang (Myth)》 has been successfully created!
“Then, shall we test the new weapon?”
Jaehyun’s body leaned forward and soon his model disappeared from sight.
Then, one of the enemies in front is mercilessly cut down without knowing why.
Awesome! Awesome! Awesome!
The Witchbeast, which was split into several pieces in an instant, died without even screaming.
Jaehyun put his strength into the dagger he was holding.
The sound of the system that came with it made the corners of his mouth rise again and again.
―Damage is increased by 50% due to the effect of the passive skill «Poison Dragon’s Sadism»!

chapters.title: Chapter 221
chapters.content:
Episode 221 Tree Defense (1)
―Damage is added by 50% due to the effect of the passive skill «Poison Dragon’s Sadism»!
Awesome!
Every time the sharp dagger danced, the monster in front of me became a piece of meat and rolled on the floor.
Seeing the sharper blade sharper than he thought, Jaehyun felt an eerie feeling that made his hair grow softer.
‘The poisonous dragon’s sadism… I never thought the 50% damage bonus would be this much.’
It was completely different from simply seeing it in numbers and experiencing it directly.
Jaehyun smiled as he looked at Nidhogg’s fangs.
It was a moment when I felt the reward of strengthening the items while struggling in the hell of Nastrond.
“Keep going.”
Jaehyun caught his breath and looked at the enemy.
The number of enemies is great.
Even if you estimate it, there are close to hundreds of monsters.
“Even Hella can’t help you this time. You have to do something yourself.”
Trials must be overcome alone without anyone’s help. In the case of Poppy, since it is her pet, there is no problem in participating in battle, but Hella was different.
Now I had no other option but to believe in myself.
Krrrrr…!
Jaehyun looked around at the low, creepy voice he heard. The magic beasts of Niflheim surrounding him all had a bloody appearance.
The weakest guy is at a level that exceeds B-class.
The ripple effect of each one was already equivalent to that of the instructors at Milles Academy.
‘But I can’t back down.’
Jaehyun sighed and put his strength into the dagger he held again.
He didn’t forget to raise his magic either.
Sword in one hand, magic in the other.
That was the Battle Mage’s battle.
* * *
―You succeeded in stopping the first wave.
It was a message that suddenly came to Jaehyun’s ear after about two hours had passed.
Jaehyun opened his eyes wide and tilted his head.
“wave……? what do you mean all of a sudden? I’m sure Idun said there were only two ordeals…”
Wave.
It was the first word I heard while carrying out this quest.
Jaehyun narrowed his eyes with a puzzled expression.
It wasn’t long before the message followed again.
―The details of the second quest have been updated.
[Main Quest]
The Trial of Idun (2)
Defend the tree from the demons that seek golden apples and harvest the fruit.
Difficulty: –
Reward: Idun’s Gift
Remaining Time: 12 Hours
Failure Penalty: Trial Restart
▶(NEW)Do you want to check the detailed information of the quest?
Jaehyun flipped over the system screen to check the newly added detailed information.
It contained information he had never thought of.
“Idun…!”
Jaehyun muttered with an angry face.
It was unfortunate for him, but the ordeal was not over yet.
Rather, it was to the point where I thought it would be more correct to say that it was just the beginning.
Jaehyun read the newly added information with a puzzled look on his face.
The rules of a game are written in the system window.
―Let the tree defense game begin!
[Tree Defense Game – Rules]
1. The purpose of the defense game is simple. The goal is to protect the Golden Apple Tree from the monster’s attacks, and to defeat as many monsters as possible to meet the achievement conditions.
2. All enemy monsters are divided into three types. Penetrating defensive magic type.
All of them have a mutual relationship, and you must know this and fight to win the defense game.
3. 1 point for each normal monster you kill 30 points for every elite monster that appears during the wave.
4. Guardian helps you to protect the tree. Users can use points to summon monsters to the allied camp to assist guardians or strengthen defense barriers.
