Fortunately, the being behind Jaehyun wasn’t his enemy.
“…Idun? Why are you here…?”
When Jaehyun looked at her and asked that question, Idun wiped his chest in surprise and said,
“Because I am the tutorial system itself!”
“yes?”
“Now follow me! I will teach you how to garden!”
* * *
After reunion and after party with Jaehyun and Papi. Returning home, Kim Yoo-jung threw herself on the bed and fell face down.
The hotel bed was soft, but somehow uncomfortable. I guess it wasn’t like that usually.
Is it time to change the seat?
Kim Yoo-jung touched her smartphone and soon set it down on the bedside table.
“By the way, Min Jaehyun… Are you really dating me?”
When I returned home and was alone, the events of the past came to my mind clearly.
The image of Eana Seo who kept taking care of Jaehyun whenever he ate something. This was something I wouldn’t do well unless I was in a relationship.
I don’t know, but I’m sure there is something between the two.
‘What’s obvious? At first, I don’t think so. I did, but now I’ve changed my mind.’
At first, I heard that Jaehyun rejected Seo Eana even though he knew her feelings.
However, judging from Seo In-na’s active behavior now, it seemed that there was a good feeling between the two of them, more than just friends.
“It’s not something I care about, but…”
It’s a problem I know well in my head, but for some reason.
The image of the two standing side by side was not erased from her mind.
Two people walking down the street exchanging delicious food.
Even though I hadn’t seen them yet, the image of them walking around holding hands was clearly visible in my head.
‘…Strange.’
Is it because I feel like I’m being taken away from him because I’ve been friends with Jaehyun for so long?
I don’t know the details, but I was certain that the feelings I had right now were not normal.
at the time of the school trip. Kwon So-yul said to himself.
You need to be honest about your feelings.
But Kim Yoo-jung couldn’t figure it out.
What are your own feelings?
She doesn’t like Jaehyun. I had feelings as a friend, but it wasn’t romance.
Seo In-na is also her best friend. If the two people’s hearts are right, wishing them well was what they had to do.
But why why.
“I don’t know. I don’t know.”
Kim Yoo-jung covered her eyes with her arms and thought for a moment. For some reason, even though I was exhausted from class, I couldn’t sleep.
I can’t do anything, but I can’t sleep. Should I say it’s such a state.
So she stayed up all night until morning.
The next morning the ends of her sleeves were stained dark.
But no one will find out what it is.

chapters.title: Chapter 230
chapters.content:
Episode 230 Mission Period (2)
“This way! How do you like it?”
The land he arrived at, led by Idun, was more splendid than Jae-hyeon thought.
Gardening tools, pots, watering cans and shovels necessary for growing plants are lined up everywhere.
Idun said that all goods are services, and prided himself on not being able to get them easily.
In fact, I also liked Jaehyun.
The site itself was much larger than expected.
It’s like the land of gold dust itself.
‘It’s a pity that I can’t buy or sell this…’ It
was perfect except that it was impossible to transfer or sell to others.
Although the drawback is bigger than expected, it was a very good situation if I could grow and use plants that would help here.
Idun wandered around the Mist Garden and gave a tutorial on plant cultivation.
How to choose good seeds, starting with choosing a fertilizer. The main content was the amount of sunlight each plant needed.
Jaehyun quickly memorized what Idun had said and looked back on it.
Idun narrowed his eyes as if surprised and looked at him. She glared at Jaehyun with a slightly envious expression.
“I didn’t know you could memorize it so quickly… I’m frustrated…!”
“…Are you angry? Didn’t I hear you right?”
Unsurprisingly, Idun was envying Jaehyun’s brain and was keeping him in check.
Jaehyun shook his head.
No matter how you look at it, you are a student or a disciple.
Are you envious of this?
“It’s like Idun. It’s a compliment in its own way, so take it in moderation.”
Hella said that and crossed her arms.
Looking at her, she seemed to really think so.
Jaehyun sighed as if he couldn’t do anything about it.
“You have to explain the most important thing. so. What kind of plants can you grow here?”
What effects can you grow?
This was a very important part of determining the value of this land to Jaehyun.
Of course, since it was given to me by Idun, the person in charge of the ordeal, there’s nothing to worry about…
‘Still, I’m anxious if I don’t properly check the human heart.’
Jaehyun thought about it and nodded.
At that time, Idun smiled and lightly gestured in the air.
Then, a familiar status window pops up in Jaehyun’s eyes. This was more than enough to shock him.
Jaehyun muttered with a puzzled face.
“…you can grow all of these?”
“of course!”
Idun declared in a confident tone as if he was confident.
Jaehyun muttered as he blankly read the status window.
“crazy.”
* * *
“I am tired too. Growing plants isn’t easy either.”
The next day, Jaehyun muttered that as he passed the hotel elevator and walked down the hallway.
On the way back after visiting a convenience store on the nearby site.
I was on my way back from going out to buy something to drink for a change of mood from having spent all day gardening yesterday.
Jaehyun relaxed his stiff shoulders. Even for a radar with a transcendent body, simple repetitive tasks required quite a bit of fatigue.
“You suffered too. Poppy.”
Greung!
Jaehyun also thanked Poppy.
Helping yourself yesterday, bringing gardening tools, watering, etc. Poppy also suffered a lot.
When I first hatched, I was very worried that it would really help.
Now, I couldn’t imagine going hunting or working without Papi.
“Anyway, I’m glad things are starting to get used to now.”
Of course, there were trials and errors along the way.
However, Idun’s explanation wasn’t too difficult, and Hella also stayed by her side to give advice, so the difficulties were minimized.
It was when Jaehyun was walking while reflecting on the events of yesterday.
“uh?”
A familiar voice came from the other side of Jaehyun. It was Kim Yoo-jung.
She was looking at Jaehyun with a puzzled expression on her face while wearing a ball cap that she did not usually wear.
“what? why are you so surprised Have you seen anyone you can’t see?”
Jaehyun asked, but Kim Yoojung still couldn’t answer.
‘what? Why is he suddenly like that?’
Jaehyun tilted his head while looking at Kim Yoojung as if he was embarrassed.
Then, with difficulty, she opened her mouth and said.
“No, I just need to drop by the convenience store.”
Jaehyun nodded at Kim Yoojung’s words. Poppy also raised his hand and said hello.
Kim Yoo-jung smiled a little and greeted Papi lightly.
“Hello Yongyong?”
That was the moment.
Kim Yoo-jung’s hair fell through the hat, and her flushed eyes and cheeks came into Jae-hyun’s eyes through the tightly pressed ball cap.
Jaehyun’s expression hardened slightly.
“Hey, what are you doing?”
“uh? oh no Is there anything wrong?”
Kim Yoo-jung’s tone as if she had been waiting for an answer. Jaehyun narrowed his eyes for a moment, then nodded.
“…If that’s the case, I’m glad.”
Jaehyun turned around and headed for his room, waving his hands.
“Then I go.”
“uh.”
After Kim Yoo-jung said dryly, she hurriedly walked to the hotel lobby.
Jaehyun stood there for a moment and looked at her back. His expression hardened.
he knew
I don’t know why, but Kim Yoo-jung shed tears. that this is not a simple matter.
‘Is this the first time I’ve seen Kim Yoo-jung cry since elementary school?’
It seems that something unusual is about to happen.
He didn’t know the details behind the scenes, but at that moment, such a thought passed through his mind.
* * *
Another day passed. Jaehyun gathered at the outdoor training ground to take classes.
“Then, I will begin explaining the ‘mission performance period’ that will start tomorrow at the academy.”
Just after finishing the magic match with the cadets. The instructor’s explanation of the next event had just begun.
The main thing is about the duration of the mission that I talked about with my colleagues a few days ago.
“The mission performance period is basically an event designed to publicize the names of Miles Academy cadets and cultivate their noble spirit as raiders.
During the training period, cadets must complete one autonomous mission and one joint mission with the guild.”
The instructor raised his glasses and continued his explanation.
“Of course, grades are divided according to how well the mission was performed.
Please note that detailed explanations and applications can be made on the academy’s official website on a PC.”
The explanation wasn’t overwhelming.
The instructor delivered only the necessary information to the cadets accurately.
Jaehyun and his colleagues were not taken aback at all because they already knew that the event was coming.
In the first place, Jae-hyun went through it once, and Lee Jae-sang and Kwon So-yul also went through it last year.
You don’t have to be too scared.
…Of course, this was only true of Jaehyun.
“Hey Mr. Aren’t you crazy?! Entrusting freshmen with local government duties…?”
“That’s how it used to be, but… this time the number of missions to be performed has increased. There was only one until last year.”
“I heard that it is possible to carry out joint missions as a circle… All of our circles are fucking weak. It’s ruined.”
The worried voices of the cadets are heard.
No wonder. This is the first event in which the mission to be completed is basically conducted only by the cadets without the intervention of an instructor.
Of course, the national raiders dispatched by the local government were waiting outside the dungeon to prepare for a dangerous situation. What I was worried about was real.
The fact that they experienced a frightening event during an outdoor training camp also hardened their thinking.
At that time, the cadets had to fight the Bone Dragon, a boss monster that reached A+ rank.
“Then, spread out in circles, plan your strategy, and apply for missions. The duration of the exercise is one month in total.
I wish you all the best of luck.”
After saying that, the instructor left.
Jaehyun moved to the place where the members of Circle Nine were. Now is the real start.
* * *
“How about this? ‘Eradication of 20 Goblins in Busan’. I think the difficulty level is okay too.”
“Do you think your rating is too low? It’s white.”
Jaehyun shook his head at Kwon Soyul’s words.
The group gathered again at the hideout are sitting in front of laptops and talking.
They were in the middle of a conversation about a new mission.
It was most important to collect the opinions of circle members because the school did not directly designate the difficulty and mission, and the cadet had to choose it himself.
‘I like missions where I can get a lot of points. The more points, the better.
It would be better to receive at least a red or higher request.’
In addition, in order to raise awareness, it was good to receive good quests during the mission.
Although the difficulty was high, there was a risk, but it was necessary to expand the activity radius of the circle later.
Jaehyun fixed his gaze on the monitor again and refreshed the order in order of difficulty.
Requests are basically divided into five grades. The one Kwon So-yul picked a moment ago was white, which was the lowest grade.
Above that, there are four more grades in total, from green, blue, red, and black.
sorted in order from lowest to lowest.
For reference, the party can only select up to the maximum red mission.
Black is a student. Even there, cadets with high grades can perform only with the permission of the president.
To put it simply, it meant that the maximum mission rank that Jaehyun and his party, now freshmen, could choose was red.
“Let’s go red.”
At Jaehyun’s words, Kim Yoojung and Kwon Soyul let out a deep sigh.
“Lee Jae-sang and I are still students, so it’s okay, but you’re also quite decent. Are you okay? A red mission from the start.”
She had good reason for saying that.
A red mission from the beginning. In the first place, the probability that the instructors will give permission is slim, but the probability of returning safely from here is even slimmer.
Especially if it’s a freshman.
“are you okay.”
Jaehyun, of course, said so.
There was no reason to be shaken by a request that was only this much despite the amount of achievement he had achieved.
“For now, the color has been decided to be red, so don’t spit out and look over.”
After Jaehyun said that, he got up and disappeared somewhere.
after a few minutes. While the colleagues were arguing over the choice of mission, Jaehyun returned with a small tray in his hand.
“Now, how about watching this while eating?”
What Jaehyun brought was an apology.
It had an ugly appearance with dents everywhere, probably because he had shaved it himself.
“…what? Do you have any apples this small? Only ping-pong balls?”
Kwon So-yul tilted his head as if it was strange and asked.
Ahn Ho-yeon had the same reaction.
“Sweep apples aren’t cut like this…”
“…talk to me.”
“At this rate, I think there would be more flesh attached to the skin…”
Even Seo Na-na and Lee Jae-sang helped.
Jaehyun was annoyed at the party’s words, but he tried to keep his mouth raised.
“Even so, I did my best to cut it. Each person must eat one.”
His eyes widened like half moons, and an eerie voice leaked out.
“Otherwise I can’t get out of here.”
“…….”
“Ehh.”
Kwon So-yul was the first to sigh and put a peeled apple into his mouth. She was also weak-minded.
The apples are so small that they fit in one bite.
Everyone’s eyes were focused on Kwon So-yul.
Wasak.
Then, while munching on an apple, she frowned and muttered.
“…This isn’t very tasty, is it?”

chapters.title: Chapter 231
chapters.content:
Episode 231 Red Mission (1)
Wasak. Wasak.
Jaehyun smiled heartily at the sight of his colleagues eating apples.
The apology he handed to them a moment ago was, of course, not an ordinary apology.
‘Golden apples. It was also raised directly from the trials of Idun.’
third trial. An apple grown by Jaehyun himself in Idun’s garden.
Jaehyun gave it to his colleagues.
‘Golden apples have the power to amplify magic. If you use it well, you can further raise the level of your colleagues.’
Of course, when Idun first told Jaehyun that he could take the apples he grew himself. Jaehyun was thinking of eating it himself.
However, Idun handed over an apology and said the following.
[Only one golden apple is effective when eaten! Even if you eat it now, it will be difficult to aim for a special increase in magical power!]
It was an embarrassing remark.
Can’t eat what you grow yourself?
To be precise, it meant that no effect could be seen even if you ate it, but to Jaehyun, the two were accepted as the same meaning.
Items that cannot be utilized are merely ornamental. Unfortunately, Jaehyun had no taste for decorating his home with rare items and showing off.
However, Jaehyun, who was worried, soon found a new way to use the golden apple.
‘It’s just feeding my colleagues and making them grow fast.’
Jaehyun made up his mind when he heard the second verse of the prophecy. He decided to save people around him and finally kill Odin.
However, in order to achieve this goal, the growth of colleagues was inevitable.
At least grade A. Furthermore, if you do not reach the level of S, it will be difficult to even protect yourself.
From there, Jaehyun won’t be able to save them no matter how hard he tries. It’s impossible to stand by them 24 hours a day, and Odin can’t stand to see it.
Odin and the Aesir are ugly beings. It would be right to see that there is a very high possibility of attacking oneself by taking one’s comrades as weaknesses.
Jaehyun, of course, had no intention of letting his colleagues hold him back.
It was for this reason that he made them eat the golden apples and devised a plan to grow them.
In addition, it could also help with their own growth.
It is < The Warmth of Idun >.
If you use the newly acquired EX-class skills.
‘Idun’s Compassion is a skill that allows you to acquire undistributed stats whenever the level of your party members rises.
If I use it well, I can greatly increase my stats.’
If that’s the case, you’ll be able to move on to the next stage of divine liberation more quickly.
To put it simply, there was a bigger picture in Jaehyun’s distribution of golden apples to his colleagues.
Of course, their growth will also be helpful to you in itself. Anyway, it was more important for Jaehyun to grow on his own.
This was a good opportunity to catch both rabbits.
Jaehyun smiled and hid his dark feelings.
Kwon So-yul, who was watching this from the side, put on a puzzled expression.
“Isn’t there something strange about this?”
“It’s not strange, but it’s true that something is included. Maybe the next mission will surprise you. everyone?”
Jaehyun said that with a confident smile.
He had to calm down the corners of his mouth that kept rising.
In the next mission, Jaehyun’s stats will go up like crazy whenever his colleagues work hard to level up.
‘I eat this completely raw?’
The bear does tricks and eats the stats himself.
What is this if not heaven?
* * *
[Mission Rank: Red Description: Defeat the corrupted spirits of the newly opened B-level gate
in Pohang and collect their essence Reward
: 1.5 million academy points per person and a small amount of Ark Metal]
It was like this.
The rank is a mission that gives a lot of points to red as I thought.
The condition was that they had to attack the B-level gate, but it wasn’t a big risk to Jaehyun and the others.
In the first place, even at the time of the outdoor camp, their level had already risen to the point where they were different from other cadets.
“Above all, the arc metal that is said to be given as a reward is attractive.”
After completing the registration application, Jaehyun murmured.
Seo Ina nodded and replied.
“……That’s right. Because arc metal is not easily available anywhere else.”
“That’s right! It’s a radish item that rarely comes out at auction! Me and I snooped at the auction several times, but… we only received the message that we would have to wait a long time to buy it right away…”
Lee Jae-sang answered with excitement. He looked extremely excited.
arc metal. In fact, Jae-sang Lee was the reason Jae-hyeon chose this mission.
‘Because if you have arc metal, you can make new alchemy tools.’
Jae-hyun recently told Jae-sang Lee about the medicinal herbs and various plants he grows in the mist garden.
All of them are very valuable even if they have never been or have been.
Even if you just use the ingredients themselves, the level will be very high, but fundamentally, medicinal materials are effective when prepared.
With the help of Lee Jae-sang, he would probably be able to exert his full power.
In fact, Lee Jae-sang also decided to actively help reproduce the idea that he could handle difficult-to-handle medicinal materials.
he just said
[In order to deal with new medicines, we need stronger and more resilient weapons!]
And the optimal material for making the equipment is arc metal.
It was a material with the highest hardness and resilience.
“Isn’t it the one that was used in Yeonhwa’s guild training ground as well?”
“That’s right.”
Kwon So-yul nodded at Kim Yoo-jung’s words.
In fact, arc metal is the material used in Yeonhwa’s secret arena. That price is a level that can’t even be taken out of your mouth.
“But I am worried. No matter how good Jaehyun is, that’s the case… Ark metal is at stake in the red mission. I think it will be very difficult.”
“Are you saying that I want to live a long life again?”
As Jaehyun smiled, Kwon Soyul furrowed his brow.
“done. What would you do if you applied anyway? Let’s get started with a plan in place. It will be difficult if you get hurt and come back.”
“Do not worry. There will be no danger whatsoever.”
Jaehyun said with a confident expression. He was a well-founded self.
red mission. The name gives off a terrifying feeling, but it is true.
‘B-level dungeons are now at a level that Poppy can clear alone.’
Jaehyun smiled at that thought.
* * *
It didn’t take long to prepare for departure.
They stood in front of the portal to their destination, Pohang. The International Portal Center is overcrowded and unavailable right now, so I decided to use the academy’s transport seats.
Jaehyun and Circle Nine planned to carry out autonomous missions as soon as possible and move on to the next stage.
The period was given for a month, but anyway, it was better to finish work quickly and take a break. Because it’s so much more comfortable and relaxed.
‘As the next mission has to be done with the guild, it takes a lot of time and has a lot of restrictions. It will take longer to prepare, so it’s better to finish the autonomous mission quickly.’
“Did you pack all your things?”
Ahn Ho-yeon asked while looking at Kim Yoo-jung and Jae-hyun, who were packing their personal belongings.
Kim Yoo-jung shrugged.
“Roughly. Well, this time, they pay for everything there.”
“That’s right. If you increase your luggage for no reason, it will be troublesome to organize your inventory later.”
As Kim Yoo-jung said, in this dungeon raid, the local government was supposed to provide all the necessary items.
The group doesn’t need to worry about it.
Since the academy was in a position to help them in the first place, it was not morally right to make the cadet pay attention to even such trivial things.
It is said that there is subsidy from the state to Miles, but it is clear who gets help in the end.
‘This is why the relationship between the local government and the academy cannot be equal.’
Basically, if one side gives or receives one-sidedly in a relationship of giving and receiving help, the equity between the two has already been broken.
“Then shall we depart?”
The party took a breath after standing in front of the portal.
Soon, Jaehyun, who was at the front, took a step forward, and at the same time, his son-in-law suddenly became dark.
Not long after, they quickly arrived in Pohang.
“Damn I am. Is it the beach after all?”
Kwon So-yul muttered that and looked around.
In the middle of the blue sea, the portal the party rode on is placed in one place.
Magical power felt from the blue transmission stone.
At the same time, a man appeared in front of them.
“Is it you? The cadets who were dispatched from Miles Academy?”
His voice did not hide his displeasure even though he pretended to listen.
Jaehyun turned his head to look in the direction the voice was coming from.
Standing there was a bad-looking man with a shaggy beard.
“What are you?”
When Jaehyun asked, the man looked at him for a while with his expression wrinkled.
“I am the Radar Dinner of the Radar Management Headquarters, who is supposed to guide you guys.”
formal dinner. Jaehyun was the first name I heard.
Apparently, it was a radar that wasn’t rated that high. In the past, Jaehyun was proficient in related knowledge to the point of memorizing the list of A-class or higher raiders.
If it wasn’t in his head, there was a high possibility that he wouldn’t be very good at it.
“Guide me.”
Jaehyun looked up at him and said.
Jeong-chan’s face was not very good. It was because he didn’t like Jaehyun’s attitude towards him.
‘At least you’re a kid. Condescending that he was from Milles Academy…….’
He was a good looking guy. From the impression, he looks like a parasitic brother. For no reason, Jeong-chan felt annoyance welling up from deep inside.
Of course, Jeong-chan had already heard about and knew that Jae-hyun and Circle Nine were taking on this request.
That they have excellent skills and that they have accomplished feats that no mere cadet would dare to achieve.
But he didn’t believe all the stories he was hearing.
No matter how strong they are, aren’t they still young children who haven’t reached adulthood?
To think of entrusting these kids with a B-class dungeon in Pohang City… I couldn’t help but think that the leadership was really crazy.
Of course, this was due to his disbelief because he couldn’t grasp the strength of Jaehyun, or at least the strength of Circle Nine.
Unfortunately, no one corrected his thoughts.
“Follow me. The gate is about 2km away. Well, I have to see the mayor first, but I mean.”
he said with his hands in his pockets in poor posture.
At that moment, I heard Kim Yoo-jung’s whispering voice from behind.
“That man who is supposed to be having dinner… is it too thick?”
Jeong-chan crumpled his expression once again.
It was because her voice was too loud for a whisper.

chapters.title: Chapter 232
chapters.content:
Episode 232 Red Mission (2)
After being guided by the dinner, the party followed the procedure before entering the portal.
Meeting with the mayor of Pohang who issued the mission and hearing in detail about the dungeon to attack.
This was a process that must be followed even to request compensation from the academy after completing the mission.
“First of all, thank you for taking on the mission ordered by Pohang City.”
Pohang Mayor Go Pil-seong said that and asked for a handshake with Jae-hyun, the head of the circle. He was a man in his sixties barely covering the top of his head, which was almost bald.
Jaehyun nodded his head in response.
“you’re welcome.”
Go Pil-seong hesitated for a moment at his bold attitude, but soon after shaking hands, he gestured to the party and invited them to sit down.
He opened his mouth as he looked into the eyes of the party sitting around him.
“I have heard many stories. The fact that Circle Nine played an active part in outdoor camps and various events.”
Jaehyun sat down and looked at his face.
Compliment your opponent. Whether this is to be received as a favor is to be decided by the words that follow.
Judging by his behavior, he was likely to bring up negative things about the party.
It was a face lacking basic trust. Perhaps he had something to say. A story that is unpleasant to them.
His expectations were not wrong.
“I also received an official letter from the Milles Academy… I know that everyone’s skills are excellent. but.”
Go Pilseong widened his eyes and folded his hands neatly.
“As an old man, I think you might not have enough capital experience to clear a B-class dungeon.”
“What do you want to suggest?”
Jaehyun also asked without backing down. Go Pil-seong looked him in the eyes and continued with a curious expression on his face.
“I would like to be considerate so that you can attack the dungeon with other raiders. They are skilled, so you don’t have to worry.
That friend over there is going too.”
He pointed to Jeong-chan, who had guided Jae-hyeon and his party a moment before.
Jaehyun was so dumbfounded that curses almost came out of his mouth.
He passed the third ordeal and obtained only a few mythical artifacts. It is Jaehyun who has already broken through to the S-class level.
But because of my lack of skills, I’m going to attach another radar?
‘It’s obvious.’
Go Pil-seong’s thoughts were obvious.
‘They don’t believe all of us who are still cadets. That’s why I’m trying to clear the dungeon with other people and have an appropriate assortment.’
When Circle Nine first took on the mission, the leadership could have decided against it, but he partly did not.
As the mayor, he would not have wanted a relationship with Milles Academy.
He must have been thinking of getting the cadets on board by letting them receive the mission and showing them a picture of successfully clearing it.
If you do that, your relationship with each other will be maintained smoothly.
It didn’t matter too much about distributing more points.
It is only if Pohang City and Milles can maintain a longer relationship in the future. Whatever it is, it’s good.
Go Pilseong said with a kind smile.
“Don’t worry. We’ll keep the fact that we hired another raider as a secret…”
“It seems like you don’t trust us.”
Go Pil-seong’s eyes flashed at Jae-hyun’s words as he crossed his legs.
The corners of the eyes, which are wrinkled like crocodile skin, contract and show alertness.
Jaehyun smiled softly.
“Let’s make a bet or something.”
“bet?”
At that, even he, who had dealt with many people, couldn’t help but be embarrassed.
Suddenly what bet?
Also, the mayor himself and a cadet?
* * *
‘Totally insane. He’s overconfident about his skills.’
Go Pil-seong clicked his tongue inwardly as he watched Jae-hyun.
According to what I heard, talent seems to be innate, but growing to a high place seemed far away.
No matter how good your skills are and how much you believe in yourself, you’re a rude guy.
It couldn’t help but damage the reputation of the radar world.
‘How many guys have blown my chances with pride?’
They were all energetic and full of natural talent.
In the world, they were called geniuses, and their names came up and down in countless news and articles.
But they are all dead.
It did not survive and was eventually forgotten by others.
A belligerent personality was an important virtue for a raider, but recklessness would result in death.
In his opinion, Jaehyun was a person who could not survive for long in this market.
Go Pilseong took out a handkerchief and wiped his bald head.
“Can I ask what you mean by bet?”
He spoke politely, but his attitude was full of distrust.
Jaehyun laughed.
“We will cut the time to clear this mission in half.”
“You mean half of that?”
“yes. Then, the points that were scheduled as rewards. Give me twice that.
Instead, if you fail, you won’t get a penny even if you clear all the missions.”
This is purely Jae-hyun’s dogma, but no one dissuaded him.
Jaehyun is a talented person who has already surpassed the S rank.
It was because there was no reason to struggle in only B-class dungeons.
In the first place, it was a mission that was given 7 days to clear according to the level of a cadet.
With Jaehyun now, he should be able to catch the boss in less than a day.
Meanwhile, Go Pil-seong is immersed in worries.
No matter how much he made up his mind not to spare points… This was a relatively better choice.
Basically, the right to order missions and hire cadets at the academy is not something to be bought lightly.
Subject to stringent government approvals and allocated according to local risk.
Isn’t that the academy point?
However, Jaehyun was thinking of taking care of the work without receiving a single penny.
why? Are you confident in your own abilities?
I don’t know why, but I felt a chill run down my spine.
Jaehyun shrugged.
“It doesn’t matter who comes along. Just reduce the number a bit. Just having that old man is enough.”
After thinking for a moment, Go Pilseong nodded. It was too good a condition to refuse.
‘The points that were staked as compensation were originally 1.5 million per person. This is equivalent to 1/3 of those allocated to Pohang City. If I can save it, I have to do anything.’
He thought so.
“……I’ll place spare radars outside if there’s
anything I need to do …”
After all, he revealed that he was free (?) as he was!
“I wish you well on your mission. Have a good rest until today. Let’s start tomorrow.”
Greed glistened on his face as he greeted him.
With a strong conviction that you will never be able to clear the dungeon in time.
* * *
Dinner came after a while.
The voices of two people can be heard from inside a luxury hotel.
“Did you really need to do that? It’s better to settle it amicably.”
Three men who were assigned a room and stayed together for the day.
Hoyeon Ahn looked at Jaehyun and asked. He had just finished taking a shower and was changing his clothes.
“Rather than what other reasons…”
“Rather than?”
“It’s thick.”
“…….”
At Jaehyun’s words, Ahn Hoyeon shook his head as if he was dumbfounded.
I never thought I would talk about gambling in a conversation with the mayor of Pohang.
Of course, according to the rules of the academy, it was possible to negotiate or adjust the compensation that was originally scheduled for on the spot.
But that’s what seniors with a lot of names do.
Seeing that he even gambled on it, I thought that Jaehyun definitely had a great personality.
Lee Jae-sang was already in bed, probably tired. It was still only nine o’clock, but he was already weak.
Ahn Ho-yeon sighed and said.
“How is it that you and Yoo-jung have different personalities, yet you are almost the same?”
“Hey, even if you compare it, compare it with him…”
Jaehyun couldn’t finish his speech.
It was because the face of Kim Yoo-jung, whom he had seen a few days ago, was not forgotten in his mind.
For what reason did the usually strong woman cry?
“Jaehyun.”
“What?”
“You know that Yoojung cried a few days ago, right?”
“…….”
Jaehyun was silent for a moment at Ahn Hoyeon’s question that caught him off guard.
He must have guessed it from the look on her face. Jaehyun nodded.
“okay. I know.”
“Do you know why?”
“no. I don’t know.”
Their answers were strangely at odds with each other. Ahn Ho-yeon had a worried face. It was true that Jaehyun was also worried about Kim Yoojung.
She pretends to be bright and acts every moment, but she has a very tender disposition.
I am easily swayed by the reactions of others and worry a lot.
It was Jaehyun who knew the dark side of Kim Yoojung that no one else knew about.
Jaehyun thought for a moment.
“You’ll find out soon what’s going on. you always told me If something happens by this time.”
This time, Kim Yoo-jung asked herself why she cried.
I’ll tell you what happened again.
Jaehyun thought about it and nodded.
but he didn’t know
He knew that the reason Kim Yoo-jung shed tears was because of him and that she would never tell him anything like this.
* * *
The next day. All rough preparations have been completed.
All the supplies needed to enter the dungeon were stacked in the inventory.
Basically, Lee Jae-sang manages the potion, but in case it might fall during the dungeon raid, he decided to keep the potion in small parts.
Since I put things in my inventory anyway, I don’t have to carry miscellaneous things around.
About 2km away from the first portal I rode on.
Green gates and several structures surrounding the outside of the field were erected with warning signs.
“This way.”
Jeong-chan was guiding Jae-hyun and his colleagues with a bug-bitten expression.
Poppy is still dangerous to reveal to them, so I hid it for a while in an extra bag.
From time to time, Jeong-chan, with a displeased look on his face, talked about the sound of an animal, but Jae-hyun didn’t even pay attention.
Those who stood in front of the gate like that.
“Shall we go?”
Jaehyun stepped over it without hesitation.
That moment. No one saw Jeong-chan’s face, but everyone in the party guessed.
He would never let the members of Nine clear this dungeon.
‘Fucking kids to eat. Where should I try it? I’ll break my hands and fingers.’
Jeong-chan put on a sly smile.
However, he didn’t even expect it.
How much humiliation he would suffer from Jaehyun in the dungeon.

chapters.title: Chapter 233
chapters.content:
Episode 233 Red Mission (3)
Inside the dungeon was a forest full of greenery.
In the middle of the flood, Jaehyun and his colleagues’ dinner was abandoned.
Everyone is looking around with bewildered expressions, as if they had become Robinson Crusoe.
Among them, the only thing familiar was dinner.
He had the experience of visiting a dungeon once in the process of checking a gate in the past, and was relatively familiar with the current situation.
‘It’s the same as I’ve seen before.’
Fortunately, the level or strength of the gate has hardly changed since then. It’s probably not a big deal unless there’s an accident.
Jaehyun raised his mana and looked around.
“Soyul-senpai, please start mapping first, and Jae-sang-senpai, please wait here with Ina and Hoyeon.
And you, Kim Yu-jung, come and look around with me.”
“uh? Uh…”
After Jaehyun said that, they split apart and decided to start clearing the dungeon.
It was then.
“Wait a minute! This is a B-level dungeon! You know it’s dangerous to split up and move around here, right?”
Jeong-chan said while looking at Jae-hyun as if he was embarrassed. It was something he couldn’t understand.
However, Jaehyun only nodded his head with a calm expression.
“It’s okay, so don’t worry. If you’re so anxious, stay here too. We’ll check the surroundings and come back.”
“what……!”
Jeong-chan thought that Jae-hyun was cheating on him.
This place is on a different level from other gossip dungeons.
No matter how much Jaehyun is Yeonhwa’s follower and has the S-class skill Frozen Earth.
It was impossible to clear the B-class dungeon alone, which is called the tomb of many raiders.
Basically, Raiders team up and go into battle.
Also, the most important thing in the process is survival.
It was common sense that it was safe to move as many raiders as possible in one place in a B-class or higher dungeon.
However, Jaehyun, the leader of Nine, made a different choice. It was a judgment that could not be understood by Jeong-chan.
Are you trying to abandon your colleagues because of your own greed?
‘Hey, at this point, no matter how famous Min Jae-hyun’s colleague is, there will be a backlash…’
“Okay. We’ll find a place as safe as possible nearby. Contact me if necessary.”
At Ahn Ho-yeon’s words, Jae-hyun nodded and started moving across the forest with Kim Yoo-jung.
“Hey wait! Go with me!”
Kim Yoo-jung followed him with a sigh.
By the way, the reason Jaehyun moved with her now was simple.
‘From now on, I have to properly take care of Kim Yoo-jung. I can’t let you die this time either. Well, even if it’s not that, since he’s good at wind attribute magic, he’ll be of great help in the forest.’
Of course, even if it was a red mission, it wasn’t a dangerous dungeon at all for Jaehyun.
But he knew.
That variables can arise in any dungeon.
Also, this variable always ends in tragedy.
“Concentrate.”
“…you know even if you don’t say anything?”
When the two of them went through the forest and explored the surroundings.
Each of the remaining parties quickly began to carry out their assigned missions.
Ahn Ho-yeon and Kwon So-yul started pitching a tent in search of a safe place and found a place to cook food.
Lee Jae-sang was preparing and arranging the potions so that they could be used anytime, anywhere.
“…I’ll be on guard then.”
Seo In-na was in charge of the surrounding boundaries. Originally, at the beginning of a dungeon, it is basic that monsters do not appear often, but dungeons that are open on all sides like this place are different.
Witch Beasts enjoy hunting Raiders who are full of mana.
Like the Dark Elves, it was even more so if the Witch Beast had intelligence.
Meanwhile, Jeong-chan, who was watching all this, muttered with his mouth wide open.
‘What the hell are these bastards… what are they doing?’
He thought about that before entering the dungeon. I remembered a conversation I had with the mayor.
* * *
1 hour ago.
Go Pilseong’s office.
“so. Adjust this mission to fail as much as possible. Are you saying that?”
“That’s right. Just make sure they take out as many monsters as possible. Everything that can be plucked must be plucked and eaten.”
Go Pilseong said with a fishy smile.
In fact, since he first heard about the bet from Jaehyun, he had no intention of letting them clear the dungeon.
In the first place, it is absurd to safely close the B-level gate at the level of a cadet. In addition, he was the nature to enjoy freebies.
What if you use the Nine members appropriately to deal with the beast and then dispatch other raiders to catch the boss separately?
Then you can close the gate without spending any extra points.
Huge profits will also follow.
The dinner across the street was well aware of this. He knew very well that he would receive a decent reward from Ko Pil-seong when he successfully completed this task.
Jeong-chan nodded, looking at Go Pil-seong’s shiny eyes.
“of course. Just leave it to me.”
Go Pil-seong reveals money, but he is not stingy.
Even though there have been numerous bribery charges so far, the fact that he has not been imprisoned is entirely due to his ability to shine.
“But don’t be too careless.”
“So, shouldn’t it be life? No matter how much I didn’t come out of Milles Academy… I’m also an A-class raider.
Don’t worry too much.”
Jeong-chan bent down to say hello and went outside.
As can be seen from his tone, Jeong-chan had a strong resentment towards Miles.
It was because he applied to the academy in the past and failed twice and left the other radar academy.
To him, Milles is a trashy academy that failed to recognize his talent.
Also, Jaehyun was just a monster created by the academy for media play.
‘Probably my actual skills are terrible. tell me wisely That I’m better.’
After a while, Jeong-chan cried and cried, thinking of the cadets who would cling to him.
I felt like I was already in a good mood when I thought of the guys called the elite who were praised by the world holding their pants crotch and crying.
* * *
Back to the present.
Jeong-chan had to admit that his plan was a bit twisted.
Even though the rest of the cadets were okay because they didn’t encounter the beast… It was because when Jae-hyeon and Kim Yoo-jung returned, the things they brought shocked him.
“There were few of them nearby. I think we should go a little deeper.”
Jaehyun said so and put his booty down on the floor.
With a pattering sound, the essence of the corrupted spirits poured out of his bosom. There are about thirty of them.
“…You mean you two handled this together?”
Jaehyun laughed as he looked at the finished tent, ignoring the muttered dinner.
“Hey, it seems your tent-making skills are getting better. Has it become quite usable?”
“of course. It’s difficult if you’ve had a little more training like this.”
Ahn Ho-yeon said that and laughed at the same time.
Kwon So-yul next to him kept writing something on the newly brought touchpad.
Seeing several potion bottles spilled on the floor, it seemed that he was using his own skill.
Her search skills are highly effective anytime, anywhere.
It will be of great help in finding a way to quickly clear the dungeon.
“Is things going well?”
“so so. Anyway, I want to ask you something.”
At Jaehyun’s words, Kwon Soyul let go of his rhyme and said.
She narrowed her eyes as she looked at Jaehyun.
It was because he instinctively realized that something was wrong with his body.
“The apple you fed us that day… what the hell is that?”
Come to think of it, Kim Yu-jung said the same thing in a battle a while ago.
An apple that Jaehyun cut himself. After eating this, he began to clearly realize that his body had changed.
‘It seems Inana and Hoyeon haven’t noticed yet.’
His colleagues will clearly experience the effect of the apology in this dungeon raid.
An elixir that increases magical power.
This wasn’t something you could easily get anywhere.
In the first place, Idun’s golden apples were grown in God’s garden. If nothing changes after eating these items, that would be even more strange.
“It’s nothing special… It’s expensive.”
“Is it expensive…? As expected… that’s why the effect was amazing…!”
Kwon So-yul was basically a person steeped in materialism.
As soon as she heard that the apple Jaehyun handed her was an expensive item, she nodded with a bright smile on her face.
“Suddenly he went missing and came back to his senses. Have you finally realized the importance of your colleagues?”
“Sometimes you talk like I’ve been mean again. Even though you already picked up a lot.”
“but.”
Kwon So-yul quickly understood.
In fact, the reason she asked Jaehyun about the apology was simple.
When he used his unique skill Search a while ago. It made it possible to search a wider range without difficulty than before.
In the case of Kim Yoo-jung, it was an increase in the total amount of horsepower and an increase in proficiency.
The rest will have a similar effect.
Jaehyun couldn’t help but feel good about the situation going smoothly.
While searching the dungeon with Kim Yoo-jung, he saw a monster den, and it was full of hundreds of B-class or higher beasts.
Jaehyun can’t even dream of leveling up until
he catches it, but…
That was the business that remained.
Jaehyun sang a hum song and spread his mana widely.
The colleagues who would raise their stats were just concentrating on clearing the dungeon without knowing this fact.
‘Now then, shall we begin in earnest?’
When Jaehyun raises the corner of his mouth thinking that. On the other side, Jeong-chan was grinding his teeth at the thoughts that came to his mind.
‘I can’t let these guys clear the dungeon… I have to do something!’
If this was the case, it would have been a situation where things could go wrong.
If that happens, the beans that will fall on him will disappear, and he will have to withdraw his plan to feed the cadets of Miles Academy.
Is this the end of your grand plan?
You can’t do that!
Jeong-chan thought so and glared at Jae-hyun. He still had a slim, handsome face, but unlike the first time, for some reason, he felt an unknown force.
It must have been because he had personally witnessed the essence of the fallen spirit collected a moment ago.
‘But that would be a lie. I caught a few by accident, but it must have been a heap of essence!
Otherwise, it would be absolutely impossible to get rid of that many things in this amount of time.’
Aren’t they monsters from a B-class dungeon?
Even if a party of cadets could deal with five or six of them, it would be impossible to defeat that number quickly.
That was Jeong-chan’s conclusion.
……But he didn’t know.
That Jaehyun was already aware of his disturbing movements.

chapters.title: Chapter 234
chapters.content:
Episode 234 Red Mission (4)
Evening came a little early.
Like an open dungeon with a dense forest, the day quickly disappeared and darkness settled.
A faint smell of blood and water mist covered the forest. On a day like this, you have to be especially careful about hunting monsters, so Jaehyun decided to go hunting as soon as the day dawned.
For now, the priority is to take a break and recharge your stamina.
Anyway, if you attack the dungeon according to your skills, it will be over in an instant.
That was not going to happen.
One of the goals of clearing this dungeon was to secure his own stats through the growth of his friends.
Since Jeong-chan was also watching from the side, Jae-hyun was thinking of adjusting the attack speed appropriately.
You have to be aware of what he might do before you can respond, so it’s good to keep a close eye on his actions without losing any tension.
‘Although it’s obvious what he’s trying to do.’
Jaehyun knew.
That Jeong-chan is making a plan to sabotage their mission, which will be led by the mayor of Pohang city, Ko Pil-seong.
It was a reenactment familiar with the circumstances of politicians and adults.
There was no reason for him to be subjected to such an altercation.
But…
it’s worth using.
Jaehyun thought about it and raised his eyebrows lightly.
He will use the dinner plan in reverse from now on.
* * *
That evening, Jeong-chan sneaked out and started spraying something outside.
It is the bodily fluids of other monsters.
It was a kind of inducer to attract greedy demons.
The reason for using it is simple.
In order to attract other demons and stop their raiding of dungeons.
Simply put, it is to induce a raid of monsters.
‘Kids. Let’s get it right.’
Jeong-chan intended to teach Jae-hyun and his colleagues about the bitterness of life.
The battle against the Witchbeast is not determined only by strength.
Tact and accurate judgment in combat situations. Without it, even weak enemies can die.
‘Of course, I can’t let Pohang City and Milles die for a smooth relationship.
Moderately frightening is fine.’
No matter how inferior the dinner was, I had no intention of letting a minor die at the gate.
Right now, it’s just to scare them and induce them to properly subdue the demons at the entrance, just like Go Pil-seong requested.
that was the purpose
Ssssss…….
“Is this enough?”
As the powder was sprinkled, the scent of magic began to creep up from the surroundings.
No matter how formal it is, it feels creepy.
Of course, I brought a warp stone for multiplayer so that I could bring the cadets back.
It’s a tool that can move multiple people at the same time, so there’s no danger.
Worst case. He only had to run away wearing a coat with a one-minute stealth skill.
The lifeline of Jeong-chan, which was purchased in the past by hundreds of millions of dollars. This was the artifact that saved him from almost dying several times.
I don’t mean to let other people die, but the priority is yourself anyway.
Wouldn’t you like to do something in the future if you live?
It was much better to protect oneself than to face others who were hit a few times.
“Then I’m slowly……”
It was the time he was about to take a step while thinking so.
Grrr!
‘what?’
From somewhere in the middle of the forest, a terrifying cry was heard.
I felt goosebumps running down my spine and all over my body.
What the hell is going on?
Haven’t you heard that beast-type monsters exist here?
Thoughts continued sparsely, but soon only one thought remained in his head.
‘Dangerous.’
That thought ran through his mind. It was almost a sixth sense.
Jeong-chan immediately turned around.
A huge enemy is approaching them.
Waking up the cadets now and delaying the time would reduce the chances of his own survival.
‘It’s unfortunate, but I can’t help it!’
After he concluded, he quickly put on his stealth robe.
And it was the very moment when I was trying to get out of the seat faster than anyone else.
Whoo!
A vine that had flown from somewhere entangled Jeong-chan’s leg precisely. It was a repulsive vine with bumps sprouting everywhere.
Jeong-chan shouted in an embarrassed voice.
“What!”
When I first investigated at the headquarters, there was no story that there was a monster attacking with vines here.
Plant-type monsters are not often reported even in academic societies.
Simply put, it means no information.
To make matters worse, a black shadow was slowly approaching him in the forest.
woo woo!
A wolf howl is heard.
His legs were still not functioning and the vines were too strong to get out.
‘what! What kind of magic is this…!’
Jeong-chan saw the red eyes of the demon slowly approaching him.
At this rate, one hundred percent would die. Dangerous.
These thoughts were tangled up and clouded his thinking.
It was then.
“It’s a heavy plant.”
At that time, Jeong-chan’s expression hardened coldly at the sudden voice he heard from behind.
Following.
Awesome!
The vines that wrapped around him cut so lightly that a boy appeared from the darkness.
Jeong-chan’s face stiffened with shock.
‘That guy… Min Jae-hyun?!’
* * *
Heavy plant.
Jaehyun was well aware of the monster that attacked the dinner table. It was because he was a guy he had dealt with before returning.
At the time, I was tied to that vine and couldn’t do anything, so I was probably saved by a colleague.
Now, though, it’s quite different.
‘I’m sure Jeong-chan doesn’t know. It was around this time that heavy plants appeared in earnest. It was a time when there was no public information about him yet.’
Still in this era, information on all monsters appearing in dungeons and fields was not disclosed. A time when, at best, only about 20% of all demonic beasts in existence were properly analyzed.
There were always a lot of people dying in lower dungeons due to lack of information.
Lack of information leads to insufficient response, which is a problem that eventually leads to the death of the radar.
However, it was meaningless to Jaehyun.
He almost memorized the monster dictionary before returning. There was absolutely no chance of being hit by a monster like a heavy plant.
There was nothing to worry about because he was perfectly aware of his weaknesses in the first place.
“For now, I will take care of this guy. Keep your distance and kill the wolf, please.”
“Leave it to me.”
Ahn Ho-yeon boasted. The other colleagues also nodded and gathered around the living quarters with their backs at the center.
Dark forest is dangerous. If you open the gap even a little bit, the camp will be scattered and bitten by the wolves.
Of course, now my colleagues are strong enough, and even if a problem arises, it won’t hurt too much.
‘It’s better not to get hurt though.’
Jaehyun thought and moved his gaze toward the heavy plant in front of him.
This guy is an A-rank beast that doesn’t go well with a B-rank gate.
A monster that wraps around the opponent to weaken it, then stabs humans and monsters with the spittle at the end of the vine and sucks their bodily fluids.
While Jaehyun continued his accident, Jungchan, who had suddenly collapsed, shouted.
“Boo fire! Use fire attribute magic! If you do that…!”
“They talk all sorts of stupid things.”
Jaehyun said that and dismissed his opinion.
Well, it can be seen that there are sufficient grounds for Jeong-chan’s judgment.
Basically, it’s common knowledge that plant-type monsters are weak to flames.
But this is a trap.
Jaehyun knew.
When dealing with a Witchbeast, the ability to hit its weakness is important, but there is something more important than that.
‘The situation of the fields and dungeons.’
Jaehyun looked around. Nearby is a flooded forest.
If you use fire magic here, as Jeong-chan said, the flames will spread out of control.
If that happens, it will be a situation where you have to use more mana than necessary to extinguish the fire.
‘Not only that, but the beasts of the forest have a very sensitive sense of smell. They will react sensitively to the smell of burning.’
Because of this, capable raiders are always sensitive to starting fires in the forest.
It must be accompanied to maintain body temperature, but do not attempt it unless safety is secured. that’s fire
Jaehyun also went through many experiences like this before returning.
“For now, it’s dented in the back. I have a lot of questions to ask later.”
Jaehyun looked back for a moment and said. Jeong-chan trembled involuntarily.
‘That guy… what the hell is that?’
However, before he could even give an answer, magic burst from Jaehyun’s fingertips.
‘The most effective magic for plant-type monsters is flame… But apart from that, the ice property magic is also effective.’
―Active skill «Frozen Earth Lv. 5” to activate.
Damn it!
Huge pieces of ice rose from the ground with a roar and started attacking the head and heart, the vital parts of the Heavy Plant.
hooked! hooked!
Heavy Plant’s body is pierced with fragments of ice sharpened like awl, and purple blood bleeds.
It is a neurotoxin that paralyzes people from moving. Instead of blood, it was also the moisture that occupied the body of the Heavy Plant.
Aaah…!
Jaehyun gestured once again with the demon’s scream and froze him entirely.
It was decided to block it at the source because the poison could splash out and damage nearby colleagues.
Kwadeuk!
Along with the sound, the Demonic Beast gradually began to be trapped in the ice from below.
On the other hand, Jeong-chan regrets his actions a little while ago as he sees Jae-hyeon getting rid of the demon in an instant.
If I had known this was going to happen, I should have looked at Jaehyun’s skills and worked on it more properly…
Of course, even if I did, the result wouldn’t have changed.
The Heavy Plant was completely frozen and unable to move.
Eventually, as Jaehyun clenched his fists, the ice that wrapped around the beast broke.
Kwachang!
The Heavy Plant, which had been torn to pieces in an instant, was now at a level where its original form could not be found.
Only the ice shards on the floor told him that he existed.
“That one?”
After Jaehyun dealt with the beast, he calmly asked his colleagues.
There, except for Kwon So-yul, Kim Yoo-jung, and Lee Jae-sang, the panicking voices of the party could be heard.
Seo Ina said as she clenched and opened her fists.
“……Something seems to have changed from before.”
“I know. I don’t know why either, but the sword suddenly feels light.”
Ahn Ho-yeon also agreed. Kwon So-yul crossed his arms and said.
“That’s because of the apology Jaehyun gave me earlier.”
“……yes?”
“……Is it because of the apology? Jaehyun, what does that mean?”
“Well, let’s talk about that a little later.”
After Jaehyun moderately cut off the party, he looked at Jeongchan who was sitting on the floor.
“First, let’s think about what to do with this human. Think of you too. What and how much to rip off.”
A greedy expression appeared on Jaehyun’s face.
one of his philosophies. It was a tit for tat strategy.
If the opponent hits lightly, I hit lightly too.
‘I will cooperate with those who agree to cooperate with me. but.’
Jaehyun clenched his fist as he approached Jeongchan.
“If you betrayed me first, I will return the same. Knock it off.”
Naturally, Jaehyun never let this happen.
Jeonghan’s face hardened. For reference, it was the exact opposite of Jaehyun’s expression.
“Wait a minute! I’ll give you anything you want…! So…!”
Jaehyun thought that there would be more to rip off him than he thought, so laughter kept leaking out.

chapters.title: Chapter 235
chapters.content:
Episode 235 Owner of the Fallen Spirit (1)
“So. You mean you were targeting us from the beginning?”
“……That’s right.”
After the battle was over, Jaehyun took Jeongchan to a secluded place and beat him until he was about to die.
This process made Jeongchan a more sincere person.
“Everyone has high quality… This is what the mayor ordered! I’m not… not at fault… I’m sorry about that.”
Jeong-chan had no hesitation in using honorific words. Until a little while ago, he still had his personality, but now he was bowing his head to Jaehyun, as if he had no pride.
Well, I didn’t even know that this was his nature.
Wasn’t he hostile to Jae-hyeon and his party from the beginning just because they were from Milles Academy?
Distrusting the strong, yet bowing down endlessly. That was Jeong-chan’s nature.
“Once you know for sure. That I could clear this dungeon by myself if I put my mind to it.
And if you mess around, you will die.”
“Yes……”
Jeong-chan said in a crawling voice, glancing at Jae-hyun’s eyes.
Jaehyun appropriately changed the topic there.
“Tell me everything you know about dungeons. I have something to gain here.”
At his words, Jung-chan was taken aback for a moment.
Do you have anything to gain here? I had never heard such a thing from the mayor.
Ko Pil-sung clearly only told him that he had to deal with the dungeon break before it exploded.
But Jeong-chan knew. Looking back on your current situation, you should nod your head at Jaehyun’s words.
do you know If he even declared that he was going to leave him here, he’d be stuck and eaten by the wolves and man-eating plants we saw earlier.
Jeong-chan let out a sigh.
Right now, I had no choice but to look good for Jaehyun. Because he’s a dangerous person.
* * *
“But is it really here?”
When the next day was bright and the first talk with the mayor was about two days away, Kim Yoo-jung asked Kwon So-yul.
Kwon So-yul nodded.
“Yes, I’m sure.”
“It can’t be…”
Kim Yu-jung shook her head with a shocked expression.
The dungeon map Kwon So-yul made yesterday and gave to Jae-hyeon and his colleagues. This is because there was something strange written on it.
“I thought there would be a point where you can mine arc metal in the dungeon where the fallen spirits appear. no wonder. There was a small amount of Ark Metal in the reward.”
Kim Yoo-jung let out a sigh and sighed.
In the first mission, why was he distributing such a precious ore to the students?
Perhaps Ko Pil-seong knew this.
However, it is difficult to collect and process arc metal. After all the dungeons were cleared, he must have been thinking of stealing them and giving them away.
While pretending to be kind.
No matter how you think about it, it was not a balance calculation.
“Have you really not heard anything?”
Jaehyun asked Jeongchan with a murderous expression.
Jeong-chan hurriedly waved his hand.
“If I had known that, I would have told you earlier. I didn’t know either…….”
“If that’s a lie, you won’t die well.”
Jaehyun let go of the threat moderately and took a step forward again.
Chan’s words are probably true.
If a mediocre official found out about the possibility of mining such an expensive ore, he might be a little taken aback.
Also, this wouldn’t have been a good thing for Go Pil-seong, who reveals money.
“Anyway, I like it because the unique skill effect seems to have improved.”
“If you’re going to compliment me, would you do it for me? I feel like I became a shuttle because I only praised my skills.”
“It’s not that wrong.”
“……Would you like another shot?”
Kwon So-yul clenched his fists and said. Jaehyun moved without paying attention at all.
After walking through the forest and eating dried beef jerky and preserved food, we came to an open place before we knew it. It was a large rectangular space.
“There is such an open space in the forest. I doubt it.”
Jaehyun looked around and said that. It was as he said.
Suddenly there is an empty space in the middle of a flooded forest?
This was a trap for anyone to see.
“It looks like there is a guy with intelligence among the monsters here.”
“But it could be that the land was devastated due to territorial battles between monsters, right?”
Ahn Ho-yeon asked, but Jae-hyun shook his head.
“no. If I did, I wouldn’t have left such a mark here.”
Jaehyun pointed to the letters written on the stone near the dent in the floor and said.
It was the language of runic magic.
“I don’t know what stupid asshole rated the dungeon. I don’t think it’s a B-level here. At least it’s grade A.
The level of the boss monster will also be the same.”
Of course, it was dinner that made the grade.
He said he read the magic of this dungeon a few days ago and graded it with other raiders.
But there was an important fact that should not be overlooked.
It was that witches could also hide their abilities.
‘Among the monsters, those who use magic know how to hide their magic very well. It emits a lower level of magic than the original level, and at this time, it aims for the backs of unwary raiders. They’re very clever.’
Jaehyun remembered the many raiders who lost their lives due to this trick.
How many times had even the cautious himself crossed the line of death at the hands of the Witchbeast?
Meanwhile, Jeong-chan’s expression hardened in an instant at Jae-hyun’s words. he shouted in a bewildered voice.
“If that’s the case, shouldn’t we get out right away! It’s class A…! It’s dangerous no matter how you are…”
“Shut up and follow me. It won’t change the fact that we raid dungeons.”
Jaehyun bluffed like that. There was no change in the fact that they would attack the dungeon anyway.
If anything, Papy and himself could take charge of the battle and send the others outside.
Listening to the story earlier, it seems that Jeong-chan also has a warp stone. It was too safe to run away now.
“It has arrived.”
While Jaehyun was lost in thought. Kwon So-yul’s voice came.
Jaehyun woke up from his thoughts and looked around.
After walking for a few more minutes on the open road, a space where various stones and expensive-looking items are piled up.
If it were another radar, it would drooling and sweeping away jewels, but now Jaehyun’s eyes didn’t see any of those things.
“That’s… Ark Metal.”
There was a heap of arc metal that had not yet been smelted.
Considering the potential value, if all processing is completed, it will exceed at least 10 billion units.
“Then let’s start mining soon.”
After Jaehyun raised his eyebrows, he took out a mining pickaxe from his inventory and handed it out to the group.
Jaehyun had a habit of taking things with him before entering a dungeon, not knowing what was going to happen inside.
The pickaxe was the same.
“No way… carrying this and digging that one?”
“of course. Start right away. I still have a lot of time until the promised time, but I don’t want to delay either.”
After saying that, Jaehyun put on his forehead with a look of regret.
at the same time. He threw a pickaxe at Jeong-chan and said.
“I brought the number of people, but one pickaxe is missing. What can I do?”
I saw Jeong-chan accepting the pickaxe with Jaehyun’s voice.
He was with a mischievous smile.
“One person has no choice but to do the work for two people.”
Looking at that expression, Jeong-chan definitely realized.
Jaehyun is not human.
If he was a human, he wouldn’t have thought to treat him like this, no matter how wrong he was.
* * *
The process of mining arc metal was not that difficult.
Just hit the pickaxe with magic to break the stone and put the fragments into the inventory.
That was basic.
But even so, it was unavoidable that it took a long time.
From the middle, Jaehyun himself got involved in mining and helped his colleagues. I activated my mana weapon to strengthen my body, so even without a pickaxe, I managed to get some speed.
A smile did not leave his lips.
It was because I couldn’t help but be happy because I thought this was all money.
‘In the first place, arc metal isn’t something you can easily obtain even if you have money.’
Of course, in Jaehyun’s case, obtaining arc metal would be several times easier than other people’s.
You can ask Yeonhwa, or you can participate in the auction and spend the money as before. But if you do that, you will attract more attention than necessary.
Basically, rare materials such as arc metal have low transaction volume.
No matter how quietly the purchase was made, the buyer’s identity was bound to be exposed in a place that did not guarantee anonymity, such as a black market.
As a representation, it is bound to be burdensome.
“How is the chancellor? Do you think you can make everything you need with this?”
Jae-hyun looked at Lee Jae-sang, who was looking around the arc metal from the side. He nodded vigorously and replied.
“Yes! At this level, even Nidhogg’s fangs from the myth could be the moon!”
‘It would be difficult if it was the moon…’
Jaehyun nodded his head while unconsciously thinking about it.
In any case, the sign that this was enough for the ingredients fell off.
Arc metal is enough to distribute evenly to other colleagues.
With this, it will be much easier to prepare herbs and herbs from Idun’s garden as potions.
‘Is the only thing left now is to defeat the boss monster? It seems like he’s coming this way without having to look for anything.’
Jaehyun closed his eyes for a moment as he sensed the various mana coming from deep in the forest.
The Witchbeast was coming this way. at a very high speed.
Of course, the level of magical power felt is a terrible level to compare with A. Jaehyun.
As he thought so, he raised himself up for battle.
Suddenly, I heard the voices of my colleagues.
They were standing next to Jaehyun.
“This time we’re going to catch it, so take a look from behind.”
“……okay. It won’t take long.”
“If you step out, it will end too soon!”
Jaehyun laughed as he watched his colleagues add one word at a time.
Well, if it’s about the level of an A-rank boss monster, they’ll be enough to kill it even if you don’t step forward.
I ate a golden apple… More than anything, my colleagues have excellent basic skills.
Jaehyun shrugged and sat down on a spacious stone chair.
“Take care.”
The moment when such a warm atmosphere was created.
A panicked man’s voice interrupted.
“What kind of small thing is that?! Why is the strongest Min Jae-hyun not participating in the battle?!”
Jeong-chan appealed with a face almost crying.
However, Jaehyun simply ignored his words this time.
“Then, shall we see how much you have improved?”
Along with Jaehyun’s words, there was a thump and the sound of something falling to the ground.
Through the white dust, the figure of the Witchbeast slowly begins to emerge.

chapters.title: Chapter 236
chapters.content:
Episode 236 Master of the Fallen Spirit (2)
Greung!
Poppy jumped out of Jaehyun’s bag and blocked his colleague.
It meant that they would fight together.
Jaehyun looked at him with a smile.
As if to leave it to him, he slammed his chest with his dainty paws and snorted.
“Is that… a dragon?”
Jeong-chan narrowed his eyes and looked at Papi standing in front of him.
It was a picture that could hardly be matched. He made a blank expression, but Jaehyun smiled and nodded.
“It’s my pet. Nothing to worry about.”
“……yes?”
Jeong-chan shook his head with a shocked expression.
Dragons become humans’ pets?
It has a cute appearance like a puppy, but Papy was unmistakably a dragon.
Although the soles of its feet were made of pink jelly, it had scales and had wings.
A dragon that is generally feared by raiders.
Does that mean that Min Jae-hyun tamed such a guy?
‘It must be crazy…!’
But even in the midst of that, he was still looking at Jaehyun with eyes of disbelief.
I don’t know if he goes to battle again. Only their comrades do battle?
Is that a reasonable thing to do?
However, Jaehyun was still unmoved.
At that time, the members of Circle Nine took a step forward. At the same time, the rising smoke dissipated and the figure of the demon was revealed.
Susseu…….
Everything that was blocking their view was lifted, and what came into their eyes was a huge root.
Jaehyun narrowed his brows.
“It’s a regenerative magic beast. Everyone be careful. It’s not just one or two.”
At his words, his colleagues kept their distance and set up a tight guard.
regenerative magic.
This literally refers to monsters with very good regenerative abilities.
They mainly refer to those who can absorb the magical energy of the surrounding air to recover their physical strength, and the representative beast is a troll. And now it’s the moving tree Ent in front of them.
“I’ve never dealt with Ents before… There are definitely a lot of them.”
Kim Yoo-jung clicked her tongue and looked around.
Even if you estimate the number of enemies, it seems to exceed twenty. Well, at the point when the boss monster personally came to meet me, I wondered if that would have much meaning.
“Let’s go to Formation D for now.”
At Ahn Ho-yeon’s words, the colleagues changed positions in perfect order.
Formation D was devised by Jaehyun in the past and handed down to them, and was a formation specialized in magic attacks.
‘Hoyeoni is standing in front. After that, Ina and Kim Yoo-jung, who have no skill delay, attack. Its strength is that it has destructive power and has almost no gaps.’
As he made this formation himself, Jaehyun was well aware of how destructive this formation was.
The D formation is a very effective layout even in A-rank or higher dungeons if used well. In fact, this was an improvement that Jaehyun had learned while rolling on the battlefield before returning.
Of course, this formation is not perfect.
‘This formation cannot be utilized properly unless the abilities of individual raiders are supported. It’s basically a difficult position.’
The least Maginot Line is B-class lieutenant Raider. Now, the fact that Jaehyun’s colleagues were doing it perfectly meant that their achievements were surpassing B in the end.
In fact, they are colleagues who even ate Idun’s golden apple.
As talent was overwhelming from the beginning, it was not impossible to rise to that level.
‘Well, even though it’s amazing enough.’
Jaehyun was still sitting on a stone and quietly watching their battle.
Tsutsut!
It was Ahn Ho-yeon who went into battle first.
Jaehyun looked at him with an interesting expression. Ahn Ho-yeon raised his sword with a confident expression and ran toward the group of ents approaching.
Jaehyun’s eyes narrow, and embarrassment erupts from the corner of his mouth.
“……The tank position doesn’t keep its place?”
It was a completely different route from the D formation that Jaehyun had devised and delivered in the first place.
Ahn Ho-yeon’s choice was so unconventional that even Jae-hyun, who had spent a long time on the battlefield, was embarrassed.
A typical tanker’s role is to pass the time while protecting his teammates.
Even though Ahn Ho-yeon is fluent in swords and possesses several strong skills. In the end, he couldn’t keep up with the destructive power of magic.
However, the party was not taken aback by Ahn Ho-yeon’s actions and only smiled.
Jaehyun was convinced without knowing it.
that they have plans for something. unfounded confidence.
And along with the idea, Jaehyun started a completely unexpected battle.
Ahn Ho-yeon, who must protect his allies, infiltrated the enemy, and Kim Yoo-jung was in the vanguard. Seo Ina stood at the very back.
switching. It is a way to deal with enemies by changing positions with each other.
However, it was obviously strange for them to make these movements.
Switching play is basically when the class of the raiders is the same. To put it simply, martial arts. Or it’s normal for the magic world to do it.
Basically, each party has its own role firmly established.
However, Jaehyun’s colleagues were moving in the opposite direction.
Ahn Ho-yeon, who has to protect her colleagues, takes positions at the forefront where Kim Yoo-jung and Seo In-na are easy to defend.
What kind of tactic is this?
Jaehyun couldn’t help but think that way without even realizing it.
On the other hand, Ahn Ho-yeon smiles at Jae-hyun’s flustered appearance.
He was thinking back to the time when he came up with this bizarre operation.
* * *
After Jaehyun suddenly disappeared.
For a while, the members of Circle Nine have been training together and improving their skills.
The reason is simple.
It was because, if not as much as Jaehyun, I wanted to become strong enough to stand by him and help him.
It was hard to explain why, but his colleagues all thought the same thing.
Because of this, the colleagues who gathered around were worried. The mindset of radar heard in class and the way to practice it.
This was tedious and had little effect on survival.
These are huge events called outdoor camps. And it came to a clear realization through an encounter with Heimdall, an unknown creature.
That they are still just frogs in the well.
So they decided to devise a new formation to use in battle.
It is a new tactic that pushes individual capabilities to the limit.
It was like a tactic in football.
Before modern football developed. In the past, the positions of defense and offense were clear.
At that time, individualism between each position was more firmly established, and this soon led to players’ embarrassment.
The defense was left in the attack situation and looked around, and the attack continued the situation in which it could not do anything in the defense situation.
So, a soccer manager for a team decided to devise a new tactic.
Total Soccer.
Everyone attacks and everyone defends.
The location is divided by position, but they are ultimately one purpose.
In other words, he moved for goals and wins.
This sparked a new innovation in football and brought glory to the team.
Circle Nine also adopted this type of combat.
Fighting while clearly distinguishing positions means exposing one’s limits.
There was a high possibility that they would catch each other’s ankles when they were in trouble.
“But that doesn’t happen anymore.”
Ahn Ho-yeon muttered while saying that. he was sure
You and your teammates are getting stronger too.
Although it still takes a while to become as strong as Jaehyun
* * *
“That’s… what the hell…”
Jaehyun sighed and watched his teammates move, but suddenly he heard a voice from behind.
“Well, they weren’t playing while you were gone.”
Kwon So-yul approached Jae-hyun and said,
Like Lee Jae-sang, she did not directly participate in the battle. I only focus on measuring the distance and checking the distance so that the enemy cannot approach Lee Jae-sang using a dagger.
This was an effective decision.
The person holding the potion is the person in charge of replenishment.
If he collapsed, the longer the battle lasted, the worse it could be.
―Active skill «Blue and White Sword».
Hwareuk!
A blue flower burns from the tip of An Ho-yeon’s sword. This is much bigger than before.
It seems that the fact that his colleagues have grown further during Jaehyun’s absence was not a story that was said in passing.
Kwon So-yul is crossing his arms with a proud expression on his face.
Hung!
Ahn Ho-yeon puts strength on her legs and swiftly moves behind the enemy.
His eyes shone fiercely.
‘Ant is a guy whose resilience is as strong as a troll. It won’t be that easy to deal with. First, reduce the number.’
Ahn Ho-yeon put strength into his sword.
Awesome!
An Ent guarding the boss’s front lay down on the floor, splashing debris.
Jaehyun watched the scene in a daze, with a look of shock.
“……As you said, I counted a lot. Ent is one room.”
Ent is an A-class monster. It is a very difficult level for those who are still cadets to deal with.
It is impossible to kill with a single sword unless you are at least the highest among B-class.
No matter how strong the destructive power is, it is difficult to put an attack that exceeds their resilience.
Ahn Ho-yeon was not the only one who felt that he had become stronger.
Standing in front with Alfheim’s sword activated, Eana also felt it keenly.
In the case of Kim Yoo-jung, there was nothing more surprising because she was already surprised enough while hunting spirits with Jae-hyun.
Seo In-na looked at the sword of Alfheim, which she had embodied, and put her strength into it.
Awesome!
One monster’s head is cut and falls to the ground.
An A-class monster was easily cut and fell like a piece of paper.
No matter how I thought about it, it wasn’t something that was easy to understand. I remember Kwon So-yul saying that his mana increased thanks to the apology given to him by Jae-hyun, but…
I didn’t care that much at the time.
But now I had to admit that she was right.
Jeong-chan was also looking at Jae-hyun and his colleagues, thinking the same thing.
“Crazy bastards…….”
I thought only Jaehyun was a monster. But no. Jeong-chan seemed to understand now why he was relaxed even though he didn’t participate in the battle a moment ago.
They are at least B-class, and they are the top performers.
If you look at that inaction alone, it is already at a level that exceeds the adult radar.
‘I’m an A-class, but I didn’t rise to that position solely by force… Even if I don’t want to admit it, it’s clear that their skills are superior to mine.’
He gritted his teeth and silently watched their battle.
There was nothing he could do in this situation.
Kim Yoo-jung activated 《Overflow》 to increase the power of his teammates’ skills, and Ahn Ho-yeon penetrated behind them and stirred the battlefield with his sword.
Then, Seo Ina slaughtered enemies one after another with Alfheim’s sword.
In an instant, nearly half of the Ents were cleared, scattering debris across the floor.
“But… it’s not the end. Because that’s not all the potential of A-class monsters.”
Jaehyun muttered that while looking at the boss monster in front of him.
The guy still seemed relaxed even as his men were being swept away.
It must be that there is a corner to believe in.
The boss monster was smart as much as it was a monster with intelligence.
Jaehyun narrowed his eyes as he looked at him.
soon
Aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa…!!
The boss monster started moving.
