The boss monster’s scream fills the dungeon with the sound of the system.
Jaehyun quietly looked at the owner of the fallen spirit that started the movement.
His face, which had been hidden by the other Ents, was clearly revealed, and his characteristics slowly came to mind.
‘The owner of the fallen spirits. It is a monster that leads the forest’s Ents and Demonic Beasts. I’ve seen it in a radar dictionary before.’
This, too, was a memory before the return.
In the first place, Ent and Heavy Plant, whom he dealt with previously, are also people whose information cannot be easily found in the current radar world.
Demonic beasts that have not yet been properly revealed to the public.
Jaehyun is probably the only one with detailed information about them at this point.
Jaehyun looked at the enemy in front and looked back at the character of the enemy one by one.
‘First of all, his biggest feature is that he constantly recovers his physical strength. regenerative power.
Also, the problem is that they use various CC skills.’
Of course, there are all kinds of monsters in the world. But among them, it was rare to find a guy who was as tough and made the raiders suffer in an inventive way.
Strongness is also a problem, but multiple attack patterns were a problem.
You have to be careful not only of poisoning and paralyzing poison, but also of the vines that Heavy Plant used earlier.
His fighting style is to look for an opening and then attack and eat the enemy at once.

“be careful. If Jaehyun was about to
say that, Kwon Soyul stabbed him in the side and raised the corner of his mouth.
“If you’re in danger anyway, I’ll save you. Because it has happened before.”
“……Are you not going to save me this time? That time was special.”
Jaehyun was embarrassed and said that.
Kwon So-yul was talking about the time in the past when he saved a colleague from Heimdall. However, Jaehyun had no intention of helping his colleague like he did back then.
Of course, if it’s a really dangerous situation, the story will be different… but I don’t think that will happen.
Anyway, this battle is the part that he decided not to intervene.
If you continue to help your colleagues and become a habit, your growth might stop there.
‘You have to create a platform where the kids can play as much as possible and watch it.
……And if I catch that guy, the grand plan to sit still and collect stats will collapse.’
Jaehyun smiled and thought about it.
The most important thing for Radar is to move forward without overconfident in one’s skills.
It is to always keep in mind that you are the lowest predator in this dungeon.
Jaehyun believed that his colleagues would treat him well.
On top of that, it would be even better if he steadily leveled up and even raised his stats.
Jaehyun didn’t respond any more and started watching his colleagues. Of course, I didn’t forget to keep an eye on Jeong-chan to make sure he didn’t run away.
In order to rip things off from Mayor Go Pil-seong, it was necessary to manage him well so that he would not run away.
Hwareuk!
The flames rising from the tip of Ahn Ho-yeon’s sword fly precisely toward the enemy.
Cheonghwa itself has enormous destructive power and refinement. In terms of pure mana management, it is almost on par with an intangible sword.
A swordsmanship that has the potential to be coveted by even reproducing it if the shape of the sword is perfected. That was the blue and white sword.
“Goes!”
Ahn Ho-yeon kicked the ground with a spirited spirit.
He was taking on a kind of freeroll. The side that freely attacks and defends regardless of position.
Chow!
The sword dances through the air. Blue flames cut through the branch and body of the demon beast at once.
Taat!
At the same time, a strong counterattack begins to pour in from the Witchbeast side.
The whip made of his vines flew to wrap around An Ho-yeon’s body.
A very heterogeneous scene was created with him.
Seo In-na used Alfheim’s sword to block the vines of the demonic beast directed at An Ho-yeon.
‘The formation has changed again.’
Jaehyun recognized their movements at once.
‘Formation E. That’s an irregular tactic used during battle. A formation to confuse the enemy by changing its location according to specific conditions.
I never thought he’d do a great job with that.’
It was a move that was hard to find in his usual colleagues.
They used to adopt and use counter-attack tactics after defense, but when did they become able to switch freely like this?
Jaehyun was just enjoying their battle, forgetting to analyze it.
‘Ina, who has excellent destructive power, is concentrating on defense. Ho-yeon takes the attack… Kim Yoo-jung strikes the final blow.’
This would be several times more effective against an intelligent Witchbeast.
If they are enemies with even a rough understanding of the position and its formation. It’s a tactic that can embarrass several times.
Quaang!
Jae-hyun saw Kim Yoo-jung attacking the owner of the fallen spirit by moving to the rear while the two were blocking the eyes of the demons.
―Active skill 《Wind Edge》.
The pillar of magical power rising from the hand on the floor is shot accurately toward the large body of the fallen spirit’s owner.
Kim Yoo-jung did not stop there, immediately stepped back and activated one more magic.
―Active skill «Air Blast».
The air compressed in the hand explodes with magical energy and pierces the enemy’s head accurately.
Quaang!
With the sound of the explosion, the beast’s body began to slowly disintegrate. He was still in good health, but it was certain that he was deeply wounded.
Jaehyun looked at Kim Yoojung with an expression of surprise. It was because her attack power showed considerable destructive power.
‘Was Kim Yoo-jung’s magic originally that powerful? ……It’s probably not like that.’
However, just eating a golden apple would not have produced such destructive power.
She must have grown up with enough thought and training so far. although I haven’t seen it myself.
―Active skill 《Overflow》.
―Active skill 《Gigantification》 is activated.
The attacks of his colleagues did not end there.
Following Kim Yoo-jung’s auxiliary skill, Papi’s gigantism.
Poppy, who had inflated her size to the fullest, blocked the boss monster’s path.
Although the grades are quite different, Papi is strong. Even the scale’s hardness is beyond imagination.
He can perfectly play the tank role now.
However, Jaehyun was well aware that Papi’s value was not all of that.
‘It’s true that my teammates have become stronger. But without Poppy’s help, I would never be able to defeat him.’
Jaehyun knows. It doesn’t matter how strong your teammates become.
The master of the fallen spirits.
Dealing with him required one very important factor.
Poppy is the one with that element.
Maybe the members don’t know this well, but what. You will find out sooner or later.
You won’t have to tell me. Since they have a good fighting sense, you’ll be able to figure it out right away.
That moment when Jaehyun nodded slightly.
At a timing earlier than he expected, his teammates started attacking the boss properly.
Colleagues clear the way and attack the boss monster by defeating the lower monsters. The guy’s arm was cut off exactly.
But it was hard to see that he had a chance to win.
The enemies he was facing were not ordinary monsters.
Ssssss!
The owner of the fallen spirit whose arm had been cut off began to use magic and then began to recover by absorbing all the magic in the surrounding air.
The severed arm is attached to it, and the amount of mana that can be operated there is greatly increased.
To put it simply.
‘It’s a story that I’ve become stronger than before.’
So now what do you guys do
Can you overcome the sudden situation and defeat the boss monster?
Jaehyun looked at his colleagues with an interesting expression.
* * *
The first time I noticed something was wrong was right after I cut off my arm.
Ahn Ho-yeon thought while watching the enemy’s movements. Although they have excellent defense, their abilities have also risen considerably.
If you receive Kim Yoo-jung’s buff and work together with Seo In-na, you will be able to defeat the enemy.
Even if it’s an A-class boss monster.
However, his expectations were spectacularly wrong.
enemy resilience. It far surpassed trolls, the strongest in the same field.
All unexpected things happened.
“……Everyone calm down!”
Seo Ina shouted.
She, who did not often raise her voice, rarely raised her voice.
Ahn Ho-yeon quickly came to his senses.
Kim Yoo-jung was already calmly reading the war situation again.
Kwon So-yul and Lee Jae-sang were setting a trap nearby and preparing a potion for an emergency.
“……The biggest problem is the enemy’s resilience.”
Seo Eana took her luck and wiped out an enemy in front of her.
Awesome!
An Ent’s body is split in half and her gaze turns to Ahn Ho-yeon.
“……I’m going to have to do that somehow. If there is a way…….”
“If that’s the case, I have a way! It’s not exactly me…….”
Kim Yoo-jung interrupted and then pointed to one side and grinned.
“Yongyong has a skill that can be very useful. Dragon!”
With her cry, Poppy, who had grown in size, let out a huge cry.
Along with him, a white flame slowly rises from his mouth.
This was a corner that Kim Yoo-jung believed like iron stone.
―Active skill «Dragon Breath (Back)».
Papy’s Dragon Breath. It is also the technique of pouring out white flame.
This had the effect of burning away the enemy’s life force, nullifying his regenerative abilities.
A little while ago, when Kim Yoo-jung was collecting the essence of Jae-hyun and the spirits. I was able to check Poppy’s new skill first, and I assumed that an enemy like this would appear at that timing.
He had been thinking of using Papi’s white flame anytime since then.
For reference, the blue and white flames created by Ahn Ho-yeon’s magical powers and the white flames of Papi are moved by the user’s will.
Unlike normal fire magic, it means that you can burn exactly what you want to burn if you can control it delicately.
Kwaaaaang!!
A roar erupts, and several Ents and the owner of the fallen spirits are hit by the attack and fall back.
At that timing, Ahn Ho-yeon and Seo In-na dig into the turbulent battlefield without hesitation.
A sword with blue flames and transparent magical power that rises with him. It danced and created a strange afterimage.
Chow ah!
The two smiled as they recalled the feeling of their own swords cutting through enemies.
Unlike before, this attack was successful.
they were sure That this time, he wouldn’t be able to resist their attacks.
And that prediction was not wrong.
―You have succeeded in defeating the dungeon boss monster «Owner of the Corrupted Spirit».
“I did it!”
Ahn Ho-yeon clenched his fists tightly. They felt a sense of elation that their value was recognized and put on a happy expression.
Meanwhile, along with the sound of the system, a wide smile spread across Jaehyun’s lips.

chapters.title: Chapter 238
chapters.content:
Episode 238 Master of the Corrupted Spirit (4)
―You have succeeded in defeating the dungeon’s boss monster 《The Lord of the Corrupted Spirit》.
―The level of each of the 5 party members has increased by 1.
―With the effect of the passive skill 《Idun’s Compassion》, the user’s Free Distribution stat increases by 5!
The sound of the system you hear.
Along with that, Jaehyun could see that his teammates’ levels had risen.
5 freely distributed stats. This was a reward that brought a smile to Jaehyun’s lips.
“Somehow, the boss was defeated. Your skills have improved a lot?”
Jaehyun said that while trying to hide the joy of acquiring stats.
Kim Yu-jung crossed her arms and nodded.
“of course! Do you know that we didn’t do anything while you were gone?”
“Well, as Yoo-jung said, I did my best.”
Ahn Ho-yeon accepted her words.
Jaehyun was genuinely impressed.
It seems easy to say, but it must have taken a lot of effort for them to have that level of skill.
‘To grow this much in such a short time. That’s great.’
I was just a little bit impressed.
Of course, the main reason for that impression was the increase in his own stats.
‘Recently, it’s difficult to level up, so the rise in stats has been relatively stagnant.’
Jaehyun’s current level had already risen to the top of the human world.
The problem was that the higher the level, the stronger it became, the more difficult it became to go up to the next level.
Raider leveling basically boasts a high level of difficulty. Of course, the higher the level, the higher the difficulty increases exponentially.
‘That’s why artifacts that raise a lot of stats are traded at high prices.’
Artifacts are the easiest way for Raiders to level up.
Of course, it was a problem that it cost a lot of money, but the level of the radar does not rise after the age of 20. And even if you don’t raise the level with difficulty, you can easily raise the level.
In this respect alone, the Artifact brought a tremendous increase in efficiency to radars.
Among those artifacts, the pinnacle. It was Jaehyun who had a few things that others couldn’t even see.
‘By the way, if the Aesir system exists to train Einherjar… why did they restrict the Awakeners from growing any further when they turn 20?’
Jaehyun thought about it, but shook his head.
I thought maybe it wasn’t for a good reason.
There will come a day when this will be revealed.
Right now, there are already piles of things to worry about. It was better to put this issue aside and think about it later.
“Anyway, mining is over. The dungeon will be closed in a little while, so let’s get ready to leave.”
Jaehyun said and took the lead.
I got five stat points and arc metal without doing anything. A very fruitful dungeon raid has finally come to an end.
Circle Nine’s first autonomous mission.
It was the end of the red mission.
* * *
It didn’t take long to get out of the dungeon and visit the mayor’s office again.
Right now, the members of Circle Nine were alternately looking at Go Pil-seong, who was sweating coldly, and Jeong-chan, who was watching with his hands tied.
They were sitting on the sofa.
Go Pil-seong was trying hard to guess what was happening by examining the complexion of Jeong-chan and Jae-hyun.
Amidst the suffocating stillness. Jaehyun opened his mouth.
“I knew from the beginning. The mayor and the person named Jeong-chan here were thinking of using us.”
“……There seems to be a misunderstanding……”
Go Pil-seong quickly grasped that his situation was not good and held out his flippers. I don’t know why this happened, but I am sure of one thing.
Jaehyun right in front of you is not an easy opponent!
‘I have no choice but to avoid it as much as possible right now.’
However, it was not a representation that did not know this.
He had already guessed all of Go Pil-seong’s intentions.
Jaehyun said, putting his hands on his knees.
“I am not broad-minded enough to understand liars.”
“Are you saying I’m lying? That’s kind of hard to say, though.”
Go Pil-sung said that with a rare expression on his face.
He was now showing the composure of a politician. Not losing your composure at all even in situations where you are crowded.
Isn’t that a virtue that politicians should have?
Go Pil-seong looked at Jae-hyun, reflecting on the situation so far.
He thought for a moment.
‘Jung-chan is an A-class radar. No matter how many students there were, it was never to the point where they were tied hand and foot like this.
That means… that they used something different. In addition, there is a high possibility that he already has a hand that can put pressure on me. But I can’t take it lightly here.’
It was a quick-witted Gopilseong.
Instinctively, he knew Jaehyun and his colleagues would ask him for something.
I also knew that at a timing like now, it was necessary to give them what they wanted in moderation.
“Let’s clear up misunderstandings and let’s finish the mission in a good way.
Since you did a great job with the request, I’ll give you twice as many points as you said at the beginning.”
“Sorry, but it’s time over.”
At that time, Jaehyun’s words suddenly fell. This left more than enough to embarrass Ko Pil-seong.
“……yes?”
“You seem to be looking at that water… Are you trying to negotiate on the subject of trying to induce a mission failure and suck only sweet water?”
Jaehyun made a cold face as he said that.
“Aren’t you curious? How we managed to capture Jeong-chan, a Class A raider.”
At those words, Go Pil-seong’s body trembled and goose bumps appeared all over his body.
at the same time.
Tsutsutsutsutsu!
Suddenly, I felt the whole building shake by an unknown force.
“no way.”
Jaehyun lifted his head and opened his magic. Overwhelming magical power that is incomparable to A-class, which is the state of dining.
This was a level far beyond Jeong-chan’s.
Jaehyun laughed.
“Do you think I overpowered him by a fluke?”
* * *
“Hey… Taking out up to 4 million points per person! As expected Jaehyun, your threat is the best. I like that one!”
Kwon So-yul smiled broadly at the points deposited in the academy’s electronic bank.
Thanks to Jaehyun’s performance a little while ago, he was able to rip off a whopping 4 million points per person from Go Pilseong.
The negotiation itself went easily. It was thanks to Jeong-chan already telling Jae-hyeon of Go Pil-seong’s plan, and Jae-hyeon even finished recording it beforehand.
As for the high quality, there is no escape.
Even if he could escape in the first place, turning Jaehyun into an enemy was a very dangerous choice for him.
Jeong Chan and Go Pil-seong have a deep relationship with the Radar Management Headquarters.
However, as Jaehyun revealed, he was one of the raiders belonging to him. It also reproduces being in the position of a special agent who has a deep connection with the upper class.
In the midst of that, even if it’s a market, the high writing quality goes against Jae-hyun’s planting?
If something like this happened, you could be seriously injured. In this case, it was right to reach an agreement even if it resulted in a loss.
‘With this amount, I can finally buy it at the academy.’
Jaehyun clenched his fists while looking at his bank app.
Before the return, an amount that was not dared to be imagined was stamped.
Balance: 12150000 (points)
A whopping 12.5 million points.
It was an excessive amount for a single freshman to collect.
Jaehyun had never touched this amount of money even though he went to an academy for three years before returning. It broke the previous record in just a few months of the tax return.
‘You’ve collected a lot. Well, it’s because I’ve been collecting points since the first freshman hunt.’
Even at the time of his first admission, Jaehyun set an unmatched record in the freshman hunt and earned huge points.
In addition, the amount collected in small amounts from various other events reached millions.
For reference, Jaehyun had already decided on where to use these points.
‘Although it’s still a bit lacking.’
He grinned at the thought.
Jaehyun stopped walking for a moment and looked back at his colleagues.
“You guys earned pretty good points this time, right? There is one thing I want to do for Circle. Will you invest in me?”
It was an anti-force threat.
* * *
After completing the first request, Nine returned and visited the office of the chairman to report on the mission.
Originally, it would have stopped at the line of passing it on to other instructors. There were several things to check, so Jaehyun contacted Kim Jiyeon separately.
Of course, thanks to my network, I was able to meet her without going through any special procedures.
“…It’s amazing how the mission reward can jump from 1.5 million to 4 million…but something must have happened.
I won’t ask any more about this. Wouldn’t that be better for you too?”
Kim Ji-yeon asked with a smile. Jaehyun nodded.
She was also quick-witted and didn’t bother to check things out.
‘This is why networking is easy.’
Jaehyun realized once again how precious personal connections are. It was the same as not having to be swept away by various cumbersome things.
In any case, the first mission was successfully completed. As for reproduction, the situation is smooth.
But not everything was over.
“Which guild will you be with for your next mission? Is it Yeonhwa?”
Looking at Jaehyun, Jiyeon Kim asked that question.
The next mission is to clear the dungeon with the guild.
Jaehyun, of course, planned to move with Yeonhwa.
“yes. We are all thinking of taking on the next mission together with Yeonhwa. The conversation with Yooseong and the guild master has already been roughly finished.”
“okay. Then you will know that.”
“Oh, and I have one more favor to ask of you.”
At Jaehyun’s story, Kim Jiyeon tilted her head and put her hands together.
‘I don’t think it’s a mission story. What the hell are you asking for?’
After waiting in silence, Jaehyun’s words came back.
“I want to rent a circle insolvent.”
“yes?”
Kim Ji-yeon was always calm, but there was no choice but to be embarrassed.
Want to rent a circle stale?
“……As you know, renting a club insolvency costs a lot of points. It is possible to have at least 20 million.”
“Do not worry.”
“……yes?”
When Kim Ji-yeon asked in a bewildered voice, Jae-hyun laughed.
“I already got them all. 20 million points.”
Jaehyun said and shrugged.
It was. The reason why he has so far been collecting points with little use.
This was to get the circle insolvency.
‘Milles’ circle insolvency can only be rented by a select group of people.’
Although Circle Nine already had a place called Studio Elixir, it was too far away and focused on business.
The need for a space where they can gather, talk and train within the academy was clear.
Jaehyun was also collecting points for this.
On the other hand, most of the expressions of his colleagues who forcibly took away points with his persuasion (?) were not good.
All of them were recalling the conversation they had with Jaehyun earlier.
The first to speak was Kim Yoo-jung.
[So you’re going to rent the insolvent room now? But it won’t cost a penny or two?]
[So I’m borrowing money from you guys.]
[I can invest as much
as I want.] [Me too!]
[…I don’t know what you’re trying to do… Yeah. I will believe I want to help too.]
Ahn Ho-yeon and Lee Jae-sang and Seo In-na quickly agreed and said they would gladly invest.
It was as Jaehyun expected.
[…Isn’t it the worst thing to take away? Ugh. okay. you can give it If you give it to me…]
It was Kwon So-yul who made the most disturbing expression.
However, Jaehyun knew.
That this rental of insolvency will help colleagues grow even faster.
The goal of reproduction was clear.
‘Grow your children up to A-level and S-level as soon as possible.’
Also, the goal was not impossible. Their hard work and passion.
And…
if only there was a little delay.

chapters.title: Chapter 239
chapters.content:
Episode 239. A little bit of a surprise.
A miracle that every radar in the world longs for.
Giyeon (奇緣).
Among the Awakeners, this word refers to the case of obtaining an outstanding artifact or expressing a unique skill and rapidly rising the level.
It doesn’t come easily, but if you’re lucky, you can monopolize a few and grow quickly. That’s exactly what the Awakener was talking about.
The raiders who gained the opportunity reached a level much higher than their original level.
On average, the levels vary but rise by at least two grades.
In a word, it was like a life reversal.
However, this opportunity is given to very few radars.
Raiders who pursue excessive luck are eventually weeded out and die at an unwanted time.
Giyeon is not just Giyeon.
but.
There was a way to force even such an opportunity.
that’s right.
‘If twisted, return.’
It was to see the future.
‘Well, there’s no one other than me who can do that.’
Jaehyun thought with a smile.
The process of obtaining the mentioned opportunity was not a problem for Jaehyun at all.
future knowledge.
If you have this, you can monopolize Giyeon without difficulty.
The rental of this insolvent property was also a cornerstone for acquiring this opportunity.
‘In order to grow my colleagues, the purchase of this insolvency was essential. Of course, it was a bit expensive… but it’s worth the money.
If you know what’s hidden here.’
Jaehyun looked around and nodded.
Unlike him who seemed confident, his colleagues looked worried.
Kwon So-yul frowned and asked.
“As far as getting a bad room, that’s what you’re supposed to do… Why did you choose a place like this? It’s almost like a nuisance.”
All of her colleagues nodded their heads in agreement with her words.
Lee Jae-sang looks around for fear and keeps his ears pricked up like a meerkat. Most of the others had similar reactions.
‘Well, in a way, it’s natural.’
My colleagues had several reasons for this concern.
The biggest problem is where the insolvency will be located.
“I am curious about that too. Is there a reason why you had to get the club near the dangerous area? Wouldn’t that be too dangerous?”
It was Ahn Ho-yeon’s question.
He was concerned that an emergency might happen and his colleagues would get hurt.
The position of the insolvency that Jaehyun had obtained was the worst in terms of safety.
Because it is right next to the border of the closed city of Daegu. It was because, in the unlikely event that a situation arises and the Witchbeast attacks, he could be the first to be in danger.
Of course, Jaehyun did not consider this part either.
After much thought, he decided on the location of the insolvency. It was based on the judgment that the gains outweighed the losses when deciding to come here.
In addition, the grade of the witch beast in the shallows of the closed city was not very high. If it was the level and stats of the current colleagues, it wouldn’t be difficult to run away in the worst situation.
Since we have already taken care of all the parts we are concerned about, there is no need to worry about safety.
However, questions from colleagues still persisted.
“Even if safety is guaranteed, yes. You could just rent out the infirmary used by other seniors… Is there a reason you choose this spot to build a new infirmary?”
It was Kwon So-yul’s question.
As she said, there are still many rooms in the academy that have not been occupied by seniors.
However, Jae-hyun chose to set up a new site and build an infirmary. If Jaehyun has a lot of thoughts, there must be a reason.
Even without saying anything, all my colleagues thought so.
“There is something very helpful here.”
That was the meaning of the giyeon that Jaehyun had been thinking of from the beginning.
The best way to grow your colleagues faster. Because it is here, Jaehyun chose this spot.
‘This is possible. Really S grade kids. No, I can grow beyond that.’
Jaehyun recalled the conversation he had with Jiyeon Kim a moment ago.
She, too, had the same story as her colleagues.
[It’s good to rent an insolvent room, but… this is not a very good location. Do you have any other thoughts?]
[Of course.]
Jaehyun said that, but he didn’t properly explain why to the other colleagues.
As colleagues who do not know all of his thoughts, there is no choice but to worry.
But Jaehyun knew.
After a little time, colleagues will praise themselves.
‘Because the hidden piece hidden in this poor property is indescribably valuable.’
“Anyway, it’s Milles Academy. I rented an insolvent room, so why are you giving me such a large piece of land?”
Kim Yoo-jung stuck out her tongue and looked around.
She had good reason for what she said.
A stale room used by the circle members of Milles Academy.
This was a way of allocating a part of the lot to the circle rather than giving one room.
Simply put, this bad lease means that all of the land in this area is available for use by colleagues.
Jaehyun had a satisfied smile on his face.
“Then, let’s take a good look at the site. Let’s go find the hidden piece hidden down here soon.”
At those words, his colleagues narrowed their eyes in bewilderment.
“Hidden Peace?”
* * *
The central conference room of the National Radar Society was in a commotion for the first time in a while.
A huge rectangular table and chairs lined up on either side of it. Those who sat there were top-notch raiders with a national reputation.
Representatives of major guilds, including Yeonhwa’s Yoo Seongeun.
It was clear why they were there.
An unprecedented incident that has been spreading among guilds in secret lately. That’s what brought them together in one place.
The sound of the conversations of the raiders who sat in the seats died down with the alarm announcing the hour.
At the same time, a man stepped forward.
Song Ji-seok. He was a radar member of the radar management headquarters and the general manager of this work.
He pointed to the whiteboard in front of him and rhymed.
“Thank you very much for all of you gathered here. As you may already know, we have brought all the distinguished guests to this place with the case of attacking the super-large gate.”
“If it’s a super-large gate, are you referring to the official notice sent down the other day? How dangerous was it that you summoned the main guilds together?”
Ahn Ji-seok, the guild master of Haesin, asked with a worried expression.
Since his guild was growing smoothly recently, he had no choice but to talk about it.
You don’t want to get involved in something dangerous like this.
Song Ji-seok nodded. He gestured to a colleague standing next to him.
Then Park Kyung-hoon, who was waiting, passed the scene displayed on the screen to the next.
“As you can see by looking at this, the difficulty of this dungeon is at least S-rank or higher.”
What appeared on the screen was data that analyzed the dungeon’s magic field and displayed the numerical value as a graph.
It contained information about the super-large gate that had recently stirred up the world of radar.
The guild masters who saw this crinkled their foreheads with bewildered expressions.
‘This is nonsense…! It’s an S-class or higher gate?!’
‘If that data is true, this is not a level that one guild can stop…’ ‘
Why did this happen all of a sudden?’
Even the guild masters, there were few who had attacked the S-class gate here.
Excluding Yeonhwa’s Yoo Seongeun, even once or twice is the maximum.
It was natural to be afraid.
“If that’s true, it wouldn’t be a level that a single guild could defend against alone.
There seems to be another reason for calling us here.”
The owner of the voice that followed was Baek Ji-yeon.
As the head of the curator, she recruited other outstanding raiders with astronomical funds after Jaehyun’s recruitment failed. It was through that power that he got to where he is today.
Now, in name and reality, the guild has grown to a level that is among the five fingers of Korea.
Baek Ji-yeon, like a businesswoman, was properly analyzing the current situation.
Song Ji-seok nodded.
“you’re right. Immediately after the super-large gate occurred, there was an emergency call request from the Yeonhwa Guild.”
At Song Ji-seok’s words, the representatives’ eyes focused on Yoo Seong-eun.
Government emergency summons.
This was a system in which major guilds could convene them in one place and grant a request when there was an emergency in the country instead of receiving tax cuts.
Miles’ emergency summons was modeled after this.
Fundamentally, the two could be seen as being together.
“After reviewing the request. The government and the Radar Management Headquarters have determined that countermeasures are needed before the situation becomes unmanageable. Therefore…”
Song Ji-seok continued, scanning the audience slowly.
“Our headquarters is now proposing a guild union for the first time since the existence of the Raider Guild. To block the super-large gate.”
It was a shocking declaration.
Guild Alliance?
Ever since the establishment of the guild and the rise of the profession called radar. Never once has the headquarters made such an offer.
It was a decision that immediately made sense of the seriousness of the gate that had now burst.
A story about uniting guilds that only pursue their own interests into one union. This will draw backlash from many.
In fact, as soon as the story came out, a man stood up and said.
“I’m sorry during the talk. I risked my rudeness to get up from my seat to say a word. First of all, I ask for your understanding.”
At those words, the guild masters expressed displeasure.
What kind of guild do you show such rude behavior because you belong to a guild?
Even the guild masters, who are said to be the best in the country, try to maintain a friendly relationship with the Radar Management Headquarters.
But no matter how much I thought about it, that man’s face was not in their memory.
This idea was not unique to one person. Soon, a muffled, blatant voice filled the venue.
“Where in the world are you such a person who cuts off meetings in the middle of a mess?”
“I will… I don’t think I’ve ever seen your face.”
“Well, it must have come from another source of money. Anyway, at headquarters meetings these days, not-so-stellar guys come in droves.”
But the man wasn’t at all taken aback by this buzz.
He was calm.
“I attended this event as a representative of Jaeshin Lee Raider, Master of the Wind God Guild.”
The moment those words fell, the gaze that had been ignoring him completely disappeared, and embarrassed voices erupted from all over the place.
“Fu Wind God?”
“Huh…… For some reason, Lee Jae-shin said he couldn’t be seen today… Looks like he sent an agent again.”
wind god. Together with Yeonhwa, the Raider Guild is considered one of the best in existence.
Lee Jae-shin was the guild master who led it. Incidentally, he didn’t get along very well with Yeon-hwa, and Lee Jae-shin didn’t enjoy attending public events like this.
Independent, but also unique. An S-class raider who has reached the current position with one skill.
That was Jaeshin Lee.
“Would it be all right if we continued talking?”
the agent asked in a cold voice. Suddenly, the audience goes silent.
The people who had been cursing him a little while ago didn’t even breathe. It was because the status of the wind god was enormous.
“great. Please speak.”
When Song Ji-seok’s permission was granted, the agent said with a calm expression.
“Our wind god guild master said the following.”
he raised his head.
“Our Wind God has no intention of cooperating with any other guild, and the Wind God will block the gate, so don’t think about interfering.”
All the guild masters sitting around his story couldn’t help but frown.
There is a degree to being arrogant.
A super-large gate. This is the worst gate in history, surpassing the S class.
But what?

chapters.content:
Episode 240 Guild Joint Mission (1)
“Hidden Peace?”
Kim Yoo-jung asked with her eyes wide open.
Jaehyun nodded as if he didn’t care.
“that’s right. That’s why we chose this site. There is a hidden piece hidden under this.”
“……To think there’s a hidden piece hidden within the academy. I had no idea.”
Seo Ina also said as if she was surprised by the unfamiliar news.
“If there was such a thing, I would have said it a long time ago… By the way. If there is a hidden piece, you can get it without knowing it yourself. But why are you telling us that?”
Kwon So-yul tilted his head and asked.
but. If it was a normal radar, it was basic to monopolize it if it knew the location of the hidden piece.
It’s an opportunity to become stronger, but I don’t think there’s a need to share it with others.
But why does Jaehyun want to share it?
‘It’s precisely because it can’t be shared or needs to be shared, so it’s like that.’
It was after Jaehyun cleared his throat as he said that.
“The hidden piece hidden here is a ‘dungeon’.”
“……what?”
“……Could you elaborate on what that story is about?”
Kim Yoo-jung and Seo In-na looked at Jae-hyun in surprise at the same time.
It was an absurd story for them.
I was expecting something like an artifact or an elixir because it was Hidden Peace.
what? A dungeon?
“I’m sure you will like it too.”
However, Jaehyun only took the lead with an ambiguous answer.
His colleagues had no choice but to follow him without knowing why.
* * *
The place where the members of Circle Nine, who led the reappearance, arrived was a place full of rubble of collapsed buildings.
A place littered with broken buildings and board signs that have lost their original color due to wear and tear.
This was the place where the Hidden Peace Dungeon was located.
Incidentally, it was also the place where Circle Nine’s new club would move in.
Jaehyun passed by his teammates with puzzled expressions and lightly raised his mana.
sense of power. While activating this, continue to search the surrounding area. Eventually, after a long time, Jaehyun was able to find a trace.
It was a movement of very weak magical power.
Magical power that even the instructors at the academy hadn’t noticed before returning.
‘There is a dungeon down here. must be It’s the dungeon I’ve been looking for.’
Jaehyun carefully got down on one knee and put his hand on the ground beneath him.
then
―Active skill «Earthquake Lv3».
He dug up the ground using his skills.
Koo Goo Goo!
With the activation of the magic, the ground was shredded and the bottom slowly began to be revealed.
A deep landscape seen through cracks in the cracks in the ground.
There was something like a small tunnel there.
“What?!”
“This……!”
Colleagues were perplexed.
Where their eyes were directed, the road to the entrance of the dungeon was spread out. The dungeon that existed from the beginning was revealed, not the hole dug through by the power of reenactment.
There was even a narrow stone staircase there.
Jaehyun nodded and said.
“Here.”
“Nana I’m a bit scared…”
“It’s a little gloomy here. It’s worse than outside.”
The co-workers began to follow Jaehyun down, adding one word at a time.
Woo woo woo woo…….
The message came along with the cry of the creepy beast-type monster. This was to open the ears of his colleagues.
―You have found 《Tutorial Dungeon》!
―When hunting monsters in 《Tutorial Dungeon》, the EXP doubles.
―When hunting monsters in 《Tutorial Dungeon》, the item drop rate increases by 1.5 times.
“……Tutorial dungeon?”
Kim Yoo-jung tilted her head. Jaehyun laughed and nodded.
“okay. What we have here is a special dungeon called the Tutorial Dungeon.
It’s a dungeon that doesn’t trigger a dungeon break even if you don’t clear it, and the monster continues to regenerate.”
At Jaehyun’s words, the group’s expressions hardened.
they finally realized
Why is Jaehyun trying to build a clubhouse in such a shabby place and what was that expression he made a moment ago.
“It’s not very dangerous here, and the potions rot. therefore.”
Jaehyun laughed.
“I need to level up here for a while. We have some time until the next mission.”
The decisive reason why I wanted to get this hidden piece.
It is the growth of colleagues. And it was to acquire his own free distribution stats.
Jaehyun showed his black feelings without hesitation and shoved the backs of his colleagues.
“Now then, go and fight!”
* * *
A few days later. Academy Central Auditorium.
Here, preparations were in full swing for the second mission.
Jaehyun and his colleagues are also standing in the middle. His face was dripping with tiredness from clearing the dungeon for the past few days.
Jaehyun smiled in satisfaction.
‘Because now it only takes two weeks to complete the poor.’
The construction of the bankruptcy was faster than expected.
It is said that in the next two weeks, you will be able to move in directly and the installation of all kinds of amenities will be completed. Now, except for sleeping, I’ll be doing most of my work there.
You will also be able to observe the growth of your colleagues for a longer period of time. That’s not a bad thing.
‘Now put this thought aside for a moment. I have to focus on the next mission.’
Jaehyun thought so and looked around.
His eyes caught the sight of the worried-looking cadets sighing as they expressed their feelings.
“A joint guild mission… I feel like I’ll die if I make a real mistake…”
“When did you see the Milles event safe?”
“Well…”
“But that’s right. This time, it’s a mid-level dungeon raid. Isn’t that too dangerous?”
It’s the first event itself to attack a real dungeon, so they look nervous.
But that, too, was something I had to get used to. Radar is a job to fight demons, and basically you have to feel fear but have the ability to resist it.
……Even so, it didn’t make sense for a cadet to overcome all of those things.
Jaehyun crossed his arms for a moment and recalled the rules for clearing this dungeon.
‘This guild joint mission is simple. Each circle and guild pair up to clear the dungeon together.
Well, basically, the main content is to learn from the sidelines by watching the guild actually clear the dungeon.’
The Milles Academy did not downplay Radar’s real-world experience.
Actual combat is to ensure the survival of the radar.
Jaehyun also thought that this part was not lacking no matter how many times the cadets emphasized it.
“Ah hello. This is Kim Ji-yeon, president of Milles Academy.”
Director Kim Ji-yeon came up to the podium and opened her mouth.
Even at the time of the outdoor training camp, she tended to participate directly whenever there was an event.
“I will finish and begin explaining the second mission.”
After she cleared her throat, the conversation began in earnest.
“From now on, you must perform missions in pairs with your guild during missions.
The process is simple. Each guild will choose an individual or a circle of cadets they like. At this time, the final decision is made whether the cadet will carry out the mission with the guild.”
After Kim Ji-yeon looked around the audience, she said lightly.
“Then, I will introduce the guilds that will carry out joint missions with Miles.”
As the fire on the podium moves to the back, the silhouette hidden in the dark shadow wears a vivid color.
A few familiar faces emerged from the water-soaked shadows.
Masters of various large guilds, including Yeonhwa’s representative Yoo Sung-eun.
They gathered in one place for the Milles event.
“Nice to meet you. This is Yeonhwa’s Yoosungeun.”
“hello. I am Shin Ji-hoon, the master of training.”
“This is Jaeshin Lee. I don’t think there is anyone who doesn’t know our wind god.”
A murmur of voices leaked out from among the cadets as they watched the guild masters handing out short greetings.
Raiders basically had at least one guild they admired.
But they are all gathered in one place.
It is a situation in which they cannot contain their excitement.
Jaehyun had never seen a scene where so many guild masters gathered in one place.
“Then, guild masters, please talk with the cadets for a while and point out the ones you like.”
With those words, Yoo Seong-eun walked towards Jae-hyun.
It was a step that did not feel the weight of someone who had the title of Yeonhwa’s guild master.
“It’s been a while since I’ve seen you in a place with a lot of people like this, right?”
“I see.”
Jaehyun said with a small smile.
Kim Yoo-jung looked at Yoo Seong-eun and her eyes shone.
“Please take good care of me this time too!”
“That is what I am going to say. Yoojung said you improved a lot too? I heard from Jaehyun.”
“Why did he say all that…?”
Kim Yoo-jung looked at Jae-hyun with a confused expression.
Jaehyun avoided his gaze, and Yoo Seongeun smiled and continued.
“This time, all Nine intend to carry out their mission together with Yeonhwa, right?”
“……yes.”
“Sure!”
“It’s an honor.”
“So-so-me too…!”
Colleagues are talking to each other.
Suddenly, a cold voice interrupted from behind.
“no. you don’t You have to come with me.”
In an instant, Lee Jae-sang’s shoulders shrank and his gaze turned to one place.
As if frightened, his trembling eyes went up and Lee Jae-sang’s body stiffened coldly.
A man like a giant tree was standing in the direction from which the voice came.
He was the owner of a familiar face, known to all radars here.
“You are my son. Then, of course, you should go with the wind god. Isn’t it?”
“Aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa”
Jaehyun’s eyebrows narrowed and his eyes turned to the man.
Two chilling eyes and a frighteningly cold tone.
Standing there was Lee Jae-shin, the master of the wind god guild and Lee Jae-sang’s father.
Jaehyun glanced at Lee Jaeshin.
Of course, he knew Lee Jae-shin even before returning.
‘Pungsin. It was by far the best guild among martial arts guilds before returning. He was very strong, but he was famous for his good skills.’
When Yeonhwa fell before the return. Along with Ahn Ji-seok’s Haesin, those who quickly took the top spot were wind gods led by Lee Jae-shin.
‘Anyway, it’s much worse than what I saw on TV.’
Jae-hyun put his hand on Jae-sang Lee’s shoulder, who shrank, and walked past him and stood in front of Jae-shin Lee.
Lee Jae-shin showed interest and started talking.
“You are… Min Jaehyun. They said he was Yoo Seong-eun’s direct follower.”
“yes.”
“Judging by the look on your face, it looks like you have something to say to me.”
“Lee Jae-sang will be carrying out dungeon raids in Yeonhwa with me. Because he’s my son, I’ll take him. I guess that’s a bit difficult.”
When Jaehyun spoke, Lee Jaeshin raised an eyebrow.
“It’s none of your business. Maybe it’s because he’s still a rookie, but he can’t seem to find a place to sit in… Then you’ll regret it.”
with those words.
Kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa!
An enormous amount of magical energy erupted from Lee Jae-shin’s body and began to suppress the surrounding atmosphere.
At the same time, the faces of the cadets around them turned pale.
Jaeshin Lee. It was an unprecedented situation in which the wind god’s guild master opened his magic against a mere cadet. It was something that made even the instructors freeze.
“no. I am the circle leader of Circle Nine. Chancellor hyung is a member of our circle. You have the right to intervene.”
Lee Jae-sang looked at the two from behind with an expression that he did not know what to do.
Yoosung was also looking at the timing. At any time, if Lee Jae-shin did harm to his disciple, he was willing to intervene.
However, Jaehyun didn’t panic and just smiled again.
After Jaehyun caught his breath, he continued to stare at Lee Jaeshin.
“My son is not a tool. And one more thing.”
He waved his hand lightly. Along with him, Lee Jae-shin’s magical power, which had been suppressing the whole area, was scattered everywhere.
“I’m not the kind of person you’d look at lightly.”
Jaehyun smiled.
There was no need to activate an absolute operation. The reason was simple.
It was because Lee Jae-shin in front was an overwhelmingly weaker opponent than himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 241
chapters.content:
Episode 241 Guild Joint Mission (2)
“You want to try it with me?”
Lee Jae-shin looked straight at Jae-hyun and said that.
Contrary to his high-handed tone, he doesn’t look angry at all.
The reason was simple.
Because he was very interested in Jaehyun.
‘He’s an interesting guy.’
Lee Jae-shin sincerely thought so.
Jaehyun in front of him is nothing more than a cadet. Even though he is one of the greatest geniuses, he is a tiger cub who has not fully developed his talents.
However, the talent he showed now was beyond the level of a cadet no matter how you look at it.
‘It’s like a veteran who has lived on the battlefield for more than ten years. From compressing, expressing, and applying magical power. There’s nothing I’m not good at. amazing.’
The operation of the magical power he showed when dispersing his own magical power a while ago. It wasn’t something that could be seen simply because he was a genius.
Jaehyun erased his power by reducing his mana exactly as much as he needed.
This was something that even the most skilled players could not easily learn without rolling on the battlefield for a long time.
at least 10 years.
That was the amount of time Lee Jae-shin thought it would take geniuses to learn such controls.
but.
‘……It can’t be.’
Lee Jae-shin quickly shook his head and shook his thoughts.
The wild boy in front was at most no more than twenty. It doesn’t make sense to spend close to 10 years on the battlefield.
Lee Jae-shin, who had finished organizing, was tinged with a cold sneer.
“I hate braggarts.”
“It’s a coincidence. Neither do I.”
Jaehyun accepted it. One corner of Lee Jae-shin’s mouth went up at an angle.
I could feel the interest I had for a while growing stronger.
‘It’s been a long time since I’ve been treated like this by a young guy.’
He was the wind god guild master.
S-class radar that is said to be within the scope even if it expands its scope to the whole country as well as to the world.
He has the fastest feet in the world, and his quick sword was famous for being able to take down even his feet.
But to maintain such a high-handed attitude toward yourself?
Is that just a freshman?
On the other hand, Jaehyun was equally dumbfounded.
‘Even if I’m an S-class raider, I’ve reached the 2nd level of Divine Liberation. I can deal with this much no matter how many people come in.’
Recently, he successfully achieved the 2nd stage of divine power liberation. It is true that Lee Jae-shin is strong, and it is also true that this was his goal before returning.
But now, Jaehyun has grown too big to target him.
Of course, Lee Jae-shin didn’t seem to think so.
“Courage and bravery are different. I’ll let it go for now, but if you see me again later, you’d better be careful.”
Jae-hyun smiled at Lee Jae-shin’s words and replied.
“Who will be the one to watch out for? Watch and you will find out.”
At that moment, Lee Jae-shin’s eyes narrowed.
When the mana was about to burst out of his body once more.
Yuseong, who was waiting, interrupted and said.
“Do you have any business with my pupil? Lee Jae-shin, guild master?”
“…Looks like you picked up an interesting guy.”
Lee Jae-shin replied, but he did not take his eyes off Jae-hyun.
“But you’d better not be too fussy. This is the only time you will tolerate your disciple’s mistakes.”
“You do whatever you want. However, if there is a threat to my student’s safety, I will.”
Yoosung raised his head.
“I might make a mistake without even realizing it.”
she laughed.
* * *
After a while.
Jaehyun and his colleagues gathered at Yeonhwa Guild’s main building to hear an explanation about the mission.
The conference room was not unfamiliar to me as I had visited it for several events in the past.
They had tea and chatted in front of a huge wooden table.
Yoo Seong-eun started talking in earnest after moderately chatting with her colleagues.
“First of all, thank you for agreeing to be with the Yeonhwa Guild. I will do my best to support you so that you can safely carry out your mission.”
“As expected, the CEO is the best…! From the beginning, I didn’t even think about joining another guild!”
Kim Yoo-jung said with a bright expression. Yoosung replied with a smile.
“thank you.”
“By the way… what is the content of the mission we’re about to undertake? It’s not too dangerous, right?”
Yoo Seong-eun nodded at Kwon So-yul’s mumbling question and opened her mouth again.
“Your mission this time is to subdue the C-class dungeon managed by the Yeonhwa Guild.”
“A C-class dungeon?”
“okay. Even so, it won’t be easy because it’s a place where water-type monsters appear.
But don’t worry too much. It won’t be as dangerous as Yeonhwa’s radars are with her.”
It was as she said.
Even if the grade was low, there were many dungeons with a higher difficulty level.
For example, this was the case with the dungeons where the dead of Helheim were the main ones, or the dungeons where the water attribute demons mentioned just now appeared.
‘Basically, the appearance of a water attribute monster means that there is something to fight in a place like the sea or a lake. It’s kind of tricky without the relevant skills.’
Yeonhwa probably designated a dungeon like this to develop her ability to deal with special situations like this.
Thoughtful Yuseong was a down choice.
“That would be good training.”
It was when Jaehyun muttered that.
“No, Jaehyun, you will not participate in this mission.”
“……yes?”
“You have to clear another dungeon with me. …… Of course, if you let me.”
Yoo Seong-eun’s expression, saying that, was calmer than ever.
For some reason, Jaehyun felt an uneasy feeling rising from the depths of his heart.
‘Something doesn’t feel right.’
I guess it was written in my mouth.
Jaehyun instinctively felt that something was happening.
* * *
After all the conversations related to the mission were over, Jae-hyun remained in Yeon-hwa’s conference room.
It was because of Yoo Seong-eun’s request.
After waiting for a while, Yoo Seong-eun, who saw off the party from outside, entered the conference room.
“Sorry for taking up your time. But it was a request I had to make.”
“Teacher asked me. It’s rare.”
After saying that, Jaehyun put his hands together.
“Is it serious?”
The words had many meanings.
“Yes,” she replied, and started talking again.
“It’s a serious problem. No, it would be more accurate to say that something close to a natural disaster is happening that has never happened before.”
“natural disaster?”
“okay. You may have heard of it too. The average rating of gates has been rising lately, and that’s why the raiders are having trouble.”
Jaehyun nodded.
It was certainly news that I had heard often recently.
Didn’t there be news related to this on TV even when I was eating at a meat restaurant after going through the first three ordeals?
Colleagues also said it’s been a while since this happened.
Something that was not taken seriously at the time. However, Yoo Seong-eun’s attitude was not that of someone who spoke lightly.
“Super-sized gates that exceed the S-class have appeared in Korea.”
Yoo Seong-eun chewed her lips and took off her luck.
“Extra-large gate. We need your help to stop it.
could you help me?”
Jaehyun’s expression hardened for a moment.
‘Before the return, I’ve never heard of an S-class or higher gate appearing.’
As I thought about it, I felt a tingling sensation run up my spine.
heterogeneous
This was the feeling he had been feeling since returning, but now it was several times worse.
Jaehyun was convinced.
This super-large gate and dungeons appearing all over the world.
This is no coincidence.
Aesir they are moving.
* * *
A corner of Odin’s palace in Asgard.
A woman is walking down a long, dark, endless corridor.
again and again.
Every time you walk, the oiled armor bumps and makes a noise.
The identity of the person walking down the corridor is Sigrun.
He was one of the captains of the Valkyrie army.
pop.
At some point, her footsteps completely stopped, and her tightly closed lips opened.
“What’s going on? Hugin.”
The direction the voice was heading was clear.
Beyond the pitch-black darkness.
Sigrun had been aware for a long time that there was an entity contemplating him there.
“As expected, you are Sigrun-nim. You immediately noticed that I was following you.”
Along with him, a man’s voice sounded like noise. Before long, the owner of the voice started slowly walking towards her from the other side of the hallway.
Hugin. One of Odin’s ravens found Sigrun.
He rhymed in a calm voice.
“I have a suggestion for you.”
“A suggestion?”
“I understand that you have received a mission from Freya. He said to deal with the enemies of the prophecy.”
“okay. But it must have nothing to do with you.”
Sigrun said with a blatant displeasure.
It is certainly true that Freya had asked herself such a favor not too long ago.
Destroy the opponents of the prophecy.
However, this is Freya. Even more comforting was an order given to her by Odin himself.
It means that there is no room for Hugin, who is just a crow, to intervene.
‘Why is he bringing out these words to me?’
As Sigrun was about to ask, Hugin’s voice continued.
“you’re right. It has nothing to do with me. But we can help.”
“help?”
“That’s right. With your permission, I will help Sigrun.
It will take time to prepare an army to attack him anyway… Wouldn’t it be better to weaken their forces in the meantime?”
“……That certainly isn’t bad.”
For Sigrun, it was a very tempting proposal.
antagonist of prophecy. We don’t know how strong he is, but looking at what Heimdall has been through recently, it won’t be an easy enemy.
Sigrun did not want to lose his men to a useless battle.
“Do you have any specific plans?”
So Sigrun had no choice but to ask.
Along with her answer, Hugin replied in a calm voice.
“yes. All preparations have already been completed.”
Sigrun’s eyes narrowed as if he had noticed something from Hugin’s words.
“…I was wondering why Midgard is so noisy. Was it your fault that caused super-large gates to appear all over the world?”
Hugin just raised the corner of his mouth in silence at her question.
A moment of silence lingered between the two as they exchanged glances.
Hugin knew from the beginning. That she couldn’t refuse his offer.
Sigrun was also gradually moved by his proposal.
Even if Hugin’s plan fails, he is not at any disadvantage.
Just use each other as needed and throw it away when its value is gone.
That was the relationship between the two beings.
“good. If you can, where do you go? I will leave the adversary to you for a while.”
After saying that, Sigrun walked down the hallway and left his seat.
after a few minutes like that. Left alone, Hugin looked down at his trembling hands and thought.
‘Min Jaehyun. The antagonist of the prophecy.’
He thought with a cold expression on his face.
‘I have to deal with him quickly.’
He wanted to get rid of the enemies of the prophecy as soon as possible.
Because he was an obstacle to his grand plan.
Hougin murmured as he recalled the last time he saw Jaehyun’s face.
“Soon the second apocalypse begins. Adversary, can you really protect your precious things?”

chapters.title: Chapter 242
chapters.content:
Episode 242 Guild Joint Mission (3)
“A super-large gate. We need your help to stop it.
could you help me?”
“I will help as far as I can.”
Jaehyun said and shrugged his shoulders. A bright smile spread across Yoo Seong-eun’s face.
As expected of his disciple, Jaehyun gave her the best answer she could think of. It was something she couldn’t help but be happy about.
However, there was no time to rejoice.
Yoosung knew it well. Now we have to get to the main point.
‘I do not have time. If we can’t block the super-large gate, Korea will once again become a sea of fire.’
Seongeun Yoo clearly remembered the tragedy in Korea that occurred in her childhood.
The people of the closed city who were perishing in the red flames.
From the blood sparsely rising through the black smoke, to the maddened gaze that shines through the beast’s eyes.
Everything she saw then was still clear in her mind.
‘I have to stop it somehow.’
We will never let the tragedy repeat itself.
Also, Jaehyun and his thoughts coincide with each other. I didn’t doubt it.
* * *
The meeting room has an overall calm atmosphere.
A man was sitting in the middle of the empty space.
Jaeshin Lee. He was the wind god’s guild master and the fastest raider in the world.
“I have conveyed what you said at the union meeting.”
“Good job.”
The person reporting to Lee Jae-shin is Chu Gye-yeol.
He was one of the managers of Poongshin and participated as Lee Jaeshin’s agent in the recent guild convocation at the Raider Headquarters.
The existence that served Lee Jae-shin in the closest place and became his limbs.
Choo Gye-yeol pondered over Lee Jae-shin’s dry answer for a while before opening his mouth again.
“Are you really okay?”
“What are you talking about?”
“Don’t you know that this gate cannot be blocked easily, even by the wind god? Moreover, the relationship with Yeonhwa has grown further.
It may have been a judgment that had nothing to gain on our side.”
“Getting along with your competitors is a weak piece of trash. Yeon-hwa is something we have to overcome, not someone to cooperate with.”
“Is that why you decided not to join the coalition? To push Yeon-hwa away?”
At Chu Gye-yeol’s question, Lee Jae-shin closed and opened his eyes for a moment, clearing his mind.
Chu Gye-yeol was well aware that this was Lee Jae-shin’s habit whenever he had a lot of troubles.
It was after Jaeshin Lee cleared his throat.
“okay. It’s true that it’s dangerous, but if our wind god succeeds in attacking the super-large gate… this time, we might be able to overcome Yeonhwa’s stronghold.”
Chu Gye-yeol could only nod his head at those words.
‘The guild master has been working hard to beat Yoo Sung-eun and Yeon-hwa. He must have thought that this was his last chance to challenge himself.’
Yoo Eun-eun and Yeon-hwa.
This was a name that always made Lee Jae-shin, who was a single-minded general, small.
In the national guild rankings, Lee Jae-shin is in second place in his ten thousand years. It was an unlucky radar hidden in the shadow of Yoo Sung-eun, who always ranked first.
Of course, Lee Jae-shin was not pushed behind by Yoo Seong-eun in terms of power.
The two are fundamentally divided into combat and non-combat types, and Yoo Sung-eun is a healer, so she was relatively weaker than him.
However, Yoo Seong-eun had people’s firm trust and faith.
She is a raider who has saved countless people from the time the gate first exploded until now, earning the name of a saint and becoming a mythical being.
On the other hand, Lee Jae-shin was a case of reaching the current position based on overwhelming inaction.
You could tell which one was more respected without asking.
Jaeshin Lee.
he was strong It was a raider with excellent skills, but he never surpassed her.
There was no guarantee that we would be able to do so in the future.
However, he didn’t give up.
Lee Jae-shin aspired to surpass Yeon-hwa and gradually increased the size of the guild.
he waited
May you have a chance to surpass them.
And now he was thinking that the opportunity had come.
Chu Gye-yeol could not go against his opinion.
Of course, Lee Jae-shin’s judgment now was not rational no matter how he thought about it.
However, Chu Gye-yeol knew best how long he had longed for the current situation.
Exactly 10 years ago, from the time when the Demon Beast was rampant, he assisted Lee Jae-shin by his side.
He knew what he was feeling and what his aspirations were.
In the end, Chu Gye-yeol agreed and said.
“……All right. Are you planning to raid the dungeon with your sons again this time?”
The intention of Chu’s question was clear.
Sons of Lee Jae-shin. He had as many as three sons. Among them, the first and second resembled themselves and became excellent radars.
Even though he had just passed the age of majority, his sons’ talents were at a level that was not at all inferior to his own.
Thanks to this, Jaeshin Lee often took them to raid dungeons.
After that, he needed to build up the achievements of his sons now to eliminate the noise when he inherited the guild after retiring.
However, in the case of the youngest, the story was a little different.
“Tell the first and the second to come to the office right now. I will speak directly.”
“All right.”
Chu Gye-yeol bowed lightly and called Lee Jae-shin’s two sons to carry out his instructions.
10 minutes after that.
At the sound of a knock, two men with youthful faces walked into the conference room.
“Did you call?”
The first to speak was Lee Jae-shin’s first son, Lee Jae-hun.
Lee Jae-shin started talking in earnest with an expressionless face.
“okay. You may have already heard about it, but the two of you went together to clear the super-large gate.
You will participate as the wind god’s representative radar, so prepare properly without making any mistakes.”
Hearing those words, Lee Jae-hoon’s face showed a slight excitement.
Lee Jae-hoon usually enjoyed the attention of others. That he is given the right to capture the largest gate?
‘Anyway, as long as the wind blows, I won’t die. If I make good use of this opportunity, I will be able to spread my name throughout the country and even the world.’
Lee Jae-hoon raised his lips at the sweet thought.
At that time, Lee Jae-young, who was listening to the conversation between my father and older brother, cautiously intervened.
“…That father. Didn’t you say you’re taking the youngest one with you for this raid? I heard that you went to Miles this time.”
Lee Jae-shin’s gaze turned to Lee Jae-young.
Lee Jae-young realized the interest in that gaze at once. At the same time, the thoughts that came to mind were curious.
Have you ever had that look on your face when your father brought up the story of the youngest child?
Jaeshin Lee replied.
“It was. But my mind has changed.”
“yes?”
Jaeyoung Lee asked in a puzzled voice. Lee Jae-hoon nodded his head beside him as if it were natural.
Lee Jae-shin raised one corner of his mouth and continued.
“Did you say Nine… The circle that ugly guy crawled into? That circle leader stood in my way.”
“If it’s Nine…you’re talking about that freshman circle that often appears in the news lately.”
Lee Jae-young agreed and accepted.
“Well, the media is talking about him, but he isn’t that great. Whatever it is, in front of our Wind God…”
“No. He’s not an easy guy to look at.”
Lee Jae-young suddenly interrupted Lee Jae-young and said.
Both brothers looked at their father with puzzled expressions at the same time.
It was a shocking story. This is because it is very rare for Lee Jae-shin, who is normally picky, to acknowledge someone.
Despite his son’s surprised expression, Lee Jae-shin was not shaken at all.
“Behave well so that you do not have any problems. This Red Gate attack is one of the few opportunities to push Yeonhwa out and engrave our name on the highest level of our Wind God.”
“yes.”
“I will keep that in mind. father.”
The two brothers looked at each other for a while, receiving their father’s words.
Almost at the same time, the corners of their mouths rose. Fortunately, Lee Jae-shin did not notice that the two had disturbing thoughts.
* * *
“There are two main features of the gate.
The first is that a new structured magic power with a dark red color was discovered outside the super-large gate.
Researchers have been investigating for several days, but they have not yet identified a clear cause.”
“Dark red magic?”
“okay. It was several times more condensed magic than what normal raiders use. I didn’t compare properly because I didn’t have time… but it seemed to have at least five times the condensation.”
Yoo Seong-eun handed over the file book and gestured lightly.
Jaehyun carefully accepted it.
Attached to the file are several photos of the incident. All of them were taken outside the gate.
Just as she had said, dark red magic power was swirling there.
‘The color of magic that originally exists in the natural world is blue. There are cases where their own personality is added and their properties change, but there is no magical power that is red from the start.’
Gate was the same.
By default, the color of the gate was blue, with no exceptions.
But what Jaehyun is looking at right now.
This was clearly a red gate.
Yooseong was pointing to the gate in this photo.
“We’ve decided to temporarily call it the ‘Red Gate’ before the details of this gate’s research are revealed.”
“Red Gate.”
Jaehyun had never heard of the Red Gate anywhere.
He knew everything about the future from now to the point where 10 years had passed, but he knew nothing about it.
‘Of course, it might not have been revealed because it was being investigated in top secrecy, but…’
The conclusion was that the probability of that was slim.
When Jaehyun thought about it, there was a high possibility that this incident happened because of his own variable.
It’s not clear who is behind it, but it’s probably Asgard.
Jaehyun calmed himself down and looked up.
“What is the second feature?”
“There are too many monsters using powerful magic inside the dungeon.
The magic grade used is at least A grade or higher. No matter how fluent in magic, even if you take raiders with you, it’s a level that’s hard to handle.”
“The ones who use high-level magic?”
Jaehyun nodded his head as he spoke.
It was only then that he seemed to know why Yoo Seong-eun asked him to clear the dungeon.
Knowing that Jaehyun realized what he was thinking, Yoosung smiled.
“As you think. The reason I asked you to help me clear the dungeon is simple. It’s because of the ‘magic that can nullify magic’ you possess.”
‘also.’
Jaehyun sighed and smiled.
Magic that can nullify magic. As far as Jaehyun knew, it was the only one.
absolute operation.
For reference, this skill has grown even more in recent sparring with Nidhogg.
It seemed that Yoo Seong-eun was planning to drastically lower the difficulty of the dungeon by using it to destroy the enemy’s magic.
Even if it’s an enemy who uses magic, there’s no reason to be afraid if you destroy all of them in the end.
“All right.”
Anyway, Jaehyun also had a chimney-like desire to utilize the newly strengthened absolute arithmetic.
Just because you can’t use it carelessly. I just didn’t reveal it because I didn’t have a chance to show it yet.
However, the story is different now.
With Yoo Sung-eun, confidentiality would be guaranteed, and it would not be a problem to reveal one’s skills to some extent.
* * *
Meanwhile, the two brothers who came out of Lee Jae-shin’s office are talking arm in arm.
“Brother, so that guy. Are you going to leave it alone?”
“Min Jae-hyun… Are you talking about the leader of Nine’s circle?”
“huh.”
The reason the two were having this conversation was clear.
It was because he had heard that his father showed an arrogant attitude towards his father when he visited Miles not long ago on a joint guild mission.
Father to two brothers. In other words, the name of Jaeshin Lee, the guild master of Wind God, was lofty.
A being worthy of respect!
That was a person named Lee Jae-shin, and that was their background.
however. Did a freshman dare to challenge his father?
It was, of course, unacceptable to them.
Lee Jae-hoon put his hand on his brother’s shoulder with a fishy smile on his lips.
“You can’t let go. Get ready now. Jaehyun Min. I have to go see his face.”

chapters.title: Chapter 243
chapters.content:
Episode 243
Milles Academy’s cadet dormitory with Lee Jae-sang’s guild joint mission just a few days away.
Lee Jae-sang was suffering from a terrible nightmare.
“Heh heh heh heh…”
He sighed heavily, sat down on the bed, and trembled.
It was because the shock from the dream from a while ago still lingered.
My whole body was wet, and my mind was dizzy, probably because it couldn’t stand the shock. Jaesang Lee looked at his body with empty eyes while holding on to his heart.
“Again… it’s the same dream…”
A weak muttering voice fills the room.
The contents of Jaesang Lee’s nightmares were always the same as in the past.
Lee Jae-yi, his father, appears and engages in sparring with himself. He coldly says to himself who has become covered in dirt:
[Grab the sword.]
Grab the sword.
That sentence stimulated Lee Jae-sang’s trauma and plunged him into a deep pit.
Words I’ve already heard.
It was also a word that eventually revealed Lee Jae-sang’s weakness.
Fragments of the past came to Lee Jae-sang’s mind. When he was much younger than he is now, his father, Lee Jae-shin, made demands on himself.
Become a strong radar.
Like himself and like Lee Jae-sang’s brothers.
But Lee Jae-sang had no talent.
In the sparring with his father, which he had every day as a child, he did not always show what he expected. Every time he gripped the sword, his father was disappointed in himself and he was gradually broken.
At the age of 10, he first entered Dalian. Jaeshin Lee told him.
[You are my blood, so you must have great talent.]
However, it didn’t take long for his expectations to be met with disappointment.
Lee Jae-sang did not have even the slightest bit of sword talent.
Even unique skills were not inherited.
From then on, Lee Jae-shin no longer expected him.
Instead, she just ignores him, calling him trash for failing to meet her expectations.
His father’s cold attitude towards Lee Jae-sang, whose mother passed away, made him hide in a rat hole.
It was from then. What made Lee Jae-sang stutter?
Of course, the more he did, the more his father’s eyes grew colder.
After that, I had very little contact with my father.
It was difficult to expect anything from his father when he was barely paying for his school fees. All of my siblings grew up to be the hopefuls of Poongshin, but he wasn’t.
There was no fatherly favor or love.
All that was left of him were tools and a small laboratory that smelled of drugs.
Lee Jae-sang further built a wall in his heart and hid in the gap.
So that no one can find you anymore.
* * *
The next day, after class at the academy, Jaehyun was blocked by two men seeing Jaehyun for the first time.
He looked ahead and tilted his head. They were the first faces I ever saw.
“Who are you?”
At Jaehyun’s question, the two men wrinkled their faces and said in displeasure.
“I am Lee Jae-hoon, the Class A Raider of Wind God.”
“I am Lee Jae-young of the same rank.”
Jaehyun looked back at his memory for a moment. Lee Jae-hoon and Lee Jae-young……
I think I’ve heard of it somewhere, but my memory wasn’t clear.
Fortunately, the other side revealed his identity first.
“We are the sons of Jaeshin Lee’s guild master. Lee Jae-sang’s older brother.”
‘Somehow, I thought that two raiders from the Wind God Guild had come to visit me. Was the chancellor his brother’s brother?’
Then I remembered.
Jaehoon Lee and Jaeyoung Lee. They were Lee Jae-sang’s older brothers with a 3-year-old and 2-year-old gap.
People who will often show their faces in the radar newspaper in the future with their tyrannical temper.
‘It doesn’t seem like it came for good.’
The two of them seemed to be messing with each other. I’m not here to tell you something positive.
Jaehyun thought so and asked in a calm voice.
“Why did the Prime Minister’s older brothers come to see me?”
“You didn’t think you would dare to go against my father and go over without retaliation, did you?”
“What is that all of a sudden… Ah. at that time.”
Jaehyun sighed briefly recalling the past.
Jaeshin Lee. It was certainly true that there had been a war of nerves with him a few days ago. He opened the magic and he erased it, maybe.
Apparently, they found themselves because they didn’t know that their great father and a mere cadet were having a war of nerves.
‘what the.’
It was absurd for Jaehyun, but it seemed that there was no more important problem for the two of them.
They surrounded Jaehyun and continued talking.
“It seems that he is a direct disciple of Yoo Sung-eun, but
he has become more energetic…” “I have never been more energetic. I don’t think there’s any reason to talk like this. If you came here to get into trouble, go. Before you look bad.”
Jaehyun sighed and said. As he waved his hands and spoke, the faces of the two crumpled up.
Eventually, the moment Jaehyun turned away.
Unforgettable stories flowed from their mouths.
“I hear you’re taking care of my trashy little brother.”
Startle.
Jaehyun’s steps stopped for a moment at the harsh words. The two seemed excited as if they thought their provocation had worked.
“I thought I was useless, but I was lucky. I mean, you have a talent for alchemy. Well, you might have approached him to take advantage of him from the beginning, but…”
“I don’t think the relationship between the brothers is good. So what do you want to say?”
When Jaehyun opened his mouth and said that, the brothers looked at each other for a moment and were taken aback.
Lee Jae-young suddenly came to his senses.
“Did you approach Lee Jae-sang to use the wind god from the beginning? I heard that you supported Lee Jae-sang from the time he had no foundation.
It wouldn’t be possible if you weren’t thinking of messing around with something.”
“under.”
It seemed that the brothers had already investigated Jae-hyun and Lee Jae-sang’s first meeting and everything that had happened since then.
Jaehyun clearly understood.
Lee Jae-sang and his two brothers are by no means family.
The fact that they are more distant than others and that they do not respect Lee at all.
Jaehyun faced the two of them straight with a crumpled face.
He took a step forward and lightly released his mana.
The two brothers also responded, released their magical powers, and shouted.
“How dare you act like that when you hear whose son we are. Didn’t you just call garbage garbage?”
“There’s nothing to be so hot about. is not it?”
“No, I have enough reasons to be angry. Chancellor hyung is your family, but he is also an important circle member of Nine. If you say it that way…”
Jaehyun chuckled.
“My circle looks out of place.”
Dig!
At that moment, Jaehyun’s new model disappeared and caught the two behind them.
at the same time. Jaehyun grabbed both of them by the nape of their necks and forced them to rub their foreheads against each other.
With a bang, the heads of the two brothers collide and their minds wander.
spinning head. In the midst of the mess, the two seemed not even aware of what had happened.
“I will tell you one thing for sure.”
Jaehyun raised an eyebrow and raised his fist again.
I tried to treat him as a colleague’s older brother, but I decided that I couldn’t.
“I’m not scared at all even if you bring your father.”
“Kheop!”
“Ouch!”
Lee Jae-hoon and Lee Jae-young were frightened and saw Jae-hyun standing behind them.
It seems that I did not choose the right opponent to touch.
The two thought about it almost at the same time.
* * *
After sending the two brothers back to Tyler, Jaehyun thought for a while.
‘I never thought I’d find out why the prime minister stuttered like this.’
Just a moment ago, while he was beating up the two brothers, I asked him about this and that.
they said It wasn’t that Lee Jae-sang had stuttered from the beginning.
Lamentation and burden for oneself without talent. And Lee Jae-shin’s pressure.
that it broke him
When Jae-hyeon learned the whole story that he had never known, he felt more and more sorry for Lee Jae-sang.
He himself had been gripped by an inferiority complex.
I longed for the best raiders, but I was pessimistic about myself for not being able to become like them.
Eventually, it gradually eats away at people and destroys them.
“The Prime Minister must have felt the same way.”
Jae-hyeon wanted to somehow return Lee Jae-sang to his original form.
Even if he had never seen him before, Jaehyun could recall some of him.
Like how innocent he was when he explained alchemy, or how he packed up potions for himself every moment.
Jae-hyun remembered Lee Jae-sang like that. That’s why I wanted to help him.
‘But it’s not a matter of what I can do. The chancellor should stand up on his own.’
Unfortunately, Jaehyun knew. In the current situation, the part that he could help him was extremely limited.
If you don’t get up on your own, you’ll collapse again soon.
Humans are inherently that way.
However, Jae-hyun believed in Jae-sang Lee. he will be able to rise again
He has the strength to step out of his father’s shadow and move forward.
That was the conclusion that Jae-hyeon had made while going through Jae-sang Lee, and it was not dependent on his memories before returning.
…although I did take a little reference to it.
* * *
Hideout where Jaehyun and Lee Jaesang are missing. Nine members are gathering and having a conversation.
Naturally, the subject was the father-son relationship between Lee Jae-sang and Lee Jae-shin.
“I didn’t even think of it. To think that Lee Jae-sang’s father was Lee Jae-sin of the wind god…….”
Kwon So-yul shook his head and said so.
Well, since Lee Jae-sang never revealed anything about his father, it was only natural that he didn’t know.
Kim Yoo-jung nodded.
“Iknow, right. Looking at it, it seems that Min Jae-hyun knew. How can you not say a word?”
“Well, Jaehyun must have thought of everything.”
