A muffled voice is heard. Jaehyun nodded lightly.
“There is a lot of controversy about me. I know. But one thing I can tell you for sure. I am not your enemy. I may not be a good person, but I want to make it clear that I am not a bad person either.”
Startle.
At Jaehyun’s declaration, the gathered raiders swallowed saliva and shook their hands. When they first heard that Jaehyun was a black robe, they couldn’t believe him completely.
But not now. They are also the heads of guilds that are said to be the best in Korea.
Will there ever be a cadet who can accurately convey his intentions without trembling?
In addition, Yoo Sung-eun and Lee Jae-shin and Song Ji-seok did not say anything.
It meant that there were no lies in the words of Ahn Ji-seok and Shin Ji-hoon.
“I think you have a lot of questions. Why did I dig the great ruins and subdue Yamata no Orochi? But there is only one answer I can give you.”
Jaehyun said with a serious expression.
“A greater threat looms. A huge war cloud is coming that cannot be stopped by tearing the guild into pieces.”
“What do you mean?! There’s no way something worse than the Red Gate is coming…!”
“Maybe.”
“I lost my one and only brother to this gate! What on earth… do you know anything about the Red Gate incident?”
“I know. But I won’t tell you.”
Jaehyun clearly conveyed his intentions.
Know. There was no need to lie here.
Fortunately, no one here asked Jaehyun anything.
If Jaehyun in front of you is the one who killed that Red Gate alone.
If it looked wrong, everyone could be annihilated.
It was a good situation to refrain from rash words and actions.
“Then why did you arrange this place? Isn’t that why they gathered it for some reason?”
Lee Dong-kyung looked at him and asked, and Jae-hyun nodded.
“Everyone join the guild union. It is a matter directly related to your life. All guilds must unite and fight against it.
In fact, it is a fight that cannot be said to have a chance of winning.”
“Does that mean that the enemy that approaches that much is strong?”
“yes. And if I have one more request, I would like you not to fully disclose my identity to other countries yet.”
At Jaehyun’s words, the entire guild nodded.
However, there was no one who objected to the former story.
“We form a guild alliance to fight against an unknown enemy… Ha, that sounds like a good story on the surface. I was almost fooled!”
The fiery Raider who was sitting next to Lee Dong-kyung. he was shouting
“In the end, if the union is formed like that, isn’t it that the state will take over all guild management! If you do that, the small guild will starve to death!”
“That’s right! It’s going to be hard to cover the astronomical amount you have to go through with your radar insurance!”
Others also voice their voices.
In fact, they had good reasons for saying that.
radar. They basically have a low survival rate and are rarely accepted by insurance companies because of the risk.
Therefore, if any casualties or disabilities occur, the guild must pay for all these costs.
If you don’t have the confidence to make more money than that by raiding dungeons, in fact, you have to somehow stabilize the profit structure through operation.
But a large guild and the state will control it?
It was a proposal that could not be readily accepted in a free economic system.
“It would be better than dying under any circumstances.”
Jaehyun’s words shorten, and a sense of incongruity begins to spread throughout the bodies of those sitting around.
I didn’t want to go this far, but I couldn’t help it.
Here you have to show your strength and win the guild’s persuasion.
It was the moment I thought so.
drooling.
“I can’t hear you. Our wind gods will participate in the alliance. And I will not accept any profits from the alliance. It doesn’t matter how you use it.”
“That word…!”
“Father but!”
Lee Jae-shin’s two sons also protested, but kept their mouths shut at the pressure of his two downcast eyes.
“Don’t make me say it twice.”
After saying that, Lee Jae-shin looked at Jae-hyun.
‘okay. This is my return to the person who made me overcome my twist. Although it may be a bit clunky, it’s probably the surest way.’
“If even the god of wind says so… we will participate.”
“We also…”
“We also participate. I don’t want everyone to die.”
“Of course, Yeonhwa participates in the alliance. In addition, we will also share all profits generated from alliance activities with the middle and lower guilds.”
Song Ji-seok was surprised by Lee Jae-shin and Yoo Sung-eun’s judgment.
They were two people who were considered polar opposites. They all came together.
I couldn’t find a radar that only pursued its own interests there.
* * *
After Jaehyun left.
One by one, people were leaving Kim Yoo-jung’s noisy hospital room.
Those who now have to go back and prepare for a new daily life. In the evening, Jaehyun said he would come back to check on me, but as a result, I had to be alone for a while.
Her parents left for another country to take care of work again, worrying until the end.
Now all that is left is Seoina Hana. She was slowly getting up from her seat.
“…Still, I’m so glad it’s like this. Take good care of this and that so that you get well soon. I’ll go too.”
“Yeah… thank you.”
After receiving the greeting, Kim Yoo-jung put her hands on her hands with empty eyes for a while.
Her beautiful hands overlap on the white blanket in the hospital.
Dreuk.
Then, the moment the door opened, Kim Yoo-jung suddenly opened her mouth to Seo In-na.
“Inaya.”
“…huh? Do you need anything?”
“I have something to tell you.”
Seo Eana looked at Kim Yoo-jung, who said that. Her eyes were as hard as ever and seemed to be burning with fire.
While I was thinking, Kim Yoo-jung’s words continued.
“It’s about Min Jae-hyun.”
At those words, Seo Ina’s pupils narrowed.

chapters.title: Chapter 261
chapters.content:
Episode 261 Freesia (2)
After the Red Gate Incident is all over.
Jaehyun also returns to the hotel and rests his tired body, lost in thought.
What happened at the time of the gate capture and the magic of the beginning. Hugin’s story. There were still a lot of unresolved stories.
“Are you concerned? Because you couldn’t kill Hugin?”
Hella came to Jaehyun’s side and sat down on the bed.
Jaehyun shook his head.
“no. Rather… I was thinking about what I should do next.”
he smiled faintly
“Because there is too much to do now to regret.”
After saying that, Jaehyun opened the status window.
The description of the newly upgraded armor of the abyss came to mind with a refreshing sound.
It was to confirm that the grade had been upgraded while catching Eorduksini.
―Displays the status of 《Abyssal Armor+》.
[Equipment Item]
Name: Armor of Abyss+
Rank:
Armor said to have been made from the abyss of Myth Kinnungagap.
The shards of Eoduksini imbued with the primordial mana permeated and further strengthened it.
Effect
1. Physical / magic defense +750
2. Acquire the active skill 《Stealth Lv 5》.
3. The level of the passive skill 《Shadow Fairy Tale》 rises to the highest level.
Others were within predictable ranges.
But what?
A skill level increase?
Jaehyun immediately brought up the skill window and checked the information.
[Active Skill]
Name: Stealth (Lv 5)
Grade: B
Stats: –
Completely hides from the enemy’s sight for 1 hour.
Cooldown: 30 minutes
*However, if an enemy uses the 《Detection》 skill, the duration of the skill is reduced to 15 minutes.
First of all, the efficiency of stealth has increased significantly.
It is true that it has become stronger and less frequently used recently, but being able to hide one’s presence for an hour is a great advantage.
Even at the time of the Red Gate attack, Jaehyun used stealth to run before his last appearance.
One really big change was the next skill.
[Passive skill]
Name: Shadow assimilation
Rating: S
Creates layered afterimages by assimilating the shadow and the user.
Drains the enemy’s attack with a certain probability.
1. Drains the enemy’s attack with a 10% chance.
2. You can avoid the attack of a designated target once without taking any damage.
*However, the effect of the skill does not apply to light attribute attacks.
It was truly an astonishing development.
First of all, it was the fact that the probability of activating Shadow Fairy Tale increased. It has risen exponentially from 2 percent to as much as 10 percent.
In fact, shadow assimilation was a fairly useful skill before, but it was not a skill to be expected in a decisive situation.
It was too risky to gamble with the 2% chance.
But now, his skills have been strengthened to the point where he can even consider the last bastion in a dangerous situation.
In addition, you can evade an attack only once for a designated target.
There was nothing more to say about this part.
Being able to dodge any enemy attack just once could completely change the direction of future battles.
However, there was still one thing that Jaehyun had to check.
“The last one is, after all, this.”
Muttering that, Jaehyun took out a mysterious stone from his inventory and held it in his hand.
[Special Item]
Name: Beginning Awakening Stone
Rating: ???
An Awakening Stone imbued with the primordial magical power. When used, you can acquire a large amount of divinity and magic.
The Awakening Stone of the Beginning.
This was the last item obtained after the capture of Red Gate.
Seeing this artifact for the first time, Hella took a backward step as if it were a flagship.
[How the hell did such a precious thing come to be in a place like this!?]
Upon hearing the story, it seemed that this primordial Awakening Stone was a top-notch artifact that rapidly increased the user’s magical power and divinity.
An object that never existed in the human world and is found in only three of the nine worlds.
“Anyway, Hugin seems to have used this to explode the Red Gate.”
Hella looked at Jaehyun, who was lost in thought, and added that explanation.
Jaehyun nodded.
“No matter what it is, if it can grow… you have to use it all.”
Jaehyun smiled and injected magic into the primordial Awakening Stone.
―Use the Artifact 《The Beginning Awakening Stone》.
―The user’s divinity and magical power increase rapidly!
―The 3rd stage of Godhead Liberation is imminent! Fill the required Deity and reach Stage 3!
‘good. is growing smoothly. But… I can’t be satisfied yet.’
The rewards I got from this dungeon were definitely satisfying, but I didn’t feel any joy.
A lot of people died in this Red Gate capture.
Jaehyun thought.
What did they say at the last moment?
Did he scream that he wanted to live, or did he reflect on his family and memories while feeling the end of his life aloof.
Nothing could be known.
Jaehyun was not them.
Jaehyun is not dead.
they are already dead
All Jaehyun could do was kill Odin.
In order to do so, we only become stronger and more prepared.
he got up from his seat
In the evening, there is a party to commemorate the reorganization of the alliance and the capture of the Red Gate.
I didn’t want to participate, but as a black robe. Also, as a disciple of Yeon-hwa, Jae-hyun was in a position where he had no choice but to go.
Jaehyun took out suitable clothes from the closet and put them on. He wore a light blazer with no tie on a white shirt.
The pants were also slacks. It was black, but it was functional in preparation for any eventuality.
Shoes are penny loafers. It must be difficult not to be too formal.
I don’t have any sense, so I bought it as instructed by the clerk, so there shouldn’t be any major problems.
That’s when Jaehyun was preparing. Suddenly, a question passed through his mind.
“But you shouldn’t take the cat to the party.”
“…I will hide again this time.”
Hella clenched her fists in exasperation.
* * *
The place where the party was held was a very special place.
A cruise made by combining the advanced technology of headquarters. The place where the ship floats is a subspace.
This special space is huge enough to accommodate more than a thousand people. It’s about the same size as when I was hunting freshmen at the academy in the past.
There was a reason for organizing a party in such a sub-space.
This is a kind of social gathering. There were so many radars to meet people and build deep relationships here.
In order to maintain secrecy, it was better to arrange a meeting in a deserted place.
Jaehyun went to a party with his colleagues.
Ensuring identity was not difficult thanks to Jaehyun and Yeonhwa.
However, Jaehyun’s identity as a black robe was revealed to the leadership. I couldn’t avoid being baptized with questions here and there.
“How did you, still young, obtain such power?”
“What kind of a mutant was Oduksini? What features were there! I would love to hear a detailed explanation!”
High-ranking people who speak easily asked Jae-hyun.
Jaehyun sighed as if he was annoyed while answering moderately.
The members of Nine put on some gloomy expressions as they watched.
“…Did we not help this time again?”
Seoina’s words. There was no answer coming back.
I knew it in my heart.
Jaehyun is a radar with skills beyond the standard, and now he has the best skills not only in Korea but also in the world.
Even the desire to stand by their side was nothing more than a childish complaint in the eyes of others.
too much emotion. That was their longing.
Apart from that, the affection his colleagues had for Jaehyun was very great.
It’s not just about love, but in their hearts, Jaehyun was the person who made each of them move forward.
when i’m weak The person who pulled you when you were at your lowest.
It felt like he had gone too far, so they couldn’t be calm.
I thought about what would happen if I made friends with someone who was much greater than myself and didn’t need them.
By the time everyone thinks like that.
Jaehyun, who had a hard expression while talking, found his colleagues.
“That’s why… The society defined the grade of the new gate and named it EX…” ”
Wait a minute. sorry. my friends are waiting I think I need to take a break for a while.”
The professor who had authority in gate research nodded as if he was sorry.
“If you are a friend, go ahead. In many ways, there was nothing like friendship during school days.”
“Thank you for your consideration.”
After saying that, Jaehyun walked towards his colleague and arrived.
“What are you talking about so much fun without me?”
Colleagues felt ashamed at that moment. Distancing is not reproduction.
It was just his own weak heart and inferiority complex.
The group found out about it.
* * *
“Still, I’m glad it ended well somehow. Yoojung also recovered quickly.”
These were the words Ahn Ho-yeon said when the colleagues gathered and started to enjoy the party. Lee Jae-sang nodded vigorously.
“that’s right. I was worried.”
“…but it’s strange that oppa doesn’t stutter…?”
Kim Yoo-jung said so without hiding her embarrassment. Ahn Ho-yeon crossed his arms and said with a serious face.
“If I politely ask you to grope again, somehow…”
“Hey. don’t joke How hard must it have been for him to overcome that? I heard all the stories.”
“ouch.”
Kwon So-yul lightly hit Ahn Ho-yeon on the head with the blade of his hand and said so.
After the incident, the co-workers told Lee Jae-sang all about his father.
The reactions and attitudes of my colleagues, of course, did not change from before.
“Anyway, it’s strange to see people I’ve seen on TV right in front of me like this.”
“…I know.”
Kim Yoo-jung and Seo Ina looked around and exchanged words.
surely. It was close to a social church, and there were many people who were familiar with it.
There were also those who made a name for themselves in politics.
Among them, of course, there were a few people who had memories of Jaehyun.
His gaze turned to one place, and Jaehyun’s expression hardened for a moment. There was a man with a dignified appearance in the place where the gaze landed.
‘Rep. Park… That guy is dangerous.’
Rep. Park was a person who played the role of Gu Ja-in’s practical backing in the past.
after his downfall. Although he was not active and was saving himself, there was no doubt that he was a reluctant enemy.
Incidentally, Jaehyun had already asked Yeonhwa to keep an eye on him.
‘Huh… First of all, I should rest a bit. If you think about too many things at once, you might miss something.’
Jaehyun took a sip of non-alcoholic champagne and looked at the sea.
The sea specially created as a subspace. This place is an illusion, but it was a place where sophisticated science and technology were concentrated to the extent that it could not be felt at all as an illusion.
That’s when Jaehyun stood alone and drank champagne. Suddenly, Kim Yoo-jung spoke to me from behind.
“Hey Min Jaehyun. This pasta was delicious. Have you eaten too?”
Excited Kim Yoo-jung proudly showed it to him holding a fork that rolled up the pasta.
Jaehyun smirked and approached her, and abruptly thrust his face into her.
thump
At that moment, Kim Yoo-jung’s expression hardened in an instant.
Jaehyun took the pasta from the fork he was holding and ate it.
Seo In-na’s pupils constricted slightly as she watched the scene.
Kim Yoo-jung’s cheeks suddenly started to heat up red.

in order to change anything.

like that. Silence passed between the party for a while.

“Master is in danger! The Red Gate… needs the power of the black robe… is!”
Jaehyun couldn’t help but doubt his own ears.
Ballack, one of the best raiders. And Camilla, who sticks together.
They are the shining stars among the top.
But are they in danger?

* * *
Valhalla.

Sigrun. He was one of the leaders of the Valkyries.

in the middle of the hallway. She frowned at Hugin, who was limping.

As a person who handles emotions, he also controls his own emotions.
It was a part that no other god had.
Of course, to Sigrun, all of that just felt disgusting.
Anyway, he is a servant who serves Freya. The relationship between her and Odin is not good, and unfortunately, the crow serves Odin.
A dangerous being unknown to the inside.
That was Sigrun’s definition of Huginn.

“Please.”
Sigrun sighed, and Hugin quickly bowed his head and asked.
It was an embarrassing situation for her, but she couldn’t help it.
In the end, Odin gave Freyja the task of dealing with the adversary he was entrusted with.
If this is not handled properly, Freyja’s position will be embarrassing.

She took her luck indifferently.

An immediate answer that falls quickly. It twisted Sigrun’s brow.

It’s a lie if it doesn’t interest you.

Most of Odin’s crows aren’t that strong, but he and Juwon were different.
A weapon bred for Odin from the core. It must be what he said.

The remaining time until she raises an army is about two weeks. At the same time as Sigrun moves, a terrible hell will unfold in Midgard.
Hugin, however, thought otherwise.
Jaehyun Min. antagonist of prophecy.

Hugin somehow felt a chill at the fact that he could no longer answer the question definitively.
* * *
Of course, there is also a room for secret stories in Subspace Cruise.

sorry but

black robe. And it must mean that Eoduksini’s treatment had a big impact.

Is it the second bottle? If it wasn’t that, maybe it was because of that terrible naming sense, but I couldn’t tell Jaehyun, but the story was more urgent now.
Lena Meyer.
The news that she brought with her that Balak and Camilla are in danger.
What does this mean?

“Do not worry. They have a heavy mouth.”

he put his hands together Eventually, after making up her mind, the story slowly begins to flow out of her mouth.

Jaehyun had no reason to refuse.
After all, there is no one who can block the Red Gate single-handedly unless it is Jaehyun.
Here, pretending to give in moderately to Rina Meyer’s words…
“But… there is one problem…. Master’s pride is too strong. If someone else goes into the dungeon with you… you’ll probably get angry…”

Jaehyun swallowed his saliva and continued.
“Because I am quite familiar with him.”

“ah.”

Can not help it. Now, he attacks the Red Gate in Europe and obtains another Awakening Stone there.

last week. Even though they have to take the test, they have been away for a long time in Europe and now they are back.

after regression. Emotions that I hadn’t felt all along would once again tighten my breath.

chapters.title: Chapter 268
chapters.content:
Chapter 268. Circle Competition (1)
“I came to make a proposal to Min Jae-hyun and Circle Nine.
Milles’ circle competition, which will be held as a practical test for the final exam. Let’s join hands with Aran there.”
The proposal was simple.
Aran. As one of Miles’ main circles, they are proposing an alliance to Nine.
Jaehyun crossed his arms. It was an act that showed that he was deliberately taking a defensive stance.
“well. What are the benefits of joining hands with Aran?”
To put it simply, it was a threat.
Jaehyun was well aware of his abilities. His powers were coveted by anyone in other circles.
No matter how much the cadets’ stats were fixed below a certain level in the circle competition and the upper skills were restricted. Because the value of representation never fades.
Kang Joo-hyeop must have known this and rushed to find Jae-hyun.
“I’ve been through it once, so you know. What unique rules are mixed into Miles’ test?”
“broadcast.”
Jaehyun nodded his head again.
“that’s right. Just like when you took your midterm exams in the past, the cadets taking practical exams will be broadcast live across the country. There, inevitably, we have to grab the attention of the viewer.”
Aggro.
To put it simply, Kang Joo-hyeop was letting people know that his teammates were much more individual than members of other circles.
By the way, there was a good reason why he put it as a strength rather than a part that was helpful in battle.
Unlike the midterm exam, this broadcast is not a one-way communication. The biggest feature of this term is that you can have a direct conversation with the viewers.
It was self-evident that cadets with unique personalities would attract better responses.
‘In addition, in this final exam broadcast, viewers can ‘sponsor’, and depending on the amount, the cadets can purchase items necessary for survival.’
It is a very unique system.
Miles Academy hoped to further enhance the academy’s honor when the cadets grew up as raiders. From the first time there was a director, Jain Koo, this trend has continued.
The sponsorship system was the extreme of this.
A radar that can draw attention. A radar that can show off its whimsical side on the battlefield.
It was the best ‘product’ in his opinion.
Therefore, Gu Ja-in intended to give vicarious satisfaction to viewers through broadcasting and to bring appropriate financial gains and publicity effects to them.
This was not so different even now when Chairman Kim Ji-yeon took office. Of course, you may think it’s a bad event, but Kim Ji-yeon couldn’t abolish it at once.
At least one year in office.
It is not possible to change the composition of all events held at the academy in one year.
Moreover, the competition is one of the most popular events in Milles.
If it was suddenly canceled here, there was room for Kim Ji-yeon’s position to be shaken.
‘Because if even the viewers get angry and make a fuss, it will be difficult.’
For this reason, Kim Ji-yeon chose reform rather than the abrupt abolition of Daejeon.
She converted all donations from viewers into points and distributed them to the cadets.
It was a policy change.
This was to properly imprint that he and Milles Academy were considerate of the cadets.

divine magic. Among them, offensive magic was only basic, such as Holy Arrow, and the effect was not that great.

and awe.

you are strong More than anyone living here right now.”

‘Memories of Hrungnir. There I saw the giant’s brutal death.’
Hrungnir. The sad look of him leaving the young Smir and dealing with Thor alone.
It remained very deep in Jaehyun’s brain.
Because he decided
At this point, we must somehow unite the power of the world’s raiders.

three?

All of them were the best items with an A+ grade value.
However, not all of them were as good as Jaehyun’s.

Startle.

assassination?

anyway it is You can’t assassinate a customer, can you?

something. The fact that something very huge was slowly approaching him and his comrades.

the story has developed so far.

pay.

Jaehyun returns to his room.

pay. An exotic-looking boy who was said to have come from Sweden.

pay.

but he was also looking at himself.

Jaehyun has already made a decision. I will fight if necessary.
Because if I don’t do that, I won’t be able to protect mine.
* * *
A few days after that.
The first day of the school festival finally dawned.
The booth preparations for the cafe run by Nine were proceeding smoothly.
Under the direction of Kwon So-yul. They set up a signboard, set up a basic framework, and bought various items to redecorate the interior.
Ahn Ho-yeon learned how to make coffee, and Seo E-na learned how to make dessert. Now there is no such thing as a big problem in operation.

“Are you done with this now? The opening is in two days.

Kwon So-yul muttered that while holding the pen. She was almost a secretary now.
Jaesang Lee nodded from the side.
“I think so. Since it is only open for one day, you have to pay that much attention and do well.”
“Then, today and tomorrow are free, right?”
It was Kim Yoo-jung’s question. Kwon So-yul nodded with a slightly subtle expression.
Kim Yoo-jung first took off her apron and folded it neatly, then looked back at Jae-hyun and said,
“It’s tonight. Didn’t you forget?”
“I am not you.”
When Jaehyun answered like that, Kim Yoojung wrinkled her forehead a little and left first.
The expression of Seo Eana, who was watching this from behind, also changed subtly.
Following Kwon So-yul, even Ahn Ho-yeon asked in a whisper if he had come to grasp the unusual atmosphere.

“Don’t say more. now i don’t know The kids will take care of it.”
“yes.”

In that situation, the only bright light was Lee Jae-sang.
“There must be a lot of customers in the cafe…”

The night came quickly.
Summer is coming, so I thought the days would be long, but I guess I was wrong.

Just came from Sweden. Exotically handsome. That was it.
If there’s anything caught, I’d ask you to investigate that side a bit more.

Suddenly, after wasting time like that.

Meanwhile at that time.

Above, a denim dress, a white short-sleeved tee, a blue skirt, and black hot pants are lined up. Naturally, a decision had not yet been made.
Which of these would work best?
I searched the Internet for a girlfriend look, but I couldn’t come up with a sharp answer.
The sound of everything.
[As long as it’s pretty!]
It’s all bullshit…
“Ha… What did he say, did I go this far…” I
suddenly had that thought, but I shook my head and brushed off the thoughts.
Can not help it. If your heart has already been shaken once, it will only lead to a sluggish state without an end in any way.
At the time when Kim Yoo-jung woke up in the hospital room a few days ago while choosing clothes.
I remembered the conversation I had with Seo Ina.
[Inaya. I have something to tell you.]
[It’s about Min Jae-hyun.]
* * *
A few days ago.
A private room at a hospital affiliated with Yeonhwa.
Kim Yoo-jung and Seo E-na were having a conversation. There is no one around.

“okay.”

We have something we want from each other.
Also, in order to achieve this, no one had to give up.

Surprisingly, Seo Eana was the first to break the silence.
“…thank you. For being honest.”
“Sorry. I should have noticed my heart sooner…”
At Kim Yoo-jung’s words, Eana Seo shook her head as if she was okay.
She held the hand of Kim Yoo-jung, who was barely holding back her tears while holding the duvet cover tightly.
After all, she didn’t do anything wrong. It’s just that it’s a little late to notice your feelings. It was nothing that anyone would call a sin.
Even so, the reason she is in pain must be because of her feelings of guilt and guilt towards herself.
Thinking like that made me feel sad again. He himself hadn’t decided on Jaehyun for a while, and he finally revealed it on a field trip.
Kim Yoo-jung, who watched the reenactment for a much longer time, thought that it must have been even worse.
Seo Ina said in a friendly voice.
“are you okay. I really. rather like this For Jaehyun and for us.”
Kim Yoo-jung and I somehow became romantic partners, but in any case, the relationship between the two did not diverge. He was a colleague and a friend.
The relationship between the two was not something that could be sorted out so easily.
Seo Ina stood up from her seat with a rare bright smile.
“…Anyway, neither of you has the heart to give up. right?”
“huh.”
Let’s not say sorry to each other.
Seo Ina said so and Kim Yoojung nodded slightly.
And Kim Yoo-jung a few days later.
While preparing the booth, I mustered up the courage to tell Jaehyun.
[Hey, Min Jae-hyun.]
[That… Do you have time during the school festival? On the first night.]
[I have something to say then. Shall we see that day?]
* * *
Many cadets were already gathered at the main gate where Jaehyun and Kim Yoojung were supposed to meet.

When Jaehyun arrived, Yoojung Kim came out first and was waiting. She was wearing white short sleeves over blue hot pants.
For some reason, the faint redness on her cheeks must have been made up.
The shoes are all white Converse. It wasn’t a shoe I wore often. Jaehyun thought about it and waved his hand.
It was 5 minutes earlier than the scheduled time.
“You came out early. What are you doing?”
“Huh? Just by chance?”
“Have you thought about what to do first? Then let’s go.”
After Jaehyun said that, he remembered the calendar he had seen earlier.
In fact, it wasn’t for any other reason that Jaehyun decided to stay with Kim Yoojung on the first day of the festival.
He recalled a memory he would never forget.
‘It’s getting closer and closer to the day Kim Yoo-jung died. In order to protect it, it is advantageous to stay by my side as much as possible.’
The butterfly effect has already occurred with its own regression.
A lot has changed and twisted.
But Hella said.
[The butterfly effect due to regression is only affirming the minimum interference for the adversary. In the end, the person who will die is most likely going to die.
Unless you save it.]
Kim Yoo-jung will also die if she does not save it.
Jaehyun was thinking of somehow preventing the tragedy before returning. That’s why I couldn’t refuse her words to enjoy the festival on a busy day like now.
“First, from there.”
But she won’t know this feeling.
Jaehyun also enjoyed the present time without expressing any more.
Kim Yoo-jung seemed to have thought of all the schedules and wandered around well.
The first was a restaurant and the next was a game room. After that, we ate street food and chatted at street vendors.
It was not a bad atmosphere even for Kim Yoo-jung herself.
But that time didn’t last forever.
The night was deeper than the first, and there was complete darkness all around. The people around them were slowly disappearing from the roadside as if they were slowly returning.
Since there is a curfew at the academy anyway, he must have decided that it was better to go back now.
Time goes by so fast
A time when no one else was around except for the two of them.
pounding.
Suddenly, Kim Yoo-jung’s heart starts pounding and beating repeatedly.
It was a feeling I felt for the first time in my life.
“Then we slowly turn around…”
“Huh…”
After letting out a dizzying breath, she looked up at Jaehyun, who was one head taller than herself.
Jaehyun was looking down at him with a worried expression.
“hey. Are you okay? Is it weird to breathe? Are you sick?”
After she made up her mind, she ignored Jaehyun’s words and took her luck.
“We saw each other for a long time. right?”
“What are you worried about? It’s all over again.”
After Jaehyun said that, he decided that Kim Yoojung was okay.
“It’s not quite like that. It seems like it’s already been over 10 years…”
Jaehyun looked at her and smiled.
“If you think about it, how much trouble I suffered because of you. Did you always leave something behind and take care of it for a day or two? It bothers me when I think about it.”
“It was like that then…”
Jaehyun couldn’t help but be a little taken aback by Kim Yoojung’s reply.
Wasn’t she the one who would have shouted ‘When am I!’ and kicked her in the shin? Why are you smiling so obediently today and accepting my words?
By the time the doubts were added, Kim Yoo-jung stopped for a moment and lucked out.
“You didn’t know because you weren’t interested in talking about the kids, but… Do you know what the other kids said to us every time we went home after school?”

When Jaehyun asked indifferently, Kim Yoojung said in a trembling voice.
“Are you dating us?” he asked.
“Did anything like that happen? so. Are you in a bad mood and want to ask me?”
When Jaehyun asked with a smile, Yujeong Kim looked at Jaehyun and said,

“…what?”
At that moment, Jaehyun’s footsteps also stopped.
Kim Yoo-jung’s voice continued in a situation where she couldn’t even grasp what the hell she was hearing.
“I feel bad.”
“……I don’t know what you mean.”
“What are you talking about?”
At that time, Kim Yoo-jung’s two cheeks came to mind and a faint smile leaked out.
With a face that seemed to finally feel relieved, she said.
“It means I like you.”

of course.

one that moment. Jaehyun was more focused on other things.

The scenery standing in the middle of the sea changed in an instant, and then it was transformed into a flat land.
Apparently, the host of the fourth ordeal seemed to be quite a conversationalist. If you look at how they take care of themselves from the beginning and move them to the place.
[This might be better for you, a half-human, to talk about. First of all, I will introduce myself.]
Jormungand flicked his tongue.
[I am Jormungand. It’s a Midgard serpent and one of the bloody Loki’s children.]
Jaehyun narrowed his eyes. what? One of your children’s children…?
At those words, he didn’t even think that he shouldn’t do it in the first meeting, and he did it without even realizing it.
“…Is that a gag?”
[…No.]
At Jaehyun’s words, Jormungandr twisted his body as if he was very embarrassed.
What the hell is this…
Jormungandr, a serpent described as one of the strongest in mythology… a guy who makes such a silly gag?
Even the problem was that it was a gag with a different resolution from Mimir.
‘That old man didn’t know shame, so he was at least able to listen… What if he gets embarrassed after doing this…’
Jaehyun started the fourth ordeal in a situation where he could neither laugh nor cry.
But then.
Hella’s shoulder next to her suddenly trembled.
what?

Jormungand was delighted.
Jaehyun was now in a frenzy.

When Jaehyun meets Jormungandr for the ordeal.
Kwajik!

Hlydskalp.

Loki.

Loki, the head of the Anti-Aesir Alliance.
The power he had dared to equal or exceed that of himself or Thor. Although its power must have been degraded due to long restraints, if it regains its power quickly…
‘There is a risk that the game of the second Ragnarok will be reversed.’
It just meant that it couldn’t be ignored.

Because of this, even when he first built the prison to restrain Loki, he put a lot of thought and effort into it compared to other buildings.
Even if all the restraints and restrictions in the world disappear, I have been thinking and worrying so that I can never get out of my control.
Mythical level monsters were also placed at a level that reached 10,000 water points.

It was so vaguely judged.
However…
“I was complacent. He was more cunning and stronger.”
Could it be that the intuition has been blunted for 10,000 years?
He underestimated Loki.
Loki’s escape this time was tantamount to proving this.
when he was in trouble
Thor, who had been silently listening in front of him, interrupted.
“But Father. There is no need to worry too much, right? No matter how much he is, he probably hasn’t fully recovered his strength yet… Besides.
Aren’t you the one who was defeated by us anyway?”
“Defeat? Did you say defeat?”
Odin snorted.
It was proof that Thor’s words were absurd.
Odin said, raising his rank and extending his momentum.
The deity of a mythical being that has reached the 5th level stretches out and starts to shake the ground and the palace.
“In the first Ragnarok, the anti-Aesir forces were much weaker than us. However, it was always us who fell a little behind in battle. Why do you think it was?”
Thor narrowed his brow.
This time, it was an unspoken sign that he would not just listen.
“Are you saying Loki alone made that possible? The word leaps too far.”
“At least, he was a much more usable guy than you, who was stupid and strong. Although he was an enemy, his tactics were excellent enough to be counted on one hand.”
Odin didn’t even think about Thor’s expression or mood.
“The only thing we were able to win was Idun’s Golden Apple and Einherjar. And it was thanks to the Valkyrie army led by Freya, not because you were strong.”
“That is also strength. If making use of others is not strength, then what is strength?”
“You’re just a mouthful. How many times do you think you and your wife have been fooled by his tricks? Thor, you’re starting to lose your mind. I doubt if he is really my son.”
As Odin’s sarcastic remarks settled down, Thor stopped his constant flirtation.
His gaze turns to his father.
It was a blasphemous gaze that could hardly be believed to be directed at the highest power in Asgard.
However, Odin persisted in his stubborn attitude and continued to criticize his son.
“If you’re arrogant about killing a filthy giant, you’d better stop right now. If you really don’t want to die by my hand.”
“…sorry. However, I was just saying it because I was worried that my father seemed to be overly concerned. Please forget it with a generous heart.”
As Thor lowered his head, Odin looked away with a slightly softened face.
“So… have you all figured out what the adversary’s current skill level is? Late?”
At that moment, a black shadow that had been moving behind the curtains stood out clearly in front of me.
A being that appeared in the thick darkness.
It was Hugin the Crow.
“I haven’t fully grasped it yet… but I think it’s close to the 3rd stage of divine power liberation. After all, it was none other than Sigrun-nim. At least you won’t be stuck at stage 2.
And… it will grow faster.”
Odin nodded.
“I will move a little faster. I need to restore my divinity, which I lost due to the destruction of the mirror… At least prepare to move properly within a month.”
“I will take your order.”
“Everyone go away.”
Thor and Hugin in Odin’s celestial order.
The two beings lowered their heads at the same time as if they had matched.
“Everything according to the will of the great Odin.”
* * *
“So Jormungand. What is the theme of the fourth ordeal?”
Jormungandr, who finally regained his composure at Jaehyun’s question, smiled grinning as he flicked his tongue.
It seemed that the embarrassment caused by the gag had finally gone.
[Are you directly asking me, the person in charge of the trials, about the contents of the test? I knew the rumors, but… Isn’t this too shameless?]
Jaehyun’s guts were truly amazing.
To the extent that even that Jormungandr laughed.
However, contrary to what Jormungand had thought, Jaehyun’s eyes were only serious.
His expression was innocent, as if he really thought that Jormungand would tell the story of his ordeal.
Of course, Hella knew very well that Jaehyun was the farthest from naivety.
‘It’s impudent.’
Though thinking so, Hella did not point out Jaehyun’s attitude.
In fact, for Jaehyun, the current reaction was quite natural.
It’s better for him to go through the ordeal with a little more information in his hands.
Although there is no royal road to becoming strong, and you must not rush your mind. Even so, it was not a story that could be used even in the current situation.
Moreover.
‘The three trials I’ve taken so far… they always pushed and tested me to my limits. It will be the same this time too. I like to find the easiest way.
At least until I can properly handle this power.’
No matter how much the ordeals grow Jaehyun…
the fourth ordeal in a situation where you can’t properly handle the godhead?
Whatever is in reserve would be perfect for dying.
‘Unfortunately, I don’t think I’ve heard the contents, but I roughly understand Jormungandr’s personality…’
It was at that time that Jaehyun was collecting information about the person in charge of the fourth ordeal.
Jormungandr’s voice broke into his thoughts with a sudden gasp and tongue flick.
[good night. let me know The theme of the fourth trial.]
“…yes?”
Jaehyun rolled his eyes and said.
At first, he acted like he wouldn’t tell me, but it seemed that the story would work. He smiled in satisfaction, as if he liked Jaehyun again.
[why? Don’t you like it?]
Jaehyun shook his head and put a faint smile on his lips.
“As expected, Midgard’s serpent… Yudori is cool. Even if it’s not, when I read Shinhwa, I thought your story was the most interesting.”
[haha. is it. Thank you for lying.]
In a warm atmosphere. For some reason, Hella had a dark expression.
She seemed to be talking to someone. He’s probably communicating with Hell or other faction members via telepathy.
Jaehyun didn’t care deeply. First of all, because trials lie in front of you.
Right now, you have to focus on what’s in front of you first.
Jormungandr, perhaps aware of Jaehyun’s feelings, also slowly opened his mouth.
It was the moment when the details of the fourth trial were finally revealed.
[The theme of the fourth ordeal is ‘forbidden’.]
Forbidden?
While Jaehyun tilted his head, Jormungandr’s explanation continued.
[You are me from now on. You will receive Jormungandr’s ban, and if you pass it, you will fully rise to the stage of Divinity Liberation 3.
Now, no one will be able to call you a half-god, and you will get the right to attend the regular meeting in Hel.] It
was a more shocking reward than Jaehyun had thought.
Along with his thoughts, a quest window appeared in the air.
―Accept the main quest 《The Trial of Jormungand》.
―The contents of the quest are displayed.
[Main Quest]
Jormungandr’s Ordeal
Jormungandr, the serpent of Midgard, gives an ordeal to the adversary.
Endure the restrictions imposed and open the way to escape to the outside.
Success Conditions
Overcome inhibitions (one or more).
Failure conditions
1. Death of the opponent
2. Failure to overcome the ban Difficulty
level: ???
Reward: Storm of Jormungand (EX) Divinity level
released
*There are three preparations.
* * *
Sounds of conversation can be heard from inside Thor’s room in Asgard.
There were three men standing there.
Thor and two young men standing side by side in front of him.
They were Thor’s sons, Magni and Modi.
“Magni Modi. Do you understand What an important task you have been entrusted with this time.”
“… but father. Aren’t you the antagonist who defeated Sigrun? Even if we fight together, we might not be able to defeat him.
Odin didn’t even give us the mission directly… I don’t know if it’s right for us to step forward now.”
Magni said slightly embarrassed.
Modi interjected, frowning.
“Magni, are you at least afraid of humans? We are the sons of the thunder god Thor and one of the great gods of Asgard.”
“Mony. Don’t you think you’re too careless?”
The opinions of the sons were sharply divided.
Of course, Thor didn’t like the answer, but they also had their own circumstances.
The words that Thor summoned the two gods a while ago.
That was enough to embarrass the two gods.
[I will give you an order as a father. Go to Midgard, kill the opponents, and return.]
It was almost like a thunderbolt from the sky.
Sadly, Magni was not a battle fanatic like his father.
He was born with such strong power that he was accustomed to fighting, but he did not enjoy fighting.
In the case of Modi, he inherited his father’s warlike personality, but lacked fundamental strength and talent.
‘It would have been nice if only one of them had inherited all of my powers and personality…’
Thor had thought of that more than once or twice.
To Magni and Modi, Thor’s mountain was high with Mjolnir and Megingjord.
An existence that cannot be surpassed by any means.
That was the status of a father in Asgard.
Because of this, the two sons gave up on surpassing their father and spent time with Egir every day drinking or enjoying sex.
The other gods, of course, looked at them with pitiful eyes.
Thor was upset about it, and now he too was ignored by Odin. I devised a trick to boost myself and my son Modi Magni’s presence in Asgard.
The plan itself was simple.
It’s to get Modi and Magni to kill the antagonist.
If he succeeds, his position in Asgard will now reach right below his father.
The ripple effect of the name of the antagonist of prophecy.
This is because it is a level that cannot be ignored in Asgard, which values prophecy.
However, Tor has this problem. What if Modi and Magni, who were called his ugly sons, succeed in defeating them?
As long as he won, there was nothing wrong with Thor. A reward obtained by defeating an adversary, a human who obtained at least slightly stronger power.
It was sweet indeed.
‘No matter how strong the adversary is, there is a high possibility that it is an inflated rumor. Although she killed Heimdall and Sigrun, who had a 30% divine power, it must have been because she made a mistake or was careless.
No matter how you think about it, that crow’s evaluation is incomprehensible.’
Thor thought about that and nodded his head.
“My decision will not be reversed. You will have to head to Midgard to defeat the adversary. but.”
Thor said, looking down at his two sons.
“I am also your father. I am not giving you anything and telling you to destroy your opponents. Take this with you.”
“This is…?!”
Modi was the first to look surprised.
It was because the thing his father Thor gave him was something he hadn’t even thought of.
Megingjord.
It was Thor’s belt, which almost doubled the wearer’s strength.
My father is handing such things to himself!
“It is borrowed in any way. Modi, take this with you. You are born with the same temperament as me, but you are naturally weak.”
“thank you. father.”
“And Magni.”
“yes.”
“I will lend you a Gullfaxi.”

Magni couldn’t help but be surprised there.
Gulpaksi.
It was his horse that Thor had obtained as a trophy when he defeated Hrungnir in the past.

Truly, the famous horse of the world.
Deep down, after the battle with Hrungnir was over, it was a trophy he wanted to tell his father about, but Thor correctly grasped it.
These two artifacts were enough to ignite the two sons’ affection.
adversary.
If you think about it, it’s a simple thing.
No matter how strong he is, is he barely human?
Humans were weak scum, not even a Dark Elf, let alone a god. The reward for defeating him was simply sweet.
“I will go. Do you, Modi, go too?”
“Of course.”
Modi and Magni.
After the two gods greeted Thor, they headed for Bifrost.

two gods. Modi and Magni thought.

Episode 307 The fourth ordeal (2)
“It’s forbidden…”
Jaehyun pondered for a while as he looked at the quest window that popped up.
Prohibited.
At this moment, of course, there was only one meaning of this word.
Sealing part of one’s talents and powers.
To put it simply, this ordeal meant that Jaehyun would place restrictions on something that he had been using frequently until now.
Whether it’s skills or stats…
or something else special.
‘It’s the same that they all control my power. I don’t think it will be an easy ordeal.’
I ate my heart out and took a deep breath.
Hela said that the past trials were designed to test the strength of the adversary to the limit.
What she said was actually true.
Of course, the second was much more difficult than the first, and the third was several times more difficult than the second. At least that’s what Jaehyun felt.
Now, there are only two ordeals left.
It would be correct to assume that only relatively difficult ones will remain. There’s a good chance you’ll see blood if you don’t approach carefully.
However, there was no time for Jaehyun right now.
Hasty judgment is poison, but in the end, trials must be endured.
He took a step forward without hesitation.
“I will take the test right now.”
[good night. But I will tell you one thing in advance. This ordeal is completely against the enemy. It is prepared only for you. You will not receive Fafnir’s help.]
“Okay. hella. Take care of Poppy. I’ll have two sandwiches here, so if you whine about being hungry, eat them.”
“Yes, yes?! If it’s a sandwich… that purple poison…?”
“My friend worked hard on it, but it’s poisonous. You talk too much.”
“…sorry.”
Hella immediately apologized.
By the way, Hella was the guide of the ordeal, so she couldn’t help Jaehyun.
Well, it was like that in the trials in the past, so Jaehyun didn’t care that much.
at that time.
Jormungand looked at Jaehyun and pondered for a while, then for some reason said with a confident expression.
[Then I hope you can get what you want from this ordeal.
Don’t take the test too much.]
“Keukheop!”
Hella laughed again.
By the time Jaehyun heard that, he doubted his ears again.
A white halo of light engulfed Jaehyun, and soon he felt his body shifting somewhere.
After a while.
Jaehyun arrived at the white room. When I raised my head, I saw things that seemed completely unrelated to the ordeal.
His mind suddenly became confused.
“Is that… a soap bubble?”
It was as he said.
Above his head were numerous transparent spheres that looked like soap bubbles.
―Jormungandr’s first ban 《The ban of weight》 is applied.
―Detonate all the orbs floating in the air and open the portal to decide whether to enter the next Forbidden Zone or end the ordeal.
* * *
That time. When Jaehyun entered the beginning of his ordeal.
Jormungandr opened his eyes, which had been closed for a moment, and his cunning-looking tongue clicked.
[Hella, you must have felt it too. This mighty magical movement…]
Hella nodded with a dark expression at his question.
“yes. I am feeling it too. They… are finally starting to move.”
Grrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrr.dol
as well.
Hela and Jormungand were well aware of the reason for this reaction.
Right now, the magical energy that has suddenly begun to be detected in Midgard…
This is probably the god sent by the Aesir to defeat Jaehyun.
For Fafnir, who accepted Jaehyun as his master, he had no choice but to react to the murderous feeling he felt right now.
[It will not be an overwhelming force. Because the Æsir gods who broke the mirror of equilibrium couldn’t have recovered that much power yet.]
Jormungand said calmly.
His words were well-founded.
No matter how much Ragnarok has started, the Aesir gods can’t attack Midgard and the worlds at will.
Basically, in order to interfere in each other’s world, divine power is required.
Right now, the Æsir did not have enough spiritual power to bring out the spirits of countless gods in Midgard.
Efforts would be made to recover it, but it was inevitable that it would take time.
6 months. In order to attack Jaehyun with the divine power recovered in a short period of time, he had to be weak.
There is probably nothing other than sending relatively low-level gods.
[However, even if you are weak, it is difficult to deal with a perfect godhead.
Even if not as much as when dealing with Sigrun, it would be difficult without the opponent drawing out half of it.]
Jormungandr’s vertically slit amber pupils emitted light.
Hela agrees with him and adds.
“It is as you said. A little while ago, I got a call from the Temple of Hel. It is both gods who have passed through Bifrost to Midgard.
Modi and Magni. It seems that they are targeting the enemy.”
[But I’m worried about what to do. I want to help, but I can’t get out of here… It’s obvious that the whole of Midgard will become a sea of fire if I leave it alone.
If necessary, take the risk and the other gods will step in…]
Jormungand’s words. Hella cut her teeth and turned her back.
“I will go and help them. You just help Jae-Hyun go through the ordeal safely.”
At her words, Jormungandr couldn’t help but be truly taken aback.
No matter how strong Hela was, it wasn’t enough to tie the two gods together. However, her expression was serious. No matter how you look at it, it wasn’t a face that was playing a joke.
Jormungandr wrinkled his brow slightly.
[No matter how you are, it is impossible to deal with both gods at the same time.]
“I know.”
[But why did you make that decision?]
“I have no intention of stopping it alone. The Adversary’s allies… they are also quite strong now, so I will rely on them.
Besides… I don’t think it will take Jaehyun to complete the ordeal. You don’t have to worry about me.”
Hela left those words and completely disappeared from Jormungand’s realm.
Fafnir II also disappeared with him, so Jormungand had no choice but to be left alone in subspace.
Own territory where the deep blue sea spreads. Standing tall there, he was lost in thought as he repeated the story of Hela from earlier.
[This is really strange. What is it about the adversary that draws the trust of so many people? Also, what are the limits
of his talent?
It remains to be seen how the adversary progresses from now on.
All three preparations were prepared.
However, a little while ago he told him. Even if you pass only one of the forbidden trials, you will be cleared. It is only up to the adversary to decide whether to go further.
Jormungandr flicked his tongue, recalling Jaehyun’s thin face. Only one person had ever shown such an attitude in front of him.
Loki.
A question popped into Jormungandr’s mind.
The thing that reminds me of Loki and Jaehyun.
Is it just a coincidence?
* * *
“Blast all those soap bubbles… La. It’s an ordeal with contents that I didn’t even think of from the beginning.”
Jaehyun scratched his head and carefully looked at the drops floating in the air.
It reminded me of the soap bubble machine I used to play with as a child.
At that time, it was said that soap bubbles burst with just a light touch with a finger.
After my hair grew a bit, I also saw magicians doing bubble tricks.
Did you say that it does not explode well because it is mixed with a special solution?
Jaehyun carefully refined his thoughts.
The theme of this ordeal is forbidden.
Also, the sound of the system that had been heard earlier said that the weight of the restraint had been placed on him.
Why was there a ban on weight in the ordeal of popping soap bubbles?
Jaehyun quickly brushed off his thoughts.
Whatever it was, it was something to try.
“then.”
Jaehyun gave strength and lightly swung his fist at the soap bubble. It was to see if it was possible to pop the bell with pure muscle power.
‘My strength stat is already over 500. If this bubble isn’t special, it will burst soon.’
So, it was first thing to check.
However.
hug.
The bell was crumpled into the shape of Jaehyun’s fist for a moment, but it quickly returned to its original state.
A heterogeneous sense stays in the hands of representation.
‘It doesn’t look like a normal soap bubble after all.’
After thinking so, Jaehyun drew out his mana this time.
―Active skill 《Mana Weapon》.
Then, Jaehyun poured his mana into his fist and threw it out.
hug.
However, this time, the soap bubbles did not respond at all.
It didn’t take much effort, but it seemed like there was another standard method.
Jaehyun stretched out his hand toward the soap bubble for a moment.
―Activate the active skill 《Magic Power Detection》.
A skill that detects magical power.
I didn’t know if I could find out something if I expressed my skills along with my sensitive sixth sense.
Fortunately, Jaehyun’s prediction was not wrong.
―The appraisal result of the designated target has been derived.
“also.”
The soap bubbles confirmed by magic detection were composed of a very special substance. 100% pure magic. It was tangled up.
Even the drops had excellent elasticity. This meant that the formula was structured to absorb and release shocks well from the beginning.
Even if you don’t know, it must have been prepared with the intention of making Jaehyun realize something.
Jaehyun touched the sphere with his hand for a moment.
Then, lightly release the magic power.
―Active skill «Absolute Calculation».
―The activation of the skill is canceled.
―This skill cannot be used in the trial stage.
“As expected, the shortcut doesn’t work.”
However, Jaehyun was not at all embarrassed. After all, a drop is a drop. If you hit it with as much force as possible, it will eventually explode.
Jaehyun started to slowly open up his magic power.
Unlike the first time, several times concentrated magic power. The primordial mana begins to pulsate through Jaehyun’s body, turning the area around him red.
It’s a power that I don’t use often because I can’t use it properly yet, but now it’s Jae-Hyun’s only reliable hand.
like that.
It was when Jaehyun raised his mana and tried to swing his fist at the soap bubble again.
Jaehyun’s body stiffened as he heard an unexpected system sound.
―The user’s magical power is mixed with divinity.
―The first ban is activated!
Suddenly, Jaehyun felt his body become heavy.
‘what? My body suddenly became… heavy?’
Jaehyun’s knee bends and touches the ground before the accident continues.
It was because an unknown, intangible force that he suddenly felt began to oppress his whole body.
“This is…”
Jaehyun let out a small sigh and clenched his fists.
The more Jaehyun exerts his magic to get up off the ground. The power of the first restraint intensifies and his body becomes heavy.
‘Why?’
A question arises from the depths.
Why did my body feel heavy all of a sudden after drawing out the mana?
At that moment, the sound of the system he heard a while ago lingered in Jaehyun’s ears.
[The user’s magical power is mixed with divinity.]
[The first ban is activated!]
‘Yes. Was it like that?’
Jaehyun quickly captured the magic and divinity he had drawn out.
The thin thread of magical power that had been spun returned to Jaehyun’s body, and the restraint that weighed him down slowly began to weaken.
One corner of Jaehyun’s mouth went up.
“Jormungand… You made something interesting from the beginning.”
He had just uncovered the first forbidden secret.

chapters.title: Chapter 308
chapters.content:
Episode 308 Purification and Separation
Jormungand.
The reality of the first ban prepared by the Serpent of Midgard was simple.
A prohibition that makes the body heavy whenever magic power is mixed with divinity.
Perhaps this is the reason why it was called the ‘prohibition of weight’.
Jaehyun took a deep breath and thought.
‘Magic power and divinity are fundamentally different forces. It’s a relationship that can’t be separated, but in the end, the derivation itself is completely different.’
Magical power is the power possessed by all living beings.
Simply put, it’s common.
An awakened person in society refers to a case in which the tangibility and manifestation of this magical power is relatively easy and more extensive.
It is the aptitude value that recorded that number.
Thanks to this, it is easy to find Awakeners in society even if it is not on the radar. Based on magical power and various skills, there are awakened people in various occupations.
Deity, on the other hand, is different.
Being a god is a status given to those who have transcended the limits of one race.
Although it is called a godhead for convenience, it is not something that only gods can have, and it is very difficult to find someone who has it.
Of course, if you have skills, you can use elves, dwarves, dragons…
and even humans.
Anyone who has reached the extreme of nothingness can be equipped with dignity.
In fact, didn’t Jae-Hyun also rise to the level of a half-god after gaining status during the battle with Heimdall?
…Well, the problem was that the process of getting there was filthy difficult.
Jaehyun recalled the story he heard from Smir at the temple in Hel six months ago.
[What you are suffering from is a mental problem.]
Smir said to himself that he couldn’t use his divine power properly. What you are suffering from is a psychological problem.
There must be a reason why Smir said that.
Wasn’t he the one who helped Jaehyun during the second trial?
Jaehyun remembered Smir’s face for a moment.
And he recalled the significance of the first ban.
‘First ban. In the end, it says to burst this bell with pure magical power without any divinity mixed in.’
In the end, this ordeal had one thing to say.
“Take full control of your Godhead.”
It was a reenactment that raised the level by forcibly reaching the 3rd stage of divine power liberation. However, forcibly raising the rank like this is too risky.
Perhaps this ban was prepared to teach Jaehyun a lesson.
“But the problem here is. It’s about how to rule out the divinity.”
Smir is Jaehyun after the battle with Sigrun.
He said that he was mixing magic power with divinity without even realizing it. It was also said that the circuitry of the brain or the body organs that store magical energy, such as the short circuit, may be out of order.
This was not incorrect.

And the degree of strength of the enemy and where the enemy appeared, as Park Seong-jae said.

if so.

of course.

However, it took me about four hours to do zazen.

Finally.
Perong!

Episode 309 Time Forbidden (1)
―You succeeded in popping all the bells.
―You can move to the second ban.
―Please decide whether to take the second ban or end the ordeal.
“Heo-eok… I’m going to the next one.”
Jaehyun took a deep breath and said that.
It was natural. Didn’t he say that when he first received the quest, he would give you more rewards if you overcome as many restrictions as possible?
Jaehyun knew why his rapid growth was possible.
main quest. and ordeal.
When did you grow the fastest?
It was a time of trial.
Trials have always allowed Jaehyun to grow at an astonishing rate.
But to blow the chance to become stronger?
No matter how much the ordeal bothered him, it was a loss.
In particular, it was necessary to rip off as many things as possible from Jormungand. Isn’t that why he put up with his daddy’s gag?
“It was really terrible.”
Jaehyun muttered that while standing in front of the portal to the next forbidden event.
Eventually, after passing through the blue portal, the place where Jaehyun arrived… is.
Jaehyun couldn’t confirm it himself.
“what? The transmission seems to have gone well, but…?”
It was strange.
Clearly, the portal has taken me to a different place.
But why can’t he see anything in his eyes?
Right now, Jaehyun’s eyes were pitch black.
There is nothing to be seen. This made me wonder if something was wrong.
The time when Jormungandr thought that the ordeal had been roughly prepared.
A system tone was heard.
―Jormungandr’s second ban 《Sight ban》 is applied.
Jaehyun doubted his ears.
what? A visual restraint?
If what he heard was correct, it meant that he had to go through this stage with his eyes closed.
Jaehyun was dumbfounded.
Seal the most important point of view among human senses?
However, the conditions for clearing the ban were not the only ones.
―Here in the 《Forest of Trials》, hunt monsters with the ban on and survive for 7 days.
Suddenly, the game of survival began.
Jaehyun dyed his hair white. What is the reason for such an ordeal?
restraint of vision.
It was not a joke because of its name.
Humans have countless senses. Jae-hyun attained the status of a half-god by gaining divine status, but he was still half-human.
The current ban was no different from telling them to overcome it.
Five senses.
It is said that transcendental beings fully control it and pioneer their own realm.
However, it will be difficult for Jaehyun, who has not been able to handle the 3rd stage of liberation properly yet. His mind gets more complicated.
‘Looking at it, this must be several times more difficult than popping the bell.’
The importance of what you see cannot be overstated.
People get frustrated because they can’t see what’s in front of them.
I’m relieved that I can’t see it in front of my eyes.
There is no one who doesn’t know that the idiom that everything can’t be avoided just by looking away came from him.
‘Anyway, I have to be calm.’
Jaehyun thought so, swallowing even the self-talk that had become a habit by now.
It is a situation where there is a restraint of vision. It goes without saying that making noise is dangerous.
It’s an extreme situation where you don’t know when and where you will be attacked.
Because of this, Jaehyun repeatedly thought about it. And cautiously take a step forward.
The ban seemed to have moved a great distance, but in reality it had only moved forward very little.
However, it was possible to infer some information from that alone.
‘First of all, this is a forest. When you hear the sound of the leaves being stepped on, the estimated time is the beginning of autumn or winter.’
Coincidentally, it was the timing when hungry beast-type monsters were infested.
―Activate the active skill 《Magic Power Detection》.
Jaehyun moved on.
Figure out the information. And prepare for the threats to come.
The senses that helped Jaehyun survive as a radar for the past time shine and focus his attention.
It was evolving him in a better direction even at this moment.
Krrrr….
And.
From the moment Jaehyun realized something, he heard the demon’s cry from somewhere.
low-pitched cry.
At that point, I couldn’t help but feel a terrible fear for the first time in a while.
It’s been a long time since I’ve felt fear from a Witchbeast that wasn’t a being with divine power.
―Active skill 《Formation of magic tools》 is activated.
Jaehyun summoned Balmung, a great sword with a wide attack range.
Nidhogg’s fangs and Tyrbing, which are mythical level, are superior in destructive power, but in a situation where vision is prohibited like now, it was judged that a longer reach would be more advantageous.
Jaehyun didn’t stop there, he also activated his magic.
―Active skill «Frozen Earth Lv 5» is activated.
Quadd Deuk!
It was when Jaehyun raised his mana to wipe out the enemy at once.
―The user’s magical power is mixed with divinity!
―The first ban, 《The ban on weight》, is applied.
Jaehyun’s body trembles. Only then did one thing the system said come to mind.
[During the ordeal, all prohibitions overlap.]
* * *
Members of Nine induced Modi and Magni to a subspace in Seoul.
A place that is several times larger than the place where the shipboard party was held in the past.
It was based on the judgment that no matter how fierce the battle would be here, there would be no big problem.
Things will get better if Jaehyun returns quickly after passing the ordeal.
“I’m sorry for entrusting you with such a heavy burden. We will do our best to help.”
“Do not worry! I’ll try my best!”
To Yoo Sung-eun’s sorry words, Kim Yoo-jung cheerfully replied.
Yoo Sung-eun looked at Kim Yoo-jung’s eyes for a moment.
Did such a bright child try to sacrifice himself for his comrades? that scared kid
I thought again that the world was ironic.
In the name of Radar, the world is using countless children as tools. It is to treat it as one’s own defense and to use it politically.
Just listen to the recent speech of the Global Radar Alliance.
They portray the Adversary and the Nine as heroes and are thinking of using them as a fence to protect themselves.
They, too, must be guessing. Because they are smart kids.
But it doesn’t show it outwardly. It is probably because of their kindness and a sense of debt to the people they need to protect.
Looking at it, no matter how much Yoo Seong-eun is a radar to the bone, one side of her heart felt cold.
It broke my heart that there was so little he could do.
Since she had hardly experienced anything like this since she was on the S-class radar, those feelings grew even more.
“Do not work too hard.”
“We have no intention of dying either. And… Jaehyun is coming. You just have to hold out until then. It would be best if we could get them out of our line, but… we’re still just taking our steps.”
Ahn Ho-yeon speaks calmly.
He never overconfided in his own strength. It was an unusual reaction for those who recently gained strong strength and received the highest newly established grade of S+.
It was calm. And it doesn’t shake.
‘A lot has changed. This child too.’
Yoo Sung-eun thought so and looked at Ahn Ho-yeon’s swaying gray hair for a moment.
In the past, Sungeun Yoo and Hoyeon Ahn were put on Yeonhwa’s recruiting list and then canceled.
Because, as a radar, he showed serious flaws in the most important areas.
just mental. It is as if there is no foothold for the weak to grow higher.
‘Honestly, I thought Hoyeon wouldn’t be able to grow as much as her talent. But… it wasn’t. Now he’s stronger than me.’
There was only one reason why that was possible.
presence of reappearance. It made everyone stronger.
both mentally and physically.
Yoo Sung-eun was to the extent that her student’s current skills could not be measured anymore.
Because Jaehyun was the top radar in name and reality, and no one can deny that.
She just hoped he wouldn’t have too much of a burden.
No matter how strong he is, he is his disciple. As a teacher, seeing them suffer was bound to break my heart.
“Should we stay here to get in the way?”
Yoo Seong-eun’s words. Nine members nodded.
The word hindrance itself carries a bit of weight, but it was true.
The enemies approaching them now were at a level that S-class raiders could never stop.
Yoo Sung-eun and Park Seong-jae were much better supporting them from behind.
“I’ll ask you from behind. We’ll do our best to stop it.”
Even Kim Yoo-jung said that, and Seo E-na agreed.
“…Now that Jaehyun is gone, this is the best. Please trust me.”
“Of course I believe.”
Yoosung smiled brightly. Seongjae Park felt the fierce hostility slowly felt from behind.
It was something that was difficult to bear.
next.
All right. All right.
A landscape that cannot be believed to be modern came into their eyes.
Two men on horseback were running furiously toward us.
Yoo Sung-eun and Park Seong-jae have already fallen a little from the battle scene. It was only natural that they were given the role of supporting them from afar.
Jaeshin Lee and other members of the Raider Union were blocking giant gates from elsewhere.
Over the past six months, large gates have become more frequent, just like these red gates.
It really meant the arrival of Ragnarok.
“That’s… that’s for sure. He’s a guy with magical powers similar to Heimdall’s.”
Those were the words of Kwon So-yul.
She had experience of being directly attacked by Heimdall during the camp in the past.
This meant that they could feel their magical power most vividly.
Seo Ina also affirmed.
“…that’s right.”
“Are you allies of the adversaries?”
Modi and Magni, who were riding horses in front of them, spoke in front of them.
The horse gallops vigorously.
Sparks flew from him, proving that the horse was a great horse even at first glance.
“We are the sons of the thunder god Thor. He personally arrived in Midgard to slay the opponent.”
“…Are you going to attack Jaehyun?”
At Seo Eana’s words, the two beings immediately affirmed.
“Of course. He is the enemy of the Æsir. Because that’s also the prophecy’s steadfast opponent. But before that.”
“I decided to kill you first.”
Modi and Magni said so while talking to each other.
Then the earth shook with a roar.
cooong!
I feel the ground splitting into several pieces and the center of gravity leaning forward.
Magni chuckled. He thought for a moment as he got off his horse.
‘He’s strong for a human. also has the ability But all of this is for naught if you are not given the time to grow properly. Even if you blame me in Helheim, it’s already too late!’
Magni’s body was shot straight at Kim Yoo-jung. However, the members of Nine were not taken aback and corrected their posture.
Ahn Ho-yeon shouted while blocking Kim Yoo-jung’s way.
“Yoojung!”
“okay!”
At that moment, Magni saw a shocking sight.
Kwaaang!
human… He dared to block his own attack, which is said to be comparable to that of his father, Thor, in terms of pure strength.
It was not a situation that could be easily understood, no matter how much mercy was put into one’s hands.
“What is this…!”
The system I heard then.
―Active skill 《Soul Link》.
―Four party members (one absent) handle the attack together.
And when their health drops below a certain level.
Just in time, Lee Jae-sang, who was waiting behind him, quickly drank a potion to recover his HP.
Then, along with Lee Jae-sang’s physical strength being restored, the other people’s HP bar gauges began to rise.
“A weakling has his own way of struggling.”

If I can’t fight a winnable fight, I will create a winnable situation.
It was the most efficient way for weaker comrades without representation to fight.

I didn’t mean to scare you on purpose, but it was a statement that couldn’t help but receive the stinging gaze of the party.

Then

Mimir. The one who first told me to attack the control tower here.

Jaehyun nodded slightly while looking at the newly popped up quest window.

B formation. It was the absolute defensive formation that Jaehyun had taught me in the past.
“what? Enemies?”

And the moment he tried to confirm his identity by shooting his magic there.

He is the only being who can find the way to the World Tree.

A guy like that lets others climb the tower where Asgard’s secrets are hidden?
‘It can’t be. At least if it’s the child I know.’

At that moment, an emotion pops up in Jaehyun’s head.

wouldn’t Ratatoskr be able to do great damage to Odin?

Hella nodded in agreement.
Only Lee Jae-sang spoke in a very low voice.

he muttered softly.

“Hey Min Jaehyun. But can I really trust him? According to Norse mythology, Ratatosque is the one who antagonizes Nidhogg and the nameless repairman, isn’t it?
So, isn’t it right to assume that they are lying to us as well?”

Because Ratatosque is portrayed as a malevolent being in mythology.
An existence that keeps Nidhogg and the nameless repair apart and makes them fight each other.
That was the essence of Ratatosque.
