He was just curious.
How could such a small squirrel be able to come and go in Yggdrasil, where these high-level monsters are infested?
And whether what he said was really true or not.
In order to confirm this, it was necessary to take a certain risk.
“My dear—here it is! If you go this way, the door to climb the spiral tower will open! The ta-tower is made up of five tsu-layers!”
spiral tower.
Familiar words leaked from Ratatosk’s lips.
‘As expected, this guy must know something.’
Jaehyun was sure.
Just now.
She had never told him that Yggdrasil was made of a spiral tower.
That means at least Ratatosque knows the structure of this place.
And it meant that Jaehyun and his colleagues were worth using him.
“That Yggdrasil has five floors. Please explain in detail.”
Jaehyun said in a high-pressure voice.
Ratatosk’s eyes widened anxiously, but no one took his side.
It was natural. They are Jae-Hyun’s colleagues, and while living by his side for a long time, he learned Jae-Hyun’s cold-heartedness.
It was a natural thing for a radar.
In order to survive, he must not be seduced by the cute (?) guy in front.
“Tatata—the tower is made up of two crossroads. Nanana—from the name Spiral Tower, that’s true—but—”
“Two crossroads?”
Simply put, this meant there were two ways to climb the tower.
Jaehyun crossed his arms as if telling him to continue.
“Everything—but here, nothing—there is a problem! That-that’s- Yggdrasil can’t go up to the top floor unless you conquer both paths!”
“therefore. Should we divide into two teams and climb the tower?”
“G-g-g-yeah!”
“How can I believe you?”
Ratatosque was startled by Jaehyun’s words, so he raised his front paws and slapped them.
“Gee, gee—I’m not lying!”
Jaehyun smiled. Acting as if he was waiting for the words to fall.
A cool smile lingered on his face.
“good. As you said, we will divide into two teams and climb the tower. Instead, if everything you said was true.”
Jaehyun reached out his hand towards Ratatosque.
Magical energy leaked out of his hands, stayed in Ratatosque’s body for a while, and then went up the magic circuit of his head.
“Sasa-sasa- save me!”
Ratatosque shouted in horror, but surprisingly nothing happened.
Because Jaehyun had no intention of attacking him from the beginning.
―Active skill 《Subordinate》.
I just had to take certain steps to ensure that his words could be trusted.
Jaehyun lowered his head and a shadow fell on his face.
“Should I sign it?”
“Aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!”
* * *
Thanks to the success of the dependent skill, Jaehyun realized that everything Ratatosk said was true.
In addition, the fact that it was he who actually separated Nidhogg from the nameless repair.
“As long as you have this skill, you cannot lie to me even if you die. So take care of yourself and act well.”
“Aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah”
Jaehyun clearly threatened.
The squirrel in front of you is a dangerous guy.
How could he be able to go back and forth between the venomous dragon Nidhogg and the nameless repair? How can such a thing be possible if one’s tongue is cunning…
“…Jaehyun-ah, so how will our team be divided?”
Seo Ina looked around and looked at Jaehyun and asked.
Now, with Ratatosque’s guidance, they have arrived at a huge hollow.
After passing through the rusty door and reaching the inside, there were two high-dimensional portals inside as he said.
It was probably the gate to go upstairs, as the guy said.
“If you climb the two portals at the same time—the left side and the right side—the left side and the right side—the test to climb the tsutsu-floor will begin!”
The floor consists of five floors.
It’s like an ordeal.
In order to move forward, the things to be done on the floor are set, and only when you succeed in this, you can reach the next floor.
Jaehyun had a moment of doubt and asked while looking at Ratatosque.
“Yggdrasil is a place where you can go up only after enduring such a test… How can you just go up and down?”
“So-so-I’m a little bit-a special case! Tae-tae-tae—because I was born with this tree from the beginning, I’m not affected by this—aaaa—not!”
“Right.”
A being born with Yggdrasil.
Jaehyun looked at Hella with a questioning face, but she didn’t seem to know the details either.
The reality of Ratatosque. Jaehyun’s curiosity about it continued to grow, but he decided to hold back for now.
I don’t have time right now, and I have no choice but to climb the tower with this guy.
Spiral structure tower.
It is possible to reach the end only by riding through two portals at the same time.
A mistake here meant that he would soon die.
“For now, as this guy said, I’m going to divide the team into two.”
Jaehyun said as if he was declaring first, then looked back at the party.
“First of all, please go with Kim Yoo-jung, Ho-yeon, Jae-sang, Hyung, So-yul, and Hella.”
Jaehyun naturally wanted to form a team with a balance of power.
And inevitably, the one on his side has no choice but to be stronger.
Therefore, after arranging Hella and colleagues with strong utility in one place, Jaehyun planned to bring only one member with good compatibility.
“okay.”
Kim Yoo-jung replied with a dissatisfied expression, and the rest of her colleagues quickly agreed.
“Since our forces are clearly weak, it will be safer to stay together. Yoo-jung’s soul link or Prime Minister’s potion So-yul’s search will also work to your advantage.
If there is also Hella, there will be no big problem.”
Ahn Ho-yeon accurately analyzed the situation, and the others nodded as well.
“okay. okay.”
“All right. We do our best to help. It’s not even an ordeal this time.”
Jaehyun looked back at Seo Ina this time.
“Inaya. You will come with me.”
“…huh!”
Seo Ina was joking with a slightly excited expression.
Jaehyun grabbed and dragged Ratatosque as he slowly walked towards the opposite team.
“Where are you running? You are here too.”
“Let’s go—let’s eat it, but mama—please don’t!”
“Um… Come to think of it, I’ve never eaten squirrels before. Is it delicious?”
Ratatosque was frightened by Jaehyun’s sly words and took a backward step.
“Hehehehehehehehe!”
In response to his reaction, Jaehyun moderately relaxed his expression and said.
“Don’t worry. don’t eat There is a guide on the other side, but there is no guide on this side, so I just take him. It would be different if there was nothing to eat inside or if you didn’t listen to me.”
It was as he said. The reason why he takes Ratatosque is because he needs a guide.
There was Kwon So-yul with the search skill on the other side, but not this one.
The danger that Jaehyun could detect with the sentences of mana detection and sense amplification was very close.
It wasn’t very helpful for identifying traps in the distance or finding a quick way to the next floor.
If that’s the case, it’s a matter of taking a guide with you in the end.
Moreover, the dependent skill was reproduced to the last. There was no reason to leave him alone.
After making a decision, Jaehyun headed to the left of the huge hollow.
Seo In-na chased after him, and the rest of the members stood in front of the transmission portal on the right.
They took a deep breath and looked at Jaehyun.
“Everyone is doing well. I’m sure you’ll be able to clear it. Then let’s meet on the 5th floor.”
“okay.”
“Only trust us!”
Ahn Ho-yeon and Kim Yoo-jung were the first to respond to Jae-hyun’s words, and soon they completely disappeared under the light of the portal.
However, at that moment. they didn’t know
The huge iron gate of the empty common they passed through.
that it slowly began to close.
* * *
The center of Asgard. Thunder God Thor’s room.
Reports of shock and grief followed.
“My… my son was killed in action? Both of them…?”
Thor’s eyes widened as he listened to the report of the confidant sent to observe the adversary. Right now, he was clenched in fists, engulfed in the greatest rage he had ever felt in his life.
It’s something that makes absolutely no sense.
No matter how half they are, they are the sons of Thor, the god of thunder.
Not only that, but didn’t he hand over the artifact and instruct him to defeat the enemy?
I paid attention to all safety and thought there would be no problems.
By the way… lost?
my sons?
“Ha ha ha ha ha!!”
Thor burst into madness as if he had lost his mind. It didn’t calm down at all.
A dark murderous intent lingered in his eyes, and a cold smile formed.
But it didn’t mean much.
All of his sons have already passed away.
It was virtually impossible to go to Helheim and bring them back.
As long as Hel guarded the place, there was no way he would give himself a way.
“Adversary… Damn bastard… I will definitely strike and kill you…!!”
The time when Thor’s anger clearly filled the room.
Suddenly, along with a knock, a familiar voice was heard.
“Thor. Odin has called.”
“Hugin…”
Thor accepted, gritting his teeth.
He knew very well why Hugin and Odin were looking for him.
He sent his son to attack the enemy without giving any instructions.
Even failing to do this, he consumed all of Asgard’s divine power that he had accumulated so far.
You want to hold him accountable.
“Tell me I’m going.”
However, Thor also had many things he wanted to ask about this time.
the sorrow of losing a son. That’s big too, but now he’s the opponent.
Because the doubts and anger toward him were many times greater.
“I will kill myself with my own hands somehow. Adversary… I’ll make sure you pay the price for the mere human who touched the god of thunder.”
Thor’s clenched fists trembled, and the real Thunder God’s lightning bolt surged for a moment before disappearing.

Episode 321 Golden Labyrinth (1)
[You have reached the first floor of the Spiral Tower of Yggdrasil.]
[ The tower gives appropriate rewards to climbers whenever the tower is successfully cleared.]
Ina and Jaehyun.
What lay in front of the two was a huge, shady maze.
“Where are you?”
Jaehyun immediately asked the squirrel next to him to figure out the location.
Ratatosque rubbed his front paws and said.
“My dear—this is the first layer—. Maze—this is where the maze is!”
“maze?”
“G-g-yes! If you clear the way and reach the end of it, you can go to the next floor.
Depending on your skills—you can even get treasures in hidden rooms in the maze!”
“Mirror.”
Jaehyun looked around quietly.
A labyrinth composed of seemingly enormous magical energy.
It seemed that it was designed so that it would not break even with its own magical power or divine power.
I tested it with strength just in case, but the result was as expected.
“Because the hardness is ridiculously millet-level, it will be uh-difficult to break!”
“I have to find a way. Ratatosk. Have you memorized all the roads?”
“Ah-a-a-a-sorry, but every time I come here, the location changes—it changes—I don’t know the details—.”
“Okay, so be quiet for now. Inaya, I’ll find the way, so could you help me look around?”
“…huh! Leave it to me.”
At Jaehyun’s instructions, Ina nodded with a clear expression.
Inside, she seemed happy that she came here with Jaehyun.
It was all for the proper distribution of power, but it was all the more so because the opportunity for the two to be together was rare.
Didn’t you stay together for a long time because Jaehyun quickly recovered during the last hospitalization?
‘…Of course, if I lie down for a long time, that’s just a concern.’
Seo Ina thought about that with a wry smile.
Fortunately, Jaehyun quickly found his way. It seemed to be the effect of the skill that allows you to sense magical powers he had told you and his colleagues last time.
Ratatosque also detects persistent mana and finds his own way.
Poppy was sniffing hard at the floor because Jaehyun had put it on the floor a while ago.
“I think it’s this way. But there seems to be something strange on the other side. Rather, the magic power is felt more on the other side than on this side. Is there a Ratatosk reason?”
“That’s because the legacy of the Golden King is over there!”
“Golden King?”
“That—yes!”
Jaehyun put on a slightly embarrassed expression at the name he had never heard before.
I thought I had thoroughly studied Norse mythology. It seemed that there were beings that he didn’t know about yet.
“A man called the Golden King… what the hell was he doing?”
“He was—truly mad about gold—crazy! In the past, Barbaba—a Viking tribe—wandered around in search of gold with countless people—.
I’ve heard that he died while tampering with the treasury of the gods!”
“hmm.”
What the golden king stole from the treasury of the gods.
That is the legacy of the Golden King, said Ratatosque.
Trying to touch the treasure house of the gods? I thought I had a lot of guts.
‘Hella told me before. A warehouse that stores the treasures of the gods of Asgard. It is called the treasure house of the gods, and there are a lot of artifacts of an enormous level hidden there.’
But the doubts remained.
“Why is a guy like that in Yggdrasil?”
“It’s because Odin stuffed him here in order to punish those who have ta-greed.”
To sum up Ratatosque’s words: In the end, it was said that the golden king was now stuffed here because he was caught by Odin while robbing the treasure house of the gods.
Ratatosque added that this labyrinth is also called the Golden Labyrinth, and many races who tried to climb Yggdrasil in the past lost their lives here.
Suddenly curious, Jaehyun asked.
“Golden King. What the heck did he stole from the treasury of the gods?”
It is not difficult to pass through the maze like this.
However, I wondered what the golden king was trying to take away by sacrificing his life so much.
Ratatosque said with a worried expression.
“Well, I don’t know either, but at least I think it’s a mythical artifact.”
A mythical artifact?
Jaehyun felt his eyes light up.
At that moment, Ratatosque quickly put his hands together and shook his head as if he felt the magic rising from his eyes.
“Ha ha ha—but Odin hee—the golden king endowed with power must be strong! At least the third stage of liberation—maybe even more—!”
Jaehyun wondered why humans could have such strong power, but Ratatosque quickly solved it.
“Hwahwahwa—the golden king wasn’t strong from the beginning—!
I heard that after being stuffed in Yggdrasil by Odin, he received power from him and now has the same sense-ability!”
Ratatosque was relieved, as if he thought Jaehyun would not fight the Golden King, but Jaehyun’s answer was completely different from what he expected.
“It’s worth a try.”
Jaehyun nodded his head confidently.
It is a mythical artifact hidden in Yggdrasil.
Wouldn’t that make your next journey much easier?
In addition, now I have a new S+ class artifact, a glove. It was a stronger reenactment than when he was fighting Modi and Magni.
There was no reason to hesitate.
Seo Ina also nodded.
“…Nothing comes without risk.”
“Looks like you know the conditions to reach the golden king’s legacy. Why don’t you guide me when I say good things?”
Even if it’s a labyrinth whose position changes every time you come, if he’s to the point of calling himself a guide.
It was only natural that Ratatosque knew at least a hint about the Golden King.
Jaehyun was almost certain.
He must have known something about the hidden room.
Meanwhile, Ratatosque broke into a cold sweat and opened his mouth to deny Jaehyun’s words.
“Well, I don’t know-.”
―The subordination effect is activated. Subject is lying.
At the sound of the system, Ratatosque lowered his head, thinking that he would die.
“Ah! I’m sorry. I know-.”
“Look at this. It’s because lies don’t work, right? Let’s not lose our strength.”
At Jaehyun’s words, Ratatosque’s expression turned thin, as if shed tears at any moment.
However, looking at Jaehyun, Seo Eana just thought that he was the same as usual.
‘…Jaehyun seems to be in good shape today.’
She thought so and smiled like a good thing.
* * *
Odin’s golden palace located right in the center of Asgard.
Odin is seen sitting on the throne, and Thor is seen bowing beneath him.
Conversation between father and son. However, the conversation between the father and son continued in a colder atmosphere than usual.
The reason was simple.
“It’s not enough that you didn’t even dare to give the mission, and you messed up the job. Did you mean that you dedicated two of Asgard’s sacred objects to the enemy?”
The heavy fall of the words and godhead put pressure on Thor’s entire body.
Thor bowed his head.
“…has no face.”
Thor lamented having to apologize.
In fact, for him who had lost his son, he was in a difficult situation even if he was comforted.
However, now that the war broke out, it was not enough to consume the divine power arbitrarily, so the sacred object was taken away.
others.
In particular, it was natural to be criticized by Odin, the leader of the Aesir.
unavoidable.
Thor endured this while looking at Odin and speaking calmly.
“As much as I disappointed you, I will bring more glory to Asgard. I beg you. Give me a chance.”
“What do you mean by chance?”
Odin narrowed his eyes. It was as if Thor had been waiting.
“Adversary. Please let me take care of him with my own hands.”
“Not now. I haven’t fully recovered my sanity yet.
You must have learned from the deaths of your lowly sons that he is not someone you can deal with with a hasty spirit.”
humble son.
Odin looked at his two sons and said so.
Thor gritted it.
Although he was a dead son to himself, to Odin, he was nothing more than an expendable item for the Æsir.
In fact, even that wasn’t the right thing.
Didn’t he think so too?
The two of them are just things that only serve one person when they are together.
“Wait until all your spiritual power is restored. Then I will give you one last chance.”
“thank you.”
It was around the end of the conversation between Odin and Thor.
Suddenly, the floor shook black and a being crawled up.
Odin asked in a nervous voice.
“What’s going on?”
“Something went wrong.”
problem.
It wasn’t a word that Hugin, cold-hearted in everything, uttered often.
Odin quickly realized the seriousness of the word and asked.
“Is it related to the adversary?”
“yes. The news is that the adversary and his companions have begun climbing the Tower of Yggdrasil. They say you have already reached the first floor.”
“I started climbing Yggdrasil… is that really true!”
Odin asked, rarely showing emotion.
Hugin only nodded silently.
“That’s right. It even seems that he already knows how to climb Yggdrasil, as both portals are active.”
“That can’t be…”
Thor, who was listening to the story from the side, shook his head.
The anti-Aesir gods were not even allowed to climb Yggdrasil for a while.
Besides, haven’t the conditions for climbing Yggdrasil changed recently?
But the adversary knows how to climb the spiral tower to the upper level?
This was obviously impossible.
at that time. Odin cut off his words and raised his head.
“Ratatosk. That’s what he did.”
“Certainly, that squirrel seems to have potential. Because you are one of the few who will defy the will of the Great One.”
Hugin agreed and nodded.
Ratatosk.
He was born with the birth of Yggdrasil, and during the war 10,000 years ago, he did not stand on either side.
What could the little squirrel do in the first place?
Because of this, Odin didn’t even pay much attention to him.
But this was a mistake.
He knew the structure of Yggdrasil better than Odin did, and he knew how to climb the newly remodeled tower.
So, when I tried to kill him recently, it seems that I ended up on the side of the enemy.
Odin’s concern deepened.
Yggdrasil.
No matter how strong he was, there was a limit to interfering with the foundations connecting the world.
It might be possible to go up to the 2nd and 3rd floors at most, but it would be difficult beyond that.
Although it was not likely that the adversary would reach the top floor, it was true that it was a serious problem.
‘I don’t know why the adversary moves toward the world tree. But he hadn’t moved meaninglessly until now. There must be a reason.’
“First, find out why he is moving. You Thor, move too.”
“All right.”
For some reason, Odin couldn’t get rid of the ominous feeling.
Why the adversary climbs the tower at this point.
Why is he, who has recently grown to the point of being able to kill Modi and Magni, doing something close to such an eccentricity?
The top of Yggdrasil’s Tower.
hidden layer.
Odin was determined to kill him at this opportunity, by any means, if the opponent was aiming there.
at any risk.
He will keep the secret there.

chapters.content:
Episode 322 The Golden Labyrinth (2)
The Golden King.
Ratatosque finally gave up and started explaining in earnest, guiding the way.
Of course, about half of them were due to Jaehyun’s threats.
“Hwahwa—The Golden King was a legendary man! He-he coveted gold, but never harmed people. Choi Choi – They say he did his best to take care of the weak!”
It was an unexpected story.
When I first heard of it, the Golden King was nothing but a grave robber. It seems that there was a surprisingly healthy corner.
‘Well, the bad guy was always Odin. Even if he’s a nice guy, there’s nothing strange about it.’
“Sure—he loved humans—and he treated other races gradually—without discrimination!
Hwahwa―there were many stories that even aimed for gold was actually to help them too―but―.”
“Odin must have arbitrarily altered history.”
“Ah–I’m thinking it’s very likely!”
Seeing that Ratatosk thought the same, it seemed that his thoughts were roughly correct. Well, it’s similar. I’ve been through it countless times so far.
Odin has always arbitrarily usurped people’s lives and used them as he pleases.
Thirfi and Roskva. Fafnir et al.
I used and discarded various beings to suit my taste.
He’s such a guy, but it wouldn’t have been a problem to harass even one more human.
‘I am one of those victims.’
Jaehyun briefly recalled himself before returning, but erased it from his mind.
Now I’m standing by your side.
What if she gets hurt by selling her mind elsewhere?
That really couldn’t have happened.
the insignificant past.
Or maybe it’s a future that I didn’t know that would happen.
It didn’t matter anymore.
Jaehyun needed to see the present and move on.
“An arrow trap this way. Over there, when you step on the footrest, a huge stone rolls down. be careful.”
With that thought in mind, Jaehyun was easily destroying the trap.
Basically, his physical ability was at the 3rd level of divine personality liberation, but it was more correct to say that it was more than that.
How many mythological artifacts and S-class or higher items did he have?
As long as they are all in effect, Jaehyun will not be defeated by beings of the same level as himself.
It was for that reason that he went hunting for the Golden King.
It’s because I’m sure he won’t be as great as he is, no matter how great items he packs around.
“By the way, what weapon does the Golden King use?”
“Ii—as the name suggests, it handles molten gold, and basically ja—it is known to handle long spears!”
“Right.”
It is likely to be a tricky enemy.
Jaehyun made that decision.
‘Enemies using spears cannot easily close the distance. I’m used to using swords, but I rarely use spears. Until now.’
With cold eyes, he recalled for a moment the most famous spear wielder in Norse mythology.
Odin.
It was he who possessed the legendary spear that said that if he left the hand called Gungnir, it would pierce the opponent.
The fight now is likely to be helpful in the battle against Odin later.
No matter how excellent an artifact is, there is no way it can consistently hit the enemy.
Close the distance as much as possible and pay attention to horizontally swinging attacks while dealing with enemies.
‘can win.’
widely.
While Jaehyun and Seo Ina Ratatosque thought so, the steps stopped at one point.
“Is this here?”
“G-g-yeah!”
“…It looks like there’s something dangerous inside. You have to be careful, Jaehyun.”
It was as Seina said. In front of them was a huge golden recognition device.
It seemed to be an equation designed to open when mana was injected. It was a method that Jaehyun was quite familiar with.
“don’t worry. don’t push yourself too hard Understand?”
“…huh.”
a golden king
‘Should I check how it came to be?’
Jaehyun thought and carefully channeled his mana into the recognition device.
Tsutsutsutsutsu…!
However, for some reason, the Golden King’s room didn’t even show any reaction.
However, the ensuing message only informed him that he had failed.
―Recognition release failed.
Jaehyun tilted his head.
“what? a failure? Are there any other conditions?”
“…I think so.”
Seo Ina agreed.
Along with him came a voice from the middle of a labyrinth-filled cavity.
[Those who can pass this place, those who are recognized by the King of Gold.]
[Those who covet gold, shining gold here.]
[Those who covet gold, here sparks that take away lives.]
Two sentences with meaning.
The sentences were difficult to grasp immediately, so Jaehyun frowned.
This place was almost similar to the Trial of the Giant that he had gone through in the past.
Hrungnir’s Trial.
Jaehyun went through trials that tested countless wisdom there.
The voice heard in this maze is also almost identical to that one.
Interpret the hidden meaning, solve it, and move on to the next.
Perhaps that is what the Golden King is asking for from Jaehyun.
Jaehyun first repeated the two most important keywords.
‘Brilliant gold and life-consuming flames.’
It’s brilliant gold…
Jaehyun pondered for a while at the words of the Golden King’s recognition.
Soon, he took out an artifact from his inventory.
“…is that… Draupnir?”
“that’s right. I feel like this is what I need to be recognized by the Golden King.”
I thought it was as easy as possible.
The Golden King has the meaning of a person who coveted gold from the name.
It does not change the essence of how noble values were pursued.
Then, one conclusion.
give me gold
‘Draupnir is a bracelet that increases to 9 every 9 days. The inventory is already overflowing to the point of rotting.’
Jaehyun held Draupnir to the recognition device first.
―Recognizer 1st lock unlocked.
– Recognized by the Golden King.
―Disable the following devices.
“It must be bingo.”
“…I always feel that Jaehyun-ah, you’re really smart…”
Seo Ina said with her eyes twinkling.
Jaehyun is second again. He focused on the flame that took away his life.
Soon after, the next answer came out.
Jaehyun brought Poppy who was sniffing on the floor and put it down in front of the sensor.
and instructed
“Papi. Fire your breath at that device.”
The reason why Jaehyun gave Papi such an order was simple.
A spark that consumes life. Wasn’t it white fever?
In fact, Papi’s white flame has shown a great effect on the undead and the undead. Therefore, the life-consuming flame requested here is most likely a white flame.
Poppy toddled and approached the recognition device.
Kreureung!
I heard a much more threatening cry than before, perhaps because I had grown a little. It was a cute (?) cry like a dragon, one of the dominant species in the nine worlds.
Jaehyun smiled.
―Active skill «Dragon Breath (Back)».
At the same time, the white flame inside the recognition device and the duplicate of Draupnir that I had just dedicated were mingling with light.
Following.
―The second condition has been met.
―The reader is unlocked.
Awesome profit!
Jaehyun smiled. Because the door was finally open.
* * *
“Wow… I am amazed every time I see her unique skill. How can you find your way so quickly?”
“It is definitely a great ability. There must be a reason why Jaehyun chose you as a team member.”
The exact same place as the dungeon that Jaehyun and Seo Ina are targeting.
I could hear the voices of my colleagues from other portals here. Now, it was Kim Yoo-jung.
Seeing Kwon So-yul, who had just activated her unique skill and found all the directions of the road, she was envious inside.
Kwon So-yul smiled and patted her on the shoulder.
“Your soul link is even more amazing.”
“no. Well… from now on, I won’t be able to save other people like I did back then…”
Kim Yoo-jung said that with a slightly gloomy expression.
The context of what she is saying now. It was simple.
The promise I made with Jaehyun.
Kim Yoo-jung sighed, recalling the conversation she had with him a few months ago.
[therefore. Never. In the future, don’t use Soul Link in the way you sacrifice yourself. Because I can’t accept it.]
[Ah, I got it.]
[Did you really understand?]
Jaehyun asked, looking at Kim Yoojung. She was averting her eyes.
What that meant was clear.
I can’t tell. The next time this situation comes up, I might use my ability again.
The reason Jaehyun was able to understand this was as follows.
This is because Kim Yoo-jung’s frequent behavior when lying is to avert her eyes. Of course, Jaehyun was well aware of this.
Hana Jae-hyun was much more elaborate than Kim Yoo-jung thought.
Knowing this, he set one more condition.
[Because you say you reflect that much. Let’s make one thing clear.]
Meanwhile, Jaehyun activated a skill on Kim Yoojung.
subordination.
It was a skill to conclude an irresistible contract between the opponent and oneself.
There, Jaehyun suggested only one thing to Kim Yoojung.
Never sacrifice yourself to save others.
Kim Yoo-jung ended up signing there… Now, Soul Link can only be used to help the team members thoroughly.
Sacrifice is not allowed. Because that was the condition for reproduction.
“Still, I think it’s a good thing. Whenever there is danger, if Yu-jeong tries to sacrifice herself, Jae-hyun will start a fuss again. Even if you don’t, you have an eccentric personality…”
“That’s true…”
Kim Yoo-jung muttered in a small voice at Hella’s words.
I was grateful to Jaehyun for worrying even though he didn’t say anything. The proof was that her cheeks were a little hot.
“Still, I think we need to go a little further, so cheer up. I don’t think there are any separate monsters.
It does get a signal from one place… but I think it was made to trap people who went in the wrong direction.”
“It’s too much…”
Lee Jae-sang shook his head at the fact that the tower went that far.
Kwon So-yul busily searched for the road, wondering how Jae-hyun would be doing by now.
He’s a great junior and even has a guide, so there’s probably nothing to worry about.
On the contrary, they would be worried about themselves. if that guy
“Then we go quickly. Jaehyunie always got ahead of us… shouldn’t we also get ahead of ourselves sometimes?”
Everyone in the party nodded at Ahn Ho-yeon’s words.
Deep down, Kwon So-yul was annoyed by the existence that turned out to be a monster on the other side of the exit… but
decided to pass it on thinking it was some kind of MacGuffin.
Jaehyun is not around anyway.
There was absolutely no reason to do anything dangerous.
* * *
Thanks to Draupnir and Papi’s breath, Jaehyun is a hidden place in the maze. You have succeeded in reaching the Golden King’s room.
It was a very special place, like a hidden room.
Just like when Fafnir’s nest was discovered in the past, there was a lot of gold and white flames were burning from the torches hanging on the walls.
[This is the Golden King’s room…]
At that moment, the voice continued again.
Jaehyun listened closely and took a closer look at his surroundings.
A little while ago, through magic detection, I knew for sure that there was a demonic beast here.
But I couldn’t guess what was going to happen here.
‘It would have been fine if Soyul sunbaenim was there, but… I can’t do it right now. If a dangerous situation arises, I have no choice but to prepare immediately.’
when you made that promise.
A huge skeleton holding a spear appeared along with a system message.
―A stuffed 《Golden King》 has appeared in Yggdrasil.
―Free the soul of the Golden King.
He wore a Viking helmet on his head and held a huge polearm in his hand.
The golden king was there.
Jaehyun asked him according to the system message he heard.
“Did you say the golden king… are you an ally or not?”
He raised his head and opened his magic.
“Enemy?”
It was a question that was truly reproducible.

Episode 323 The Golden Labyrinth (3)
[I am… a brave Viking… a golden… king…]
The golden king seemed to be out of his mind.
Jaehyun frowned and looked ahead.
‘Do I need to be beaten a little like Fafnir to come to my senses?’
It’s probably Odin’s work.
Through brainwashing, he has been harassing those who disobey him. The representative being was Fafnir, whom Jaehyun had.
Jaehyun noticed Seo Ina by his side.
It was a kind of sign that he had to go into battle now.
Fortunately, she understood right away and brought out her new weapon.
It was a small wand, but it fit very well with her innocent image.
A wand beautifully decorated with white patterns on an old tree.
Light leaks from there.
―Active skill 《Fire Strike》.
A bursting spearhead. It was a concentrated fire.
The judgment was correct.
Excessively large range attacks destroy the enemy’s weak point, which is not good.
Of course, if it was an extremely strong attack, it could destroy at least one floor, so there was no particular problem, but there were only a handful of people capable of such destructive power.
According to Ratatosque, in the past, Loki had destroyed an entire layer, and it took hundreds of years to restore it.
‘I don’t know what the hell he’s doing. The only thing that’s certain is that I’m not insane.’
Jaehyun quickly put aside his thoughts about Loki and opened up his godhood. It was to maximize the attack power by opening the godhead following magic power.
―The godhead is opened.
―Active skill 《Mana Weapon》.
A skill that turns one’s entire body into a weapon. Its power needs no explanation.
Jaehyun continued to use his magic.
―Active skill 《Formation of magic tools》 is activated.
―You have succeeded in producing the artifact 《Nidhogg’s Fang》.
He leaped lightly, feeling the synergy between the glove and weapon that clung to his hand.
Diving between the fire strikes fired by Seo Ina, he freely changed the trajectory in the air.
It was because the size of the golden king reached almost 2m.
It wasn’t as tall as a giant, but it was a height rarely found among humans.
There is a high possibility that it will become a difficult enemy.
Jaehyun sighed as he thought about it. It expands its own muscles and shoots at the enemy.
―Active skill «Leap in the air».
Jaehyun activated the air jump twice in a row and then lowered the dagger in his hand once.
It was an attack aimed at the rib area, one of the few vulnerable parts of a skeleton.
However, unlike his size, the golden king showed agility and resisted Jaehyun’s attack.
Caang!
The tips of the spear and dagger collided with each other, creating a wild gust of wind. A sharp pain crept up in my wrist.
After catching his breath, Jaehyun took about ten steps back. He thought as he looked at the unshakable enemy in front of him.
‘I blocked it too. Doesn’t that mean that the nickname of the golden king came about because of greed?’
Jaehyun’s mouth twisted.
I didn’t think I would be able to defeat him with one shot from the start.
When Jaehyun’s attack didn’t work, Seo Ina quickly looked at him in front of him.
In order to support him at any time, it was necessary to check each other’s condition.
Contrary to her thoughts, however, Jaehyun had an expression that looked like he was having fun.
In fact, Jaehyun’s eyes were clearly drawing an arc.
‘It’s rather good. With an enemy like this, I can try out my new skills and items.’
He reacted that way because he was genuinely interested.
Recently acquired gloves and items.
In order to use all of them properly, it was necessary to fight in advance with an enemy who was not a good match, but equal to him.
Now, even if he fights with other S-class raiders or colleagues, the gap with himself is too big, so it wasn’t very helpful.
It is not until he fights against the gods or giants of the anti-Aesir coalition that Jaehyun cannot properly test his strength.
‘But doing so would draw too much attention. I couldn’t even ask the others to fight because Odin would be picking up our movements.’
However, the current situation is different.
Yggdrasil.
This is a target to attack anyway, and Jae-hyun must do his best here. To this end, Jaehyun reached the 3rd level of divine power liberation and attained full status.
Therefore, it means that there is no problem at all even if you show all your skills here.
“Ratatosk, you know how to hide.”
“Hehehehehehehehe! That word—!”
Jaehyun raised his mana, leaving behind the frightened squirrel.
Did you say golden king?
No matter how strong he was, Jaehyun had no intention of losing here.
[I… have to protect…]
The unknown story of the golden king came out, but Jaehyun just shrugged.
“It looks like you have a problem too… but I have a lot of things at stake here too. I’m sorry, but I can’t lose.”
Jaehyun immediately thrust out his dagger.
Once again, the enemy’s spear and dagger collided, sparks flying on each other’s blades.
Jaehyun felt the pain rip through his palms, but he didn’t waver.
It was because the current situation was rather willing to reproduce.
The enemy seemed a little taken aback when his spear did not reach Jaehyun.
Jaehyun laughed.
‘It’s not like he doesn’t have intelligence at all.’
After making a decision in a short time, Jaehyun identified the enemy’s strengths.
‘Anyway, the Golden King seems to be the type to wield a spear based on his strength. It may seem clunky, but it is one of the most effective methods. If it’s an enemy who lacks strength, he’ll be defeated in no time.’
However, Jaehyun only smiled. He immediately opened his magic.
―Active skill «Frozen Earth Lv 5» is activated.
A terrible chill that froze the surroundings. The resulting power instantly cooled the temperature in the huge room that had been filled with heat a moment ago.
The Golden King was flustered and clicked his chin.
Jaehyun did not stop there.
―On/Off skill 《Megingijord’s Blessing》 is switched to ON mode.
―Strength stat doubles.
Jaehyun recalled for a moment the skill window he had seen immediately after obtaining Megingijord in the past.
A smirk spread across Jaehyun’s lips.
* * *
When Jaehyun continued to attack.
From Mimisbrunn, the sound of two people talking could be heard.
Loki, who has the familiar appearance of a young boy with red hair.
And Mimir, the giant who guards this spring, was right there.
It was Loki who spoke first.
“I would have thought that the adversary had already climbed Yggdrasil. After all, he’s great.”
“Say that. It’s faster than you thought.”
Mimir nodded in agreement.

maybe others. In particular, if a human had used that belt, it would have been okay if he could not stand the force and became a corpse or collapsed by now.

Chae Ae-Aeng!

bang!

and last minute.

While Jaehyun was flustered, a pure white light flashed in his vision.
before losing consciousness. Ratatosk’s voice is heard.

‘What the hell is this…!’
Jaehyun was taken aback, but soon came to his senses.
Has the system sent itself to a harsh place once or twice?
It wasn’t surprising at all.
When Jaehyun, who had made up his mind, tried to calm himself down. My vision slowly began to return to normal.
What followed was the story of a certain king.
At the same time, a low voice like a subtitle resonates in my ears.
[This is the story of a king who loved a certain people.]
* * *
[This is the story of a king who loved a certain people.]
For some reason, when the same story was told again, Jaehyun first checked to see if his comrades were all right. .
Fortunately, Seo In-na and Papi Ratatosque were all together.
Anyway, I cleared the stairs, but it wouldn’t be a problem if there was a penalty.
Jaehyun thought so and looked around.
‘This is… in the memory of the Golden King during his lifetime.’
He could intuitively understand.
The scenery he could see reflected the audience room of a certain kingdom.
Also, on the throne there was a king with a distraught face in a filthy appearance.
He was holding his forehead with both hands.
At that moment, I hear the voices of the servants standing next to me.
“Odin told me to send a tribute this time in September.”
At those words, the king groaned briefly. He said, suppressing his frustration.
“How much gold did you ask for again this time?”
The servant hesitated for a moment at the king’s question, then closed his eyes and answered.
“He told me to prepare at least twice as much as before. He also said that if not, he would spread a plague in the country next year.”
[…I guess they are people who serve Odin. … Judging from the situation, I don’t know why, but it seems like I’m being threatened…]
Seo Ina spoke to me through telepathy.
Jaehyun nodded.
Perhaps the Golden King was one of many humans who served Odin at first. But something had happened and it seemed that his faith had faded.
‘There is a high possibility that the amount of gold that has to be given as a ‘tribute’, which is being talked about, has had an effect on his faith.’
If the amount of tribute to be paid is too large, there will inevitably be disruptions to the kingdom’s operation. If anger builds up from it, there is nothing strange about it.
Jaehyun pondered for a while and then conveyed his thoughts.
[It seems that greed didn’t make him the Golden King. The same goes for the first sound of the system.]
It’s the story of a king who loved his people.
No matter how you look at it, the system is trying to tell the story of the hidden golden king.
No, it would be more accurate to assume that Yggdrasil was doing that.
“Can’t we collect tribute somehow?”
The king said with a worried expression, but the servant shook his head.
“Impossible. As long as you don’t raid a dragon’s nest…”
“Ask Odin for a little more tail…”
“That’s also impossible. Because Odin said he would not wait any longer…”
“…I see. Somehow, I will find a way within today.”
The scene cuts off there, and not long after, the scene continues.
* * *
“Are you serious?”
The king is standing in a different place than before.
Nearby stood a man who appeared to be the captain of the guard.
He is looking down from the top of the great wall that surrounds the border.
There, their people are starving to death.
A small determination dwells in the sad king’s eyes, and at the same time, the narration continues.
[Odin demanded more tribute each year. As each day passed, more people died of starvation and poverty, and the king was forced to suffer from deep guilt and worry
.
“I will hit another country. If you don’t somehow collect the gold and give it to Odin, all the people will die. There is no other way.”
“But… that’s not your way, is it?”
[The king was never someone who coveted someone else’s for his own.]
[However, the helplessness of having no way and the guilt of having to somehow save the dying person in front of him forced him to move.]
The king looked sad and twilight . He said while looking at the ground.
“Yes…yes. Not my way… but I can’t help it.”
The scene moved on to the next scene. The king gathers an army and gathers those who have not eaten properly to attack the neighboring country.
“Kill the enemy soldiers immediately! Otherwise, our people will die!”
The captain was at the forefront.
The king is also commanding the soldiers from the front.
It was not a common sight.
Anyway, the king who has to survive until the end is fighting at the forefront.
The king of the enemy country and his entourage raise their voices as if grieved.
“Why are you attacking our kingdom! Weren’t you our ally?! You know what you’re doing!”
The king said nothing.
[It was probably the king’s guilt. Even though it was a foreign country, it was a country with friendly relations where they exchanged goods and stayed together.] [
However, they eventually had to make a choice. In order to protect my family, I had to kill others in order to protect my people.]
[Finally, the king subjugated the enemy country and took away a lot of gold. In the end, the king was able to pay tribute to Odin that year.]
* * *
Jaehyun and Seo Eana. And Ratatosque said no more.
As the screen continues.
His more miserable life continues to be projected.
* * *
The king fought battle after battle, but the tribute he had to pay increased each year.
The men of the village had to be taken to the battlefield when they turned 15, and more than half of them returned dead.
But if you don’t pay tribute, everyone will die.
The king had to choose.
Because that was better than everyone dying.
It was a bitter utilitarian conclusion, but there was no other way.
The king continued to attack other nations, search for treasure… and slay dragons.
But even so, he continued to suffer in agony.
The amount of tribute Odin demands increases each year.
This is because it was not at an acceptable level.
And one year,
an epidemic broke out in the kingdom that could not pay tribute.
About 70% of the total population died.
The only survivors are the king and a few of his closest aides.
And there were only sturdy men in the army who could fight.
* * *
The king realized.
He was tricked by Odin.
That this hell will never end by paying tribute.
People continued to die, and he was furious.
But at the same time, he wanted to save even the survivors.
because.
The king, who loved his people, made a decision.
[I will raid the treasure house of the gods.]
The treasure house of the gods. It was said that there were full of weapons of the gods.
The king reached there, got the treasure, and tried to kill the god, Odin to be exact.
However, such a miracle could not have happened to him, who was only a human being.
Eventually, the king was captured by Odin. said Odin.
[As a reward for daring to stand against me, you will kill the people you love the most with your own hands.]
The king died miserably by Odin’s magic.
Also, with death, he was born as a new being.
While stuffed in Yggdrasil, he killed the people and countless humans who followed him, and the corpses formed a mountain.
Soon the king became greedy and did a foolish thing.
His story was so erroneously passed down in the world that we call it the miserable words of a foolish human who challenged God.
The story of a king who coveted gold ended so miserably.
At the end of the continued narration, Jaehyun felt his fist tighten without even realizing it.
[This is the story of a certain king who coveted gold.]
―The story of the golden king ends playing.
* * *
Jaehyun, Seo Ina, Ratatosque, and Poppy were all able to return to reality.
It was thanks to the end of all memory regeneration.
Jaehyun nodded for a moment. In front of his eyes was a golden king who had not yet died.
Jaehyun looked at him and opened his mouth slowly.
“I was told from earlier that I had to keep it that way. Were they your people?”
The Golden King said he didn’t care even as he watched his body crumble.
“Yes. My people… died at my… hand… I… was cursed…”
“Cursed for sure. Because Odin stuffed you here.”
Even as Jaehyun said that, he looked at him with a sad expression.
golden king. With only a skeleton left now, he was trying to get himself up somehow.
Jaehyun thought of the first time he met Poppy.
At that time, he lost his self due to the curse caused by Andvari’s ring.
I couldn’t move my body freely because I was playing in Odin’s hands.
As for Jaehyun, the situation then and now seemed to overlap.
“Kill me…”
“Yes. I’ll kill you even if you don’t look at me like that. You look so ugly now compared to when you were alive.”
“Thank you….
”
Jae-hyun activated Divinity Usurpation and took away his dignity.
The level given by Odin.
I can’t bring them all, but for now this is the best. Jaehyun reminded himself that he had to become stronger quickly.
“I… I…”
then.
The Golden King continued to open his mouth to say something.
Jaehyun shook his head.
Due to the aftermath of the skill, the golden king’s bones began to fly. It was impossible for him to say anything now that even his mouth was gone.
However, Jaehyun already knew what he wanted to say.
“It is not your fault.”
It was Odin who killed the people.
It wasn’t your fault in the first place.
Jaehyun swallowed the last two words and watched the golden king scattering away. Looking back, I saw Seo Eana’s dark expression.
She bit her lip sullenly.
“…There must have been countless people who have fought like this… until now, right?”
“…okay. I was one of them.”
“…How could you do this…”
Seo Ina lowered her head in disbelief.
It must be because I became emotional because I came to see the memories. Because she’s not used to this yet.
But you have to accept it.
Because this is reality.
It’s disgusting, but it’s real.
What happened after Odin seized power after the first Ragnarok.
It is impossible to undo all this.
The past has already passed.
In the death of the giants he saw in the mirror of Urd, Jae-hyeon realized that.
What you can do should always be sought in the present.
“let’s go. to the next floor.”
Because of that, Jaehyun had no choice but to say that.
Seeing his determined expression, Seo Ina nodded.
Jiying.
With the complete death of the golden king, a portal was formed in the throne he was standing on. Jaehyun and Seo Ina intuitively realized that it was to head to the second floor.
The moment when the two people and the two animals who had completed their mental preparations were about to move to the next layer.
[This is the last present I can give.]
Everyone stopped for a moment at the sudden voice.
Then, an unexpected message came to my ears.
[You have attacked the 1st floor of the Spiral Tower with the hidden route.]
[The Golden King’s Legacy (Myth-equipment item) will be given to each.]

Shocked.

just as expected.

The only corner to rely on here is Lee, the weakest!
Is this a story that makes sense?
On that day, Kwon So-yul felt like he wanted to see Jae-hyun for some reason.

After Jaehyun and Ina Seo cleared all the 1st floor.
The two were sent to a place.

A place to take a break after settling rewards before attacking the next floor. It was probably the place Yggdrasil had prepared for the climbers of the tower.
By the time Jaehyun and Ina Seo came to their senses.
The system sound that had been heard a while ago was heard again.
This was something the two of them had been waiting for.
[You have attacked the 1st floor of the Spiral Tower with the hidden route.]

You have obtained the key to the treasure house of the gods.]

what a mythical grade?

Seo Ina said as she shared her item window with Jaehyun.

(Cooldown 2 hours)

get drunk

Very few, but anyway. Judging from the current situation, this must have been the graveyard.

It will probably be the main key to clearing the quest and going to the next floor.

‘I don’t know the details, so it’s first to put it on hold and figure out the situation.’

He strode up to the gravekeeper and tried to ask something.
It was then.

Jaehyun’s heart started beating fast.
* * *
Odin’s throne. Hugin stands tall beside him.
he said, lowering his head.

thought Odin, repeating the titles that qualifies him over and over again.

That he would die to the adversary and lay down everything he was holding.
But Odin didn’t think so at all.

Then, at the end, Odin spat out the one word he had been thinking about all along.

* * *
“You are a stranger.”
“Hehehehehehehehehehehehe!”
A grotesquely bent neck.

Jaehyun asked calmly, wary of him.
“you’re right. How did you know?”

“Aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa ‘interference of the stairs’.

Jaehyun immediately understood the meaning.
It means that Odin noticed that he was climbing Yggdrasil and interfered with it.
I had heard from Hella that this might happen, so I was preparing my mind.
Yggdrasil.
The moment you set foot here, Odin can’t help but notice your movements.
What the anti-Esir coalition members had told him was still clear in his ears.
[Anyway, I have no choice but to overcome them and climb the tower. Odin must be frantic to kill you.]
[That’s right. If you’re not careful, you’re bound to die. There’s no way we can do anything about it. Now you and your colleagues have no choice but to make an accident properly.]
‘Anyway. Because it doesn’t defy expectations. Odin, this rubbish.’
That’s when Jaehyun noticed the change.
I felt a sticky gaze in front of me.
Jaehyun lifted his head and looked ahead. Suddenly, the grave keeper was facing Jaehyun’s face with two menacing eyes.
He said.
“This is the tomb of the ‘one who walks again’.”
“The tomb of the one who walks again?”

―The main quest 《Tomb of the Re-Walker》 has arrived.
―Displays quest information.
[Main Quest]
Tomb of the Re-Walker
Avoid the Re-Walkers, find the hunter here and defeat him.
TIP) Make full use of hide points hidden throughout the map.

Jaehyun tilted his head.
What in a cemetery like this?
Do you want to play hide and seek?
“Beware of those who walk again.”

Odin’s golden eyes were shining like they were burning, clearly showing his anger.
He said looking at Hugin.
“Did the adversary truly conquer the third floor?”
Hugin, who was waiting next to him, looked at him and bowed his head.
“That’s right. The signal just came.”
“…I used up what little divine energy I had left… I never thought I’d let this result come out. What a disappointment. Hugin.”
“I have no face.”
Hugin said that and bowed his head.
It had to be.
It was because he was the one who had corrected the contents of the 3rd floor quest a while ago.
Starting from the 4th floor, even if it is Odin, it is impossible to intervene in the floor with the remaining divine power.
So it should have been sorted out on the 3rd level, but this all went to nothing.
It was a strange situation for Odin not to be angry.
“I can’t help it now. no one can stop him I have no choice but to wait for it to stop on its own.”
“There is no way we can get our hands on him any more, at least until we get out of Yggdrasil.”
At Hugin’s words, Odin clenched his fists.
“Can not help it. I will revise my plan. Focus on collecting the three ‘Stars of the Distant Abyss’. Gather them all and overturn the prophecy as soon as possible.
can you do it?”
“Is there any?”
At Odin’s instruction, Hugin bowed his head once again and replied.
He soon became a shadow and disappeared to the ground.
Then Odin looked out the window and thought for a moment.
“The adversary… Indeed, as the three Norn sisters said, destiny is something that cannot be easily changed. But… I am Odin.
The star floating at the highest point of Asgard and the one who realized all the truths of the world. That is me.”
I will never give in to fate that has been foretold.
Around the time Odin muttered that and was about to sit on the throne again.
A knock was heard.
“It’s Freyja. I will go in.”
“Come in.”
Freya with the answer. She appeared before Odin.
After losing Sigrun, her expression was more ferocious than ever before. She strode to stand in front of Odin and said.
“I lost my favorite knight. Odin… How will you compensate?”
“I’ll give you any amount of gold.”
“Do you think I came to you looking for something like that?”
“If not, will you go directly to Helheim and bring Sigrun? How are you?”
“You are trash. Odin. How many times are you planning on continuing this dirty war!”
cried Freyja, looking at Odin with contempt.
However, Odin remained solemn as if he did not care at all.
“A good leader is not a good and generous person. He is the one who wins the war and defends what is mine.”
“Tell me where the adversary is.”
“He is currently in Yggdrasil. However, Thor decided to kill him first, so your order will be next. Plus… His strength hasn’t recovered yet.
If you want to kill him too, help him recover his divine power.”

“Remember. Freya. You are a stranger to Asgard as a hostage. Now you are in the position I have taken over.”
“Such sophistry! You were the one who raided Vanaheim and destroyed the world! I have no reason to be loyal to you.”
Odin laughed.
“So why didn’t you come up with a reason?”
Freya’s pupils shook.
It was an action that revealed his inner feelings, not befitting the leader of the Valkyries.
she bit her lip
Odin added one last word.
“If you don’t want to see it again, listen to me. Freya. Become my dog and take possession of all nine worlds. That is what you must do.”
why do you say that

chapters.content:
Episode 341 Master Sword
Jiying!
with a shattering halo of light.
Jaehyun arrived in a room that was all white.
A familiar space now.
It was a resting floor prepared to take a break every time you climbed each floor.
After a while, you will receive a reward for clearing the previous floor here.
Maybe this time, too, I’ll give you something useful.
‘Huh……’
Jaehyun, while sweeping his chest in relief, did not hide his happy expression.
It was natural.
So far, Yggdrasil has always given herself the best rewards.
Give climbers trials and rewards appropriate for their level of difficulty.
Because that’s the only rule of Yggdrasil.
‘In addition, I copied Odin’s mythical skills.’
Jaehyun laughed at that thought.
As difficult as the ordeal was, the reward this time was quite large.
He briefly opened the skill window.
What came to mind was, of course, Odin’s newly acquired skill.
[Active skill]
Name: Storm of madness
Rating: Myth
Creates a storm of madness and swallows everything in the nine worlds.
When activated, temporarily gives allies a ‘Passion’ buff.
*Consumes 20% of total horsepower per use.
*The power increases whenever the number of people caught in the storm increases.
*caution! The longer you hold it, the greater the consumption of magic power and the mana rebound, so special care is needed.
[Passive Skill]
Name: Passion
Rating: S+
Gives courage to all allies and puts them in a ‘passion’ state.
Increases attack power and active skill effects by 40%.
*This is a skill that is automatically activated when a maddening storm is active.
* Whenever the number of people receiving the buff increases, the caster’s body is strained.
* Effect amplification is limited for some skills.
Jaehyun instinctively realized that this skill was one of Odin’s Feasts.
First of all, it was the fact that 20% of the total horse power was consumed at once.
‘Recently, I’ve never experienced a lack of magical power. But… it’s a skill that consumes 20% of the total magic power with a single skill?’
This would be the same number applied to Odin.
This means that at least the power of the skill is unmatched by others.
For reference, in the radar system, there is a special move that consumes consumable goods such as horsepower or physical strength of the same percentage.
Usually only S-class radar can be used. It was a skill that brought out power several times greater than that of the user by sacrificing something of himself.
For example, instead of killing oneself like absolute zero, it was a season that allowed one to get along with the enemy with a low probability.
Those who had these skills could hardly be found, and most of them consumed their own life force, so the risk was enormous.
‘Even if it replenishes the mana… 20% of Odin’s mana is well over hundreds of thousands of times that of other S-class raiders.
If it’s a skill that he has to pay that much for and use, then it should be seen as a stronger season than anything else.’
At least the power of the Thunder God he possesses. It was certain that it was more than that.
After Jaehyun decided to check the power of the skill later, he shifted his gaze to the other side.
“The next one is this way…”
Next was the special effect of the skill.
There were two peculiarities there.
The more people caught in the first storm, the stronger it becomes.
This, needless to say, meant that this skill was effective as a wide-area skill.
Honest and accurate explanation. After testing, you will be able to know how to use the skill with more certainty.
Passive skill ‘Passion’ is activated when the second storm of madness is active.
After reading the effect carefully, Jaehyun was convinced that this was a fraudulent skill.
“To amplify both attack power and skill effects by 40%… isn’t it crazy?”
If this was a game, I would have nothing to say even if I was scolded for making a mistake in the balance patch.
Of course, there is a penalty that the burden on the user increases whenever the number of allies increases, but it was the best skill even after all that.
‘I’ll have to take a chance and test this one later.’
The test was difficult because we are currently attacking the tower. In order to know the exact power and range of the skill, you have to activate the skill several times, but the conditions for that are not ready.
Therefore, Jaehyun decided to postpone the use of the skill for a while.
“…ha. For now, you can safely break through to the third floor.”
“…huh. somehow.”
Seo In-na nodded in response to Jae-hyun’s words.
Ratatosque freaked out and grabbed Jaehyun’s crotch.
“Datadadada—from now on, please say something in advance and do it! Ji-I really thought I was going to die this time!”
“It was an epilogue anyway.”
“…No matter how liars this time, Ratatosque is right. Jaehyun, you often do dangerous things.”
When Seo Ina said that, Jaehyun smiled lightly.
“That’s the case with you too. pretend you forgot me Did I really almost cry?”
It wasn’t a lie.
Seo In-na pretended to smoke and averted her gaze for a moment.
she murmured softly.
“…That’s because you’re late… without me knowing…”
“Okay. sorry. It’s just something I’ve said, so don’t take it to heart.”
“…huh. You should do as little risky things as possible from now on.”
Seo Ina said that with a slightly flushed face.
In fact, it was natural for them to talk like that.
No matter how fragmentary it is, the Wardanaz that Jaehyun encountered was Odin.
A legendary god who guards the top of Asgard.
To suddenly run into such an existence…
This meant that he would die at any moment.
‘If it wasn’t for Odin’s lost eye, he would have died instantly there.’
Odin’s lost eye.
Paradoxically, this was the reason Jaehyun was able to survive when he encountered Odin.
A skill derived from Odin’s lost eye.
Had it not been for the power of ‘absolute arithmetic’, Jaehyun would have been swept away by the maddening storm as soon as it started.
“It must be that there is still a long way to go.”
When Jaehyun said that, Poppy flew onto Jaehyun’s shoulder and sat down, raising his feet. Seo Eana also stood by him and showed a firm smile.
“…But you can’t go alone now.”
At that, Jaehyun smiled.
at that time.
Suddenly, Seo Ina fidgeted for a while with a pod in her hand, then spoke.
“…You asked when I entered the 3rd floor earlier. You are going through emotional fluctuations, but why am I okay… The reason I said I’m fine… Do you think you understand a little bit now?”
She smiled.
It was brighter than any smile she had ever shown.
The most unpretentious smile.
Seeing that, Jaehyun couldn’t do anything other than nod.
A feeling that has yet to be answered.
As if a drop of paint had been dropped into the depths of his chest, it spread slowly and squeezed his chest.
Jaehyun made a promise.
One day I will sort out all of this.
And at that time, wouldn’t we be able to get closer to each other?
Not only to Seo Ina, but to all of her colleagues.
“Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh, good luck! This time Gigi—I really thought I was going to die!”
“okay. thanks for your help Ratatosk. I will trust you now.”
“G-g-g-then Joe-if you release the subordination a little-no-it won’t work! haha-.”
Jaehyun narrowed his eyes for a moment. His mouth was tightly shut.
‘That’s it. Because this is it.’
Leave no risk factor.
That was Jaehyun’s basic code of conduct.
“Now… then, is it finally time for compensation settlement?”
“okay. Then slowly.”
―The compensation settlement for the 3rd floor of the Spiral Tower of Yggdrasil begins.
Jaehyun crossed his arms.
“Shall we settle the reward?”
* * *
Outskirts of Asgard.
In an inn room on the other side of a remote slum, Tyr is seen suffering from a hangover.
He was distraught from having had a great time here last night.
Her clothes are disheveled and her upper body is barely covered with a gown, and traces of last night’s hot love affair remain everywhere.
There was a huge sword mark on his upper body that looked like it had been crossed by a greatsword. It was a wound that had suddenly formed during the battle at the time of the first Ragnarok in the past.
The ugly face of a drunk man.
It was a look that could not be thought of as a god of war and justice.
But then.
Suddenly, Tyr’s eyes suddenly open, and a voice flows from him.
“Hmm… I didn’t expect you to come find me.”
Along with his icy voice, a shapeless black figure began to sway from the long pure white curtains.
Eventually, it took the form of a person.
No, to be precise, there is a crow in it.
It would be more accurate to call it a monster in human form.
“Is that so.”
The owner of the voice heard was none other than Hugin.
He parted his lips as he watched Tyr rise from the bed.
“First, I would like to tell you one piece of news.”
“What do you mean by news?”
“The adversary has broken through the third level of the Spiral Tower of Yggdrasil.”
Tyr’s eyebrows twitched as he calmly adjusted his clothes and rose from his seat.
He paused for a moment and looked up at Hugin.
“…That’s kind of hard to hear.”
“I guess so.”
Tyr clicked his tongue and said.
“You talk like it’s someone else’s business.”
after. Tyr let out a short breath and stood up.
“so. Why did the great Odin’s raven visit me?”
“There is something I want to ask you.”
Hugin was so lucky.
Tyr said, spreading his arms as if to please.
“Ask anything. Odin’s raven.”
There was a moment of silence after that.
Tyr tilted his head. It was because he felt that Hugin’s behavior was strange somewhere.
I had a hunch that the question he would ask of himself would be trivial.
just as expected.
The story that followed after the silence was enough to disturb Tyr’s mind.
“Tir-sama, have you ever met an adversary? From 10,000 years ago in the past.”
“What do you mean by that?”
Tyr had no choice but to respond to his words.
It was unpleasant.
There was no way he could remember anything like a human being at most, and the opponent was a kid who had been born less than 20 years ago.
It means that even if it has gained a status, it is nothing more than slightly better trash.
Even more so, 10,000 years ago must be referring to the time when the first Ragnarok took place in the past.
At that time, I can’t remember the person I killed…
“He looks like this. At the time of the Red Gate, I was not in a hurry, so I brought it thinking that I couldn’t see the face properly.”
Hugin held out a picture of the enemy and said,
and that moment.
“uh?”
An embarrassed voice came out of Tyr’s mouth.
He couldn’t help but be genuinely perplexed.
‘What is this?’
I don’t know, but… Tyr was convinced.
He knows this person.
I also remembered seeing it at the time of Ragnarok 10,000 years ago.
After all, just like that damn crow said.
Even though it’s just a blurry fragment…
Tyr started to think over and over again to remind himself of the enemy called the enemy in his scattered mind. However, the memories continued to scatter.
In the sea of memories drifting in the form of fragments, he remained silent.
* * *
With system notes, the time for settlement of rewards has arrived.
Jaehyun listened quickly to the voice and confirmed the information.
What will TOP give to himself this time?
With a swollen heart, Jaehyun confirmed what he had newly acquired.
It wasn’t an artifact at all, as I thought.
―The 3rd tier clear reward is given.
―The Climber has cleared all 《The Dragon Slayer and the Song of Tragedy》.
―Receive the protection of Sigurd.
―The crafting level of the dragon slasher Balmung has increased by 1!

Episode 342 Alfheim (1)
“It can’t be like this… Why do I know this guy?”
Tyr muttered in shock as he put his hand on his forehead.
He was looking at the photo of the adversary and comparing it with his own memories.
It was to remember where I had met him in the past.
However, there were no significant results.
The more he tries to do something, the worse the headache gets.
Because no memory came back.
Just 10,000 years ago, in a certain war, he met an opponent.
There, he himself…
“I confirmed that he knew it, so it was okay. I’ll just go there. I have business to deal with.”
As Hugin said that and was about to disappear, Tyr glared at him and said,
“Explain the situation.”
“I am Odin’s raven, not Tyr’s.”
It was an obvious line drawing.
Tyr couldn’t say anything. no matter how crow he is
He was directly connected to Asgard’s strongest Odin. There was nothing he could gain by fighting back now.
‘Damn… once I sat there…’
God of War and Justice.
Tyr was a god who had power over Asgard before Odin.
Although he is now pushed to the rear after being defeated in the battle for supremacy with Odin, it was true that his reputation in the past was comparable to that of Odin.
“…it is. First of all, you will know that. However, once things are sorted out, you will have to explain this to me. It’s not like I don’t have that much authority, right?”
“of course.”
After Hugin disappeared like that. Tyr sat alone in his seat, blankly.
I didn’t feel bad until yesterday.
Today, thanks to that, the aftertaste has become bitter.
It’s not too bad, but thanks to his gloomy personality and Odin’s favor, the Æsir gods’ evaluation of him was not so good.
Just being Odin’s crow and he’s the one who delivers Odin’s opinions.
And being a being who can handle emotions as he wants.
That was all.
Tyr sighed as if he couldn’t help it.
For now, the only thing left to do was to see how Odin and Hugin would move.
also.
‘Why is there an adversary in my memory now? We need to find out why a youngster who was born less than 20 years ago existed 10,000 years ago. That comes first.’
Tyr was determined to find out somehow.
adversary. What is his true identity?
Why was he able to use primordial magical powers and being born with the best talent along with Odin and Loki as a human subject and growing so fast so far?
The moment Tyr’s thoughts reached that point,
he began to wonder about the name of his opponent for the first time.
* * *
―The 3rd tier clear reward is given.
―The Climber has cleared all 《The Dragon Slayer and the Song of Tragedy》.
―Receive the protection of Sigurd.
―The crafting level of the dragon slasher Balmung has increased by 1!
“…what?”
Jaehyun couldn’t help but be genuinely surprised.
It was the news he had been waiting for so far.
Dragonslayer Balmung.
Strengthening the weapon that was being used well by copying it from Balak from the beginning.
This was bound to be of great help to Jaehyun.
‘Recently, I’ve been using Nidhogg’s fangs as my main focus, as each grade is a grade. The fact that it could grant a deadly poison effect was also great.’
The one that Jaehyun has been using the most lately is Nidhogg’s Fang. It was easy to use because it was a dagger, and it had good synergy with a mythical skill, so it happened without my knowledge.
Because of this, Jaehyun has been feeling regret lately.
‘Because each weapon has its own characteristics. In particular, the greatsword is excellent in that it has a long reach and can cut more enemies at once.
But I couldn’t use it in the battle with the most important gods.’
Balmung, which has not been brought out recently, except for special circumstances such as the visual ban.
However, representation can now overcome limitations.
Upgrade from S-class to one level!
It means that Balmung has finally reached the status of a myth.
With a throbbing heart, Jaehyun lightly poured magic into his hand.
―Active skill 《Formation of magic tools》 is activated.
With the activation of the magic, blue spheres gradually gathered from Jaehyun’s hand, and soon began to take the shape of a greatsword.
However, this was quite different from what Jaehyun knew.
The huge dragon’s teeth marks were engraved everywhere, and the overall size of the greatsword became larger.
That wasn’t all. Balmung has changed to fit his hand even more.
As if it had been a reenactment from the beginning, the balmung was wrapped around the hand from the hilt.
From there, a black and red aura like a greatsword of a dragon slayer overflows.
Tsutsutsutsutsu…!
Jaehyun experienced the power of a completely different weapon from before.
Just by holding it, I could tell that the sword had changed.
‘Destructive power as well as sharpness has become incomparably stronger than before. It’s an absurd growth rate.’
As soon as Jaehyun’s mouth caught his ear, the sound of the system continued.
―I succeeded in crafting the artifact «Dragon Slasher Balmung (Myth)»!
Dragonslayer Balmung.
Jaehyun smiled as he looked at the advanced martial arts.
Now with this, he has a total of three mythical weapons.
To be precise, it would be more appropriate to say that there were three craftable weapons.
Jaehyun continued to check Balmung’s changed detailed description.
[Equipment Item]
Name: Dragonslayer Balmung (Crafting Item)
Rank:
The beloved sword of Siegfried (Sigurd), an ancient human hero who killed the mythical Fafnir.
Received the protection of the dragon slayer and was strengthened to the limit.
Effect
1. Strength + 200 / Agility + 100
2. Passive skill 《Dragon Slayer (Myth)》 Acquisition
Jaehyun smiled at the newly acquired skill 《Will of the Dragon Slayer》.
[Passive Skill]
Name: Will of the Dragon Slayer
Grade: S+
Inherit the will of Sigurd the Dragon Slayer.
Instantly recovers 20% of the user’s stamina once in an extreme situation.
As described in the skill, this is when Jaehyun’s endurance has fallen to the limit. It was a skill that could recover 20% of it only once.
Jaehyun couldn’t help but admire.
endurance.
Jaehyun thought about the first time he leveled up after the change to the Nornir system.
At that time, for a while, Jaehyun invested almost all of the stats he gained after leveling up into endurance.
The reason Jaehyun did that was simple.
This is because the stat called endurance is directly related to Raider’s survival.
when performing repetitive activities. And when the radar is pushed to the limit.
A power that allows you to instantaneously exert power beyond your limits.
that’s endurance
‘Of course, in a state where stamina has fallen, I can’t fight properly.’
However, the will of the dragon slayer was when this stamina ran out. It is a skill that allows you to recover 20% of your stamina at once.
To put it simply, it was no different from the meaning of being able to withstand the crisis of dying once with endurance.
‘In a word, it’s a dog scam.’
Jaehyun reverse summoned Balmung with a happy expression.
Then, he approached Seo Ina and asked.
“Did you get anything good?”
“…Ah yes. It seems that way… but even after reading the contents, I’m not quite sure what it is.”
For some reason, what Seo Ina got was not an item, but a skill.
Jaehyun tilted his head.
“Is it too difficult to explain?”
“…I think so. Would you like to take a look…?”
Jaehyun nodded and Seo Eana showed him her skill window.
Looking at the skill window, Jaehyun put on a slightly embarrassed expression.
[Passive Skill]
Name: Royal Family
Rating: ???
Detailed skill descriptions will be revealed when certain conditions are met.
To fulfill the conditions, you must head to Alfheim, the time of the first Ragnarok, 10,000 years ago.
“Go to Alfheim 10,000 years ago?”
No matter how I look at it, I thought it was strange.
At the point where the second Ragnarok took place, I was told to head to the kingdom of the elves where the first Ragnarok took place?
How is that even possible in the first place?
“…There must be a reason…?”
By the time Seo Ina muttered so quietly.
As if trying to clear the doubts of the two, a system sound was heard.
―The waiting room usage time has all ended.
―Transfer to Yggdrasil Spiral Tower’s 《Fourth Layer: Ancient Kingdom of Elves》.
* * *
Jaehyun’s colleagues’ reward for clearing the 3rd floor was truly eye-opening.
A ‘case’ that is an extension of what was obtained in the immediately previous layer.
Yggdrasil gave it to them as a reward for clearing the tower.
“It’s not quite enough to reach the first level of liberation yet… but that’s good. If things go smoothly like this, within a few months we will reach the first stage of liberation.”
Hella was also surprised, but said so in the most calm tone possible.
Of course, it was not a perfect godhead like Jaehyun.
It is virtually impossible for them to grow up there in the first place.
However, as a human being, he has taken even a small step towards the transcendental realm. It could never have been acknowledged.
Hella recalled for a moment the time when Jaehyun first gained divinity and obtained ‘divine usurpation’.
At that time, he fought against Heimdall while controlling his unstable magic to save himself.
But now their colleagues are trying to reach that level little by little.
Even though he couldn’t reach Jaehyun’s toes, it was unavoidable.
Arrangement of the system and innate talent.
No matter how you look at it, Jaehyun was truly a monster.
‘Because he’s that kind of person, they probably want them to reach him like they are now.’
Hella thought about that and nodded her head slightly.
“We are stronger.”
Ahn Ho-yeon recalled the battle and clenched his fists.
“As strong as the shadow guys I dealt with earlier. We have become stronger too.”
“you’re right. you are growing I will vouch for it.”
When even Hella said that, Kim Yoo-jung and the other members’ noses twitched slightly.
However, smiles soon spread across their lips.
There was still a long way to go.
Jaehyun is waiting for them in a far away place.
So I can’t be satisfied with that much.
They all thought so and burned with a sense of goodwill.
* *
* ―Transfer to 《4th Layer: Ancient Elven Kingdom》 of Yggdrasil Spiral Tower.
On the other hand, the time when my comrades first gained their status and were lost in thought.
Jaehyun finally arrived at the next layer.
4th tier. The kingdom of the ancient elves.
Jaehyun frowned and opened his eyes.
He muttered, looking around.
“…This is the world of elves. Is it Alfheim?”
All around were grassy fields and tall tall trees.
As I read in the myths of the past, there were entangled vines. In the fresh air, fairies with pure white light fly around.
There was a scent of magical power that was much thicker than that of Midgard.
A place full of life.
but then A fishy smell spread through Jaehyun’s nose that he shouldn’t have felt here.
That moment.
Kreung!
A beast in the shape of a dog flew in from somewhere and rushed to bite Jaehyun’s shoulder.
As Jaehyun expanded his field of vision, he felt three beast-type monsters nearby.
Jaehyun was sure. It was an unpleasant, sticky smell that I felt a while ago.
“…Blood. There must be someone dead.”
Seo Ina said that, and Jaehyun immediately nodded.
Poppy stood in front and puffed up.
However, Jaehyun couldn’t immediately get into a fighting stance.
Because the witch is strong? No.
It wasn’t even weak.
Just because I was curious.
‘Those magic beasts…!’
The monster that Jaehyun is facing right now.
These are the gods of war who let Hugin escape after a battle in the past.
Because it was a beast-type monster that Tyr handled.
At that moment, a message came again to the two of them.
―Transferred a climber across the timeline to an ancient elven kingdom 10,000 years ago.
―You have accepted the main quest 《Lullaby of the End》.

they killed my father
