By culling the members who participated in the anti-Esir alliance according to the Last Ordeal Elimination Act, it was easy to identify the last organizer.
The father of Squall and Hati and one of Loki’s sons.
A giant wolf that was only recently released from being tied to the real thing of its ‘Gleipnir’s copy’.
Fenrir.
He was also famous for eating one of Tyr’s arms while making a bet with him.
A being described as one of the strongest in mythology.
In addition, if he is a guy who becomes strong just by breathing, as Hella said, there is a high possibility that he continued to grow even while he was sealed.
It was a situation in which Jaehyun had to rely on a considerable amount of time.
So he headed for Nidavellir first.
The desire to reach the 4th stage of Divinity Liberation as soon as possible and defeat Odin was like a chimney, but it is impossible to be buried there and miss the big picture.
“Once you get everything you need here. Let’s go slowly now.”
“okay!”
Kim Yoo-jung, wearing a nice white robe, responded like that.
It seems that the effect of the item is fraudulent. Well, Jaehyun got that too.
“By the way… can you really give me this?”
At that time, Ahn Ho-yeon asked cautiously. He was holding the exact same longsword that Jaehyun was holding earlier. Jaehyun nodded.
“of course. Well… it’s an item only for opponents, so you won’t be able to use that effect, but if it has enough attack power, it will always be useful.
And only I have the skills to make equipment.”
Ahn Ho-yeon nodded with a firm expression.
He seems to be feeling quite a bit of pressure, but now that he’s used to that, he’s probably fine. Because being with Jaehyun made his mentality stronger.
Now, Ahn Ho-yeon is in a state where he can overcome even that burden.
Jaehyun was so sure.
Ahn Ho-yeon pondered for a while before responding with a smile.
“Then… ok. I will do my best to help you.”
“So do i.”
Lee Jae-sang also said that with a warm smile. He also got a pair of black half-gloves to use, and they looked pretty good.
Seo Na-na and Kwon So-yul also got a belt and a necklace, respectively. Jaehyun confirmed that the effect was very good.
At this level, even while he was undergoing the fifth ordeal, his comrades would be able to sufficiently respond to the enemy’s attack.
I heard that Fenrir has an impatient personality, so the ordeal won’t take too long, so there was nothing to worry about.
“Black feet. You suffered too.”
“joy. Of course.”
The black-footed sole said that while seeing Jaehyun off. Unfortunately, Daren couldn’t come out separately because he had to deal with business as a king.
Of course, the two slaves were welcoming Jae-hyeon as he left.
…Precisely, it would be to welcome Jae-hyeon, who is leaving.
“See you again?”
“…….”
“…….”
The two twins fell into silence again. see you again?
Stay up all night hammering for another month?
Receiving two gold coins…?
“Of course… Isn’t that right, little brother?!”
“Of course not bro! We will welcome you anytime…!”
“of course.”
Jaehyun laughed.
His next destination has been decided. Also, in the meantime, Jaehyun has decided to leave a very important task to his colleagues.
It was to kill a certain god.

chapters.title: Chapter 381
chapters.content:
Episode 381 Fifth Ordeal (1)
“I didn’t expect to visit this place in its true form again… Tsk. After all, there are no guys who do the job properly.”
A white male god who arrived in Midgard after passing through Bifrost. Heimdall muttered with an annoyed face.
He had just reached his peak.
To be honest, Midgard was not a place he had good memories of.
I challenged the opponent to a fight and was completely pushed back, and it wasn’t enough to help him wake up, so I lost more than 30% of my level.
In the aftermath of that time, one powder, not the main body, was lost, and Heimdall was unable to move properly for a while.
It seems that the aftermath of that time still throbs in the body.
However, Odin instructed him to clean up the enemy and his allies.
In the conversation a moment ago, he had asked himself, the gatekeeper, if he could properly deal with the adversary.
Heimdall decided to obey his instructions because he was tired of protecting Bifrost.
Anyway, the guys who gave themselves shame before. This time, I was about to grind my teeth with the thought of paying back from this side.
For the belligerent Heimdall, this was not something to refuse.
“This time, I will be able to defeat the enemy with certainty. Then you will be favored by Odin… and your role as a gatekeeper will be over.”
Heimdall is actually the weakest among the Aesir gods.
Utilizing not only combat skills but also brilliant ideas and knowledge.
There is almost no part that directly affects the operation of Asgard.
His practical value is at least his flute and his eyes that can see well into the distance.
I could say that was all.
That is why he was assigned to Bifrost.
A loyal dog that monitors whether other people cross the rainbow bridge and faithfully reports to Odin whenever there is a problem.
That was Heimdall’s current address.
“But that is over now. This time I will be able to go higher. If I can only kill the adversary… I can put everything back in place.”
I have already finished talking to Odin.
If you prove your worth, I will give you a better seat. I had heard such a story.
Also, Odin granted himself enormous deity.
It is also possible to use one’s power in Midgard.
That’s why he wasn’t rough now.
Clench your fist lightly and open it.
Aww!
The muscle expands and contracts repeatedly. It seems that it is far from the strength of ordinary people.
Even in small movements, the strength is clearly felt.
It was one of Heimdall’s greatest strengths. Even that was inferior to Thor, but no one could easily ignore him anyway.
“Then… Shall we find the antagonist?”
The corners of his lips went up.
* * *
The adversary at that moment. Jaehyun was on his way to the fifth ordeal.
He was riding on Poppy’s back, stroking the mouth of his neck, which had grown through gigantism.
The destination is clear. Jaehyun recalled a conversation he had with Hella a while ago.
[Perhaps after you receive all of the dwarves’ equipment and inscriptions, they too will start moving properly. The war… is about to break out.]
[Does that mean… that the fifth ordeal should be skipped?]
[That’s not the case.]
This time Hel said that and put his hand on Jaehyun’s shoulder.
[You have to go through all the trials prepared for you. And the full-fledged start of the war…
means that we, who are here now, also participate in the battlefield.]
[The anti-Aesir coalition… begins to move properly…?]
[Yes.]
Smir is thick. crossed arms with hands he was
[Adversary. You go through the ordeal and come back. ASAP. Instead of you, we will fight together with your comrades to protect humans.]
[But if you do that…]
[As you thought. It would be our job to present them with war and its justification. I mean, they’ll be able to use more divine power.]
I didn’t rush out from this side. And the reason why Aesir couldn’t put all his power right away was because of his divine power.
The force needed to interfere with each other’s world worked, limiting their range of action.
However, if the anti-Aesir alliance brings other gods to attack them, they will also get a justification for Odin to act directly.
If that happens… the war will really intensify and disaster may come.
Jaehyun swallowed his saliva.
If you don’t return quickly, you’ll have a more difficult situation if you don’t prove your worth by reaching level 4 of liberation.
This meant that at least half of the world’s population could be wiped out in an instant.
all unavailable. It is different from not being able to save even the person in front of you.
Jaehyun was a person who thought life had seriousness.
It can be called hypocrisy, but the safety of himself and his fellow family members was the most important thing. That’s what he said at a recent press conference.
to protect yourself If you don’t do that, I won’t protect all of you.
It was something he said to others, but it was more appropriate to say it to himself.
In order to move on, you must eventually give up something.
It shouldn’t be the person next to you. I will make it like that.
That’s what it meant.
Because of this, Jaehyun called his colleagues before the fifth trial and said.
[Everyone, borrow the power of the other gods and kill the enemies before I go through the fifth trial. When they come, never die, you have to kill them.
Maybe I think… Heimdall. that guy will come As the gatekeeper, he is the first to announce the improvement of the war. Because that would be the most rational thing for them too.]
Jaehyun’s words fell heavily. However, the colleagues again had bright expressions.
Kim Yoo-jung smiled lively.
[Isn’t this an opportunity to repay what you suffered during the camp? Why are you making such a gloomy face? Not like you.]
[It’s a little scary. I almost died from being strangled at that time…]
Kwon So-yul pretended to tremble as she wrapped her arms around her.
Lee Jae-sang and Ahn Ho-yeon also nodded in response.
An answer in place of will.
Hella lifted her tiptoe one last time and put her hand on Jaehyun’s head.
No, rather than putting it on, it was a motion of raising the blade.
“Don’t try to do everything alone on a subject that has just become a god. Leave this to us. The war has begun… and its end will now begin.”
“…Yes. It won’t be too late.”
“of course. You are the adversary. Do you think I will tolerate running away from my fate?”
Hela laughed and said that.
Why? Jaehyun felt a little relieved by her words that seemed to restrain him.
There is a place to return to.
Is it because such a feeling spreads deep in the heart?
For that reason, Jaehyun was determined to go through the ordeal as soon as possible and return.
Fortunately, I already knew who the person in charge of the test was.
Even though there was no guide, Hella, he had heard a lot of information about this place. Home to the world’s mightiest wolf.
This was a wetland.
‘Well, the origin of the name is natural, right?’
In Fenrir, Pen has the meaning of ‘marsh’.
So, in a way, it is natural for him to appear in the wetlands.
Jaehyun got off Poppy’s back and walked through the dark marsh. Slowly, a gurgling sound came from somewhere, creeping up the back and waist.
I could even feel the deep magic power from him. far too high.
It seemed to choke Jaehyun’s breath.
‘Is this… at least more than Tyr?’
Jaehyun was convinced that someone with more power than Tyr was here.
And it was confirmed there that the words of Hell and Hella were not lies.
[You’re the enemy.]
A black shadow fell over Jaehyun’s head, and a drop of saliva fell on it. Jaehyun lightly bounced it off with magic. With the wolf’s low cry
,
the two red eyes radiate.
Jaehyun laughed at his huge size like a mountain. It was exactly the same face as described in mythology.
“Fenrir. Are you the master of my final ordeal?”
[Yes. I was annoyed that he left troublesome things to me, but I mean.]
After Fenrir said that, he began to look closely at Jaehyun.
The corners of his mouth twisted and went up.
[You seem to be the one who will make me happy, so I don’t regret it. It will be fun.]
“I hope so.”
[Then, let’s start the fifth ordeal.]
The start of the ordeal.
Like Fenrir, it was a quick decision and start. I have already heard from Van Aesir’s other gods and giants that the ordeal with him is very simple.
His final ordeal is…
[Fight me and win.]
Fight him and win.
This is not an empty word, it means that Jaehyun will die unless he really fights with him and wins.
―I encountered an opponent with an excessively high rank.
-caution! The enemy reveals a strong sense of triumph!
Jaehyun cleared his head coldly.
Fenrir. An existence that is at least the same level as Nidhogg, unofficially at the 4th level of Divine Liberation. Will Jaehyun be able to defeat him?
The answer does not come easily. But it is also true that it must be done.
But why?
“Ha ha…”
A smile leaks out at the crossroads of life and death.
Fenrir raised an eyebrow.
[You seem to be a combat fanatic like me.]
“It can’t be. Can’t you see I’m shaking? Please take it easy.”
It was a curious thing. Jaehyun’s shoulders were clearly shaking.
However, Fenrir seemed to have no intention of reaping his opinion.
he added.
[The reason your body trembles… isn’t it because you’re looking forward to fighting with me, not because you’re afraid? Did you try to trick me?]
“Ah.”
Jaehyun laughed.
“I can’t help it if I get caught.”
Jaehyun immediately made a sword and held it in his hand.
Mythical Longsword. The masterpiece created by the Brock-Eitri brothers, the sword for the opponent, is in his hand and begins to aim for Fenrir.
yes this is the last one
The last ordeal will lead you to a higher place than ever before.
Quaang!
Jaehyun narrowed the gap before he knew it, and after accurately shedding Fenrir’s claws aiming at his shoulder, he put his strength into the longsword he was holding.
―The artifact’s special effect is activated.
―[Counterattack Imprint] is activated. Temporarily increases attack power by 200%.
Chow ah!
Along with that, the sword of Jaehyun climbed up Fenrir’s leg and cut it vertically.
Streams of blood scatter and fill the sky. Dark red raindrops slowly begin to pour down Jaehyun’s red eyes.
Jaehyun was sure. that he can win.
And that the end is closer than ever.

chapters.title: Chapter 382
chapters.content:
Episode 382 The Fifth Trial (2)
Chow ah!
The long sword climbs up the enemy’s legs at once and cuts them in a spiral pattern. Jaehyun stepped between the giant wolf’s legs and reached his eyes before he knew it.
Looking at Fenrir from close range, the pressure seemed to intensify. Jaehyun didn’t feel so intimidated anymore.
‘I don’t intend to be vigilant though.’
Jaehyun sighed and looked ahead.
Fenrir, the strongest wolf in mythology.
That bright red pupil resembled himself. Like a wild beast, I feel the fear of swallowing anything at any moment. The drooling jaws would also be able to devour voraciously whatever it puts in.
Thinking of putting my hand in there…
He’s the god of war, but I thought Tyr wasn’t sane either.
[That’s interesting.]
Fenrir was a crazy talent who had become so strong with just one body without any artifacts.
The strongest existence that Loki gave birth to.
No matter how strong Jaehyun attacks him, he won’t break through easily.
However, Jaehyun had no intention of avoiding it.
Wasn’t the reason why I got this and that artifact in the first place to deal with him?
It was the right decision here to fight him directly rather than back down. If you lightly show your back, you’ll see yourself in his mouth in an instant.
Jaehyun took a few steps back, sweating.
Then, a late system sound and a quest window come to mind.
―You have accepted the main quest 《The Fifth Trial: The Trial of Fenrir》.
[Main Quest] Trial
of Fenrir
Fenrir, the god-eating wolf, gives an ordeal to the adversary.
Fight Fenrir, subdue him, and claim your worth.
Clear reward: Liberation Level 1
Failure to rise Penalty: death
As a result, the story the system tells is simple.
If you don’t beat that big guy, you’ll die. And for this, he must prepare for everything he has and be recognized for his strength.
Jaehyun had already prepared several measures for this.
Perhaps, if he could use them properly, winning victory over Fenrir wouldn’t be too much of a stretch.
However, Jaehyun’s positive thoughts were something he could do because he hadn’t experienced Fenrir yet.
Fenrir showed his teeth and smiled.
[I expected it because he was an adversary… but he’s exactly living up to my expectations. But… you’re still at the top of the 3rd level of liberation.]
He looked down at Jaehyun with his red eyes.
[Let me tell you one thing for sure. You’ll never be able to beat me with that level of skill. So, in this place I am looking at, you must go beyond your limits.]
Limits.
What that means is clear.
stage of liberation. Fenrir was telling me to get over it at this moment.
‘It’s not even impossible.’
Jaehyun put strength into the longsword in his hand.
As an adversary, he has greater potential than anyone else. Also, several times so far he has crossed his walls.
It wasn’t any different than it was now.
However, Fenrir was not conceited either.
Fenrir was recognized as one of the strongest beings. A monster that makes even the gods tremble. Because he is such a being, Jaehyun, a human being, thinks that he cannot easily reach him.
Therefore, it is not conceit. It meant superior innate confidence.
“There has never been a time when I didn’t do my best.”
Jaehyun said so with force.
Fenrir also responded by pressing down on each letter.
[That’s something I’ll have to check. Let’s start a proper fight… Let’s start.]
White smoke begins to leak from Fenrir’s mouth.
It was breath. A cold breath that seems to freeze everyone in this very cold place spreads over Jaehyun’s shoulders and feet, making him freeze cold from his waist.
Jaehyun immediately activated the fire magic to prevent his body from stiffening.
Hwareuk!
quick response.
However, the coldness of Fenrir was not something that could be resisted that much. It’s a pity, but it’s a severe cold that goes beyond simple coldness.
Fenrir’s fear was that he had fangs of bitter cold.
Of course, the simple destructive power is also terrifying.
Jaehyun quickly repeated his thoughts.
‘It’s not the coldness that can be blown away with flame magic. If it wasn’t for Hel’s protection, I’d probably be frostbitten and unable to move.’
I felt very fortunate that the first ordeal was Hel’s.
At that time, Jaehyun exceeded his limit by holding Nightshade, and as a reward, he obtained the protection of Hell, which can resist all status ailments.
That has considerably reduced Jaehyun’s consideration of compatibility when dealing with enemies so far.
[It’s clear what he’s thinking. However, the power of the cold that I possess is of the kind that cannot be completely twisted by Hel’s protection. Just extreme cold. After saying that, Fenrir tore open his mouth wide and started shooting something
.
The coldness was immediately apparent, but there was something more surprising than that.
Bruce right away. Because what he’s shooting is his breath.
Jaehyun quickly leaned back and bounced like a spring, kicking the ground.
Dangerous.
Instinct knows that it shouldn’t be hit by that, and tells Jaehyun that. Jaehyun immediately injected magic into his hand.
―Active skill «Absolute Calculation».
Kwachang!
As the shot breath breaks, the shards scatter like glass fragments. At first glance, it was nothing more than a very beautiful landscape.
Actually, it didn’t end there.
blah blah!
With its huge jaw wide open again, it approaches Jaehyun at close range. Jaehyun tried to roll over, but the floor was already icy.
It’s a situation where you can’t be sure where you’ll land if you roll over there.
I couldn’t throw myself away recklessly.
Jaehyun immediately raised his longsword vertically to block Fenrir’s approaching fangs. Cleverly, Fenrir quickly fell back, and this time he threw his claws.
I thought that this was really unavoidable, so I had no choice but to recreate it and used the special effects of the equipment.
―Active skill 《Shadow Fairy Tale》.
While activating Shadow Assimilation, Jae-Hyun let the enemy attack once.
The attacks followed with wild wolf howls.
There was Fenrir, who was gradually getting stronger from him, and Jaehyun had no choice but to focus all his energy on receiving the attack for a long time.
He didn’t even have time to wipe his cold sweat.
An unstoppable attack.
How the hell can I get out of this situation?
At that moment, Jaehyun put on a smile that put his worries to shame.
‘As expected, that’s the best.’
You can’t face the wolf in front of you without revealing all of your cards.
Then you just bring your talents to the fore.
Even if it’s a power that hasn’t been completed yet.
Roaring!
―The special effect of the Artifact 《Mythic Longsword》 is displayed.
―The dust of Surt embedded in the artifact takes effect!
At that moment, Fenrir’s eyes narrowed for an instant. Jaehyun didn’t miss it.
Wild flames rise through the medium of the sword, and then shoot towards the enemy.
* * *
Deep in the city of Daegu is a bridge connecting the human world and Asgard.
It was the place where Bifrost was located.
Few people know that this bridge is hidden here, but of course the Æsir’s keepers. Heimdall was different.
Isn’t he the highest being who protects Bifrost and at the same time becomes another eye of Odin?
Because it is such a hidden place.
In fact, when Heimdall visited Midgard this time, he thought the neighborhood would be quite quiet.
however.
“What are you?”
Contrary to his expectations, all kinds of people are gathered in front of him.
Looking closely, every aspect of his face looked familiar…
Heimdall’s lips went up as if he knew right away.
“Someone said they were the opponent’s colleagues.”
“then?”
Ahn Ho-yeon, who was standing in front of him, responded first.
Behind him are Jaehyun’s colleagues and members of Nine.
Heimdall snorted as if it were absurd.
“As far as I know, the current achievements of the adversaries have reached the third stage of liberation. If a guy like that had come here to deal with me, I would have certainly thought you had a chance.
But sending out these ragtags… does that mean you’re going to run away?”
“…Jaehyun is not that kind of person.”
Seo Ina gave strength to her voice as she said that.
Well, she should have been more confident. No matter how much the previous existence is located in the 3rd stage of liberation, she is also a person with dignity.
At least there was nothing to do or collapse in one sum.
Moreover.
“You don’t seem to know that taking your victory for granted isn’t so cool. Heimdall.”
The owner of the alluring voice heard from behind.
It belonged to Hel.
Then countless numbers of the dead and Hela followed behind.
Hel’s emergency meeting results. Smir and Jormungand were waiting in the preparation group, and Hel decided to directly participate in the battle this time. It was decided to operate the army of the dead together with Hela.
Heimdall, learning of the enemy’s plan, smiled.
“Since you can’t handle it alone now, do you keep it in check by gathering in groups? What a pitiful look. Hell.”
“That must be the saddest thing. I’ve heard stories of people ignoring me getting their throats cut, and being trampled on while talking softly. Don’t you think that’s an honorable thing?”
“This bastard…!”
Heimdall came pretty easily to provocation.
After the members of Nine used all their pre-activated skills. Be prepared for an enemy attack.
Heimdall begins to fully release his character and slowly proves his power.
‘I knew it was strong, but… I can’t believe it’s this strong!’
Kim Yoo-jung and Kwon So-yul had the same thoughts at the same time.
Heimdall, who had been attacked during the camp in the past. Back then, they didn’t know how strong he was because they were too weak.
It is just a transcendent being. I was just barely aware of that.
However, the appearance of Heimdall, who had completely disappeared even the limitations of his power following that time, was like that of a more fearful god of death.
Divinity permeated through the overflowing mana.
“Then until the adversary comes. Shall we start talking among ourselves?”
“That’s good.”
Hel retorted and clapped his hands. Then, a thin, black film formed around them and confined them.
A magic that Hel often uses. It was “Border of Death”.
It is similar to Jaehyun’s life-or-death skill in that it prevents anyone from approaching the surroundings, but it was close to a barrier that never allowed anyone to come inside without raising the caster’s attack power.
Heimdall frowned.
He scratched his head as if he was annoyed, then took out an object and murmured.
“I had no intention of using this from the beginning…”
An artifact that Heimdall took out. It was also a flute he used often.
It’s a long war. It was the sound of the flute of death announcing the beginning of Ragnarok.

chapters.title: Chapter 383
chapters.content:
Episode 383. Fifth Trial (3)
Odin leaves the throne after a while and searches all over the Nine Worlds with Hugin. He was pensive with a cynical face.
There is only one thing that fills his head. It was a deep question about the adversary.
‘The adversary from 10,000 years ago. After all, he was a real person.’
In fact, Odin already knew that another adversary existed before he heard from Tyr. It’s easy to see if you think of his usual obsession with perfectionist tendencies.
Never take care of things haphazardly and never choose the road that has no odds.
That was Odin’s way, and indeed it always worked out what was best for him. Because of this, Odin always analyzes the situation to the limit and handles the work.
No matter how dire the situation was, it was the same.
because.
In the past, Odin also looked through all the books related to the adversary in Asgard’s library.
He had already acquired all the knowledge, so he thought he would not be able to know anything, but there was a mix of disparate records that even he did not know.
first adversary.
It was mixed with the story that such a human existed 10,000 years ago.
But Odin felt strange. Why can’t even he, who is at the top of the Aesir, remember information related to a human with the alias of an adversary who existed 10,000 years ago?
He was the one who knew everything about the nine worlds. However, it was somewhat reluctant that there was a history that even the person himself did not know about.
The most incomprehensible thing is, of course, the error of memory.
As if the film was cut somewhere. In Odin’s memory, only a few fragmentary scenes floating around as fragments came to mind little by little.
“Hugin.”
when I was deep in thought. Odin, who had been walking quietly, suddenly got lucky.
Hugin immediately looked back and lowered his head.
“yes.”
“Are you hiding anything from me?”
Probably no one can answer that question by saying that there is something hidden. Even so, Odin asked.
“of course.”
Hugin said so without hesitation.
It was a vague answer. As if he was waiting for you to ask a question.
There was not even a slight change of emotion in Hugin’s eyes.
It was natural. Because he was a being who could handle emotions. That’s why you can respond calmly to your own questions.
In that respect, Hugin was both an excellent horse and a loser.
However, even in that situation, Odin closed his eyes as the thoughts continued to wander through his head. Why the hell did Tyr say such a thing the other day?
What kind of correlation is there between the prophecies of the three Norn sisters about the enemy and their own death?
‘What am I missing? and.’
Odin remembered the first time he saw Hugin.
‘What is Hugin hiding from me?’
But it was a meaningless question.
Odin quickly lost interest and turned his attention the other way.
No wonder. There was no reason to worry.
Odin is the god at the top of the Æsir. And Hugin is a mere trifle. It is nothing more than an existence that has shared its status a little.
Right now, he probably won’t be able to defeat even his opponents.
“How is the process of finding the star in the far abyss?”
“It’s going smoothly. Since Tyr and Freya-nim are stepping out on their own, we should be able to find them anywhere.”
“okay. Tell everyone not to disappoint me.”
“All right.”
After saying that, Hugin greeted her with the same attitude as the first time.
Then, in the blink of an eye, he was already gone.
shadow welcome. It was one of the powers Odin gave him.
“I don’t know what he is hiding. Everything will be meaningless.”
At that moment, there was a small shimmer in the space floating in the air.
Odin did not miss.
he thought
Hugin must have been listening to his story a while ago.
And that he would never change anything he was planning.
* * *
The main of the fifth trial is basically winning the battle against Fenrir. It was simple, but not so easy to do.
There was no need to explain why.
‘Fenrir… The guy is getting stronger as he fights. Are you testing me?’
are testing
Jaehyun was initially a little annoyed by the premise.
The pain of the last four times that I’ve been through in the name of trials. It made him grow and put him where he is now.
Now I wanted to feed myself at least one room.
Even though they were allies, it was a refusal to stand in a position where they were constantly being tested. Even if it’s the huge monstrous wolf in front of you.
“Haap!”
With a spirit, he drew the newly obtained sword.
Fenrir’s leg, which had already been cut off a while ago, had been healed after being sutured, so it was necessary to deal with him with more frequent and faster attacks.
Even though he wouldn’t be able to spread his swordsmanship with all his might like he did at the beginning, but if he crosses over several times and aims for the same part, there’s no possibility at all.
It was quite difficult, but Jaehyun believed he could do it.
Then Fenrir opened his mouth and said.
[Hmm. You have a useful sword. It seems that he met the Brock-Atri brothers.]
It was not unreasonable to guess that way. Among the Dwarves, there were not many people who had this much talent for equipment production.
Didn’t Ivaldi’s sons completely stand on Asgard’s side?
Those crazy clumsy dwarves were all the guys who could make weapons for Jaehyun, who was now his opponent.
The good news is that my skills aren’t too bad.
“That’s it. They are now my slaves.”
[haha! I guess he gave quite a bit of gold?]

Jaehyun’s words were persuasive enough. Whatever it is now, one thing is certain.
That there is something going on in Asgard that they don’t understand.
If you don’t figure it out, you might face a difficult situation in the war later.

Jaehyun focused his mind as he said that. As he expected, things didn’t take long.
It was because Freya’s expression hardened coldly as she heard a knock from outside. She gave more strength to the hand that held her child.
Why?

Freya seemed to think for a moment, but eventually put the child down and sighed and started to pick out a dress from the closet.
At that moment, Freya’s monologue was heard in Jaehyun and Kim Yoojung’s ears.
[I regretted my decision to attend Odin’s banquet that day for the rest of my life.]
[I shouldn’t have gone to the banquet.]

The two of them spit again . It fell over once, and the son-in-law went dark again. The two instinctively realized that they were moving to the next scene.
that disturbing monologue.

From the beginning, his target was Odin.
The moment he decided to kill his father and live a new life.
The first time he met Hugin and learned that a man named Odin was involved in the case.
In all situations, Jaehyun always calmly tried to give the best answer.
It was the same this time, and this is the result.
Risking his life, he infiltrates Asgard’s prison. There, he rescues Frey, who will become his best ally.
Turn Freya into an ally. The power of the Valkyrie army is brought here.
If you can do that, at least the number of allies will not be pushed back in the second war. It meant that he would not feel the lethargy he experienced in the city of the elves in the past.
“Whoa… what kind of person is Frey anyway?”
“You must be handsome.”
Jaehyun just said that. In fact, it was only natural that he was one of the most famous gods in mythology.
But after thinking about it for a while, an unexpected story came back from her mouth.
“Me, I… I like being handsome, but I like being moderately handsome.”
Then he said, ‘God is not my type…’ and didn’t even ask.
Jaehyun was dumbfounded, but thought this was also her strong point.
Even just believing in yourself and going with you in a dangerous moment like now.
she believes in herself More than anyone.
That’s why she decided to sacrifice herself twice.
It would have been impossible without deep trust.
“Kim Yoo-jung.”
“…ok?”
“Somehow, stick well next to me.”
“Aren’t you going to do that anyway?”
After Kim Yoo-jung stuck out her tongue, she took the lead with her reddened cheeks, then stopped in place. Jaehyun smiled and stood beside her.
“You’re afraid to stop because you’re so ahead of the gilchiju.”
“……It was bad, really. Pretend you don’t know.”
“okay.”
Of course, I didn’t listen and answer properly, but this was like two people.
When you start to be too conscious of it, you end up distant, but when you’re next to each other, it’s a relationship that ends up being warmer than anyone else.
That was the consciousness Jaehyun and Kim Yoojung had for each other.
* * *
Spiral Tower of Yggdrasil before heading to the dungeon.
We need to get to the center of it.
Basically, Yggdrasil is divided into three roots, but above them. This is because there are three worlds in Middle-earth and three worlds above it.
Among them, Asgard is the best. It is also centrally located.
In order to head there, Jaehyun had to head a little higher.
Anyway, the place I was a moment ago was almost at the bottom. Mimisbrunn’s position was at the bottom of the World Tree.
Reaching the top couldn’t be easier.
It was because I thought that Odin couldn’t have made the road to Asgard so easy.
Well, I would have done that even if I was myself, so I decided to think that there was nothing I could do about it. Isn’t the enemy one of the sages who have realized the rune language?
Since he was a smart guy who climbed to the top of Asgard, Jaehyun didn’t think he would be able to deal with him easily from the start.
“It’s nice to have a map, though.”
After Kim Yoo-jung said that, she looked around.
The surroundings are an unknown structure with randomly carved murals and pillars. There were all sorts of piles of stones and rubble.
Jaehyun and Kim Yoojung were currently climbing the stairs to the hidden upper level. It was easy to understand that it was a kind of emergency staircase concept that could be used because you had succeeded in climbing the tower in the past.
“I know. Anyway, there are no monsters. Going to Asgard itself shouldn’t be a big problem. Well, the problem comes next.”
After reaching Asgard, Jaehyun had to head to the dungeon where Frey was.
‘And to do that, I need a stealth class. I have stealth, but Kim Yoo-jung’s case is different. Of course… I’ve already finished all the preparations for that.’
Jaehyun was walking with a cloak over Kim Yoojung.
Kim Yoo-jung pursed her lips and muttered.
“Do you really have to keep wearing this? It’s a bit hot…”
“Being hot is better than dying.”
Jaehyun calmly responded. With a small voice, she agreed.
The cloak she is wearing now. It was an invisibility cloak with stealth effects applied. An S-class artifact specialized in hiding one’s identity.
The duration of the skill was long, and the biggest advantage of all was that the duration did not pass unless he moved.
As soon as Jaehyun saw this item, he bid on it at the auction house and bought it with an amount that was not noticeable even after taking it off a little.
It was natural since he had planned to invade Asgard with Kim Yoo-jung from the beginning.
Even he is not sure that he can survive if his identity is revealed there. No matter how strong you become, what if the Æsir gods stop reappearing?
If such a worst-case scenario happens, Jae-hyun will surely die.
How much more so is Kim Yoo-jung?
For this reason, Jaehyun bought an invisibility cloak and gave it to her.
Maybe this item will be of great help later on.
“It seems to be halfway through now. If you go a little further, you will be on the top floor.”
The two of them had already climbed the stairs for hours.
It was fortunate that he was not tired because he was a radar.
If he was a normal person, he would have been struggling with mana poisoning and waiting for the day he would die.
* * *
Loki.
Trickster is now standing in the ruins of Vanaheim.
In the past, this place was the home of the Vanir gods, such as Frey Freya.
However, before the first Ragnarok even started due to Odin’s attack. This place has become a sea of fire. Now only the shape of the shattered kingdom remains.
Loki has been there for several days now. He was recalling memories of the past while wandering around the remains of those who had perished throughout the nine worlds.
The memory of a certain human being and the scars of war. And it was in order to regain his strength and gain the highest rank again.
In fact, since he is the best being in mythology, it doesn’t show too much, but Loki was in a fairly weak state.
In order to regain that power, I had to go through the past records like now.
Everywhere he hid fragments of himself.
Each time he finds and absorbs them, he will become a little stronger.
It was the same here in Vanaheim.
“No matter how I look at it, I can’t adapt.”
Loki groaned and put his hands in his pockets. He contemplated the undying landscapes with a frown, which is rare.
I have been to many worlds so far.
I deliberately didn’t overlap with the adversary, but Jotunheim, Alfheim, Vanaheim, etc…
I retrieved a lot of fragments of myself that were abandoned in the destroyed places of the world.
Perhaps Asgard and Odin did not know that they had hidden fragments of power in this way.
Before signing the first dirty contract, Loki had already hidden his power in several places and was captured by Odin himself.
The reason for sharing the power was to keep an excessively huge divinity and magical power in one place and not be noticed by him.
Thanks to that, except for one powder, his powers were now back.
“Now I can move properly even in war. Odin… I could give him a shot.”
Loki smiled brightly, trying to erase the dark expression on his face.
In the war that started again, he remembered exactly what he had to do.
The promise I made with the three Norn sisters.
And the story Mimir told him.
Loki will never forget this.
Just like he did, he will not forget anything from the past.
he thought so.
* * *
It was already dawn when Jaehyun arrived in Asgard.
Bustling Asgard, where the sun always seems to rise, also has a time when it is locked in the deep night. Jaehyun realized that he had arrived here at the right time and at the right time.
As soon as he arrived, he overpowered the gatekeeper waiting in front and ended his life. I didn’t mean to go hard just to be good here.
These people were already like magic beasts to Jaehyun and Kim Yoojung.
In any case, they agreed to Odin’s command, and how many people were sacrificed because of it? That alone gives a valid justification for their deaths.
‘…know. That this is just an assortment match.’
But I couldn’t help it.
Hadn’t Jaehyun already made up his mind several times? In order to protect precious things, sometimes you need to become a wicked person.
A moment of hesitation from my colleague. It is a world where the family’s throat is cut off.
He will never let such a tragedy happen in that world.
That determination will not be shaken.
To do that, he needed strength.
A strong force that will prevent anyone from harming them and their families and friends.
“let’s go.”
Kim Yoo-jung also agreed with Jae-hyun’s will and shook her head. At the point where she decided to stand by Jaehyun’s side, it was the point at which she understood that she could often go through situations like this.
I couldn’t be afraid of killing someone now.
That death is inevitable in war, she regretfully realized at the moment of her death.
The one that activated Soul Link. On the day he decided to sacrifice instead of Jaehyun, his own life had already been cut off once.
definitely remember His own soul was completely shattered.
If it wasn’t for Loki’s body, everything would have definitely ended. And then… to Helheim?
I didn’t know for sure, but I was certain that it was better to survive.
‘I have to move forward without being shaken.’
Kim Yoo-jung firmly believed and carefully looked at Jae-hyun’s broad back.
Without realizing it, a smile leaked out.
The two walked through the darkness of Asgard together and cautiously walked towards the lower floors.
about two hours like that. before the morning sun rises.
The two eventually found the dungeons of Asgard, where they found Viruhan.
However, I met a man with a truly wonderful beauty.
This time, Kim Yoo-jung was convinced.
That god is unmistakably Frey.
…I’ve never seen anyone so handsome… not like that.
Her head turned to Jaehyun for a moment. Kim Yoo-jung’s cheeks turned red, but soon returned to normal.
Jaehyun looked ahead, ignoring the sudden, burdensome gaze. The energy you feel there. It was because the nerves of my body were on edge without my knowledge.
“Are you the enemy?”
At that moment, a voice came from a man in prison.

chapters.title: Chapter 393
chapters.content:
Episode 393 Dungeon (3)
“Are you the adversary?”
I heard the voice of Frey, a lowly inmate.
Jaehyun nodded.
“That’s right.”
Jaehyun said so with respect as he does to other gods.
Kim Yoo-jung fed up and laughed at her polite attitude, but Jae-hyun remained calm.
He just continued talking while looking at the god whose limbs were bound.
“Frey. We know you can help us. I’m here to help. Get out of here.”
However, at Jaehyun’s words, Frey seemed a little taken aback. He pondered for a moment, then looked at Jaehyun’s expression and said.
“…I also want to help you with my heart. But… before that, I have one request.”
“Ask for it?”
“I need to get my sword back.”
Jaehyun let out a short exclamation and nodded his head.
The sword Frey is talking about. It is probably his magic sword that appears in mythology. A sword that comes out of the scabbard and swings according to one’s own will.
It was the weapon that made Frey one of the strongest among the Aesir gods. Of course, it is a high-ranking item among the mythical classes.
‘Now the weapon must be taken away. There’s no way Odin would have imprisoned me here while giving me a weapon.’
Odin is thorough. It’s very likely that he took the weapon and hid it somewhere, or he was already drunk.
Jaehyun sighed and asked.
“If Odin has a weapon, I can’t help it. My level is still not up to the level of Odin.”
Cold, but true.
It is true that Jaehyun has reached the 4th stage of divine liberation and has become the top predator. However, it was not yet to the extent of directly fighting Odin or fighting multiple divine beings at the same time.
Something that should be avoided even if there is a possibility.
It was always forbidden to be careless.
At that time, Frey looked at Jaehyun and said, as if not to worry.
“Nothing to worry about. We already know where the weapon is.
Odin can’t even hold my sword in the first place. It’s a sword made entirely for me.”
A story that did not appear in mythology. Jaehyun listened.
Frey continued.
“The sword is probably in Asgard’s ‘Treasury of the Gods’.”
“The treasure house of the gods…”
Jaehyun thought for a while at the somewhat familiar tone.
Meanwhile, Frey continued to explain.
“Yes. You’ll probably need a key to get there… Unfortunately, I don’t have one right now. First we have to find a way to get the key.”
Frey’s weak voice. Jaehyun, who quickly organized his thoughts, smiled.
The key to the treasure house of the gods. It was because it was an object that resonated very familiarly with Jaehyun.
Jaehyun nodded and raised an eyebrow.
He took a key from his inventory and held it in front of him.
“Is this the key you are talking about?”
“…how do you have that…?”
“How did you get it?”
Jaehyun responded to Frey’s bewildered voice.
In fact, he didn’t get this key to get it, but somehow got it as a reward. It was when he encountered the Golden King while climbing Yggdrasil in the past.
At that time, Jae-hyun saw the story of the golden king, and as a reward for freeing his soul by defeating him, he obtained this key to enter the treasure house of the gods once.
Thanks to that, I was able to use it in the right situation.
Of course, Frey was genuinely impressed, as he had no idea what was going on behind the scenes.
‘Did the adversary know that this would happen and even bring the key? Also, preparation is thorough. It deserves Loki’s choice.’
Jaehyun knew that he was giving me an illusion, but he didn’t show it. Anyway, now is the important time to survive.
There was no reason to waste time talking about pointless things.
“So, to sum things up, are you saying that we can retrieve your items from the treasury of the gods?”
“So it is. I’m sorry about this. But without that sword, I think I will become a burden to you.”
“All right. Then I will go. Do you know the exact location?”
Frey nodded and opened up her mana slightly to create a transparent thread. As if in a weaving operation, the thread is pulled out in a long way, and something is formed.
It was an unmistakable map.
It was drawn with magical power and you can only see it for a moment, but that was enough for Jaehyun.
Even so, Frey added a detailed explanation.
“Valhalla of Asgard. If you go through the central staircase of the ‘heaven for the dead’ and go out into the garden, you will find a huge stone chamber.
Insert the key into the door engraved with the golden crow pattern there and turn it.”
“I will keep that in mind. See you then.”
“I’ll see you again!”
Greung!
Kim Yoo-jung and Papi also greeted like that.
Jaehyun started walking again, thinking that he would like to emulate the cheerfulness of the two of them. Now he was going to head to the treasure house of the gods.
Of course, Jaehyun also had the idea to properly touch the treasures there.
If there is something useful, isn’t it the privilege of a warrior to steal it?
……Well, I wonder if there’s another brave hero like this.
* * *
“Looks like it’s not that easy to find a star in the far-off abyss.”
A battlefield covered in darkness.
Even if you dare to call it Gyeonggukjisaek (傾國之color), the beautiful goddess muttered that while holding a sword.
The god, who roughly took off his helmet, clenched his fists and closed his eyes.
Freya.
As the god of beauty and the head of the Valkyries, she had yet to fulfill Odin’s command.
Odin’s command is to secure the ‘Star of the Distant Abyss’ in time.
But it wasn’t easy.
In the first place, it was an object that could not be properly found even for a long time of 10,000 years.
A star in the far abyss.
A fragment of the beginning, an item that fell from the abyss of Kinnungagaf. It couldn’t have been that easy to find something like that in the first place.
Even that is Odin, so I’ve already found a few of them, and if it were others, I wouldn’t have thought of it.
Among them, two were found by himself in the past.
Even then, I searched through the nine worlds.
But I couldn’t collect all the items.
It was not something that could be obtained easily even after all the hard work.
Of course, Freya was well aware of this.
But she had to find all the pieces as quickly as possible.
Freya briefly stroked the brisinggamen hanging around her neck.
It was more precious than one’s own life, and it was a fragment of the soul of a person he had to protect.
Moreover, recently Odin has spoken.
[You’d better find the pieces quickly. It took a lot of work to maintain the four children’s souls.]
Odin’s meaning was clear. Freya gritted her teeth.
There was nothing he could do now.
Just go to the battlefield to protect the child and find the star fragment.
“Freya-sama, it would be better for you to die soon.”
A Valkyrie standing by Freya’s side spoke.
She had armor with luxurious decorations even at first glance. At least, it was on the same level as Sigrun, whom Jaehyun had dealt with in the past.
Freyja had a rare gloomy expression. It was raining sparsely from the blue sky.
“Gunner… when the hell does Odin intend to return mine? You never really know what and how much you have to hold in your hands to be satisfied.”
“Freya-nim…”
Gunner, Freya’s limb and one of the captains of the Valkyries.
He was silent as he watched his master’s lonely back.
All the top Valkyries, including Gunner, already knew.
Why did Freya follow dirty Odin’s instructions and join Ragnarok for him?
own child.
It was because he was threatened through the medium of his only child’s soul.
Not only that.
Lately, she has become like another family member. Sigrun was lost.
adversary. If you look closely, he too was just trying to survive, but each other’s interests and values don’t match.
That creates a strange gap between the two, resulting in tragedy.
Gunner knew that it was disrespectful, but he was thinking that the adversary and Freyja might have the same thoughts.
The recent events in Midgard.
From all the rumors he heard, he cared terribly for his family and his colleagues.
The lord in front of him now. like Freyja.
She saved countless poor young and weak women and gave them light. He allowed them to stand by his side and was considerate of them so that they could accomplish feats.
Such was Freyja.
The one most worthy of the name of God.
Gunner certainly thought so.
‘It’s impossible to keep looking at the back like that forever.’
Gunner thought of his dead friend Sigrun.
Also, Bruenhilte of the past. I thought of a colleague with whom I shared forbidden love.
The last is Freya’s strange fate.
He bowed his head in a calm voice, vowing to always fight by Freya’s side.
“It is windy. Please go in now.”
“…okay.”
The rain is gradually getting stronger.
A strong wind as if a typhoon is about to blow.
Whether it is due to a simple whim of the weather or something else. Whether it was a harbinger of an unpredictable tragedy, even Gunner and Freyja could not know.
* * *
Asgard was very large.
There was a place called Odin’s Palace. And the place where the Valkyries stay… It’s because all kinds of places are concentrated in one place.
It is natural to reappear, but since I did not come to tour Asgard, I had to move as efficiently as possible.
If it was only a gatekeeper or a soldier, he could easily subdue it, but if he encountered a higher god, he had to risk his life no matter how much.
Besides, this is the enemy’s headquarters. It would have been better to abandon the idea of letting the enemy fight one-on-one here.
[Kim Yoo-jung. Let’s talk telepathically from here on out. Because I think it would be better to be as careful as possible.]
[Okay.]
Kim Yoo-jung immediately replied to Jae-hyun’s words and nodded.
It wasn’t too difficult to sneak into the robe, which concealed even the use of magic as much as possible. It was thanks to the robe that blocked out any sounds or signs.
In addition to that, Jaehyun is a magical genius.
It was no longer difficult for him to recreate the enchantment on the robe and perform multiple types of casting at the same time.
He made a higher version of the cognitive ‘Robe of Error’ he had made in the past, put it on, and slowly entered the interior.
By the way, they had just passed Valhalla and were passing through the garden Frey had told them about.
[Is that that?]
Along with Kim Yoo-jung’s telepathy, Jae-hyeon’s gaze goes to one place.
The place where his eyes reached was none other than a huge stone chamber.
A huge door made of stone. Even a lock that can be turned by inserting a key under it. Jaehyun was sure.
That this place is the ‘treasure storehouse of the gods’ that Frey said.
That’s when Jaehyun started moving forward little by little.
Krrrrr…!
A dark shadow fell from above the stone chamber along with the voice of a ferocious beast somewhere. Jaehyun and Kim Yoojung’s eyes turn at the same time.

chapters.title: Chapter 394
chapters.content:
Episode 394 Treasure Vault of the Gods
A treasure chest full of the most mythical weapons in Asgard.
There is one guarding it.
These are Odin’s rune words and long agony. And it was the product of transcendent black magic.
It was a kind of chimera, and its name was ‘Astel’. It was the guy named for protecting the treasures of the As gods.
Even if I stretched my magic for a moment and measured it, the rank of the monster was indescribable.
Jaehyun frowned.
‘Damn… This is not a good situation.’
Astel’s existence is, of course, thoroughly hidden except for Asgard’s gods.
The anti-Aesir forces, including Jae-hyun, were not even aware that such a threatening being was guarding the stone chamber.
Jaehyun looked up for a moment and saw a dog guarding the stone chamber below.
Like Garreum in Norse mythology, he was very large and stained his chest with fresh blood.
Garm was the dog guarding Helheim, and it seems that Odin created a being like this with him as a motif.
[What should I do?]
Kim Yoo-jung asked. Jaehyun couldn’t help but think for a while.
‘It’s not a big deal to subdue. The really big problem is the noise generated during the suppression process.’
This is where the dead stay. it’s Valhalla
In Norse mythology, the main army of Einherjar and Odin is stationed. Any commotion here could have resulted in an instant encirclement.
[For now, let’s silence the noise and get as close as possible.]
Kim Yoo-jung nodded to Jae-hyeon’s telepathy and followed.
Jae-hyeon contrasted the figure of Gareum in Shinhwa more closely and found out that he was a bit bigger and darker.
Other than that, there were no other crops.
‘As expected, I have no choice but to bump into it.’
It was when I thought so.
“Oh Astel. You are also very sincere. Who dares to stand in your way so stubbornly that you are coming to rob Asgard’s warehouse?”
I heard someone’s voice. The voice was a little frivolous.
Jaehyun narrowed his eyes and hid in a corner. Soon, his body trembled. There was someone there that he had no choice but to know.
[……Thor. Hide your magical energy as much as possible and be careful.]
[…Yeah.]
Jaehyun immediately warned. A hammer with a short handle attached to the waist. I saw Thor wearing Mjolnir. He brought a large piece of meat and set it down in front of Astel.
“Eat a lot. It is red dragon meat.”
Astell approached Thor and immediately began to eat the meat.
It seemed like a regular thing.
“You must have been very hungry. Well, it can’t be helped to maintain that size.”
Thor, who had been saying that, thought for a moment and then said.
“Anyway, that’s very strange… I thought even Heimdall would die. I never thought I’d die from those comrades who weren’t even opponents.”
Astell raised his head and chewed on the bone. Thor had his thick hands on his head.
“I don’t know if it’s dirty giants. At least to die to humans. It’s not something you can easily understand. There must be something wrong.”
As Thor said, he added one last word.
“The most suspicious thing is Hugin… that crow. I will definitely catch that dirty back.”
After Thor had finished speaking, he was disappearing across the garden before he knew it.
‘Thor and the discerning gods of Asgard already seemed to know that Hugin had betrayed them. I got information from an unexpected place.’
Contrary to Jaehyun’s thoughts, their bodies were wet with sweat.
It was because I was too nervous.
The two of them barely sighed. If it wasn’t for the invisible robe and skill, there would have been a battle without a doubt being caught by Thor.
Maybe he died from a joint attack.
Thinking so, I felt a chill run down my spine for no reason.
After all, I thought that there is no human being who can remain calm in the face of the primal fear of death.
Jaehyun looked at Kim Yoojung. She also didn’t look good.
It seemed that he was greatly shocked by Thor’s rank.
[Are you okay?]
[It’s ridiculous… It’s completely different from Heimdall… How can you do that…]
Kim Yoo-jung sparsely said that. She was pale with fear.
Jaehyun put a hand on her shoulder to calm her down and pointed forward.
[I understand your surprise, but you have to move now. And… It seems like we have a chance.]
[…A chance?]
Kim Yoo-jung came to her senses and said. Jaehyun nodded.
[okay. It seems like an opportunity that can only be used once… How is it? Do you want to try it?]
Kim Yoo-jung looked in front of Jae-hyun’s gesture. There, I could see Astel’s eyes slowly closing because she was full.
It seemed he was going to bed soon.
Jaehyun smiled.
[There’s a good skill at times like this.]
After getting as close as possible to Astell’s nose, Jaehyun carefully stretched out his hand and placed it on his head.
Krrrrr!
Astell, embarrassed by the unfamiliar touch, made a sound, but it quickly subsided.
It was thanks to the magic that Jaehyun had activated.
―Active skill «Sleep Lv 5».
Sleep, a magic that grants a drowsy effect.
Although it is a basic magic, it exerts an almost invincible effect when used on a sleepy person. To Astel, who was sleepy right now, the effect of this skill meant that it was outstanding.
Kreur… Le…
Jaehyun’s prediction was exactly right. Astell collapsed and began to fall asleep.
Jaehyun smiled in satisfaction.
However, he did not forget to add one thing to Kim Yoo-jung.
[No matter how much I put him to sleep, he’ll wake up in less than 30 minutes. Before that, you have to rob the warehouse. Got it?]
[Ah yeah…!]
Kim Yoo-jung nodded immediately. Jaehyun nodded his head with a proud expression.
‘I didn’t know there would be a time when Thor would be helpful in this way… but I’ll use whatever is available.’
Jaehyun thought about that and immediately put the key he was holding into the stone chamber.
Deed deed…!
The sound never leaked out. It was the effect of magic silence.
Like that, Jaehyun and Kim Yoojung are the treasure house of the gods. In other words, I was able to set foot inside the place where Odin and the As gods lived.
[Papi. You keep an eye on Astel to make sure he doesn’t wake up here. If anything happens, you must let me know right away. Okay?]
[Greung.]
Papi gave a short salute to Jaehyun. It was Poppy who, thanks to her growing up, learned how to answer quietly over her shoulder.
* * *
Stone chamber.
The inside of the place, which is said to be the treasure house of the gods, was truly splendid.
Numerous artifacts piled up everywhere. It was a level that was difficult to gauge the grade even at a glance. At least, there were a variety of weapons piled up, from S-class to mythical.
However, before coming here for the first time, Frey had said.
He said that he should never touch any other item except his own magic sword. If you do that, Asgard’s security system will activate, so you will surely die.
However, it was not a big problem for Jaehyun. Stealing an item might be difficult, but copying it magically wasn’t that difficult.
In the first place, the condition for copying arms was just touching it once.
Jaehyun had nothing to worry about.
The security system is activated when you go outside with an item. By exploiting the loopholes in the system, Jaehyun could get more than he thought.
After Jaehyun nodded, he looked around and touched the arms. Thanks to this, the number of weapons that could be copied continued to increase.
It’s just that it’s difficult to use it often because it’s not engraved, but…
‘Because each weapon has its own characteristics. It’s good if you can use it anytime. Nothing bad.’
Jaehyun thought so, so he didn’t worry.
[By the way, where is Frey’s magic sword?]
In response to Kim Yoo-jung’s question, Jae-hyeon continued to look around and answered.
[Maybe I should go inside. Because the other guys say they can’t even handle magic swords anyway.]
Because Frey can only handle his magic sword. He said that the other gods couldn’t have installed a security device.
I heard that even Odin’s hands would burn just by touching it.
In addition, magic swords are basically long swords, but can be used by floating in the air with magical power. It is said to have a rounded end.
Jaehyun started looking for such a weapon.
First the shelf, then the floor, then the wall.

taking a breath After relaxing the muscles of the whole body, it observes the movements of the enemy like a beast. Concentration to see through everything.

* * *
A night with a full moon in mid-heaven.
Having made up her mind, Freya visited Odin’s palace with a gloomy expression.

nothing was known

built sometime. The plan to destroy Asgard that I told Sigrun. that it should be implemented as soon as possible.

Odin’s raven.

pounding. pounding. pounding. pounding.

did you notice this?

tissue destruction. The imprint of destruction began to take effect.

she shouted quickly.

why at that moment

Odin’s overbearing voice. At that, Frigg felt an irresistible fear. At the same time, he felt his own body moving at its own pace and moving little by little towards him.

like that.

predestined death.

he was dying

Something blurry was everything.

remember him

The highest point among the lofty peaks. you can climb there.

The adversary in it will not be able to kill itself.
The corners of Odin’s mouth rose very slightly.

Drooling!

Episode 417 Twilight (1)
Twilight descends.
Cold air and silence fill Odin’s throne.
By now Midgard would be at war. Perhaps Thor is holding back his adversary, and the rest of the Valkyries are also fighting for themselves.
‘Freya’s betrayal was expected. It was like a ticking time bomb that was about to explode. It’s not something to be embarrassed about just because it exploded.’
Odin was infinitely calm. The opponents are strong, but no matter how strong they are, they will not be able to overcome Thor and come this far.
The target he should check now is rather Loki.
It was a guy who might soon reach his very eyes.
“Now time is on my side. Loki… and the antagonist. What can you do? What can be changed is just your insignificant roles.”
“Do you really think so?”
At that time when Odin muttered while thinking so.
A man appeared before Odin’s eyes.
Hugin. A crow that left the battlefield a while ago.
He appeared directly in front of Odin.
“The lowly servant will ask the master first.”
Hugin asked in his usual calm voice.
“What is your purpose?”
It was not a question that one could dare to ask the ruler, Odin, about the crow. However, he asked with sunken eyes without even a hint of agitation.
It means that it was meant to be this way from the beginning.
Odin looked at Hugin carefully and replied calmly.
“Everything.”
“Is everything?”
“Yes. It’s all about getting your hands on it. To do so, I need proof that I am the loser of the world.
Yes… that means ‘that sword’ must be held in my hand.”
Hugin said with a forced self-deprecating smile.
“As expected, what you want is different from what I want.”
“different?”
Odin let out a bitter laugh.
“What on earth is the meaning of what the feelings of an insignificant creature like you want to me?
You also believed in me and followed me. During the last tens of thousands of years and aeons of time. isn’t it? Why have you changed your mind now?”
“Because that wasn’t what I wanted from the start.”
Hugin’s story baffled even Odin, who prided himself on knowing everything. Why is he talking like this?
If so, what is the real reason you followed yourself until now?
Hugin quickly added a reason.
“…I followed you because I believed that holding everything in my hands would bring me peace. But it wasn’t like that. You were a plunderer, a man of greed, not peace.”
Hugin was calm. His eyes contain emotions for the first time. The magic that had been controlling his emotions was lifted.
The cost of that was terrible and painful indeed. right after the magic is lifted. All the emotions he remembered began to vividly come back to Hugin. It
came
with memories, sometimes with remorse,
sometimes with sin,
sometimes with pain, and sometimes with compassion.
The mistake he had repeatedly made while following Odin for eons of time.
Now, as a burden, it weighs him down. Hugin didn’t do anything other than deal with it.
endured
The memories of the past, the memories and painful times that Jaehyun must have experienced before returning someday on that timeline…
“It can’t help but be funny. Just having feelings makes a person so weak.”
“Because of that, I forbade you to have feelings. Emotions are just a useless variable for not only you but also many people who follow me.
Emotions only bring disaster to people in the end.”
“Catastrophe.”
Hugin cut off and took a step forward.
“It has already come from you. Odin.”
“It is disrespectful. Hugin. my crow Now, you know very well that these words have no meaning. then.”
Odin lifted his hand to let go.
“As the owner, I will take you.”
Fu-wook!

However, even at this moment, Odin did not guess.
What Hugin has left for the adversary in the final moments of the end.
How big of an impact that will bring in the battle later.
* * *
“Yeah I know. That your sisters sacrificed and continued to work hard even in hell.”
“great job. really. Soon this story will come to an end. Will your names appear in the epilogue? Probably. I will make sure to do that.”
“So… can you help me one last time? Just like when we first promised.”
* * *
The light goes out.
All living things in the nine worlds slowly begin to lose their powers. Like oiled torches hanging on the wall, people’s lives become weeds and shimmer.

Jaehyun.

for example.

Seo In-na, who suddenly broke off a kiss before realizing her feelings properly, is now married.
She was also in a situation where objectification was complete about being ashamed of her actions. So, to put it simply, the current situation was like that.
It’s rat poison for both of them!
“Then what should I call it?”

I could feel Seo Eana’s reply sound slightly out of sync.
Jaehyun was sure.
Both of them said that this title would give them trouble all day today.

chapters.content:
Extraversion 15. Ending – Seo Eana (4)
“…Now, are you… are you?”
Seo Ina’s voice creeped in. His face became angry. It was quite embarrassing to have a head bent toward the floor and not wanting to come up.
It was the same with Jaehyun, but he endured the shame anyway and was barely getting used to the sentence ‘darling’.
“Uh… uh. babe?”
“…….”
Seo Eana couldn’t hide her joy when she saw Jaehyun.
Did I say it was a nickname I had been dreaming of?
Jae-hyun, unexpectedly, thought that Seo E-na’s wish was ordinary, but felt his own weakness to endure shame.
‘Feeling pain from this kind of nickname… Is it because I’m still far short of becoming a god?’
It was Jaehyun who thought in a completely different way, but unfortunately, there was no one to correct his thoughts.
Thanks to this, he had no doubt that his lack of practice had resulted in such a disgrace.
Even worse, in the case of Seo Eana, she couldn’t even raise her face at all.
“…Jaehyun, that… my heart hurts, but can I take a break and try again…?”
Jaehyun shook his head resolutely at Seo Ina’s sad voice.
“no. did you forget Did it take two hours just to get us to sleep? It’s already six hours. The honeymoon was only a few hours away. It shouldn’t take all day like this.”
“……That’s true, though.”
Seo Ina said that in a volmening voice, but Jaehyun didn’t care.
If something needs to be done someday, do it as quickly as possible.
Because this was the creed of representation.
“babe.”
Jaehyun lowered his voice and said that.
As if there was nothing she could do about it, Seo Ina checked Jaehyun’s eyes and looked up at him with slightly open eyes as she answered.
“…yeah honey.”
For a brief moment, a tingling sensation ran through my body.
This… I was happier than I thought.
Jaehyun decided to enjoy this situation a little more since he hadn’t shown it to anyone yet.
In fact, Seo In-na’s reaction was steady and interesting, so Jae-hyun kept asking her to call him in the name of tidying up the names.
Seo In-na, of course, did not know the true intentions of Jae-hyun, who was dark like this, and kept calling him by the title of ‘darling’, with a blushing expression.
“Inaya.”
“…Darling… I told you to call me.”
When Jae-hyun suddenly calls out to her with a smile, Seo In-na opens her eyes and says that, as if she finally realized that she had been tricked by Jae-hyun.
Jaehyun immediately covered his mouth with a smile and answered again.
“why? babe?”
Jaehyun decided to go out brazenly now.
Did you say that man is an animal of adaptation?
Perhaps this was also steadily applied to Jaehyun, who gained divine status, after Jaehyun quickly got used to the title.
“…Then, are we done with the title arrangements?”
Jaehyun nodded slightly at Seo Ina’s question.
Then she asked another question this time.
“…Do you have any plans left for today?”
“well. It was pretty hard… Let’s unpack and rest. I’ll take a look at it tomorrow.”
“…huh. if you like it.”
Seo In-na leaned on Jae-hyun’s shoulder as if she liked anything and smiled lightly.
Jaehyun gently stroked Seo Ina’s hair.
Then there was silence for a while.
After a while, Jaehyun and Seo Eana were startled by the sound of the second hand of the clock hanging on the wall.
It’s new, but hearing intermittently tells you the situation you’re currently in the most straightforward way. For instance, the two of them were now sitting side by side on the bed…
and the fact that this situation could not easily be passed between a man and a woman in love. So, Jae-Hyun and Seo E-Na suddenly realized.
They are now on their honeymoon, and the current time is 1:00 in the morning.
What is usually a newly married couple to do in a hotel?
Question after question leads them to come up with an obvious answer.
gulp.
Unknowingly, Jaehyun’s throat, which had been swallowing saliva, made a loud noise.
It was a prime example of how you can tell that he is rigid at once even though he has almost no tension.
Seo Ina was no different.
Only the secret silence that flows between the two tells us what the current situation is like.
And…
Jaehyun finally made up his mind.
It was because he intuitively knew what he had to do now, no matter how bad he was in dating.
“Inaya. I’ve been thinking about it.”
“…huh.”
“Isn’t it the first day of your honeymoon? That… I know you’re tired and exhausted. I think we have something to do…”
Jaehyun didn’t even know what he was talking about anymore.
Now it was time for Seo Ina and herself.
The silence between the two of us that would have been a lie if we hadn’t imagined it for a long time.
It wasn’t awkward at all.
By the time this silence is over, Seo Eana as well as herself will have a completely different relationship than before.
The weight of the titles that have been sorted out so far will be added.
Knowing that, Jaehyun wanted to lead this situation more perfectly.
“There is something I want to do… I want to know if that’s what you want too. Can you tell me?”
Jaehyun lightly tousled Seo Ina’s hair and hugged her, sharing the sound of her beating heart. It’s like something is about to happen.
Seo In-na smiled at Jae-hyun’s rarely honest feelings and hugged him tightly.
“……huh. I know. And… I’ve come this far. Of course I want it too.”
Jaehyun barely controlled his beating heart and cautiously bent down on the bed to avoid hurting Seo Ina. The composition of herself looking down at Ina Seo from above.
It was the first time for the two of them, but they intuitively knew what to do in this situation. Seo Ina smiled more transparently than ever while watching Jaehyun approaching her.
“…will you kiss me?”
It didn’t take long for Jaehyun and Seo Eana’s lips to collide.
The night between the two people, which began, took on a beautiful color as if it would never end forever as it was caught at the end of dawn.
Jaehyun seemed to know what love was like.
It’s okay to give up everything, so I want to continue to be with this person.
Vivid emotions embraced Jaehyun, and the most beautiful time left deep in the minds of the two.
At dawn when anything can begin.
The two swore a new relationship like that.
* * *
Alfheim’s late morning was very beautiful, as if trying to relieve the tiredness of the two. Jaehyun stood up from his seat after looking at Ina Seo who was sleeping next to him.
Even though he didn’t set the alarm on his watch, he wakes up at six o’clock.
It was because I had already become accustomed to working as a radar for a long time. Not to mention, having a transcendent body, he had no trouble continuing his life without sleeping.
Of course, after a grueling event like yesterday, it is good to be forced to sleep. Sleep is basically mental fatigue is also quite a bit of a bit of a bit of a bit of a bit of a bit of a bit of a bit of a bit of a bit of a bit of
Recalling the events of yesterday, Jaehyun felt his face heat up for a moment.
The moonlight seeped through and Seo Eana’s face shone transparently.
From the light fragrance to the subtle atmosphere leaking out and the beating heart.
“What have I done?”
As Jaehyun muttered that without even realizing it, Seo Ina, who opened her eyes before I knew it, smiled at me and hugged me tightly into Jaehyun’s arms.
“…What are you thinking about?”
“Ah, just…”
Jaehyun couldn’t bear to say that his face reminded him of yesterday, so he covered it moderately.
But Seo Eana already seemed to know why he reacted that way. Actually, yesterday’s incident was a big incident for Seo Ina as well, so there was a bit of awkwardness between the two of them, but…
Seo Ina smiled faintly as if it didn’t matter, and put Jaehyun back on the bed. Then he pokes Jaehyun’s cheek and laughs.
Jaehyun suddenly became her toy and asked in vain.
“Is it Inaya?”
“…no. It’s just…….”
Seo Eana hurriedly picked up the words, but it was Jaehyun who realized that he had already become a toy.
As if he couldn’t help it, he gave the ball to Seo Ina like that for a while.
After waking up late in the morning, it was lunch time and I went down to the restaurant.
Breakfast, lunch and dinner are provided at the hotel, of course. There was no problem even if the two of them went down a little late because the food was prepared so that they could eat it anytime they went down.
Jaehyun ordered coffee and egg tarts for dessert in advance, and then ordered beefsteak for dinner.
It’s because I was pretty hungry because I had a hard day yesterday.
Seo Eana also chose the same menu as Jaehyun. In response to Jaehyun’s question why she is doing that, Ina says she just wants to do that. was just replying.
“By the way, what are we going to do today?”
Jaehyun said as he cut the meat into large pieces and put it in his mouth.
Seo Ina thought for a moment and then said.
“……well. I think they said the hot springs nearby were good. I guess I’ll have to go and see what it’s like.”
“What is left is time. Loki has to do some work anyway… let’s go together.”
Jaehyun regretted it within a few hours after saying that.
No matter how much I got used to it yesterday, in order to enter the hot springs with Seo Ina…
it was because the two of them had to wear swimsuits.
“…….”
“…….”
There was a deep silence between the two of them.
Looking closely, Seo In-na’s expression was also very reminded, not only her cheeks were red, but her shoulders and other parts that I couldn’t see properly because it was dark yesterday were also red.
Jaehyun felt dizzy.
Spa?
It was good enough.
It was to the extent that he could understand why the elves boasted and recommended it to him.
One… The biggest problem right now was Seo Eana’s outfit.
“……that is. Can I ask just one question?”
“……huh.”
In response, Seo In-na squatted down to cover the most exposed area of her clothes in the water and held her legs together.
Jaehyun took a deep breath and asked her.
“Who the hell is the person who put that dress on you?”
It was an unavoidable question.
As for Jaehyun, it was because I was sure that Eana Seo would never have chosen this outfit on her own volition.
The reason was simple.
What she is currently wearing is a bikini. It was a bikini with a small area, and it was enough to embarrass Jaehyun in many ways.
But that was then.
The unexpected answer came back from Seo Eana.
“……This is what I chose.”
huh?
Jaehyun tilted his head and looked at her.
Seo Eana made bubbling bubbles with her face dipped in water.
And then it connects like this:
“…I didn’t expect it to be this embarrassing, but this is what I chose.”
Jaehyun felt the string of rationality break. Then, I tried hard to calm my beating heart… I couldn’t calm it down.
“…Jaehyun?”
“You know this is all your fault, right?”
Jaehyun slowly began to close the distance towards Seo Ina.
It didn’t take long for the distance between the two of them to narrow.

whispering voice.

uh? It shouldn’t be like this.

Jaehyun was still lacking in knowing a woman’s heart.
I think I need to study in many ways.
Jaehyun sighed for a moment as he thought about it.
Meanwhile at that time.

How on earth did Jaehyun, who doesn’t know anything about women’s feelings, say such a thing?

It’s more important that you feel good right now.

purr!

jump.

a light smile. However, the self-righteousness hidden beneath it makes Lee Jae-sang tremble.

bang!
